title: Design of multi-channel interconnection controller based on TMS320F28335
abstract: With the development of science and technology;various interconnected controllers have been widely used in fields such as aerospace and industrial control. In order to meet the requirements of the interconnection controller for data acquisition and output signal accuracy;channel number;and other aspects;a multi-channel and high-precision interconnection controller based on TMS320F28335 was designed. The overall system architecture of the interconnection controller was provided;corresponding hardware and software were designed;and the interconnection controller was tested and verified. The test results show that the designed 4 mA constant current source can drive the sensor to collect vibration signals normally. The designed low-pass filter has a good filtering effect on signals above 350 Hz. The input voltage range of the 12 ADC acquisition channels is ± 5 V;and the voltage range of the 6 DAC output channels is ±10 V. The deviation between the acquisition and output signals is within 5 ‰.

title: FPGA software online upgrade method based on DSP28335
abstract: In embedded systems based on DSP + FPGA architecture;some products do not have the conditions to disassemble the shell and upgrade the software through the JTAG interface. A method for online upgrading FPGA software based on TMS320F28335 is proposed to address this issue. This method sends FPGA code to TMS320F28335 through the upper computer;then TMS320F28335 simulates JTAG timing through GPIO to complete the erase;program;and verify operations of the configured PROM chip. After re-powering on;the FPGA loads the new program from the configured PROM. On the basis of theoretical analysis;the hardware schematic diagram and software implementation process of the proposed method are provided. A large number of experimental results indicate that this method has good feasibility;stability;and reliability;and can achieve the goal of upgrading FPGA software without disassembling the product under the DSP+FPGA architecture.

title: Design and Implementation of a Reading Room Environmental Monitoring System Based on Zigbee
abstract: To effectively monitor parameters such as room temperature; humidity; carbon monoxide; and lighting in the library; this paper proposes a reading room environment monitoring system based on Zigbee wireless sensor network technology. The system is designed based on a three-layer system of the Internet of Things;including the perception layer; network layer; and application layer. The CC2530 microcontroller is used to design the terminal node and gateway node modules of Zigbee; and a reading room environment monitoring cloud platform with functions such as data display; policy settings; sensor settings; and actuator settings is constructed. The simulation test results show that the system can effectively achieve automatic adjustment of reading room temperature and humidity; as well as control of lighting and lighting. It has the function of real-time pushing weather information and monitoring fire alarms; providing a low-cost and easily deployable feasible solution for reading room environmental monitoring.
keywords: book reading room, cloud platform, environmental monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: Fujian Polytechnic of Information Technology, The Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence College

title: Miniaturized K-Band Frequency Source Design Based on PhaseLocked Loop Technology
abstract: In the field of broadband electromagnetic receivers; high-frequency frequency sources usually have problems such as low output power and poor phase noise performance; so frequency source performance is particularly important. To address this problem; this paper uses phase-locked loop and frequency multiplication design methods to design a miniaturized K-band frequency source. First; the phase-locked loop circuit; control unit circuit and voltage-stabilized power supply circuit are designed; and then the frequency source is modeled and simulated to verify its feasibility. The phase-locked loop circuit and control unit are completed by using cavity design and micro-assembly; the design of the voltage-stabilized power supply circuit and the frequency multiplier; and finally the frequency source was tested. The test results show that the output frequency of this frequency source is 25. 6 GHz; the output power is greater than 10 dBm; its normalized phase noise is-76 dBc/Hz@100 kHz; and its overall size is 60 mm×40 mm×8 mm. The designed frequency source has the advantages of small size; excellent performance and longterm stable operation; and it can meet the application requirements of broadband receiver engineering.
keywords: frequency source, k-band, lmx2594, modeling simulation

title: 一种低功耗无线温湿度采集设备的设计
abstract: 在某些特定场所，环境温度采集有着特殊的要求，论文提出一种基于蓝牙通信技术的便携式低功耗温湿度环境参数采集设备的设计方法。该方法设计采用CC2640芯片及SHT45数字温湿度传感器，由嵌入式控制芯片对封闭空间中的温湿度进行实时检测、采集与存储，可广泛应用于船舱舱体、装备存储库房、装备贮运箱、岛礁环境的温湿度监测。

title: 煤矿主要通风机智能保护器的设计及应用
abstract: 针对山西某矿主要通风机系统存在自动化智能化水平低、保护性差、实时性差的问题，应用TMS320F28335芯片为该矿主要通风机系统设计了一种智能保护器，对具体设计状况进行了介绍，并实施了试验验证，所得出的试验结果为：该智能保护器不仅实时性好，保护性强，而且运行稳定可靠，有助于提升矿井通风系统运行的自动化和智能化水平，更好地保障矿井安全通风。

title: 基于CC2530单片机控制的温室大棚环境调节系统设计
abstract: 该文设计一种基于CC2530单片机控制的温室大棚环境调节系统，使用CC2530单片机作为系统核心控制处理器，利用传感器技术和无线通信技术实现温室大棚中的农作物生长信息数据采集，包括空气温湿度、二氧化碳浓度、光照强度、土壤酸碱度pH、水分传感器等参数的实时采集、传输、分析控制，实现温室大棚内部环境的远程自动调节，提供系统各控制参数的历史曲线和实时曲线以供分析，做出决策管理，实现农作物的生产管理透明化、自动化、智能化、协同化的现代管理模式。
keywords: cc2530单片机, 传感器技术, 无线通信技术, 温室大棚, 调节系统

title: 基于ZigBee的温室无线测控网络构建
abstract: 针对现有温室大棚缺乏有效在线测控手段，以及布线困难等问题，设计开发了基于ZigBee的温室无线测控网络，将信息采集、无线传输、数据处理与远程控制集于一体，既可解决数据远程传输技术问题，又避免安装大量传感器和终端设备的弊端，从而满足温室环境监测过程中对多测点、多要素、移动性、便捷性等方面的要求。系统采用ZigBee星型拓扑结构，温湿度传感器采用DHT11，微处理器采用超低功耗片上系统CC2530，实现数据的多点采集和无线传输。从硬件和软件两方面考虑了低功耗设计的要求，搭建了系统的硬件结构及软件设计方案。最后实验调试结果表明，搭建的网络可实现良好的自组网性和可扩展性，工作性能稳定，并且有效简化了现场设备安装与拆移等过程，使之更适合温室大棚现场数据测控的需求。
keywords: zigbee, 无线测控, 温湿度传感器
affiliations: 平江县农业农村局, 平江县自然资源局

title: 智能温室大棚自动控制系统的设计
abstract: 我国温室大棚应用比较普遍，很大程度上促进了我国农业的发展。但我国温室大棚长期以来主要依靠人工管理，工作量大，而且对植物生长环境的把控不精确，对农作物产量造成影响。针对这些问题，设计以CC2530搭建的ZigBee无线网络为核心的智能温室大棚自动控制系统，将各传感器及各执行机构连接到CC2530上形成不同功能的网络节点，可以实时监测大棚内空气湿度、土壤湿度、光照强度、温度，同时按照植物的生长环境需求进行补光、浇水、通风、降温等操作，将环境变量控制在用户设定的范围内。此系统通过无线网络进行信息传输，解决长距离信号不良的问题，对各节点的控制更加灵活。在农业温室大棚中，此系统具有较大的实用价值与较高的经济效益。
keywords: zigbee, 无线传输, 智能温室大棚, 环境, 自动控制
affiliations: 鄂尔多斯应用技术学院

title: 面向FT-M6678的对称矩阵特征值求解算法实现与优化
abstract: 目前国产自主可控FT-M6678平台上没有对称矩阵特征值求解相关的实现，且平台上现有数学计算库不能很好地满足类似问题求解的需求。面向国产FT-M6678处理器，对对称矩阵特征值求解（SYEV）算法进行实现与优化，完善FT-M6678平台的线性代数计算库。通过对SYEV算法的实现过程以及运行热点的分析，基于FT-M6678平台进行编译优化、访存优化以及向量并行化优化，其中：编译优化是根据不同的编译选项指导编译器对程序优化以达到加速效果；访存优化包括缓存优化以及数据段与程序段的分配优化，用于提高矩阵数据的访存效率；向量并行化优化包括循环展开以及适配FT-M6678平台的单指令多数据流（SIMD）指令并行优化，用于提升程序的计算效率。在FT-M6678平台上对所实现并优化的算法进行正确性验证与优化性能分析，结果表明，算法能够正确通过LAPACK官方测试集测试，并且在FT-M6678平台上的加速效果可达到58.346倍，对比TMS320C6678平台速度可提升2.053倍。
keywords: ft-m6678平台, 向量并行, 对称矩阵特征值, 热点分析, 缓存优化
authors: 罗有才;于立;商建东;韩林
affiliations: 国家超级计算郑州中心, 郑州大学计算机与人工智能学院

title: 基于Zigbee无线传感系统的设计与应用
abstract: 无线传感网络（WSN）近年来在不同的领域得到了广泛的应用，基于此，采用Zigbee无线网络数据协议，搭建无线传感系统，采用TI公司的CC2530F256无线通信芯片进行硬件和软件的详细设计。可将节点数据传送至协调员或计算机终端，具备显示和控制功能，收集和分析有关数据信息。并分析其搭载不同类型传感器在环境、工业、农业、智慧城市、军事等领域的的具体应用。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 无线传感网络

title: 自驱动关节臂测量机多电机同步控制系统
abstract: 为了解决自驱动关节臂坐标测量机的多电机同步转动问题，设计了一套多电机同步控制系统。该系统选用以TMS320F28335为核心的DSP处理器，依次设计了双CAN通信电路、功率逆变电路、电机驱动电路等驱动板接口电路；利用Simulink建立了六电机同步转动控制仿真模型，将电机控制模型转化为工程代码，对六电机设定不同的位置角度进行点到点位置同步实验，以及多电机轨迹跟踪实验。实验结果分析得到同步控制时间精度在10ms以内，验证了六电机的同步控制有效性，为提高测量机的运动平稳性和测量效率提供参考依据。
keywords: dsp, 同步控制, 多电机, 自驱动关节臂

title: 基于无线传感网络的采煤机监控技术研究
abstract: 针对采煤机有线检测系统因布线繁琐且故障率高、系统灵活性差及扩展功能受限导致的采煤机故障频发、系统通信时常中断等问题，采用低功耗、可靠性高的Zigbee无线通讯技术对采煤机状态监测系统进行设计。新系统采用智能传感器终端现场采集采煤机工况参数，以CC2530进行监测数据发送接收、串口完成上位机通信，通过上位机可直观、动态掌握采煤机运行状况，有效提高采煤机运行可靠性。
keywords: 无线通信, 状态监测, 采煤机
affiliations: 山西焦煤西山煤电西铭矿

title: 煤矿井下通风智能管控系统设计与试验
abstract: 针对煤矿井下通风管控系统存在的网络结构不合理、风速检测不准确、动态调节能力差、环境监测参数不完善等问题，设计煤矿井下通风智能管控系统，包括以TMS320F2812芯片为核心的通风智能管控系统硬件、软件方案，由芯片实时采集巷道环境参数并控制变频器输出，达到动态调节风机转速的目的；由TCP/IP通讯、CAN总线通信技术组建通风系统数据传输网络，通过地面调度室实现对井下通风系统的远程监控；最后完成试验分析。试验分析结果表明，该通风智能管控系统满足设计要求，提升了煤矿井下通风管控系统的智能化水平，保障了煤矿井下安全、高效生产。
keywords: tms320f2812芯片, 变频控制, 通风管控系统
affiliations: 晋能控股装备制造集团晟泰公司

title: 基于FPGA的高速ADC数据采集系统设计
abstract: 针对激光扫描共聚焦显微镜的大视场、高分辨率需求，为在振镜扫描的时间内获取更多数据量，设计一种基于FPGA的高速数据采集系统。该系统采用Xilinx的A7系列FPGA作为主控芯片，同时选用TI公司提供的LMK0482X系列时钟发生器和一款支持JESD204B协议的单通道14位高速ADC14X250芯片共同组成信号采集系统。系统使用Verilog硬件描述语言在Vivado平台下实现各模块功能，通过SPI协议完成LMK0482X和ADC14X250芯片的寄存器配置，利用Xilinx提供的JESD204B IP核构建基于AXI协议的高速串行数据链路，实现ADC与FPGA之间高效的数据采集传输。实验结果表明，在5 Gbps的传输速率下，接口可以正确接收与解析数据，系统的采样速率可达到250 Mbps，数据采样精度为14 bit，符合激光扫描共聚焦成像仪器的数据采集要求。

title: “互联网+应急环境”的室内火灾应急响应模式
abstract: [目的/意义]构建“互联网+应急环境”的室内火灾应急响应模式;提高室内火灾应急响应效率。[方法/过程]从技术角度对“互联网+”的理念进行了深度剖析;创建了“互联网+”跨界融合技术实现框架。应用该框架;从应急环境与应急部门的联动机制、突发室内火灾事件的大数据集成、基于改进Zukoski室内火灾预警模型构建、基于知识推理的火灾应急响应方法等方面;构建了“互联网+应急环境”的室内火灾应急响应模式。应用该模式;使用CC2530物联网开发套件、Neo4j知识图谱工具以及Java EE技术;开发了基于多传感器的突发火灾预警仿真系统;并通过在室内环境燃烧纸条模拟火灾的方式进行了实验。[局限]实验仅在模拟环境下进行;在进入实际应用前;还需要进行大量的、更为真实的实验。[结果/结论]实验结果表明;本文构建的室内火灾应急响应模式行之有效。
keywords: “互联网+”, 火灾应急, 突发事件

title: 基于DSP的多普勒雷达测速仪的设计与实现
abstract: 为了进一步解决当前基于单片机的交通测速仪中存在的电路复杂、测量精度低、反应速度慢等问题，本文基于多普勒效应和快速傅里叶变换（FFT）原理，提出一种基于DSP芯片TMS320F2812的多普勒雷达测速仪，该测速仪以TMS320F2812为主控核心，对运动车辆产生的多普勒频移信号进行处理，进而计算其行驶速度。实验结果表明该测速仪测速效果与预期结果相符，可以在一定程度上缓解上述问题。
keywords: tms320f2812, 多普勒效应, 快速傅里叶变换, 雷达测速仪
affiliations: 宁波大学信息科学与工程学院

title: 一种可手机远程控制的智能浇水系统设计
abstract: 由于工作出差或旅游等导致人们无法及时观察到家中的盆栽或绿植的生长状态，为了解决这一问题，智能浇水系统应运而生。此系统采用CC2530（ZigBee）无线SOC芯片作为核心控制系统构建物联网，温湿度检测传感器放置于土壤内，并配置OV2640摄像头模块对植物进行实时监控，观测植物生长情况。之后通过ESP8266WiFi模块上传数据到服务器后，即可通过手机APP或小程序查看盆栽和花草的状态并实时发送浇水指令。同时，该系统还具备缺水报警功能，使照料植物轻松化，智能化。
keywords: 实时监控, 智能浇水, 远程控制
affiliations: 西安思源学院工学院

title: 智能照明控制系统的硬件设计
abstract: 照明设备无论在日常生活还是在工作中都必不可少。随着社会发展，人们生活品质逐渐提高，能源安全问题备受关注，节约照明所用的电能也成为节能重点，因此，智能照明控制系统尤为重要。主要介绍了基于STC12C5A32S2和CC2530的智能照明控制系统的硬件设计。选择STC12C5A32S2作为中央处理器的核心芯片、CC2530作为通信系统核心芯片，外加光敏电阻及热释电红外传感器，通过电路设计在理论上实现对照明的智能控制，并在此基础上对终端设备及遥控器等进行硬件设计。
keywords: cc2530, stc12c5a32s2, 无线通信, 智能照明, 自动控制

title: 基于TMS320F28335的绝对值编码器通信研究
abstract: 在高精度伺服控制应用场合中，通常需要获取绝对值光电编码器的数据测量信息。首先分析了绝对值编码器的特点以及RS-485通信原理，然后基于DSP的SCI模块设计了编码器通信接口电路和通信程序。结果表明，所设计的通信接口和程序能够实现DSP与编码器之间的通信。
keywords: dsp, 数据通信, 绝对值编码器

title: 一种成像定位与速度补偿系统
abstract: 实现基于TMS320F28335控制器的成像定位与速度补偿系统。通过绘制包含F28335最小系统、ADC采集、位置采集、电机控制等模块，完成控制板原理图与PCB。通过嵌入式软件编程实现接收上位机控制指令，根据当前传感器数值和PID与SVPWM等算法解算，控制两个永磁同步电机实现双轴空间定位与双轴速度补偿功能。经过实验与实际应用验证：该系统能够快速解析与响应上位机所发出的定位与补偿请求，且定位与补偿精度高。适合车载或航拍等需要大角度成像控制范围与需要速度补偿稳像成像的使用场景。
keywords: pid, svpwm, 成像定位, 永磁同步电机, 速度补偿

title: 基于智能视觉的变电站内人员异常行为辅助监控系统
abstract: 为解决变电站人工监控的各种弊端，设计基于智能视觉的变电站内人员异常行为辅助监控系统。在系统硬件部分，以无线芯片CC2530为核心连接硬件的各个模块，设计协调器以及电源等模块；在系统软件部分，运用人工智能与图像处理技术，预先对监控视频阴影处理，然后采用背景建模的方法，对视频中的信息描述，最后将HOG特征识别应用到异常行为检测中，实现变电站内人员异常行为辅助监控。实验结果表明，此次研究的变电站内人员异常行为辅助监控系统，在人多与人少的时候都具有较高的监控识别准确性，证明了此次研究的系统的应用效果。
keywords: 变电站, 定位, 异常行为, 智能视觉, 辅助监控, 远程视频
authors: 任宇路;刘毅敏;荆玉智;节连彬
affiliations: 国网朔州供电公司, 国网阳泉供电公司

title: 基于FPGA的无线传感器应用评标系统的网络控制器设计
abstract: 无人机等现代设备日益依赖于精确的无线传感器网络，但频繁的信号丢失和错误传输对其性能构成挑战。为此，研究提出了一种基于现场可编程门阵列的无线传感器应用评标系统网络控制器设计。该设计利用了FPGA结合ADS8365模数转换器和三轴振动传感器，并采用CC3200 RF电路模块实现无线通信。结果显示，在2 m测试距离下，所设计控制器的准确率为99%;漏包率为0.000 6%;传输速率高达0.230 M/s。在22 m距离下，该控制器的错误率和数据丢失率分别仅为0.042 1%和0.012 1%;远低于其他控制器。可以发现，所设计控制器在提高数据传输准确率和处理高峰数据流量方面具有显著优势。该研究对于未来无人机及其他设备在无线传感器网络中的数据处理具有重要意义。
keywords: fpga, 控制器, 无线传感器, 网络, 评标
authors: 李雅然;丁娜;韩靖雯;王耀方延
affiliations: 国网陕西省电力有限公司物资公司

title: PMSG和SRG同轴发电系统软硬件实验平台设计
abstract: 为了分析永磁同步发电机（PMSG）和开关磁阻发电机（SRG）的发电性能，研制了一套双电机同轴连接发电硬件实验平台，并搭建系统的软件仿真平台。软件实验仿真平台通过设定电机的转速、负载、控制参数等物理量，仿真GUI界面显示系统的主电路拓扑、电机结构、输出电压和电流波形等信息。硬件平台以DSP TMS320F28335为控制核心，集成了电源模块、功率变换器、驱动电路、隔离保护电路、电压电流检测电路、原动机、动态扭矩传感器和负载设备等。软硬件实验平台可完成两种发电机在不同工况下的发电性能分析对比实验和仿真。通过分析比较两种发电机在不同速度和不同负载情况下的发电功率、效率、发电电压、发电电流等性能指标，可使学生直观理解两种发电机的发电原理、控制方式和各自的优缺点，具有较高的教学应用价值。
keywords: pmsg, srg, 发电机, 电机实验平台
affiliations: 扬州大学, 扬州工业职业技术学院

title: 基于ZigBee的无线物联网传感系统
abstract: 传统环境监测领域的多点式传感器，存在多节点供电及布线困难或设备电池使用寿命短、节点成本高昂、扩展性差等痛点。针对上述痛点，该文设计开发了一种基于ZigBee无线传感网络系统。系统使用CC2530单片机作为终端节点联合多种传感器进行数据采集，设计ZigBee网关将终端节点所采集的数据转发至物联网云平台，用户可使用APP或者网页登录云平台进行远程查看系统终端节点状态信息，当系统监测到数据异常时向用户发送警报。系统性价比高、成本低廉，经测试，系统功耗相较于其他系统低，节点休眠电流仅为8μA，且可靠性和可拓展性高，能够在大棚养殖等对环境要求较高的行业进行部署使用，具有实际应用研究价值。
keywords: zigbee, 低功耗, 物联网, 环境监测
authors: 阮国辉;肖蕾;李冠希;吴海欣
affiliations: 广东技术师范大学自动化学院

title: 基于物联网的智能粮库监测系统研究与设计
abstract: 针对传统粮库环境监测系统具有布线困难、不易扩展、控制方式单一等问题，该文设计一款基于物联网的粮库智能监测系统。系统分为上位机和下位机，上位机基于Qt和Sqlite3数据库为平台，设计显示和控制界面；下位机以CC2530为主控制器，结合各种传感器和外围设备设计协调器和终端节点，利用ZigBee技术实现自组网功能。系统具有2种控制模式调节粮库环境，即手动模式和自动模式；手动模式下，用户可自主控制外围设备；自动模式下，系统可以根据设置的阈值区间自动控制外围设备。测试结果表明，系统满足粮库监测要求，可以实时监测粮库环境信息，具有预警和调节粮库环境等功能。
keywords: zigbee技术, 传感器, 单片机, 物联网, 监测系统
authors: 韩思蕊;苏世雄;马新华;李川
affiliations: 西安航空学院计算机学院

title: 基于物联网技术的棉籽储存温度监测系统
abstract: 基于物联网技术设计了1套棉籽储存温度监测系统，系统由数据采集端、服务器端和应用端构成。数据采集端包括电阻温度传感器、基于CC2530开发板的采集终端模块和协调器。服务器端为本地部署的云服务器，建立有PostgreSQL数据库。应用端为基于ThingsBoard平台开发的交互软件。电阻温度传感器将采集到的信号发送至蜂舞协议（Zig Bee）无线网络，协调器通过第4代移动通信技术信号将检测到的数据上传至本地云服务器，订阅用户可在应用终端查看温度变化情况。经过测试，该系统数据传输稳定，能够有效地实现棉籽储存温度的远程监测，可为棉籽储存温度监测提供重要的技术支持。
keywords: zigbee, 数据传输, 棉籽储存, 温度监测, 物联网
authors: 杨啸;张扬;张学亮;周冬丽;石文杰

title: 面向FT-M7002平台拉普拉斯算法的优化实现
abstract: 为了充分发挥国产FT高性能处理器的平台优势，针对其对拉普拉斯算法进行并行优化，在数据迁移的基础上使用DMA数据传输机制解决数组矩阵转置、数据访问不连续以及数据传输存在时间间隙的问题，提高了程序性能，充分发掘了程序的数据级和指令级并行性。实验结果表明，优化后的向量化并行算法较优化前，获得了2.02～2.55倍的加速效果。相较于TMS320C6678处理器，FT优化之后的算法可达到其1.48～2.56倍的效果。
keywords: dma数据传输, 并行优化, 拉普拉斯算法, 高性能处理器
authors: 商建东;郭子涵;范明亮;李靖

title: 基于串口的TMS320F2812软件升级方法研究与实现
abstract: 针对传统DSP应用程序烧写的缺陷，通过对DSP应用程序烧写原理的分析，设计了一种利用串口对应用程序进行升级的方法；首先阐述了在线升级方案的必要性、所依赖的硬件系统组成和在线升级方案的总体构架，然后分别对应用程序HEX数据文件的转换方法、HEX文件重新编码的Labview上位机软件设计方法和DSP嵌入式升级软件设计方法等进行了详细的描述，最后通过开环实验、FLASH数据对比实验及DSP控制系统功能验证实验，证明了基于串口的TMS320F2812软件升级方法的正确性和可行性，解决了DSP控制软件必须通过下载器进行烧写的缺点，提高了系统嵌入式软件升级的灵活性、可靠性，延长了产品寿命，该方法简单、实用，移植性强，为激光器控制系统及其它领域软件进行系统远程、无线升级奠定了基础。
keywords: api, dsp, labview, tms320f2812, 在线升级
authors: 朱虹;许廷金;袁鑫全;杨爱武
affiliations: 华北光电技术研究所

title: 随钻核磁仪器数字电路在系统编程实现方法
abstract: 受钻井过程中冲击和振动的影响;随钻核磁测井仪器的内部电路需要特殊封装;使得DSP和FPGA组成的数字电路系统不能正常通过JTAG接口升级程序。本文提出了一种基于串口总线的在系统编程技术。根据FLASH的配置特性和JTAG接口协议的特点;以DSP作为主控制器;利用自编写的底层程序将串口传输的配置文件分别烧写进DSP和FPGA内部FLASH中;实现了DSP和FPGA的在系统编程（ISP）。利用对TI TMS320F2812和Actel A3P1000的数字电路的系统调试;证明这种方法可靠性高、现场操作方便。
keywords: jtag, 串口, 在系统编程, 随钻测井仪器
authors: 吕焕军;娄伟;张嘉伟;陈敬智

title: 基于PID控制器的无轴承异步电机控制策略研究
abstract: 无轴承异步电机（Bearingless Induction Motor; BIM）具有摩擦小、无需润滑、运转速度高等优点，具有重要的研究和应用价值。但是相对于传统异步电机，无轴承异步电机的数学模型是一个强耦合、多变量、非线性的高阶函数，导致其控制策略相对复杂。为此，本文研究了一种基于PID控制器的无轴承异步电机气隙磁场定向控制策略，对其控制原理和实现方法进行了详细的论述，采用Matlab仿真软件对其有效性进行了验证，并基于TMS320F28335搭建了实验平台，对控制效果进行了验证。
keywords: pid控制器, 实验研究, 无轴承异步电机, 气隙磁场定向控制
affiliations: 国网江苏省电力有限公司涟水县供电分公司

title: 基于多传感器的阀室环境参数检测系统设计与实现
abstract: 针对油气管线所处位置偏僻、线路过长导致阀室分散，无法及时检测阀室环境参数的问题，文中设计了一款基于多传感器的阀室环境参数检测系统。该系统由温湿度传感器（DHT11）、智能烟感探测器、人体红外感应模块（HC-SR501）、ZigBee模块等组成。系统借助终端采集数据并上传至云端进行分析处理，若测得的数据超过阈值，则云平台将第一时间发送短信通知工作人员，便于工作人员及时采取科学有效的措施进行处理，避免造成重大安全事故。经验证，该系统运行稳定，能够有效检测阀室各项环境参数，节省了大量人力、物力、财力，具有良好的社会效益与经济效益。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee模块, 云平台, 人体红外感应模块, 智能烟感探测器, 温湿度传感器

title: 基于ZigBee组网的停车场管理系统设计
abstract: 随着现代社会经济的高速发展，汽车普及率越来越高，汽车保有量越来越多，大中城市普遍出现了“停车难，停车慢”的问题，为此提出一种基于ZigBee组网的停车场管理系统。本系统以CC2530单片机作为核心器件，前端采用超声波测距技术识别车位是否空闲，并通过串口显示屏与空车位状态指示灯引导用户快速找到停车位；当用户停好车后，通过人体红外检测技术和照明装置引导用户找到最近的出口，从而实现快速离场。后端采用云平台技术，在网络覆盖范围内可实时查看该停车场信息。本系统较传统的停车场管理模式，能有效降低停车时耗与能耗，使停车场内车辆管理更智能、准确、便捷和高效，用户停车体验感也更好，对解决我国城市停车难问题具有积极的应用价值和实践意义。
keywords: zigbee技术, 云端平台, 指示灯, 智能停车场, 节能减排, 超声波测距
authors: 冼锂东;幸敏;莫富奇;黄楚婷
affiliations: 广西水利电力职业技术学院

title: 基于物联网的甘蔗长势估计方法
abstract: 针对现有农作物长势监测技术成本高、依赖特定传感器硬件等问题，本文在现有农业物联网技术的基础上，利用植物生长影响无线通信信号强度的特性，提出了一种利用物联网接收信号强度指示（RSSI）结合环境数据估计甘蔗长势的方法。基于ZigBee无线网络搭建物联网平台，将物联网平台部署于大田中监测甘蔗生长周期，获取RSSI、株高等实验数据，再利用机器学习方法构建株高估计模型及比较验证。结果显示：基于随机森林的回归模型的评价指标优于其他机器学习模型，决定系数（R~2）为0.92，均方根误差（RMSE）为20.97 cm，该方法可满足农业株高监测的需要，为农作物长势监测提供了一种低成本方案。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 信号接收强度指示, 物联网, 甘蔗, 长势估计
authors: 黄豪;杨瀚;王泽平;李修华;张木清
affiliations: 广西大学电气工程学院, 广西农业科学院甘蔗研究所, 广西甘蔗生物学重点实验室

title: 基于ZigBee的道路照明智能联控系统设计
abstract: 道路照明逐渐向着智能化方向发展，现有的道路照明系统普遍采用附加传感器的方式，实现了人来灯亮、人走灯灭的控制效果，大大节约了电能，但是这种方式往往仅点亮行人经过的照明设备，照明的舒适度不够。本文采用ZigBee技术将照明系统当中的所有设备接入网络，并在逻辑上将部署的相邻两个节点进行连接，以此来构建和道路结构一致的网络节点逻辑结构。当行人经过照明系统中某一设备时，设备将事件依据网络逻辑结构进行扩散，以此来联合控制行人前向、后向以及路口所有方向的若干个照明设备，提升了照明的舒适度和适应性。本文围绕CC2530芯片进行系统的硬件设计，对协调器、路由器和终端节点进行软件编程并验证照明效果。实验证明，该方法能够实现复杂道路结构中照明设备的联控功能。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 联控, 节点编号, 道路照明, 道路结构
affiliations: 湖南化工职业技术学院

title: Design of PMSM Regulator Based on Improved Marine Predator Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the permanent magnet synchronous motor（PMSM） vector control system speed outer loop using fractional-order proportional-integral（FOPI） regulator is difficult to meet the requirements of the system dynamic response speed; robustness and so on;it is proposed to optimize the parameters of the FOPI regulator by using the marine predator algorithm（MPA）. The optimal combination of regulator parameters is obtained by searching for the location of the predator with the optimal fitness; in which the target fitness function selection is commonly used to integrate the servo system evaluation index time multiplied by the absolute value of the error. With the goal of improving the efficiency of MPA; its position update formula is improved. Experimental comparison of the motor speed regulation performance of MPA regulation FOPI; improved MPA regulation FOPI. The PMSM servo system test platform with TMS320F28335 as the core is built for verification. Compared with the MPAFOPI regulator; the system with the improved MPAFOPI regulator shows the advantages of better dynamic response of rotational speed and better disturbance immunity;which demonstrates its advantages in the direction of electric drive such as new energy vehicles. The experimental results show that the modified MPAFOPI regulator has the advantages of enhanced system robustness and reduced overshoot.
keywords: fractional pi, improved marine predator algorithm（impa）, permanent magnet synchronous motor, speed ring

title: Design of Programmable ASK Modulation Signal Source Based on PLL
abstract: In this paper; a phase locked loop-based method for generating Amplitude-Shift Keying（ASK） modulated signal sources is proposed to solve the problem of data acquisition for electromagnetic radiation modulation signal recognition. An ASK modulation signal source with adjustable carrier; variable symbol and stable signal source is designed by using phase locked loop and STM32. The phase-locked loop LMX2572 with high stability and low power consumption is used to generate sine waves in the frequency range of 12.5 MHz ～ 3 GHz; and the baseband signal is controlled by the STM32F103C8T6 microprocessor to digitally modulate the sine waves generated by the phase-locked loop to realize the function of generating ASK modulated signals. The experimental results show that the designed ASK modulated signal source realizes the functions of variable frequency; variable symbol; variable power and programmable control; and solves the problem of real-time and convenient data acquisition. The ASK modulated signal generated by the proposed method can be used to verify the type detection of electromagnetic radiation modulated signal.

title: 基于老年人的智能家居系统设计与研究
abstract: 针对全球老年人口增加带来的老龄化问题，设计并实现一套基于ZigBee通信协议的适老性智能家居系统，以提升老年人生活质量。系统由协调器、两个终端节点和手机App 3个部分组成，具备温湿度监测、光照检测、床垫压力和加速度监测等多重功能。硬件设计上，采用CC2530作为主控制器，保证系统的低功耗和稳定性。软件设计上，实现环境数据的实时检测与控制，并支持远程通信。期望为智能家居技术在适老化领域提供了新的应用思路。

title: Design of the Smart Home Control System Based on the Internet of Things Technology
abstract: With the development of economy and the progress of The Times;people have a higher standard for the living environment;and smart home has become one of the most popular research fields.This paper proposes a design scheme of intelligent home control system with low cost;high accuracy and good real-time performance;which has good application and reference value.First of all;ZigBee technology is selected as the basic communication architecture;CC2530 chip is taken as the processing core;and wireless communication networking technology is combined with sensor application technology to realize the intelligent networking of the home environment.In terms of hardware;according to the needs of the home environment;equipped with temperature and humidity;light;gas;infrared theft for sensing and control of terminal equipment.In terms of software;the ZigBee wireless network is used to successfully network each terminal device;realize the real-time detection and upload of the home environment data;and realize the intelligent control of the system through the gateway module.The login;management;control and alarm interface are designed to process the collected environmental data and display the data in the form of charts on the corresponding interface.

title: Research on Three-dimensional Mathematical Model and Control Strategy of Rail Welding Joint Induction Heating Power Supply
abstract: In order to improve the performance of welded joints; the rail welding joint must be normalized after welding.Compared with the flame heating normalization method; the induction heating normalization method has the advantages of high degree of automation; stable normalizing quality; good working environment and so on. It is more and more recognized in rail field welding joint normalization. This paper focuses on the analysis of the PFM; PWM; PFM＆PWM three AC side power regulation methods; the establishment of the mathematical model of the three control methods; and the use of MATLAB software to carry out three-dimensional visualization analysis of the mathematical model. The results show that the PFM＆PWM control method has the advantages of less switching loss and less frequency change during power adjustment compared with the other two control methods. The control strategy of rail welding joint induction heating power supply based on PFM＆PWM control method is proposed; and its control track is illustrated by combining with the threedimensional mathematical model of rail welding joint induction heating power supply; The software and hardware based on TMS320F28335 are designed to realize the control waveform of the control strategy.

abstract: 本文针对煤矿采煤机电控系统存在的实时性差、可靠性低等问题，基于DSP技术设计了一套高性能电控系统。该系统由控制与驱动模块、传感器与反馈模块、人机交互界面模块和通信与网络模块组成，硬件架构合理，软件算法先进。控制器采用TMS320F28335 DSP芯片，实现了高精度矢量控制；传感器融合了多种滤波算法，提高了数据质量；HMI界面丰富直观，支持多点触控；通信网络采用双冗余设计，可靠性高达99.999%。硬件在环仿真实验表明，该系统在起动特性、调速性能、稳态精度等方面均达到预期目标，可有效提升采煤机的作业效率和可靠性。

abstract: 随着科技的发展，工农业对电能的需求增大，传统的输电线路无法满足有效传输的要求。针对此问题，各国对智能电网的建设高度关注，我国也制定了智能电网综合发展战略方案。在线监测输电线路故障成为电网发展的必备要求。因此，本文提出了一种基于嵌入式计算机技术的输电线路故障监测系统设计方案，采用TMS320F2812和S3C2440双CPU总体架构。在硬件设计方面，选用了合适的芯片和进行了合理的原理图设计。在软件设计方面，按照软件工程的步骤进行功能分析，并进行了模块化的软件设计。设计包括DSP数据处理系统、ARM系统和上位机监测软件。

title: Design and implementation of monitoring and control system for dust deposition on the surface of photovoltaic module
abstract: The power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic（PV） modules can be affected by the dust deposition on the surface of modules; which can also reduce the economy of PV power plant operation. In order to monitor the dust deposition status on the surface of modules in PV power plants and carry out the research on optimization methods for cleaning scheduling of PV power plants based on the monitoring data; a monitoring and control system for dust deposition on the surface of PV module is proposed. In this system; the STM32F407 microprocessor expanding the ADS1256 analog-to-digital converter is used for lower computer to sample various sensor signals related to dust deposition; and the data are transmitted to the upper computer monitoring software through wireless transmission modules. The upper computer monitoring software developed based on LabVIEW can receive data through a serial port; process and store the data; and optimize the cleaning schedule of the PV power plant based on the corresponding data. Experimental test results show that the proposed system can accurately sample; transmit;process; and store data; and can monitor the dust deposition status on the surface of PV modules; then achieve the cleaning scheduling of PV plant; which is of great significance for the optimization of PV power plant cleaning scheduling.

title: Design of Elevator Automatic Disinfection Device Based on CC2530-Microcontroller
abstract: In the densely populated cabin elevator environment; pathogens can transmit diseases through contact; airborne transmission; and other means. Therefore; correct and effective disinfection work should be carried out on elevators. This paper designs a device capable to automatically disinfect elevator buttons and cabin based on the actual frequency of elevator use. The device employs the CC2530 microcontroller as the core controller; and achieves dynamic monitoring; intelligent control; and online decision-making of the elevator disinfection device through wireless sensor networks. The disinfection operation of the device does not affect normal use of elevators. Replacing the original manual disinfection with an automatic disinfection device can improve disinfection efficiency and effectiveness; and is more conducive to preventing the spread of pathogens.

title: Improved P-f Droop-based Active Islanding Detection Method for Grid-forming Inverters
abstract: At present; most islanding detection algorith ms are designed for grid-connected inverters; which are not suitable for grid-forming inverters based on droop control. The passive islanding detection method is based on the droop control system. Due to the small designed droop coefficient and the negative feedback characteristics of the system itself; islanding can only be detected when load power and inverter output power are seriously mismatched. The conventional active islanding detection method needs to add disturbance to realize islanding detection; which has a great influence on power quality. An active islanding detection method based on improved P-f droop equation is proposed. Potential deviation increment is added after grid-connected stability. Once main grid end encounters instantaneous power loss; the frequency of common coupling point at this moment is calculated by the new droop equation. Because the value of common coupling point′s frequency fluctuates greatly at that moment and quickly exceeds the limit value; islanding detection can be completed quickly; facilitate reduction in impact on power quality. Finally the simulation verification of different working conditions is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink; and the actual experimental verification is carried out based on TMS320F28379D and Speedgoat real-time simulation target machine.
keywords: active islanding detection, droop control, grid-forming inverter, microgrid, potential deviation

title: An Improved Sequential Model Predictive Control Strategy for T-Type Three-Level Inverter System
abstract: The T-type three-level inverter is known for its good output waveform; high efficiency; and ability to provide high voltage and power outputs; which can meet the requirements of control strategies. One common strategy of T-type three-level inverter systems is predictive direct torque control. The unified cost function can directly describe the constraint conditions of multiple control objectives and select the optimal space voltage vector for the next control cycle acting on the inverter through traversal. The approach offers good control performance and simple control strategies. However; when dealing with multiple control objectives;appropriate weighting factors must be designed to adjust the contribution of each objective. The design of weighting factors has become a research hotspot. Sequential model predictive control adopts a sequential structure to evaluate the cost function of each control objective; avoiding the weighting factor design. However;the control performance for low-priority objectives is limited and cannot meet the equal weight control requirements of similar priority objectives. Therefore; this paper proposes an improved sequential model predictive control based on a sequential-parallel hybrid structure for coordinate control of multiple objectives. Firstly; this paper proposes an enhanced multi-objective cost function of a T-type three-level inverter system based on model predictive direct torque control. The cost function includes electromagnetic torque; stator flux;common-mode voltage; and switching frequency. Secondly; the priorities of each control objective are considered.The electromagnetic torque and stator flux; which have similar priorities; are classified as the primary set. The common-mode voltage and switching frequency; which optimize system performance; are classified as the secondary set. Herein; the primary set takes priority over the secondary set; and the control objectives within the same set have similar priorities. A proposed sequential-parallel hybrid structure improves the sequential model predictive control. The parallel synchronously optimizes objectives with similar priorities; and the sequential structure sequentially controls objectives with different priorities. Thus; multi-objective predictive control of the system is achieved while maintaining the weighting factor design; improving system performance. An experimental platform is built using a high-speed DSP（TMS320F28335） and FPGA as core components.The experimental results show that the proposed strategy can effectively suppress the common-mode voltage and reduce the switching frequency; thus reducing system power loss. Meanwhile; the system’s high-performance steady-state and dynamic responses are maintained. The computational burden is moderate and can meet the real-time requirements. The proposed strategy has the advantages of simple structure and easy implementation.
keywords: common mode voltage, model predictive control, multi-control objective, switching frequency, three-level inverter, weighting factors

title: Current Deadbeat Control of Permanent Magnet-Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor Based on Parameter Identification
abstract: The permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor; which combines the characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous motor and synchronous reluctance motor; has received more and more attention from many scholars because of its characteristics of less permanent magnet usage; high efficiency and high torque density. Deadbeat predictive control is widely used in modern motor control schemes. However; the control effect of deadbeat predictive control depends on the accuracy of the model; and in the actual operation of PMA-SynRM characterized by a high convex pole ratio; the motor parameters will be changed greatly with the change of operating conditions; which is more obvious in the motor inductance parameters. When the motor inductance parameter varies greatly; it leads to a decrease in the calculation accuracy of the current angle of the maximum torque per ampere controller and a decrease in the control effect of the deadbeat controller. Therefore;a parametric online identification method for the d and q axis inductance parameters of permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motors is adopted in this paper. In order to improve the control effect of deadbeat predictive current control system; the identification value is used to replace the initial model inductance parameters in MTPA controller and deadbeat predictive current controller.First; this paper defines the position of the d and q axis in the rotor structure and derives a mathematical model of a permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor. Secondly; according to the voltage equation of permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor; the mathematical equation of traditional deadbeat predictive current control is deduced; and the parameter sensitivity of inductance parameters in traditional deadbeat predictive current control scheme is analyzed. According to the stability condition of closed-loop transfer function in discrete domain; the fluctuation range of d and q axis inductance which can keep the deadbeat predictive current controller stable is given. The controller is in an unstable state when the d and q axis inductance is greater than two times the nominal model inductance. Finally; the parameter adaptive rate of the model reference adaptive motor parameter identification system is designed according to Popov’s super stability theory; and the inductance parameter online identification scheme of PMA-SynRM is given to complete the design of the variable parameter MTPA-DBPCC controller.In order to verify the effectiveness of the deadbeat predictive current control strategy based on parameter identification; the algorithm is simulated and verified in Matlab/Simulink environment; and the experiment is carried out on the experimental platform with TMS320F28335 controller as the core. The simulation and experimental results show that the deadbeat predictive current control scheme based on parameter identification can effectively suppress the system oscillation and current ripple caused by inductance parameter mismatch. When the d axis inductance is greater than two times the parameter mismatch; the peak values of d and q axis current fluctuations are reduced by about 142% and 55%; respectively; when the q axis inductance is greater than two times the parameter mismatch; the peak values of d and q axis current fluctuations are reduced by about 7.6% and 147%; respectively; thus the robustness of the system is improved.
keywords: deadbeat predictive current control, model reference adaptive system, parameter identification, permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor

title: IGBT Open-Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Modular Multilevel Converter Sub-Module Based on Short-Time Fourier Transform and Deep Networks
abstract: The modular multilevel converter（MMC） is a new type of multilevel converter that features low switch frequency; high output waveform quality; and low consistency requirements for power electronic device switching. Therefore; it has been widely applied in various fields such as flexible DC transmission; power electronic transmission; and rail transit traction control. However; the increase in the number of sub-modules also means an increase in potential failure points. To meet the growing demands for system safety and reliability;timely and effective diagnosis needs to be carried out after system failures. Existing MMC fault diagnosis methods mainly fall into two categories: additional hardware circuit-based and software algorithm-based. Among them; the hardware-based method exhibits excellent diagnostic accuracy and short diagnostic time but may incur additional hardware costs and wiring complexity; while the software-based method does not require additional hardware circuitry and is relatively simple and convenient to implement. However; existing software-based method often heavily depends on the capacitance voltage information of sub-modules during the diagnosis process. The excessive number of voltage sensors not only increases the complexity of system wiring but also adds to the potential failure points of the system.To this end; a deep learning-based IGBT open-circuit fault diagnosis method for MMC sub-modules using a minimum number of voltage sensors is proposed; which only requires two arm voltage sensors for each phase.Based on the analysis of open-circuit fault characteristics of MMC sub-module IGBTs; the bridge arm voltage is selected as the required electrical parameter for fault diagnosis. The short-time Fourier transform（STFT） is utilized to extract harmonic component information from the bridge arm voltage signal. By arranging frequency domain information at different sampling times; the matrix containing time-frequency domain information is constructed as the diagnostic sample. By combining with the deep belief network（DBN）; an IGBT open-circuit fault detection method based on STFT-DBN is proposed; which realizes the rapid diagnosis of the fault type.Meanwhile; to address the problem of relatively low location accuracy of the DBN; a convolutional neural network（CNN） based faulty sub-module location network is established for each fault type after the fault type is identified by the fault detection network. Combining these two methods allows for rapid fault type detection and high-accuracy faulty sub-module location.A 129-level MMC simulation model was established using Matlab/Simulink; and arm voltage information was collected under normal operation and various fault conditions. By applying the proposed method for data preprocessing; input samples were constructed; and the dataset was divided. Then the fault diagnosis networks were trained and tested separately; and the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified based on simulation data. Finally; the hardware and software of an MMC experimental system were designed in the laboratory environment; and an experimental system with reduced power levels was constructed. The control unit was implemented by a combination of DSP TMS320F28335 and FPGA; and various fault conditions were simulated by changing the drive signals. Arm voltage sensors were used to collect data from the experimental system under different fault conditions. The experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve high-precision and short-time fault diagnosis by using only arm voltage information.
keywords: convolutional neural networks, modular multilevel converter（mmc）, open-circuit fault diagnosis, short-time fourier transform
authors: Hua Runkai;Zhan Yanwen;Li Jie;Zhu Qinyue;Yu Yichen

title: A Diagnosis Strategy for Open-Circuit Submodule Faults in MMCs under Nearst Level Modulation Suitable for Different Powers
abstract: With the increasing voltage and power level of modular multilevel converters（MMC）; the number of its submodules（SMs） also increases; and the issue of its reliability is highlighted. The failure of IGBT in any SM can affect the normal operation of MMC and even further lead to the damage of other components; which eventually lead to the collapse of the whole system. Thus; it is necessary to detect the fault and locate the malfunctioning SMs accurately to improve its reliability. MMC’s SM open-circuit diagnosis strategy can be divided into two categories: hardware-based and software-based. Compared with the hardware-based strategy; the software-based strategies need no extra hardware; have low computational burden. However; it is difficult to set the empirical threshold of existing software-based strategies between different operating powers; which hinders its further development.To solve this issue; a diagnosis strategy for open-circuit SM faults in MMCs suitable for different operating powers is proposed. The SM switching function is predicted based on the number of SM inputs and the position of SM capacitor voltage sorting arrangement and then the corresponding SM capacitor voltage is predicted. On the basis; the fault is detected and located by judging whether the absolute error between the predicted value and the actual value of the SM capacitor voltage exceeds a threshold. Moreover; to further eliminate the effects of errors and prevent the existence of fault misdiagnosis situations; a time flag is used in both the detection process and location process.In the proposed strategy; to avoid the effects of misdiagnosis near the arm current-over-zero point; a currentover-zero filtering part is proposed. Based on the mathematical deduction; the principle of setting threshold is given. It is indicated that the proposed strategy eliminates the need to manually set the threshold when the MMC operating power changes; which greatly reduce the difficulty of setting the threshold compared with the existing strategies. At the same time; theoretical analysis verifies that the proposed strategy is not only suitable for NLM modulation strategy; but also can be extended to other MMC modulation strategies after adjusting the prediction method of SM switching function.A detailed real-time digital simulation model of the MMC-HVDC system is built in a hardware-in-the-loop platform. The power-stage model is emulated by the target machine and the control system is realized by the DSP TMS320F28335 control board. The experimental result verify that the proposed strategy can accurately diagnose two types of MMC SM open-circuit faults at different operating powers. It is observed that the absolute error of a Type I malfunctioning SM is high when the arm current is negative and the absolute error of a Type II malfunctioning SM is high when the arm current is positive; which verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis. Before the fault occurs; the absolute error will not exceed the threshold so that misdiagnosis will not occur during normal operation. After the fault occurs; the absolute error exceeds the threshold; the system can quickly detect the fault and then locate the remaining malfunctioning SMs. Moreover; the proposed strategy integrates the advantages of existing strategies; including no extra hardware; low computational burden; fast diagnosis（＜20 ms）; and can cope with the cases of multiple SM failures in the arm.

title: Negative Sequence Voltage Suppression of Photovoltaic Inverters Under Asymmetric Grid Faults
abstract: The control strategies for photovoltaic inverter of new energy under asymmetrical grid faults are designed;analyzed and studied with experiments.The key is to study the two control strategies under asymmetrical grid faults;which are achieved under synchronous reference frame and under two-phase stationary coordinate system respectively.The working principles and implementation methods are designed and analyzed in detail from the aspects of grid synchronization;power control and current regulation.The experimental platform based on TMS320F28335 is conducted to verify the studied control strategies.The experimental results show that the inverter based on stationary coordinate system not only exhibits better performance;but also offers the simpler control structure.

title: Design of interface between DSP and ARINC429 bus controller based on FPGA

title: Global dynamic reconfigurable method based on DSP
abstract: Reconfigurable computing technology solves the contradiction between computing performance; efficiency and flexibility very well.As a very important part of heterogeneous multi-core platform; DSP has few researches on its reconfiguration; which limits the application of this technology.To solve this problem; a global dynamic reconfiguration method based on DSP is proposed.Pre-partition FLASH memory and burn SPI parameter files as well as image files A and B.After the system starts; it runs image A first.When receiving the reconstruction command; modify SPI parameters to point the image in BOOT to B.Finally; control the DSP to restart BOOT to complete the reconstruction.The test results of TI TMS320C6678 DSP show that this method can complete the switching of DSP running image within 320 ms; and has a good application prospect.

title: 基于Zigbee的铁路隧道监控系统的设计与实现
abstract: 随着信息技术的快速发展，智能电子设备不仅带给人们方便，还能加强某些领域的安全。针对铁路隧道积水可能引起列车脱轨事故的问题，文章采用以Zigbee为核心的控制系统，来监视火车隧道内是否有积水。通过雨量传感器为前端采集器件，检测是否有水淹没铁轨，再将采集的信息传给单片机，每个单片机最小系统通过无线传输技术一层一层地传送出去，最终将信息传给监控室。值班人员可实时调取监控或者派人进行现场确认，以保证行车安全。该系统的原理是采用TI公司生产的CC2530单片机来实现采集、组网、传输的功能。Zigbee每一个终端节点上放置雨滴传感器，将该终端节点的网络设置为节点模式，再把其他Zigbee设置为路由器模式，这样节点采集的信息通过路由的方式就可以进行远距离无线传输，最后信息汇总至协调器进行分析，以此供工作值班人员进行参考。
keywords: zigbee, 组网, 雨滴传感器
affiliations: 西安思源学院

title: “德才兼育”在教学全过程中的实践与探索——以CC2530单片机技术应用课程为例
abstract: 本文以CC2530单片机技术应用课程为研究对象，通过学情分析，明确了高职院校学生在该课程中面临的挑战和需求。确立了“德才兼育”作为课程改革的核心目标，并对教学内容、方法、手段以及考核机制进行了全面重构和优化。特别是在教学方法和手段方面，提出了多元化的思政教育载体，以及与之相适应的教学评价体系。实践证明，该教学模式不仅提高了学生的专业技能，还在思想道德层面取得了显著成效。本研究的方法和成果对于其他高职专业课程的思政教育改革具有参考价值。
keywords: 学情分析, 德才兼备, 考核方式, 课程思政, 项目导向
affiliations: 河源职业技术学院电子与信息工程学院广东茂名健康职业学院教育技术与网络中心

title: 基于阿里云的无线IOT在数字制药车间场景下的设计应用
abstract: 本文主要设计一个基于阿里云物联网平台的关于制药车间和仓库的环境的监测系统。首先描述硬件的研究与设计，其次描述软件的设计与开发，最后描述Web可视化页面的设计。本系统通过手机移动端和网页端等多种形式登录，方便管理者实时了解车间及仓库的状况，及时针对不同场景制定管理决策来调节生产计划和实施方案，从而有力保障工厂日常生产的安全。
keywords: 4g模块, cc2530, zigbee组网, 制药车间
affiliations: 三江学院

title: Design and Implementation for Hidden Terminal Experiment Case Based on CC2530
abstract: Traditional communication network and computer network courses often focus on the explanation of pure theoretical models and related principles when it comes to the teaching of wireless access technology; and rely more on computer simulation methods in the experimental links; and rarely have experimental teaching based on real hardware equipment. In order to enrich the teaching content; make students more intuitive and comprehensive understanding of wireless LAN and mobile Ad Hoc Network Media Access Control（MAC） technology; master the concept of hidden terminal; a design and implementation method of hidden terminal experiment case based on CC2530 was proposed. The advantages of CC2530 as the hardware of the experimental platform were introduced; the experimental principle was explained; the construction of the experimental platform; the implementation process of the experiment and the method of analysis of the results were explained. By learning experimental principles and completing experiments independently; students can have a deeper understanding of the hidden terminal phenomenon in wireless networks. The experiment also provides teaching reference for teachers of related courses.
keywords: ad hoc network, cc2530, hidden terminal, mac access
affiliations: School of Information and Electronics, Beijing Institute of Technology

title: ZigBee无线通信技术在高标准农田中的应用
abstract: 针对传统农业生产过程费时费力、产量不高的现状，以及国家高标准农田建设的需求，设计了一套基于ZigBee无线通信技术的农田土壤墒情监测、环境气象监测及自动水肥灌溉的信息化系统。该系统主要由土壤墒情监测、空气温湿度检测、光照强度检测、CO2浓度检测等传感器，CC2530组网模块，ARM嵌入式Linux服务器，远程客户端组成，其实现方式灵活，便于在农田中进行系统的建设，且建设成本低，模块式设计降低了后期维护成本。
keywords: cc2530模块, zigbee技术, 传感器, 高标准农田
affiliations: 南宁理工学院信息工程学院

title: Single-stage three phase harmonic current injection step-up/down AC/DC converter
abstract: A novel single-stage three phase harmonic current injection Step-up/down（STHSUD） AC/DC converter is proposed in this paper. This proposal integrates a three-phase uncontrolled rectifier bridge combined with a post-stage Cuk module; and the low-frequency bidirectional switch is introduced to provide a path for the converter to feed back the harmonic current; so that the purpose of reducing the harmonic content of input current is achieved. Firstly; the topology and operating principle of the proposed converter are analyzed; its equivalent circuit is established; the voltage transfer ratio of the converter is deduced; and combined with hysteresis tracking control; the closed-loop simulation of the proposed converter is performed to prove the buck-boost capability. The control strategy is simple; and input current can be sinusoidal with high power factor. Finally; the experiments are carried out in the TMS320F28335 DSP digital control platform; and the experimental results verify the feasibility of the proposed topology.
keywords: buck-boost, harmonic current injection, integrated cuk, single-stage, three-phase ac/dc
affiliations: Key Lab of Power Electronics for Energy Conservation and Motor Drive of Hebei Province, School of Electrical Engineering, Yanshan University

title: Non-contact Position Detection Method in BLDC Motor
abstract: To achieve high reliability and miniaturization of the rotor position measurement of brushless motors; a non-contact magnetic rotary encoder is applied to the rotor angle detection of brushless motors. On the basis of analyzing the working principle and application characteristics of the magnetic rotary encoder; the interface and communication mode between the magnetic rotary encoder and the brushless motor digital controller are discussed. A miniaturized rotor position sensing component is designed; and an experimental platform is built and TMS320F2812 is used as the controller. The drive and control tests of brushless motor are carried out; and the results are discussed. The experimental results show that the non-contact rotor position detection method has the advantages of high measurement accuracy; fast response speed and small size; and can obtain good motor control effect with digital controller.
keywords: bldc motor, digital controller, magnetic rotary encoder, non-contact position detection, synchronous serial interface（ssi）

title: Development of a Practical Teaching Device for Photovoltaic Grid Connected Inverter Based on SPWM Hybrid Modulation
abstract: To enhance the achievement of teaching objectives in photovoltaic grid-connected inverter principles; this paper presents a universal photovoltaic grid-connected inverter practical teaching device based on simulation and digital control technology. The device integrates a DC-DC boost unit; a DC-AC full-bridge inverter unit; a communication unit; and an upper computer display unit. The teaching device’s universal main circuit is the boost circuit with SG3525 as the core and the inverter circuit with DSP TMS320F28335 as the core. It employs the sinusoidal pulse width modulation（SPWM） single and double polarity hybrid modulation control strategy; enables the completion of various experiments such as DC boost and inverter during the course. The teaching device significantly improves students’ understanding of boost switching circuit principles and characteristics; as well as the working principle and waveform analysis of single-phase sinusoidal pulse width modulation（SPWM） inverter circuits.
keywords: photovoltaic grid connection, power electronics, spwm modulation, teaching equipment

title: Design of Wearable Multi-data Acquisition Node Based on ZigBee
abstract: The clinical evaluation of limb function usually relies on scale evaluation. However; scale evaluation has the disadvantages of strong subjectivity; inconsistent evaluation criteria and time-consuming. Although the evaluation method based on computer vision can capture human body movements; it cannot monitor muscle movement status in real time. In order to solve the problem of automatic and high-precision limb function evaluation; this paper proposes a wearable multi-data acquisition node design based on ZigBee. The node is composed of a CC2530 main control chip connected with SEMG sensor and ADXL345 sensor; and multiple sensors transmit data to the sink node through the ZigBee protocol; and finally transmit data to the host computer. The test is carried out by the tester ’s arm flexion and abduction movement. The experimental results show that the upper computer serial port debugging can successfully receive and display the test data;including the three-axis acceleration value and the EMG voltage value. With the change of action speed; the three-axis acceleration and myoelectric voltage value also change accordingly; which meets the expected requirements.
keywords: adxl345, cc2530 singlechip, semg, wearable sensor
affiliations: School of Medical Information and Engineering, Xuzhou Medical University

title: 基于物联网及边缘网关的智慧果园监控系统设计
abstract: 随着物联网技术的飞速发展，将物联网技术与水果种植相结合，有助于推动水果种植朝着自动化、智能化的方向发展，提高水果种植的现代化水平。因此，本文设计了一种基于物联网及边缘网关的智慧果园监控系统，该系统基于物联网架构，以CC2530芯片为核心，设计无线数据采集及环境调控节点；以STM32为核心构建边缘网关，一是负责融合无线传感网络中协调节点和摄像头数据，进行协议转换后，通过5G模块将数据传送至上位机，同时可向ZigBee节点发送控制指令；二是可对土壤环境进行本地调控。管理用户可以通过PC端、手机端对果园环境进行远程监控，上位机软件能根据数据和图片信息实现果园病虫害预警。该系统具有使用便捷、操作简单、运行成本低等优点，能较好地实现果园智慧化管理。
keywords: 5g模块, stm32网关, 水果种植, 物联网技术
authors: 陈生学;李波;严佩升;孟星
affiliations: 昭通学院

title: FPGA-based network controller design for bid evaluation system with wireless sensor applications
abstract: Modern devices such as drones increasingly rely on accurate wireless sensor networks; but frequent signal loss and erroneous transmissions challenge their performance.To this end; the study proposes a Field Programmable Gate Array-based network controller design for a bid evaluation system for wireless sensor applications.The design utilises an FPGA combined with an ADS8365 analogue-to-digital converter and a three-axis vibration sensor with a CC3200 RF circuit module for wireless communication.The results show that the designed controller has an accuracy of 99%; a packet leakage rate of 0.0006% and a transmission rate of up to 0.230 M/s at a test distance of 2 m.Compared with other wireless sensor network controllers in the market; the error rate and data loss rate of the controller are only 0.0421% and 0.0121% respectively at a distance of 22 m; which is much lower than that of other controllers.It can be found that the designed controller has significant advantages in improving data transmission accuracy and handling peak data traffic.This research is of great significance for data processing of wireless sensor networks for future UAVs and other devices.
keywords: bid evaluation, controller, fpga, network, wireless sensor
affiliations: State grid Shaanxi Electric power Co., Ltd.,Material company

title: Design of software and hardware experimental platform for PMSG and SRG coaxial power generation system
abstract: In order to analyze the power generation performance of permanent magnet synchronous generator（PMSG） and switched reluctance generator（SRG）; a set of hardware experimental platform for coaxial connected power generation of double motors is developed; and the software simulation platform of the system is built. The software experimental simulation platform displays the main circuit topology; motor structure; output voltage and current of the system by setting the speed; load and other relevant parameters of the motor. The hardware platform takes DSP TMS320F28335 as the control core; and integrates power module; power converter; driving circuit; isolation and protection circuit; prime mover; dynamic torque sensor and load equipment. The software and hardware experimental platform can complete the power generation performance analysis and comparison experiment of dual motors under different working conditions. By analyzing and comparing the generation power; efficiency and generation voltage/current of dual motors under different speeds and loads; students can intuitively understand the generation principle; control mode; advantages and disadvantages of the two generators; which has high teaching application value.
keywords: generator, motor experiment platform, pmsg, srg
affiliations: Yangzhou Polytechnic Institute

title: Wireless Io T Sensing System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Traditional multi-point sensors in the field of environmental monitoring;there are multi-node power supply and wiring difficulties or short device battery life;high node cost;poor scalability and other pain points. In response to the aforementioned pain points;this paper has designed and developed a wireless sensor network system based on ZigBee. The system uses a CC2530 microcontroller as the terminal node and combines multiple sensors for data collection. A ZigBee gateway is designed to forward the data collected by the terminal node to the Io T cloud platform.Users can use an APP or webpage to log in to the cloud platform to remotely view the system’s terminal node information;and send an alert to the user when the system detects abnormal data. The system has high cost-effectiveness and low cost. After testing;the power consumption of the system is lower than other systems;and the node sleep current is only 8 μA. And it has high reliability and scalability;which can be deployed and used in industries with high environmental requirements such as greenhouse aquaculture;and has practical application research value.
keywords: environmental monitoring, io t, low power consumption, zigbee
affiliations: School of Automation,Guangdong Polytechnic Normal University

title: Design and Research of Intelligent Grain Depot Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: In response to the problems of traditional grain depot environmental monitoring systems such as difficult wiring;difficulty in expansion;and single control method;a smart grain depot monitoring system based on the Internet of Things is designed. The system is divided into upper computer and lower computer. The upper computer is based on Qt and Sqlite3 databases as platforms;and designs display and control interfaces. The lower computer uses CC2530 as the main controller;and combines various sensors and peripheral devices to design coordinators and terminal nodes. ZigBee technology is used to achieve wireless communication function in the self-organized network;and real-time communication with the upper computer is achieved through serial port. The system has two control modes to adjust the grain depot environment;namely manual mode and automatic mode. In manual mode;users can independently control peripheral devices such as fans. In automatic mode;the system can automatically determine whether to turn on peripheral devices based on the set threshold range. The test results show that the system meets the requirements of grain depot monitoring. It can not only monitor the environmental information of the grain depot in realtime;but also has functions such as early warning and regulating the grain depot environment.
keywords: internet of things, monitoring system, sensors, single chip microcomputer, zigbee technology
affiliations: College of Computer Science,Xi’an Aeronautical University

title: Research on Absolute Encoder Communication Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In high-precision servo control applications; it is usually necessary to obtain data measurement information from absolute value photoelectric encoders. Firstly; the characteristics of the absolute encoder and the RS-485 communication principle were analyzed. Then; based on the SCI module of DSP; the encoder communication interface circuit and communication program were designed. The results show that the designed communication interface and program can achieve communication between DSP and encoder.
keywords: absolute encoder, data communication, dsp
affiliations: School of Intelligent Manufacturing, Xiangyang Auto Vocational Technical College

title: An Imaging Positioning and Velocity Compensation System
abstract: The imaging positioning and velocity compensation system based on TMS320F28335 controller is realized. The schematic diagram and PCB of the control board are completed by drawing modules including F28335 minimum system; ADC acquisition; position acquisition and motor control. It receives the upper computer control instructions through embedded software programming; solves according to the current sensor value and PID and SVPWM algorithms; controls two permanent magnet synchronous motors to realize the functions of dual axis spatial positioning and dual axis speed compensation. Experiments and practical applications show that the system can quickly analyze and respond to the positioning and compensation requests sent by the host computer; and the positioning and compensation accuracy is high. It is suitable for vehicle or aerial photography; which requires large angle imaging control range and speed compensation image stabilization imaging.
keywords: f28335, imaging positioning, permanent magnet synchronous motor, pid, speed compensation, svpwm

title: Auxiliary Monitoring System for Abnormal Behavior of Substation Personnel Based on Intelligent Video
abstract: In order to solve the disadvantages of manual monitoring in substation; an auxiliary monitoring system for abnormal behavior of personnel in substation based on intelligent vision is designed. In the system hardware part; the wireless chip CC2530 is used as the core to connect each module of the hardware; and the coordinator; router; terminal equipment and power supply module are mainly designed. In the system software part; the shadow of the monitoring video is processed in advance by using artificial intelligence and image processing technology; and then the information in the video is described by using the method of background modeling. Finally; hog feature recognition is applied to abnormal behavior detection to realize auxiliary monitoring of personnel abnormal behavior in substation. The experimental results show that the auxiliary monitoring system for personnel abnormal behavior in the substation has high monitoring and identification accuracy when there are many people and few people; which proves the application effect of the system.
keywords: abnormal behavior, auxiliary monitoring, intelligent vision, location, remote video, substation
affiliations: State Grid Shuozhou Power Supply Company, State Grid Yangquan Power Supply Company

title: Vector Shuffling Based Parallel Radix-4 FFT Algorithm for Fixed Point Data on Vector DSP
abstract: The Fast Fourier Transform（FFT） algorithm of fixed-point data can reduce the hardware requirements within a reasonable accuracy range but obtain faster computing speed. Based on the hardware characteristics of high performance vector Digital Signal Processors（DSPs）; this paper constructs an efficient instruction level parallel processing algorithm of Radix-4 complex FFT algorithm. This algorithm considers the calculation process of the Radix-4 complex FFT algorithm and the characteristics of butterfly units; and it fully integrates SIMD calculation; vector shuffling; indexing DMA and other techniques with the transformation process of Radix-4 complex FFT. This algorithm effectively controls the data block movement between memory and in-chip cache during the computing process and improves the utilization rate of SIMD processing unit. In this paper; an experimental study is conducted on the FT-M7002DSK platform of the YHFT-M7002 processor; which has independent intellectual property rights. Result shows that; compared with the performance obtained by CCS simulator for the corresponding TMS320C6678 library function; the average performance of our algorithm is 3.79 times faster than the former.
keywords: index dma, radix-4 complex fft, simd technology, vector dsp, vector shuffling

title: Development of DSP bootloader for MBD code download based on CAN communication
abstract: In order to meet the demand for convenient downloading of MBD（Model-Based Design） code in practical applications of DSP embedded systems; this study designs a Bootloader solution based on CAN communication for MBD code download. Taking TMS320F28335 as an example; by analyzing the structure of MBD code; a memory partition scheme between Boot program and MBD program is designed to ensure the effectiveness and stability of program download. The corresponding Boot program and host computer program are developed; and the implementation process of Bootloader is introduced in detail. The functions of Committed step are analyzed and explained; and the program download is realized using CAN communication. The experimental results indicate that this method is stable; reliable; and practical; providing a feasible and efficient solution for downloading MBD code in practical applications in DSP embedded systems.
keywords: bootloader, can communication, mbd code download, tms320f28335

title: A Low Energy Consumption Synchronization Mechanism for TDMA Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: In order to reduce the node energy consumption caused by clock synchronization in TDMA networks; a low energy synchronization mechanism for star wireless sensor networks was proposed according to the potential drift of node crystal oscillator. In this mechanism; the entire time axis is composed of long frames; and each long frame contains one synchronization frame and several sub-frames; each sub-frame is composed of the sub-time slots bound by all the sub-nodes. The root node sends a synchronization frame at the beginning of a long frame; which causing all child nodes to synchronize their clocks. The corresponding protection interval is increased for each sub-slot; which effectively avoids the interaction between the sub-nodes due to clock drift; thus maximizing the number of sub-frames in the long frame and reducing the frequency of the sub-nodes waking up for synchronization.From the perspective of receiving synchronous frames; the energy consumption of sub-nodes is greatly reduced by comparison with traditional TDMA in which each sub-frame needs to be synchronized. Finally;under the assumption that the crystal frequency error is normally distributed; MATLAB simulation is used to verify the correctness of the formula of the low-energy synchronization model; and the simulation is applied to the star network constructed by CC1310 device.
keywords: clock drift, clock synchronization, low energy consumption, protection interval, time slot
affiliations: Zhejiang Wanli University

title: Design of smart agricultural greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless sensor network and edge gateway
abstract: Under the cross-fertilization of evolving Internet of Things（IoT）; big data and cloud computing technologies; a smart agricultural greenhouse monitoring system is designed and realized based on wireless sensor self-assembling network and edge gateway; applying edge computing.The system design is based on the Internet of Things architecture; and the sensing layer is composed of a CC2530 chip as the core to construct a sensing type collection node and a control type node. The node deployment scheme using a regular triangle grid has achieved high-quality construction of wireless sensor networks.The edge gateway takes STM32F103ZET6 MCU as the core; on the one hand; it is responsible for data communication with each node in the wireless sensor network; completing the edge calculation and managing and controlling the nodes in the network. On the other hand; it carries out the wireless transmission of data through the communication modules such as WiFi; 4G/5G; etc.; and encapsulates; processes and packages the collected data for transmission to the server side; so that it can realize the corresponding function of the edge gateway as a connection between the sensing nodes and the server monitoring center. The application layer is constructed by EMQTT server and Node-RED to build a cloud platform. Users can log in to the WEB server of the data processing center through PC and cell phone to realize the control of IoT devices and monitoring of the environment.
keywords: edge gateway, monitoring system, smart agriculture, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Lanzhou Petrochemical University of Vocational Technology, PetroChina Lanzhou Petrochemical Company, Beijing Youtejie Information Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 电子束曝光机图形发生器系统研究
abstract: 电子束曝光机是半导体晶片的制造过程中制造掩膜片或自写硅片的非常重要的设备。电子束曝光机可以在非常小的区域内进行高精度的曝光，从而实现对芯片的精细图案及图形制作。它由电子源、电子光学系统、扫描系统、真空系统、恒温控制系统、电气控制系统、传送系统等部分组成。图形发生器是扫描系统的主要组成部分，是完成精细图形制作的关键部件。该文提出一套功能较为完备的新型电子束曝光机图形发生器的硬件设计方案。该方案采用创龙ZYNQ-7000、TMS320C6678数字信号处理器芯片作为核心单元，并由可编程逻辑器、标记检测控制电路、DAC转接电路、束闸控制电路、消像散器和对中电源、运动控制校正电路等曝光控制电路和构成。图形发生器产生电子束曝光机要曝光的各点X、Y坐标值，再将这些值经过高速度、高精度数模转换器（D/A）变换成对应的模拟量，驱动高精度偏转放大器以控制电子束沿X、Y方偏转，对承放在激光工作台上的掩模基片进行扫描曝光。同时，图形发生器根据不同的工作状态，还要驱动束闸部件，控制电子束接通或切断。数据处理能力强、速度快、接口方便等优势，克服了传统图形发生器单纯依靠软件完成、速度慢、精度低、工作不稳定的缺点。
keywords: 图形发生器, 束闸、标记、dac转接, 电子束曝光机
authors: 黄云;梁文彬;苏鑫;何远湘

title: Design of Data Acquisition System for Geo-Electrical Resistivity Meter Based on ADS1256
abstract: The purpose of seismic earth resistivity monitoring is to observe the change of geo-electrical resistivity in a specific area; which requires high measurement accuracy. The data acquisition system of geo-electrical resistivity meter is based on the 24 bit analog-to-digital converter of ADS1256. It has the characteristics of high precision; low noise; large dynamic and strong anti-interference ability. The laboratory test results show that its voltage resolution reaches 10 μV;peak to peak noise is less than 7 μV and the dynamic range reaches 120 dB. The main technical performance indicators of the data acquisition system meet the needs of seismic geo-electrical resistivity monitoring and prediction research. It can also be applied to other fields requiring high-precision; low-noise DC voltage measurement.
keywords: ads1256, data acquisition, earth resistivity measurement, high-precision, low noise

title: 基于ZigBee的湿地公园生态环境监控系统研究设计
abstract: 设计了一种基于ZigBee无线传感器网络的湿地公园生态环境监控系统。利用ZigBee技术组建无线传感器网络，终端节点连接温湿度传感器、空气质量传感器、水质pH值传感器采集收集温湿度、空气质量、水质等环境数据，并将数据发送至ZigBee协调器，最后由协调器借助网关将各类环境信息传送到上位机监控平台，能够实现湿地公园生态环境信息的实时监测功能。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 无线传感器网络, 生态环境监测

title: 云平台和Zigbee技术在实验室环境监测中的应用
abstract: 随着高校招生人数的增多，校园中实验室使用频率和人次也与日俱增，不仅给实验室的管理工作增添了更多负担，还提高了意外事件发生的风险。如何更好地提升实验室的管理效率和安全性成为亟待解决的问题。针对这一情况，设计了一款基于Zigbee和云平台的实验室环境监测系统。该系统选用CC2530作为微处理芯片，实时采集环境数据后并通过OLED显示屏显示，随后将数据通过ESP-12F模块将数据上传到云平台。云平台对数据采取一站化存储、处理和显示。该系统具有成本低、易于开发、便于扩展和多地多主机实时监测等优点，具有良好的应用前景。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 云平台, 实验室环境
affiliations: 安徽理工大学电气与信息工程学院

title: 基于DSP的抗噪声语音识别系统设计
abstract: 针对复杂噪声环境下语音识别率降低的问题，本文提出一种基于最小均方误差（MMSE）功率谱估计的语音增强算法，研究并设计出以数字信号处理器（DSP）为核心，由麦克风和语音识别系统共同构成的一个抗噪声实时语音识别系统。DSP采用TMS320C6713 DSP 型号开发板，语音识别系统是利用开源识别工具搭建的简易识别系统，数据输入方式采用麦克风实时数据采样输入。实验结果表明本文提出的语音识别系统比传统系统具有更好的抗噪声效果。
keywords: dsp, mmse, 语音增强, 语音识别
affiliations: 遵义师范学院信息工程学院

title: 基于CC2530单片机控制的温室大棚环境调节系统设计
abstract: 该文设计一种基于CC2530单片机控制的温室大棚环境调节系统，使用CC2530单片机作为系统核心控制处理器，利用传感器技术和无线通信技术实现温室大棚中的农作物生长信息数据采集，包括空气温湿度、二氧化碳浓度、光照强度、土壤酸碱度pH、水分传感器等参数的实时采集、传输、分析控制，实现温室大棚内部环境的远程自动调节，提供系统各控制参数的历史曲线和实时曲线以供分析，做出决策管理，实现农作物的生产管理透明化、自动化、智能化、协同化的现代管理模式。
keywords: cc2530单片机, 传感器技术, 无线通信技术, 温室大棚, 调节系统
affiliations: 云南现代职业技术学院

title: Algorithm Implementation and Optimization of Symmetric Matrix Eigenvalue Solution for FT-M6678
abstract: Currently;there is no implementation related to the symmetric matrix eigenvalue solution on China’s autonomous and controllable FT-M6678 platform;and the existing mathematical calculation library on this platform cannot satisfy the requirements for solving similar problems. This study focuses on the domestic FT-M6678 processor;implements and optimizes the algorithm of the symmetric matrix eigenvalue solution;SYEV;and improves the linear algebra calculation library of the FT-M6678 platform. First;by analyzing the implementation process and running hotspots of the SYEV algorithm;compile;memory access;and vector parallel optimizations are performed based on the FT-M6678 platform. Compilation optimization refers to guiding the compiler to optimize programs based on different compilation options to achieve acceleration effects;memory access optimization includes cache optimization and allocation optimization of data and program segments;accelerating the efficiency of matrix data access;and vector parallelization optimization includes loop unrolling and Single Instruction Multiple Data（SIMD）instruction parallel optimization adapted to the FT-M6678 platform;which improves the computational efficiency of programs. Verification and performance tests of the implemented and optimized algorithms are performed using the FT-M6678 platform. The accuracy of the algorithms passes the test of official Linear Algebra PACKage（LAPACK）test set;and the optimization acceleration effect of the algorithm on the FT-M6678 platform can reach 58.346 times;which can improve the speed by 2.053 times compared with the TMS320C6678 platform.
keywords: cache optimization, ft-m6678 platform, hotspot analysis, symmetric matrix eigenvalue, vector parallelism
affiliations: National Supercomputing Center in Zhengzhou, School of Computer and Artificial Intelligence,Zhengzhou University

title: Study on Monitoring Technology of Shearer Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: In response to the frequent faults and communication interruptions in traditional wired detection systems for coal mining machines due to cumbersome wiring and high failure rates;poor system flexibility;and limited expansion functions;the author proposes the Zigbee wireless communication technology with low power consumption and high reliability for the shearer monitoring system;which can collect the operating parameters of the shearer on site through intelligent sensor terminals;send and receive the monitoring data through CC2530;complete the upper computer communication with serial ports; and intuitively and dynamically grasp the shearer operating status through upper computer;effectively improving the operation reliability.
keywords: condition monitoring, shearer, wireless communication, zigbee

title: Design and Test of Intelligent Control System for Underground Ventilation in Coal Mine
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the underground ventilation control system of coal mine; such as unreasonable network structure; inaccurate wind speed detection; poor dynamic adjustment ability and imperfect environmental monitoring parameters; the intelligent ventilation control system of underground coal mine is designed in the paper; including the hardware and software scheme of the intelligent ventilation control system with TMS320F2812 chip as the core. The chip collects the environmental parameters of roadway in real time and controls the output of frequency converter to achieve the purpose of dynamically adjusting the fan speed. The data transmission network of the ventilation system is established by TCP/IP communication and CAN bus communication technology; and the remote monitoring of the underground ventilation system is realized through the ground control room; whose experimental analysis results show that the intelligent ventilation control system meets the design requirements; improves the intelligent level of underground ventilation control system; and guarantees the safe and efficient production of underground coal mine.
keywords: tms320f2812 chip, variable frequency control, ventilation control system
affiliations: Shengtai Company, Jinneng Holding Equipment Manufacturing Group

title: Research on Bidirectional RFPower Amplifier for Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Aimingat the situation of less transmit power and low receiving sensitivity in wireless communication module in industrial IOT wireless sensor network; a kind of bi-directional RF power amplifier working in 470MHz band has been designed in this paper.Choosing SiGe NPN transistor NESG270034 made by Renesas and the fifth generation of Si material technology NPN transistor BFU530W made by NXP to design forward amplifier and reverse amplifier respectively.The test results show that in the 470 MHZ band; the gain of forward amplifier is 18.9dB;S11 and S22 is less than-15dB;the gain of reverse amplifier is greater than 15dB;the noise factor is less than 1dB;S11 and S22 is less than-15dB.Testing the transmit power and receiver sensitivity with cc1120～470MHz node has proved the practicability of the bi-directional RF power amplifier at last.
keywords: bi-directional rf, industrial wireless communication, power amplifier, rf front end
affiliations: College of Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Chongqing College of Electronic Engineering

title: Design of a Bidirectional Non-isolated DC-DC Converter System based on DSP28335
abstract: In this paper; a non-isolated bidirectional DC-DC converter system based on DSP chip TMS320F28335 is proposed. The effectiveness of the converter topology is verified through functional debugging and relevant test analysis of the prototype.
keywords: dc-dc converter, intelligent control, non-isolated
affiliations: Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineering,Kaifeng University

title: Multi-Motor Synchronous Control System for Self-Driving Articulated Arm Measuring Machine
abstract: To solve the problem of multi-motor synchronous rotation of self-driven articulated arm measuring machine;a set of multi-motor synchronous control system is designed. The DSP processor with TMS320F28335 as the core is selected by the control system. And the driver board interface circuits;such as dual CAN communication circuit;power inverter circuit;motor drive circuit;are designed orderly. Then;the simulation model of multi-motor synchronous control is established by Simulink. The above motor control model is converted into engineering code. Accordingly;point-to-point position synchronization experiments with different position angles set for six motors are performed;as well as multi-motor trajectory tracking experiments. Experimental results show that the synchronous control time accuracy is within 10ms;which can not only verifies the synchronous control effectiveness of the six motors;but also provide references for improvement of motion stability and measuring efficiency of measuring machine.
keywords: dsp, multi-motor, self-driven doint arm, synchronous control
affiliations: School of Mechanical Engineering,Anhui University of Science and Technology, School of Applied Technology,Huainan Normal University
