title: Construction of greenhouse wireless measurement and control network based on ZigBee
abstract: 针对现有温室大棚缺乏有效在线测控手段，以及布线困难等问题，设计开发了基于ZigBee的温室无线测控网络，将信息采集、无线传输、数据处理与远程控制集于一体，既可解决数据远程传输技术问题，又避免安装大量传感器和终端设备的弊端，从而满足温室环境监测过程中对多测点、多要素、移动性、便捷性等方面的要求。系统采用ZigBee星型拓扑结构，温湿度传感器采用DHT11，微处理器采用超低功耗片上系统CC2530，实现数据的多点采集和无线传输。从硬件和软件两方面考虑了低功耗设计的要求，搭建了系统的硬件结构及软件设计方案。最后实验调试结果表明，搭建的网络可实现良好的自组网性和可扩展性，工作性能稳定，并且有效简化了现场设备安装与拆移等过程，使之更适合温室大棚现场数据测控的需求。
keywords: zigbee, 无线测控, 温湿度传感器

title: 智能温室大棚自动控制系统的设计
abstract: 我国温室大棚应用比较普遍，很大程度上促进了我国农业的发展。但我国温室大棚长期以来主要依靠人工管理，工作量大，而且对植物生长环境的把控不精确，对农作物产量造成影响。针对这些问题，设计以CC2530搭建的ZigBee无线网络为核心的智能温室大棚自动控制系统，将各传感器及各执行机构连接到CC2530上形成不同功能的网络节点，可以实时监测大棚内空气湿度、土壤湿度、光照强度、温度，同时按照植物的生长环境需求进行补光、浇水、通风、降温等操作，将环境变量控制在用户设定的范围内。此系统通过无线网络进行信息传输，解决长距离信号不良的问题，对各节点的控制更加灵活。在农业温室大棚中，此系统具有较大的实用价值与较高的经济效益。
keywords: zigbee, 无线传输, 智能温室大棚, 环境, 自动控制
affiliations: 鄂尔多斯应用技术学院

title: 基于无线传感器网络的粉尘浓度检测系统的开发与实现
abstract: 文章根据前人的研究成果，提出了一种使用电容传感器测粉尘含量的方法，利用无线传感器网络的优势，提出一套基于无线传输模块CC2530 ZigBee协议的、用于检测粉尘浓度的无线传感器网络方案，可以提高粉尘检测的稳定性，对于控制粉尘浓度具有重要意义。
keywords: 无线传感器网络, 检测系统, 粉尘浓度
affiliations: 北京中冶卓元科技发展有限公司

title: Research and Application of Pressure Wireless Monitoring System of Underground Hydraulic Support Based on SimpliciTI Protocol
abstract: In view of wiring complexity and low reliability of data transmission existed in the wired monitoring system of hydraulic surrort pressure in underground coal mine;a pressure monitoring system of hydraulic support based on SimpliciTI protocol was designed. Taking a radio frequency chip CC1101 as the key part of the system; the pressure data of hydraulic support can be acquisited; displayed;stored; wireless routed and transmited combined with the SimpliciTI protocol; which realizes the pressure monitoring of hydraulic support that the wireless network scope can cover.
keywords: cc1101, hydraulic support, monitoring system, simpliciti protocol
affiliations: CCTEG Fushun Testing Center Co., Ltd., State Key Laboratory of Coal Safety Technology, CCTEG Shenyang Research Institute Co., Ltd.

title: Research and Design of Online Monitoring System of Scraper Conveyor Chain State Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: An online monitoring system of scraper conveyor chain state was proposed. The wireless sensor of scraper conveyor chain was composed with ZigBee wireless chip CC2530 as the core control device; and the pin lock wireless sensor was installed on the link ring to detect the stress of the pin lock of the link ring in real time; so as to realize the real-time detection and fault warning of the scraper conveyor chain state. The alarm after the break of the chain is changed to the warning stop before the chain break accident; so as to avoid the occurrence of the chain break accident.
keywords: fault warning, online monitoring, pin lock wireless sensor, scraper conveyor chain
affiliations: Zhengzhou Coal Mine Machinery Group Co., Ltd.

title: Research on Motor Control System of New Energy Pure Electric Four-drive Agricultural Machinery
abstract: Due to its high efficiency; long life and good dynamic characteristics; brushless DC motor has gradually be-come the preferred power choice for electric vehicles. It presents a set of control system of pure electric four-wheel drive agricultural machinery motor based on TMS320F2812. The system uses brushless DC motor as the driver; and combines with incremental PI control algorithm to realize the high-precision control of pure electric four-wheel drive agricultural machinery motor. The system is more suitable for the complex operation conditions of pure electric four-wheel drive agri-cultural machinery.
keywords: agricultural machinery, dc brushless motor, electric vehicle, pi control, tms320f2812
affiliations: Henan Polytechnic School of Science and Engineering

title: Non-contact detection of yarn tension based on embedded system
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of yarn tension detection and avoid the contact error caused by contact measurement; a non-contact real-time yarn tension detection method based on machine vision and embedded system was proposed. Firstly; in order to ensure both the speed of image processing algorithm and the accuracy of yarn tension detection in real-time system; a fast feature extraction algorithm based on threshold segmentation was proposed. The image dimension reduction and edge feature extraction were realized at the same time; which can extract the moving yarn waveform in real time and reduce the interference of the external environment on the yarn image. Secondly; an image acquisition system composed of high-speed linear array camera and FPGA high-speed storage system and a detection system composed of image processor with TMS320C6678 as the main chip were built. Through real-time acquisition of images of moving yarns; yarn vibration frequency was extracted from yarn vibration waveform in unit period; and real-time tension of yarns was calculated by using string vibration model. The experimental results show that the error between the detection value of the non-contact yarn detection system based on embedded machine vision and the resistance sensor was about 1.5%; which meets the control requirements of the real-time system.
keywords: embedded, image recognition, non-contact detection, string vibration, yarn tension

title: 煤矿主要通风机智能保护器的设计及应用
abstract: 针对山西某矿主要通风机系统存在自动化智能化水平低、保护性差、实时性差的问题，应用TMS320F28335芯片为该矿主要通风机系统设计了一种智能保护器，对具体设计状况进行了介绍，并实施了试验验证，所得出的试验结果为：该智能保护器不仅实时性好，保护性强，而且运行稳定可靠，有助于提升矿井通风系统运行的自动化和智能化水平，更好地保障矿井安全通风。

title: Research and Implementation of TMS320F2812 Software Upgrade Method Based on Serial Port
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional DSP application programming; through the analysis of the application programming principle; a method for upgrading application programs using serial ports is designed. Firstly; this paper expounds the necessity of online upgrading scheme; the composition of the hardware system; and the overall architecture of online upgrading scheme. Then; it describes the conversion method for application HEX data file; designs the method for LabVIEW host computer software with re-encoding HEX files and embedded DSP upgrading software; respectively. Finally; the correctness and feasibility of the TMS320F2812 software upgrading method based on serial port are verified through the open-loop experiments; FLASH data comparison experiments; and DSP control system functional verification experiments; the method solves the disadvantage that DSP control software must be burned and written through a downloader; improves the flexibility and reliability of the embedded software upgrading; and prolongs the life of the product. It has the advantages of simple; practical and strong portability; which lays a foundation for the remote and wireless upgrading of laser control systems and other software in other fields.
keywords: api, dsp, labview, online upgrading, tms320f2812
affiliations: North China Research Institute of Electro-Optics

title: Transplant and Optimization of CiSSA-CSP Feature Extraction Algorithm on DSP Platform
abstract: In order to realize the on-line and real-time processing of portable signal binary classification analysis systems; DSP platform is used to implement the embedded transplantation of CiSSA-DSP feature extraction algorithm. A CiSSA-CSP feature extraction algorithm has the excellent performance of time-frequency-spatial feature extraction; and it is suitable for extracting non-stationary signals in real-time binary classification system. Compared with PC; an embedded implementation has the characteristics of miniaturization; portability; low power consumption and low delay; while the computing resources and memory of embedded platform processor is limited; and the transplant feature extraction algorithm must be optimized to ensure the binary classification accuracy and low delay. The steps of the CiSSA-CSP algorithm; the compiler optimization; keywords and library functions are optimized to improve the compilation efficiency; the CiSSA-CSP feature extraction algorithm is transplanted to the TMS320C6678 embedded DSP platform; and its effectiveness for real-time classification system is verified by the public dataset. Compared with Matlab on PC; the classification accuracy of the binary classification system is reduced by less than 0.5% on the DSP platform; and the computing time for singel experiment is less than 0.15s.
keywords: binary classification, cissa-csp, dsp, feature extraction, transplant and optimization
affiliations: Heilongjiang North Tool Co., Ltd., Department of Precision Instrument, Tsinghua University

title: In-system Programming of Digital Circuits for LWD-NMR Logging Tools
abstract: Affected by the impact and vibration of well drilling; the internal circuit of the logging while drilling（LWD-NMR） tool need special packaging; so that the digital circuit system composed of DSP and FPGA can not be upgraded through the JTAG interface. A system programming technology based on serial bus is proposed. According to the configuration characteristics of flash and JTAG interface protocol;using DSP as main controller and using the underlying program by self-written; the configuration files by URAT were written into the internal flash of DSP and FPGA; achieving the DSP and FPGA in system programming（ISP）. By using the system debugging of the digital circuit of TI TMS320F2812 and Actel A3P1000; it is proved that this method has high reliability and convenient operation.
keywords: isp, jtag, lwd-nmr, urat

title: The Emergency Decision Mode for Indoor Fire Disaster Based on the “Internet Plus Emergency Environment”
abstract: [Objective/Significance] Construct an emergency response mode for the indoor fire based on the “Internet Plus Emergency Environment” to improve the efficiency of emergency response for the indoor fire disaster. [Methods/Processes] This paper unravels the “Internet Plus” idea technically; creates the technology implementation architecture of “Internet Plus” crossborder integration. By applying the architecture; the fundamental mechanism of the emergency decision mode for indoor fire disaster based on the “Internet Plus Emergency Environment” is investigated from four aspects which respectively are the linkage mechanism between emergency environment and department; the big data integration for the sudden indoor fire disaster; the improved Zukoski-based indoor fire detection model; the fire emergency response method based on the knowledge reasoning and so on. Based on the mode; a fire warning emulated system based on the multiple sensors for the emergency fire was developed by using the CC2530 development toolkits of Internet of Things; Neo4j knowledge graph tool and Java EE technologies. And a fire emulation experiment was conducted by burning pieces of paper indoor. [Limitations] The experiment was conducted in a simulated environment. Before practical application; abundant and more real experiments are needed. [Results/Conclusions] The experiment result shows the constructed emergency decision mode is effective.
keywords: emergency, fire disaster response, “internet plus”
authors: ZHANG Dong;TANG Mingwei;YU Dingfang;QIN Yuhao;ZHANG Wei

title: 煤矿井下通风智能管控系统设计与试验
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the underground ventilation control system of coal mine;such as unreasonable network structure;inaccurate wind speed detection;poor dynamic adjustment ability and imperfect environmental monitoring parameters;the intelligent ventilation control system of underground coal mine is designed in the paper;including the hardware and software scheme of the intelligent ventilation control system with TMS320F2812 chip as the core.The chip collects the environmental parameters of roadway in real time and controls the output of frequency converter to achieve the purpose of dynamically adjusting the fan speed.The data transmission network of the ventilation system is established by TCP/IP communication and CAN bus communication technology;and the remote monitoring of the underground ventilation system is realized through the ground control room;whose experimental analysis results show that the intelligent ventilation control system meets the design requirements;improves the intelligent level of underground ventilation control system;and guarantees the safe and efficient production of underground coal mine.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对煤矿井下通风管控系统存在的网络结构不合理、风速检测不准确、动态调节能力差、环境监测参数不完善等问题;设计煤矿井下通风智能管控系统;包括以TMS320F2812芯片为核心的通风智能管控系统硬件、软件方案;由芯片实时采集巷道环境参数并控制变频器输出;达到动态调节风机转速的目的;由TCP/IP通讯、CAN总线通信技术组建通风系统数据传输网络;通过地面调度室实现对井下通风系统的远程监控;最后完成试验分析。试验分析结果表明;该通风智能管控系统满足设计要求;提升了煤矿井下通风管控系统的智能化水平;保障了煤矿井下安全、高效生产。
keywords: tms320f2812 chip, variable frequency control, ventilation control system

title: 基于锁相环的可编程ASK调制信号源设计
abstract: In this paper;a phase locked loop-based method for generating Amplitude-Shift Keying(ASK)modulated signal sources is proposed to solve the problem of data acquisition for electromagnetic radiation modulation signal recognition.An ASK modulation signal source with adjustable carrier;variable symbol and stable signal source is designed by using phase locked loop and STM32.The phase-locked loop LMX2572 with high stability and low power consumption is used to generate sine waves in the frequency range of 12.5 MHz~3 GHz;and the baseband signal is controlled by the STM32F103C8T6 microprocessor to digitally modulate the sine waves generated by the phase-locked loop to realize the function of generating ASK modulated signals.The experimental results show that the designed ASK modulated signal source realizes the functions of variable frequency;variable symbol;variable power and programmable control;and solves the problem of real-time and convenient data acquisition.The ASK modulated signal generated by the proposed method can be used to verify the type detection of electromagnetic radiation modulated signal.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章针对电磁辐射调制信号识别所需数据采集问题;提出基于锁相环的可编程幅移键控(Amplitude Shift Keying;ASK)调制信号源生成方法。使用锁相环结合单片机STM32设计一个载波可调、码元可变、信号源稳定的ASK调制信号源。采用稳定性高、功耗低的锁相环LMX2572产生频率范围12.5 MHz~3 GHz的正弦波;并使用STM32F103C8T6微处理器控制基带信号对锁相环生成的正弦波进行数字调制;实现ASK调制信号产生功能。实验结果表明;设计的ASK调制信号源实现了频率可变、码元可变、功率可变和可编程控制功能;解决了实时便捷数据采集的问题。所提方法生成的ASK调制信号可用于电磁辐射调制信号类型检测的验证。
keywords: electromagnetic modulation signal, phase locked loop lmx2572, signal source, stm32f103c8t6

title: Research on Online Monitoring System for Vibration Equipment in Coal Preparation Plant Based on Wireless Transmission
abstract: 针对选煤厂有线数据采集系统布线困难以及费用较高的问题，在ZigBee无线传感技术的基础上设计出一套选煤厂振动设备在线监测系统。该系统选用CC2530单片机，终端数据采集节点选用MPU6050加速度传感器、DS18B20温度传感器和DHT11温湿度传感器，实时采集振动设备的加速度、温度值和周边环境的温湿度情况，并将传感器读取的数据进行计算和校验，再通过无线传输，最后对系统进行测试，结果表明：该系统能够实时显示设备的运行状况，若设备发生温度或振动异常可及时报警，有效保障了设备稳定可靠的运行。
keywords: zigbee, 传感器, 在线监测, 振动设备, 无线传输

title: Design and Research of Smart Home System Based on Elderly People
abstract: In response to the aging issue caused by the global increase in the elderly population; this article designs and implements an elderly-friendly smart home system based on the ZigBee communication protocol to enhance the quality of life for the elderly. The system consists of three components: a coordinator; two terminal nodes; and a mobile APP; with multiple functions such as temperature and humidity monitoring; light detection; mattress pressure and acceleration monitoring. In hardware design; the CC2530 is used as the main controller to ensure low power consumption and stability of the system. In software design; real-time detection and control of environmental data are achieved; and remote communication is supported. It is expected to provide new application ideas for smart home technology in the field of aging-friendly designs.
keywords: aging adaptability, illumination, smart home system, temperature and humidity, zigbee communication protocol

title: 基于Z-Stack协议栈的环境数据无线传输实验的递进式实现
abstract: 基于Z-Stack协议栈的环境数据无线传输实验是《无线传感网络技术》课程的重要实践环节。通过做好两个前置实验：传感器实验（以温湿度传感器为例）和TI CC2530 Z-Stack协议栈IAR工程配置实验，为进一步实现基于Z-Stack协议栈的环境数据无线传输实验建立了基础。这种递进式的学习和实践方式，不仅符合循序渐进的学习规律，而且有利于培养本科生的工程实践技能和创新能力。

title: A Pig House Environmental Monitoring System Based on the IoT
abstract: This study focuses on the pig farming environment and aims to design and develop an Internet of Things（IoT）-based monitoring system for pig pens.Environmental factors such as temperature; humidity; light intensity; and ammonia concentration within the pig pens are collected using sensors.Data transmission is carried out through the CC2530 wireless transmission module and ZigBee gateway.The IoT platform is used to manage and receive environmental data uploaded by the monitoring system.When the environmental factors of the pigsty exceed the threshold; an alarm will be triggered; and environmental data can be viewed at any time through cloud platforms and mobile phones.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, iot, pigsty environment
affiliations: School of applied technology,Huanghe S＆T College

title: The Indoor Environmental Monitoring System Based on the OneNET Cloud Platform
abstract: With the development of Internet of Things; blockchain; big data and artificial intelligence; the environmental monitoring industry is booming. However; at present; lots of environmental infrastructure has the regret of simplicity; oldness and lacking modernization. In order to obtain more efficiently and accurately all kinds of information of the current indoor environment; and achieve the accurate monitoring of environmental information; we design a kind of indoor environmental monitoring system based on the OneNET cloud platform. This system adopts the ZigBee development board; takes the CC2530 chip as the core of data processing to realize the wireless transmission of data; and realizes the intelligent monitoring and automatic control of indoor environment based on multi-source perception nodes through the technologies of intelligent perception and storage; and the multidimensional data fusion of computation and indoor environment.
keywords: indoor environmental monitoring, internet of things, onenet cloud platform, zigbee wireless communication
affiliations: School of Information Engineering, Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University

title: Application of ZigBee Technology in Distributed Photovoltaic Power Generation Systems
abstract: This paper describes the optoelectronic monitoring technology implemented by Zig Bee technology. The system is based on CC2530 as the core; adapted to RS-485 communication interface; and has four power consumption modes. It verifies that Zig Bee technology achieves data transfer between nodes in distributed photovoltaic power plants.
keywords: distributed photovoltaics, wireless communication, zig bee technology
affiliations: Clean Energy Branch of CNOOC Energy Development Co., Ltd.

title: 面向超声刀能量发生器的嵌入式DSP控制系统设计
abstract: In the working process of ultrasonic scalpel;there are high requirements for the real-time and stability of the energy generator control system.Aiming at these requirements;a control system of ultrasonic scalpel energy generator based on DSP is designed.The system takes TMS320F28377D with main frequency of 200 MHz as the main control chip;and controls the power supply circuit;drive circuit;feedback circuit and man-machine interaction system through ePWM module;IIC module;SPI module and SCI module of the chip;and generate sinusoidal AC signals that drive the ultrasonic scalpel to work.Then;the control law accelerator CLA is called to carry out non-periodic sampling algorithm and PID control algorithm to complete the closed-loop control of the whole energy generator system.Compared with the MCU control system whose data operation and control functions are all completed by CPU;the control system using CPU and CLA together has faster operation speed and shorter control cycle.The power control strategy of constant output current is adopted to maximize the stability of the ultrasonic scalpel;and the parameters such as current signal and voltage signal of the system are displayed on the screen in real time.
abstract_in_chinese: 超声手术刀在工作过程中;对能量发生器控制系统的实时性和稳定性有着较高要求。针对这些要求;设计一种基于DSP的超声刀能量发生器控制系统;该系统以主频达200 MHz的TMS320F28377D为主控芯片;通过芯片的ePWM模块、IIC模块、SPI模块和SCI模块完成对供电电路、驱动电路、反馈电路和人机交互系统的控制;产生驱动超声刀工作的正弦交流信号;调用CLA对采样信号进行运算并执行PID控制程序;完成对整个能量发生器系统的闭环控制。相比于数据运算和控制功能全部由CPU完成的MCU控制系统;协同使用CPU和CLA的控制系统运算速度更快、控制周期更短。采用恒定输出电流的功率控制策略;可最大限度地提高超声刀工作的稳定性;实现通过屏幕控制系统;并将系统的电压信号、电流信号等参数实时显示到屏幕上。
keywords: control system, dsp, embedded system, energy generator, ultrasonic scalpel

title: Intelligent Early Warning System for Logistics Warehouse Safety and Fire Fighting Based on Multimodal Information Fusion
abstract: Conventional logistics warehouse safety and fire protection intelligent warning system mainly uses Z-Stack protocol stack to call warning instructions; which is easily affected by the role of task polling; resulting in some of the functions of the system anomaly; so it is necessary to design a new logistics warehouse safety and fire protection intelligent warning system based on multimodal information fusion. In the hardware part; CC2530 node transceiver chip; TAD smoke sensor and DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor are designed. The software part uses multimodal information fusion to design an intelligent warning multi-target detection algorithm; and designs the fire intelligent warning function module; thus realizing the logistics warehouse safety fire intelligent warning. The system test results show that the designed logistics warehouse safety and fire safety intelligent warning system based on multimodal information fusion has good performance; the test functions are normal and reliable; has certain application value; and can make some contribution to reducing the fire risk of logistics warehouses.
keywords: fire, intelligent early warning system, logistics, multimodal information fusion, safety, warehouse
affiliations: Fire Prevention and Supervision 1st Section, Jinshan District Fire and Rescue Division

title: Sliding mode compensation control of a permanent magnet synchronous motor based on a new voltage control law
abstract: There is a problem of weak dynamic performance caused by the dynamic coupling and back EMF terms in the torque closed-loop control system of a permanent magnet synchronous motor. Thus a sliding mode compensation control method based on a new voltage control law is proposed. First; based on the permanent magnet synchronous motor model; a new voltage control law is established to ensure the stability of the torque closed-loop control system. Second; using the functional relationship between the velocity estimation and the sliding mode surface; an adaptive velocity observer is designed to compensate the coupling and back-EMF terms of the d-axis and q-axis; and realize the speed closed-loop of the system at the same time. After that; a sliding mode surface with a sigmoid nonlinear smooth function is introduced; and a sliding mode compensation control strategy is constructed to realize the robustness of the control law to parameter and external perturbations during the entire motion process. Finally; a Matlab/Simulink simulation model and experimental platform of a 400 W permanent magnet synchronous motor controlled by TMS320F28335 are built. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control method has the characteristics of small torque and current fluctuation; fast response and strong robustness.
keywords: adaptive speed observer, new voltage control law, permanent magnet synchronous motor, sliding mode compensation control, torque closed-loop control system
affiliations: Engineering Research Center of Ministry of Education for Renewable Energy Generation and Grid Connection Technology, Xinjiang University

title: MPC of multi-module dual active full-bridge converters
abstract: The dual active bridge（DAB）converter with parallel output in the cascaded power electronic transformer（PET）is taken as the research object;the modeling of multi-module parallel DAB topology structure is conducted;and the power balance control of each module is realized by means of the model predictive control（MPC）. On this basis;an improved MPC strategy is proposed for the case that the DAB module of the actual cascade PET equipment has no load current sensor. The strategy can be used to calculate the total output current by means of the power transmission characteristics of the DAB;the current equalization is used to realize the equal power operation of each module under the conditions that only the output voltage is sampled;but does not need to introduce any additional virtual current to replace the sampling current. The proposed control strategy is verified by means of the Matlab/Simulink simulation and the construction of two-module DAB parallel output experimental prototype taking TMS320F28335 as the core. The experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.In comparison with the traditional control strategy;the dynamic response of the control strategy is faster;its output ripple is smaller;and its modular control is easy to achieve large-scale cascade;which can effectively reduce costs.
keywords: dual active full-bridge converter, equipower operation, modularity control, mpc, output current calculation, power balancing, simulation testing
affiliations: The Electrical Engineering College,Guizhou University, Guizhou Key Laboratory of Electric Big Data,Guizhou Institute of Technology

title: 基于ZigBee的室内指纹定位算法应用
abstract: 随着科学技术的快速发展，人们对于定位的需求也随之增加，但室内定位发展尚不成熟。针对目前室内定位的精准度以及成本过高问题，设计一种基于ZigBee的物联网室内定位系统。采用CC2530芯片模块作为无线通信设备，通过ZigBee技术采集定位区域内的各个参考节点的接收信号强度值（RSSI），建立离线指纹库；再利用欧氏距离公式计算出与离线指纹库中差距最小的3组数据，最后根据三边测量法计算出未知节点的坐标，实现室内定位功能。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 三边测量法, 室内定位, 指纹定位, 接收信号强度值, 物联网定位
authors: 张瑞年;时子皓;高常青;王国锋
affiliations: 济南大学山东交通学院

title: 基于物联网的智能农业温室大棚监测系统
abstract: 针对目前传统农业模式需要花费大量人力物力进行农作物生长环境监测等问题，为了实现农作物生长环境数据的实时远程监测，提出一种基于物联网的智能农业温室大棚监测系统。利用Zig Bee通信模块和CC2530控制模块，实现了对农业温室大棚内多种环境数据的智能实时监测，以及对农业大棚内部环境的远程控制和智能管理。
keywords: zigbee, 农业大棚, 温室大棚, 温湿度传感器, 物联网, 监测技术
authors: 尤达;陈雷;郭登宇;苗君臣;王艺涵;涂德宇;王睿昊
affiliations: 安徽理工大学电气与信息工程学院

title: Automatic Control System of Electronic Measuring Device Based on Wireless Sensing Technology
abstract: In order to meet the high-precision measurement requirements of electronic measurement devices;an automatic control system for electronic measurement devices based on wireless sensing technology is designed. The data acquisition layer of the system utilizes sensors to collect the operating signals of electronic measuring devices. The CC2530 chip is selected as the communication core chip in the network layer;and the ZigBee coordinator is used to design wireless sensor network node software to manage and maintain wireless sensor nodes and transmit data to the control layer. The control layer selects the S3C44B0X microprocessor as the control chip;controls the automatic control module to run the PID control algorithm;automatically controls the electronic measurement device;and displays the control results to the user using the human-machine interaction module in the application layer. The test results indicate that the designed system can automatically control different types of electronic measuring devices;reducing the measurement error to 0.4%.
keywords: automatic control system, coordinator, electronic measuring device, microprocessor, pid control, wireless sensing technology
affiliations: School of Electronic Information and Computer Engineering,Sichuan Institute of Industrial Technology

title: 基于新型电压控制律的永磁同步电机滑模补偿控制
abstract: There is a problem of weak dynamic performance caused by the dynamic coupling and back EMF terms in the torque closed-loop control system of a permanent magnet synchronous motor.Thus a sliding mode compensation control method based on a new voltage control law is proposed.First;based on the permanent magnet synchronous motor model;a new voltage control law is established to ensure the stability of the torque closed-loop control system.Second;using the functional relationship between the velocity estimation and the sliding mode surface;an adaptive velocity observer is designed to compensate the coupling and back-EMF terms of the d-axis and q-axis;and realize the speed closed-loop of the system at the same time.After that;a sliding mode surface with a sigmoid nonlinear smooth function is introduced;and a sliding mode compensation control strategy is constructed to realize the robustness of the control law to parameter and external perturbations during the entire motion process.Finally;a Matlab/Simulink simulation model and experimental platform of a 400 W permanent magnet synchronous motor controlled by TMS320F28335 are built.Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control method has the characteristics of small torque and current fluctuation;fast response and strong robustness.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对永磁同步电机转矩闭环控制系统中动态耦合项和反电动势项引发弱动态性能的问题;提出一种基于新型电压控制律的永磁同步电机滑模补偿控制方法。首先;基于永磁同步电机模型建立新型电压控制律;保证转矩闭环控制系统的稳定性。其次;利用速度估值与滑模面的函数关系;设计自适应速度观测器;对d、q轴耦合项和反电动势项进行补偿;同时实现系统的速度闭环控制。在此基础上;引入含sigmoid非线性光滑函数的滑模面;构造滑模补偿控制策略;实现控制律在整个运动过程中对参数摄动和外扰动的鲁棒性。最后;搭建Matlab/Simulink仿真模型和由TMS320F28335控制的400 W永磁同步电机的实验平台。仿真和实验结果表明所提控制方法具有转矩和电流波动小、响应快和鲁棒性强的特性。

title: 基于本地化ARM主控的智能家居联动集成系统设计
abstract: 随着社会经济不断发展以及人们生活节奏加快，智能家居的应用场景越来越丰富，智能家居使用和方便越来越受人们青睐。但市面上的智能家居系统普遍存在价格高昂，功能花哨而不实用的特点。本文介绍了以低功耗芯片CC2530为无线模块，STM32F103ZET6高算力芯片为总控（网关）通过路由和节点终端（STM32F103C8T6）的连接，结合语音识别等模块，借助立创EDA及STM32CubeMx等软件，构建一套智能家居系统。实现了部分日常生活实用价值较高的功能，例如日程定时提醒，全屋联动，家用电器的语音控制，线上控制，及定时开关等。
keywords: 嵌入式自动化系统, 智能家居, 网关
authors: 黄堪杰;陈嘉欣;魏小镇;陈俊龙;黄映欣
affiliations: 广东东软学院

title: Design of robot integrated joint drive and control system
abstract: The robotic joint is the key component of robot; which needs to meet the indicators of high precision and high reliability.However; due to the restriction of volume and cost; its design is more difficult. A highly integrated joint and its drive and control system were designed. On the basis of meeting the requirements of “light and thin” mechanical structure design; the hardware and software of the drive and control system were mainly designed.Using TMS320F28379D as the main control chip; the hardware circuit of the drive and control system was designed. Finally; the software algorithm was designed. The experiments show that the designed integrated joint has the characteristics of compact structure; high integration degree; stable operation; and can be rapidly applied to the design and development of robots.
keywords: drive and control system, integrated joint, modular design, robot joint module
affiliations: Jiangsu Key Laboratory of Advanced Food Manufacturing Equipment and Technology, School of Mechanical Engineering, Jiangnan University

title: Contactless Intelligent Delivery Car Based on OpenMV
abstract: A new type of intelligent delivery device has been designed to meet the needs of hospitals; hotels; restaurants; and other places that require "contactless delivery"; providing a safer; more efficient; and accurate service for the logistics industry. The system is controlled by an STM32 microcontroller and equipped with an OpenMV image recognition module; TSL1401 linear CCD module; HX711 weight sensor module; and 2.4G ZigB ee CC2530 serial wireless transmission and reception module. Two OpenMV modules recognize the location information; and the TSL1401 linear CCD module in front and rear of the small car; together with the white light strip; realize the forward and backward tracking function. The 2.4G ZigBee serial wireless module realizes communication between delivery vehicles; and the HX711 electronic scale module obtains the weight of the delivered items. Experimental testing has shown that this contactless delivery device achieves a more efficient; accurate; safe; and convenient delivery method; with good system stability.
keywords: contactless delivery, openmv, pid, tsl1401 line tracking
affiliations: Keyi College of Zhejiang Sci-tech University

title: Design and test of real-time monitoring system for production line based on Internet of Things technology
abstract: Since the automatic production line is in the unsupervised state; the occurrence of abnormal working conditions will bring serious negative impact on product quality and production safety; so it is particularly necessary to adopt remote real-time monitoring. This paper firstly introduces the hardware design of the real-time monitoring system of the production line; including the circuit design of CC2530 chip; the design of terminal node and gateway node; etc. Then it Outlines the components of system software; including SQL database; ZigBee node and so on. Finally; the system test was carried out in the laboratory. The results show that the system can accurately collect the temperature; humidity and smoke concentration of the production line; and according to the collected data; it can be presented on the monitoring platform in two ways: data and curve; which is convenient for managers to timely grasp the real-time condition of the production line.
keywords: internet of things, production line real-time monitoring system, temperature and humidity sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Guangxi Vocational ＆ Technical Institute of Industry

title: Visual Management Method of Intelligent Equipment with Integrated Video Monitoring Function
abstract: In order to improve the visual monitoring capabilities of smart devices; this research designs a visual management solution that can realize the life cycle management of smart devices. In video management; the main control chip is TMS320DM8168; and it achieves to capture multi-channel digital video. The hardware includes ARM subsystem; high-definition video processing subsystem; codec subsystem and DSP subsystem; etc. In order to improve the ability of visual recognition; an improved random forest model is used to visually monitor the data information of smart devices to improve the ability of data information monitoring. Experiments show that the method proposed has high working efficiency and high recognition efficiency.
keywords: intelligent equipment, multi-channel digital video acquisition, random forest model, visual monitoring

title: 提高不对称半桥反激变换器轻载效率的数字化控制方法
abstract: The traditional control method of asymmetric half-bridge flyback converter(AHBFC)is to use complementary PWM control.Under light load;due to the long turn-on time of its clamping tube;the primary side has large turn-on loss and cycle loss;and the converter efficiency is low.In order to solve the problem of low light-load efficiency;a digital control method based on TMS320F28335 is proposed.Non-complementary PWM control is adopted.The zero-crossing point of excitation current is estimated by control algorithm combined with the inductance voltage-second balance relationship.The converter works in intermittent mode;thus greatly reducing the conduction loss and circulating loss at the primary side of the transformer.Before the main switch is turned on;the auxiliary pulse is introduced to make the power switch zero-voltage switching(ZVS);which reduces the switching loss.The main loss of light load under the complementary control is analyzed;the working principle and design flow of the proposed control method are given;and the method is applied to a digital power supply prototype with input voltage of 48 V and output of 12 V/100 W.The experimental results show that under light load;the converter can realize zero voltage turn-on of two switches with this control method.Compared with the traditional complementary control method;the conversion efficiency is improved by 3%~11%;and the no-load current is reduced by 37.5%.
abstract_in_chinese: 传统的不对称半桥反激变换器(Asymmetrical half-bridge flyback converter;AHBFC)控制方法是采用互补PWM控制.在轻载时;由于其箝位管导通时间过长;初级侧具有很大的导通损耗和循环损耗;变换器效率较低.为了解决轻载效率低问题;提出了一种基于TMS320F28335的数字化控制方法.采用非互补PWM控制;结合电感伏秒平衡关系设计控制算法预估励磁电流的过零点;变换器工作于断续模式;从而大幅降低了变压器初级侧的导通损耗和循环损耗;在主开关管开启前;引入辅助脉冲;使功率开关零电压开通(zero-voltage switching;ZVS);实现了开关损耗的降低.分析了互补控制下轻载运行时的主要损耗;给出了所提控制方法的工作原理和设计流程;并将该方法应用于一台输入电压48 V;输出12 V/100 W的数字电源原理样机.实验结果表明;在轻载下;采用提出的控制方法;变换器能够实现两个开关管的零电压开通;相较于传统互补的控制方法;转换效率提高了3%~11%;空载电流降低了37.5%.
keywords: asymmetrical half-bridge flyback, digital control, light-load efficiency, soft-switching

title: Application of ZigBee wireless network technology in forest fire prevention
abstract: In order to effectively prevent and reduce the damage of forest fire to the forest ecological environment;this paper designs and develops a forest fire monitoring system based on ZigBee technology;aiming at the shortcomings of insufficient intellectualization of forest fire prevention and excessive capital and artificial investment. The system adopts the“terminal-host-cloud platform”architecture;using ZigBee terminal node to obtain environmental data of various sensor using carry 4G communication module of ZigBee coordinator node will upload data to the cloud server;relevant staff by the host the client view the environment data and adjusting the threshold value;realize the reverse control of the terminal equipment. The test results show that the forest fire monitoring system based on ZigBee technology can achieve the purpose of forest environment monitoring and intelligent control;has strong operability and practical significance.
keywords: cc2530, forest fire prevention, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Topology and Control Strategy of Lower Voltage Stress Single-stage Buck-boost Inverter
abstract: Traditional non-isolated inverters based on the Buck-Boost principle usually have the disadvantage of high voltage stress. A new transformerless single-stage Buck-Boost voltage source inverter topology with lower voltage stress and its control method are proposed. This topology can realize inversion in a wider input voltage range; while having lower switching device voltage stress and inductor current ripple. The topological characteristics and working mode of the inverter are analyzed; and the sequence of each switch of the inverter that can ensure the balance of the output capacitor voltage is designed. A high frequency equivalent circuit is established to analyze the high-frequency leakage current. Finally; a hardware experimental platform is built; and the proposed scheme is experimentally verified on DSP TMS320F28335 and FPGA XC6SLX9-2TQG144C digital platform. The experimental results verify the feasibility of the proposed novel topology; control method and voltage balance strategy.
keywords: buck-boost inverter, common-mode voltage, modulation, multi-level inverter, voltage stress
authors: GUO Xiaoqiang;Josep M.GUERRERO;WANG Baocheng;ZHANG Hao;HUA Changchun;CHEN Zhaowen

title: Design of Intelligent Protector for Coal Mine Ground Main Ventilation
abstract: In view of the problems of low intelligence level and poor real-time performance existing in the coal mine ground main ventilation system; an intelligent protector for coal mine ground main ventilation is designed based on TMS320F28335 chip. The functional design and software and hardware scheme design of the intelligent protector for main ventilation are analyzed; and experimental verification is completed. The results show that the designed intelligent protector for coal mine ground main ventilation improves the intelligence level of the main ventilation system; improves the real-time performance of protection actions; and helps to enhance the safety production coefficient of coal mines.

title: Design of plant factory environmental data acquisition system based on ZigBee and WiFi technology
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the popularization and application of Internet of Things technology in agriculture and rural areas; the research and development of digital agricultural equipment has gradually become a popular research field of agricultural informatization industry. In this context; this paper designs a plant factory environment accurate acquisition system based on agricultural Internet of Things. This paper describes the overall structure of the system function with ZigBee-WiFi module as the core. The hardware system structure with CC2530 and ESP8266 as the core components is described. Then the design structure of Z-stack protocol stack and OneNET platform is described. After debugging and running; the system designed in this paper can accurately and real-time collect the environmental parameter data of the plant factory.
keywords: plant factory, wifi protocol, zigbee protocol

title: Emergency road condition rescue warning device based on wireless transceiver
abstract: In recent years; rescue vehicles have been blocked from time to time; and the vehicles on the road cannot know in advance the passing of rescue vehicles; resulting in slow avoidance. Aiming at the problem of how to ensure the timeliness of rescue during the traffic peak period; a wireless signal transceiver based on single chip microcomputer and CC1125 chip is proposed. Firstly; the overall design scheme of the transmitter is proposed; and secondly; the realization principle of transmitting and receiving wireless signals from the hardware and software perspectives is expounded on the basis of the scheme. Through the test and simulation experiment of the transmission stability of sending and receiving communication; the final result shows that the design has high transmission stability; and the rescue efficiency has been improved to a certain extent; which is of great significance for the relief of emergency rescue vehicles stuck on the rescue road.
keywords: emergency rescue, rf, wireless transceiver chip cc1125

title: Transformer inrush current simulation modeling and magnetic inrush current identification and suppression
abstract: This research applies simulation modeling based on the internal structure of the single-phase transformer; identifies and inhibits the data; analyzes the change of the magnetic flux ratio in the transformer and the dynamic process during closing; establishes a single-phase transformer simulation model; designs a transformer magnetizing inrush current suppression system.By using TMS320F2812 main controller; TV31B02 voltage transfermer and TA21A11 current transfermer in sampling module; the transfermer current and voltage were transfered into optimal signals.Experiments showed that the identification error of the magnetizing inrush current identification method in this study was the smallest; and the maximum value of the magnetizing inrush current generated after using the suppression system was 15.2A;which was only twice the rated current.
keywords: inhibition system, inrush current, sliding data window, the wavelet entropy, transformer simulation

title: Control system design of six axis robot based on fuzzy robust control
abstract: To tackle the problem that the trajectory deviation of the traditional six axis robot motion control system based on PLC or control card was too high; a robot control system based on fuzzy robust control was designed. In the hardware part of the control system; STM32F103C8T6 single chip microcomputer and TMS320C6203 DSP signal processor were selected; and the fuzzy adaptive control module was added to correct the motion trajectory through the adaptive adjustment of the control system parameters; At the system software level; the nonlinear moving trajectory and multiple uncertainties were compensated and optimized by updating fuzzy rules and introducing robust term algorithm. The experimental data showed that the joint angle parameters; link offset and displacement of the robot in the fuzzy robust control mode were accurate; and the trajectory deviation compensated by the dynamic control of three axial coordinates was smaller.
keywords: dynamic compensation, fuzzy robust control, path of particle, robot, six degrees of freedom

title: 基于无线传感网络的定位与测距技术研究
abstract: 无线传感器网络中涉及到一系列的测距算法，包括AOA定位法、TOA测距定位法、TDOA测距定位法、RSSI值的测距定位法，不同测距定位法所使用的信号模型、定位结果处理方式存在差异，但都是通过网络锚节点传感器之间的无线信号收发，得出无线传感网络内移动目标的相对位置信息。这一情况下，基于无线传感器信号传播的测距原理，利用RSSI值测距方法、多个传感器节点等，对某一移动目标的相对位置进行测量定位，可先建构起无线渐变信号的传播模型，再在ZigBee网络协议、CC2530数据处理模块支持下，展开无线信号传输的节点实验值仿真测量、噪声滤波处理，得出信号能量、测量距离间的数据拟合结果，并验证信标锚节点密度对未知节点定位精确度的影响，以实现误差范围内移动目标的精确测距定位。
keywords: rssi测距技术, 定位算法, 无线传感网络, 研究
affiliations: 河南交通技师学院

title: Feedforward PID Control of the Piezoelectric Micromanipulator Using EUPI Hysteresis Compensator
abstract: Piezoelectric driven micromanipulation improves the actual positioning performance of flexiblemicromanipulator. Due to the advantages of high resolution; simple structure and small size; the piezoelectric driven micromanipulator has been widely used in the field of IC manufacturing and cell operation. However; it is difficult to deal with the nonlinear characteristics; such as hysteresis characteristic; and the traditional PID controller can not meet the needs of control accuracy and response speed of micromanipulator system. Based on the analysis of the data model of the piezoelectric driven micromanipulator; a new control strategy（EIPID） based on the combination of EUPI inverse model and PID is proposed. In order to verify the real-time performance of the EIPID algorithm; the DSP chip TMS320F2812 is selected as the main control chip. The hardware circuit and software program are disigned and tested. The experiment mainly includes fretting platform; EUPI model;EUPI model simulation; EUPI inverse model; EUPI inverse model simulation; feedforward PID controller design; open-loopexperiment; closedloop experiment and so on. The experimental result shows that the EIPID controller based on DSP has good trajectory tracking performance than EUPI inverse controller. The average static tracking error ratio of EUPI inverse controller is 5.89%; the average static tracking error ratio of EIPID controller is 1.47%. Thus; the method achieves a good control effect.
keywords: dsp, eipid algorithm, piezoelectric driven micromanipulator, positioning control
affiliations: Shandong Aerospace Materials and Device Engineering Technology Research Center, Finance Department of Binzhou Vocational College, Binzhou Key Laboratory of Aerospace Optoelectronic Materials and Devices, School of Aeronautical Engineering, Binzhou University

title: Interface Research on DSP and Synchronous Serial EEPROM 93LC56B
abstract: In order to find out if DSP chip TMS320F2812 can read-write EEPROM chip 93LC56B through SPI interface; this paper analyzes the key interface timing characteristics of 93LC56B;designs a circuit which connects the SPI pins of TMS320F2812 and 93LC56B to I/O pins of FPGA.By capturing interface data of the two chips with ChipScope; this paper confirms the register parameters of TMS320F2812 SPI interface adapted for 93LC56B and gives the read-write subprogram; with findings that the most significant bit of data is inefficacious in single-step reading.

title: Design of pedestrian behavior detection system based on embedded platform
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of the monitoring system and reduce the consumption of human resources; the development of pedestrian abnormal behavior detection system based on multi-core DSP platform is designed. Through the improvement of the ViBe algorithm; the dead zone of the ViBe algorithm is solved; and the extraction of the motion region is realized. Secondly; aiming at the problem of single feature in the process of pedestrian detection; based on the characteristics of HOG feature and Haar-like feature; a HOG feature and Haar-like feature fusion method based on serial cascade method are designed to form complementary advantages to ensure the accuracy of pedestrian detection. Then; aiming at the problem that the traditional Hu moment does not have scale invariance; thus cannot adapt to the image scaling scene; the Hu invariant moment is improved; the scale factor is eliminated; and the scale invariance is improved. Thereafter; An improved pedestrian anomaly behavior detection algorithm based on Hu moment invariance is proposed; and several pedestrian behaviors are recognized. Finally; a pedestrian abnormal behavior detection system based on multi-core DSP platform is designed. Through experimental tests; the effectiveness of the system function is verified.
keywords: feature fusion, hu moment invariance, pedestrian detection, tms320c6678, vibe algorithm

title: 基于AM5728的嵌入式图像处理系统
abstract: 本文研究了基于AM5728的嵌入式图像处理系统的设计方案和实现方法，选择了基于ARM15的AM5728处理器为硬件平台和嵌入式Linux操作系统来完成图像处理技术的开发。在宿主机上安装虚拟机并在虚拟机上创建Linux系统的交叉编译环境，以此作为后续项目开发的软件环境。其次本文通过视频采集方法，进行了图像的采集、保存以及时延测试。使用Gstreamer API通过ARM端获取视频，通过OpenCL调用DSP端对图像进行Sobel（边缘检测）算法处理。测试结果显示该系统不仅拥有很好的设备兼容性，同时具有良好的图像处理实时性。

title: Design and implementation of context backup and resume scheme based on multi-core DSP
abstract: In software-defined computing architectures; DSP; as a commonly used hardware resource; is bound to develop virtualization in order to maximize its performance. This paper proposes a multi-core DSP context environment backup and resume scheme; with core 0 as the control core; through reasonable memory allocation and read/write operations; the states of remaining core in the calculation process; such as register state; stack state; data state; and program state; are saved and written back;achieved the function of switching from computing task M to computing task N; and then switching back to M after N is completed. Using TI 66AK2H14 to verify its feasibility. This scheme provides practical methods and experience for the flexible application of multi-core DSP hardware resources.

title: Implementation and Optimization of Symmetric Matrix Eigenvalue Solving Algorithm for FT-M6678
abstract: Eigenvalue solution of symmetric matrix is an important branch of linear algebra， which has important applications in aviation dynamics， computational fluid dynamics and other fields. At present， there is no implementation related to eigenvalue solution of Symmetric matrix on China’s autonomous and controllable FT-M6678 platform， and the existing mathematical calculation library on the platform can not meet the requirements of similar problem solving. This paper aims at the domestic FT-M6678 processor， implements and optimizes the algorithm for solving the eigenvalues of the Symmetric matrix， improves the linear algebra calculation library of the FT-M6678 platform， and is conducive to the innovative ecological development of the domestic advanced computing platform. Firstly， by analyzing the implementation process and running hotspots of the solving algorithm， compile optimization， memory access optimization， and vector parallel optimization are carried out based on the FT-M6678 platform. compile optimization refers to guiding the compiler to optimize programs based on different compilation options to achieve acceleration effects; memory access optimization includes cache optimization and allocation optimization of data and program segments， accelerating the efficiency of matrix data access; vector parallelization includes loop unrolling and SIMD （Single Instruction Multiple Data） instruction parallel optimization adapted to FT-M6678 platform， which improves the computational efficiency of programs. Secondly， the correctness verification and performance testing of the implemented and optimized algorithms are conducted on the FT-M6678 platform. The correctness of the algorithms pass the official LAPACK （Linear Algebra PACKage） test set， and the optimization acceleration effect of the solving algorithm on the FT-M6678 platform can reach 58.346 times， which can improve the algorithm speed by 2.053 times compared to the TMS320C6678 platform. The overall performance acceleration effect is quite impressive on the FT-M6678 platform.
keywords: cache optimization, eigenvalues of symmetric matrices, ft-m6678, hot spot analysis, vector parallelism

title: 基于树莓派的Zigbee+WiFi室内有毒气体自动检测系统
abstract: 为了更好地检测室内有毒气体，系统是基于树莓派为核心，综合运用Zigbee+WiFi技术设计室内有毒气体自动检测系统。以CC2530芯片为核心控制器，通过Zigbee将终端节点进行组网络，Zigbee网络终端传感器实现实时采集数据上传树莓派，再经过WiFi上传至云平台，用户可以通过终端查询采集数据。研究结果表明，通过系统的测试及数据分析，系统功能能精确的检测室内有毒气体的浓度，给用户提供准确的数据，保护用户生命安全。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 室内有毒气体, 树莓派

title: Smart home system based on STM32 and ZigBee network
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high cost;poor expansibility and compatibility of smart home;a smart home system based on Internet of things is designed. The system uses CC2530 MCU to build ZigBee wireless network;STM32 MCU to build the main controller;with temperature;humidity and air quality sensors to achieve wireless collection of indoor environmental data and control of household appliances. The main controller is responsible for aggregating the data collected by sensors through the ZigBee wireless network;realizing the local human-computer interaction through TFT touch screen;and exchanging data with the server through the GSM module and MQTT protocol. The server-side data is stored in the MySQL database;and the user-side obtains the server-side data in real time through the MQTT service. Users can use the TFT touch screen for real-time monitoring and controlling in the field;and can also achieve the same operation on the terminal software. Experiment shows that the system can effectively realize the remote monitoring of the environment and the real-time regulation of electrical appliances;and the system module has high compatibility and strong expansibility;so it has a certain application value.
keywords: internet of things, mqtt protocol, smart home, stm32, zigbee wireless network

title: 基于ZigBee技术的轿厢禁烟排烟报警系统设计
abstract: 随着城市建筑物高度不断提升，直升梯运行时间逐渐增加，电梯运行期间轿门关闭，轿厢空间受限，电梯内如有个别乘客吸烟，会造成已经进入轿厢的其他乘客被动吸烟。由于个人乘梯习惯和身体状况各不相同，且乘客在乘坐电梯时无法预知其他人是否会吸烟，尤其是孕妇、儿童或病人等特殊群体乘坐电梯时，对于轿厢内是否有人吸烟的情况需要有相关提示信息和解决方法。本文出于对电梯运行中的乘客实际需求，设计了基于Zig Bee技术的轿厢禁烟排烟报警系统。该系统基于Zig Bee无线传输通信技术，通过MQ-2传感器模块对轿厢内烟雾浓度进行监测，利用CC2530芯片实现对轿厢内禁烟的语音提示和轿顶排风扇排烟开启、大厅候梯处亮灯报警进行无线控制，以提高乘客舒适度和安全性的乘梯体验，具有实际应用意义。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee技术, 嵌入式, 烟雾传感器

title: Design of DSP “Pocket Lab” Engineering Practice
abstract: In view of the lack of experimental class hours and long practice period of students under the traditional DSP course learning mode; the learning effect is low. As an important course emphasizing the ability of practice; the “Pocket Lab” of DSP can effectively expand students’ experimental places. A DSP “Pocket Lab” based on TI company’s TMS320F28335 chip as the core controller is designed to solve the problem; which integrates the simulator; provides expansion modules to realize low-voltage two-level inverter; and realizes the hardware support of three-phase current reconstruction experiment based on single resistor current sampling. By using the “Pocket Lab”; students can combine the theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom with practice; shorten the interval from theoretical learning to practice; and improve their teaching effect.
keywords: current reconstruction, dsp “pocket lab”, module expansion, single resistor current sampling

abstract: Aiming at the imperfection of the existing electronic information network course experiment platform; a set of electronic information network course experiment platform based on DSP system is developed. The experimental platform adopts the TMS320F2812 DSP chip as the core control system; adopts the two-cross-direct-cross frequency converter as the main frequency conversion circuit; and designs the DSP main program based on SIMULINK to realize the control of the electronic information network course platform. The test results show that the hardware part of the experimental platform meets the design requirements; can realize the SVPWM control of the hardware circuit; and observe and detect various waveforms; the software part can improve the stability and response speed of the system by changing the designed speed regulator PI; so as to realize the control of the experimental platform and meet the design requirements.

title: Research on Monitoring and Early Warning Technology of Geological Hazards Based on MEMS+ZigBee
abstract: In order to achieve intelligent and real-time geological hazard monitoring;improve the accuracy and applicability of monitoring means;and reduce monitoring costs;a geological hazard monitoring and early warning system is built based on MPU-6050 MEMS acceleration sensor and CC2530 ZigBee wireless communication processor;which can realize real-time dynamic intelligent monitoring of multiple parameters such as displacement;inclination;temperature and humidity. The monitoring errors are only 1.5%;1.4% and 2.22%. In order to achieve high data transmission reliability and accuracy;ZigBee node distance should be controlled within 50 m;the average packet loss rate of the system is only 0.83%;and the average signal strength reaches 35.5 dBm. By setting early warning thresholds at all levels and accessing historical data;staff can conduct real-time;accurate and comprehensive research and judgment on geological disasters;and timely formulate prevention and emergency plans to prevent geological disasters from occurring or causing significant personnel and property losses.

title: Design of a real-time voltage monitoring system based on ZigBee technology
abstract: In order to realize voltage automatic detection in power system;a real-time voltage monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is proposed. In the system;CC2530 is taken as the core-controller to achieve the functions of real-time acquisition;transmission and display of voltage signals. A platform of real-time monitoring and display of voltage signals is constructed by the development of a virtual platform. ZigBee technology is used to construct a multi-node voltage transmission network; which realizes the acquisition and transmission of multi-node voltage. Meanwhile;Visual Studio integrated development environment is utilized to construct the upper computer system;which can display the voltage collected by each node and conduct the data processing. The testing results indicate that this system has the characteristics of low cost; low power consumption and flexible networking and can be applied to the occasions of various real-time monitoring.

abstract: 我国设施农业起步较晚，温室大棚等农业设施存在功能单一、智能化程度低、光照不足、通风不良等问题。针对温室大棚存在的不足与局限性，以无线通信技术ZigBee为基础，设计了一套农业大棚环境监测控制系统。该系统由ZigBee无线传输模块、CC2530控制平台、基于窄带物联网（Narrow Band Internet of Things;NB-IoT）的阿里云物联网云监控模块、传感器数据采集模块等组成，可通过阿里云平台显示大棚内各种传感器监测到的数据，控制大棚内风扇、水泵、补光灯等设备工作，使温室大棚内各种参数保持在正常范围。该系统具有实时性好、耗能低、传输距离远、操作方便等优点，实用价值较高，可为智能农业大棚的设计提供参考。
keywords: zigbee技术, 传感器, 智能农业大棚, 物联网

title: Design of Unstructured Sensitive Information Recognition System Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In view of the problems that the current sensitive information recognition system does not consider to establish a specific sensitive word warehouse; resulting in low recognition accuracy; poor recognition effect and large number of missing and false positives of sensitive information in different texts; an unstructured sensitive information recognition system based on deep learning is designed. The DM9000 network card chip with low power consumption and high communication speed is used to complete the data transmission and reception. The ultrasonic flowmeter based on TMS320F28335 is selected and applied to the extended network port connected with the network card chip to complete the system hardware design. It calculates the semantic structure of unstructured sensitive information and the occurrence probability of sensitive words; uses deep learning to establish a sensitive word warehouse; sets the true and false judgment function; obtains the maximum and minimum values of the generated network; obtains the weight attribute dimension; generates the sensitive information identification algorithm; calculates the minimum value of the loss function; and realizes the unstructured sensitive information identification. The experimental results show that in single word recognition; vocabulary recognition; phrase recognition and long sentence recognition; the proposed method has better sensitive information recognition effect; and the number of missing and false positives is small; which can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of sensitive information in different texts.
keywords: chip card, deep learning, identification system, information identification, sensitive information, unstructured system

The test proves that this system has reliable communication and sensitive action.

title: 基于RFID技术的变电站设备运行状态实时监测系统
abstract: 针对现有监测系统无法正确监测设备运转，容易出现误差、漏查等问题，提出并设计了一种基于RFID的变电站设备运行状态在线监测系统。该方法首先基于AE-S微型高频动态控制传感器和TMS320C6474设备控制执行器完成设备硬件环境的搭建，其次以此为基础，运用RFID技术完成数据的实时采集，再次引入多层GRU预测模型来提高对特征信息的提取，采用三层网络GRU网络模型提高预测精度，最后基于小波分解完成对变电站运行状态的实时监测。实验结果表明，应用该方法异常监测准确率均高于95.8%，优于对比方法。由此可证明，采用该方法可对变电站设备进行准确监测，具有较好的监测效果。

title: 基于66AK2H14控制器的新能源汽车充电系统设计
abstract: 本文针对新能源汽车充电桩在充电过程中，等效匝数的导线会产生较大的抑制谐波，导致充电系统温度增高的问题，设计了一种基于66AK2H14控制器的新能源汽车充电系统。硬件部分以芯片为核心控制器，设计充电桩的组成结构，通过单片机连接两个石英晶体，稳定功能电路晶振频率，实现功能电路结构设计。软件部分规范充电电感正向状态，通过调节控制匝结构中的有效面积，改变一次正向电感所产生的的电感量，对充电桩电感效应做等效处理，完成新能源汽车充电系统设计。测试结果表明：所设计的充电系统具有充电速度较快，在充电开关器件上产生的能量损耗较小，充电过程中温度波动幅度小，能够保证充电系统的正常运行。
keywords: 充电系统, 控制器, 新能源汽车

title: Time synchronization testing system for quartz flexible accelerometer
abstract: In order to meet the synchronous test requirements of quartz flexible accelerometers in parameter modeling system; a time-synchronized wireless test system is designed based on wireless communication technology. The system is designed based on the CC2530 wireless SOC chip. The hardware captures timestamps to reduce some delay factors. Least Squares Fit（LSF） is used to estimate and compensate for the relative clock drift between wireless nodes. The monitoring synchronization method is designed to reduce the number of times sync packets sent. The single-hop and multi-hop monitoring synchronization test results show that the average synchronization error of the four hops is 3.826 μs; the mean square error is 3.286 μs; and the average monitoring errors of the four hops are 8.193 μs and 5.241 μs; respectively. The system can meet the synchronous test requirements of the quartz flexible accelerometer parameter modeling application; and can be extended to similar applications.
keywords: clock skew, monitoring, synchronization testing, time stamp

title: 基于无线传感器网络的多点测温系统设计与实现
abstract: 无线传感器网络（WSN）技术具有分布式、低功耗、自组织等优点，广泛应用于环境监测、工业控制等领域。以多点温度测量为例，设计并实现了一种基于WSN技术的多点测温系统。该系统由多个传感器节点组成，通过无线通信方式将温度数据上传至中心节点，由中心节点进行数据处理和显示。系统的硬件平台采用TI CC2530芯片作为主控制器，结合LM35温度传感器和nRF24L01无线模块进行数据采集和通信。系统软件采用Contiki操作系统进行系统的管理和协议的实现。实验结果表明，该系统能够实现对多点温度的准确测量和实时监测，并具有良好的实用性和稳定性。

title: Dual Optimal Control of DAB Converter Based on Gradient Descent Method
abstract: A dual-objective optimal control strategy based on dual-phase shift（DPS） control is proposed for the optimization of current stress and backflow power in dual-active bridge（DAB） converters.Firstly;the mathematical model of DAB converter under DPS control is established;the operating state is analyzed to determine the constraints and the objective function for current stress and backflow power is constructed.Secondly;the shift-phase relationship θ is introduced to ensure that the shift-phase values are within the constraints;the gradient descent method is applied to find the optimum and the compensation control based on the output voltage feedback is combined to build a complete dual-optimized control strategy.Finally;the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation and an experimental platform using TMS320F28335 controller.

title: A Trans-Z-source Five-leg Dual-output Two Stage Matrix Converter
abstract: A topology and modulation strategy of a Trans-Z-source five-leg dual-output two stage matrix converter（TSMC）is proposed.The topological structure not only has the advantages of five-leg dual-output TSMC;but also can overcome the deficiency of low voltage transmission ratio of the system itself when introduced the Trans-Z-source.Compared with existing dual-output TSMC;Trans-Z-source five-leg dual-output TSMC has lower Z-source capacitor voltage stress and lesser number of capacitor required;it can change the transformer turns ratio to adjust the output voltage range;with a higher voltage transfer ratio.An experimental prototype with TMS320F28335 and EPM574t144 as controller is established.The experimental results verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed topology and control strategy.

title: Self-correction strategy of zero-point drift error of DC bus single current sensor
abstract: In order to study the influence of the zero drift of the DC bus single current sensor on the phase current reconstruction accuracy in the three-phase two-level inverter; the principle of the phase current reconstruction of the DC bus single current sensor was clarified; and the multi-current sensor and the single current sensor were compared. The zero drift error reveals the cause of the zero drift error and the mechanism of the amplification effect. Based on the space vector pulse width modulation method of inserting complementary effective voltage vectors instead of zero vectors; a self-correction strategy for zero drift errors was proposed. The current observation window duration of each sector was analyzed; and the phase current reconstruction and the self-detection and self-correction of the current zero-point drift were realized by using the complementary effective voltage vector dynamic current double sampling. A control system experiment platform with TMS320F28035 DSP as the electric drive controller was built. Under the working conditions within the rated speed; the error of the reconstructed phase current after self-calibration is less than 3.56%; which shows that the proposed error self-calibration strategy can provide reliable reconstructed current for the control system.

title: Satellite-borne embedded tracking system based on salient detection
abstract: With the development of aerospace science and technology; the application of computer vision algorithms on satellites is in the ascendant.In order to achieve more functional requirements and deal with possible threats; visual target tracking is a fundamental but challenging task.However; most existing algorithms only operate on pure image sequences.On the other hand; restricted by hardware conditions; few excellent algorithms are applied to satellite-borne embedded systems because of their high complexity.These pure object tracking algorithms usually need to artificially give the bounding box of the object.To get the bounding box automatically; an object detection algorithm is necessary.We propose an integrated detection and tracking algorithm for single target based on saliency detection and correlation filtering; which achieves 24 fps on DSP TMS320C6678 for the resolution of 2 048 pixel×2 048 pixel.The detection algorithm is responsible for preprocessing the image and obtaining the bounding box; then the object tracking algorithm gives the position of the object in the subsequent frames. In order to verify the effectiveness of our algorithm during the actual tracking; in this research; we build an optical platform consisting of a camera; DSP and Pan/Tilt/Zoom（PTZ） and test it.In this system; the DSP automatically completes the tasks of detection; tracking; driving the PTZ and re-detection; and achieves good results of detection and tracking.

title: Design of chain tension monitoring system for coal mine scraper conveyor with autonomous power supply
abstract: Scraper conveyor is an important mechanical equipment in coal mine production; and its operation performance directly affects coal mine safety and production efficiency.Taking the SGZ1250-2400 scraper conveyor as the research object; the overall scheme of the scraper chain tension monitoring system was designed.The system consists of four modules; namely data acquisition module; single chip module; self-powered device and wireless data transmission module.The self-powered supply device can generate electricity through the movement of the scraper conveyor for the operation of the tension monitoring system; which significantly improves the reliability of the system operation.The chip models used in the single-chip microcomputer and the wireless transmission module are STM32 and CC1101 respectively; which have good performance and can meet the actual use requirements.The scraper chain tension monitoring system is deployed in the coal mine engineering practice; and it is found that the effect is good after on-site debugging and application; and the tension of the scraper chain can be accurately detected; which significantly improves the operation safety and reliability of the scraper conveyor.
keywords: autonomous power supply, scraper chain, scraper conveyor, tension monitoring system

title: Four-channel Scalable Radio Digital Receiver System
abstract: In response to the requirements of high sampling rate; wide bandwidth; multi-channel amplitude-phase consistency; as well as high-speed direct sampling and time-domain data storage in current radio observation devices; this paper investigates and analyzes the technical architecture and functionalities of digital processing systems in multiple radio observation devices. It proposes a 4-channel digital receiver system based on ZYNQ SOC and core components such as ADS54J60. This system achieves a maximum sampling rate of 1GSPS per single channel; demonstrating flexibility and scalability; which allows for the addition of expansion cards to increase sampling channels for meeting the fundamental requirements of future large-scale expandable radio interference arrays. The system consists of three parts: a high-speed data acquisition card; an optical communication receiving card; and a server. Currently; the high-speed serial interface technology based on SerDes has achieved direct sampling with a quantization accuracy of 16 bits and a sampling rate of 300 MSPS; providing a full-scale signal-to-noise ratio of 60 dB; a 40 Gbps SFP+ data transmission bandwidth; and a 1.5 GB/s PCIe communication bandwidth. It can capture analog signals in the intermediate frequency range of 4.5 MHz to 150 MHz. The system has completed both hardware and software design and testing. In our tests; we sampled a 10 MHz sine wave signal with an amplitude of 125 mV; and the amplitude difference between the 4 channels was less than 1 mV; with a phase delay of less than 3.3 ns. The system integrates programmable SFP+ communication interfaces and a multi-machine synchronization mechanism to accommodate the synchronous acquisition needs of multi-element arrays. It can also store the data of the original radio signals; providing more detailed time-domain data for radio research.

title: Experiment design and verification of finite-time stabilization control
abstract: The past two decades have witnessed the development of finite-time stabilization as a hot spot in control area. Using the technique of finite-time stabilization; control system or observer can be designed such that the system error or estimation error converges to zero in finite time. This property is valuable for mission-critical systems with stringent time specification. This paper takes the permanent magnet synchronous AC motor; which has been widely used in industrial servo systems; as the target system for control. In the field-oriented framework;position servo controllers are designed for motor position-speed loop; using a combination of finite-time control law and finite-time observer. Comparison will be made with a conventional controller which only achieves asymptotic convergence. An experimental test-bench is established using a TMS320F28335 digital signal processor;and experiment results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the designs. The comprehensive experiments is adopted in the undergraduate module of computer control system practice and the graduate modules of control engineering; which can help students appreciate the potential of advanced control techniques; and inspire on them the desire for creativity.

title: Block Data Processing and Transmission Method of Parallel Signal Muti-core DSP
abstract: Aiming at the problem of parallel signal processing and large consumption of transmission resources; the high-speed RapidIO bus is used to fully interconnect multi-core DSP;and the data is shared through memory mapping.Eight cores can transmit and process data in parallel respectively.The RapidIO block with lightweight header has high transmission rate; few data copies and high efficiency.It has been proved that the data throughput has been greatly improved; the transmission delay has been reduced; and the problems such as long compilation time; difficult debugging; and high price in parallel computing of traditional FPGA devices have been solved.It can be extended to radar signal pulse compression; SAR image processing; distributed intelligent cloud computing and other fields.

title: Research of DSP-based High-precision Measurement Method for Low-frequency Signal
abstract: In this paper; a digital signal frequency measurement system based on DSP TMS320F28335 is designed to solve the problems of traditional digital signal frequency measurement in measurement accuracy and real-time.The continuous capture function of eCAP module in DSP is used for pulse capture; and the frequency value is calculated in real time by the circumferential method in the capture interrupt.In order to reduce the random error and measuring time; a frequency measurement method in segments is adopted for higher frequency.The experimental results show that the accuracy of this scheme can reach 0.001% and the measuring time is less than 10s when the frequency measurement of（0.1～200）Hz pulse signal is applied.
keywords: dsp, frequency measurement, frequency measurement method in segments, signal capture
