title: 可自主供电的煤矿刮板输送机链张力监测系统设计
abstract: Scraper conveyor is an important mechanical equipment in coal mine production;and its operation performance directly affects coal mine safety and production efficiency.Taking the SGZ1250-2400 scraper conveyor as the research object;the overall scheme of the scraper chain tension monitoring system was designed.The system consists of four modules;namely data acquisition module;single chip module;self-powered device and wireless data transmission module.The self-powered supply device can generate electricity through the movement of the scraper conveyor for the operation of the tension monitoring system;which significantly improves the reliability of the system operation.The chip models used in the single-chip microcomputer and the wireless transmission module are STM32 and CC1101 respectively;which have good performance and can meet the actual use requirements.The scraper chain tension monitoring system is deployed in the coal mine engineering practice;and it is found that the effect is good after on-site debugging and application;and the tension of the scraper chain can be accurately detected;which significantly improves the operation safety and reliability of the scraper conveyor.
abstract_in_chinese: 刮板输送机是煤矿生产中重要的机械设备;其运行性能直接影响煤矿安全和生产效率。以SGZ1250-2400型刮板输送机为研究对象;对刮板链张力监测系统的整体方案进行了设计。系统由四大模块构成;即数据采集模块、单片机模块、自供电装置以及无线数据发送模块。利用自供电装置可以通过刮板输送机的运动发电;供张力监测系统运行;显著提升了系统运行的可靠性。单片机和无线发送模块中使用的芯片型号分别为STM32和CC1101;均具有良好的性能;可满足实际使用要求。将刮板链张力监测系统部署到煤矿工程实践中;经现场调试和应用发现效果良好;可以对刮板链的张力进行准确监测;显著提升了刮板输送机的运行安全性和可靠性。
keywords: autonomous power supply, scraper chain, scraper conveyor, tension monitoring system
authors: 祁培成;刘毅;刘玉明;刘洋
affiliations: 乌海能源公司骆驼山洗煤厂

title: 基于zigbee技术的仓库监测报警系统
abstract: 针对仓库日常的环境和人员监测工作，基于zigbee技术的仓库监测报警系统以cc2530单片机为核心，采集仓库各个节点的温湿度传感器、火焰传感器、人体感应传感器和红外对射传感器的相关数据，最终将采集的数据汇聚到节点并在个人计算机上显示，当数据有异常时能自动报警并亮起报警灯。该系统具有部署简单、方便移动、易于扩展等优点，方便对仓库实现智能化管理。
keywords: cc2530单片机, zigbee技术, 传感器, 监测
affiliations: 厦门海洋职业技术学院信息工程学院

title: Design of Low Power Wireless Monitoring System based on CC3200 and QT
abstract: 设计了一款无线信号监视系统，实现了模拟音频信号和数字信号的远程采集和实时显示，可广泛应用于智慧矿山、智慧仓储、智能交通等领域。系统在硬件结构上，MCU采用CC3200;通过WIFI数据传输。同时基于QT开发的APP进行展示，可切换接入多组采集节点。经过实验分析和功能测试，系统具有低功耗、高带宽、实时性强等优点，是一款性能优良的无线监视系统。
keywords: cc3200, qt, wifi, 无线监视
source: Journal of Huainan Vocational Technical College.

title: Research on remote monitoring system for shearers based on CAN and ZigBee technology
abstract: The remote monitoring system plays an important role in ensuring the stability and reliability of shearer operation.The monitoring system is designed based on CAN bus technology and ZigBee wireless network technology.The system can be divided into two parts: downhole and uphole.On the basis of comprehensively considering the actual situation of the mine; data transmission is carried out based on ZigBee wireless network downhole; and data transmission is carried out based on CAN bus technology between downhole and uphole.The chip models used in the two data transmission modules are CC2530 and STM32F103BET6 respectively.In terms of software program; the work flow of coordinator node; routing node and terminal node in ZigBee module and the basic work flow of node 1 in CAN bus module are analyzed and researched.The system is deployed in engineering practice; and it is found that good results have been achieved after debugging and application; and it has good monitoring accuracy; which reduces the operating failure rate of the shearer by more than 20%;and the economic benefits are significant.
keywords: can bus, remote monitoring system, shearers, zigbee technology
authors: Bai Jing;Xie Xiaofei;Fu Shoufei;Xie Mingjun;Li Ting
affiliations: Equipment Management Center,Shenhua Shendong Coal Group, Department of Mining Engineering,Yulin Vocational and Technical College, Yuandatan Coal Mine,Shaanxi Zhongneng Coal Field Co.,Ltd., Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering,Shenmu Vocational and Technical College

title: Design of Automobile Anti-theft Alarm System Based on Multi-Sensor
abstract: The current automobile anti-theft alarm device has the problem of high false alarm probability. In order to solve the automobile anti-theft security we use GPRS system to package information and data for the transmission of information; use the precise computing power of the microprocessor to effectively process the merged data and information for. Finally; these can make them get closer to the actual status of the car body reaction; and the purpose of reducing false alarm rate and environmental protection is achieved. By selecting 16-bit DSP TMS320LF2407A vehicle equipment and using four-stage pipeline technology; it is beneficial to improve the running speed of the system program within a cycle. If the system is applied to the automotive field; it can effectively ensure the safety and stability of the automobile.
keywords: car anti-theft alarm, gsm wireless network, multi-sensor, rfid technology
affiliations: School of Automotive Engineer, Shaanxi College of Communication Technology

title: Design and application effect analysis of typical intelligent irrigation system in Gansu Yindaruqin irrigation area
abstract: 针对甘肃中部地区农田灌溉水肥利用效率低，智慧化和信息化程度低的问题，文章开展基于引大灌区现状的典型智慧灌溉系统设计，并通过典型经济作物娃娃菜田间试验，对比分析该系统应用效果。智慧灌溉系统主要采用可编程逻辑控制器（Programmable Logic Controller简称PLC）对田间灌溉设备控制，采用CC2530无线模块将田间传感器数据传送至PLC中进行处理后将各项数据传送至云平台；该系统较传统灌溉提高娃娃菜产量1.8万kg/hm~2;节水4695m~3/hm~2;节省肥料990kg/hm~2;节省人工费用7500元/hm~2;经济效益、社会效益、生态效益明显，为该系统在甘肃中部地区的推广应用提供了理论和实践依据。
keywords: plc, 云平台, 应用效果分析, 智慧灌溉系统

title: 基于CAN和ZigBee技术的采煤机远程监测系统研究
abstract: The remote monitoring system plays an important role in ensuring the stability and reliability of shearer operation.The monitoring system is designed based on CAN bus technology and ZigBee wireless network technology.The system can be divided into two parts:downhole and uphole.On the basis of comprehensively considering the actual situation of the mine;data transmission is carried out based on ZigBee wireless network downhole;and data transmission is carried out based on CAN bus technology between downhole and uphole.The chip models used in the two data transmission modules are CC2530 and STM32F103BET6 respectively.In terms of software program;the work flow of coordinator node;routing node and terminal node in ZigBee module and the basic work flow of node 1 in CAN bus module are analyzed and researched.The system is deployed in engineering practice;and it is found that good results have been achieved after debugging and application;and it has good monitoring accuracy;which reduces the operating failure rate of the shearer by more than 20%;and the economic benefits are significant.
abstract_in_chinese: 远程监测系统在保障采煤机运行稳定性和可靠性方面发挥着重要作用。基于CAN总线技术和ZigBee无线网络技术设计了监测系统;系统可分为井下和井上两部分。在综合考虑矿井实际情况的基础上;在井下基于ZigBee无线网络进行数据传输;在井下和井上之间基于CAN总线技术进行数据传输。两种数据传输模块中使用的芯片型号分别为CC2530和STM32F103BET6。软件程序方面;主要对ZigBee模块中的协调器节点、路由节点和终端节点的工作流程以及CAN总线模块中节点1的基本工作流程进行了分析研究。将系统部署到工程实践中;经调试和应用发现取得了良好的效果;具有良好的监测精度;使得采煤机的运行故障率降低了20%以上;经济效益显著。

title: A Method for Specific Communication Emitter Identification Based on Multi-Domain Feature Fusion
abstract: To solve the problem of low identification rate caused by specific communication emitter identification using a single feature; a method for individual identification of the communication emitter based on multi-domain feature fusion is proposed. Firstly; multiple transform domain features of the signals transmitted by the communication emitter are extracted; and these features are combined into multi-domain features.Secondly; the multi-channel convolution neural network is constructed; and the multi-channel convolution operation is carried out to extract the multi-domain features at a deep level. Finally; specificcommunication emitter classification is completed using the neural network classifier.Compared with the identification method based on a single feature; this method makes full use of the multi-domain features of the signals sent by the communication emitter and combines the powerful microscopic feature mining capability of the neural network to realize the effective individual identification of the communication emitter. Through the identification of 20 CC2530 devices under the conditions of low signal-to-noise ratio（SNR） and Rayleigh channel; the results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the identification accuracy and timeliness under a low SNR; and that the identification effect can still reach 91.01% under the condition of 0 dB.
keywords: communication emitter identification, feature fusion, low signal-to-noise ratio, multi-channel convolution neural network
authors: ZHANG Jie;WANG Jian;WEI Guofeng;GUO Daoxing;ZHANG Bangning
affiliations: College of Communications Engineering, Army Engineering University of PLA

title: Design and implementation of a compact microwave synthesizer for atomic interference gravimeter
abstract: In atom interferometer gravity experiments;Raman laser preparation commonly uses an optical phase-locked loop method;in which the master and slave laser beat signal is mixed with a 6.8 GHz microwave signal source firstly;then frequency discrimination is performed with direct digital frequency synthesis signal generator;and lastly the feedback signal obtained is used to control the low-noise Raman optical output.So the phase noise of Raman output will directly affect the sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter.This design uses the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller to program and control the LMX2594 digital phase-locked loop chip;and obtains a 6.8 GHz microwave signal source through the phase-locked loop frequency synthesis technology.The final experimental results show that the phase noise of the microwave signal source is 65.2 dB@1 Hz;and-95.3 dB@1 kHz;Allan deviation （ADEV） is2.72×10-11@1 s;and the output power is greater than 10 dBm.When the pulse interval time （T） is 100ms;influence of signal source on sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter is 8×10-8 m/s~2/Hz1/2;and on the resolution of the atom interference gravimeter is 2×10-8 g@600 s.It is shown that the design has the advantages of high frequency stability and low phase noise;which can meet the requirements of microwave reference sources for atom interferometer.
keywords: atom interference gravimeter, microwave signal source, phase noise, phaselooked loop, quantum optics
affiliations: National Key Laboratory of Science and Technology on Metrology and Calibration, Changcheng Institute of Metrology and Measurement

title: Research on Personnel Positioning System of Underground Roadway Based on ZigBee
abstract: Traditional underground personnel positioning technology（such as RFID positioning） has problems such as large positioning error; high cost; and difficult wiring. Therefore; a ZigBee based underground roadway personnel positioning system is designed based on comprehensive considerations such as environmental adaptability; cost and energy consumption; and positioning accuracy. The system uses CC2530 as a positioning module; and a Mesh network with ZigBee protocol as the core as a transmission method; thereby achieving the function of real-time monitoring the location of underground personnel. Firstly; a Kalman filtering algorithm is used to process the received RSSI value. Then threshold optimization of the RSSI value is followed; which is uploaded to the monitoring management center through the transmission system. Finally; a triangular weighted centroid algorithm is used to solve and locate unknown nodes. An improved RSSI algorithm is proposed for this positioning system. Simulation results show that the algorithm improves positioning accuracy by about 70%; and does not depend on the number of anchor nodes; having better application value.
keywords: kalman filtering, personnel positioning, rssi, threshold optimization, zigbee
authors: LIU Xiang;XIA Shujuan;ZHANG Yue;LI Chenchen;WANG Xude;MIAO Shuguang
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information, Huaibei Normal University
source: Journal of Luoyang Institute of Science and Technology(Natural Science Edition).

title: Design of Frequency Control System for Local Ventilation in High Gas Coal Mines
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor real-time and serious waste of electric energy in local ventilation control system of high gas coal mine; a local ventilation energy-saving control system based on TMS320F28335 microcontroller is designed. It takes DSP microcontroller as the core; collects data from gas concentration sensors in the tunnel in real time and completes the dynamic and adaptive processing process;and completes the over-limit blocking function when the gas concentration exceeds the limit to ensure safe production in coal mines.
keywords: dsp, high methane, local ventilation fan, variable frequency speed control
affiliations: Jinneng Holdings Group Gaoshan Coal Co., Ltd.

title: Research on hardware in the loop experimental platform for vector control of vehicle asynchronous motor
abstract: In order to reduce the research and development cost of the vehicle asynchronous motor control system; shorten the development cycle; and improve the development efficiency; this work designs a closed-loop control experimental platform for the vehicle asynchronous motor based on the TMS320F28335 micro-controller and the field oriented control（FOC） algorithm. The experimental platform realized code generation through the seamless connection between MATLAB/Simulink and TI series digital signal processing（DSP） development board; and thus eliminated complex C language code writing. The program-generated code was automatically loaded into the microprocessor TMS320F28335 development board through CCS6.2 software to control the operation of vehicle asynchronous motor; and Labview software was used to monitor the operation data of vehicle asynchronous motor system in real time and modify it online. The experimental results show that the experimental platform can realize the performance test of vehicle asynchronous motor vector control system; effectively shorten the development cycle of asynchronous motor controller; improve the system development efficiency; and save the development cost.
keywords: asynchronous motor, c language, digital signal processing（dsp）, matlab/simulink, vector control
affiliations: School of Electrical Engineering, Shaoyang University, Hunan Provincial Key Laboratory of Grids Operation and Control on Multi-power Sources Area Shaoyang University, Shaoyang Zishui Technology Co., Ltd.
source: Journal of Shaoyang University(Natural Science Edition).

title: Design of Intelligent Medicine Delivery Trolley
abstract: Aiming at the demand of the medical industry that is developing towards intelligence and automation; an intelligent medical delivery trolley system based on STM32F103RCT6 is designed. The system is powered by three 18650 lithium batteries; Through the Open MV image recognition module; the ward number is identified; The trail of the trolley is realized through the TSL1401 linear linear CCD module; Read the real-time weight of pharmaceutical products through the HX711 load cell module; Through the 2.4G Zigbee CC2530 serial port wireless transceiver module to realize the communication of the two cars; Through 0.96-inch OLED display the identified ward number and round-trip time;etc. The practice shows that the system has good performance; high reliability and certain application value.
keywords: intelligent medicine delivery trolley, linear array ccd module, open mv, wireless transceiver module
affiliations: Soft Video Software (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd., Keyi College of Zhejiang Sci-Tech University

abstract_in_chinese: 为解决利用单一特征进行通信辐射源个体识别识别率不高的问题;提出一种基于多域特征融合的通信辐射源个体识别方法。提取通信辐射源发射信号的多个变换域特征;并组合这些特征为多域特征。构建多通道卷积神经网络;利用多通道卷积操作对多域特征进行深层次提取。通过神经网络的分类器;完成对通信辐射源个体的分类。在低信噪比和瑞利信道条件下;使用所提方法对20个CC2530设备进行识别。研究结果表明:与基于单一特征的辐射源个体识别方法相比;该方法充分利用了通信辐射源发射信号的多个变换域特征;结合神经网络的强大细微特征挖掘能力;实现了对通信辐射源个体的有效识别;该方法能够显著提升在低信噪比的识别准确率和时效性;在0 dB条件下的识别效果仍可达到91.01%。

title: 一种基于CC2530的无线数据传输系统
abstract: In response to the high requirements of temperature and humidity in the environment for equipment in industrial sites;the overall composition of a wireless data transmission system based on CC2530 was proposed;and the software and hardware design of the system was completed and tested.The experimental results show that the system can achieve the collection;wireless transmission;and display of temperature data from terminal nodes;and can remotely monitor temperature data without changing the on-site layout.

title: Design of Motor Vector Control Experiment Based on Improved Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: An improved linear active disturbance rejection vector control experimental platform for three-phase motor based on TMS320F28379D is designed for high precision AC motor vector control experiment. Dual-core DSP chip is taken as the control core; and the system clock frequency is 200 MHz. High integration intelligent power module is adopted to drive motor; optocoupler isolation drive is not needed. The speed and position information of the motor are measured by using the resolver; which can achieve 16-bit high-precision measurement with the decoder chip. In terms of control algorithm; based on the traditional linear ADRC algorithm; the disturbance feedback channel is changed and a low-pass filter is added to the error feedback channel; and then an improved linear ADRC algorithm is proposed and verified by physical experiments. Compared to the classical PI and linear ADRC; the response velocity of the improved algorithm driven by the unit step signal is increased by 25% and 18%; the speed drop affected by the instantaneous disturbance is reduced 4 times and 2 times; and the speed recovery time is reduced by 85% and 70%; respectively; which greatly improves the dynamic and static characteristics of the system.
keywords: active disturbance rejection control（adrc）, digital signal processor（dsp）, intelligent power module（ipm）, vector control
affiliations: College of Electrical Engineering and Automation, Shandong University of Science and Technology

title: Design of Flow Control Method for Aiming System Software Based on DSP
abstract: Aiming system is used for providing azimuth reference for weapon system; so that the requirement of initial orientation precision of the guidance system is met; and therefore lateral firing precision of the weapon system is guaranteed. Due to the complication of the aiming system and the flow thereof; and the limitation of TMS320C6713 DSP at the aspects of interrupt numbers; timer numbers and task scheduling; a flow control method based on state machine mechanics is provided in this paper. Firstly; 8 user timers are designed base on 5 kHz interrupt of DSP6713 for the use of flow control. Then; the flow of the aiming system is divided into two levels. Finally; reliable automatic flow control is achieved by the design of finite state machines for the main flow and the sub-flows.
keywords: aiming system, automatic flow control, dsp, software design, state machine

title: Research on combustible gas measurement and control technology in catering industry under Internet of Things
abstract: This paper designs a combustible gas monitoring system based on the Internet of Things technology. The system takes ATmegal28 as the control core; uses the combustible gas alarm to collect the on-site combustible gas data; and its core device is the combustible gas detector. To ensure the stable communication between the nodes of the system; CC2530 is selected as the RF wireless communication module; integrating NB;Bluetooth; 5G; WiFi communication modules; which can adapt to the complex and changeable working scene of the restaurant.
keywords: catering industry, combustible gas, internet of things, measurement and control system
affiliations: Hunan Fugu Times Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Fugu IoT Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Design and implementation of integration of medicine;water and fertilizer control system based on Internet of Things in orchard
abstract: In view of the large workload of pest control and irrigation and the increase of labor cost in the production of mountainous and hilly orchards;at the same time;the current fertilization mode in China is rough;the waste of water and fertilizer is large;and the concentration of fertilizer solution is not easy to control.Combined with Internet of Things technology and Internet technology;an integrated control system of orchard medicine;water and fertilizer based on Internet of Things is designed.The system is based on ZigBee node based on CC2530;combined with MCU and various sensors.Remote monitoring and control are realized through ZigBee network;and the execution module performs various functions.At the same time;fuzzy control is used to accurately control the water pump to realize precise fertilization and irrigation.Through experimental verification;the packet loss rate of ZigBee network has no obvious relationship with the distance;and has a certain relationship with the contracting frequency of host computer software.The system can realize remote monitoring and automatic control;and display the monitoring data such as air and soil humidity;conductivity value and pH value in real time.The conductivity value of the mixing tank is adjusted by the system for about 690sto reach the set value of 1.5ms/cm.The soil conductivity value is adjusted by the system for about 810sto reach the set value of1.2ms/cm.At the same time;the system implements different irrigation schemes;fertilizer mixing and fertilization schemes according to different soil conductivity values and mixed medicine pool conductivity values;accurately controls irrigation and fertilization;and has good stability.
keywords: control system, integration of liquid medicine, mountain orchard, water and fertilizer, zigbee
authors: Xiao Liping;Zhang Hong;Tao Zhongyan;Xiong Qin;Cai Jinping;Dong Wei
affiliations: College of Engineering,Jiangxi Agricultural University,Key Laboratory of Modern Agricultural Equipment of Jiangxi Province

title: Research and Implementation of Dynamic Loading Software Module Based on TMS320C6678 DSP+Tianyi Embedded Operating System
abstract: In view of the requirements of software module product integration; application upgrade and fault recovery of different manufacturers in complex embedded systems; this paper studies the dynamic loading on C6000 series DSP; and implements the dynamic loader of software modules based on TMS320C6678 DSP+Tianyi embedded operating system missile version design and takes it as a component of Tianyi embedded operating system. ■is product with high reliability embedded system has a broad application prospect.

title: Research on tension monitoring system of scraper conveyor scraper chain based on wireless network
abstract: The scraper chain in the scraper conveyor is one of the structural parts prone to failure problems.Monitoring its tension is an effective means to improve its operational stability and reliability.Taking the SGZ764-400 type scraper conveyor as the object; the tension monitoring system of the scraper chain is established; which is mainly composed of three parts; namely the tension acquisition device; the data receiving device and the proximity switch.The CC2530 is selected as the radio frequency chip of the wireless network to wirelessly transmit the collected tension data.The tension data collected by the strain gauge module needs to be processed by the amplifying module and the filtering module; and then input to the CC2530 chip through the I/O interface.The monitoring system software is divided into three levels; namely the hardware abstraction layer; the Basic RF layer and the application layer.Field tests have verified that the tension detection error of the monitoring system does not exceed 5%;and the status of the scraper chain can be monitored in real time and accurately to ensure the stable and reliable operation of the scraper conveyor.
keywords: scraper chain, scraper conveyor, tension monitoring system, wireless network
affiliations: Xin′an Coal Industry Co.,Ltd.,Zaozhuang Mining Group

title: Design and Implementation of 6LoWPAN Network Based on Raspberry Pi CM4 and CC2530
abstract: In order to realize the interconnection and intercommunication between wireless sensor network（WSN） and IPv6network; a design scheme of6LoWPAN network based on Raspberry Pi CM4and CC2530microprocessor is proposed; and the hardware and software design of6LoWPAN wireless network terminal node with CC2530as the main controller chip is realized; as well as the design of a complete edge road network composed of Raspberry Pi CM4and CC2530microprocessor. Based on this; the IPv6network and6LoWPAN network test platform is built; the corresponding communication function is realized and the feasibility of the scheme is verified.
keywords: 6lowpan network, cc2530microprocessor, internet of things（iot）, raspberry pi cm4, wireless sensor network

title: Online upgrade method of second bootloader based on TMS320F28335
abstract: To avoid the operations of opening embedded device; configuring GPIO pin voltage level; or developing the special upper computer software during the online upgrade process of application program for TMS320F28335; a second bootloader method was proposed. To realize the online upgrade function of application program; TMS320F28335 was configured as Flash boot mode; and the second bootloader was pre-burned. The application program binary file from general serial port upper computer software was stored in the external extended SRAM of TMS320F28335; and was downloaded to on-chip Flash. And then; the system jumps to execute the application program. The experimental results show that this method is effective and feasible; and it has strong universality and reliability.

abstract: In order to speed up the calculation and processing speed of electricity information data; a distribution network electricity information acquisition and management system based on cloud computing technology is designed.The main control module of the concentrator in the system acquisition layer uses MSP430F249 microcontroller; and the communication module uses CC2530 chip and H685 device.The cloud computing platform uses segmental aggregation approximation algorithm to reduce the dimensionality of electricity consumption information data; and uses interpolation method to deal with the missing values in the pre-processing of abnormal large data set of electricity consumption; calculates the continuous fluctuation value of user’s electricity consumption slope and line loss; and establishes the identification model of abnormal electricity consumption information.The cloud computing experimental platform is set up for application testing.The experiment results show that the target error rate of this research system is 0.006%;and the shortest processing time of experimental sample data is 7.85 ms.

title: Speed control of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on RESO and composite sliding mode
abstract: To solve the internal and external disturbances in permanent magnet synchronous motors（PMSM） with parameter variations; modeling error and load uncertainties; a reduced-order extended state observer（RESO） based on composite sliding mode control strategy was proposed. Based on the state space model; a novel RESO was designed to estimate and eliminate the internal and external disturbances with considering the speed signal of PMSM measured by the encoder; and the performance for the RESO was analyzed. The composite sliding mode control method was introduced to design the sliding mode surface and control law for improving the anti-disturbance ability of the whole control system; and the stability of the control strategy was analyzed by Lyapunov method. The hardware-in-the-loop speed control platform of PMSM was built based on the control core of DSP chip TMS320F28335 and the MATLAB control module. The proposed method was simulated and compared with traditional PI and linear active disturbance rejection control methods. The results show that the speed variation of the system with loading can be reduced more than 60% in contrast to traditional system with excellent performance of anti-disturbance and regulation speed.

title: Genetic Algorithm Based 7-Level Step-Up Inverter with Reduced Harmonics and Switching Devices
abstract_in_chinese: This paper presents a unique voltage-raising topology for a single-phase seven-level inverter with triple output voltage gain using single input source and two switched capacitors.The output voltage has been boosted up to three times the value of input voltage by conﬁguring the switched capacitors in series and parallel combinations which eliminates the use of additional step-up converters and transformers.The selective harmonic elimination(SHE)approach is used to remove the lower-order harmonics.The optimal switching angles for SHE is determined using the genetic algorithm.These switching angles are com-bined with a level-shifted pulse width modulation(PWM)technique for pulse generation;resulting in reduced total harmonic distortion(THD).A detailed com-parison has been made against other relevant seven-level inverter topologies in terms of the number of switches;drivers;diodes;capacitors;and boosting facil-ities to emphasize the beneﬁts of the proposed model.The proposed topology is simulated using MATLAB/SIMULINK and an experimental prototype has been developed to validate the results.The Digital Signal Processing(DSP)TMS320F2812 board is used to generate the switching pulses for the proposed technique and the experimental results concur with the simulated model outputs.

title: Voltage Stabilization Control Strategy of High-Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator Based on Disturbance Observer Compensation
abstract: High-speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator （HSPMSG） has the advantages of high power density， small size and light weight， it is widely used in many applications. However， the conventional double closed-loop control has poor control performance as the output voltage fluctuates with the change of load， which is difficult to meet high performance applications. For the above problems， some advanced control methods have been proposed， but most of them have limited ability to suppress load disturbances. In order to improve the ability of the system to resist load disturbance， this paper proposes a voltage stabilization control method based on the disturbance observer compensation.   Firstly， a dynamic mathematical model of the permanent magnet synchronous generator system is established. Secondly， considering the influence of load changes on voltage stability， this paper considers the load current as a system disturbance and a disturbance observer based on the super-twisting algorithm is designed. To improve the response speed of the disturbance observer， the super-twisting algorithm is improved and its stability is demonstrated by Lyapunov stability theory. Then， for further improving the tracking and immunity of the conventional PI controller， a two-degree-of-freedom voltage loop PI controller is designed and its control parameters are analyzed. Finally， the load current observed by the disturbance observer is converted and feedback to the output of the voltage loop， so that fluctuations in the dc-side voltage during load changes can be suppressed. The system stability is analyzed by frequency domain analysis， and the results show that with load current feedforward the disturbance of the system by the load current can be effectively suppressed. To verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control method， simulations and experiments are carried out based on a HSPMSG. The simulation results show that the voltage fluctuation is reduced from 2.5V to 0.2V， and the settling time is reduced from 20ms to 5ms when the load is suddenly changed. The simulation results fully demonstrate that the proposed control method can significantly suppress the voltage fluctuation during load switching， shorten the voltage settling time and improve the dynamic performance of the output voltage. To further highlight the advantages of this control method， an experimental platform for a high-speed permanent magnet synchronous generator system based on the TMS320F28377D is built and a series of experiments are conducted. According to the experimental results， the voltage drop is 11V and the settling time is 110ms when the conventional control method is used， while the voltage drop is reduced from 11V to 3.5V and the settling time is reduced to 42ms with the control method proposed in this paper. The experimental results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper can effectively suppress the voltage fluctuation when the load changes and improve the dynamic performance of the system.   The following conclusions can be drawn from the simulation and experimental results: 1) The disturbance observer based on the improved super-twisting algorithm can observe the change of load disturbance in real time and with high observation accuracy. 2) The control method proposed in this paper can significantly improve the dynamic performance of the system， which can effectively suppress the voltage fluctuation when the load changes and shorten the settling time of the voltage fluctuation.
keywords: disturbance observer, high-speed permanent magnet synchronous, immunity, stability, two-degree-of-freedom control

title: Research on a New High Power Induction Heating System
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low power; low efficiency and uneven heating of metal bars in the traditional single power supply system in the casting industry; a new LLC resonant system is designed in this paper. TMS320F28335 is selected as the main control circuit to generate low-frequency SPWM signals and temperature closed-loop. EMP57079100C5N chip is selected to deal with hardware circuit faults. Before building a small system test algorithm in the laboratory; MATLAB/Simulink is used for theoretical simulation. Finally; it is measured in the factory that when the workpiece is heated to more than 800 ℃; the power factor can reach 0.97. This new induction heating system has been preliminarily verified; which has high power and efficiency; and can also heat metals gradiently.

title: Design of Adsorption Control System of Wall Climbing Robot Based on DSP Technology
abstract: Wall adsorption is one of the basic functions of a wall climbing robot; and its adsorption degree directly affects the stability and moving speed of the wall climbing robot. Therefore; a wall climbing robot adsorption control system based on DSP technology is designed. Select the sensor device MPU6050 of the wall climbing robot; add the digital signal processor TMS320F28335; and design the adsorption controller of the wall climbing robot by PD control. A corresponding mathematical model is constructed according to the composition structure and working principle of the wall climbing robot. According to the mathematical model; DSP technology is used to calculate the adsorption force of the wall climbing robot. Through the force analysis results of the wall climbing robot on the wall; the safe adsorption conditions of the wall climbing robot are determined. The adsorption controller is used as the actuator to realize the adsorption control of the wall climbing robot. The negative pressure wall climbing robot is selected as the test prototype. The system test shows that compared with two comparison systems under three wall environments of ceramic tile; wood board and glass; the control error of the wall climbing robot’s adsorption force is reduced by 2.04 N; and the overturning risk coefficient is reduced by 0.29; which has good adsorption control effect.

title: Design of PMSM Drive System for Multi-Function Dust Spraying Vehicle Application
abstract: In this system; 32 bit processor TMS320F28035 is used to design and develop a motor controller for the spray system of multifunctional dust suppressant vehicle. The design of motor controller includes two parts: hardware and software platform. The hardware platform includes: fault detection module; MOS driver module; motor phase current Angle sampling module; main control module.The software part adopts layered design; which is mainly divided into driver layer; application layer and algorithm layer. The application layer and algorithm layer adopt the development mode based on MBD;Simulink model is built for simulation; and M language script is written for the generation of C code of the model. The controller was matched with a 3.5 kW built-in permanent magnet synchronous motor;and torque response test and full speed domain efficiency MAP test were carried out. The experimental results show that the controller achieves the expected design objectives.

title: 采用缓冲池的无线传感器网络中继算法
abstract: 无线传感器网络由于能量限制通信距离有限，当需要实现远距离的无线传感器网络通信时，可以采用中间节点转发的中继传输方法。为避免中继节点发出的无线信号发生空中数据重复转发碰撞问题，提出了采用缓冲池的中继算法。算法在数据帧中增加部分字节作为缓冲池，用于记录数据经过的中继节点号；当数据帧被中继节点转发时，通过对比缓冲池中记录的中继节点数据，如果存在本中继节点号，则抛弃该数据帧不转发，否则中继节点将自己的节点号存入缓冲池并形成新数据帧后转发出去。在CC2530芯片上实现了算法，进行了线性布置的中继实验，结果表明算法可以实现线性布置中继转发并避免重复转发数据碰撞。
keywords: 中继, 无线传感器网络, 算法, 缓冲池, 重复数据碰撞

title: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF DYNAMIC PRODUCT ATTITUDE ACQUISITION SYSTEM BASED ON AM5728
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent flexible production; it is necessary to obtain the product placement attitude on the dynamic pipeline in real time and adjust the actuator such as the mechanism attitude control robot according to the product placement attitude in real time to execute the corresponding actions with the designed path; and the dynamic product attitude acquisition system is designed. Based on the AM5728 controller; the hardware platform of the control system was designed and tested. An accurate and fast algorithm for contour extraction was presented by image enhancement and morphology. Under the premise of no contact with any appearance of the product; the product placement posture on the dynamic assembly line could be obtained in real time; which provided technical basis and theoretical support for the realization of the follow-up intelligent flexible production.

title: Optimization Design and Implementation of RF Circuit Based on CC1101
abstract: RF circuit optimization design is an important means to ensure high reliability;low power consumption and long-distance data transmission of RF communication system.Aiming at the problems of short transmission distance and high packet loss rate of CC1101commercial RF circuit;the impedance converter;filter and RF full link in CC1101 RF circuit are simulated and optimized by Advanced Design System（ADS）;a high-frequency electromagnetic simulation software.Components are adjusted according to the simulation results.The transmission distance and packet receiving rate of the modified CC1101 RF circuit are tested.The results show that the impedance of the optimized RF circuit（115+j42Ω） is closer to the target differential impedance（116+j41Ω），the return loss is increased by 11 d B;the insertion loss is reduced by 0.6 d B;and the stable transmission distance is increased by 30 meters.At the distance of 60meters;the data reception rate is increased by 33.6%.

title: Research and application of 2.45 GHz inverted-F folded printed antenna
abstract: Aiming at the miniaturization requirements of wireless communication nodes and the problems of poor normalized impedance and small gain of existing printed inverted-F antenna; a design applied to the wireless terminal nodes center frequency of 2.45 GHz printed inverted F antenna is folded.The antenna model is established by using Ansys HFSS.According to the theory; the antenna parameters are simulated; and the optimal parameters are obtained through parameter scanning analysis.Under this structure parameter; at the resonant frequency of 2.45 GHz; the normalized impedance of the antenna is（0.979 1-0.188 2 i）Ω;the maximum gain is 3.81 dB and has a return loss of-20.42 dB.Meanwhile; its performance is tested by appling to CC2530 wireless communication node.Test results show that the packet loss rate of the wireless communication nodes loaded with the antenna is 0.2 % under certain conditions; which is prior to that of similar antennas.

title: Wireless monitoring system of miners’body temperature based on ZigBee protocol
abstract: Aiming at the basic requirements of Novel Coronavirus epidemic prevention and the health of miners; a portable human body temperature wireless detection system based on ZigBee technology is designed.First of all; the terminal equipment composed of temperature sensor; CC2530 microcontroller unit（MCU） and OLED display screen collects; processes and displays the temperature data of miners respectively.Secondly; the system transmits the processed data to the coordinator through the routing node through the Mesh network formed by CC2530 MCU.Finally; the coordinator aggregates the data of all terminal devices and uploads it to OneNET through the WiFi module for recording and display.Through this system; the body temperature of the miners can be monitored in real time so as to achieve the purpose of early detection; early isolation and early treatment.The detection results show that the system can accurately measure the temperature data of miners and upload it to the cloudserver for statistical display in real time; which has certain practical value and significance.

title: Design of High-Performance Closed-Loop Driver System for Two-Phase Hybrid Stepper Motor
abstract: Based on the research of traditional open-loop subdivision drive and control algorithm of the stepper motor; a position plus current closed-loop drive scheme is proposed with an encoder for stepper motor leading angle control. When different traditional open-loop subdivisions drive; the given current phase angle is independent of the rotor position. The closed-loop drive scheme uses an encoder to detect the actual position of the rotor and calculate the position error and the velocity error information to adjust the current phase angle given by the current subdivision in real time; thereby improving the working performance of the stepper motor at different speeds. Using TI’s TMS320F28069 high-performance processor with IR2104S and IRF540 as the main control unit and power drive circuit; the stepper motor position closed-loop experimental platform is built and the currents and position accuracy at different speeds are tested. The test results show that the closed-loop drive scheme can effectively improve the problems of low-speed jitter and high-speed out-of-step of the stepper motor; which works well in the speed range of 60～1200 rpm; and the position accuracy is controlled within 10 pulses. The solution has reached the level of the traditional servo motor and has good market application value.

title: Research on Key Technologies of Wireless Networking and Positioning in Closed Bid Evaluation Base
abstract: The workload of current bidding and procurement has increased exponentially; the types of bidding have increased; and standardized operation is difficult. This study designs a closed bid evaluation base; establishes an intelligent bid evaluation system; forms a MESH network based on ZigBee; and a network coordinator establishes a wireless network. The routing node joins the network and expands the network coverage. Carrier-free pulse radio ultra-wideband technology realizes high-precision positioning; real-time display of bid evaluation personnel location information; and alarms for irregular activities. The node equipment of the position detector uses the CC2530 chip; and the radio frequency transceiver is integrated in the main control chip to optimize the radio frequency circuit to match the input impedance of the antenna. The experimental results show that the wireless network data transmission rate of the bid evaluation base of this research is the fastest; and the experimental sample data are transmitted to the display layer to show the shortest usage time.

title: Design and implementation of drive interface reuse for multiway electromagnetic valve and proportional value
abstract: The drive signal of solenoid valve is usually the on-off quantity（high electrical-level valve opening;low electrical-level valve closing）. The drive signal of proportional valve is usually pulse width modulation（PWM）;and its drive current is generally 3 A or more. A digital signal processor（DSP）TMS320F28335 based drive system for electromagnetic valve and proportional valve is designed. The way of using isolated power module to replace bootstrap capacitor of half bridge driver chip is designed innovatively to realize the drive interface reuse for multiway electromagnetic valve or proportional value;that is;an interface can be used to output both switching value signal and PWM signal. The designed system can drive multiway electromagnetic valve or proportional valve. Taking 4-channel output drive interface as an example;a hardware over-current protection based on interlocking circuit is designed for each branch;and the over-current status of each branch is inputted to DSP by means of the in-out shifter. The testing results show that the system can occupy not only less interface resources;but also less resources on the chip. It has the characteristics of high reliability and stability;and has high practical value for projects with resource shortage on the chip.
keywords: drive system, electromagnetic valve drive, interface reuse, isolated power module, over-current protect, proportional valve drive

title: Design of High Rate Wireless Network System Based on Multi-channel Acquistion
abstract: In view of the problem that present industrial wireless sensor network node payload data transfer rate is slow; a high rate wireless monitoring network system based on the technology of Sub-GHz was designed; the system took ultra low power devices CC1310 as hardware core; adopted multiplex acquisition way to reduce system secondary nodes deployment.At the node physical layer; a method was proposed to expand the communication bandwidth of CC1310 chip by modifying the underlying radio frequency parameters.In the data link layer; radio frequency transmission was realized by simplifying the data frame structure and adopting direct polling access; which can improve the data transmission rate of the system while ensuring the reliability of the system.The test results show that the data transmission rate of the system can reach 377 kbps when the device node is connected with 8 sensors; which is completely suitable for industrial wireless real-time monitoring system.

abstract: 随着物联网技术的快速发展，传统的婴儿床也经历了智能化与网络化的新变革，但目前市面上的智能婴儿床功能较为简单，只有音乐播放、哄睡等功能，缺少针对孩子睡眠情况、是否尿床以及是否存在掉床风险的监测。本系统就上述问题开发了基于物联网的智能婴儿床远程监控系统，采用传感器采集技术和CC2530主控芯片构建信息采集模块（尿湿检测模块、掉床检测模块、啼哭检测模块、空气质量检测模块），利用ZigBee自组网功能将婴儿床的实时数据接入云平台存储，设计了相应的网页界面对数据进行监测，通过邮件下发通知实现了对智能婴儿床的实时有效监控。

title: Design of Intelligent Depth Monitoring System for Wireline Logging
abstract: According to the requirements of wireline logging for depth accuracy and reliability; this paper designs and develops a set of intelligent wireline logging depth monitoring system to realize the functions of depth detection; recording; real-time data analysis and depth abnormal alarm in the process of wireline logging and maintenance. The intelligent monitoring system takes TMS320F2812 as the control core; combined with the stepping motor control; to realize the depth processing and monitoring of the field operation; as well as the detection of the depth encoder in the maintenance process; and to realize the real-time data recording and analysis playback in the monitoring process. The intelligent monitoring system can be easily connected to the existing logging surface system and run independently; which greatly ensures the accuracy of wireline logging depth. The system has been successfully applied in the field and maintenance work; and is stable and reliable.

title: Design of Underground Parking Lot Fire Protection System Based on CC2530
abstract: 目前，住宅配建地下车库的消防设施，尚未考虑电动汽车起火的特殊灭火需要，不能适应电动汽车迅速增加的消防现状，且无法实时监测火灾风险并做出预警。为解决以上问题，本文采用CC2530构建了符合ZigBee协议的无线传感器网络，用于实时监测火灾风险，并执行相关灭火措施。通过PL2303实现了协调器节点与上位机通信，若有异常风险情况，可在上位机屏幕显示风险等级、异常车位号及车位区域编码；在值班室声光报警；在相关主通道路由节点处声光报警；并在相关终端节点处声光报警、自动采取灭火措施。该系统的传感器节点布置较为灵活，系统整体具有低成本、易安装、可扩展及低功耗的特点。

title: A diagnosis strategy for open-circuit submodule faults in MMCs under NLM strategy suitable for different operating powers
abstract: With the increasing voltage and power level of modular multilevel converters （MMC）， the number of its submodules （SMs） also increases， and the issue of its reliability is highlighted. The failure of IGBT in any SM can affect the normal operation of MMC and even further lead to the damage of other components， which eventually lead to the collapse of the whole system. Thus， it is necessary to detect the fault and locate the malfunctioning SMs accurately to improve its reliability. MMC’s SM open-circuit diagnosis strategy can be divided into two categories: hardware-based and software-based. Compared with the hardware-based strategy， the software-based strategies need no extra hardware， have low computational burden. However， it is difficult to set the empirical threshold of existing software-based strategies between different operating powers， which hinders its further development.    To solve this issue， a diagnosis strategy for open-circuit SM faults in MMCs suitable for different operating powers is proposed. The SM switching function is predicted based on the number of SM inputs and the position of SM capacitor voltage sorting arrangement and then the corresponding SM capacitor voltage is predicted. On the basis， the fault is detected and located by judging whether the absolute error between the predicted value and the actual value of the SM capacitor voltage exceeds a threshold. Moreover， to further eliminate the effects of errors and prevent the existence of fault misdiagnosis situations， a time flag is used in both the detection process and location process.   In the proposed strategy， to avoid the effects of misdiagnosis near the arm current-over-zero point， a current-over-zero filtering part is proposed. Based on the mathematical deduction， the principle of setting threshold is given. It is indicated that the proposed strategy eliminates the need to manually set the threshold when the MMC operating power changes， which greatly reduce the difficulty of setting the threshold compared with the existing strategies. At the same time， theoretical analysis verifies that the proposed strategy is not only suitable for NLM modulation strategy， but also can be extended to other MMC modulation strategies after adjusting the prediction method of SM switching function.   A detailed real-time digital simulation model of the MMC-HVDC system is built in a hardware-in-the-loop platform. The power-stage model is emulated by the target machine and the control system is realized by the DSP TMS320F28335 control board. The experimental result verify that the proposed strategy can accurately diagnose two types of MMC SM open-circuit faults at different operating powers. It is observed that the absolute error of a Type I malfunctioning SM is high when the arm current is negative and the absolute error of a Type II malfunctioning SM is high when the arm current is positive， which verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis. Before the fault occurs， the absolute error will not exceed the threshold so that misdiagnosis will not occur during normal operation. After the fault occurs， the absolute error exceeds the threshold， the system can quickly detect the fault and then locate the remaining malfunctioning SMs. Moreover， the proposed strategy integrates the advantages of existing strategies， including no extra hardware， low computational burden， fast diagnosis （＜20ms）， and can cope with the cases of multiple SM failures in the arm.
keywords: absolute error, fault diagnosis, modular multilevel converter, operating power
authors: Liu Yi;Wang Yue;Li Pengkun;Xue Yinglin;Wu Hong

title: Satellite-borne embedded tracking system based on salient detection
abstract: With the development of aerospace science and technology; the application of computer vision algorithms on satellites is in the ascendant.In order to achieve more functional requirements and deal with possible threats; visual target tracking is a fundamental but challenging task.However; most existing algorithms only operate on pure image sequences.On the other hand; restricted by hardware conditions; few excellent algorithms are applied to satellite-borne embedded systems because of their high complexity.These pure object tracking algorithms usually need to artificially give the bounding box of the object.To get the bounding box automatically; an object detection algorithm is necessary.We propose an integrated detection and tracking algorithm for single target based on saliency detection and correlation filtering; which achieves 24 fps on DSP TMS320C6678 for the resolution of 2 048 pixel×2 048 pixel.The detection algorithm is responsible for preprocessing the image and obtaining the bounding box; then the object tracking algorithm gives the position of the object in the subsequent frames. In order to verify the effectiveness of our algorithm during the actual tracking; in this research; we build an optical platform consisting of a camera; DSP and Pan/Tilt/Zoom（PTZ） and test it.In this system; the DSP automatically completes the tasks of detection; tracking; driving the PTZ and re-detection; and achieves good results of detection and tracking.
keywords: correlation filtering, integrated algorithm, moving object detection, salient detection, satellite-borne embedded system

title: Open Circuit Fault Diagnosis Strategy of MMC Sub-Module Based on Generalized Capacitor Voltage Unbalance
abstract: Modular multilevel converters（MMC） have features of modular construction; redundancy configuration; and power scalability. The MMC topology is composed of a large number of series-connected submodules（SMs）; and reliability is one of its important issues. The faults of the insulated gate bipolar transistor（IGBT） can generally be divided into short-circuit faults and open-circuit faults. The short-circuit fault is destructive; but now the gate driver is always integrated with short-circuit protection. In contrast; the open-circuit fault will not immediately damage the SM and may remain undetected for a long time. MMC’s SM open-circuit diagnosis strategy can be divided into hardware-based and software-based categories. The software-based strategies have the advantages of no additional hardware and fast diagnosis time. However; it often requires an empirical threshold; which is difficult to set when the MMC operates at different power.Therefore; an open-circuit fault diagnosis strategy for MMC sub-modules based on generalized capacitor voltage unbalance degree（GCVUD） is proposed. The fault is detected by judging whether the GCVUD of the SM with the largest capacitor voltage in the arm exceeds the threshold. The remaining faulty SMs are located until the GCVUD of one SM is within the threshold according to the capacitor voltage sorting results. Moreover; to further eliminate the effects of errors and prevent fault misdiagnosis situations; a counting flag is used in the detection process and location process.In this strategy; the threshold setting determines the accuracy and rapidity directly. The threshold shall be greater than the GCVUD to ensure no misdiagnosis during normal operation. On the other hand; the threshold shall be less than the minimum of the corresponding GCVUD in the case of two types of open-circuit faults. The type II fault of SM in rectifier mode is selected for setting the diagnostic threshold. The quantitative relationship between the diagnostic threshold and the operating power is given by calculation and deduction.A detailed real-time digital simulation model of the MMC-HVDC system is built in a hardware-in-the-loop platform. The power-stage model is emulated by the target machine; and the control system is realized by the DSP TMS320F28335 control board. The experimental results verify that the voltage characteristics of the faulty SM are related to the type of fault and the MMC operating mode. The SM capacitor voltage under the type I fault will remain unchanged. The SM capacitor voltage will increase continuously in inverter mode but will keep an abnormal balance in rectifier mode. The GCVUD in the type II fault in rectifier mode is smaller than in other cases when the operating power is equal; and its calculated value is close to the actual value. The proposed strategy can accurately diagnose two types of MMC SM open-circuit faults at different operating powers. Before the fault occurs; the GCVUD will not exceed the threshold; so misdiagnosis will not occur during normal operation. If the fault occurs; the GCVUD exceeds the threshold; and the system can quickly detect the fault.Then; the number of faulty SMs and their serial numbers can be determined. In addition; the proposed strategy can cope with the cases of multiple SM failures in the arm and complete the diagnosis process within one fundamental frequency period.
keywords: fault diagnosis, generalized capacitor voltage unbalance degree, modular multilevel converter, operating power
authors: Liu Yi;Wang Yue;Li Pengkun;Wu Hong;Li Runtian

title: Voltage Stabilization Control Strategy of High-Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator Based on Disturbance Observer Compensation
abstract: High-speed permanent magnet synchronous generator（HSPMSG） has the advantages of high power density; small size; and lightweight; and is widely used in many applications. However; the conventional double closed-loop control has poor control performance as the output voltage fluctuates with the change of load;which is difficult to meet high-performance applications. For the above problems; some advanced control methods have been proposed; but most have limited ability to suppress load disturbances. In order to improve the ability of the system to resist load disturbance; this paper proposes a voltage stabilization control method based on the disturbance observer compensation.Firstly; a dynamic mathematical model of the permanent magnet synchronous generator system is established. Secondly; considering the influence of load changes on voltage stability; this paper considers the load current as a system disturbance; and a disturbance observer based on the super-twisting algorithm is designed. To improve the response speed of the disturbance observer; the super-twisting algorithm is improved; and its stability is demonstrated by the Lyapunov stability theory. Then; to further improve the tracking and immunity of the conventional PI controller; a two-degree-of-freedom voltage loop PI controller is designed; and its control parameters are analyzed. Finally; the load current observed by the disturbance observer is converted and feedback to the output of the voltage loop so that fluctuations in the DC-side voltage during load changes can be suppressed. The system stability is analyzed by frequency domain analysis; and the results show that with load current feedforward; the disturbance of the system by the load current can be effectively suppressed. To verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control method; simulations and experiments are carried out based on a HSPMSG. The simulation results show that the voltage fluctuation is reduced from 2.5 V to 0.2 V; and the settling time is reduced from 20 ms to 5 ms when the load is suddenly changed. It is demonstrated that the proposed control method can significantly suppress the voltage fluctuation during load switching; shorten the voltage settling time; and improve the dynamic performance of the output voltage. To further highlight the advantages of this control method; an experimental platform for a high-speed permanent magnet synchronous generator system based on the TMS320F28377D is built; and a series of experiments are conducted. According to the experimental results; the voltage drop is 11 V; and the settling time is 110 ms when the conventional control method is used. In comparison; the voltage drop is reduced from 11 V to 3.5 V; and the settling time is reduced to 42 ms with the proposed control method. The experimental results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper can effectively suppress the voltage fluctuation when the load changes and improve the dynamic performance of the system.The following conclusions can be drawn from the simulation and experimental results:（1） Based on the improved super-twisting algorithm; the disturbance observer can observe the change of load disturbance in real time and has high observation accuracy.（2） The control method proposed in this paper can significantly improve the dynamic performance of the system; which can effectively suppress the voltage fluctuation when the load changes and shorten the settling time of the voltage fluctuation.
keywords: disturbance observer, high-speed permanent magnet synchronous, immunity, stability, two-degree-of-freedom control

title: Design of pedestrian behavior detection system based on embedded platform
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of the monitoring system and reduce the consumption of human resources; the development of pedestrian abnormal behavior detection system based on multi-core DSP platform is designed. Through the improvement of the ViBe algorithm; the dead zone of the ViBe algorithm is solved; and the extraction of the motion region is realized. Secondly; aiming at the problem of single feature in the process of pedestrian detection; based on the characteristics of HOG feature and Haar-like feature; a HOG feature and Haar-like feature fusion method based on serial cascade method are designed to form complementary advantages to ensure the accuracy of pedestrian detection. Then; aiming at the problem that the traditional Hu moment does not have scale invariance; thus cannot adapt to the image scaling scene; the Hu invariant moment is improved; the scale factor is eliminated; and the scale invariance is improved. Thereafter; An improved pedestrian anomaly behavior detection algorithm based on Hu moment invariance is proposed; and several pedestrian behaviors are recognized. Finally; a pedestrian abnormal behavior detection system based on multi-core DSP platform is designed. Through experimental tests; the effectiveness of the system function is verified.

title: Dual Optimal Control of DAB Converter Based on Gradient Descent Method
abstract: A dual-objective optimal control strategy based on dual-phase shift（DPS） control is proposed for the optimization of current stress and backflow power in dual-active bridge（DAB） converters.Firstly;the mathematical model of DAB converter under DPS control is established;the operating state is analyzed to determine the constraints and the objective function for current stress and backflow power is constructed.Secondly;the shift-phase relationship θ is introduced to ensure that the shift-phase values are within the constraints;the gradient descent method is applied to find the optimum and the compensation control based on the output voltage feedback is combined to build a complete dual-optimized control strategy.Finally;the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation and an experimental platform using TMS320F28335 controller.

title: A Trans-Z-source Five-leg Dual-output Two Stage Matrix Converter
abstract: A topology and modulation strategy of a Trans-Z-source five-leg dual-output two stage matrix converter（TSMC）is proposed.The topological structure not only has the advantages of five-leg dual-output TSMC;but also can overcome the deficiency of low voltage transmission ratio of the system itself when introduced the Trans-Z-source.Compared with existing dual-output TSMC;Trans-Z-source five-leg dual-output TSMC has lower Z-source capacitor voltage stress and lesser number of capacitor required;it can change the transformer turns ratio to adjust the output voltage range;with a higher voltage transfer ratio.An experimental prototype with TMS320F28335 and EPM574t144 as controller is established.The experimental results verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed topology and control strategy.

title: Research on Key Technology of Wireless Intelligent Sensor Design for Monitoring Condition of Parallel Capacitor Bank
abstract: The process of frequent switching of parallel capacitor to compensate for power grid reactive power produces serious inrush current and harmonics. The transient over-voltage and large current pose a great threat to the safe operation of capacitor unit. A kind of power capacitor condition monitoring program based on wireless sensing technology is proposed. Through the analysis of core magnetic field distribution;material characteristics and coil output power;the double CT sensor structure with closed-circuit core for high-voltage energy extraction and open-circuit core for measurement is determined. The built-in A/D and the CC2530 chip of the ZigBee communication protocol stack as well as the dedicated signal processing circuit are used for current and temperature rise sensing of the capacitor unit;The low-power IEEE802.15.4standard protocol encrypts the terminal node information for wireless networking;and the aggregated data is comprehensively judged in the background machine analysis. The compact design of the dual-core structure sensor solves the problem of high energy extraction and accurate measurement of linear zone under the magnetic saturation of the iron core;and achieves the overall performance optimization of the sensor’s onsite high-voltage insulation;anti-interference and wireless networking design.

title: Self-correction strategy of zero-point drift error of DC bus single current sensor
abstract: In order to study the influence of the zero drift of the DC bus single current sensor on the phase current reconstruction accuracy in the three-phase two-level inverter; the principle of the phase current reconstruction of the DC bus single current sensor was clarified; and the multi-current sensor and the single current sensor were compared. The zero drift error reveals the cause of the zero drift error and the mechanism of the amplification effect. Based on the space vector pulse width modulation method of inserting complementary effective voltage vectors instead of zero vectors; a self-correction strategy for zero drift errors was proposed. The current observation window duration of each sector was analyzed; and the phase current reconstruction and the self-detection and self-correction of the current zero-point drift were realized by using the complementary effective voltage vector dynamic current double sampling. A control system experiment platform with TMS320F28035 DSP as the electric drive controller was built. Under the working conditions within the rated speed; the error of the reconstructed phase current after self-calibration is less than 3.56%; which shows that the proposed error self-calibration strategy can provide reliable reconstructed current for the control system.

title: Research on Reliability of Wireless Measurement and Control System for High Voltage Switchgear
abstract: With the increasing complexity of the power grid;the traditional power maintenance methods are difficult to meet the needs of current power grid maintenance. This paper designs and implements a wireless monitoring system based on wireless communication of multiple single chip computers and CC1310 modules. The system transmits data and instructions through wireless interfaces;controls the opening and closing operations of high-voltage circuit breakers;and measures their characteristic parameters. The reliability test of the system under a series of typical disturbances was carried out in the vacuum switch cabinet. The parallel experiments were carried out on the data communication demonstrator without electromagnetic interference for comparison. In addition;a signal strength experiment is designed to investigate the wireless communication effect at different distances. Through the design and test;it is proved that the design of wireless measurement and control system for high-voltage circuit breaker monitoring is feasible.
keywords: condition monitoring, control, high voltage circuit breaker, wireless communication
affiliations: Jiangsu Daqo Changjiang Electric Co.,Ltd.

title: Interface Research on DSP and Synchronous Serial EEPROM 93LC56B
abstract: In order to find out if DSP chip TMS320F2812 can read-write EEPROM chip 93LC56B through SPI interface; this paper analyzes the key interface timing characteristics of 93LC56B;designs a circuit which connects the SPI pins of TMS320F2812 and 93LC56B to I/O pins of FPGA.By capturing interface data of the two chips with ChipScope; this paper confirms the register parameters of TMS320F2812 SPI interface adapted for 93LC56B and gives the read-write subprogram; with findings that the most significant bit of data is inefficacious in single-step reading.
keywords: 93lc56b, dsp, eeprom, spi, tms320f2812

title: Block Data Processing and Transmission Method of Parallel Signal Muti-core DSP
abstract: Aiming at the problem of parallel signal processing and large consumption of transmission resources; the high-speed RapidIO bus is used to fully interconnect multi-core DSP;and the data is shared through memory mapping.Eight cores can transmit and process data in parallel respectively.The RapidIO block with lightweight header has high transmission rate; few data copies and high efficiency.It has been proved that the data throughput has been greatly improved; the transmission delay has been reduced; and the problems such as long compilation time; difficult debugging; and high price in parallel computing of traditional FPGA devices have been solved.It can be extended to radar signal pulse compression; SAR image processing; distributed intelligent cloud computing and other fields.
keywords: fully interconnect, memory mapping, parallel computing, rapidio, tms320c6678

title: Application of Cloud Computing in Distribution Network Information Acquisition System
abstract: In order to speed up the calculation and processing speed of electricity information data; a distribution network electricity information acquisition and management system based on cloud computing technology is designed.The main control module of the concentrator in the system acquisition layer uses MSP430F249 microcontroller; and the communication module uses CC2530 chip and H685 device.The cloud computing platform uses segmental aggregation approximation algorithm to reduce the dimensionality of electricity consumption information data; and uses interpolation method to deal with the missing values in the pre-processing of abnormal large data set of electricity consumption; calculates the continuous fluctuation value of user’s electricity consumption slope and line loss; and establishes the identification model of abnormal electricity consumption information.The cloud computing experimental platform is set up for application testing.The experiment results show that the target error rate of this research system is 0.006%;and the shortest processing time of experimental sample data is 7.85 ms.
keywords: cloud computing technology, msp430f249, virtualization technology
authors: Zhang Xingfu;Xu Bing;Zhang Meng;Wang Manyi;Li Bin

title: Design and implementation of integration of medicine;water and fertilizer control system based on Internet of Things in orchard
abstract: In view of the large workload of pest control and irrigation and the increase of labor cost in the production of mountainous and hilly orchards;at the same time;the current fertilization mode in China is rough;the waste of water and fertilizer is large;and the concentration of fertilizer solution is not easy to control.Combined with Internet of Things technology and Internet technology;an integrated control system of orchard medicine;water and fertilizer based on Internet of Things is designed.The system is based on ZigBee node based on CC2530;combined with MCU and various sensors.Remote monitoring and control are realized through ZigBee network;and the execution module performs various functions.At the same time;fuzzy control is used to accurately control the water pump to realize precise fertilization and irrigation.Through experimental verification;the packet loss rate of ZigBee network has no obvious relationship with the distance;and has a certain relationship with the contracting frequency of host computer software.The system can realize remote monitoring and automatic control;and display the monitoring data such as air and soil humidity;conductivity value and pH value in real time.The conductivity value of the mixing tank is adjusted by the system for about 690sto reach the set value of 1.5ms/cm.The soil conductivity value is adjusted by the system for about 810sto reach the set value of1.2ms/cm.At the same time;the system implements different irrigation schemes;fertilizer mixing and fertilization schemes according to different soil conductivity values and mixed medicine pool conductivity values;accurately controls irrigation and fertilization;and has good stability.
keywords: control system, integration of liquid medicine, mountain orchard, water and fertilizer, zigbee
authors: Zhang Hong;Xiao Liping;Tao Zhongyan;Xiong Qin;Cai Jinping;Dong Wei
affiliations: College of Engineering,Jiangxi Agricultural University,Key Laboratory of Modern Agricultural Equipment of Jiangxi Province

title: Design and implementation of energy storage battery management system in microgrid
abstract: Combined with the working characteristics of microgrid energy storage battery;a battery management system based on TMS320F2812 and LTC6811 is designed. The master-slave system architecture is adopted;and the slave module is mainly LTC6811. The voltage;current;temperature and other state acquisition circuits and active equalization circuits are established to manage 12 series of battery packs;and communicate with the master module through SPI serial port;In the Code Warrior development environment;the software of the main control module TMS320F2812 minimization system is developed to realize the program design of battery SOC estimation;active balance control;safety protection and so on;and improve the monitoring and management ability of battery packs. Experiments show that the scheme is feasible and effective;the battery data acquisition accuracy is high;the voltage error is within ±5 mV;the temperature error is within ± 1 ℃;and the active equalization effect is obvious;and the SOC difference of the series battery pack is within 1%.
keywords: acquisition circuit, active equalization, battery management system, energy storage battery, ltc6811

title: Design of intelligent door lock system based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to improve the security of intelligent door lock and realize the remote monitoring and management of door lock;an intelligent door lock system based ZigBee is designed.The system consists of terminal door lock;wireless gateway;platform and user terminal. The system takes CC2530 chip as the core;terminal door lock as the terminal node and wireless gateway as the coordinator to construct ZigBee’s wireless network and realize the network interconnection with the platform.Users can issue control instructions through the platform to realize remote control of the door lock.At the same time;the terminal door lock can detect the state of the door lock and upload the state information to the platform.The test results show that the dormant power consumption of the terminal door lock is less than 20 μA and the success rate of unlocking is more than 95%.The platform can accurately obtain the state of the door lock.It is practical to control the state of the door lock in real time.
keywords: cc2530, intelligent door lock, internet of things, zigbee

title: Application of ZigBee wireless network technology in forest fire prevention
abstract: In order to effectively prevent and reduce the damage of forest fire to the forest ecological environment;this paper designs and develops a forest fire monitoring system based on ZigBee technology;aiming at the shortcomings of insufficient intellectualization of forest fire prevention and excessive capital and artificial investment. The system adopts the“terminal-host-cloud platform”architecture;using ZigBee terminal node to obtain environmental data of various sensor using carry 4G communication module of ZigBee coordinator node will upload data to the cloud server;relevant staff by the host the client view the environment data and adjusting the threshold value;realize the reverse control of the terminal equipment. The test results show that the forest fire monitoring system based on ZigBee technology can achieve the purpose of forest environment monitoring and intelligent control;has strong operability and practical significance.
keywords: cc2530, forest fire prevention, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Smart home system based on STM32 and ZigBee network
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high cost;poor expansibility and compatibility of smart home;a smart home system based on Internet of things is designed. The system uses CC2530 MCU to build ZigBee wireless network;STM32 MCU to build the main controller;with temperature;humidity and air quality sensors to achieve wireless collection of indoor environmental data and control of household appliances. The main controller is responsible for aggregating the data collected by sensors through the ZigBee wireless network;realizing the local human-computer interaction through TFT touch screen;and exchanging data with the server through the GSM module and MQTT protocol. The server-side data is stored in the MySQL database;and the user-side obtains the server-side data in real time through the MQTT service. Users can use the TFT touch screen for real-time monitoring and controlling in the field;and can also achieve the same operation on the terminal software. Experiment shows that the system can effectively realize the remote monitoring of the environment and the real-time regulation of electrical appliances;and the system module has high compatibility and strong expansibility;so it has a certain application value.
keywords: internet of things, mqtt protocol, smart home, stm32, zigbee wireless network

title: Design and Implementation of 6LoWPAN Network Based on Raspberry Pi CM4 and CC2530
abstract: In order to realize the interconnection and intercommunication between wireless sensor network（WSN） and IPv6network; a design scheme of6LoWPAN network based on Raspberry Pi CM4and CC2530microprocessor is proposed; and the hardware and software design of6LoWPAN wireless network terminal node with CC2530as the main controller chip is realized; as well as the design of a complete edge road network composed of Raspberry Pi CM4and CC2530microprocessor. Based on this; the IPv6network and6LoWPAN network test platform is built; the corresponding communication function is realized and the feasibility of the scheme is verified.
keywords: 6lowpan network, cc2530microprocessor, internet of things（iot）, raspberry pi cm4, wireless sensor network
