title: The control system of motor which is based on DSP
abstract: The article introduces the structure and working theory of motor torque and position（speed）control system based on DSP（TMS320LF2407）. Focuses on the function and the application of TMS320LF2407; photoelectric isolation; the driving circuit; photoelectric encoder; Hall sensor. The main function of TMS320LF2407 referred to in this paper is: A/D conversion; PWM output; Event manager; timer/counter; and so on; and also gives a detailed introduction to the realization of hardware and software control system of the current and position.
keywords: dsp, motor, torque and position closed-loop control
affiliations: Chinalco Shandong Engineering Technology Co., Ltd

title: A Method for Specific Communication Emitter Identification Based on Multi-Domain Feature Fusion
abstract: To solve the problem of low identification rate caused by specific communication emitter identification using a single feature; a method for individual identification of the communication emitter based on multi-domain feature fusion is proposed. Firstly; multiple transform domain features of the signals transmitted by the communication emitter are extracted; and these features are combined into multi-domain features.Secondly; the multi-channel convolution neural network is constructed; and the multi-channel convolution operation is carried out to extract the multi-domain features at a deep level. Finally; specificcommunication emitter classification is completed using the neural network classifier.Compared with the identification method based on a single feature; this method makes full use of the multi-domain features of the signals sent by the communication emitter and combines the powerful microscopic feature mining capability of the neural network to realize the effective individual identification of the communication emitter. Through the identification of 20 CC2530 devices under the conditions of low signal-to-noise ratio（SNR） and Rayleigh channel; the results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the identification accuracy and timeliness under a low SNR; and that the identification effect can still reach 91.01% under the condition of 0 dB.
keywords: communication emitter identification, feature fusion, low signal-to-noise ratio, multi-channel convolution neural network

title: 基于物联网的果园药水肥一体化控制系统设计与实现
abstract: 针对山地丘陵果园生产作业中，病虫害防治和灌溉工作量大，人工成本上升，同时我国当前施肥模式粗犷、水肥浪费量大、肥液浓度不好控制等问题，结合物联网技术和互联网技术设计一种基于物联网的果园药水肥一体化控制系统。该套系统以基于CC2530的ZigBee节点为基础，结合MCU单片机及各类传感器，通过ZigBee网络实现远程监测和控制执行模块执行各种功能，同时采用模糊控制对水泵进行精准控制，实现对果树的精准施药、施肥和灌溉，并进行试验验证。结果显示，ZigBee网络的丢包率与距离没有明显关系，与上位机软件发包频率有一定关系；系统能够实现远程监测与自动控制，实时显示空气和土壤湿度、EC值和pH值等监测数据；混合药池的EC值经过系统调节690s左右，达到设定值1.5ms/cm，土壤EC值经过系统调节810s左右，达到设定值1.2ms/cm附近；同时系统根据不同的土壤EC值与混合药池EC值执行不同的灌溉方案与混肥、施肥方案，精准控制灌溉施肥，有较好的稳定性。
keywords: zigbee, 山地果园, 控制系统, 药水肥一体化
authors: 陶中岩;张鸿;蔡金平;董伟;肖丽萍;熊钦

title: Research and application of 2.45 GHz inverted-F folded printed antenna
abstract: Aiming at the miniaturization requirements of wireless communication nodes and the problems of poor normalized impedance and small gain of existing printed inverted-F antenna; a design applied to the wireless terminal nodes center frequency of 2.45 GHz printed inverted F antenna is folded.The antenna model is established by using Ansys HFSS.According to the theory; the antenna parameters are simulated; and the optimal parameters are obtained through parameter scanning analysis.Under this structure parameter; at the resonant frequency of 2.45 GHz; the normalized impedance of the antenna is（0.979 1-0.188 2 i）Ω;the maximum gain is 3.81 dB and has a return loss of-20.42 dB.Meanwhile; its performance is tested by appling to CC2530 wireless communication node.Test results show that the packet loss rate of the wireless communication nodes loaded with the antenna is 0.2 % under certain conditions; which is prior to that of similar antennas.
keywords: 2.45 ghz antenna, inverted f-shaped bending antenna, resonant frequency, wireless communication
affiliations: School of Automation and Electrical Engineering, Lanzhou Jiaotong University, Rail Transit Electrical Automation Engineering Laboratory of Gansu Province, Lanzhou Jiaotong University

title: Wireless monitoring system of miners’body temperature based on ZigBee protocol
abstract: Aiming at the basic requirements of Novel Coronavirus epidemic prevention and the health of miners; a portable human body temperature wireless detection system based on ZigBee technology is designed.First of all; the terminal equipment composed of temperature sensor; CC2530 microcontroller unit（MCU） and OLED display screen collects; processes and displays the temperature data of miners respectively.Secondly; the system transmits the processed data to the coordinator through the routing node through the Mesh network formed by CC2530 MCU.Finally; the coordinator aggregates the data of all terminal devices and uploads it to OneNET through the WiFi module for recording and display.Through this system; the body temperature of the miners can be monitored in real time so as to achieve the purpose of early detection; early isolation and early treatment.The detection results show that the system can accurately measure the temperature data of miners and upload it to the cloudserver for statistical display in real time; which has certain practical value and significance.
keywords: cc2530 microcontroller unit（mcu）, human body temperature, mesh network, onenet platform, zigbee protocal
authors: LIU Zhongyu;SHAO Dan;FAN Qiang;LI Zheng;MIAO Shuguang

title: Design of wireless sensor node for bearing vibration based on compressed sensing
abstract: In this paper;a wireless sensor vibration monitoring node was designed to overcome the shortcomings of the existing wire bearing vibration monitoring system. In the node;the low power consumption TMS320F28335 single chip microcomputer was used as the core. A biaxial accelerometer based on micro-electro-mechanical system（MEMS） was used to collect vibration signals. MAX291 and OP07 were used as data processing. The LTC4070;TPS79533 and FP6291 were used to manage the power circuit. SD memory was used as data buffer area. The node adopted hybrid wireless communication which was included ZigBee and GPRS. The appropriate filtering algorithm was used to get the characteristic frequency. In order to reduce the amount of wireless data transmission;compressed sensing technology was introduced. The bearing signal was sparse processed by DCT and the Gaussian random matrix was used as the measurement matrix;and the signal was reconstructed by orthogonal matching pursuit（OMP） algorithm. In this paper;the software and hardware systems of the main modules based on the wireless monitoring node of bearing vibration were mainly introduced. The filtering algorithm and compressed sensing algorithm were designed. The acquisition accuracy and signal reconstruction accuracy of the system were tested and verified.
keywords: bearing, compressed sensing, micro-electro-mechanical system（mems）, wireless
affiliations: School of Mechanical Engineering,Nantong Institute of Technology

title: Design of RS485 communication system based on TMS320F2812
abstract: Based on the real-time and data reliability requirements of industrial automation control for upper and lower data transmission; an RS485 data communication system based on TMS230F2812 DSP chip has been designed. The communication principle of RS485; the workflow and software design of the system by using the embedded 485A interrupt module in DSP to achieve real-time communication with the upper computer have been discussed in the text. Tests have shown that the system has stable data transmission; high communication speed; strong anti-interference ability; and has achieved good results in data communication for industrial automation equipment.
keywords: digital signal processor, rs485, tms230f2812
affiliations: Jiangsu Yawei Machine Tool Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Provincial Key Laboratory of Metal Sheet Intelligent Equipment

title: Research on ultrasonic flow measurement technology of four-channel gas based on DSP
abstract: Aiming at the defects of low accuracy; low reliability and large error of ultrasonic flowmeter in low velocity fluid measurement; a four-channel gas ultrasonic flow measurement technology based on DSP is proposed. Firstly; according to the measurement principle of ultrasonic flowmeter; the time difference method is selected as the flow measurement algorithm.Secondly; the acoustic channel layout scheme of the ultrasonic flowmeter is determined; and the weighting coefficient of the instantaneous flow is calculated by using the mathematical integration method. TI′s TMS320F28335 DSP chip is selected to complete the system hardware design. Finally; the received signal is filtered to simulate the flow in the pipeline under static and quantitative conditions.The experimental results show that the average measurement errors of each acoustic channel in the static flow measurement of pipeline are 0.142%; 0.217%; 0.273 % and 0.362%; and the error is less than ±0.4 %; which meets the standard requirements. In the quantitative measurement of low flow rate; the average error between the prototype and the standard meter is 0.945%; and the experimental data show that the prototype detection error decreases with the increase of gas flow rate; which also meets the industrial standards and meets the design requirements.
keywords: dsp, four-channel, low flow velocity, ultrasonic flowmeter
authors: Cheng Pengfei;Zhu Yanping;Pan Jinyan;Wang Shuchen;Cui Chuanjin

title: Design of Intelligent Home Environmental Information Monitoring System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: This article designs and implements a smart home environmental information monitoring system based on ZigBee technology.This system utilizes ZigBee technology to achieve real-time monitoring and control of home environment data（such as temperature;humidity; lighting; etc.） and execution devices. The hardware part is implemented using the ZigBee development board of CC2530 chip;while the software part is written and debugged using the IAR Embedded Workbench development environment. The system data is displayed on the Qt upper computer interface. The test results show that the system can effectively monitor home environment data; and can achieve bidirectional communication by controlling the execution mechanism of terminal nodes through the upper computer; with the characteristics of fast response and stable transmission. This study provides a low-power; high transmission rate wireless communication solution for the field of smart homes; which has broad application prospects.
keywords: environmental monitoring, graphic interaction, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: Xiamen Nanyang Vocational College

title: Design and implementation of context backup and resume scheme based on multi-core DSP
abstract: In software-defined computing architectures; DSP; as a commonly used hardware resource; is bound to develop virtualization in order to maximize its performance. This paper proposes a multi-core DSP context environment backup and resume scheme; with core 0 as the control core; through reasonable memory allocation and read/write operations; the states of remaining core in the calculation process; such as register state; stack state; data state; and program state; are saved and written back;achieved the function of switching from computing task M to computing task N; and then switching back to M after N is completed. Using TI 66AK2H14 to verify its feasibility. This scheme provides practical methods and experience for the flexible application of multi-core DSP hardware resources.
keywords: backup, context, multi-core dsp, resume

title: Time synchronization testing system for quartz flexible accelerometer
abstract: In order to meet the synchronous test requirements of quartz flexible accelerometers in parameter modeling system; a time-synchronized wireless test system is designed based on wireless communication technology. The system is designed based on the CC2530 wireless SOC chip. The hardware captures timestamps to reduce some delay factors. Least Squares Fit（LSF） is used to estimate and compensate for the relative clock drift between wireless nodes. The monitoring synchronization method is designed to reduce the number of times sync packets sent. The single-hop and multi-hop monitoring synchronization test results show that the average synchronization error of the four hops is 3.826 μs; the mean square error is 3.286 μs; and the average monitoring errors of the four hops are 8.193 μs and 5.241 μs; respectively. The system can meet the synchronous test requirements of the quartz flexible accelerometer parameter modeling application; and can be extended to similar applications.
keywords: clock skew, monitoring, synchronization testing, time stamp

title: Online upgrade method of second bootloader based on TMS320F28335
abstract: To avoid the operations of opening embedded device; configuring GPIO pin voltage level; or developing the special upper computer software during the online upgrade process of application program for TMS320F28335; a second bootloader method was proposed. To realize the online upgrade function of application program; TMS320F28335 was configured as Flash boot mode; and the second bootloader was pre-burned. The application program binary file from general serial port upper computer software was stored in the external extended SRAM of TMS320F28335; and was downloaded to on-chip Flash. And then; the system jumps to execute the application program. The experimental results show that this method is effective and feasible; and it has strong universality and reliability.
keywords: dsp, online upgrade, second bootloader, serial communication, tms320f28335

title: Design of Vehicle Mounted Electric Leveling Control System
abstract: This paper describes the design of an electromechanical four point automatic leveling control system that can be applied to vehicle platforms; and explores the system composition; leveling methods; hardware design; and software design. The system is based on the TMS320F2812 DSP chip as the controller core; and uses high-precision tilt angle sensors to achieve platform angle feedback. It realizes the automatic lifting function of the vehicle platform; automatic unlocking and locking function of the leveling leg; automatic landing detection function of the leveling leg; overload and over travel protection of the leveling leg; tilt angle monitoring; automatic leveling and retraction.

title: Application of ZigBee Technology in Distributed Photovoltaic Power Generation Systems
abstract: This paper describes the optoelectronic monitoring technology implemented by Zig Bee technology. The system is based on CC2530 as the core; adapted to RS-485 communication interface; and has four power consumption modes. It verifies that Zig Bee technology achieves data transfer between nodes in distributed photovoltaic power plants.
keywords: distributed photovoltaics, wireless communication, zig bee technology
affiliations: Clean Energy Branch of CNOOC Energy Development Co., Ltd.

title: Design of APFC Control System Model Compatible with Single Phase and Three Phase
abstract: In the aspect of the control system of the active power factor（APFC） of switching power supply; for the complicated control algorithm; the traditional manual code has a long period and low efficiency. This paper proposes a control system method based on model Design（MBD）. Take APFC control system compatible with single-phase AC input as an example. The co-simulation of Matlab and CCS was carried out; and the generated code was verified on TMS320F28335. Experimental results show that this method can complete APFC compatible with single-three-phase AC input; and the development efficiency is higher than the traditional method.
keywords: active power factor correction（apfc）, co-simulation, compatible with single three-phase, model based design（mbd）
affiliations: School of Physical Science and Technology, Southwest Jiaotong University

title: 基于TMS320F28335的用电器识别装置设计
abstract: In this paper; a kind of electric appliance identification device is designed with the design goal of the H item of the National Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest 2021. The device takes TMS320F28335 chip as the core; and is externally connected with IM1281b electric energy metering module; matrix keyboard; LCD12864 LCD; ZMPT107 voltage transformer and ABC210 full wave rectifier bridge. In the learning mode; the device collects electric signals through the voltage transformer and the electric energy metering module; and generates a database of electrical appliances. In the recognition mode; the device uses the look-up table method to analyze the parameters of electrical appliances; and finally displays the identification results of electrical appliances on the liquid crystal display screen.
keywords: electric energy metering module, electrical appliance identification device, phase difference, tms320f28335 chip, voltage transformer

title: 基于TMS320C6678 DSP+天熠嵌入式操作系统的软件模块动态加载的研究与实现

title: 基于ZigBee协议的矿工体温无线监测系统
abstract: 针对新冠病毒防疫的基本要求以及矿工的生命健康，设计了一种基于ZigBee技术的便携式体温无线检测系统。首先，由体温传感器、CC2530单片机（MCU）以及OLED显示屏组成的终端设备，对矿工的体温数据分别进行采集、处理和显示。其次，该系统通过CC2530 MCU组建的Mesh网络将处理后的数据经路由节点传输至协调器。最后，协调器汇聚所有终端设备的数据通过WiFi模块上传至OneNET进行记录和显示。通过该系统对矿工的体温进行实时监测，从而起到早发现、早隔离、早治疗的目的。实验结果表明：该系统可以较为准确地测量出矿工的体温数据，并且实时上传至云端服务器进行统计显示，具有一定的实用价值和现实意义。
keywords: cc2530单片机, mesh网络, onenet平台, zigbee协议, 体温

title: 并联电容器组状态监测的新型无线传感器设计关键技术研究
abstract: 并联电容器组频繁投切补偿电网无功过程产生严重涌流和谐波，瞬间过电压和大电流对电容器单元运行安全威胁极大。提出一种基于无线传感技术的电力电容器状态监测方案，通过铁心磁场分布、材料特性和线圈输出功率分析，确定传感器采用闭路铁心高压取能、开路铁心测量的双CT结构，利用内置A/D及ZigBee通信协议栈的CC2530芯片，以及专用信号处理电路实现电容器单元电流和温升感知；由低功耗IEEE 802.15.4标准协议将终端节点信息加密无线组网，汇聚的数据在后台机进行综合判别分析。双铁心结构传感器的紧凑化设计，解决了铁心磁性饱和下高位取能、线性区的准确测量问题，实现了传感器现场高压绝缘、抗干扰和无线组网设计的整体性能优化。
keywords: 在线监测, 复合传感器, 并联电容器组, 无线组网, 高压自取能

title: 多路电磁阀及比例阀驱动接口复用的设计与实现
abstract: 电磁阀的驱动信号通常是开关量（高电平阀门开通、低电平关断），比例阀的驱动信号通常是脉宽调制（PWM），驱动电流一般在3 A甚至更大。文中设计一种基于数字信号处理器（DSP）TMS320F28335的电磁阀、比例阀驱动系统，创新地设计使用隔离电源模块替代半桥驱动芯片自举电容的方式，实现电磁阀、比例阀驱动接口复用，即一个接口既可以输出开关量信号，也可以输出PWM信号。所设计系统可以驱动多路电磁阀或比例阀，以4路输出驱动接口为例，设计一种基于互锁电路的每一支路硬件过流保护，各支路经过并入串出移位器将其过流状态输入给DSP。试验结果表明，系统不仅占用接口资源少，而且占用片上资源少，具有可靠性和稳定性高等特点，对于片上资源紧缺的项目具有较高的实用价值。
keywords: 接口复用, 比例阀驱动, 电磁阀驱动, 过流保护, 隔离电源模块, 驱动系统

title: 综掘工作面智能局部通风机管控系统研究
abstract: 为解决综掘工作面局部通风系统智能化水平低、“一风吹”现象突出的问题，研究了基于TMS320F28335控制器的智能局部通风机管控系统，结合综掘工作面瓦斯涌出特点、局部通风理论，运用模糊控制、变频调速技术实现了局部通风机智能管控系统，同时设计了局部通风机智能管控系统人机界面，完成了试验验证和试运行。结果表明，该智能局部通风机管控系统极大地提升了综掘工作面通风监测系统的智能化水平，实现了自适应调速，达到了节能降耗运行的目的，保证了局部通风系统安全、可靠、稳定运行。

title: 基于无线网络的智能交通监控系统研究
abstract: 本系统基于无线传感网络对智能交通监控系统进行开发研究，用以解决目前城市道路交通拥堵、道路利用率低下等问题。基于无线传感网络的智能交通监控系统利用ZigBee网络进行网络架构，由终端节点、监测站协调器和监控中心三部分组成。终端节点为具有无线收发模块的CC2530和磁阻传感器组成，用以完成车辆流信息的采集；监测站协调器由具有无线收发模块的CC2530和TMS320F28335组成，用以完成对各路口车辆流信息的接收，并将采集到的信息通过Internet网络传输给监控中心；监控中心通过计算、分析，得出各路口拥堵情况，并将拥堵情况通过车联网技术发送给监控中心车辆电子信息卡数据库里的车主，提醒车主根据实时路况，提前更改路线，避开道路拥堵。这里通过车牌号与车辆的其它信息进行唯一对应，建立车辆电子信息卡数据库。
keywords: tms320f28335, zigbee, 无线网络, 智能交通, 监控

title: 一种高精度液位测量仪的设计
abstract: 液位测量适用于生产生活的各个方面，是现代测量科学的重要方向。电容式液位测量较为常见，但是测量精度容易受外界环境干扰。为了提高液位测量的精度，提出了一种新型的高精度液位测量仪。该系统以CC2530为核心处理器，AD7147为液位采集器，将传统的触摸屏用法改造为分段式液位测量用法，并结合外围传感器电路的设计，由于AD7147的可编程性和对环境因素引起的电容变化的屏蔽功能，实现了对液位高精度测量。经试验表明该测量仪系统稳定、测量精度可达到毫米级别。
keywords: cc2530, 分段式, 液位测量, 高精度

title: 一种三相电流型Sepic逆变器
abstract: 该文提出一种非隔离型三相电流型Sepic逆变器，该逆变器的结构主要通过传统的三相桥式电路以及可升降压模块的Sepic电路组合而成。借助SPWM载波幅值可调策略解决对于电流型逆变器直流侧电感较大的问题，同时优化输出波形质量。首先介绍此三相电流型Sepic逆变器的工作原理以及相应的调制方式，并在此基础上给出此电路的电压增益数学公式推导，进行相应的数学建模，并由此确定了闭环控制策略。通过仿真验证此电路的升降压能力，最后通过TMS320F2812与FPGA搭建数字控制平台进行实验验证，验证此电路的可行性。

title: 基于DSP的电动拖拉机开关磁阻电机双轮驱动系统

title: Alcohol concentration monitoring system of solid-state pit fermentation based on wireless sensor network
abstract: The existing Baijiu solid-state fermentation process is basically closed fermentation. The realtime data of alcohol concentration in fermentation cellar can not be obtained. In order to solve this problem;a monitoring system of alcohol concentration in solid-state pit fermentation based on wireless sensor network is proposed. The system takes CC2530 as the main control chip;uses ZigBee technology to design the wireless sensor network;uses RS485 bus based on ModBus protocol to design the wired transmission mode;uses TGS2620 alcohol sensor to collect the alcohol concentration data in the pit;and uploads the filtered and fitted data to the host computer through the combination of wireless transmission and wired transmission. The upper computer displays the data in real time. The system has the characteristics of automatic data collection;automatic data transmission and automatic data display. The test results show that the system runs stably;the data is reliable and meets the design requirements.
keywords: real time monitoring, sensor, wireless transmission, zigbee technology

title: Design of regional intelligent production scheduling system for filter rod forming in cigarette factory
abstract: In order to improve the production efficiency of filter rod forming in cigarette factory and reduce production cost; a regional intelligent production scheduling system for filter rod forming in cigarette factory is designed. In the hardware part of the system; the TMS320F2812 chip is used as the control core of the system; and the memory module is designed. The system of this research focuses on the software part; and the production scheduling model and the interference factor analysis model are pre-built to divide the interference events in the production process. It is divided into three categories; and solutions are proposed. At the same time; the regional intelligent production scheduling process for filter rod forming is set to realize the design of the regional intelligent production scheduling system for filter rod forming in cigarette factories. The experiment is divided into two parts. The results of experiment one show that the system in this study can complete the filter rod forming in a relatively short period of time during the production process of different numbers of filter rods; which effectively improves the production efficiency of filter rod forming. The regional intelligent production scheduling system in this study can determine the optimal objective function with fewer iterations; which effectively reduces the production cost.
keywords: cigarette factory filter rod forming, coding, disturbance, instruction, intelligent production scheduling, process

title: Design of Simulation Experimental Platform for Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter Based on FPGA control
abstract: This paper introduces the design of an inverter simulation experimental platform based on FPGA control. The design uses the hardware simulation technology to virtual dual active bridge DC-DC converter（DAB） experiment in FPGA.It is composed of FPGA; DSP and host computer. FPGA uses SparkRoad FPGA to internally virtualize a DAB converter circuit; receive signals from the controller; process the internal information of the simulator; and upload the results to the supreme computer system. DSP uses TMS320F28335 to generate IGBT switching signal in analog DAB converter circuit;and sends the switching signal to FPGA for processing in the way of PWM wave. The host computer is a personal computer; which is used for serial communication with the other two parts.
keywords: dual active bridge dc-dc converter, fpga, semi-physical simulation technology

title: Design of Flow Control Method for Aiming System Software Based on DSP
abstract: Aiming system is used for providing azimuth reference for weapon system; so that the requirement of initial orientation precision of the guidance system is met; and therefore lateral firing precision of the weapon system is guaranteed. Due to the complication of the aiming system and the flow thereof; and the limitation of TMS320C6713 DSP at the aspects of interrupt numbers; timer numbers and task scheduling; a flow control method based on state machine mechanics is provided in this paper. Firstly; 8 user timers are designed base on 5 kHz interrupt of DSP6713 for the use of flow control. Then; the flow of the aiming system is divided into two levels. Finally; reliable automatic flow control is achieved by the design of finite state machines for the main flow and the sub-flows.
keywords: aiming system, automatic flow control, dsp, software design, state machine

title: Speed control of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on RESO and composite sliding mode
abstract: To solve the internal and external disturbances in permanent magnet synchronous motors（PMSM） with parameter variations; modeling error and load uncertainties; a reduced-order extended state observer（RESO） based on composite sliding mode control strategy was proposed. Based on the state space model; a novel RESO was designed to estimate and eliminate the internal and external disturbances with considering the speed signal of PMSM measured by the encoder; and the performance for the RESO was analyzed. The composite sliding mode control method was introduced to design the sliding mode surface and control law for improving the anti-disturbance ability of the whole control system; and the stability of the control strategy was analyzed by Lyapunov method. The hardware-in-the-loop speed control platform of PMSM was built based on the control core of DSP chip TMS320F28335 and the MATLAB control module. The proposed method was simulated and compared with traditional PI and linear active disturbance rejection control methods. The results show that the speed variation of the system with loading can be reduced more than 60% in contrast to traditional system with excellent performance of anti-disturbance and regulation speed.

title: Design and Implementation of Remote Network Video Acquisition and Monitoring System for Hydropower Station Based on ARM
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the traditional video data acquisition and monitoring of hydropower stations; such as poor applicability of monitoring hardware; low monitoring efficiency; low accuracy; low algorithm analysis efficiency and low analysis accuracy. In order to improve the remote network video monitoring capability of hydropower station; this research solves the problem through the improvement of algorithm and acquisition hardware. In terms of hardware; this research uses embedded technology to design multi-channel digital video acquisition equipment. At the same time; the overall design of the monitoring system based on MPT monitoring technology strengthens the monitoring capability of the monitoring system and improves the monitoring efficiency and real-time data transmission capability. The TMS320DM8168 is used as the main control chip; and the TVP5158 computing chip is used for video acquisition to obtain data information about the operation of the hydropower station through image acquisition; which improves the ability to extract field video information. In the aspect of algorithm; based on the EMD hybrid distribution algorithm; the data information collected on site is transformed into micro data analysis; which improves the ability of fault identification and monitoring equipment adjustment. Through the test; the maximum transmission speed of this study can reach 1.65 GB/s; and the transmission time is only 43 s under the maximum data volume.
keywords: centralized monitoring, digital video capture, genetic algorithm, remote network

title: Design of PMSM Drive System for Multi-Function Dust Spraying Vehicle Application
abstract: In this system; 32 bit processor TMS320F28035 is used to design and develop a motor controller for the spray system of multifunctional dust suppressant vehicle. The design of motor controller includes two parts: hardware and software platform. The hardware platform includes: fault detection module; MOS driver module; motor phase current Angle sampling module; main control module.The software part adopts layered design; which is mainly divided into driver layer; application layer and algorithm layer. The application layer and algorithm layer adopt the development mode based on MBD;Simulink model is built for simulation; and M language script is written for the generation of C code of the model. The controller was matched with a 3.5 kW built-in permanent magnet synchronous motor;and torque response test and full speed domain efficiency MAP test were carried out. The experimental results show that the controller achieves the expected design objectives.

title: Design of Low Power Wireless Monitoring System based on CC3200 and QT
abstract: 设计了一款无线信号监视系统，实现了模拟音频信号和数字信号的远程采集和实时显示，可广泛应用于智慧矿山、智慧仓储、智能交通等领域。系统在硬件结构上，MCU采用CC3200;通过WIFI数据传输。同时基于QT开发的APP进行展示，可切换接入多组采集节点。经过实验分析和功能测试，系统具有低功耗、高带宽、实时性强等优点，是一款性能优良的无线监视系统。

title: 采用缓冲池的无线传感器网络中继算法
abstract: 无线传感器网络由于能量限制通信距离有限，当需要实现远距离的无线传感器网络通信时，可以采用中间节点转发的中继传输方法。为避免中继节点发出的无线信号发生空中数据重复转发碰撞问题，提出了采用缓冲池的中继算法。算法在数据帧中增加部分字节作为缓冲池，用于记录数据经过的中继节点号；当数据帧被中继节点转发时，通过对比缓冲池中记录的中继节点数据，如果存在本中继节点号，则抛弃该数据帧不转发，否则中继节点将自己的节点号存入缓冲池并形成新数据帧后转发出去。在CC2530芯片上实现了算法，进行了线性布置的中继实验，结果表明算法可以实现线性布置中继转发并避免重复转发数据碰撞。
keywords: 中继, 无线传感器网络, 算法, 缓冲池, 重复数据碰撞

title: Research on combustible gas measurement and control technology in catering industry under Internet of Things
abstract: This paper designs a combustible gas monitoring system based on the Internet of Things technology. The system takes ATmegal28 as the control core; uses the combustible gas alarm to collect the on-site combustible gas data; and its core device is the combustible gas detector. To ensure the stable communication between the nodes of the system; CC2530 is selected as the RF wireless communication module; integrating NB;Bluetooth; 5G; WiFi communication modules; which can adapt to the complex and changeable working scene of the restaurant.
keywords: catering industry, combustible gas, internet of things, measurement and control system
affiliations: Hunan Fugu Times Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Fugu IoT Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 基于树莓派的Zigbee+WiFi室内有毒气体自动检测系统
abstract: 为了更好地检测室内有毒气体，系统是基于树莓派为核心，综合运用Zigbee+WiFi技术设计室内有毒气体自动检测系统。以CC2530芯片为核心控制器，通过Zigbee将终端节点进行组网络，Zigbee网络终端传感器实现实时采集数据上传树莓派，再经过WiFi上传至云平台，用户可以通过终端查询采集数据。研究结果表明，通过系统的测试及数据分析，系统功能能精确的检测室内有毒气体的浓度，给用户提供准确的数据，保护用户生命安全。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 室内有毒气体, 树莓派
affiliations: 广西安全工程职业技术学院

title: A Pig House Environmental Monitoring System Based on the IoT
abstract: This study focuses on the pig farming environment and aims to design and develop an Internet of Things（IoT）-based monitoring system for pig pens.Environmental factors such as temperature; humidity; light intensity; and ammonia concentration within the pig pens are collected using sensors.Data transmission is carried out through the CC2530 wireless transmission module and ZigBee gateway.The IoT platform is used to manage and receive environmental data uploaded by the monitoring system.When the environmental factors of the pigsty exceed the threshold; an alarm will be triggered; and environmental data can be viewed at any time through cloud platforms and mobile phones.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, iot, pigsty environment
affiliations: School of applied technology,Huanghe S＆T College

title: Research of DSP-based High-precision Measurement Method for Low-frequency Signal
abstract: In this paper; a digital signal frequency measurement system based on DSP TMS320F28335 is designed to solve the problems of traditional digital signal frequency measurement in measurement accuracy and real-time.The continuous capture function of eCAP module in DSP is used for pulse capture; and the frequency value is calculated in real time by the circumferential method in the capture interrupt.In order to reduce the random error and measuring time; a frequency measurement method in segments is adopted for higher frequency.The experimental results show that the accuracy of this scheme can reach 0.001% and the measuring time is less than 10s when the frequency measurement of（0.1～200）Hz pulse signal is applied.
keywords: dsp, frequency measurement, frequency measurement method in segments, signal capture

title: Design of Frequency Control System for Local Ventilation in High Gas Coal Mines
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor real-time and serious waste of electric energy in local ventilation control system of high gas coal mine; a local ventilation energy-saving control system based on TMS320F28335 microcontroller is designed. It takes DSP microcontroller as the core; collects data from gas concentration sensors in the tunnel in real time and completes the dynamic and adaptive processing process;and completes the over-limit blocking function when the gas concentration exceeds the limit to ensure safe production in coal mines.
keywords: dsp, high methane, local ventilation fan, variable frequency speed control
affiliations: Jinneng Holdings Group Gaoshan Coal Co., Ltd.

title: Intelligent Early Warning System for Logistics Warehouse Safety and Fire Fighting Based on Multimodal Information Fusion
abstract: Conventional logistics warehouse safety and fire protection intelligent warning system mainly uses Z-Stack protocol stack to call warning instructions; which is easily affected by the role of task polling; resulting in some of the functions of the system anomaly; so it is necessary to design a new logistics warehouse safety and fire protection intelligent warning system based on multimodal information fusion. In the hardware part; CC2530 node transceiver chip; TAD smoke sensor and DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor are designed. The software part uses multimodal information fusion to design an intelligent warning multi-target detection algorithm; and designs the fire intelligent warning function module; thus realizing the logistics warehouse safety fire intelligent warning. The system test results show that the designed logistics warehouse safety and fire safety intelligent warning system based on multimodal information fusion has good performance; the test functions are normal and reliable; has certain application value; and can make some contribution to reducing the fire risk of logistics warehouses.
keywords: fire, intelligent early warning system, logistics, multimodal information fusion, safety, warehouse
affiliations: Fire Prevention and Supervision 1st Section, Jinshan District Fire and Rescue Division

title: Design of Intelligent Home Control System Based on the Internet of Things
abstract: The system of this design has strong practicality; accurate judgment; simple operation; and strong expansion function. Its function is to automatically turn on the light when someone is detected indoors; and to automatically turn on the fan when the indoor temperature is high. If the indoor humidity reaches a certain value; the humidifier will automatically turn on; and the curtain will automatically pull down when the outdoor light reaches a certain temperature.
keywords: cc2530, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Kaifeng University

title: Design and realization of the circuit of magnetic resonance wireless power transmission system
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the large number of desktop devices and the complicated charging connection; a wireless power supply device based on magnetic resonance technology is designed; which mainly includes transmitting coil; transmitting circuit; receiving coil and receiving circuit. The natural resonant frequency of the transmitting coil is consistent with that of the receiving coil. TMS320F28335 chip of TI company is used to control 4-channel SiC MOS to provide inverter power. The receiving end uses a rectifier DC/DC circuit composed of a power chip GS3671 to convert the AC power output from the receiving coil into a stable DC power supply that can be used by the load. Through the tests of different coil diameters; distances and relative positions; the receiving coil designed can stably drive the load within the range of 0～15 cm from the desktop; and ensure a transmission efficiency of more than 80%.
keywords: magnetic resonance technology, series resonance, wireless power transmission
affiliations: Guangdong Meizhi Refrigeration Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF DYNAMIC PRODUCT ATTITUDE ACQUISITION SYSTEM BASED ON AM5728
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent flexible production; it is necessary to obtain the product placement attitude on the dynamic pipeline in real time and adjust the actuator such as the mechanism attitude control robot according to the product placement attitude in real time to execute the corresponding actions with the designed path; and the dynamic product attitude acquisition system is designed. Based on the AM5728 controller; the hardware platform of the control system was designed and tested. An accurate and fast algorithm for contour extraction was presented by image enhancement and morphology. Under the premise of no contact with any appearance of the product; the product placement posture on the dynamic assembly line could be obtained in real time; which provided technical basis and theoretical support for the realization of the follow-up intelligent flexible production.
keywords: am5728, dynamic assembly line, image processing, product placement posture
affiliations: Zhuhai GREE Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd., GREE Electric Appliances, Inc.of Zhuhai Co., Ltd., Intelligent Manufacturing College,Guangzhou Panyu Polytechnic

title: Design of Adsorption Control System of Wall Climbing Robot Based on DSP Technology
abstract: Wall adsorption is one of the basic functions of a wall climbing robot; and its adsorption degree directly affects the stability and moving speed of the wall climbing robot. Therefore; a wall climbing robot adsorption control system based on DSP technology is designed. Select the sensor device MPU6050 of the wall climbing robot; add the digital signal processor TMS320F28335; and design the adsorption controller of the wall climbing robot by PD control. A corresponding mathematical model is constructed according to the composition structure and working principle of the wall climbing robot. According to the mathematical model; DSP technology is used to calculate the adsorption force of the wall climbing robot. Through the force analysis results of the wall climbing robot on the wall; the safe adsorption conditions of the wall climbing robot are determined. The adsorption controller is used as the actuator to realize the adsorption control of the wall climbing robot. The negative pressure wall climbing robot is selected as the test prototype. The system test shows that compared with two comparison systems under three wall environments of ceramic tile; wood board and glass; the control error of the wall climbing robot’s adsorption force is reduced by 2.04 N; and the overturning risk coefficient is reduced by 0.29; which has good adsorption control effect.
keywords: adsorption control system, adsorption controller, dsp technology, wall adsorption, wall climbing robot
affiliations: College of Big Data and Internet, Shenzhen Technology University

title: Sliding mode compensation control of a permanent magnet synchronous motor based on a new voltage control law
abstract: There is a problem of weak dynamic performance caused by the dynamic coupling and back EMF terms in the torque closed-loop control system of a permanent magnet synchronous motor. Thus a sliding mode compensation control method based on a new voltage control law is proposed. First; based on the permanent magnet synchronous motor model; a new voltage control law is established to ensure the stability of the torque closed-loop control system. Second; using the functional relationship between the velocity estimation and the sliding mode surface; an adaptive velocity observer is designed to compensate the coupling and back-EMF terms of the d-axis and q-axis; and realize the speed closed-loop of the system at the same time. After that; a sliding mode surface with a sigmoid nonlinear smooth function is introduced; and a sliding mode compensation control strategy is constructed to realize the robustness of the control law to parameter and external perturbations during the entire motion process. Finally; a Matlab/Simulink simulation model and experimental platform of a 400 W permanent magnet synchronous motor controlled by TMS320F28335 are built. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control method has the characteristics of small torque and current fluctuation; fast response and strong robustness.
keywords: adaptive speed observer, new voltage control law, permanent magnet synchronous motor, sliding mode compensation control, torque closed-loop control system
affiliations: Engineering Research Center of Ministry of Education for Renewable Energy Generation and Grid Connection Technology, Xinjiang University

title: Design and Implementation of DSP Serial Port Expansion Based on Register Time-division Multiplexing
abstract: Aiming at the lack of asynchronous serial port resources of the core processing chip DSP in the control system; a serial port expansion method based on time-division multiplexing of DSP registers is proposed. The serial port resource based on TMS320F28335 DSP is studied; the hardware circuit design and software program design are expounded; and a platform is built to test and verify its extended function. The test results show that this extension method is reliable; simple; and has low hardware overhead; which effectively improves the utilization rate of the asynchronous serial port resources of the DSP itself; and has a high reference value for the design of multi-peripheral control systems.
keywords: dsp, multiple peripheral control, serial port expansion, time division multiplexing
authors: LIU Li;CAI Jia-Cheng;LI Xing-Zhou;GAO Yu-Wen;MA Jun-An;WU Jian-Gang
affiliations: Research Department of Sichuan Aerospace Liaoyuan Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.
source: Development ＆ Innovation of Machinery ＆ Electrical Products.

title: Research on Intelligent Traffic Monitoring System Based on Wireless Network
abstract: This system is based on wireless sensor network for intelligent traffic monitoring system development research; to solve the current urban road traffic congestion; low road utilization and other problems. The intelligent traffic monitoring system based on wireless sensor network uses ZigBee network for network architecture; which consists of three parts: terminal node; monitoring station coordinator and monitoring center. The terminal node is composed of CC2530 with wireless transceiver module and reluctance sensor to complete the collection of vehicle flow information. The monitoring station coordinator is composed of CC2530 and TMS320F28335 with wireless transceiver module; which is used to receive the vehicle flow information at each intersection and transmit the collected information to the monitoring center through the Internet network. Through calculation and analysis; the monitoring center obtains the congestion situation at each intersection; and sends the congestion situation to the car owners in the vehicle electronic information card database of the monitoring center through the Internet of vehicles technology to remind the car owners to change the route in advance according to the real-time road conditions to avoid road congestion. Here; through the unique correspondence between the license plate number and other information of the vehicle; the vehicle electronic information card database is established.
keywords: intelligent traffic, monitoring, tms320f28335, wireless network, zigbee
affiliations: Hebei Vocational University of Industry and Technology
source: Development ＆ Innovation of Machinery ＆ Electrical Products.

title: Control system design of six axis robot based on fuzzy robust control
abstract: To tackle the problem that the trajectory deviation of the traditional six axis robot motion control system based on PLC or control card was too high; a robot control system based on fuzzy robust control was designed. In the hardware part of the control system; STM32F103C8T6 single chip microcomputer and TMS320C6203 DSP signal processor were selected; and the fuzzy adaptive control module was added to correct the motion trajectory through the adaptive adjustment of the control system parameters; At the system software level; the nonlinear moving trajectory and multiple uncertainties were compensated and optimized by updating fuzzy rules and introducing robust term algorithm. The experimental data showed that the joint angle parameters; link offset and displacement of the robot in the fuzzy robust control mode were accurate; and the trajectory deviation compensated by the dynamic control of three axial coordinates was smaller.
keywords: dynamic compensation, fuzzy robust control, path of particle, robot, six degrees of freedom
affiliations: Ya’an Vocational and Technical College

title: Design of Emergency Power Supply System Based on Photovoltaic Technology
abstract: With the development of industrial technology and the improvement of living standards; the demand for electricity in various aspects of people’s lives and production is increasing. While relying on electricity; there are also increasing demands for the safety; reliability; and environmental friendliness of power supply. Especially the interruption of power supply may lead to abnormal equipment operation; seriously affecting personal and property safety. The emergency power supply system based on photovoltaic technology can solve these problems. Photovoltaic power generation technology can provide a green and pollution-free energy supply method; achieving environmental protection effects. Based on this; an emergency power supply system can be built; combined with appropriate energy storage equipment; to ensure the basic power supply of electrical equipment 24/7 in the event of power network interruption or failure. This emergency power supply system that does not rely on traditional electricity has broad development prospects.
keywords: emergency power supply, photovoltaic technology, plc control, tms320f2812 chip
affiliations: Suzhou Higher Vocational and Technical School

title: Design and Application of Networked Controller for Flexible Packaging Printing Equipment
abstract: In order to promote the performance of controller; through borrowing from the typical design scheme of network controller; the design of original controller is designed according to the basic performance; cost and related requirements of flexible package printing equipment. The study proposes the total design scheme of network controller. The study deploys master software chip; uses modified integrated circuit chip TMS320F28335 instead of primary TMS320LF2407 audion as master check crystal oscillator; and explores the application of controller in printing tension control system.
keywords: application, flexible packaging printing equipment, network controller design
affiliations: Tianjin Masterwork Technology Group Co., LTD

title: 中频感应加热电源谐振频率自适应追踪方法的研究
abstract: 为解决中频感应加热电源在受到温度、工件材质等因素变化影响时固有频率发生波动的问题，提出了一种基于模数转换（Analog to Digital; A/D）采样优化的感应加热电源谐振频率自适应追踪方法。在一个感应加热电源的输出周期内，细化电流A/D采样过程，找到输出电流与电压的相位差并判断系统状态。在优选A/D采样次数的基础上，设计自适应调节机制来追踪谐振频率，使系统达到准谐振状态。以TMS320F28335控制芯片为基础搭建感应加热电源样机，对所采用频率自适应追踪方法进行了验证。实验结果表明，频率自适应追踪方法在环境温度变化剧烈时可避免系统受到干扰，并且能在无硬件过零检测电路的情况下快速追踪负载的谐振频率。
keywords: a/d采样优化, 中频感应加热, 控制芯片, 频率自适应追踪方法
authors: 巫付专;王长通;周元浩;向乃皇;陈蒙娜
affiliations: 中原工学院电子信息学院,  中原工学院学报编辑部

title: 基于ZigBee的嵌入式智能家居网关设计
abstract: 为解决传统智能家居系统数据采集、远程信息传输控制与处理等问题，本文设计并实现了一个涵盖LAN与PAN的智能家居网关，以嵌入式处理器STM32F103RCT6为主控制器，ARM Linux为实时操作系统，以CC2530、ESP8266为核心的ZigBee-Wi-Fi无线网关，在STM32处理器上构建嵌入式Web服务器，实现了ZigBee和Wi-Fi异构互联网络的交互操作。本文给出了系统的软件、硬件设计方案。经实验测试验证了该智能家居系统在低成本组建、灵活性和安全性等方面的可行性和适用性，为本地与远程设备的控制与监测提供了便利。
keywords: cc2530, stm32, wi-fi, zigbee, 智能家居
affiliations: 牡丹江师范学院

title: 基于NB-IoT的家庭环境监控系统设计
abstract: 针对上班族朝九晚五，因为长时间不在家导致居住环境质量舒适程度变化大及家庭安全隐患等问题，设计了一个基于NB-IOT的家庭环境监控系统，以CC2530为控制核心，通过采集房屋的温湿度、光照强度、烟雾浓度等环境数据进行分析，控制窗户、窗帘设备去实现全屋舒适最大化，同时利用低功耗物联网NB-IOT技术将采集到的数据实时传输到One NET云平台进行存储，方便管理者在互联网平台上统一查看。当传感器采集到的数据异常时，cc2530上传数据的同时拉响家庭报警器进行报警，云平台接收异常数据后显示异常警报。测试结果表明该系统能够实现对家庭环境监控，提高人员居住的舒适度，在一定程度上还可以预警火灾，大大提高了管理家庭环境的便利性和家庭的安全性。
keywords: bc26通信, cc2530, nb-iot技术, onenet云平台, zigbee通信, 家庭环境监控
affiliations: 吉林化工学院信息与控制工程学院

title: 智能三相充电桩系统的开发
abstract: 随着当今我国的社会践行可持续协调发展观、建设社会资源节约型和构建环境和平友好型新社会理念要求的逐步提出，我国电动汽车等新能源交通工具迅速发展。然而，面对能源供给问题，我国供电设备的不足严重影响这些新兴产业的发展。基于以上背景，本项目拟以TMS320F28335为核心的，由创新型的iVenna整流，功率因素矫正模块，智能安全检测模块等组成。基于以上模型硬件的实现，可直接应用于新能源汽车产业市场，大大填补市场上能源供给不足的漏洞。
keywords: tms320f28335, venna整流, 新能源, 智能化
authors: 庞寿全;莫英观;邱杰晋;黄月容;邹丽玲;韦创炜
affiliations: 玉林师范学院

title: 基于IOT云平台的水温测控系统设计
abstract: 为了实现智能化、高精度的水温实时监测控制系统需求，本文提出基于物联网（IOT）云平台和ZigBee模块的水温控制系统设计，该系统硬件采用CC2530模块、温度传感器、无线通信模块和加热控制电路，并结合上位机软件和手机APP设计，实现在云平台和手机端APP对水温的实时监测和控制，通过PID控制算法控制加热电路，上位机软件记录实时温度数据，并将得到的数据进行分析。实验表明，该系统在20℃～90℃范围内，水温监测控制精度可达到±0.1℃。
keywords: zigbee, 水温控制, 物联网云平台, 系统设计
affiliations: 贵州电子科技职业学院

title: 基于无线网络的鱼塘网关设计
abstract: 提出一种基于无线传感器网络的鱼塘网关设计，无线网络技术采取的是ZgBee技术。在无线网络中，核心是网关，网关设计需要满足成本低、功耗低、安全可靠等条件。网关节点采用美国德州仪器公司的无传感器模块CC2530，利用CC2530对传感器终端节点、路由器节点、协调器节点进行硬件、软件设计。对温度、PH值数据进行采集，点对点的数据传输，通信质量的测试实验。实验结果表明：鱼塘网关实现了终端和协调器的数据传输，网关结构合理、软件设计满足要求。
keywords: arm, qt, stm32, 机械臂
affiliations: 毕节高新技术产业开发区国家能源大规模物理储能技术研发中心贵州省电网公司六盘水分局

title: 基于多路USB3.0接口的高速图像处理平台设计
abstract: 为.解决复杂图像处理应用场景如全景视频拼接、多目标跟踪、环境感知等对于图像处理.设备的高实时性和灵活性需求，本文结合多路USB30接口的高吞吐性能与多核DSP+FPGA架构的高算力优势，.提出了一种基于多路USB30接口的高速图像处理平台设计I。该平台以8核IDSP芯片TMS320C6678为核心，辅以基于FPGA实现的6路USB30高速接口，搭配8片大容量的DDR3SDRAM和4通道的SRO与2通道的PCE高速通道，可实现最多同时对6路高清视频数据的实时传输与处理。经测试验证，该平台能以330MBps的速度稳定地传输多路视频数据，具有良好的灵活性和高吞吐率。
keywords: cyusb3014, fpga, usb3.0, 多核dsp, 高速图像处理平台
authors: 彭俊龙;钟海丽;唐清善;常怀志
affiliations: 长沙理工大学物理与电子科学学院

title: 基于Android的智能家居交互系统设计与开发
abstract: 该系统采用ZigBee芯片CC2530和WiFi芯片ESP8266作为主要构件搭建智能网关。利用串口UART在CC2530和ESP8266间进行数据传输，实现ZigBee-WiFi网络的转换。使用CC2530芯片搭建终端电路实现设备状态信息的获取并通过ZigBee网络与智能网关互联实现物联网的构建。在基于Android系统的智能手机开发APP，以实现智能家居工作状态的获取及控制指令的发送。设计基于Android客户端的WEB服务器，以实现外部网络对智能家居的控制。
keywords: android系统, zigbee, 智能家居, 智能网关
affiliations: 桂林信息科技学院

title: Parallel Calculation Method for Key Parameters of Missile Borne SAR Echo Simulation
abstract: For SAR radar echo simulation; this article first introduces the principle of generating echo simulation signals; and then provides a specific calculation process for the key parameters based on the calculation method of echo simulation signals. Combining the TMS320C6678 multi-core DSP architecture; the system tasks are reasonably divided and multi-core synchronization is achieved. A key parameter calculation scheme for SAR radar echo simulation based on multi-core parallel is proposed. Finally; the effectiveness and real-time performance of the proposed scheme are verified through data comparison.
keywords: echo simulation, multi-core parallelism, synthetic aperture radar
affiliations: School of Information, North China University of Technology

title: Research and Implementation of Dynamic Loading Software Module Based on TMS320C6678 DSP+Tianyi Embedded Operating System
abstract: In view of the requirements of software module product integration; application upgrade and fault recovery of different manufacturers in complex embedded systems; this paper studies the dynamic loading on C6000 series DSP; and implements the dynamic loader of software modules based on TMS320C6678 DSP+Tianyi embedded operating system missile version design and takes it as a component of Tianyi embedded operating system. ■is product with high reliability embedded system has a broad application prospect.
keywords: dsp, dynamic link, dynamic loading, embedded operating system, software module
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Computer Technology and Application, University of South China

title: High-Rate Data Transmission Method Based on Multi-Core DSP and UDP Protocol
abstract: In this paper; a UDP（User Datagram Protocol） protocol packet is written using a multi-core DSP（Digital Signal Processor） to achieve the purpose of high-speed data transmission; and the TMS320C6678-core octa-core processor is used to solve the problem of high-speed data transmission and reception; and the wireshark packet capture tool is used to give a screenshot of the UDP packet and a screenshot of the debugging time. In order to realize high-speed data forwarding between the DSP chassis and the DSP chassis; the UDP communication protocol is used to write the corresponding transceiver program; and the local program is encoded and decoded according to the protocol requirements. The experimental results show that the use of multi-core DSP can realize the sending; receiving; data encoding and decoding of UDP packets between DSP chassis within the specified time; achieve the index of high-speed data transmission; meet the performance requirements of high-real-time equipment; and have high research value and practical purpose.
keywords: high speed data transmission, multi core dsp, tms320c6678, udp protocol
affiliations: Shanghai Shipbuilding Electronic Equipment Institute

title: Optimization Design and Implementation of RF Circuit Based on CC1101
abstract: RF circuit optimization design is an important means to ensure high reliability;low power consumption and long-distance data transmission of RF communication system.Aiming at the problems of short transmission distance and high packet loss rate of CC1101commercial RF circuit;the impedance converter;filter and RF full link in CC1101 RF circuit are simulated and optimized by Advanced Design System（ADS）;a high-frequency electromagnetic simulation software.Components are adjusted according to the simulation results.The transmission distance and packet receiving rate of the modified CC1101 RF circuit are tested.The results show that the impedance of the optimized RF circuit（115+j42Ω） is closer to the target differential impedance（116+j41Ω），the return loss is increased by 11 d B;the insertion loss is reduced by 0.6 d B;and the stable transmission distance is increased by 30 meters.At the distance of 60meters;the data reception rate is increased by 33.6%.
keywords: cc1101, filter, impedance matching, radio frequency full link
authors: GAO Xin;LI Zhengyang;ZHAO Juanhong;XIAN Shuai;MU Jiliang

title: Study on Communication Design between Protection Device and Touch Screen Based on Digital Signal Processor
abstract: With the wide application of digital signal processing technology in power system and the new demand for intelligent protection device in power systems;a communication method based on Modbus protocol is developed with TMS320F28335 as the core processor and HollySys touch screen as the human-machine interaction interface.The communication frame format of Modbus protocol is introduced;the hardware connection mode between digital signal processor and touch screen is put forward and the Modbus communication program combined with the Serial Communication Interface（SCI） function of digital signal processor is compiled;which helps to realize the functions of data communication;reading real-time signal;changing the setting value and detecting equipment status through the touch screen;and so on.
keywords: digital signal processor, human-machine interaction, modbus protocol, touch screen

title: Experimental Platform and Application Research of Electronic Informati on Network Course Based on DSP System
abstract: Aiming at the imperfection of the existing electronic information network course experiment platform; a set of electronic information network course experiment platform based on DSP system is developed. The experimental platform adopts the TMS320F2812 DSP chip as the core control system; adopts the two-cross-direct-cross frequency converter as the main frequency conversion circuit; and designs the DSP main program based on SIMULINK to realize the control of the electronic information network course platform. The test results show that the hardware part of the experimental platform meets the design requirements; can realize the SVPWM control of the hardware circuit; and observe and detect various waveforms; the software part can improve the stability and response speed of the system by changing the designed speed regulator PI; so as to realize the control of the experimental platform and meet the design requirements.
keywords: circuit design, dsp system, electronic information network course, main program design and experimental platform

title: sEMG Wireless Acquisition System Based on CC3200 and ADS1299
abstract: A multi-channel surface electromyography wireless acquisition system is designed; which is mainly composed of ADS1299 integrated analog front-end chip and CC3200 wireless MCU of TI company. The key indicators of hardware are measured according to the industry standard; and the results are better than the industry standard; which can meet the continuous use of multi-scene tasks. This system has the advantages of high performance; low power consumption and small size. It has been applied to the detection of surface EMG signal in motion gesture recognition and has a good application value.
keywords: ads1299, cc3200, surface electromyography, wireless

title: Research on frequency adaptive tracking method of medium frequency induction heating power supply
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the natural resonance frequency of the medium frequency induction heating power source fluctuates due to factors such as changes in temperature and component material; an adaptive tracking method of induction heating frequency based on A/D sampling optimization is proposed. First; in a cycle of the output of the induction heating power supply; the sampling times of the current A/D are subdivided; the phase difference between the output current and the voltage is found; and the system state is judged. Then; based on the optimal number of A/D samples; an adaptive adjustment mechanism was designed to adjust the frequency so that the system can reach a quasi-resonant state. Finally; an induction heating power supply prototype is built by using the TMS320F28335 control chip; and the adopted frequency tracking method is verified. The experimental results verified the effectiveness of this method. The method can avoid system interference when the ambient temperature changes drastically; and can quickly track the load resonant frequency without a hardware zero-crossing detection circuit.
keywords: a/d sampling optimization, adaptive frequency tracking method, control chip, medium frequency induction heating
authors: WU Fuzhuan;CHEN Mengna;ZHOU Yuanhao;WANG Changtong;XIANG Naihuang

title: Design of chain tension monitoring system for coal mine scraper conveyor with autonomous power supply
abstract: Scraper conveyor is an important mechanical equipment in coal mine production; and its operation performance directly affects coal mine safety and production efficiency.Taking the SGZ1250-2400 scraper conveyor as the research object; the overall scheme of the scraper chain tension monitoring system was designed.The system consists of four modules; namely data acquisition module; single chip module; self-powered device and wireless data transmission module.The self-powered supply device can generate electricity through the movement of the scraper conveyor for the operation of the tension monitoring system; which significantly improves the reliability of the system operation.The chip models used in the single-chip microcomputer and the wireless transmission module are STM32 and CC1101 respectively; which have good performance and can meet the actual use requirements.The scraper chain tension monitoring system is deployed in the coal mine engineering practice; and it is found that the effect is good after on-site debugging and application; and the tension of the scraper chain can be accurately detected; which significantly improves the operation safety and reliability of the scraper conveyor.
keywords: autonomous power supply, scraper chain, scraper conveyor, tension monitoring system
affiliations: Luotuoshan Coal Washing Plant of Wuhai Energy Company

title: Research on remote monitoring system for shearers based on CAN and ZigBee technology
abstract: The remote monitoring system plays an important role in ensuring the stability and reliability of shearer operation.The monitoring system is designed based on CAN bus technology and ZigBee wireless network technology.The system can be divided into two parts: downhole and uphole.On the basis of comprehensively considering the actual situation of the mine; data transmission is carried out based on ZigBee wireless network downhole; and data transmission is carried out based on CAN bus technology between downhole and uphole.The chip models used in the two data transmission modules are CC2530 and STM32F103BET6 respectively.In terms of software program; the work flow of coordinator node; routing node and terminal node in ZigBee module and the basic work flow of node 1 in CAN bus module are analyzed and researched.The system is deployed in engineering practice; and it is found that good results have been achieved after debugging and application; and it has good monitoring accuracy; which reduces the operating failure rate of the shearer by more than 20%;and the economic benefits are significant.
keywords: can bus, remote monitoring system, shearers, zigbee technology
authors: Bai Jing;Xie Xiaofei;Fu Shoufei;Xie Mingjun;Li Ting
affiliations: Equipment Management Center,Shenhua Shendong Coal Group, Department of Mining Engineering,Yulin Vocational and Technical College, Yuandatan Coal Mine,Shaanxi Zhongneng Coal Field Co.,Ltd., Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering,Shenmu Vocational and Technical College

title: Research on tension monitoring system of scraper conveyor scraper chain based on wireless network
abstract: The scraper chain in the scraper conveyor is one of the structural parts prone to failure problems.Monitoring its tension is an effective means to improve its operational stability and reliability.Taking the SGZ764-400 type scraper conveyor as the object; the tension monitoring system of the scraper chain is established; which is mainly composed of three parts; namely the tension acquisition device; the data receiving device and the proximity switch.The CC2530 is selected as the radio frequency chip of the wireless network to wirelessly transmit the collected tension data.The tension data collected by the strain gauge module needs to be processed by the amplifying module and the filtering module; and then input to the CC2530 chip through the I/O interface.The monitoring system software is divided into three levels; namely the hardware abstraction layer; the Basic RF layer and the application layer.Field tests have verified that the tension detection error of the monitoring system does not exceed 5%;and the status of the scraper chain can be monitored in real time and accurately to ensure the stable and reliable operation of the scraper conveyor.
keywords: scraper chain, scraper conveyor, tension monitoring system, wireless network
affiliations: Xin′an Coal Industry Co.,Ltd.,Zaozhuang Mining Group

title: Topology and Control Strategy of Lower Voltage Stress Single-stage Buck-boost Inverter
abstract: Traditional non-isolated inverters based on the Buck-Boost principle usually have the disadvantage of high voltage stress. A new transformerless single-stage Buck-Boost voltage source inverter topology with lower voltage stress and its control method are proposed. This topology can realize inversion in a wider input voltage range; while having lower switching device voltage stress and inductor current ripple. The topological characteristics and working mode of the inverter are analyzed; and the sequence of each switch of the inverter that can ensure the balance of the output capacitor voltage is designed. A high frequency equivalent circuit is established to analyze the high-frequency leakage current. Finally; a hardware experimental platform is built; and the proposed scheme is experimentally verified on DSP TMS320F28335 and FPGA XC6SLX9-2TQG144C digital platform. The experimental results verify the feasibility of the proposed novel topology; control method and voltage balance strategy.
keywords: buck-boost inverter, common-mode voltage, modulation, multi-level inverter, voltage stress
authors: GUO Xiaoqiang;WANG Baocheng;ZHANG Hao;CHEN Zhaowen;HUA Changchun;Josep M.GUERRERO
affiliations: Department of Electrical Engineering, Yanshan University, Department of Energy Technology, Aalborg University
