title: Global Optical Control Method of Dual-bridge Series Resonant DC/DC Converters Based on Extended Phase Shift Control
abstract: The accuracy of the dual bridge series resonant（DBSR） DC/DC converter model established based on the traditional fundamental harmonic analysis is low; which results in control errors and reduces the efficiency of the converter. In this paper; the segmental analysis method is used to set up the model of the DBSR converter under the extended phase shift（EPS） control; which can accurately describe the characteristics of the converter. The backflow power and switching loss of the converter under the traditional single-phase shift control are relatively large; which leads to the reduction of the efficiency of the converter. In this paper; a global optimization control method based on EPS control is proposed; which can effectively reduce the backflow power and switching losses.First; the principle of backflow power of the DBSR converter is analyzed; and the optimal control model of backflow power is set up. Then; the global optimal control algorithm of the DBSR converter is established by combining soft-switching conditions and considering the complete soft-switching characteristics under dead time. Finally; on the physical experimental platform based on the TMS320F28335 controller;the experimental comparison between the proposed method and the traditional method is carried out under the wide voltage gain and the full power range. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional fundamental harmonic analysis; the proposed modeling method has higher accuracy;and the proposed optimal control method can effectively reduce the backflow power; significantly reduce the switching loss of the converter; and greatly improve the transmission efficiency.
keywords: backflow power, dual bridge series resonant dc/dc converter, extended phase shift （eps） control, soft switching, transmission efficiency
authors: YIN Shuai;SONG Wensheng;CHEN Jian;DENG Yaru;FENG Xiaoyun
affiliations: School of Electrical Engineering,Southwest Jiaotong University

title: Automatic Control System of Electronic Measuring Device Based on Wireless Sensing Technology
abstract: In order to meet the high-precision measurement requirements of electronic measurement devices;an automatic control system for electronic measurement devices based on wireless sensing technology is designed. The data acquisition layer of the system utilizes sensors to collect the operating signals of electronic measuring devices. The CC2530 chip is selected as the communication core chip in the network layer;and the ZigBee coordinator is used to design wireless sensor network node software to manage and maintain wireless sensor nodes and transmit data to the control layer. The control layer selects the S3C44B0X microprocessor as the control chip;controls the automatic control module to run the PID control algorithm;automatically controls the electronic measurement device;and displays the control results to the user using the human-machine interaction module in the application layer. The test results indicate that the designed system can automatically control different types of electronic measuring devices;reducing the measurement error to 0.4%.
keywords: automatic control system, coordinator, electronic measuring device, microprocessor, pid control, wireless sensing technology
affiliations: School of Electronic Information and Computer Engineering,Sichuan Institute of Industrial Technology

title: Research on Monitoring and Early Warning Technology of Geological Hazards Based on MEMS+ZigBee
abstract: In order to achieve intelligent and real-time geological hazard monitoring;improve the accuracy and applicability of monitoring means;and reduce monitoring costs;a geological hazard monitoring and early warning system is built based on MPU-6050 MEMS acceleration sensor and CC2530 ZigBee wireless communication processor;which can realize real-time dynamic intelligent monitoring of multiple parameters such as displacement;inclination;temperature and humidity. The monitoring errors are only 1.5%;1.4% and 2.22%. In order to achieve high data transmission reliability and accuracy;ZigBee node distance should be controlled within 50 m;the average packet loss rate of the system is only 0.83%;and the average signal strength reaches 35.5 dBm. By setting early warning thresholds at all levels and accessing historical data;staff can conduct real-time;accurate and comprehensive research and judgment on geological disasters;and timely formulate prevention and emergency plans to prevent geological disasters from occurring or causing significant personnel and property losses.
keywords: geological hazard, mems acceleration sensor, monitoring and early warning system, threshold, zig bee wireless communication technology
affiliations: Hubei Provincial Geological Environment General Station

title: The Indoor Environmental Monitoring System Based on the OneNET Cloud Platform
abstract: With the development of Internet of Things; blockchain; big data and artificial intelligence; the environmental monitoring industry is booming. However; at present; lots of environmental infrastructure has the regret of simplicity; oldness and lacking modernization. In order to obtain more efficiently and accurately all kinds of information of the current indoor environment; and achieve the accurate monitoring of environmental information; we design a kind of indoor environmental monitoring system based on the OneNET cloud platform. This system adopts the ZigBee development board; takes the CC2530 chip as the core of data processing to realize the wireless transmission of data; and realizes the intelligent monitoring and automatic control of indoor environment based on multi-source perception nodes through the technologies of intelligent perception and storage; and the multidimensional data fusion of computation and indoor environment.
keywords: indoor environmental monitoring, internet of things, onenet cloud platform, zigbee wireless communication
affiliations: School of Information Engineering, Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University

title: Design of Mine Safety System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: This paper is based on the internet of things technology and designs a mine safety system; aiming to achieve realtime monitoring and data transmission of the mine environment and worker status. The system consists of a node section and a coordinator section. In the node section; STC89C52 microcontroller is used as the main control chip; combined with MQ-2 gas sensor; DS18B20 temperature sensor; and pyroelectric sensor; to achieve data acquisition and real-time monitoring functions. Node devices communicate with the coordinator through IoT technology and transmit the collected data to the coordinator. The coordinator part uses CC2530 as the main control chip; combined with Zigbee module; OLED display screen; and CH430 chip; to achieve data reception; processing; and transmission functions. The coordinator interacts with node devices through wireless communication and transmits the data to the upper computer PC. The upper computer software uses the LABVIEW development environment to achieve data reception; processing; visual display; and alarm functions. This system provides strong support for the safety production and emergency response of the mine by monitoring the internal environment of the mine and the status of miners in real-time; provides a new solution for mine safety management; and has the advantages of real-time; stability; and reliability.
keywords: gas monitoring, internet of things, mine safety, safety equipment
affiliations: Departmnent of Electrical and Control Engineening, Shanxi Energy College

title: Design of Intelligent Control and Protection System for Local Ventilator in Coal Mine
abstract: Local fans play an important role in ensuring the safety of coal mines. Taking Y7-11 local ventilator in coal mine as the research object; an intelligent control and protection system is designed based on TMS320F28335 chip. The system has two major functions: fan comprehensive protection and intelligent speed control. The system software program is based on modular design and consists of a main program and multiple subprograms. Each subprogram has specific functions. The main program circulates; interrupts and calls the subroutine operation as needed to realize the overall function of the system. After one year of practical application; the intelligent control and protection system has achieved the expected effect; reducing the failure rate and energy consumption of local fans by about 16% and 20% respectively; and producing good safety and economic benefits.
keywords: intelligent control, local ventilator, protection system, tms320f28335 chip
affiliations: Shanxi Ningwu Dayunhuasheng Nangou Coal Industry Co., Ltd.

title: Consistency Verification System of Heterogeneous Data Transmission Based on Migration Learning
abstract: In order to shorten the data verification time; this paper designs a heterogeneous data consistency verification system based on migration learning. Firstly; the system memory is optimized. TMS320LF2407 chip is selected as the core chip of communication controller interface circuit. Then; according to the results of system hardware optimization; the core circuit is reorganized. A data classification method based on transfer learning is proposed; and the consistency verification of heterogeneous data transmitted over the network is realized according to the principle of function dependence and the processed data. The test results show that the basic functions and performance of the system meet the current requirements and can be put into use.
keywords: data classification, data consistency detection, heterogeneous database, transfer learning algorithm
affiliations: Information Center of GuiZhou Power Grid Co., Ltd.

title: Design of Embedded DSP Control System for Ultrasonic Scalpel Energy Generator
abstract: In the working process of ultrasonic scalpel; there are high requirements for the real-time and stability of the energy generator control system. Aiming at these requirements; a control system of ultrasonic scalpel energy generator based on DSP is designed. The system takes TMS320F28377D with main frequency of 200 MHz as the main control chip; and controls the power supply circuit; drive circuit; feedback circuit and man-machine interaction system through ePWM module; IIC module; SPI module and SCI module of the chip; and generate sinusoidal AC signals that drive the ultrasonic scalpel to work. Then; the control law accelerator CLA is called to carry out non-periodic sampling algorithm and PID control algorithm to complete the closed-loop control of the whole energy generator system. Compared with the MCU control system whose data operation and control functions are all completed by CPU; the control system using CPU and CLA together has faster operation speed and shorter control cycle. The power control strategy of constant output current is adopted to maximize the stability of the ultrasonic scalpel; and the parameters such as current signal and voltage signal of the system are displayed on the screen in real time.
keywords: control system, dsp, embedded system, energy generator, ultrasonic scalpel
authors: ZHAO Haonan;LIN Xiaojia;CHEN Xiaohong;SUN Fujia;HUANG Yongguo
affiliations: School of Materials and Chemistry, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, School of Health Science and Engineering, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

title: Access Control Cystem Design Based on ZigBee Wireless Control
abstract: The design of this access control system is based on the cross-fertilization of computer technology; ZigBee wireless network technology and single-chip microcomputer; etc. The real-time status of the electronic combination lock is sent to the host computer through the ZigBee terminal node and the coordinator; and the host computer records and manages the sent data and controls the electronic combination lock accordingly. The system is mainly composed of CC2530 transmission processing module; STC15 microcontroller module（including the minimum system circuit）; optocoupler isolation relay module; 4×3 matrix keypad; OLED display module; buzzer alarm module; etc. By switching the relay module to simulate the state of the access control lock; the ZigBee terminal node of electronic combination lock based on the relay control is constructed. The system is designed with complete functions and has good expandability and applicability.
keywords: access control system, cc2530, microcontroller, wireless network, zigbee
affiliations: Petro China Lanzhou Petrochemical Company, Lanzhou Petrochemical University of Vocational Technology

title: Research on the Application of the Noise Monitoring System Along the Railway Track Based on Real-time Data Acquisition and Processing
abstract: In order to solve the problem of whether the environmental noise along the railway exceeds the standard; a noise monitoring system along the railway has been designed that can achieve the integration of noise data acquisition; A/D conversion; Ethernet transmission; algorithm processing; data storage; and interface monitoring. The system uses ADS1256; TMS320VC5509; and ADR4525 chips to complete system signal conditioning; signal conversion; and signal processing; and completes data network transmission to the OneNet cloud through the Ethernet module W5500. The upper computer of the system uses VS.NET and C # to achieve cloud data reading; and the lower computer implements DPS data processing through the CCS6 environment and C program. The system test shows that the data acquisition accuracy is 0.2 level; and the maximum frequency division vibration level and Z vibration level values are used as noise research and judgment indicators to meet the system monitoring purpose.
keywords: a/d conversion, data processing, ethernet, onenet cloud platform
affiliations: School of Information Engineering,Zhengzhou University of Industry Technology

title: Landslide Geological Hazard Monitoring and Early Warning System Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor
abstract: In order to reduce the safety risk of landslide geological hazards to railway operation;a landslide geological hazard monitoring and early warning system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network is designed.The system mainly includes laser sensor wireless data acquisition terminal layer;wireless data aggregation layer;4G transmission network layer and ground monitoring center.The system hardware circuit design mainly includes the main control CC2530 circuit connection design;the laser range sensor circuit connection design and the RS484communication bus circuit connection design;The system software mainly includes coordinator software flow;terminal node software flow and Modbus RTU data packet format design.The system test shows that when the network node is deployed within 70m;the packet loss rate of the system can be controlled within 5%for stable operation.
keywords: coordinator, lasersensor, monitoringandearlywarning, terminalnode
affiliations: School of Information Engineering,Zhengzhou University of Industrial Technology

title: Contactless Intelligent Delivery Car Based on OpenMV
abstract: A new type of intelligent delivery device has been designed to meet the needs of hospitals; hotels; restaurants; and other places that require "contactless delivery"; providing a safer; more efficient; and accurate service for the logistics industry. The system is controlled by an STM32 microcontroller and equipped with an OpenMV image recognition module; TSL1401 linear CCD module; HX711 weight sensor module; and 2.4G ZigB ee CC2530 serial wireless transmission and reception module. Two OpenMV modules recognize the location information; and the TSL1401 linear CCD module in front and rear of the small car; together with the white light strip; realize the forward and backward tracking function. The 2.4G ZigBee serial wireless module realizes communication between delivery vehicles; and the HX711 electronic scale module obtains the weight of the delivered items. Experimental testing has shown that this contactless delivery device achieves a more efficient; accurate; safe; and convenient delivery method; with good system stability.
keywords: contactless delivery, openmv, pid, tsl1401 line tracking
affiliations: Keyi College of Zhejiang Sci-tech University

title: Design of Intelligent Medicine Delivery Trolley
abstract: Aiming at the demand of the medical industry that is developing towards intelligence and automation; an intelligent medical delivery trolley system based on STM32F103RCT6 is designed. The system is powered by three 18650 lithium batteries; Through the Open MV image recognition module; the ward number is identified; The trail of the trolley is realized through the TSL1401 linear linear CCD module; Read the real-time weight of pharmaceutical products through the HX711 load cell module; Through the 2.4G Zigbee CC2530 serial port wireless transceiver module to realize the communication of the two cars; Through 0.96-inch OLED display the identified ward number and round-trip time;etc. The practice shows that the system has good performance; high reliability and certain application value.
keywords: intelligent medicine delivery trolley, linear array ccd module, open mv, wireless transceiver module
affiliations: Soft Video Software (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd., Keyi College of Zhejiang Sci-Tech University

title: Research on Personnel Positioning System of Underground Roadway Based on ZigBee
abstract: Traditional underground personnel positioning technology（such as RFID positioning） has problems such as large positioning error; high cost; and difficult wiring. Therefore; a ZigBee based underground roadway personnel positioning system is designed based on comprehensive considerations such as environmental adaptability; cost and energy consumption; and positioning accuracy. The system uses CC2530 as a positioning module; and a Mesh network with ZigBee protocol as the core as a transmission method; thereby achieving the function of real-time monitoring the location of underground personnel. Firstly; a Kalman filtering algorithm is used to process the received RSSI value. Then threshold optimization of the RSSI value is followed; which is uploaded to the monitoring management center through the transmission system. Finally; a triangular weighted centroid algorithm is used to solve and locate unknown nodes. An improved RSSI algorithm is proposed for this positioning system. Simulation results show that the algorithm improves positioning accuracy by about 70%; and does not depend on the number of anchor nodes; having better application value.
keywords: kalman filtering, personnel positioning, rssi, threshold optimization, zigbee
authors: LIU Xiang;XIA Shujuan;ZHANG Yue;LI Chenchen;WANG Xude;MIAO Shuguang
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information, Huaibei Normal University
source: Journal of Luoyang Institute of Science and Technology(Natural Science Edition).

title: Design and implementation of a compact microwave synthesizer for atomic interference gravimeter
abstract: In atom interferometer gravity experiments;Raman laser preparation commonly uses an optical phase-locked loop method;in which the master and slave laser beat signal is mixed with a 6.8 GHz microwave signal source firstly;then frequency discrimination is performed with direct digital frequency synthesis signal generator;and lastly the feedback signal obtained is used to control the low-noise Raman optical output.So the phase noise of Raman output will directly affect the sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter.This design uses the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller to program and control the LMX2594 digital phase-locked loop chip;and obtains a 6.8 GHz microwave signal source through the phase-locked loop frequency synthesis technology.The final experimental results show that the phase noise of the microwave signal source is 65.2 dB@1 Hz;and-95.3 dB@1 kHz;Allan deviation （ADEV） is2.72×10-11@1 s;and the output power is greater than 10 dBm.When the pulse interval time （T） is 100ms;influence of signal source on sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter is 8×10-8 m/s~2/Hz1/2;and on the resolution of the atom interference gravimeter is 2×10-8 g@600 s.It is shown that the design has the advantages of high frequency stability and low phase noise;which can meet the requirements of microwave reference sources for atom interferometer.
keywords: atom interference gravimeter, microwave signal source, phase noise, phaselooked loop, quantum optics
affiliations: National Key Laboratory of Science and Technology on Metrology and Calibration, Changcheng Institute of Metrology and Measurement

title: Transformer inrush current simulation modeling and magnetic inrush current identification and suppression
abstract: This research applies simulation modeling based on the internal structure of the single-phase transformer; identifies and inhibits the data; analyzes the change of the magnetic flux ratio in the transformer and the dynamic process during closing; establishes a single-phase transformer simulation model; designs a transformer magnetizing inrush current suppression system.By using TMS320F2812 main controller; TV31B02 voltage transfermer and TA21A11 current transfermer in sampling module; the transfermer current and voltage were transfered into optimal signals.Experiments showed that the identification error of the magnetizing inrush current identification method in this study was the smallest; and the maximum value of the magnetizing inrush current generated after using the suppression system was 15.2A;which was only twice the rated current.
keywords: inhibition system, inrush current, sliding data window, the wavelet entropy, transformer simulation
affiliations: State Grid East Inner Mongolia Electric Power Supply Co.,Ltd., NARI Group Corporation, NARI Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: 基于RFID技术的变电站设备运行状态实时监测系统
abstract: 针对现有监测系统无法正确监测设备运转，容易出现误差、漏查等问题，提出并设计了一种基于RFID的变电站设备运行状态在线监测系统。该方法首先基于AE-S微型高频动态控制传感器和TMS320C6474设备控制执行器完成设备硬件环境的搭建，其次以此为基础，运用RFID技术完成数据的实时采集，再次引入多层GRU预测模型来提高对特征信息的提取，采用三层网络GRU网络模型提高预测精度，最后基于小波分解完成对变电站运行状态的实时监测。实验结果表明，应用该方法异常监测准确率均高于95.8%，优于对比方法。由此可证明，采用该方法可对变电站设备进行准确监测，具有较好的监测效果。
keywords: rfid技术, 变电站监测, 变电站设备, 实时监测系统
affiliations: 国网北京市电力公司检修分公司

title: Design and application effect analysis of typical intelligent irrigation system in Gansu Yindaruqin irrigation area
abstract: 针对甘肃中部地区农田灌溉水肥利用效率低，智慧化和信息化程度低的问题，文章开展基于引大灌区现状的典型智慧灌溉系统设计，并通过典型经济作物娃娃菜田间试验，对比分析该系统应用效果。智慧灌溉系统主要采用可编程逻辑控制器（Programmable Logic Controller简称PLC）对田间灌溉设备控制，采用CC2530无线模块将田间传感器数据传送至PLC中进行处理后将各项数据传送至云平台；该系统较传统灌溉提高娃娃菜产量1.8万kg/hm~2;节水4695m~3/hm~2;节省肥料990kg/hm~2;节省人工费用7500元/hm~2;经济效益、社会效益、生态效益明显，为该系统在甘肃中部地区的推广应用提供了理论和实践依据。
keywords: plc, 云平台, 应用效果分析, 智慧灌溉系统

title: Research on a New High Power Induction Heating System
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low power; low efficiency and uneven heating of metal bars in the traditional single power supply system in the casting industry; a new LLC resonant system is designed in this paper. TMS320F28335 is selected as the main control circuit to generate low-frequency SPWM signals and temperature closed-loop. EMP57079100C5N chip is selected to deal with hardware circuit faults. Before building a small system test algorithm in the laboratory; MATLAB/Simulink is used for theoretical simulation. Finally; it is measured in the factory that when the workpiece is heated to more than 800 ℃; the power factor can reach 0.97. This new induction heating system has been preliminarily verified; which has high power and efficiency; and can also heat metals gradiently.
keywords: induction heating, inverter, metal processing
affiliations: School of Electrical ＆ Information Engineering, HuBei University of Automotive Technology

title: Design of Intelligent Protector for Coal Mine Ground Main Ventilation
abstract: In view of the problems of low intelligence level and poor real-time performance existing in the coal mine ground main ventilation system; an intelligent protector for coal mine ground main ventilation is designed based on TMS320F28335 chip. The functional design and software and hardware scheme design of the intelligent protector for main ventilation are analyzed; and experimental verification is completed. The results show that the designed intelligent protector for coal mine ground main ventilation improves the intelligence level of the main ventilation system; improves the real-time performance of protection actions; and helps to enhance the safety production coefficient of coal mines.
keywords: frequency control, intelligent protector, main ventilation system, sensor, tms320f28335
affiliations: Shanxi Coking Coal Group Co., Ltd.,Dongqu Coal Mine

title: Design of High Reliability Mine Fluid Leakage Monitoring System Based on Optical Fiber Sensor
abstract: With the continuous extension of mine mining; hydrogeological conditions are increasingly complex; and water exploration and release operations are frequent. In the process of operation; orifice pipe leakage often occurs; which directly affects the safety of mine production in serious cases. Based on this; proposed the design of high reliability mine fluid leakage monitoring system based on optical fiber sensor. The system adopts node-oriented design; each node selects optical fiber liquid leakage sensor as the front-end sensing layer; CC3200 wireless communication module as the intermediate data transmission layer; and wireless liquid leakage monitoring host computer as the back-end data analysis and liquid leakage event early warning and monitoring layer; so as to carry out real-time warning and monitoring of liquid leakage in high precision positioning of working pipelines during the water exploration and release task. The experimental results show that each node can provide early warning; real-time monitoring and accurate identification of the liquid leakage position; and the positioning accuracy reaches 0.01 m.
keywords: cc3200, event warning, fiber distributed sensing, highly reliable mine machinery
affiliations: CCTEG Taiyuan Research Institute Co., Ltd., Shanxi Tiandi Coal Mining Machinery Co.,Ltd., National Engineering Laboratory for Coal Mining Machinery

title: Design of Wireless Control System of "Exploration Is Necessary Before Digging" Overloaded Power Outage Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Proposed a wireless control system of "exploration is necessary before digging" over loaded power outage based on ZigBee technology. This system takes ZigBee wireless chip CC2530 as the core control device; uses lithium battery power supply; and consists of two units; such as ranging processing and sending device; and signal receiving and power outage control device. The test proves that this system has reliable communication and sensitive action.
keywords: exploration is necessary before digging, overloaded power outage, wireless control
affiliations: Zhengzhou Coal Mine Machinery Group Co., Ltd., China Coal Research Institute

title: Research and Design of Wireless Control System for Mining Negative Pressure Dust Removal Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Proposed a wireless control system for mining negative pressure dust removal based on ZigBee technology. This system uses ZigBee wireless chip CC2530 as the core control device; uses lithium battery power supply mode; composed of dust sensor; infrared sensor; voltage/frequency conversion unit; wireless transmission unit; 3×3 keyboard and LCD screen. The experiment proves that this system has reliable communication and quick action.
keywords: negative pressure dust removal, wireless control, zigbee technology
affiliations: Zhengzhou Coal Mine Machinery Group Co., Ltd., China Coal Research Institute

title: Research on intelligent control system for local ventilator in comprehensively-mining work face
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as low intelligent level of the local ventilation system on the comprehensively-mining work face and the prominent phenomenon of "one-time gas exhaust"; the paper researched the intelligent control system for the local ventilator based on TMS320F28335 controller; and applied the fuzzy control and the frequency conversion speed regulation technology to realize the intelligent control system for the local ventilator in combination with gas exhaust characteristic on the comprehensivelymining work face and the local ventilation theory. Meanwhile; the human-machine interface of the intelligent control system for the local ventilator was designed; and test verification and trial operation were completed.The results showed the intelligent control system for the local ventilator greatly enhanced the intelligent level of the ventilation monitoring system on the comprehensively-mining work face; realized the adaptive speed regulation; achieved the purpose of energy saving and consumption reduction; and guaranteed the safe; reliable and stable operation of the local ventilation system.
keywords: comprehensively-mining work face, control system, frequency conversion speed regulation, fuzzy controller, local ventilator
affiliations: CCTEG Taiyuan Research Institute Co.,Ltd., China National Engineering Laboratory for Coal Mining Machinery, Shanxi Tiandi Coal Mining Machinery Co.,Ltd.

title: Design and Implementation of Analog Signal Distortion Measurement Device
abstract: Signal processing technology is particularly important in the design and application of electronic fields. Signals are affected by environment; transmission network working status and application components parameters in open and closed loop transmission process; causing the original signal characteristics to change and signal distortion problems. A signal distortion measurement device based on TMS320F28335 platform is designed. Firstly; the input signal is converted to the sampling range allowed by the analog to digital converter（ADC） through operational amplifier circuit and offset circuit. Then; the normalized amplitude of fundamental wave and harmonics is obtained by fast Fourier transform algorithm（FFT）. Frequency domain analysis is used to calculate the distortion of signal sampling data. At the same time; the detection results can be synchronized displayed on the touch screen and mobile APP;which enhances the practical application. Finally; the experimental test results show that the measurement error of the signal distortion measurement device reaches 0.7%; and it has good real-time and stability.
keywords: digital signal processing, fast fourier transform, signal distortion, total harmonic distortion
affiliations: College of Vocational and Technical Teacher Education,Shanghai Polytechnic University, School of Energy Engineering, Xinjiang Institute of Engineering, School of Intelligent Manufacturing and Control,Shanghai Polytechnic University

title: Greenbelt Irrigation System Based on ZigBee Wireless Senso Network
abstract: Designed by the wireless sensor nodes; routing nodes; the controller node of wireless sensor network based on ZigBee technology of water-saving green space automatic irrigation system. Sensor nodes is based CC253O built Soil Moisture and Temperature Acquisition System. Temperature and humidity data from the sensor nodes in wireless way by routing node are sent to the controller; So as to realize the automatic data collection and monitoring of temperature and humidity data. Developed a winter; spring and autumn; summer;three kinds of irrigation mode according to the temperature data; With C language to program embedded controller node; implements data acquisition and transmission to irrigation control run independently working mode. System has simple structure; low cost; save the PC monitoring and personnel operation; are completely independent operation; implement the design of water-saving and unattended.
keywords: cc2530, irrigation control, wireless sensor networks, zigbee
affiliations: Shandong Hejian Construction Group Co., Ltd, Engineering training center of Shandong University

title: TMS320C6678多核DSP高可靠数据处理方法
abstract: 针对高性能数字信号处理器被广泛应用到航天信号处理系统，空天辐照环境的单粒子翻转效应可能造成数字信号处理器（digital signal processing; DSP）电路逻辑功能混乱、计算机指令流发生混乱导致程序“跑飞”或“死机”的问题，提供了一种主从多核DSP高可靠数据处理方法。首先，通过定时器判断计算核是否处理异常；其次，能够在计算核并行处理超时异常时，触发定时器中断对各个计算核进行软复位，恢复系统正常处理。实验表明计算核处理异常导致计算超时，主核可以将计算核从异常状态中恢复正常运行。
keywords: ipc, 单粒子翻转, 软件复位, 高可靠

title: Design of Intelligent Depth Monitoring System for Wireline Logging
abstract: According to the requirements of wireline logging for depth accuracy and reliability; this paper designs and develops a set of intelligent wireline logging depth monitoring system to realize the functions of depth detection; recording; real-time data analysis and depth abnormal alarm in the process of wireline logging and maintenance. The intelligent monitoring system takes TMS320F2812 as the control core; combined with the stepping motor control; to realize the depth processing and monitoring of the field operation; as well as the detection of the depth encoder in the maintenance process; and to realize the real-time data recording and analysis playback in the monitoring process. The intelligent monitoring system can be easily connected to the existing logging surface system and run independently; which greatly ensures the accuracy of wireline logging depth. The system has been successfully applied in the field and maintenance work; and is stable and reliable.
keywords: depth, intelligent monitoring, labwindows/cvi, stepping motor, wireline logging
affiliations: Oilfield Technology Division,China Oil Field Service Limited

title: Research on hardware in the loop experimental platform for vector control of vehicle asynchronous motor
abstract: In order to reduce the research and development cost of the vehicle asynchronous motor control system; shorten the development cycle; and improve the development efficiency; this work designs a closed-loop control experimental platform for the vehicle asynchronous motor based on the TMS320F28335 micro-controller and the field oriented control（FOC） algorithm. The experimental platform realized code generation through the seamless connection between MATLAB/Simulink and TI series digital signal processing（DSP） development board; and thus eliminated complex C language code writing. The program-generated code was automatically loaded into the microprocessor TMS320F28335 development board through CCS6.2 software to control the operation of vehicle asynchronous motor; and Labview software was used to monitor the operation data of vehicle asynchronous motor system in real time and modify it online. The experimental results show that the experimental platform can realize the performance test of vehicle asynchronous motor vector control system; effectively shorten the development cycle of asynchronous motor controller; improve the system development efficiency; and save the development cost.
keywords: asynchronous motor, c language, digital signal processing（dsp）, matlab/simulink, vector control
affiliations: School of Electrical Engineering, Shaoyang University, Hunan Provincial Key Laboratory of Grids Operation and Control on Multi-power Sources Area Shaoyang University, Shaoyang Zishui Technology Co., Ltd.
source: Journal of Shaoyang University(Natural Science Edition).

title: Design of DSP “Pocket Lab” Engineering Practice
abstract: In view of the lack of experimental class hours and long practice period of students under the traditional DSP course learning mode; the learning effect is low. As an important course emphasizing the ability of practice; the “Pocket Lab” of DSP can effectively expand students’ experimental places. A DSP “Pocket Lab” based on TI company’s TMS320F28335 chip as the core controller is designed to solve the problem; which integrates the simulator; provides expansion modules to realize low-voltage two-level inverter; and realizes the hardware support of three-phase current reconstruction experiment based on single resistor current sampling. By using the “Pocket Lab”; students can combine the theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom with practice; shorten the interval from theoretical learning to practice; and improve their teaching effect.
keywords: current reconstruction, dsp “pocket lab”, module expansion, single resistor current sampling
authors: YU Dongsheng;YE Zongbin;TAO Mengjiang;CHEN Zhiguo;DENG Xianming
affiliations: State Grid Anhui Ultra High Voltage Co., Ltd., School of Electrical Engineering, China University of Mining and Technology

title: Design of Motor Vector Control Experiment Based on Improved Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: An improved linear active disturbance rejection vector control experimental platform for three-phase motor based on TMS320F28379D is designed for high precision AC motor vector control experiment. Dual-core DSP chip is taken as the control core; and the system clock frequency is 200 MHz. High integration intelligent power module is adopted to drive motor; optocoupler isolation drive is not needed. The speed and position information of the motor are measured by using the resolver; which can achieve 16-bit high-precision measurement with the decoder chip. In terms of control algorithm; based on the traditional linear ADRC algorithm; the disturbance feedback channel is changed and a low-pass filter is added to the error feedback channel; and then an improved linear ADRC algorithm is proposed and verified by physical experiments. Compared to the classical PI and linear ADRC; the response velocity of the improved algorithm driven by the unit step signal is increased by 25% and 18%; the speed drop affected by the instantaneous disturbance is reduced 4 times and 2 times; and the speed recovery time is reduced by 85% and 70%; respectively; which greatly improves the dynamic and static characteristics of the system.
keywords: active disturbance rejection control（adrc）, digital signal processor（dsp）, intelligent power module（ipm）, vector control
affiliations: College of Electrical Engineering and Automation, Shandong University of Science and Technology

title: Experiment design and verification of finite-time stabilization control
abstract: The past two decades have witnessed the development of finite-time stabilization as a hot spot in control area. Using the technique of finite-time stabilization; control system or observer can be designed such that the system error or estimation error converges to zero in finite time. This property is valuable for mission-critical systems with stringent time specification. This paper takes the permanent magnet synchronous AC motor; which has been widely used in industrial servo systems; as the target system for control. In the field-oriented framework;position servo controllers are designed for motor position-speed loop; using a combination of finite-time control law and finite-time observer. Comparison will be made with a conventional controller which only achieves asymptotic convergence. An experimental test-bench is established using a TMS320F28335 digital signal processor;and experiment results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the designs. The comprehensive experiments is adopted in the undergraduate module of computer control system practice and the graduate modules of control engineering; which can help students appreciate the potential of advanced control techniques; and inspire on them the desire for creativity.
keywords: finite-time stabilization, fractional power function, nonlinear control, servomotor, test-bench
affiliations: College of Electrical Engineering and Automation, Fuzhou University

title: System Design of Turbine While Drilling Simulator
abstract: Turbogenerator has become a standard configuration for downhole measurement while drilling（MWD） technology. To ensure its reliable work; taking turbine characteristics as the research object; a Simulink model with permanent magnet synchromotor as the main component of the turbine while drilling simulator was built to conduct simulation design and research on the MWD turbogenerator system and its operating characteristics. The research results show that a permanent magnet synchromotor control simulation system with TMS320F28335 as the core has been built; Simulink model and system have been tested under different flow rates; and the output performance of the motor at different flow rates is consistent with the characteristics of the turbine; completing the DC motor and DSP based turbine simulator design; by means of comparing the output characteristics of the DC motor and turbine model; the measurement in the test shows that when the input flow rate is 5 to 11 L/s; the output characteristics of the turbine are well reflected; thus verifying the correctness of the turbine simulator. The research conclusions provide a reference for subsequent research on turbines and have guiding significance for field operations.
keywords: input flow rate, measurement while drilling techndogy, simulink model, turbine output characteristics, turbine simulator
affiliations: School of Electronic Engineering,Xi’an Shiyou University, Directional Drilling Branch,CNOOC Key Laboratory of Well Logging and Directional Drilling

title: 基于ZigBee的室内指纹定位算法应用
abstract: 随着科学技术的快速发展，人们对于定位的需求也随之增加，但室内定位发展尚不成熟。针对目前室内定位的精准度以及成本过高问题，设计一种基于ZigBee的物联网室内定位系统。采用CC2530芯片模块作为无线通信设备，通过ZigBee技术采集定位区域内的各个参考节点的接收信号强度值（RSSI），建立离线指纹库；再利用欧氏距离公式计算出与离线指纹库中差距最小的3组数据，最后根据三边测量法计算出未知节点的坐标，实现室内定位功能。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 三边测量法, 室内定位, 指纹定位, 接收信号强度值, 物联网定位
authors: 张瑞年;时子皓;高常青;王国锋
affiliations: 济南大学山东交通学院

title: 基于物联网的智能农业温室大棚监测系统
abstract: 针对目前传统农业模式需要花费大量人力物力进行农作物生长环境监测等问题，为了实现农作物生长环境数据的实时远程监测，提出一种基于物联网的智能农业温室大棚监测系统。利用Zig Bee通信模块和CC2530控制模块，实现了对农业温室大棚内多种环境数据的智能实时监测，以及对农业大棚内部环境的远程控制和智能管理。
keywords: zigbee, 农业大棚, 温室大棚, 温湿度传感器, 物联网, 监测技术
authors: 尤达;陈雷;郭登宇;苗君臣;涂德宇;王艺涵;王睿昊
affiliations: 安徽理工大学电气与信息工程学院

title: 基于STM32F103的智慧大棚无线温度传感器节点设计
abstract: 针对智慧大棚复杂环境温度采集网络难覆盖的问题，文中设计了基于STM32的智慧大棚无线温度传感器节点系统，系统以STM32F103为核心，包括主控模块、数据采集模块、无线传感器模块以及电源模块。其实现原理是通过DS18B20采集数据，利用CC2530搭设的无线传感网络将数据传输至STM32F103进行处理，同时将数据传送至PC端或者移动终端设备，方便用户实现远程控制。实验结果表明，该系统在处理功耗、通信质量等方面均优于传统系统。
keywords: cc2530, ds18b20, stm32f103, 无线传感器网络, 智慧大棚, 温度
affiliations: 徐州工程学院

title: 基于物联网的智能婴儿床远程监控系统
abstract: 随着物联网技术的快速发展，传统的婴儿床也经历了智能化与网络化的新变革，但目前市面上的智能婴儿床功能较为简单，只有音乐播放、哄睡等功能，缺少针对孩子睡眠情况、是否尿床以及是否存在掉床风险的监测。本系统就上述问题开发了基于物联网的智能婴儿床远程监控系统，采用传感器采集技术和CC2530主控芯片构建信息采集模块（尿湿检测模块、掉床检测模块、啼哭检测模块、空气质量检测模块），利用ZigBee自组网功能将婴儿床的实时数据接入云平台存储，设计了相应的网页界面对数据进行监测，通过邮件下发通知实现了对智能婴儿床的实时有效监控。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 云平台, 传感器, 智能婴儿床, 物联网
affiliations: 中国电子技术标准化研究院安徽理工大学中国联合网络通信有限公司安徽省分公司

title: 基于ZigBee技术的农业大棚环境监测控制系统设计
abstract: 我国设施农业起步较晚，温室大棚等农业设施存在功能单一、智能化程度低、光照不足、通风不良等问题。针对温室大棚存在的不足与局限性，以无线通信技术ZigBee为基础，设计了一套农业大棚环境监测控制系统。该系统由ZigBee无线传输模块、CC2530控制平台、基于窄带物联网（Narrow Band Internet of Things;NB-IoT）的阿里云物联网云监控模块、传感器数据采集模块等组成，可通过阿里云平台显示大棚内各种传感器监测到的数据，控制大棚内风扇、水泵、补光灯等设备工作，使温室大棚内各种参数保持在正常范围。该系统具有实时性好、耗能低、传输距离远、操作方便等优点，实用价值较高，可为智能农业大棚的设计提供参考。
keywords: zigbee技术, 传感器, 智能农业大棚, 物联网
affiliations: 南宁科泰机械设备有限公司广西农业职业技术大学

title: Design and Implementation of EMIF Communication System Based on DSP+FPGA
abstract: Digital Signal Process（DSP）+Field Program Gate Way（FPGA）is widely used in complex digital signal processing fields. Aiming at the problems of limited performance and inflexibility of DSP and FPGA single processor;a system design scheme of DSP+FPGA architecture is proposed. Based on the External Memory Interface（EMIF）of TMS320C6748 （DSP）and EP3C40Q240C8N （FPGA）chips;a DSP+FPGA collaborative processing system is implemented. The system makes use of the advantages of FPGA in the underlying algorithm and DSP in the complex algorithm;it has flexible hardware structure;strong versatility;and improves the system performance compared with a single chip. After testing;the system runs stably;and the communication rate can reach 20MB/s without error.
keywords: dsp, emif, fpga, high speed communication
affiliations: School of Information and Communication,Guilin University of Electronic Science and Technology, Xinjiang Key Laboratory for Luminescence Minerals and Optical Functional Materials,School of Physics and Electronic Engineering,Xinjiang Normal University
source: Journal of Xinjiang Normal University(Natural Sciences Edition).

title: Design of High-Performance Closed-Loop Driver System for Two-Phase Hybrid Stepper Motor
abstract: Based on the research of traditional open-loop subdivision drive and control algorithm of the stepper motor; a position plus current closed-loop drive scheme is proposed with an encoder for stepper motor leading angle control. When different traditional open-loop subdivisions drive; the given current phase angle is independent of the rotor position. The closed-loop drive scheme uses an encoder to detect the actual position of the rotor and calculate the position error and the velocity error information to adjust the current phase angle given by the current subdivision in real time; thereby improving the working performance of the stepper motor at different speeds. Using TI’s TMS320F28069 high-performance processor with IR2104S and IRF540 as the main control unit and power drive circuit; the stepper motor position closed-loop experimental platform is built and the currents and position accuracy at different speeds are tested. The test results show that the closed-loop drive scheme can effectively improve the problems of low-speed jitter and high-speed out-of-step of the stepper motor; which works well in the speed range of 60～1200 rpm; and the position accuracy is controlled within 10 pulses. The solution has reached the level of the traditional servo motor and has good market application value.
keywords: closed-loop control, leading angle, pid control, stepper motor, subdivision drive
affiliations: Jiangsu Research and Development Center of Application Technology for Wireless Sensing System, Wuxi Vocational Institute of Commerce
source: Journal of Wuxi Vocational Institute of Commerce.

title: Design of High Rate Wireless Network System Based on Multi-channel Acquistion
abstract: In view of the problem that present industrial wireless sensor network node payload data transfer rate is slow; a high rate wireless monitoring network system based on the technology of Sub-GHz was designed; the system took ultra low power devices CC1310 as hardware core; adopted multiplex acquisition way to reduce system secondary nodes deployment.At the node physical layer; a method was proposed to expand the communication bandwidth of CC1310 chip by modifying the underlying radio frequency parameters.In the data link layer; radio frequency transmission was realized by simplifying the data frame structure and adopting direct polling access; which can improve the data transmission rate of the system while ensuring the reliability of the system.The test results show that the data transmission rate of the system can reach 377 kbps when the device node is connected with 8 sensors; which is completely suitable for industrial wireless real-time monitoring system.
keywords: cc1310, high rate, multi-channel data acquisition, wireless sensor network
affiliations: North University of China, State Key Laboratory of Electronic Measurement Technology, Key Laboratory of Instrument Science and Dynamic Measurement of Ministry of Education

title: A THREE-PHASE CURRENT SOURCE SEPIC INVERTER
abstract: This paper proposes a novel three-phase current source SEPIC inverter;which is composed of traditional three-phase bridge circuit and SEPIC circuit. The inverter can achieve buck-boost comply with the characteristics of SEPIC circuit. Meanwhile;by means of the SPWM carrier amplitude adjustable strategy;the problem which traditional current source inverter has large inductance parameter in DC side is solved;and the output waveform quality is optimized. This paper first introduces the working mode and the corresponding modulation method of the inverter;afterwards gives the mathematical formula of the voltage gain. Moreover;based on the characteristics of the circuit;the corresponding mathematical model and the closed-loop control strategy is established. Finally;the corresponding digital control platform is built by TMS320F2812 and FPGA;and the corresponding experimental verification is carried out;which verifies the feasibility of the circuit.
keywords: buck-boost, carrier amplitude adjustable, current source inverter, sepic

title: 基于ZigBee技术的轿厢禁烟排烟报警系统设计
abstract: 随着城市建筑物高度不断提升，直升梯运行时间逐渐增加，电梯运行期间轿门关闭，轿厢空间受限，电梯内如有个别乘客吸烟，会造成已经进入轿厢的其他乘客被动吸烟。由于个人乘梯习惯和身体状况各不相同，且乘客在乘坐电梯时无法预知其他人是否会吸烟，尤其是孕妇、儿童或病人等特殊群体乘坐电梯时，对于轿厢内是否有人吸烟的情况需要有相关提示信息和解决方法。本文出于对电梯运行中的乘客实际需求，设计了基于Zig Bee技术的轿厢禁烟排烟报警系统。该系统基于Zig Bee无线传输通信技术，通过MQ-2传感器模块对轿厢内烟雾浓度进行监测，利用CC2530芯片实现对轿厢内禁烟的语音提示和轿顶排风扇排烟开启、大厅候梯处亮灯报警进行无线控制，以提高乘客舒适度和安全性的乘梯体验，具有实际应用意义。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee技术, 嵌入式, 烟雾传感器
authors: 牛明霞;李丹;李丹璐;胡健;何旭中

title: Off-line Parameter Identification Method of Induction Motor Based on Gradient Descent Method
abstract: In order to address the problem of inaccurate identification of electric motor parameters resulting from the calculation of incorrect magnitude and phase of motor voltage and current during the identification process of the asynchronous propulsion motor; a gradient descent-based asynchronous motor parameter identification algorithm was proposed. By passing different voltages into the stator resistance; relevant motor sampling data that can be used to identify the stator resistance; rotor resistance; and mutual inductance of the motor are obtained. The theoretical voltage of the inverter was modified by a third-order curve fitting method; ultimately increasing the accuracy of the rotor resistance identification. By numerically fitting the waveforms of motor AC voltage and current using the gradient descent method; accurate waveform magnitude and phase were estimated; and the power factor was calculated; allowing the precise identification of motor rotor resistance; leakage inductance; and mutual inductance. An identification experiment was conducted on a 7.5 kW motor using a self-developed inverter based on TMS320F28379D; which demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in improving identification accuracy.
keywords: asynchronous motor, gradient descent method
authors: ZHANG Zhenrui;FAN Hongwei;LI Qingzhuo;SUN Guodong;ZHANG Lingyun

title: Simulation of a New Control Algorithm for Horizontal Well Traction Drive Motor Control System Based on DSP
abstract: 水平井牵引器使用无位置传感器控制的无刷直流电机（BLDCM）作为驱动电机，能够适应恶劣工作环境，在水平井牵引器领域有着广泛的应用。在实际页岩气开采工况中，电机达到一定转速后，继续升高电压会产生失步现象，针对这种情况本文提出了一种新型控制算法，使用了新的换相时刻计算及相位补偿算法，搭建了基于TMS320F28335型DSP的仿真系统实验平台。
keywords: bldc, dsp, 无位置传感器, 水平井牵引器

title: Design of Underground Parking Lot Fire Protection System Based on CC2530
abstract: 目前，住宅配建地下车库的消防设施，尚未考虑电动汽车起火的特殊灭火需要，不能适应电动汽车迅速增加的消防现状，且无法实时监测火灾风险并做出预警。为解决以上问题，本文采用CC2530构建了符合ZigBee协议的无线传感器网络，用于实时监测火灾风险，并执行相关灭火措施。通过PL2303实现了协调器节点与上位机通信，若有异常风险情况，可在上位机屏幕显示风险等级、异常车位号及车位区域编码；在值班室声光报警；在相关主通道路由节点处声光报警；并在相关终端节点处声光报警、自动采取灭火措施。该系统的传感器节点布置较为灵活，系统整体具有低成本、易安装、可扩展及低功耗的特点。
keywords: cc2530, pl2303, visual c++, zigbee, 无线传感器网络

title: Four-channel Scalable Radio Digital Receiver System
abstract: In response to the requirements of high sampling rate; wide bandwidth; multi-channel amplitude-phase consistency; as well as high-speed direct sampling and time-domain data storage in current radio observation devices; this paper investigates and analyzes the technical architecture and functionalities of digital processing systems in multiple radio observation devices. It proposes a 4-channel digital receiver system based on ZYNQ SOC and core components such as ADS54J60. This system achieves a maximum sampling rate of 1GSPS per single channel; demonstrating flexibility and scalability; which allows for the addition of expansion cards to increase sampling channels for meeting the fundamental requirements of future large-scale expandable radio interference arrays. The system consists of three parts: a high-speed data acquisition card; an optical communication receiving card; and a server. Currently; the high-speed serial interface technology based on SerDes has achieved direct sampling with a quantization accuracy of 16 bits and a sampling rate of 300 MSPS; providing a full-scale signal-to-noise ratio of 60 dB; a 40 Gbps SFP+ data transmission bandwidth; and a 1.5 GB/s PCIe communication bandwidth. It can capture analog signals in the intermediate frequency range of 4.5 MHz to 150 MHz. The system has completed both hardware and software design and testing. In our tests; we sampled a 10 MHz sine wave signal with an amplitude of 125 mV; and the amplitude difference between the 4 channels was less than 1 mV; with a phase delay of less than 3.3 ns. The system integrates programmable SFP+ communication interfaces and a multi-machine synchronization mechanism to accommodate the synchronous acquisition needs of multi-element arrays. It can also store the data of the original radio signals; providing more detailed time-domain data for radio research.
keywords: fpga, high-speed data acquisition, jesd204b, pcie, sfp+

title: 煤矿井下电动车自动化驱动控制器的电路设计
abstract: 该文设计的自动化驱动控制器由主回路、控制回路和电源组成，利用TMS320F2812芯片处理前端传感器采集的温度、速度和电流等信号。完成数据分析后生成控制指令，利用前端执行器执行指令，对电动车进行驱动控制。在满足驱动控制要求的基础上，该文还设计了故障检测电路、剩余电量检测电路和故障保护电路，进一步提高了煤矿井下电动车的运行可靠性。

title: Design of Agricultural Information Monitoring Terminal System Based on TinyOS
abstract: In order to improve the level of agricultural production informatization in China; the agricultural information monitoring terminal system based on TinyOS is designed. To achieve automatic collection of agricultural information; the hardware system of the information collection node is designed using the CC2530 processor; and the TinyOS application software is developed. We have independently designed the topology and deployment scheme of Wireless Sensor Networks（WSN） for agricultural information monitoring based on the characteristics of the agricultural Internet of Things. To ensure the data security of agricultural information monitoring; a WSN data encryption algorithm based on MD5 is adopted.
keywords: agricultural information monitoring, information acquisition, tinyos

title: Indoor air quality monitoring system based on ZigBee technology
abstract: To address the potential health hazards of toxic gases in household environments; this paper designs a home air quality monitoring system based on ZigBee technology; which can detect parameters such as temperature; humidity; CO and formaldehyde. The system consists of a data acquisition module; main control module; alarm module and LCD display module. Two CC2530 ZigBee chips act as coordinator and end device respectively; working with sensors and other hardware modules in the system. The system can monitor and display indoor air quality in real time; warn against air quality changes; and achieve home environmental monitoring.
keywords: air quality monitoring, cc2530, wireless sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: College of Computer Internet of Things Engineering, Wuxi Taihu University

title: Design of WSN location system based on RSSI
abstract: This paper designs and develops a WSN positioning system based on RSSI. The system converts the wireless received signal strength（RSSI） of ZigBee network nodes into distance; uses Kalman filtering algorithm to correct the received RSSI data value; and calculates the unknown node position using a trilateral positioning algorithm. Utilize CC2530 chip for ZigBee network networking. In the ZigBee network; RSSI data values are sent to the upper computer for processing through the coordinator node. After testing; the positioning algorithm of this system works well. Under the condition of limited number of anchor nodes; it can achieve ideal positioning accuracy; and is suitable for large-scale wireless sensor networks.
keywords: cc2530, kalman filtering, rssi, zigbee network
affiliations: College of Intelligent Manufacturing, Tianjin Sino-German University of Applied Sciences

title: Design and test of real-time monitoring system for production line based on Internet of Things technology
abstract: Since the automatic production line is in the unsupervised state; the occurrence of abnormal working conditions will bring serious negative impact on product quality and production safety; so it is particularly necessary to adopt remote real-time monitoring. This paper firstly introduces the hardware design of the real-time monitoring system of the production line; including the circuit design of CC2530 chip; the design of terminal node and gateway node; etc. Then it Outlines the components of system software; including SQL database; ZigBee node and so on. Finally; the system test was carried out in the laboratory. The results show that the system can accurately collect the temperature; humidity and smoke concentration of the production line; and according to the collected data; it can be presented on the monitoring platform in two ways: data and curve; which is convenient for managers to timely grasp the real-time condition of the production line.
keywords: internet of things, production line real-time monitoring system, temperature and humidity sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Guangxi Vocational ＆ Technical Institute of Industry

title: Design of plant factory environmental data acquisition system based on ZigBee and WiFi technology
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the popularization and application of Internet of Things technology in agriculture and rural areas; the research and development of digital agricultural equipment has gradually become a popular research field of agricultural informatization industry. In this context; this paper designs a plant factory environment accurate acquisition system based on agricultural Internet of Things. This paper describes the overall structure of the system function with ZigBee-WiFi module as the core. The hardware system structure with CC2530 and ESP8266 as the core components is described. Then the design structure of Z-stack protocol stack and OneNET platform is described. After debugging and running; the system designed in this paper can accurately and real-time collect the environmental parameter data of the plant factory.
keywords: plant factory, wifi protocol, zigbee protocol
affiliations: Jilin Agricultural Science and Technology University

title: Emergency road condition rescue warning device based on wireless transceiver
abstract: In recent years; rescue vehicles have been blocked from time to time; and the vehicles on the road cannot know in advance the passing of rescue vehicles; resulting in slow avoidance. Aiming at the problem of how to ensure the timeliness of rescue during the traffic peak period; a wireless signal transceiver based on single chip microcomputer and CC1125 chip is proposed. Firstly; the overall design scheme of the transmitter is proposed; and secondly; the realization principle of transmitting and receiving wireless signals from the hardware and software perspectives is expounded on the basis of the scheme. Through the test and simulation experiment of the transmission stability of sending and receiving communication; the final result shows that the design has high transmission stability; and the rescue efficiency has been improved to a certain extent; which is of great significance for the relief of emergency rescue vehicles stuck on the rescue road.
keywords: emergency rescue, rf, wireless transceiver chip cc1125
affiliations: College of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, Anhui Sanlian University

title: Research on Key Technologies of Wireless Networking and Positioning in Closed Bid Evaluation Base
abstract: The workload of current bidding and procurement has increased exponentially; the types of bidding have increased; and standardized operation is difficult. This study designs a closed bid evaluation base; establishes an intelligent bid evaluation system; forms a MESH network based on ZigBee; and a network coordinator establishes a wireless network. The routing node joins the network and expands the network coverage. Carrier-free pulse radio ultra-wideband technology realizes high-precision positioning; real-time display of bid evaluation personnel location information; and alarms for irregular activities. The node equipment of the position detector uses the CC2530 chip; and the radio frequency transceiver is integrated in the main control chip to optimize the radio frequency circuit to match the input impedance of the antenna. The experimental results show that the wireless network data transmission rate of the bid evaluation base of this research is the fastest; and the experimental sample data are transmitted to the display layer to show the shortest usage time.
keywords: bid evaluation base, intelligent system, mesh network, network coordinator, ultra wide-band positioning

title: MPC of multi-module dual active full-bridge converters
abstract: The dual active bridge（DAB）converter with parallel output in the cascaded power electronic transformer（PET）is taken as the research object;the modeling of multi-module parallel DAB topology structure is conducted;and the power balance control of each module is realized by means of the model predictive control（MPC）. On this basis;an improved MPC strategy is proposed for the case that the DAB module of the actual cascade PET equipment has no load current sensor. The strategy can be used to calculate the total output current by means of the power transmission characteristics of the DAB;the current equalization is used to realize the equal power operation of each module under the conditions that only the output voltage is sampled;but does not need to introduce any additional virtual current to replace the sampling current. The proposed control strategy is verified by means of the Matlab/Simulink simulation and the construction of two-module DAB parallel output experimental prototype taking TMS320F28335 as the core. The experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis.In comparison with the traditional control strategy;the dynamic response of the control strategy is faster;its output ripple is smaller;and its modular control is easy to achieve large-scale cascade;which can effectively reduce costs.
keywords: dual active full-bridge converter, equipower operation, modularity control, mpc, output current calculation, power balancing, simulation testing
affiliations: The Electrical Engineering College,Guizhou University, Guizhou Key Laboratory of Electric Big Data,Guizhou Institute of Technology

title: Design of a real-time voltage monitoring system based on ZigBee technology
abstract: In order to realize voltage automatic detection in power system;a real-time voltage monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is proposed. In the system;CC2530 is taken as the core-controller to achieve the functions of real-time acquisition;transmission and display of voltage signals. A platform of real-time monitoring and display of voltage signals is constructed by the development of a virtual platform. ZigBee technology is used to construct a multi-node voltage transmission network; which realizes the acquisition and transmission of multi-node voltage. Meanwhile;Visual Studio integrated development environment is utilized to construct the upper computer system;which can display the voltage collected by each node and conduct the data processing. The testing results indicate that this system has the characteristics of low cost; low power consumption and flexible networking and can be applied to the occasions of various real-time monitoring.

authors: HUANG Xiangdong;JIA Lining;LIN Qian;WANG Meiqian;WANG Xiaozheng

title: Design and implementation of drive interface reuse for multiway electromagnetic valve and proportional value
abstract: The drive signal of solenoid valve is usually the on-off quantity（high electrical-level valve opening;low electrical-level valve closing）. The drive signal of proportional valve is usually pulse width modulation（PWM）;and its drive current is generally 3 A or more. A digital signal processor（DSP）TMS320F28335 based drive system for electromagnetic valve and proportional valve is designed. The way of using isolated power module to replace bootstrap capacitor of half bridge driver chip is designed innovatively to realize the drive interface reuse for multiway electromagnetic valve or proportional value;that is;an interface can be used to output both switching value signal and PWM signal. The designed system can drive multiway electromagnetic valve or proportional valve. Taking 4-channel output drive interface as an example;a hardware over-current protection based on interlocking circuit is designed for each branch;and the over-current status of each branch is inputted to DSP by means of the in-out shifter. The testing results show that the system can occupy not only less interface resources;but also less resources on the chip. It has the characteristics of high reliability and stability;and has high practical value for projects with resource shortage on the chip.
keywords: drive system, electromagnetic valve drive, interface reuse, isolated power module, over-current protect, proportional valve drive
affiliations: No.58 Research Institute of China Electronic Technology Group Corporation

title: Portable Intelligent Electronic Scale Based on CC2540
abstract: The portable electronic scale designed in this paper is controlled by CC2540F256RHAR chip. The strain data is collected by strain gauge; amplified by HX711; and then converted by AD for microcontroller processing. The measured quality is displayed on LCD1602; and the error meets the requirements within a certain range. At the same time; it provides basic unit price setting; total price calculation; and peeling functions. By using the above uncomplicated; simple and easy to operate components for effective integration; the electronic scale with complete functions and low energy consumption is made; and the cost of the traditional electronic scale is compressed.
keywords: cc2540, hx711, resistance strain gauge, simple electronic scale

title: Design of a High Precision Liquid Level Measuring Instrument
abstract: Level measurement is suitable for the production of all aspects of life; which is the important direction of modern measurement science. In order to improve the precision of level measurement; the paper introduces a new type of high precision level gauge. The system uses AD717 as the core processor; uses the touch screen for level measurement usage; combines with peripheral circuit design of sensor and realizes the measurement of liquid level. The prototype test show that the measuring instrument system is stable and with high precision.
keywords: cc2530, high precision, level measurement, sectional
affiliations: Shanxi Institute of Technology, Shanxi Vocational University of Engineering Science and Technology

title: A Wireless Data Transmission System Based on CC2530
abstract: In response to the high requirements of temperature and humidity in the environment for equipment in industrial sites; the overall composition of a wireless data transmission system based on CC2530 was proposed; and the software and hardware design of the system was completed and tested. The experimental results show that the system can achieve the collection; wireless transmission; and display of temperature data from terminal nodes; and can remotely monitor temperature data without changing the on-site layout.
keywords: cc2530, remote monitoring, wireless data
affiliations: School of Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence, Wuxi Vocational Institute of Commerce

title: Research on Data Acquisition System of Shearer Based on ZigBee
abstract: First of all; the function of the shearer data acquisition system is analyzed; which is mainly the real-time collection of gas and roof pressure data and wireless network transmission. Then the circuit design is introduced in detail; including the design of gas acquisition circuit; pressure acquisition circuit and ZigBee communication chip CC2530 circuit. Finally; the software and networking process of coordinator node; router node and data acquisition terminal node are introduced.
keywords: data acquisition system, shearer, zigbee
affiliations: Taiyuan Coal Gasification (Group) Co., Ltd.

title: 综掘工作面智能局部通风机管控系统研究
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as low intelligent level of the local ventilation system on the comprehensively-mining work face and the prominent phenomenon of "one-time gas exhaust"; the paper researched the intelligent control system for the local ventilator based on TMS320F28335 controller; and applied the fuzzy control and the frequency conversion speed regulation technology to realize the intelligent control system for the local ventilator in combination with gas exhaust characteristic on the comprehensivelymining work face and the local ventilation theory. Meanwhile; the human-machine interface of the intelligent control system for the local ventilator was designed; and test verification and trial operation were completed.The results showed the intelligent control system for the local ventilator greatly enhanced the intelligent level of the ventilation monitoring system on the comprehensively-mining work face; realized the adaptive speed regulation; achieved the purpose of energy saving and consumption reduction; and guaranteed the safe; reliable and stable operation of the local ventilation system.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决综掘工作面局部通风系统智能化水平低、“一风吹”现象突出的问题;研究了基于TMS320F28335控制器的智能局部通风机管控系统;结合综掘工作面瓦斯涌出特点、局部通风理论;运用模糊控制、变频调速技术实现了局部通风机智能管控系统;同时设计了局部通风机智能管控系统人机界面;完成了试验验证和试运行。结果表明;该智能局部通风机管控系统极大地提升了综掘工作面通风监测系统的智能化水平;实现了自适应调速;达到了节能降耗运行的目的;保证了局部通风系统安全、可靠、稳定运行。
keywords: comprehensively-mining work face, control system, frequency conversion speed regulation, fuzzy controller, local ventilator

title: 并联电容器组状态监测的新型无线传感器设计关键技术研究
abstract: The process of frequent switching of parallel capacitor to compensate for power grid reactive power produces serious inrush current and harmonics.The transient over-voltage and large current pose a great threat to the safe operation of capacitor unit.A kind of power capacitor condition monitoring program based on wireless sensing technology is proposed.Through the analysis of core magnetic field distribution;material characteristics and coil output power;the double CT sensor structure with closed-circuit core for high-voltage energy extraction and open-circuit core for measurement is determined.The built-in A/D and the CC2530 chip of the ZigBee communication protocol stack as well as the dedicated signal processing circuit are used for current and temperature rise sensing of the capacitor unit;The low-power IEEE802.15.4standard protocol encrypts the terminal node information for wireless networking;and the aggregated data is comprehensively judged in the background machine analysis.The compact design of the dual-core structure sensor solves the problem of high energy extraction and accurate measurement of linear zone under the magnetic saturation of the iron core;and achieves the overall performance optimization of the sensor’s onsite high-voltage insulation;anti-interference and wireless networking design.
abstract_in_chinese: 并联电容器组频繁投切补偿电网无功过程产生严重涌流和谐波;瞬间过电压和大电流对电容器单元运行安全威胁极大。提出一种基于无线传感技术的电力电容器状态监测方案;通过铁心磁场分布、材料特性和线圈输出功率分析;确定传感器采用闭路铁心高压取能、开路铁心测量的双CT结构;利用内置A/D及ZigBee通信协议栈的CC2530芯片;以及专用信号处理电路实现电容器单元电流和温升感知;由低功耗IEEE 802.15.4标准协议将终端节点信息加密无线组网;汇聚的数据在后台机进行综合判别分析。双铁心结构传感器的紧凑化设计;解决了铁心磁性饱和下高位取能、线性区的准确测量问题;实现了传感器现场高压绝缘、抗干扰和无线组网设计的整体性能优化。
keywords: high-voltage self-energy extroction, intelligent sensor, online monitoring, parallel capacitor bank, wireless networking

title: 基于ZigBee技术的矿用负压除尘无线控制系统研究与设计
abstract: Proposed a wireless control system for mining negative pressure dust removal based on ZigBee technology.This system uses ZigBee wireless chip CC2530 as the core control device;uses lithium battery power supply mode;composed of dust sensor;infrared sensor;voltage/frequency conversion unit;wireless transmission unit;3×3 keyboard and LCD screen.The experiment proves that this system has reliable communication and quick action.

title: 一种三相电流型Sepic逆变器
abstract: This paper proposes a novel three-phase current source SEPIC inverter;which is composed of traditional three-phase bridge circuit and SEPIC circuit. The inverter can achieve buck-boost comply with the characteristics of SEPIC circuit. Meanwhile;by means of the SPWM carrier amplitude adjustable strategy;the problem which traditional current source inverter has large inductance parameter in DC side is solved;and the output waveform quality is optimized. This paper first introduces the working mode and the corresponding modulation method of the inverter;afterwards gives the mathematical formula of the voltage gain. Moreover;based on the characteristics of the circuit;the corresponding mathematical model and the closed-loop control strategy is established. Finally;the corresponding digital control platform is built by TMS320F2812 and FPGA;and the corresponding experimental verification is carried out;which verifies the feasibility of the circuit.

abstract: Digital Signal Process(DSP)+Field Program Gate Way(FPGA)is widely used in complex digital signal processing fields.Aiming at the problems of limited performance and inflexibility of DSP and FPGA single processor;a system design scheme of DSP+FPGA architecture is proposed.Based on the External Memory Interface(EMIF)of TMS320C6748(DSP)and EP3C40Q240C8N(FPGA)chips;a DSP+FPGA collaborative processing system is implemented.The system makes use of the advantages of FPGA in the underlying algorithm and DSP in the complex algorithm;it has flexible hardware structure;strong versatility;and improves the system performance compared with a single chip.After testing;the system runs stably;and the communication rate can reach 20MB/s without error.

title: Safety Monitoring System of Hoisting Machinery Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: The crane equipment safety monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network is designed to monitor the crane working safety in real time and avoid dangerous accidents. The system can be divided into three levels: field; local and remote. CC2530 is used as the core chip of ZigBee network hardware; USB and lithium batteries are set as power supply; and other units such as serial port and debugging units are set respectively. The hardware equipment required by the data acquisition module is studied; the monitor module is taken as the core of the system hardware; and related facilities are selected from the monitoring unit and display unit. The distributed assignment mechanism is established in the system software to solve the problem of Web address allocation in ZigBee wireless sensor network. Cluster-tree algorithm is adopted to simplify node functions; formulate a more reasonable routing protocol; reduce system communication loss; design the software flow of security monitoring unit; and complete the system design. Simulation experiments show that the average collection error of the system is within 0.02 V;and the maximum information packet loss rate is 1.81%. When the number of users reaches 200;the information packet loss rate is 75.4%.
keywords: cluster-tree algorithm, hoisting equipment, routing protocol, security monitoring system, zigbee wireless sensor network

title: Design and Implementation of High-performance Control Platform for Vehicle Asynchronous Motor Electric Drive System
abstract: In order to study the high-performance control strategy of induction motor for pure electric vehicles; based on the analysis of the mathematical model of induction motor; the vector control principle and space vector pulse width modulation（SVPWM） are studied;and the vector control system model of induction motor is built by using MATLAB/Simulink. In the environment of MATLAB/Simulink and CCS6.2; the code generation software of asynchronous motor vector control system based on TMS320F28335 control is written; the hardware experiment platform driven by intelligent power module（IPM） FSBB30CH060 is built; and the upper computer monitoring interface convenient for data acquisition and monitoring is established by using LabVIEW. Taking the 60 W asynchronous motor as the controlled object; the performance of the asynchronous motor vector control system platform is studied. The experimental results show that the platform; combined with computer simulation and embedded real-time control technology; can realize the development of highperformance control strategy for vehicle asynchronous motor; and has important application value in the research of high-performance control strategy for vehicle asynchronous motor.
keywords: asynchronous motor, code generation, platform design, space vector pulse width modulation, vector control

title: 基于ZigBee的网络安全监测监控系统设计
abstract: 电子技术的飞速发展加快了网络信息交流，网络安全问题也成为目前信息快速传递中需要注意的重点，因此，急需设计网络安全监测系统解决目前的网络安全问题。硬件部分设计了CC2530芯片、USB接口电路和前置功率放大电路，软件部分首先设计了网络安全监测监控架构，其次基于ZigBee构建了网络安全监控部署模型，最后设计了网络安全监控平台功能模块。测试设计的网络安全监测监控系统的性能，结果表明：设计的网络安全监控系统的性能良好，可以实现实时监测，对保证网络信息交流安全有重要意义。

title: 一种基于DSP技术的采煤机自动控制系统设计
abstract: 针对当前煤矿综采工作面自动控制能力弱，多数仍以人工操控或遥控器操控为主的现状，基于DSP技术设计一种采煤机的计算机自动控制系统。自动控制系统采用主从双DSP控制内核结构，建立DSP/BIOS即时嵌入式操作系统，由机组传感器对不同数据进行采集，实现实时通讯，确保输入输出的灵活控制，有效完成自动截割等工艺组合，接受远程监控保障安全生产。自动控制系统的主DSP采用32位定点微控制单元（MCU）TMS320F2812，实现采煤机自动控制系统的信息采集、数据传输、交互通信等基本功能；辅DSP采用32位浮点处理单元TMS320F28335，实现自动控制相关的算法处理，缓解软件开发压力；双DSP间经SPI总线接口建立通信渠道。自动控制系统的远距离监控功能将采用CAN总线来连接采煤机与上位机，前者的工况数据传至上位机后，后者直接发布命令指挥采煤机的实时动作。自动控制系统能够实现对煤矿综采工作面采煤机的日常作业工况的数据采集与处理，达到采煤机自动截割、远程监控，组态设计稳定等目的，提升了煤矿综采工作面采煤机的操作自动化水平。
keywords: 煤矿综采, 自动控制系统, 计算机, 采煤机

title: Research on Complex Vector Current Controller Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: Traction inverters are limited by the switching frequency; and the bandwidth of the current controller is also limited. As a key point of asynchronous traction motors in the vector control; the current controller has an important impact on the dynamic performance and stability of the system. In the vector control; the dq axis current has serious cross-coupling after the coordinate transformation of the motor current; and the coupling component increases with the increase of the stator frequency; which reduces the performance of the current controller. In order to improve the dynamic performance of the motor and realize the decoupling control; proposed a complex vector current controller based on TMS320 F28377 D. The virtual resistor was used to solve the current oscillation problem under different modulation methods. This method can satisfy the control algorithm and modulation mode running independently in two cores of a CPU; which improves the reliability and high efficiency. The controller improves the dynamic and stability performance of the motor operation; effectively improves the decoupling effect. The simulation and experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the complex vector current controller.
keywords: complex vector, decoupling control, tms320f28377d, virtual resistor
