title: Design of Water and Fertilizer Metering Pump Control System Based on Embedded Linux
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high-precision control of water and fertilizer metering pump; it designs a set of water and fertilizer metering pump control system based on embedded chip by using Linux and stepping motor drive method.The hardware of the control system takes TMS320F2812 microprocessor as the core and adopts the modular design idea.The software adopts Linux system; uses the closed-loop control mode to output PWM; precisely controls the stepping motor; and realizes the precise irrigation of crop water and fertilizer.The experimental results show that the error between the actual value and the set value of the system is less than 1.5%; and the experimental effect is ideal.It shows that the control system has high precision; good stability and meets the design requirements of the system.

The module is based on edge algorithm and combined with Internet of Things platform; which can realize the real-time processing of analog; digital; serial and other data are collected and processed. For multi serial port data acquisition; a communication process based on process identification is designed. Finally; the implementation of edge computing and strategy in embedded system is introduced.

title: Real-time detection of industrial SO
abstract: In industry; SO3 gas prepared by oxidation of SO2 is of high concentration; strong corrosion and great cross-influence; and difficulty by high precision real-time detection. Moreover; the relationship between input flow and SO3 concentration is not clear; which leads to that the parameter adjustment depends on experience. Aim at the above problems; a real-time system for detection of industrial SO3 gas concentration was designed by AO2 electrochemical oxygen sensor; and a multivariate nonlinear regression model with input air; SO2 flow and output SO3concentration was established. The real-time detection system of SO3 gas concentration mainly included AO2 electrochemical oxygen sensor; sensor conditioning circuit;AD620 amplifying circuit and ADS1256 A/D conversion circuit. It indirectly measured SO3 concentration by detecting the millivolt level change of O2 concentration in input air and the output mixture gas from SO3 generator. In this way; the cross influence of other sensitive gases was avoided. The experimental results showed that the detection time of the system was 27s; the sensitivity was 111mV/%; the deviation was less than 0.18% and the stability was good; which demonstrated the effectiveness of the detection system. A cubic polynomial nonlinear regression model for predicting SO3 concentration was established by response surface method. The results of variance analysis for this model were very significant with the mean square error（MSE） of the model of 0.0007174 and the correlation coefficient（R2） of 0.9929; which proved that the model had good fitting degree and high prediction precision.
keywords: instrumentation, model, prediction, real-time detection, so gas concentration

title: Research on Detecting and Tracking Algorithm of Small Moving Targets Based on TMS320C6455
abstract: Based on TMS320C6455;the partial differential factor and inter-frame difference factor are adopted and improved in the paper. Firstly;an image is divided into blocks of the same size. And then the blocks are imported into the chip from the off-chip in turn. Each block is computed and the result is stored. This method solves the problem of insufficient chip storage space effectively. Then a more efficient tracking method is proposed in the tracking mode. A region of interest is obtained based on the target coordinates after searching. In order to meet the accuracy and completeness of the tracking;the paper conducts a search of interest in a block and performs a global search on adjacent block. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm not only reduces the time and space complexity;but also improves the accuracy of tracking targets.

title: Multi-channel wireless sensor system based on CC1310 chip wtih high speed and low power consumption
abstract: In order to effectively reduce the weight of sensor data acquisition and transmission system for the new-generation launch vehicle; a wireless sensor system based on chip CC1310 was designed and implemented. Multi-node networking and group management are accomplished using frequency division multiplexing（FDM） and time division multiplexing（TDM）. The FDM scheme among groups not only increases the number of nodes; but also improves the transmission rate multiplexing multiple. When there are four groups; the system is capable of supporting more than 100 sub-nodes. In order to ensure high precision synchronization of multi-nodes; avoid node collisions; and obtain the optimal intra-group achievable rate; we also suggested an optimal method of master node timing in combination with a multi-node time-sharing transfer protocol. Moreover; a node wake-up/idle mode switching strategy is designed to reduce system power consumption effectively. The experimental results show that the transmission rate can reach 400 Kbps when two master nodes work in parallel with five sub-nodes; and the transmission rate will increase proportionally when the number of master nodes rises. The power consumption of the single sub-node is less than 60 mW during work hours and less than 12 mW during idle hours. The average power consumption of the single sub-node is 15.2 mW; which meets the requirements of low power consumption. At the same time; the wireless sensor system designed in this paper has good reliability and robustness.

title: Design of Self-powered Wind Speed Monitoring System for Desertification Combating
abstract: The expansion of land desertification is a serious threat to the sustainable development of the ecological environment.Real-time monitoring of regional wind speed can provide scientific decision-making support for desertification control work.However; most wind-speed monitoring devices have the problem of heavy dependence on external power supply and high power consumption.To this end; a self-powered wind speed monitoring system based on composite energy harvesting is designed.The experiment results show that the system can collect and store solar energy and wind energy compositely through the energy management circuit to drive the back-end circuit.The wireless transmission module uploads the output signal of the triboelectric nanogenerator to the data terminal; and finally realizes the display and storage of wind speed information.In addition; the low-power logic design effectively prolongs the working time of the sensing node.This work promotes the application of self-powered sensing in the field of environmental monitoring.

title: Design of Rail Transit Environmental Vibration Monitoring System Based on DSP
abstract: In the paper; a set of supervising system for rail transit environmental vibration is designed; which integrates vibration signal acquisition; data treating; data uploading and supervision.The supervising node uses DSP digital signal processor to analyze the 1/3 frequency range spectrum and get the index used to appraise the environmental vibration; and upload the processed data to OneNet cloud platform through W5500 communication module.The supervising software is made on account of VS.NET platform.It reads the data stored on OneNet cloud platform through HTTP protocol to monitor the vibration status of rail transit environment.Through detecting the data gathering and the overall performance of the supervising system; the results show that the system is exact in signal gathering; the result is accord with the reality; and achieves the design purpose.

title: Design and verification of data acquisition clock circuit based on dual-loop phase-locked loop
abstract: [Background] Digital measurement system based on ADCs（analog-to-digital converter） has higher requirement on the signal to noise ratio（SNR） of sampled data. Among all the factors; the jitter of sampling clock has the most prominent effect on SNR. [Purpose] This study aims to design a clock circuit based on dual-loop phaselocked loop to reduce the jitter of digital measurement system input clock. [Methods] First of all; the influence of clock jitter on digital measurement system was analyzed. Then; the LMK04610 chip with dual loop PLL architecture of Texas Instruments was employed to design and implement a dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit. The cores of this design were power supply design and the loop filter design. At last; the performance of the circuit was tested by using Rodschwarz phase noise analyzer. [Results] After testing; the dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit can reduce the jitter of the 62.475 MHz source clock from more than 7 ps to less than 2 ps with output frequency of 499.8 MHz. The SNR of the sampled data is close to the theoretical value. [Conclusions] Dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit has a good result and can provide reference for designers of digital measurement system.
keywords: data acquisition, dual-loop pll, jitter cleaner, snr of adc

title: High-gain Ultra-small Streak Camera and Its Integrated Control System
abstract: As a diagnostic instrument with ultra-high temporal and spatial resolution and spectral resolution;the streak camera is widely used in basic research fields such as physics;life sciences;and materials science;as well as in national strategic fields such as detonation physics;lidar;and inertial confinement fusion. Aiming at the requirements of airborne lidar for miniaturized;high-sensitivity;highgain;and high spatiotemporal resolution streak camera;a high-brightness-gain compact streak camera and its new integrated control system are developed.Compared with the general picosecond visible light streak camera;the volume and weight of the camera are reduced by more than 2/3. The selected streak camera adopts the theoretical simulation research of cathode semiconductor and the method of optimizing the process to greatly improve the sensitivity of the cathode. Using a slit acceleration grid improves the photoelectron transmittance;enhances the photoelectron energy to give the fluorescent screen higher luminous efficiency;and optimizes the cathode process to improve the brightness gain. The streak image tube has the characteristics of high sensitivity;large detection field;high brightness gain;and high temporal and spatial resolution.Starting from the principle and control requirements;combined with the theoretical analysis of the defects of the active control system;a new type of high-integration control system is developed for the camera;which fully eliminates the low integration;poor reliability and compatibility of the previous version.defect. The hardware of the new control system adopts the design method of modularization and function reuse;and the PCB adopts the multi-layer board design. Compared with the current version;the degree of integration is increased by 2.36 times to achieve multi-device compatibility. The bottom layer of the system hardware is divided into main control module;power supply module;A/D module;D/A module;digital I/O and extended scan switching module:the main control module takes STM32F107VCT6 as the core and is responsible for the information between each module and the host computer Interaction;the power supply module is divided into a high-voltage power supply part and a low-voltage power supply part;which provide corresponding voltages for the stripe tube and each element of the circuit;the A/D module takes ADS1256 as the core;adds anti-static protection and digital-analog isolation to entirely eliminate noise interference;and uses SPI The protocol communicates with the host computer;the D/A module takes DAC8534 as the core to control the output of analog devices such as MCP and high-voltage power supply;the digital I/O and expansion scan switching module use the microcontroller GPIO as the control;and the24 pins programmable interface supports function multiplexing. The PC-side visualization system realizes human-computer interaction and has functions such as camera control;instant feedback of collected images and data;and operation logs. The interface is concise and optimized;which greatly enhances the operability and maintainability of the camera.Finally;the streak tube static test system is used to test the parameters of the streak image tube:the cathode integral sensitivity is 268 μA/lm;the brightness gain is 20.1;and the time resolution is 36 ps;femtosecond laser;F-P etalon;DG645 delayer;oscilloscope;etc. built a dynamic test system for streak camera;and tested the static/dynamic spatial resolution;time resolution;control system function;etc. of the whole machine. The static spatial resolution is higher than 26 lp/mm;the full-screen scanning time is600 ps;and the functions of control;monitoring and information exchange of the control system are normal.The developed streak camera works well in the laser radar and Inertial Confinement Fusion（ICF）picosecond laser targeting experiments.
keywords: brightness gain, cathode sensitivity, compatibility, control system, integration, streak camera

title: Design of low voltage power grid relay protection input signal identification system based on improved wavelet threshold
abstract: The input signal identification system of relay protection in low-voltage power grid is disturbed by noise signal;and the reliability and accuracy of signal identification results are low.A low-voltage power grid relay protection input signal identification system based on improved wavelet threshold is designed.According to the hardware structure of the system;the A/D conversion module is used to convert the electrical signal into digital signal;and the L298N drive module is used to drive the DC motor to protect the over-current and separate the power supply from the load.The RS485 communication interface is designed to transmit the query information to the slave to avoid receiving the wrong data.The TMS320LF2407 is adopted DSP chip transmits the data to the simulator through JTAG port to realize the input signal identification.By using the improved wavelet threshold recognition algorithm;the noise signal is eliminated while the initial signal is intact;and the absolute value of low frequency coefficient and high frequency coefficient are determined.The identification process is designed to realize the input signal identification of low-voltage power grid relay protection.The experimental results show that the system has good reliability through the verification of step signal and sine signal;and the recognition accuracy can be as high as 0.98.
keywords: identification system, improved wavelet threshold, input signal, low voltage power grid relay protection

title: 一种高增益超小型条纹相机及其集成控制系统
abstract: As a diagnostic instrument with ultra-high temporal and spatial resolution and spectral resolution;the streak camera is widely used in basic research fields such as physics;life sciences;and materials science;as well as in national strategic fields such as detonation physics;lidar;and inertial confinement fusion.Aiming at the requirements of airborne lidar for miniaturized;high-sensitivity;highgain;and high spatiotemporal resolution streak camera;a high-brightness-gain compact streak camera and its new integrated control system are developed.Compared with the general picosecond visible light streak camera;the volume and weight of the camera are reduced by more than 2/3.The selected streak camera adopts the theoretical simulation research of cathode semiconductor and the method of optimizing the process to greatly improve the sensitivity of the cathode.Using a slit acceleration grid improves the photoelectron transmittance;enhances the photoelectron energy to give the fluorescent screen higher luminous efficiency;and optimizes the cathode process to improve the brightness gain.The streak image tube has the characteristics of high sensitivity;large detection field;high brightness gain;and high temporal and spatial resolution.Starting from the principle and control requirements;combined with the theoretical analysis of the defects of the active control system;a new type of high-integration control system is developed for the camera;which fully eliminates the low integration;poor reliability and compatibility of the previous version.defect.The hardware of the new control system adopts the design method of modularization and function reuse;and the PCB adopts the multi-layer board design.Compared with the current version;the degree of integration is increased by 2.36 times to achieve multi-device compatibility.The bottom layer of the system hardware is divided into main control module;power supply module;A/D module;D/A module;digital I/O and extended scan switching module:the main control module takes STM32F107VCT6 as the core and is responsible for the information between each module and the host computer Interaction;the power supply module is divided into a high-voltage power supply part and a low-voltage power supply part;which provide corresponding voltages for the stripe tube and each element of the circuit;the A/D module takes ADS1256 as the core;adds anti-static protection and digital-analog isolation to entirely eliminate noise interference;and uses SPI The protocol communicates with the host computer;the D/A module takes DAC8534 as the core to control the output of analog devices such as MCP and high-voltage power supply;the digital I/O and expansion scan switching module use the microcontroller GPIO as the control;and the 24 pins programmable interface supports function multiplexing.The PC-side visualization system realizes human-computer interaction and has functions such as camera control;instant feedback of collected images and data;and operation logs.The interface is concise and optimized;which greatly enhances the operability and maintainability of the camera.Finally;the streak tube static test system is used to test the parameters of the streak image tube:the cathode integral sensitivity is 268μA/lm;the brightness gain is 20.1;and the time resolution is 36 ps;femtosecond laser;F-P etalon;DG645 delayer;oscilloscope;etc.built a dynamic test system for streak camera;and tested the static/dynamic spatial resolution;time resolution;control system function;etc.of the whole machine.The static spatial resolution is higher than 26 lp/mm;the full-screen scanning time is 600 ps;and the functions of control;monitoring and information exchange of the control system are normal.The developed streak camera works well in the laser radar and Inertial Confinement Fusion(ICF)picosecond laser targeting experiments.

title: 低电压应力单级升降压逆变器及控制策略
abstract: 针对传统基于Buck-Boost非隔离逆变器具有电压应力大的缺点，提出了一种具有低电压应力的新型无变压器单级升降压电压源逆变器拓扑及其调制方案。该拓扑可以在较宽的输入电压范围内实现逆变，同时具有低电压应力与电感电流纹波。文中首先分析了该逆变器的拓扑特性及工作模态，设计了可以保证输出电容电压平衡的逆变器的调制策略，建立了共模等效电路，对高频漏电流进行分析。最后搭建了硬件实验平台，在DSP TMS320F28335和FPGA XC6SLX9-2TQG 144C数字化平台上对提出的方案进行了实验验证，实验结果验证了提出新型拓扑和控制方法的有效性。

title: Topology and Control Strategy of Lower Voltage Stress Single-stage Buck-boost Inverter
abstract: Traditional non-isolated inverters based on the Buck-Boost principle usually have the disadvantage of high voltage stress. A new transformerless single-stage buck-boost voltage source inverter topology with lower voltage stress and its control method are proposed. This topology can realize inversion in a wider input voltage range， while having lower switching device voltage stress and inductor current ripple. In this paper， the topological characteristics and working mode of the inverter are analyzed， and the sequence of each switch of the inverter that can ensure the balance of the output capacitor voltage is designed. A high frequency equivalent circuit is established to analyze the high-frequency leakage current. Finally， a hardware experimental platform is built， and the proposed scheme is experimentally verified on DSP TMS320F28335 and FPGA XC6SLX9-2TQG144C digital platform. The experimental results verify the feasibility of the proposed novel topology， control method and voltage balance strategy.
keywords: buck-boost inverter, common-mode voltage, modulation, multi-level inverter, voltage stress

title: 双向全桥串联谐振DC/DC变换器扩展相移控制的全局优化方法
abstract: 基于传统基波等效法建立的双向全桥串联谐振DC/DC变换器模型准确度不高，导致控制存在误差，变换器的工作效率降低。本文采用分段分析法建立DBSR变换器在扩展相移下的模型，能够准确描述变换器的特性。传统单相移控制下变换器的回流功率和开关损耗较大，导致变换器工作效率降低，而本文提出一种基于扩展相移的全局优化控制方法，能有效降低回流功率和开关损耗。首先分析双向全桥串联谐振DC/DC变换器的回流功率原理，建立回流功率的优化控制模型，然后结合软开关条件以及考虑死区时间下的完全软开关特性，建立双向全桥串联谐振DC/DC变换器的全局优化控制算法。最后，在基于TMS320F28335控制器的实物实验平台上，对所提方法与传统方法在宽电压增益下以及全功率范围内进行实验对比。实验结果表明：与传统基波分析法相比，所提建模方法具有更高的准确度，且所提的优化控制方法可以有效降低回流功率，显著降低变换器的开关损耗，能够大幅提升变换器的传输效率。
keywords: 传输效率, 双向全桥串联谐振dc/dc变换器, 回流功率, 扩展相移控制, 软开关

title: Global Optical Control Method of Dual-Bridge Series Resonant DC/DC Converters Based on EPS Control
abstract: The accuracy of the dull bridge series resonant （DBSR） DC/DC converter model established based on the traditional fundamental harmonic analysis is low， which results in control errors and reduces the efficiency of the converter. In this paper， the segmental analysis method is used to establish the model of the DBSR converter under the extended phase shift （EPS） control， which can accurately describe the characteristics of the converter. The backflow power and switching loss of the converter under the traditional single-phase shift control are relatively large， which leads to the reduction of the efficiency of the converter. In this paper， a global optimization control method based on EPS control is proposed， which can effectively reduce the backflow power and switching losses. Firstly， the principle of backflow power of the DBSR converter is analyzed， and the optimal control model of backflow power is established. Then， the global optimal control algorithm of the DBSR converter is established by combining soft-switching conditions and considering the complete soft-switching characteristics under dead time. Finally， on the physical experimental platform based on the TMS320F28335 controller， the experimental comparison between the proposed method and the traditional method is carried out under the wide voltage gain and the full power range. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional fundamental harmonic analysis， the proposed modeling method has higher accuracy， and the proposed optimal control method can effectively reduce the backflow power， significantly reduce the switching loss of the converter， and greatly improve the transmission efficiency.
keywords: backflow power, dual bridge series resonant dc/dc converter, extended phase shift control, soft switching, transmission efficiency
authors: YIN Shuai;SONG Wensheng;CHEN Jian;DENG Yaru;FENG Xiaoyun

title: DSP Serial Port Software Upgrade Scheme Based on State Machine Strategy
abstract: TI company’s DSP software upgrade usually needs to be connected to the emulator;the operation often needs to disassemble the product equipment;which is not convenient for routine maintenance.To solve this problem;this paper takes TMS320F2812 platform as an example;and gives a DSP serial port software upgrade scheme based on state machine strategy.This scheme can not only upgrade the software of the target machine directly through the serial port;but also ensure the correctness;recoverability and repeatability in software upgrade.The scheme has strong operability and high flexibility;and has high practical application value.
keywords: dsp software upgrade, flash programming, serial port software upgrade, state machine strategy, tms320f2812

title: Application research of ZigBee technology in coal mine safety monitoring system
abstract: Coal mine safety has attracted more and more attention from all walks of life.Based on ZigBee wireless network technology; a coal mine safety monitoring system was constructed.The system is mainly composed of the host computer system; terminal node equipment; and coordinator equipment.The latter two realize data information transmission based on ZigBee wireless network technology; which can ensure the security of data in the transmission process.Taking CC2530 module circuit; power circuit module and sensor interface circuit as examples; the main hardware facilities of the safety monitoring system were studied.The software program and main work flow of the three components in the system were analyzed.The safety monitoring system was applied to the practice of coal mine production.After on-site debugging; it was found that the performance is good; and the environmental parameters of the coal mine can be accurately and timely detected.If the environmental indicators exceed the standard; the sound and light alarm can be issued in time.It has created good safety benefits for coal mining enterprises.
keywords: coal mine safety, monitoring system, wireless network, zigbee technology

title: Design of Portable Solenoid Valve Performance Test System Based on Android
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the solenoid valve performance test equipment is not convenient to carry; a portable solenoid valve performance test system based on microcontroller unit（MCU） and Android mobile phone terminal was designed.In the system; the Android smart phone was used as data processing center; STC15 W408 AS microcontroller was used as main control chip; combined with 511 series pressure sensor; CC2540 bluetooth module and other devices and control software; the functions of solenoid valve status data collection; real-time display; performance test and data sharing were achieved.The results show that the mobile APP developed with the help of Android Studio fully embodies the advantages of human-computer interaction; the system has the advantages of simple structure; convenient use; reliable test accuracy; meets the national solenoid valve performance test standard; and can be effectively used in the field rapid test of solenoid valve.

title: Design of Online Testing System for Coal Power Cable State Based on AM3358
abstract: Aiming at the problems of instability of mine power cable insulation measurement signal and low accuracy of parameters; a remote measurement terminal RTU for insulation parameters based on AM3358 is designed; and also the design of the software and hardware is given. The wide-area measurement scheme is adopted to synchronize the RTU at both ends of the cable using EtherCAT; and then the voltage;current and temperature at both ends are sampled in real time. With the aid of vector calculation; the insulation resistance and the capacitance are calculated; and the online evaluation of the insulation performance of the power cable under actual conditions are of great significance for greatly improving the safety and reliability of the power supply system.

title: 基于小波变换的数字图像无损压缩系统设计
abstract: 随着科技的发展，图像压缩技术也已经由有损压缩逐渐转化成为无损压缩，在数字图像无损压缩的过程中，如何实现实时、高效是目前图像压缩领域的重要问题，为满足压缩需求，解决传统的数字图像无损压缩系统的运行速度慢、压缩效率低的问题，设计了基于小波变换的数字图像无损压缩系统，硬件部分设计DSP数字信号处理器、TMS320C6201芯片和DM642外设接口，软件部分首先优化了数字图像压缩传输数据，然后基于小波变换进行了无损压缩编码，最后设计了数字图像压缩框架，实现了数字图像无损压缩，进行系统测试，结果表明，设计的数字图像无损压缩系统性能良好，运行速度较快，压缩效率较高，有一定的应用价值。

title: Urban energy saving lighting dimming system based on intelligent gear control
abstract: The traditional urban energy-saving lighting dimming system can not predict the traffic flow in real time; which leads to the large urban energy consumption. Therefore; an energy-saving lighting dimming system based on the intelligent gear control is designed. The hardware circuit of the city energy-saving lighting dimming system is designed; and the system hardware design is completed through the CC2530 minimum system; controller and other peripheral circuits. In the software part of the system; the intelligent control model of gear is used to predict the traffic flow and adjust the urban energy-saving lighting; and the dimming system design of urban energy-saving lighting based on the intelligent control model of gear is realized. The experiment results show that the urban energy-saving lighting dimming system based on the intelligent gear control in this study can effectively reduce the urban energy consumption and reduce the lighting regulation time; which has practical application significance.
keywords: cc2530 minimum system, intelligent gear control model, lighting dimming system, urban energy saving

title: Design method of electronic tag based on radio frequency energy acquisition
abstract: According to the characteristics of energy acquisition applied to tags; a monitoring circuit was added between the energy acquisition module and the tag module; and the cooperative working strategy of energy acquisition and tags was put forward based on the setting of high and low thresholds. The low threshold selection principle is to ensure that the energy storage of the energy storage module can ensure the one-time broadcasting of the tag and prevent the tag from entering the power down state to the maximum extent. The optimal value of energy storage capacitance; minimum and optimal radio frequency（RF） input power in the environment were deduced by starting from the broadcast interval and power required in the tag design goal according to the amount of energy that can be collected in the environment and the change of energy consumption required by the tag in different states. A tag based on RF acquisition was designed by using P2110B and CC2640R2F chip for verification. Test results show that the energy acquisition tag designed by this method can realize the cooperative work of energy acquisition module and tag module. The tag can carry out continuous “sleep and broadcast” cycle when the RF input power is greater than the optimal value. It can effectively prevent the label from falling into “energy deadlock”; and can adaptively switch in different working states.
keywords: cooperative work, energy acquisition, energy deadlock, radio frequency, tag

title: An Improved Architecture Design and DSP Implementation of Turbo Code
abstract: Aiming at the error floor problem of traditional Turbo code in high bit rate scenarios; and the larger bit rate range requirement in data link projects of communication; the scheme of enhanced Turbo code and parallel decoding algorithm are explored. The tail-biting code structure is used to solve the decoding error floor problem. A lower bit rate code structure is designed to meet the lower bit rate range; and the BER（Bit Error Ratio） performance is improved by 0.4～0.6 dB. Finally; combined with the parallel decoding algorithm and the optimizing technology of Digital Signal Processor（TMS320C6678）; the fixed-point implementation of the decoder is optimized; so that the decoding calculation obtains a speedup of 2.6～3.7. Simulation and project verification indicate that the design has good performance and high engineering practice value.
keywords: dsp（digital signal processor）, parallel decoding, sf-max-log-map, tail-biting code, turbo code

The wireless call system is easy to install; it will not disturb the daily life of nursing homes. Provide a safer living environment for the elderly; the advantages of low cost and high efficiency also make the system have good application prospects in nursing homes; communities and other places.

title: 基于卫星定位与GPRS技术的检测系统设计
abstract: 该系统以CC2541为主控芯片，挂载PCB天线以实现蓝牙无线通信；GPRS通信模块采用SIM900A芯片，为用户上传数据至云端提供无线链路；卫星定位模块使用ZOE-M8Q芯片，可支持高达12颗卫星定位；云端服务器利用Windows Server 2012RC操作系统实现数据采集和信息存储。它体积小、性价比高、监测实时，可用于汽车定位、无人机测速、轮船定航向等，实现对运动载体运动信息的全方位监测，适合个人及单位使用。

title: DSP Based Brushless DC Motor Double Closed-loop PID Servo System
abstract: Aiming at the key technical problems of traditional DC motors such as mechanical commutation; poor speed regulation performance;small starting torque; and poor anti-interference; a brushless DC motor control system using PID double closed-loop control was studied and designed. The working principle and mathematical model of the brushed DC motor were analysed; the simulation model of the brushless DC motor control system was built based on Matlab/Simulink; and the current-speed double closed-loop PI speed regulation method was used to improve the speed regulation performance of the system; finally; the TMS320F28335 chip was used. In order to control the core; the external drive circuit module; communication circuit module; detection circuit module; protection circuit module; etc. had completed the hardware design of the system; and the software design was developed on the CCS5.2 platform. In order to observe the operating parameters of the motor in real time; based on Labwindow had designed the host computer interface. The designed brushless DC motor control system was tested in the actual environment; and the output display results not only met the design requirements of rapid and stable startup; good dynamic performance;and excellent speed regulation performance; but also the hardware system ran stable and had good control effect; which verified the correctness of the algorithm.
keywords: brushless dc motor, closed-loop control, dsp, servo system, simulation modeling

title: ZigBee Multi-area Wireless Temperature and Humidity Acquisition System Based on LabVIEW
abstract: To solve the problem of real-time monitoring of temperature and humidity in large-span greenhouses; based on wireless sensor network technology; a ZigBee multi-area wireless acquisition and monitoring system for temperature and humidity based on LabVIEW was designed.Firstly; using CC2530 as the main control chip; the topology of a star wireless network was constructed using ZigBee protocol stack technology to realize the communication between the main node and multiple slave nodes;followed by the construction of a basic architecture for the acquisition and transmission of regional temperature and humidity data; secondly;based on the LabVIEW software;a temperature and humidity acquisition and monitoring system platform was designed;with multi-area temperature and humidity data numerical and curve display;over-limit alarm and storage and other basic monitoring interfaces designed;VISA function used for the communication part. Finally;the whole system was tested;and the stability of wireless data transmission and the effect of real-time monitoring were observed. The experimental results show that the system can realize the functions of real-time monitoring and display of environment temperature and humidity;real-time data storage and over-limit alarm in multiple areas;and provide a scheme design or method for greenhouse planting for reference based on Internet of things technology monitoring.
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition, labview, wireless communication, zigbee

title: 球磨机衬板提升条厚度测量系统设计与实现
abstract: The lifter bar of liner is a damageable part of a ball mill; and the damage of the lifter bar would cause a rise in the possibility of the liner shell being worn out and cause a potential safety hazard. Usually when the wear degree of the shell liner is tested; it is necessary to stop the ball mill. This paper designs a real-time measuring system for the thickness of the lifter bar of the ball mill’s liner. By embedding the resistancetransducer in the fixed bolt of liner to obtain the wearing data of the lifter bar; and then using radio frequency communication for data transmission; it could realize real-time monitoring of the thickness change of the lifter bar of liner without stopping the ball mill. Additionally; the ultra-low power circuit system using the CC1310 chip and the wireless communication mode of aerial awakening enables the system to work continuously for more than 6 months to meet the needs of engineering operations. The experimental result shows that the average measurement error of the system is 1.83 mm. The system could accurately and effectively measure the wear degree of the lifter bar of liner;and ensure the high-efficiency and safe operation of the ball mill.
keywords: liner lifting bar, low power consumption, real-time monitoring, thickness measurement

title: Modeling and smulation of SVPWM modulation wave
abstract: This paper analyzes the principle of SVPWM modulation technology and introduces a modulation method AZSPWM based on active zero vector. The three-phase voltage-source inverter controlled by the two modulation methods is modeled by MATLAB. Through simulation; it is verified that the SVPWM modulation method can improve the input voltage utilization rate; and AZSPWM can reduce the common mode voltage. The experimental verification is carried out on the DSP chip based on TMS320F28335.
keywords: azspwm, common mode voltage, dsp verification, matlab simulation, svpwm
affiliations: Wuhan Institute of Marine Electric Propulsion, Institute of Science and Technology , Shenhua Zhunneng Group Co., Ltd

title: 基于CC3200的自动浇花系统设计
abstract: 本系统是将物联网技术应用到浇花系统中，主要包括智能控制板、手机APP、云平台等。智能控制板可实时检测土壤的温度、湿度，通过继电器控制水泵，实现自动浇花的功能；手机APP提供了两种浇花模式，即自动浇花和远程手动浇花，在自动浇花模式下，该系统在土壤湿度低于阈值时自动浇水；在手动模式下，当湿度接近阈值时通过手机APP开启水泵按钮，进行远程手动浇花。本设计还设置了风扇和补光灯，在温度较高时，启动风扇可以达到降温的效果，补光灯可以为植物提供光照，并使花卉更具有观赏性。
keywords: cc3200, 智能花盆, 自动浇花, 远程控制
affiliations: 内蒙古自治区法治培训中心

title: Design and Implementation of Ultra-High-Speed Digital Acquisition System Based on FPGA
abstract: UWB radar has high range resolution and strong anti-jamming capability because UWB radar has a large bandwidth.As a key component of UWB radar system; digital acquisition system requires a high sampling rate to acquire UWB signals.In the paper; a high-speed digital acquisition system is designed with the structure of high-performance FPGA and ultra-high sampling rate ADC to achieve two-channel 8 bits 9.4 Gsps signal sampling.The ENOB of the system is better than 5.4 bits; and the SFDR is better than 50 dB.The performance meets the design requirements and has good engineering application value.
keywords: adc12dj5200rf, fpga, high-speed digital acquisition, uwb
affiliations: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Electrical and Communication Engineering, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

title: 基于RSSI的低成本室内三维空间定位模型研究
abstract: 在当前物联网环境下，为确保物联网的经济性、完整性和扩展性，针对三维空间复杂的二维参量延伸及干扰因素，研究基于RSSI构建低成本的室内物联网3D定位系统。通过构建合适的三维空间定位模型以及进一步优化数据处理的方法，能够获得较好的定位效果，并且为更高精度的定位奠定了一定的现实基础。
keywords: cc2530, rssi, zigbee技术, 三维定位, 无线传感网, 节点定位
authors: 顾祥玉;余雨;赵千倩;陈静;吴莹
affiliations: 南京工程学院信息与通信工程学院

title: ZigBee and Cloud-based Design of Rotary Kiln of Rollers Vibration Monitoring System
abstract: The ZigBee and cloud-based full-coverage rotary kiln of Rollers vibration monitoring system was designed to address the problems of cumbersome wiring;high cost and difficult maintenance and management of wired monitoring of cement rotary kilns.The system consists of several terminal nodes installed on rotary kiln of Rollers and a coordinator;both of which use a low-power;low-cost ZigBee processor CC2530.The coordinator sends the data from multiple end nodes via the serial port to the 4Gmodule;which in turn sends the data to a designated cloud server.The monitor can monitor the pallets’ vibration data in real time through the computer and mobile applications connected to the cloud server for early diagnosis of kiln operation faults.The system has the advantages of simple structure;easy deployment;no wiring;etc.It effectively solves the problem of transmission distance limitation of a single ZigBee network and achieves the expected design effect;which will have a wide engineering application prospect in rotary kiln operation status monitoring.
keywords: rotary kiln, rotary kiln of rollers vibration monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: School of Mechanical and Electronic Engineering,Wuhan University of Technology

title: Design of Wireless Communication System for Coal Mine Rescue Robot Based on ZigBee
abstract: Firstly; the overall design of the coal mine rescue robot system is carried out; and the advantages and disadvantages of the current mainstream wireless communication technology are analyzed. ZigBee technology is selected to carry out the wireless communication of the rescue robot with the frequency of 900 MHz in the mine tunnel. Then; according to the characteristics of ZigBee technology; the process of wireless networking is designed to make higher bandwidth and the maintenance of wireless communication more convenient; while avoiding the problem of data transmission because of the occupation of transmission path; Finally; the hardware design of the wireless communication system of the mine rescue robot is completed based on CC2530 chip; and according to the communication protocol designed;the multi-robot cooperation to complete the rescue task is realized.
keywords: cc2530, coal mine rescue robot, wireless communication, zigbee
affiliations: Hebei Polytechnic Institute

title: Design of Fire Alarm System for Distribution Low-voltage Electrical Appliances Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems of fire alarm in electronic low-voltage distribution system;ZigBee wireless transmission technology is used to realize fire alarm.In hardware;STC89 C52 single chip microcomputer with CC2530 as the core and smoke;temperature and humidity sensor are selected to form hardware equipment combined with ZigBee wireless transmission technology to achieve fire alarm.In software;the compound Kendall-τ trend algorithm is used to judge the ambient data of the building.By comparing data with the preset threshold value;the fire alarm can be sent at the same time.The design scheme can be applied to the fire alarm of electronic low voltage distribution system.
keywords: low-voltage distribution fire alarm, stc89c52mcu, zigbee wireless technology
affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: Design of smart childrestraint system based on CC2541
abstract: In order to realize the monitoring functions of environment detections; intallation detections; sedentary reminder and children anti-abandonment alert; a smart child restraint system is designed. The design is equipped with CC2541 as the control core; uses SBR sensor; ISOFIX sensor; support leg sensor; ambient temperature and humidity MEMS sensor to collect real-time data. The system uses BLE4.0 to communicate with the mobile terminal; and judge child anti-abandonment via RSSI. The system uploads alarms to the cloud server and push the remote alarm to customers through the mobile terminal’s network. After debugging and testing; the smart child restraint system is realized and it can push the remote alarm to emergency contacts in the form of application; SMS and telephone. So it has a certain market promotion value and development prospect for the safety protection and healthy travel of child passengers.
keywords: anti-abandonment, cc2541, crs, rssi
affiliations: Ningbo Baby First Baby Product CO., LTD., School of Information Science and Engineering, Ningbo Tech University, Ningbo University, Business School of Ningbo University

title: Optimal Control of Operation Efficiency of Belt Conveyor in Light Load Mode
abstract: To solve the problem of inefficient operation of belt conveyor in light load mode and serious energy wastage; the optimal scheme of belt conveyor operation efficiency in light load mode based on the combination of particle swarm optimization（PSO） algorithm and back propagation（BP） neural network is designed. The working principle of the belt conveyor and the loss principle are analyzed; and the PSO-BP optimization algorithm is designed to dynamically search for the optimal flux; so that the minimum input active power of the head/tail motor of the belt conveyor is globally optimal and the copper and iron losses are the lowest. The belt conveyor vector frequency conversion speed control scheme with the TMS320LF2407A DSP chip as the core is designed to realize the PSO-BP optimization algorithm. The hardware and software design of the scheme is completed. The optimization test of belt conveyor light load operation efficiency is designed; and the change curves of motor electromagnetic torque; rotor flux; input power and speed data are analyzed when the conveyor is started; and the load changed suddenly. The test results show that the scheme can improve the belt conveyor operating efficiency when the belt conveyor is lightly loaded; and quickly find the best solution to optimize the motor efficiency and ensure the efficient and stable operation of the belt conveyor.
keywords: back propagation（bp）, belt conveyor, keil arm, light load, operating efficiency, partiole swarm optimization（pso）
affiliations: CCTEG Taiyuan Research Institute Co.,Ltd., Shanxi Tiandi Coal Mining Machinery Co.,Ltd., National Engineering Laboratory for Coal Mining Machinery

title: A Method for Individual Identification of Communication Emitter Based on Multi-domain Feature Fusion
abstract: To solve the problem of low identification rate caused by individual identification of communication emitter using a single feature，a method for individual identification of communication emitter based on multi-domain feature fusion is proposed.Firstly，multiple transform domain features of the signals transmitted by the communication emitter are extracted，and these features are combined into multi-domain features.Secondly，the multi-channel convolution neural network is constructed，and the multi-channel convolution operation is used to extract the multi-domain features at a deep level. Finally，the individual classification of the communication emitter is completed based on the neural network classifier.Compared with the individual identification method based on a single feature，this method makes full use of the multi-domain features of the signals sent by the communication emitter and combines the powerful microscopic feature mining ability of the neural network to realize the effective individual identification of the communication emitter. Through the identification of 20 CC2530 devices under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio（SNR） and Rayleigh channel，the results show that this method can significantly improve the identification accuracy and timeliness under a low SNR，and the identification effect can still reach 91.01% under the condition of 0 dB.
keywords: communication emitter identification, feature fusion, low signal-to-noise ratio, multi-channel convolution neural network
authors: ZHANG Jie;WANG Jian;WEI Guofeng;GUO Daoxing;ZHANG Bangning

title: 基于多域特征融合的通信辐射源个体识别方法
abstract: 为解决利用单一特征进行通信辐射源个体识别识别率不高的问题，提出一种基于多域特征融合的通信辐射源个体识别方法。提取通信辐射源发射信号的多个变换域特征，并组合这些特征为多域特征。构建多通道卷积神经网络，利用多通道卷积操作对多域特征进行深层次提取。通过神经网络的分类器，完成了对通信辐射源个体的分类。研究结果表明：与基于单一特征的辐射源个体识别方法相比，新方法充分利用了通信辐射源发射信号的多个变换域特征，结合神经网络的强大细微特征挖掘能力，实现了对通信辐射源个体的有效识别；在低信噪比和瑞利信道条件下对20个CC2530设备进行识别，结果表明该方法能够显著提升在低信噪比的识别准确率和时效性，在0 dB条件下的识别效果仍可达到91.01%。
keywords: 低信噪比, 多通道卷积神经网络, 特征融合, 通信辐射源识别
authors: 张洁;王检;张邦宁;魏国峰;郭道省
affiliations: 陆军工程大学通信工程学院

title: 一种脑卒中手部康复设备研究
abstract: 在手部康复设备的帮助下，可以使脑卒中患者手部得到早日恢复，极大提高患者的自理能力。使用这种设备可以缩短康复周期，且复健费用显著降低。文中提出了一种建设性康复设备解决方案，设备基于Arduino Nano和12个微型伺服器SG90制作而成，具有完整的机械结构并可以对手指进行按摩，获得手指的反应力进行生物反馈。使用2、4、6、8或12个伺服器组装Rehab Helper，用于1、2、3、4或5+1（左/右手）根手指。运动力由桥式传感器测量，可以在PC端直观得到手指反应力数据，并对数据做出分析，医护人员可以结合数据对患者进行更精确、快速的评估。
keywords: arduino nano, cc2541, hx711, 伺服器, 手部康复设备, 脑卒中
authors: 王铮;杨博;成尔卓;廖浩添;史建新
affiliations: 南开大学滨海学院

title: 基于无线传感器网络的智能开关节点定位算法研究与实现
abstract: 针对复杂环境下的智能开关节点定位结果误差较大的问题，文中提出了一种基于RSSI的智能开关节点测距定位算法。文中对RSSI节点测距方案模型进行了MATLAB仿真，并通过改变仿真参数来分析其仿真结果的变化趋势，通过基于CC2530的智能开关节点测距试验来验证该算法的短距离高精度特性。实验结果表明，短距离的定位误差可以控制在10%左右，且对环境衰减因子的优化可以提高智能开关节点间的测距精度，并得出理论距离与误差率的变化关系图。同时，基于CC2530的RSSI测距技术能用于短距离的智能开关节点测距。
keywords: cc2530, 定位误差, 接收信号强度, 无线传感器网络, 测距精度, 节点定位
authors: 段勇强;张建业;李正刚;曾凡伟;廖红华;钟建伟
affiliations: 国网湖北省电力有限公司恩施供电公司湖北民族大学信息工程学院

title: Design of the TMS320F28335-based Coal Mine Integrated Mining Monitoring Device
abstract: As automation technology; intelligent control technology and information technology are enriched and developed; a new coal mine safety monitoring device for coal mine safety monitoring is designed.The system adopts TMS320 F28335 digital processor for the orderly work of detection module; monitoring module; communication module and upper computer module through the command; monitoring underground environmental indicators; the Code Composer Studio platform and YKSe touch screen software are used to design system programming and upper computer interface; cylinder explosion-proof housing is adopted to detect; display and automatically alarm the underground gas concentration; dust concentration; wind speed; temperature and humidity; mine car load; and roadway condition; etc.Through the experiment; it can been seen that the system can realize the functions of information collection; information processing; data upload; upper computer display and automatic alarm of over-threshold value after powering up.The feasibility of the design has been proved by the experiment.
keywords: digital processor, explosion-proof housing, information collection, integrated coal mine monitoring
affiliations: School of New Energy and Power Engineering,Lanzhou Jiaotong University

title: Design of Wireless Medical Infusion Monitor Based on CC2530
abstract: In order to solve the problems of abnormal situations in the traditional infusion process; such as the inability to monitor in time and the unreasonable allocation of medical staff; an infusion monitoring system is designed in this paper. The system uses CC2530 single-chip microcomputer as the main control chip; and uses infrared tube to detect and display the infusion speed. When the infusion is over; it can alarm in time and intelligently disconnect the infusion valve to prevent blood return; and realize sound and light alarm. The system wirelessly sends data to the nurse station computer through 2.4GHz to realize long-distance wireless communication; and the upper computer can monitor the infusion status of each bed in the ward without on-site real-time monitoring. The experimental results show that the system can normally realize the alarm function when the infusion is abnormal and completed. The error between the measured value and the actual value of the infusion rate can be controlled within ±1 drop. When the communication distance is less than 60m; the data packet loss rate is almost zero. The system adopts the information closed-loop management design method; which has the advantages of low power consumption; small size and strong scalability.
keywords: cc2530, infrared detection, infusion monitoring, wearable device, zigbee
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information, Henan Polytechnic University

title: Robot Path Tracking System Based on Embedded Image Recognition
abstract: In order to solve the poor tracking accuracy of traditional path tracking system; a robot path tracking system based on embedded image recognition is designed in this paper.The system uses the image acquisition module of the kernel driver layer to drive the CCD camera of the hardware layer to collect the image information of the driving path and transmit it to the control module of the same layer.The control module uses TMS320 DM6437 embedded control chip to transmit the image information to the image recognition module of the business support layer.The image recognition module identifies the path information through the process of edge extraction and transmits the recognition result to the path tracking module; and displays the path tracking result in the interface of the wireless communication network in the communication module.The experiment results show that the displacement deviation of the robot path tracking results obtained by the system is less than 2 cm and the angle deviation is less than 1° under different light intensity; indicating that the system has excellent path tracking performance.
keywords: ccd camera, image recognition, path tracking system, tms320dm6437
affiliations: Electronic Information Technology Research Center, Ankang University

title: Design of Distributed Storage and Parallel Computing System in Medium Voltage Environment
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor data storage capacity and poor data calculation and analysis capacity in the current medium and low voltage environment; a new type of computing system is proposed.The method designs a set of distributed storage and parallel computing system including data layer; storage layer; computing layer and application layer.The system is compatible with HBASE+HIVE+SPARK multiple data storage methods and improves data compatibility.Through Calling functions; data interaction and storage between different data attributes are realized.Also through the introduction of TMS320 C6713 chip; the data calculation ability has been improved.The experiment results show that the method of this research effectively improves the ability of distributed data storage and calculation of medium and low voltage equipment and has certain technological progress.
keywords: calling function, data compatibility, medium and low voltage environment, tms320c6713
authors: Song Guangming;Liu Yun;Zhao Aihua;Huang Shaoxiong;Cheng Chen
affiliations: Chizhou Power Supply Company, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd., Hefei Power Supply Company, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd., State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co., Ltd., Electric Power Research Institute, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd.

title: 小直径存储式多极子阵列声波信号采集处理电路设计
abstract: 本文针对仪器接收声波信号信噪比低、通道多、数据量大、控制时序复杂等特点，设计了一种基于TMS320F28335 DSP的阵列声波数据采集与处理电路，实现了16路声波信号的并行数据采集。在设计中，根据有用声波信号和干扰信号频谱的特点，用MATLABFDATool工具箱设计了FIR数字滤波器算法，为了减少数据传输时间和存储的数据量，本文实现了ADPCM数据压缩算法，所有算法通过C语言编程在DSP上得到了实现。试验结果表明，该电路工作非常稳定可靠，性能优异，能够满足多极子阵列声波信号采集和处理的要求。
keywords: dsp, 多极子阵列声波, 存储式, 数字滤波器, 数据压缩
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第二十二研究所

title: Design of Positioning System Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: This paper designs a positioning system based on wireless sensor network; which uses CC2530 chip as the core controller. Through the cooperation of anchor nodes; target nodes and sink nodes; the location information of target nodes can be accurately determined and displayed on the monitoring host. Experiments show that the system has high positioning accuracy and great popularization value.
keywords: cc2530, positioning system, wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Automation, Shenyang Institute of Engineering

title: 太阳能物联网的食用菌无线监测节点设计
abstract: The wireless collection node of edible fungi is an important part of the remote monitoring system of edible fungi. Using the technology of Internet of Things; a wireless monitoring node of edible fungi based on solar Internet of Things is designed and intelligent control technology. The acquisition node is composed of solar panel module; solar charge management module; lithium battery; single-chip microcomputer controller; RS232/485 conversion circuit; CO2 sensor; light sensor; temperature sensor; humidity sensor; LCD touch display module; CC2530 communication module; relay drive module and so on. The network of each node is realized by porting the Zstack2007 protocol stack of TI company; and each acquisition node sends the collected data to the data concentrator wirelessly. The test results show that the system works stably and meets the design requirements.
keywords: edible fungi, internet of things, remote monitoring, wireless monitoring node
authors: 韦树贡;宋俊慷;黄梅春;杨秀增
affiliations: 广西民族师范学院物联网技术集成与应用重点实验室

title: Design of Indoor Environment Real-time Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high power consumption; high cost; complicated wiring and inability to self-organize the network in the current environmental monitoring system; a real-time monitoring system for indoor environment based on the Internet of Things was designed in this study.The system was developed based on CC2530;and used the ZigBee and GPRS hybrid networking mode to realize wireless transmission of temperature and humidity; smoke concentration; and human infrared information; and was designed and implemented a host computer monitoring system for remote monitoring and alarming by using LabVIEW.According to the test; the system was realized high measurement accuracy; good stability and scalability between nodes; and it has a certain application value in the field of indoor environmental monitoring.
keywords: real-time monitoring system for indoor environment, the internet of things, wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Computer Science, Huainan Normal University

title: Design of vehicle data recorder based on redundant storage
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional vehicle data recorder;such as the lack of video data recording function;the inability to playback the video data in real time;and the easy loss of the stored data;a vehicle data recorder based on redundant storage was designed. TMS320 DM8168 was used as the main video processing chip to realize the video data recording and playback function of the recorder. Two solid state hard disks are managed by database to realize the redundancy storage function of the recorder.Combined with the experimental results of 72 hours continuous operation and high and low temperature storage;it is shown that the recorder runs stably;the video recording and playback function is practical;and the data storage reliability is high.
keywords: data recorder, redundant storage, tms320dm8168, video recording
affiliations: School of Information and Communication Engineering,North University of China

title: Design of wireless temperature measurement system for icing wind tunnel based on ZigBee technology
abstract: Temperature is an important measurement parameter of icing wind tunnel. The wired temperature sensor has some limitations due to its long-distance wiring. In order to improve the efficiency of temperature measurement;a wireless temperature measurement system based on ZigBee technology is designed in this paper. The temperature measurement device uses CC2530 to drive Max31865 chip to realize the temperature signal acquisition of Pt100 platinum resistance. The temperature data is transmitted to the coordination node connected to the monitoring host through ZigBee wireless network. The temperature acquisition software is designed to realize the acquisition;storage and processing of temperature signal at the temperature measurement point. The temperature measurement system is applied to the icing wind tunnel test. The practical application shows that the wireless temperature measurement system based on ZigBee technology has good application in icing wind tunnel test and has high measurement accuracy;the measurement accuracy can reach 0.6 ℃ in the range from-20 ℃ to 0 ℃.
keywords: cc2530, icing wind tunnel, max31865, pt100, wireless temperature measurement, zigbee
authors: XIONG Jianjun;LI Ziyu;RAN Lin;ZHAO Zhao;GUO Xiangdong
affiliations: Key Laboratory of Icing and Anti/De-Icing,China Aerodynamics Research and Development Center

title: Research on Rotor Angle Detection of Permanent Magnet Motor Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: The rotor angle of permanent magnet motor has an important influence on the control of the motor. At present; the resolver is widely used in the permanent magnet traction motor to detect the rotor angle and speed information. Based on the TMS320 F28377 D dual-core CPU combined with AD2 S1210 decoding chip; a rotor position detection system is formed. Angle segment compensation is used for error correction. Thus; the accurate rotor angle information is provided for the permanent magnet motor control algorithm. The rotor angle information output by the decoding chip under different rotor frequencies is verified by the hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform. The detection method has the characteristics of high precision and strong anti-interference ability. It can meet the requirements of high reliability and stability of the traction system. The results of the simulation and experiments show the feasibility and effectiveness of the angle detection method proposed.
keywords: ad2s1210, permanent magnet motor, resolver, tms320f28377d
affiliations: CRRC Dalian R＆D Co., Ltd.

title: 基于ZigBee网络的家庭燃气阀门智能安全系统
abstract: 物联网家居在我国发展迅速，一大批智能家居逐渐涌现，在此基础上我设计出一款家庭燃气智能安全系统。本产品采用ZigBee网络技术通过MQ-2气体传感器对空气中燃气进行检测采集，从而实现燃气的多处无线监测。当监测到燃气泄漏时，CC2530模块通过控制继电器开关自动关闭电磁燃气阀门并且蜂鸣报警器发出报警声音，与此同时GSM移动通讯模块向用户发送短信提醒。本设计可广泛应用于家庭燃气监测。
keywords: zigbee, 天然气阀门, 物联网技术
affiliations: 安徽三联学院

title: 基于超声波和ZigBee的多点检测报警系统设计与开发
abstract: 为了测量多个点位的距离并对不同点位的特定距离范围做出不同的报警提示，以便于探测障碍物、计算空间大小、做出危险警示等，开发了可实现无线多点位的超声波测距报警系统。首先，使用多个HC-SR04超声波测距传感器对多个不同方位点的距离进行测量，超声波传感器的布局可在有效范围内根据实际场景进行布置。然后，通过ZigBee的点对点无线通信方式把测量到的距离传输到声光报警传感器所在的CC2530开发板。最后，通过Python编写的串口程序在PC上显示距离、提示信息和报警情况统计等，且依次在LED上显示几个超声波传感器发来的数据和相应的提示信息，这样可以看到在多个点检测到的不同距离，只要有一个方向达到报警要求蜂鸣器就会响起。经测试表明，本系统可以达到预期效果，成本低、算法简单，可实现多点位距离的测量与报警，具有一定实际应用价值。
keywords: zigbee技术, 串口通信, 传感器, 报警系统, 点对点无线传输, 超声波测距
authors: 张敏贤;张志伟;马涛;韩小龙;吴明静;冯晟;黄义行
affiliations: 绍兴文理学院机械与电气工程学院

title: Design of PCB Production Line Energy Consumption Monitoring System Based on Cloud Platform
abstract: Due to the high energy consumption of PCB manufacturing enterprises; a PCB production line energy consumption monitoring system based on a cloud platform is designed. The system uses CC2530 as the main processor and consists of several data collection terminals; a data gateway and OneNET cloud server. The data collection terminal sends sensor data to the data gateway through ZigBee wireless network; and the gateway connects to the cloud server through WiFi. Managers can view the data of PCB production line energy consumption; output and workshop environment through computers; pads; mobile phones and other terminals anytime and anywhere. This provides data support for optimizing production planning and improving the efficiency of air-conditioning systems; which can reduce the company’s electricity expenses and increase efficiency of the production line.
keywords: cc2530, cloud platform, energy consumption monitoring, printed circuit board（pcb）, zigbee
authors: LIU Xuping;Dongguan Polytechnics;CHEN Ruijie;YU Xiaoqiong;JIANG Jian
affiliations: Guangdong Hetong Jianye Technology Co., Ltd.

title: High Efficient QR Decomposition by Vector Technology on Multi-core DSP
abstract: The multi-core DSP（Digital Signal Process） cluster system with multi-core DSP as the computing node has become a major development trend. At the current stage， due to the insufficient utilization of multi-core DSP hardware computing resources and memory access bandwidth limitations， there is gap between peak performance and actual performance. Based on the rich instruction set architecture of the C66x core and the principle of operation instruction arrangement， combined with the assembly information provided by the compiler， this paper designing and optimizing the QR decomposition algorithm， which fully exploiting the extreme performance of the DSP single core and reducing the calculation time of matrix decomposition. Then， according to the optimization technology， a large-scale parallel QR decomposition model based on multi-core DSP cluster system is designed and implemented， and the decomposition task is completed on the distributed computing frame. The research results show that the optimized QR decomposition computation efficiency and the C66x single-core hardware resource utilization rate are both increased by more than 20 times. As the size of the matrix to be decomposed increases exponentially， the multi-core DSP cluster’s computing performance has improved more significant compared to single-core.
keywords: digital signal process, multi-core dsp cluster, qr decomposition, software optimization, tms320c6678

title: 基于ZigBee技术的避雷器放电次数监测装置的设计
abstract: 以牵引变电所内用氧化锌避雷器计数器为应用场景;基于ZigBee技术设计了一款氧化锌避雷器放电次数智能监测装置;完成硬件电路设计和试验;实现了监测终端智能组网、放电次数监测与显示、超次数报警等功能。监测数据能够实时传输至后台服务器;能够融入泛在电力物联网中;实现电力保护设备运行状态的智能监测。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 光电隔离, 避雷器
affiliations: 柳州铁道职业技术学院

title: A Design of Power Quality Monitoring and Analysis System Based on ZigBee and LabVIEW
abstract: Aiming at the problems of communication circuit and data analysis of traditional power quality monitoring and analysis system; a power quality monitoring and analysis system is designed based on ZigBee and LabVIEW. The data acquisition module of the system is composed of ADS8364 and TMS320F2812; and the data communication module is constructed by CC2430. The analysis of power quality indexes such as voltage deviation; frequency deviation and harmonic is realized by LabVIEW platform. The experimental results show that the system can realize the monitoring and analysis of power quality; and the error meets the national power quality standards; which has certain practical value.
keywords: labview, power quality, zigbee
affiliations: College of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shangluo University, Key Laboratory of Modern Power System Simulation and Control ＆ Renewable Energy Technology of Ministry of Education, Northeast Electric Power University

title: 一种基于DSP的惯性寻北组件通讯软件可靠性设计方法
abstract: 惯性寻北组件通讯软件是寻北组件对内部设备、外部设备及上位机通讯的综合处理和控制软件，软件基于TMS320C6713型DSP实现。首先，针对外部接口众多而中断资源有限的情况，提出了一种可靠的软件复用方式，通过轮询查看的方法确保中断服务程序在有限次查询后能够退出，避免了外部接口有高频干扰产生时，中断响应函数无法退出的情况；其次，通过循环队列完成CAN数据发送的方法避免了多帧CAN数据发送时阻塞CAN总线的情况；最后，通过循环队列定时进行EEPROM参数存储的方法，避免多个参数连续写入时影响系统指令和流程处理的情况。
keywords: dsp通讯软件, eeprom读写, 中断复用, 可靠性设计
authors: 李朝阳;李旬;卫瑞;刘建;高艳

title: 基于DSP的六相永磁同步电机控制器的设计
abstract: 由于驱动系统不再受到电机相数的限制，多相电机因控制灵活、系统稳定性强等优点而广泛应用在电力机车牵引、电动/混合燃料汽车驱动等领域。针对六相永磁同步电机SVPWM控制策略的实现，设计了一种以DSP-TMS320F28335为主控板的控制芯片，同时搭载功率模块为Infineon的FS400R07A1E3与驱动模块为Power Integrations的6SP0110T，并配置相对应的外围电路，从而实现了满足六相永磁同步电机可用的电机控制器。以六相永磁同步电机为研究对象，基于电机的数学模型与最优开关次数六相SVPWM的算法，根据控制器主控板的核心处理器DSP-TMS320F28335芯片、英飞凌的IGBT模块、驱动系统的选型，给出了AD采样调理电路、转子位置角检测电路、PWM脉冲信号处理电路等相关外围电路的硬件设计方案。其次，阐述了软件系统的设计方法，设计了主程序处理流程及中断程序处理流程图，并分析了最优开关次数的六相SVPWM算法流程，从而完成六相永磁同步电机控制器的设计。经实验平台验证，该软硬件系统实现了基于最优开关次数六相SVPWM控制策略的以DSP为核心的电机控制器功能，对比分析电机运行的谐波开环控制与谐波闭环控制的实验数据，表明基于最优开关次数六相SVPWM调制算法的电机控制器具有稳定的调速性能，谐波含量控制效果显著，且开关损耗更小，具有一定的工程应用价值。
keywords: dsp, igbt, svpwm, 六相永磁同步电机, 硬件系统, 软件设计
affiliations: 闽江师范高等专科学校厦门唯质电气科技有限公司

title: 基于IoT的智能输液系统的设计与实现
abstract: 该系统在物联网环境下将Zigbee技术与输液器合二为一，实现了智能输液服务。系统利用特殊的传感器检测液体流动进度，当输液管中液体液面流经传感器时，传感器可以输出低电平信号至终端CC2530芯片，终端CC2530芯片再通知智能机械控流开关夹住输液管，阻止液体流动，同时向协调器CC2530芯片发送房间号信息，通知护士为对应房间换液。
keywords: zigbee, 智能输液, 物联网
affiliations: 上海工程技术大学

title: Research on Internet of Things Acquisition System in Greenhouse Based on the Improved Kalman Data Fusion Algorithm
abstract: In view of the traditional greenhouses’ disadvantages such as low precision of collected data; complicated wiring and huge energy consumption; an internet of things acquisition system in greenhouse based on the improved Kalman data fusion algorithm is studied. Hardware of the system mainly includes CC2530 chip and STM32 microprocessor. It first makes pre-treatment on the collected data with Romanowsky criterion and then carries out static fusion of the data at the nodes of coordinator with Kalman filter algorithm. Temperature is selected to serve as the observing variable for simulation and test. As shown by the result; the error of temperature processed by Kalman data fusion algorithm is no more than 0.089 ℃ and the processed data is closer to the actual value of the environment. The improved Kalman data fusion algorithm optimizes the data collection precision and system stability effectively. The research results could serve as reference for the application of data collection technology in agricultural intelligence.
keywords: data fusion, error, kalman filtering algorithm, romanovsky criterion, wireless sensor network
authors: BAO Shangling;LI Shaonian;WEI Liejiang;LI Yi;YANG Pan;LI Jinping

title: 智慧农业大棚环境监测系统研究与设计
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things technology;the environmental monitoring of agricultural greenhouses is also developing in the direction of intelligence and digitization.This paper adopts ZigBee wireless sensor network technology;with CC2530 microcontroller as the main controller;ZigBee node is equipped with DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor;YL-69 humidity capacitive sensor;MH-Z14 carbon dioxide gas sensor;BH1750FVI photoelectric sensor to monitor the environmental parameters in the shed in real time.Through ZigBee coordinator and wireless communication module;remote monitoring and intelligent management of greenhouse environmental data are realized.After testing;the system is stable and reliable;and meets the design requirements.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着物联网技术的快速发展;农业大棚的环境监测也在向智能化和数字化方向发展.本文采用ZigBee无线传感器网络技术;以CC2530单片机作为主控制器;ZigBee节点搭载DHT11温湿度传感器、YL-69湿敏电容传感器、MH-Z14二氧化碳气体传感器、BH1750FVI光电传感器对棚内环境参数实时监测;通过ZigBee协调器和无线通信模块;实现了大棚环境数据的远程监控和智能化管理.经过测试;系统运行稳定;可靠性强;满足设计要求.
keywords: cc2530 microcontroller, greenhouse environment, sensor, zigbee technology
affiliations: 三门峡职业技术学院信息传媒学院
source: 新一代信息技术;2022年第3期26-28;63;共4页

title: RSSI-based Weighted Centroid Localization Algorithm for Moving Targets in Mines
abstract: Based on the received signal strength（RSSI） positioning technology; the centroid positioning algorithm and weight factor are optimized to improve the positioning accuracy of moving targets in coal mines. The method performs Gaussian mixture filtering on the RSSI values; uses the maximum expectation algorithm（EM algorithm） to do cluster analysis on the data; and selects the distribution model with the smallest AIC value as the algorithm calculation model according to the Akaike Information Criterion（AIC）. Finally; the weighted centroid algorithm is introduced into the power value to obtain the positioning coordinates. The CC2530 sensor nodes; as the communication nodes; are used in the experimental verification; which shows that the optimized weighted centroid algorithm has less positioning error.
keywords: moving target localization in mines, positioning accuracy, rssi ranging, weight correction, weighted centroid algorithm
affiliations: College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Shanxi Datong University, College of Coal Engineering,Shanxi Datong University

title: Design of air humidifier system based on STM32
abstract: This paper designs and implements an intelligent humidifier; which adopts STM32 processor. This household intelligent humidifier includes two parts: hardware design and software design. The hardware design part includes:temperature and humidity acquisition module; which mainly collects the temperature and humidity of the surrounding environment of the equipment; and then sends the collected data to MCU for corresponding processing. The alarm module judges that the temperature and humidity enter a dangerous value according to different set thresholds; and the active high-level buzzer will give an alarm. The character display module uses LCD to display the collected temperature and humidity value; Bluetooth transparent transmission module adopts cc2541 Bluetooth module to transmit control instructions and control equipment switch and temperature and humidity threshold. The software design part includes:main control program processing; temperature and humidity detection and processing of data; setting of threshold;alarm of temperature and humidity exceeding the limit.
keywords: air humidification, cc2541, stm32, usart serial communication
affiliations: College of Intelligent Manufacturing, Hunan University of Science and Engineering

title: Environment Simple Monitoring and Remote Management Control System Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: People’s requirements for living environment make the monitoring of living environment and intelligent monitoring under simple conditions become particularly important. This paper describes a simple environmental monitoring and remote management control system based on Internet of things technology. The sensor is used to detect and collect environmental parameters; and the CC2530 single chip microcomputer of the terminal is used for data packaging processing. The Zig Bee wireless network is used to realize multi node wireless acquisition. The gateway node is composed of Zig Bee coordinator based on CC2530 single chip microcomputer and simplelink cc3200 wireless MCU. After receiving the environmental parameters; simplelink cc3200 wireless MCU is used to upload the detected environmental parameters to Alibaba cloud server; and access the server through mobile App to realize remote monitoring and control management; At the same time; CC2530 MCU communicates with the host computer through the serial port; and the host computer stores the data in the local database for storage. To realize the environment simple detection and remote control management under the Internet of things technology.
keywords: internet of things, sensors, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Wuhan Jianchun Technology Co., Ltd., Wuhan South Yang Technology Co., Ltd., Qingdao Haiwen Intelligent Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd.

title: A Multi-Channel Parallel Communication Design for Multi-Embedded Controllers Based On TMS320F28335
abstract: TMS320F28335 is a digital signal processing chip from TI company; which has rich external interfaces with high reliability.TMS320F28335 is applied widely in the field of airbone electrical; interface and control. A method with McBSP interface and DMA function is designed for the demand of the multi-machine communication by embedded controllers based on TMS320F28335.The hardware interfaces of multi-controllers are directly connected; and the software automatically completes the data transfer through the DMA by this design; avoiding the occupation of the DSP kernel by the communication. This design realizes an economical and reliable multi-machine communication solution.
keywords: dma, gpio, mcbsp, tms320f28335
affiliations: China National Aeronautical Radio Electronics Research Institute

title: Design of portable electronic call system based on Zigbee
abstract: In view of the redundant queuing mechanism and the problem of not being able to pick up meals in time;this paper designs a portable electronic call bell based on Zigbee;which includes the active call module and the passive answer module;in which the active call module uses Zigbee wireless sensing network and passive answer module for data communication;and after the active module sends the signal;the passive module will beep;vibrate;LED flash to remind customers to pick up meals. This design solves the problem of long queue time and unable to obtain the information of the meal in time;reduces the time cost between the merchant and the customer;and improves the comfort of the customer’s consumption order.
keywords: cc2530, wirelesssensing, zigbee
affiliations: School of electrical and computer science,Jilin Jianzhu university

title: Design of Wireless Fire Signal Conversion Module Based on SPI Bus Technology
abstract: In wireless fire control systems; the stable startup of fire control equipment is particularly important; and the quick and accurate startup of fire control equipment can be achieved through different bus protocol conversion methods. In order to solve the problem of controlling the stable start of wired fire-fighting equipment in a wireless way; this paper designs a wireless signal conversion module based on SPI bus technology; including SPI bus advantages and working principle; hardware circuit connection; software programming; host computer design; etc. As a result; the equipment of the wireless fire control system can be started stably; and the serial port resources of the microcontroller can be saved for the communication with other devices; which will improve the transmission efficiency and the utilization of the built-in resources of the microcontroller; and has high practical value.
keywords: c8051f040, cc2530, spi bus
affiliations: Jilin Jianzu University
source: Journal of Jilin Teachers Institute of Engineering and Technology.

title: Design of an Ultra-Low Energy Surface EMG Signal Acquisition System
abstract: A portable weak surface electromyogram（sEMG）signal acquisition system is proposed which feature of ultra-low power consumption. The sEMG signal of human arm is connected to the detection circuit through silver patch electrode; and then sampled by the built-in ADC of Silicon Lab’s EFM32 TG840 F32 after signal amplification and filtering process. CC2541;which is a low Bluetooth module; is adopted to achieve wireless transmission of the acquired data at the transparent transmission mode. Ultra-low power consumption can be achieved by adaptively switching the working mode（EM1 to EM4）with different working power of EFM32 TG840 F32. The system only works at EM1 with relatively higher power consumption during the data acquisition process of ADC and switchs into deep sleep mode with relatively low power consumption in the data transmission process. When the system is idle; it would switch into the stop mode of EM4 with the lowest power consumption. Ultimately; the maximum power consumption of the proposed system is less than 46 mW;which makes it promising in many domains including health monitoring.
keywords: efm32, surface electromyography, ultra-low power consumption
affiliations: School of Optoelectronic Science and Engineering, Soochow University
risk.affiliations: Soochow University (苏州大学)
