title: A Low-cost Controller Software Scheme Design Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: Current industrial real-time controller adopts "ARM+DSP+FPGA" software architecture; which has the disadvantages of complex data flow; high development difficulty and high cost. Therefore; this paper proposes a single MCU control system platform software scheme based on TMS320F28377D. It utilizes the dual-core feature of TMS320F28377D and hardware protocol stack chip to realize Ethernet communication; so that one core realizes motor algorithm control; and the other one completes functions such as logic program control; waveform monitoring; fault recording and external communication. The platform not only meets the functional requirements of industrial real-time controllers; but also greatly simplifies data flow of the control system;which reduces the difficulty of software development of controller platform; the number of developers of the platform is reduced from 3 to 1; and decreases the product cost to a large extent. The logic and control software based on the software architecture of the controller have been effectively applied in air conditioning screw machine inverter products; which verifies the reliability of the controller scheme.
keywords: data flow, ethernet communication, industrial real-time controller, software architecture
affiliations: CRRC Zhuzhou Institute Co., Ltd.

title: Indoor Temperature; Humidity and Smoke Signal Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: For the high cost of wired communication and tedious wiring problems; this paper proposes a ZigBee-based indoor temperature; humidity and smoke signal monitoring system. With ZigBee wireless sensor network and Wi-Fi network the means of communication; the system uses DTH11 sensor to collect indoor temperature and humidity with CC2530 as the coordinator processing chip; and MQ-2 smoke sensor to monitor indoor combustible gas concentration; and finally transmits the data to the cloud platform for display; so that users can check indoor temperature and humidity and smoke concentration anytime and anywhere. The system test shows that the system has low power consumption and high reliability; which can meet the needs of practical use.
keywords: cc2530, cloud platform, smart home, wi-fi, zigbee
affiliations: School of Electrical and Computer, Jilin Jianzhu University
source: Journal of Anhui Electrical Engineering Professional Technique College.

title: 基于CC2530的无线数据远距离通信模拟设计及应用
abstract: Zigbee技术作为一种常用的通信技术，主要采用双向通信的方式，实现无线短距离通信，但是为了实现点对点通信，硬件设计通常会涉及到原理图设计、制版工艺以及元器件布局等因素，导致Zigbee通信距离不断缩短，从而对Zigbee技术的发展产生了一定的限制作用。为了保证Zigbee远距离通信效果，现利用CC2530主芯片和CC2591射频前端芯片两种芯片，并借助ADS软件，对功率放大电路进行科学化仿真处理，以实现对其结构的优化设计，将软件程序与硬件电路进行有效地融合，以保证远距离通信模块的实现效果。
keywords: cc2530芯片, 无线数据, 设计, 远距离, 通信模拟
affiliations: 烟台理工学院信息工程学院

title: Design and Implementation of High Precision Real-time Power Quality Monitoring System
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of power quality monitoring and signal detection accuracy;a design scheme of high performance power quality detection system is proposed.Based on the traditional fast Fourier transform（FFT）;an improved window double-spectrum-line interpolation harmonic detection algorithm is used to process the detected signal;and then the accurate phase amplitude frequency and other parameters are obtained.The accuracy of the algorithm is verified by the sinusoidal signal containing harmonics;and the platform of power quality monitoring is built on digital signal processor（DSP） based on the floating point unit of TMS320F28335.Data stream encoding is improved;filter circuit;voltage type current transformer circuit;current type voltage transformer circuit and voltage lifting circuit are designed;and the feasibility of the design is verified by software simulation.The power quality can be measured by the system accurately in real time.
keywords: monitoring system, power quality, window double-spectrum-line interpolation
affiliations: Leshan Power Supply Company of State Grid Sichuan Electric Power Company

title: Design of Automatic Fire Alarm System Based on Zig Bee
abstract: Large fire control technical problems and limitations exist in traditional wireless fire alarm systems.The emerging alarm method Zigbee automatic alarm technology can fully meet the various functions of the wireless automatic fire warning system.The CC2530 module is used as the core in this article to detect and analyze fire signals.The hardware design mainly includes composite fire detectors;linkage control equipment and other parts.The software design includes coordination node;routing node;automatic fire alarm system;and upper computer display interface design.
keywords: composite fire detector, design of linkage control equipment, ds18b20 data temperature sensor, zigbee
affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: Research and Application of Wind Solar Complementary Power Generation System in Street Lamp
abstract: According to the needs of traditional street lamps;grid connection is required to realize lighting and rely on the demand of stable operation.This paper discusses the use of TMS320F2812 chip to control wind solar complementary street lamps.It is proposed to track the maximum power point of photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation and optimize the charge and discharge of battery.Based on the experimental verification;it can be widely used in low-power wind solar complementary street lamp control system.
keywords: lighting street lamp, maximum power point tracking, wind solar complementary power generation system
affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: Research on Reactive Compensation Device of Novel Magnetically Controlled Reactor Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: The structure and control principle of a new type of reactive compensation device for novel magnetically controlled reactor are introduced. The control system is developed based on TMS320 F28335 chip. The system is mainly composed of power supply module; AC module; CPU module; signal module; DI/DO module as well as the man-machine dialogue module. The compensation control device can not only smoothly adjust the reactive power of the new-type magnetron reactor; but also dynamically compensate the reactive power of the real-time tracking of the power grid; which plays an important role in the safe and stable operation of the power system.
keywords: control system, magnetically controlled reactor, reactive power compensation
affiliations: Datang Sanmenxia Power Generation Co., Ltd., China Datang Corporation Science and Technology Research Institute Co., Ltd., Central South Electric Power Test Research Institute

title: Design of Real-time Control System of Die-casting Machine Based on Embedded Soft PLC
abstract: To realize the real-time control of the injection process of the die-casting machines; the embedded soft PLC control system that supports multi-task real-time scheduling management is designed with AM3358. The Linux operating kernel is transplanted to the hardware; the software PLC control program and the LCD screen interface are designed according to the control scheme od the diecasting machine. The pressure and punch speed sampling; real-time monitoring of die casting status and other hardware modules are configured. The embedded system calls real-time control functions such as pressure and speed of the die-casting machine online; monitors the injection process curve;and improves the response speed of the system; which has important application value for ensuring the quality of die-casting.
keywords: am3358, die-casting machine, embedded soft plc, injection process, linux
affiliations: Hebei University of Petroleum Technology

title: Synchronous Control of Multi-Axis System Based on EtherCAT Real-Time Industrial Ethernet
abstract: In order to realize synchronous motion control of multi-axis system; a servo system design scheme based on EtherCAT real-time industrial Ethernet was proposed. Firstly; the technical principle of EtherCAT was briefly introduced. Then; the overall structure of the system and the specific design of software and hardware were described. The slave station was built by using LAN9252 and TMS320 F28379 D dual-core chip. The slave station program was designed based on the dual-core chip to realize the communication function and servo drive control function. Finally; a synchronization scheme was proposed; in which the high precision synchronization signals generated by EtherCAT in distributed clock mode were used to accurately synchronize the control cycle of each slave station to achieve the synchronization of motion control and the results were verified in a two-axis system. Experimental results show that the servo system based on EtherCAT can meet the requirements of high precision multi-axis synchronous control.

title: 基于ZigBee技术的电气实验室环境监测系统
abstract: 针对CNAS（中国合格评定国家认可委员会）对电气产品检验实验室的温度、湿度、照度的要求，提出了一种基于无线传感器ZigBee网络技术的电气实验室监控系统的方案。该系统硬件使用TI的CC2530射频芯片和SHT35数字温、湿度传感器、光电传感器（硅光电池）BPW34S和PWM LED驱动控制芯片HV9910，在ZigBee协议栈的基础上进行应用开发。通过组网测试表明，ZigBee技术在实现实时温度、湿度、光照等近距离、大容量控制方面具有很大的优势。

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感器的井下甲烷浓度监测系统
abstract: In order to overcome the problems in traditional detection methods;a methane concentration monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network is proposed. The terminal equipment of the system is arranged in the underground roadway;which is responsible for collecting methane concentration information;converting the sensed physical quantity into voltage analog quantity;and then wirelessly transmitting it to the router node. The router node processes and summarizes the data sent by each terminal device and forwards it to the coordinator. The coordinator transmits the data to the monitoring center on the ground through serial port. The experimental results show that the system can realize the functions of the collection of methane concentration;wireless transmission;concentration over-limit alarm;real-time display of concentration data;historical data storage;etc. It can directly monitor the underground methane concentration in the monitoring center on the ground;and realize the real-time detection and safety monitoring of underground methane. Compared with the results obtained by professional detection instruments;the research error is about 1%;which has good theoretical significance and practical application value.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了克服传统检测方法存在的问题;提出了一种基于Zig Bee无线传感器网络的井下甲烷浓度监测系统.本系统的终端设备布置在井下巷道内;负责采集甲烷浓度信息;把感知到的物理量转换为电压模拟量;然后无线传送给路由器节点.路由器节点将各终端设备发送过来的数据处理、汇总;然后转发给协调器.协调器通过串口方式将数据传输到地面监控中心.实验结果显示;本系统实现了甲烷浓度值收集、无线传输、浓度超限报警、浓度数据实时显示及历史数据存储等功能;可以直接在地面监控中心监控到井下的甲烷浓度;完成了井下甲烷的实时检测和安全监控.将本系统得到的检测值与专业检测仪器得到的检测值对比;相对误差仅在1%左右;具有良好的理论意义和实际应用价值.

title: Design of ZigBee-based safety protection system for construction machinery
abstract: According to the special working situation of construction machinery; a safety protection system for construction machinery is designed. ZigBee wireless transmission is adopted in the data transmission mode of the system. The distance between the mechanical equipment and the warehouse bottom is obtained by using the ultrasonic distance measurement module and laser ranging sensor; the fused data information is transmitted to the coordinator and displayed by the terminal node. According to the distance information; the operator can determine the lowering speed of the equipment; so as to avoid hard landing and effectively reduce the failure rate of the equipment. Through the test; the system has a very low packet loss rate and small measurement error; and has a positive significance for reducing the use and maintenance cost of equipment.
keywords: cc2530, construction machinery, data fusion, ranging sensor, zigbee

title: Research on DC Energy Feed AC PEL Based on Passive Control Theory
abstract: In view of the energy waste caused by the traditional energy consumption type Load test; the Load form cannot be adjusted flexibly; the designed DC energy feed-type single-phase AC Power Electronic Load（PEL） can flexibly simulate the Load characteristics; the energy is directly fed back to the DC input side of the inverter to be tested; to achieve the purpose of secondary energy utilization. Improve energy efficiency. In this paper; the topological structure of dc energy fed single-phase AC PEL is firstly introduced; and then the passive control strategy is introduced into the load simulation unit with nonlinear characteristics. The passive controller is designed to make the DC energy fed single-phase AC PEL get better dynamic performance; reduce the static error; and make the load simulation and adjustment more convenient. The energy feedback unit adopts double loop PI control to realize energy recycling. Finally; the Matlab/Simulink simulation model and the prototype system based on TMS320 F28335 are built. The simulation and experimental results show the feasibility of the control strategy adopted.
keywords: energy reutilization, euler lagrange model, passive control, pel, tms320f28335

title: Design and Implementation of Multi-Platform Compatible RTK Precise Positioning System with High Stability and Reliability
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low stability; low reliability and compatibility of RTK precise positioning system; a design method of high stability; high reliability and multi-platform compatible RTK precise positioning system is proposed. The GNSS locating unit is designed based on redundancy method to improve the system compatibility. Based on the working conditions; a redundant differential positioning information interaction mode is designed; and the AM5728 based on ARM+DSP architecture is designed to solve the RTK correction information in real time and share the information through the composite high-speed communication link. The accuracy of the RTK precision positioning system is tested and evaluated by CEP. The evaluation results show CEP=0.0071 m; indicating high positioning accuracy and good reliability. The problems of poor stability and reliability and low system compatibility are solved; and it effectively makes up for the limitations in the field of RTK precise positioning.
keywords: arm+dsp, composite high speed communication link, evaluation of cep positioning results, redundant design, rtk precise positioning

title: Research on landslide monitoring data acquisition system based on Beidou short message communication and internet of things
abstract: The monitoring areas of reservoir bank landslide is often located in remote areas; where the environment is complex and the communication network is poor; so it cannot meet the communication demand of data transmission in the monitoring work. However; using Beidou short message technology can give play to its unique advantages of global communication coverage so that this technology can meet the above demand. In this paper; a Beidou short message communication scheme is adopted to solve the data transmission problem in remote areas. Taking the Baijiabao landslide as an example; a monitoring system for the Baijiabao landslide is established based on the Internet of things; and the hardware and software components of the system are designed respectively. The system integrates two kinds of wireless communication technology: wireless sensor network and the Beidou short message. In the hareware; this system takes CC2530 RF chip as the core; adopts ZigBee802.15.4 agreement to form a wireless sensor network structure; and connects the Beidou short message module on the data gathering node. Finally; the Internet of things system for landslide monitoring is formed; which realizes the acquisition and wireless remote transmission of landslide monitoring data in the communication blind area.
keywords: beidou short message, data acquisition system, internet of things, landslide monitoring, wireless sensor network

title: 基于形式化分析的信号处理模块设计
abstract: 形式化技术是系统开发过程中提高可靠性的一种行之有效的途径，随着形式化技术的发展与普及，它在系统软硬件设计方面得到了一定的应用。以某超短波监测系统中的数字信号处理模块软硬件开发为例，介绍了信号处理模块的硬件设计，描述了该模块的软件设计及使用形式化分析技术在软件开发过程中的应用步骤，为形式化技术在类似产品的开发过程中的应用提供了一定的借鉴。

title: Intelligent Current Sharing of Excitation System based on TMS320F28335 Controller
abstract: Intelligent current sharing control can greatly improve the current sharing characteristics; but it may affect the response speed of excitation system adjustment; increase the current impact intensity ofthyristor during reversing; and cover the actual fault of thyristor components. In this paper; TMS320 F28335 controller is used as the core to realize the intelligent current sharing control of the excitation system; and the parameters of the control model are dynamically adjusted. At the same time; AC sampling and CAN communication are used to improve the anti-interference ability. Finally; the test results show that the intelligent current sharing control improves the current sharing characteristics of the system while avoiding adverse effects.
keywords: excitation system, intelligent current sharing, rectifier bridge, thyristor
affiliations: Fujian Shuikou Power Generation Group Co., Ltd.

title: A highly reliable loading method and implementation of spaceborne multi-core DSP
abstract: In order to respond to the complex intelligent processing application requirements of remote sensing satellites. Single-core DSP can no longer meet real-time requirements. TMS320C6678 is a high-performance multi-core floating-point DSP based on the KeyStone structure; with a main frequency of 1.25 GHz; which meets the needs of satellite application. Regarding the satellite use environment; whether it is FPGA or DSP; configuration loading is very important; and it is about success or failure. This article introduces the loading mode and process of TMS320C6678 in detail; and proposes a high-reliability heterogeneous loading method of Nor Flash based on EMIF16; and a program Bootloader. The test verifies that the TMS320C6678 can operate stably and reliably under the design method of this article.
keywords: 6678, bootloader, emif16, multi-core dsp

title: DSP-FPGA based ADCP system for high sediment concentration flow measurement
abstract: An acoustic Doppler current profiler（ADCP） system based on TMS320C6748 and Spartan-6 is designed for accurate flow measurement under the condition of high sediment concentration. DSP is used to communicate with upper computer; control system; interact with FPGA; receive peripheral data and process signal data. FPGA is used to modulate the measured signal and receive acquired signal. In order to verify the feasibility and accuracy of ADCP system in the high sediment concentration environment; a flow measurement test is carried out in the Yellow River; where the survey vessel is used to install ADCP; which accesses GPS data and Echo sounder data by DSP. Test results show that; in the hydrological environment with sediment concentration of 15.5 kg·m-3; the ADCP system could measure the flow normally and stably; the relative error of flow measurement result is only 1.01%; which meets the requirements of high precision flow measurement system.
keywords: acoustic doppler current profiler（adcp）, dsp-fpga, flow measurement, high sediment content

title: Research on Printing Energy Consumption Detection Method Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Energy consumption detection is an important means of efficiency evaluation in manufacturing plants.In this study; an energy consumption detection system was presented based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology for packaging and printing intelligent factory. The system includes data acquisition part with CC2530 chip and Hall sensor as data acquisition node; wireless data transmission part based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology and upper computer display interface. Compared with the traditional energy consumption detection system based on smart meter; the system has the advantages of flexible sampling arrangement; simple installation;convenient maintenance and low cost. Finally; part of the energy consumption data of the post-press equipment diecutting machine was collected through experiments to verify the feasibility of the system; which provides a basis for the energy consumption data collection of the printing intelligent factory; and provides a direction for other data collection of the intelligent factory.
keywords: energy consumption detection, hall element, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: 基于物联网技术智慧水产养殖系统的研究设计
abstract: 智慧是科技创新的根源力量;科技创新则为时代的进步提供了强大动力;让万物间的联系更紧密;事物间的信息传递速度更快;数据量更大;因此;让科技服务生活生产的各方面是必然的。尤其在水产养殖方面更是如此;由于水体环境复杂;各项环境指数对水产品的生长、品质和产量有直接的影响;因此基于物联网技术开发了一套智慧水产养殖系统;着力解决水产品养殖遇到的各种问题。系统以TI公司研发的CC2530芯片为主控单元;搭配外围各类数据采集传感器以及控制器;构成ZigBee数据处理网络;实现数据实时传递和共享。将命令传递给控制器后;通过WiFi将数据发送到物联网OneNET云平台;并及时反馈给用户;实现解放劳动生产力;自动化高产高质的现代化水产养殖模式。
keywords: cc2530, onenet云平台, wifi, zigbee, 传感器, 物联网
affiliations: 广西水利电力职业技术学院

title: 基于多传感器的温室环境监测系统设计与实现
abstract: 由于兰花对生长环境要求较高;温室内温湿度、光照强度均会对兰花的生长、繁殖造成严重影响。为了满足和调节兰花的生长环境;文中开发了一套基于多传感器的温室环境监测系统。首先;利用温湿度传感器、光敏传感器与ZigBee协调器进行组网;编写传感器的数据采集、数据传输代码;其次;端节点接收到协调器指令后分别解析温湿度、光敏数据;并返回数据给协调器节点;协调器节点再将数据发送至上位机;最后;由上位机图形界面实时显示监测数据。测试结果表明;该监测系统能够通过温湿度传感器和光敏传感器实时监测温室环境;并将监测数据以曲线形式在上位机实时显示。

title: Design and Implementation of Numerical Control Zeta Converter Based on TMS320F28035
abstract: Aiming at the problem of signal ripple and noise caused by the complex algorithm of digital controller; in order to improve the rapidity and stability of the control system; TMS320F28035 is used as the main control chip; and IR2104 is used as the auxiliary power supply circuit of the switch tube driver chip to complete the design of the main circuit of Zeta converter and the digital control system. The design gives full play to the advantages of fast calculation speed and low calculation delay of the controller; and can realize more complex control algorithms to cope with the rapid change of load.Experiments show that the output voltage of this system is stable; the output voltage ripple is small; and it can quickly recover to the set voltage value when the load suddenly changes. It provides an effective technical scheme for the research of digital switching power supply.

title: 基于人工神经网络的永磁电机无传感器控制与实现
abstract: Sensorless control can reduce the cost of permanent magnet motor and improve the reliability of the system. Because the inductance and other parameters of permanent magnet motor change with the operating conditions; the accurate identification of motor parameters has a positive significance to improve the control accuracy of motor. Based on the mathematical model of permanent magnet motor; the parameters of motor inductance are identified by artificial neural network; and then the rotor angle is observed by sliding mode observer(SMO) to realize the sensorless vector control of permanent magnet motor. Using TI′s TMS320 F28379 d DSP as the control chip; a motor control circuit is built to verify the above control strategy. The results show that the control strategy can accurately identify the motor parameters in real time; as well as improve the control precision and performance.
abstract_in_chinese: 无传感器控制可以降低永磁电机的成本;并且提高系统的可靠性。永磁电机的电感等参数受运行工况影响会发生变化;因而准确识别电机参数对提高电机的控制精度具有积极意义。基于永磁电机的电感模型;采用人工神经网络对电机电感进行参数辨识;再通过滑模观测器对转子角度进行观测;实现永磁电机无位置传感器的矢量控制。利用TI公司的TMS320F28379d DSP作为控制芯片;搭建了电机控制电路;对所提控制策略进行了验证。结果表明;该控制策略能实时准确地辨识电机参数;提高控制精度;改善控制性能。
keywords: artificial neural network, dsp, permanent magnet motor, sliding mode observer(smo)

title: 面向FT-M7002平台点积算法的优化实现
abstract: 基于国产的FT-M7002平台高性能DSP;针对不同类型的点积算法进行了优化实现，完善了该处理器平台数学库的技术链，充分发挥了FT-M7002内核体系结构优势，对点积算法实现了SIMD向量并行化、DMA双通道传输和SVR传输等优化。该研究充分挖掘了程序的向量并行性，有效地提升了数据传输的速度，提高了程序性能。实验结果表明，输入不同规模大小的数组，不同类型的点积算法在FT-M7002平台上优化后和优化前的平均性能比为12.416 6～45.233 8。相较于TI官网的dsplib库中不同类型的点积函数在TMS320C6678处理器上运行的性能，FT-M7002平台优化后的性能与TI平台的平均性能比为1.371 6～4.519 6。实验结果表明了该DSP平台相对于TI主流平台的计算性能优势。

title: 基于DSP的整流器SPWM调制方法优化设计与实现
abstract: 针对整流器调制过程易产生谐波干扰和非线性等问题，提出了一种DSP控制下SPWM调制的优化设计方法，以TMS320F2812型DSP为主控制器，对交流电压电流调理电路、直流电压调理电路、负载电流调理电路进行了设计、分析与计算，在DSP定时器周期中断下对电压、电流信号进行采样，将采样值优化后作为调制波采样时刻值，带入比较寄存器关系式中来改变比较寄存器的值，从而改变脉冲信号的占空比，通过Modbus协议以MCGS触摸屏下发调制度M;改变SPWM波形，并对电压信号进行显示。对系统进行了仿真和实验，结果表明系统输出信号正常、可靠，具有较强的稳定性和抗扰性。
keywords: dsp, mcgs, spwm调制, 整流器
affiliations: 陕西国防工业职业技术学院

title: 面向应急机器人的机械臂无线控制系统设计
abstract: 针对处理油气场站有毒气体泄漏事故的应急机器人，设计一种基于DSP和AR9331模块的机械臂无线控制系统；该系统用6个舵机配合金属支架搭建机械臂硬件结构，以TMS320F28335 DSP为核心处理器，利用其ePWM模块驱动舵机，同时通过AR9331 WiFi模块和DSP的SCI模块实现DSP与上位机之间的无线通信，由此完成了该无线控制系统的全部搭建；实验过程中，在上位机端通过无线通信模块向DSP发送各种控制指令，对各个舵机进行协调控制，从而控制机械臂进行清理障碍物、启闭阀门等应急处理操作，验证了该无线控制系统的可行性；实验结果表明该机械臂无线控制系统控制精度高、调节速度快、可靠性高；机械臂能够在0.5 s内接收并完成指令，舵机角度误差在1°以内，满足应急机器人的操作需求。
keywords: ar9331, dsp, pwm, sci, 应急机器人, 无线控制, 机械臂
affiliations: 中国石油大学(华东)新能源学院

title: 基于ZigBee技术的避雷器放电次数监测装置的设计
abstract: 以牵引变电所内用氧化锌避雷器计数器为应用场景;基于ZigBee技术设计了一款氧化锌避雷器放电次数智能监测装置;完成硬件电路设计和试验;实现了监测终端智能组网、放电次数监测与显示、超次数报警等功能。监测数据能够实时传输至后台服务器;能够融入泛在电力物联网中;实现电力保护设备运行状态的智能监测。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 光电隔离, 避雷器
affiliations: 柳州铁道职业技术学院

title: 一种高可靠的星载多核DSP加载方式及实现
abstract: 为了应对遥感卫星复杂的智能处理应用需求，单核的数字信号处理器已无法满足实时性要求，而多核DSP处理性能更高，可以满足卫星应用需求。提出了一种多核DSP加载的高可靠方法，利用FPGA对存放的Nor Flash中程序进行纠错回写，应对空间单粒子翻转影响，可以保障卫星可靠运行，方法新颖、可靠。TMS320C6678是基于KeyStone结构的高性能多核浮点DSP;详细介绍了TMS320C6678的加载模式和流程，并提出基于EMIF16的Nor Flash高可靠异构加载方式，以及程序Bootloader。经测试验证，TMS320C6678能够稳定可靠运行。该方法支持在轨可重构，适应目前快速发展的星上智能处理发展趋势。
keywords: 6678, bootloader, emif16, 多核dsp
affiliations: 中国空间技术研究院西安分院

title: 基于DSP的无刷直流电动机双闭环PID伺服系统设计
abstract: 针对传统直流电动机采用机械换相、调速性能差、启动转矩小、抗干扰性差等关键技术问题，研究设计了一种采用PID双闭环控制的无刷直流电动机控制系统。首先，分析了无刷直流电动机的工作原理和数学模型；然后，基于Matlab/Simulink搭建了无刷直流电动机控制系统仿真模型，采用电流-转速双闭环PI调速方式，提高系统的调速性能；最后，以TMS320F28335芯片为控制核心，外搭驱动电路模块、通信电路模块、检测电路模块、保护电路模块等完成了系统的硬件设计，软件设计是在CCS5.2平台上进行开发。为了实时观测电动机的运行参数，基于Labwindow设计了上位机界面。对所设计的无刷直流电动机控制系统在实际环境下进行测试，输出显示的结果不仅满足启动迅速稳定，动态性能好，调速性能优良的设计要求，而且硬件系统运行稳定，控制效果好，验证了本文算法的正确性。
keywords: dsp, 仿真建模, 伺服系统, 无刷直流电动机, 闭环控制
affiliations: 泉州信息工程学院,  福州大学机械工程及自动化学院

title: 差分驱动电路在HUMS系统中的应用设计及问题研究
abstract: 介绍了一种利用LTC6362构成的差分驱动电路的应用设计;电路采用3.24 kΩ高精度电阻进行比例衰减以满足ADS1278的输入信号要求;同时分析弱信号对HUMS系统多通道差分驱动电路的影响。通过对实际电路进行不同弱交直流信号的输入测试;根据不同通道输出信号的误差分析定位故障原因;并通过Multisim仿真模拟故障情况;结合仿真数据进一步分析电阻精度误差和运放的失调电压对电路的影响。设计的差分驱动电路在HUMS系统中用于的调理电路上输出的多路振动信号;同时为后端模数转换芯片提供驱动能力;为实现后端数据处理提供需求信号。实际产品设计及生产验证表明方案可行;为相关从业人员提供了一种设计参考。
keywords: ads1278, hums, 失调电压, 差分驱动, 振动信号

title: 基于DSP的UUV目标探测通用系统设计与实现
abstract: 为实现UUV系统对不同的探测系统外围传感设备信号进行快速处理和控制，利用DSP的数据高速处理能力和FPGA的高速接口数据交互能力，设计了基于高速数字信号处理器（DSP）的UUV目标探测通用处理系统；该系统采用了XC7Z045T芯片扩展TMS320C6678芯片的硬件架构设计，通过配置SPI总线进行编程设计，产生250 MHz、156.25 MHz、100 MHz和50 MHz的时钟分配设计方案，支持2路百兆以太网接口通信和16路RS232串口数据的发送及接收，并可根据实际需求扩展CAN通信以及RS485通信；经实验测试，该系统设计方案可完成百兆以太网到目标探测传感设备的数据传输，实现对不同RS232传感器设备进行地址定义、读写和数据通信操作；结果表明，该系统设计方案达到了对以太网传感设备和不同RS232外围传感器快速处理和控制的目的，实现了基于DSP的UUV目标探测通用系统设计。
keywords: dsp, fpga, rs232, 数据映射, 目标探测

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感器的井下甲烷浓度监测系统
abstract: 为了克服传统检测方法存在的问题，提出了一种基于Zig Bee无线传感器网络的井下甲烷浓度监测系统．本系统的终端设备布置在井下巷道内，负责采集甲烷浓度信息，把感知到的物理量转换为电压模拟量，然后无线传送给路由器节点．路由器节点将各终端设备发送过来的数据处理、汇总，然后转发给协调器．协调器通过串口方式将数据传输到地面监控中心．实验结果显示，本系统实现了甲烷浓度值收集、无线传输、浓度超限报警、浓度数据实时显示及历史数据存储等功能，可以直接在地面监控中心监控到井下的甲烷浓度，完成了井下甲烷的实时检测和安全监控．将本系统得到的检测值与专业检测仪器得到的检测值对比，相对误差仅在1%左右，具有良好的理论意义和实际应用价值．

title: Design of Portable Solenoid Valve Performance Test System Based on Android
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the solenoid valve performance test equipment is not convenient to carry; a portable solenoid valve performance test system based on microcontroller unit（MCU） and Android mobile phone terminal was designed.In the system; the Android smart phone was used as data processing center; STC15 W408 AS microcontroller was used as main control chip; combined with 511 series pressure sensor; CC2540 bluetooth module and other devices and control software; the functions of solenoid valve status data collection; real-time display; performance test and data sharing were achieved.The results show that the mobile APP developed with the help of Android Studio fully embodies the advantages of human-computer interaction; the system has the advantages of simple structure; convenient use; reliable test accuracy; meets the national solenoid valve performance test standard; and can be effectively used in the field rapid test of solenoid valve.

title: Vector control method of marine asynchronous motor based on digital signal processor
abstract: The vector control method of Marine asynchronous motor based on digital signal processor is studied to improve the control performance of marine asynchronous motor. TMS320F28335 single chip microcomputer is selected as the digital signal processor for vector control of marine asynchronous motor to deal with all the digital and algorithm of vector control. Set value and the corresponding rotational speed rotor flux values as vector control input values; according to estimate speed and the rotational speed value of the difference; for the next instruction cycle electromagnetic torque input values;electromagnetic torque input value and the value is set to the difference between the electromagnetic torque feedback input value of the torque controller and obtain torque component of the voltage vector instruction value. The digital signal processor is used to run PI control algorithm to complete speed estimation; torque regulation and flux regulation; and realize the closed-loop control of magnetic current current; speed and torque of marine asynchronous motor. The experimental results show that the method can control the stator current; torque and speed of the marine asynchronous motor efficiently by using digital signal processor; and the stator current can be stabilized within 0.5 s when the marine asynchronous motor is loaded.
keywords: digital signal, electromagnetic torque, marine asynchronous motor, pi control algorithm, processor, vector control method

title: 基于ZigBee和云端的回转窑托轮振动监测系统设计
abstract: 针对水泥回转窑有线监控布线繁杂、成本高、维护和管理难度大等问题，设计了基于ZigBee和云端的全覆盖回转窑托轮振动监测系统。系统由若干个架设在回转窑各档托轮上的终端节点和一个协调器构成，终端与协调器都使用了低功耗、低成本的ZigBee处理器CC2530。托轮振动数据由高精度低功耗的接触式位移传感器采集，终端节点将数据经由ZigBee网络发送给协调器。协调器通过串口将多个终端节点的数据打包发送给4G模块，再由4G模块将数据发送到指定云端服务器。监测人员可以通过连接云端服务器的电脑端和移动端应用实时监测托轮振动数据，早期诊断窑运行故障。该系统具有结构简单、部署方便、无需布线等优点，有效解决了单一ZigBee网络传输距离限制的问题，达到了预期设计效果，将在回转窑运行状态监测方面具有广泛工程应用前景。

title: 基于STM32的空气加湿器系统设计
abstract: 文章设计并实现了一个智能加湿器;采用的是STM32的处理器。这款家用型智能加湿器包含了硬件设计和软件设计两个部分。硬件设计部分包括:温湿度采集模块;主要采集设备周边环境的温度、湿度;然后把采集到的数据发送给MCU进行对应的处理;报警模块;针对不同的设定阈值判断;温湿度进入一个危险值;有源高电平蜂鸣器会发生报警;字符显示模块;利用LCD显示采集到的温湿度数值;蓝牙透传模块;采用CC2541蓝牙模块传输控制指令;控制设备开关、温湿度阈值。软件设计部分包括:主控制程序处理;数据的温度、湿度检测与处理;阈值的设定;温湿度超限的报警。

abstract: 为简化液压支架信息传输系统的布线，提高其可靠性，设计了一种基于无线网络传感技术的压力传感器。通过压力传感器采集液压支架的压力信息，经过差动全桥电路转化为电压信号，经信号调理电路处理发送给CC2530片上集成的8051单片机，通过射频模块发送，从而完成压力信息的采集、处理和发送。

title: 基于DSP-FPGA平台的ADCP高沙流量测量系统
abstract: 基于TMS320C6748与Spartan-6平台完成声学多普勒流速剖面仪（Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler; ADCP）的设计，并实现高含沙量情况下的水流流量精确测量。数字信号处理模块（Digital Signal Processing; DSP）完成上位机通信、系统控制、现场可编程门阵列模块（Field Programmable Gate Array; FPGA）交互、外设数据接入、信号数据处理等功能，FPGA完成发射信号调制、接收信号采集等功能。利用测量船搭载ADCP高沙流量测量系统在黄河流域进行测量，ADCP接入全球定位系统（Global Positioning System; GPS）和测深仪数据，在高含沙量水域进行断面流量测试，验证系统的可行性及测量精度。结果显示，在含沙量达到15.5 kg·m-3的水文环境下，ADCP系统可正常稳定地完成测量作业，测量得到的流量相对误差为1.01%，满足高精度流量测量系统的要求。

title: A digital transmit system design for MRI spectrometer
abstract: Objective A digital transmit module of an MRI spectrometer is proposed in this paper. Methods The frequency and phase of the pulse signal is modulated in two steps. The NCO within the FPGA generates the slice selection offset frequency and the initial phase of the pulse signal; the NCO within DAC3484 generates the system center frequency. Results The design combines the advantages of fast phase/frequency switching within FPGA and large range adjustment within DAC; and simultaneously meets the pulse signal modulation frequency requirements that from low field 0.07T to high field 7T; also improves the phase accuracy of pulse signal. Conclusion Two-step digital modulation method is used in transmit module to improve the phase accuracy and thus improves the image quality. This method can be widely applied in MRI spectrometer design.

title: Design of air humidifier system based on STM32
abstract: This paper designs and implements an intelligent humidifier; which adopts STM32 processor. This household intelligent humidifier includes two parts: hardware design and software design. The hardware design part includes:temperature and humidity acquisition module; which mainly collects the temperature and humidity of the surrounding environment of the equipment; and then sends the collected data to MCU for corresponding processing. The alarm module judges that the temperature and humidity enter a dangerous value according to different set thresholds; and the active high-level buzzer will give an alarm. The character display module uses LCD to display the collected temperature and humidity value; Bluetooth transparent transmission module adopts cc2541 Bluetooth module to transmit control instructions and control equipment switch and temperature and humidity threshold. The software design part includes:main control program processing; temperature and humidity detection and processing of data; setting of threshold;alarm of temperature and humidity exceeding the limit.

title: Wireless sensor positioning method for intelligent vehicles
abstract: In order to realize the positioning of unknown nodes in an area and reduce the target positioning error caused by the poor stability of RSSI（received signal strength indication） received signal strength;a wireless sensor positioning method based on the Internet of Things（IoT）is proposed for positioning of intelligent vehicles;and an area sensing positioning system with RSSI engine is established. In combination with the motion trajectory model of the intelligent vehicle;the pre-filtered sequential centroid localization algorithm is used to correct and optimize the RSSI ranging value. In the motion trajectory ranging stage;the signal strength of the intelligent vehicle and the distance between the beacon nodes indicated by the received signal strength in the WSN（wireless sensor network）are also taken into account to correct the RSSI value in the centroid positioning algorithm. In the weight selection stage;a complete wireless signal propagation loss Shadowing model is used because of considering the complexity of external communication environment of the intelligent vehicles;and the model is further modified and extended on the basis of path loss calculation method of modifying the traditional weight. By introducing a random noise variable obeying log-normal distribution and zero-mean Gaussian distribution（the weight is the sum of the distance reciprocal of beacon nodes）;the assisted positioning is completed according to the dynamic reference point group ZigBee WSN. It has been verified by experiments that the weighted centroid positioning algorithm can fully reflect the influence of beacon nodes after the weights are corrected. In comparison with the traditional centroid positioning algorithm model;the RSSI value correction model has a great improvement in both the wireless sensor ranging and weighted positioning stages of intelligent vehicles;which makes up for the ranging error caused by the common algorithm using single-node multi-hop routing information exchange to complete the location estimation. The results show that the method has network self-healing property;the RSSI ranging error is ≤3.5 m;and can obtain better positioning accuracy by using multiple groups of dynamic reference nodes for positioning.
keywords: cc2530 chip, dynamic reference point, intelligent vehicle, iot, shadowing model, wireless sensor positioning, zigbee wsn

title: Design of remote adjustable DC stabilized power supply based on CC2530
abstract: In allusion to the diversified power supply requirements for node terminals in outdoor wireless sensor networks;a low-power adjustable DC regulated power supply is designed;which takes the wireless sensor network chip CC2530 as its control core. In the power supply; the control chip CC2530 with 8051CPU core is used to realize the output voltage stabilization;remote voltage regulation;wireless networking;monitoring;abnormity warning and other functions by combing with ZigBee protocol stack and PWM voltage feedback regulation control principle. At the power supply node end;the CC2530main control chip port is used to output PWM wave;and voltage feedback is used to adjust the duty cycle to complete the output of the Buck circuit. It is connected with the coordinator through the wireless sensor network;so as to fully utilize the on-chip resources of the wireless sensor network chip CC2530. The experimental prototype system is built for verification;and the DC voltage source is used to simulate outdoor photovoltaic input in the indoor test. The testing results show that the output voltage error of the remote adjustable DC stabilized power supply is less than 0.5%;and the wireless voltage regulation step-by-step value is 0.5 V;which can meet the power supply requirements of various sensor terminal devices;and has higher practical value.
keywords: cc2530, dc stabilized power supply, indoor test, power design, remote monitoring, remote pressure regulation, wireless sensor network

title: Design and Implementation of Smart Home Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: With the progress and development of modern science and information technology; the degree and quality of electronic information in daily life have also been improved correspondingly. At the same time; people have higher and higher requirements for the safety; convenience and comfort of life and environment. ZigBee technology has the advantages of short distance; low power consumption; short delay and flexible networking. It has become a hot spot in the development of Internet of Things technology and is increasingly used in the field of smart home. This paper designs a smart home system model based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology; which realizes real-time monitoring and control of temperature; humidity; brightness; harmful gases and other data in the home environment. The system sends the data collected by each monitoring node to the mobile application terminal through the wireless sensor network after being processed by the CC2530 single-chip microcomputer. The mobile application terminal can remotely monitor and control each monitoring node in real time.
keywords: cc2530 single chip microcomputer, smart home, wireless sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: Fujian Chuanzheng Communications College

title: Design of Children’s Sports Somatosensory Training System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
abstract: In order to improve the effect of children’s sports physical training and solve the balance error problem faced by traditional sports physical training system; a new children’s sports physical training system is designed based on virtual reality technology. The hardware part is designed with embedded physical remote control; KinectV2 physical device and CC2540 physical training data processor;the software part firstly builds a framework for children’s sports physical training; secondly designs a children’s sports recognition algorithm based on virtual reality technology; and finally designs a physical training function module; thus realizing effective children’s sports physical training. The system test is conducted; and the results show that the designed children’s sports physical training system has low balance error and good training performance; which has certain application value and meets the needs of children’s sports physical training.
keywords: children’s sports, somatosensory training system, virtual reality
affiliations: Hubei University of Economics

title: Environment Simple Monitoring and Remote Management Control System Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: People’s requirements for living environment make the monitoring of living environment and intelligent monitoring under simple conditions become particularly important. This paper describes a simple environmental monitoring and remote management control system based on Internet of things technology. The sensor is used to detect and collect environmental parameters; and the CC2530 single chip microcomputer of the terminal is used for data packaging processing. The Zig Bee wireless network is used to realize multi node wireless acquisition. The gateway node is composed of Zig Bee coordinator based on CC2530 single chip microcomputer and simplelink cc3200 wireless MCU. After receiving the environmental parameters; simplelink cc3200 wireless MCU is used to upload the detected environmental parameters to Alibaba cloud server; and access the server through mobile App to realize remote monitoring and control management; At the same time; CC2530 MCU communicates with the host computer through the serial port; and the host computer stores the data in the local database for storage. To realize the environment simple detection and remote control management under the Internet of things technology.
keywords: internet of things, sensors, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Wuhan Jianchun Technology Co., Ltd., Wuhan South Yang Technology Co., Ltd., Qingdao Haiwen Intelligent Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Design of embedded storage system based on ch378
abstract: USB serial port chip ch378 has built-in USB communication protocol stack and file system;and provides a variety of operation commands;which can easily interface with a variety of processors.Based on ch378 and DSP processor TMS320C6713;a mass storage system is designed.Ch378 is used to realize the direct management of U disk;and the interface circuit and operation program of ch378 are designed.The system supports FAT32 file system;which can save various real-time data collected on site to USB flash disk in time;and can be easily integrated into various test systems.
keywords: ch378, storage system
authors: Li Guijiao;Li Jinbao;Guan Shuai;Lu Zhengyan;Yang Ying

title: 基于CC1310芯片的多通道高速率低功耗无线传感系统
abstract: 为有效减轻新一代运载火箭传感器数据采集与传输系统的质量，设计并实现了基于CC1310芯片的无线传感器系统。采用频分复用（FDM）结合时分复用（TDM）的方式完成多节点组网并实施分组管理，组间频分复用既实现了节点数的扩增，又提升了传输速率复用倍数，分组数为4时子节点数量可达100个以上。提出主节点授时法结合多节点分时传输协议的优化设计方法，保证多节点高精准同步，避免节点间碰撞，获得了最优的组内可达速率；设计节点唤醒/休眠模式切换策略，有效降低了系统功耗。实测结果表明：2个主节点带5个子节点并行工作时，传输速率可达400 Kbps;且主节点数量增加时，系统的传输速率成比例增大；单个子节点忙时功耗不超过60 mW;闲时功耗不超过12 mW;平均功耗为15.2 mW;符合低功耗要求；同时，所设计的无线传感系统具备良好的可靠性和鲁棒性。
keywords: cc1310, 低功耗, 无线组网通信, 时间同步, 高速率

title: 基于物联网的室内环境实时监测系统设计
abstract: 针对目前环境监测系统存在着的功耗大、成本高、布线繁琐以及无法自组网等问题，设计了一种基于物联网的室内环境实时监测系统。该系统以CC2530为核心处理器，采用ZigBee和GPRS混合组网方式实现温湿度、烟雾浓度、人体红外信息的无线传输，并运用LabVIEW编程软件设计PC端监测系统以实现远程监控和报警的功能。经测试，该系统测量准确度高，各节点之间具有较好的稳定性和可扩充性，在室内环境监测领域具有一定的应用价值。
keywords: 室内环境实时监测系统, 无线传感网络, 物联网
affiliations: 淮南师范学院计算机学院

title: Design and verification of data acquisition clock circuit based on dual-loop phase-locked loop
abstract: [Background] Digital measurement system based on ADCs（analog-to-digital converter） has higher requirement on the signal to noise ratio（SNR） of sampled data. Among all the factors; the jitter of sampling clock has the most prominent effect on SNR. [Purpose] This study aims to design a clock circuit based on dual-loop phaselocked loop to reduce the jitter of digital measurement system input clock. [Methods] First of all; the influence of clock jitter on digital measurement system was analyzed. Then; the LMK04610 chip with dual loop PLL architecture of Texas Instruments was employed to design and implement a dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit. The cores of this design were power supply design and the loop filter design. At last; the performance of the circuit was tested by using Rodschwarz phase noise analyzer. [Results] After testing; the dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit can reduce the jitter of the 62.475 MHz source clock from more than 7 ps to less than 2 ps with output frequency of 499.8 MHz. The SNR of the sampled data is close to the theoretical value. [Conclusions] Dual-loop phase-locked loop jitter cleaner circuit has a good result and can provide reference for designers of digital measurement system.
keywords: data acquisition, dual-loop pll, jitter cleaner, snr of adc
authors: YUE Junhui;GAO Guodong;HE Jun;YANG Jing;CAO Jianshe;TANG Xuhui;DU Yaoyao;LIU Zhi;MA Huizhou;LI Yukun;WEI Shujun;YE Qiang
affiliations: Institute of High Energy Physics,Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

title: Urban energy saving lighting dimming system based on intelligent gear control
abstract: The traditional urban energy-saving lighting dimming system can not predict the traffic flow in real time; which leads to the large urban energy consumption. Therefore; an energy-saving lighting dimming system based on the intelligent gear control is designed. The hardware circuit of the city energy-saving lighting dimming system is designed; and the system hardware design is completed through the CC2530 minimum system; controller and other peripheral circuits. In the software part of the system; the intelligent control model of gear is used to predict the traffic flow and adjust the urban energy-saving lighting; and the dimming system design of urban energy-saving lighting based on the intelligent control model of gear is realized. The experiment results show that the urban energy-saving lighting dimming system based on the intelligent gear control in this study can effectively reduce the urban energy consumption and reduce the lighting regulation time; which has practical application significance.
keywords: cc2530 minimum system, intelligent gear control model, lighting dimming system, urban energy saving
affiliations: Xi’an Planning and Designing Institute

title: Real-time detection of industrial SO
abstract: In industry; SO3 gas prepared by oxidation of SO2 is of high concentration; strong corrosion and great cross-influence; and difficulty by high precision real-time detection. Moreover; the relationship between input flow and SO3 concentration is not clear; which leads to that the parameter adjustment depends on experience. Aim at the above problems; a real-time system for detection of industrial SO3 gas concentration was designed by AO2 electrochemical oxygen sensor; and a multivariate nonlinear regression model with input air; SO2 flow and output SO3concentration was established. The real-time detection system of SO3 gas concentration mainly included AO2 electrochemical oxygen sensor; sensor conditioning circuit;AD620 amplifying circuit and ADS1256 A/D conversion circuit. It indirectly measured SO3 concentration by detecting the millivolt level change of O2 concentration in input air and the output mixture gas from SO3 generator. In this way; the cross influence of other sensitive gases was avoided. The experimental results showed that the detection time of the system was 27s; the sensitivity was 111mV/%; the deviation was less than 0.18% and the stability was good; which demonstrated the effectiveness of the detection system. A cubic polynomial nonlinear regression model for predicting SO3 concentration was established by response surface method. The results of variance analysis for this model were very significant with the mean square error（MSE） of the model of 0.0007174 and the correlation coefficient（R2） of 0.9929; which proved that the model had good fitting degree and high prediction precision.
keywords: instrumentation, model, prediction, real-time detection, so gas concentration
authors: ZHANG Wei;ZHANG Kun;XU Na;HU Heng;YU Jiapeng;KONG Xiangxu
affiliations: College of Chemical Engineering and Technology,Taiyuan University of Technology

title: 小区一氧化碳浓度集中监控系统设计
abstract: 该设计将以部分老旧小区为研究对象;将物联网技术和传感器探测技术以及上位机监控技术相结合设计一个基于物联网技术的小区一氧化碳浓度集中监控系统。该系统以一氧化碳传感器作为探测器;使用物联网技术的ZigBee CC2530作为处理器和无线传输器件;利用ZigBee的自组网以及LABVIEW的上位机监控功能;完成多个家庭浴室一氧化碳浓度自动监控、报警、和历史数据、查询和保存的功能。

title: 一个基于CC1310的无线测温系统的设计与实现
abstract: 目前供电负荷日益增加，在供电规模扩大的同时对供电设备和供电系统来说也是一个严峻的考验。其中温度检测是保证电网安全的重要一环，传统的测温系统存在测量周期长、安装复杂、不易管理维护等问题。对此，设计并实现了一个基于CC1310射频芯片的无线测温系统。采用CC1310平台搭建了无线传感器测温节点和汇聚节点，测温节点获得数据后发送至汇聚节点，其通过串口连接至计算机查看数据。在硬件方面，传感器节点采用模块化设计，并使用周期性睡眠侦听的工作方式来降低能量消耗，延长使用寿命。
keywords: cc1310, 传感器, 传感器网络, 无线传输, 温度测量
authors: 袁怀杰;竺怿晨;孙玉昕;杨翱翔;王飞

title: 基于形式化分析的信号处理模块设计
abstract: 形式化技术是系统开发过程中提高可靠性的一种行之有效的途径，随着形式化技术的发展与普及，它在系统软硬件设计方面得到了一定的应用。以某超短波监测系统中的数字信号处理模块软硬件开发为例，介绍了信号处理模块的硬件设计，描述了该模块的软件设计及使用形式化分析技术在软件开发过程中的应用步骤，为形式化技术在类似产品的开发过程中的应用提供了一定的借鉴。
keywords: tms320c6678芯片, 信号处理, 嵌入式, 形式化分析

title: 一种实现8通道高速高精度光功率计的方案设计
abstract: 本文提出一种可实现8通道高速高精度光功率计实现方案，方案采用STM32F405作为主控MCU，采用 ADS1278实现功率的高精度以及高速采样，采用THS4521实现单端转差分转换，采用串口来实现上位机与控制系统之间的通信，MCU通过SPI总线接口与ADS1278进行通信。该方案可提供多种模式来进行光功率的监控采样，以满足不同场景下的使用需求。
keywords: ads1278, stm32f405, ths4521, 对数放大, 差分转换
affiliations: 西安奇芯光电科技有限公司

title: Design and Implementation of High Precision Real-time Power Quality Monitoring System
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of power quality monitoring and signal detection accuracy;a design scheme of high performance power quality detection system is proposed.Based on the traditional fast Fourier transform（FFT）;an improved window double-spectrum-line interpolation harmonic detection algorithm is used to process the detected signal;and then the accurate phase amplitude frequency and other parameters are obtained.The accuracy of the algorithm is verified by the sinusoidal signal containing harmonics;and the platform of power quality monitoring is built on digital signal processor（DSP） based on the floating point unit of TMS320F28335.Data stream encoding is improved;filter circuit;voltage type current transformer circuit;current type voltage transformer circuit and voltage lifting circuit are designed;and the feasibility of the design is verified by software simulation.The power quality can be measured by the system accurately in real time.
keywords: monitoring system, power quality, window double-spectrum-line interpolation
affiliations: Leshan Power Supply Company of State Grid Sichuan Electric Power Company

title: 基于改进S变换的工业设备用电参数检测仪研究
abstract: 针对工业企业中主要用电设备对电能质量的要求，介绍了一种基于MSP430+TMS320C6713架构的电能质量检测仪设计方法；提出了一种结合包络极值和GAUSS窗的改进S变换，以准确提取电压扰动特征值；分别对电炉、大功率电机以及金属切削机床进行了电能质量信号检测测试，结果表明，该检测仪可以准确实现对设备电压、电流、频率及电能质量扰动等电能参数的精确测量，具有较好的工程应用价值。
keywords: 包络极值, 检测仪, 用电设备, 电能质量
affiliations: 邵阳学院多电源地区电网运行与控制湖南省重点实验室

title: Design of Wireless Fire Signal Conversion Module Based on SPI Bus Technology
abstract: In wireless fire control systems; the stable startup of fire control equipment is particularly important; and the quick and accurate startup of fire control equipment can be achieved through different bus protocol conversion methods. In order to solve the problem of controlling the stable start of wired fire-fighting equipment in a wireless way; this paper designs a wireless signal conversion module based on SPI bus technology; including SPI bus advantages and working principle; hardware circuit connection; software programming; host computer design; etc. As a result; the equipment of the wireless fire control system can be started stably; and the serial port resources of the microcontroller can be saved for the communication with other devices; which will improve the transmission efficiency and the utilization of the built-in resources of the microcontroller; and has high practical value.
keywords: c8051f040, cc2530, spi bus
affiliations: Jilin Jianzu University
source: Journal of Jilin Teachers Institute of Engineering and Technology.

title: Research on landslide monitoring data acquisition system based on Beidou short message communication and internet of things
abstract: The monitoring areas of reservoir bank landslide is often located in remote areas; where the environment is complex and the communication network is poor; so it cannot meet the communication demand of data transmission in the monitoring work. However; using Beidou short message technology can give play to its unique advantages of global communication coverage so that this technology can meet the above demand. In this paper; a Beidou short message communication scheme is adopted to solve the data transmission problem in remote areas. Taking the Baijiabao landslide as an example; a monitoring system for the Baijiabao landslide is established based on the Internet of things; and the hardware and software components of the system are designed respectively. The system integrates two kinds of wireless communication technology: wireless sensor network and the Beidou short message. In the hareware; this system takes CC2530 RF chip as the core; adopts ZigBee802.15.4 agreement to form a wireless sensor network structure; and connects the Beidou short message module on the data gathering node. Finally; the Internet of things system for landslide monitoring is formed; which realizes the acquisition and wireless remote transmission of landslide monitoring data in the communication blind area.
keywords: beidou short message, data acquisition system, internet of things, landslide monitoring, wireless sensor network
authors: MENG YongDong;QIN Yi;TIAN Bin;CAI ZhengLong;CHENG Xiang;ZHANG XiangYu

title: Design of Self-powered Wind Speed Monitoring System for Desertification Combating
abstract: The expansion of land desertification is a serious threat to the sustainable development of the ecological environment.Real-time monitoring of regional wind speed can provide scientific decision-making support for desertification control work.However; most wind-speed monitoring devices have the problem of heavy dependence on external power supply and high power consumption.To this end; a self-powered wind speed monitoring system based on composite energy harvesting is designed.The experiment results show that the system can collect and store solar energy and wind energy compositely through the energy management circuit to drive the back-end circuit.The wireless transmission module uploads the output signal of the triboelectric nanogenerator to the data terminal; and finally realizes the display and storage of wind speed information.In addition; the low-power logic design effectively prolongs the working time of the sensing node.This work promotes the application of self-powered sensing in the field of environmental monitoring.
keywords: cc1101, esp32, self-powered wind speed monitoring

title: Code Auto-generation and Application of TMS320C6678
abstract: In order to optimize the way of DSP engineering development; this paper combines Simulink’s visual model development with TMS320 C6678;and uses visual module design tools to model the algorithm model and data flow.There is a standard data stream transmission interface between the models.The code generation tool generates the signal processing program on the DSP platform according to the description of the algorithm function model; and completes the automatic code generation conversion from the MATLAB algorithm model to the DSP project.Compared with the traditional method of manual translation into DSP engineering; the algorithm function is simulated and tested at the design stage; which enables developers to develop more quickly and at less cost; and also simplifies the later modification of the algorithm architecture.

authors: Zhu Hongtai;Cheng Hu;Wang Chunhui;Zhou Gaoxing;Hu Kai

title: Robot Path Tracking System Based on Embedded Image Recognition
abstract: In order to solve the poor tracking accuracy of traditional path tracking system; a robot path tracking system based on embedded image recognition is designed in this paper.The system uses the image acquisition module of the kernel driver layer to drive the CCD camera of the hardware layer to collect the image information of the driving path and transmit it to the control module of the same layer.The control module uses TMS320 DM6437 embedded control chip to transmit the image information to the image recognition module of the business support layer.The image recognition module identifies the path information through the process of edge extraction and transmits the recognition result to the path tracking module; and displays the path tracking result in the interface of the wireless communication network in the communication module.The experiment results show that the displacement deviation of the robot path tracking results obtained by the system is less than 2 cm and the angle deviation is less than 1° under different light intensity; indicating that the system has excellent path tracking performance.
keywords: ccd camera, image recognition, path tracking system, tms320dm6437
affiliations: Electronic Information Technology Research Center, Ankang University

title: Design of Distributed Storage and Parallel Computing System in Medium Voltage Environment
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor data storage capacity and poor data calculation and analysis capacity in the current medium and low voltage environment; a new type of computing system is proposed.The method designs a set of distributed storage and parallel computing system including data layer; storage layer; computing layer and application layer.The system is compatible with HBASE+HIVE+SPARK multiple data storage methods and improves data compatibility.Through Calling functions; data interaction and storage between different data attributes are realized.Also through the introduction of TMS320 C6713 chip; the data calculation ability has been improved.The experiment results show that the method of this research effectively improves the ability of distributed data storage and calculation of medium and low voltage equipment and has certain technological progress.
keywords: calling function, data compatibility, medium and low voltage environment, tms320c6713
authors: Song Guangming;Liu Yun;Zhao Aihua;Huang Shaoxiong;Cheng Chen
affiliations: Chizhou Power Supply Company, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd., Hefei Power Supply Company, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd., State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co., Ltd., Electric Power Research Institute, State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd.

title: Parallel Calculation Method of Ultra-long Points FFT Based on TMS320C6678
abstract: Aiming at the problems of ultra-long points FFT implementation and computational efficiency encountered during the migration of DSP platform algorithms; this article combines TI’s TMS320 C6678 DSP;we use the FFT decomposition algorithm and the efficient memory access efficiency of the L2 memory segment to design a parallel processing method for ultra-long points FFT calculation by paralleling the EDMA movement of the DSP memory data and the FFT decomposition calculation.The specific implementation process of the method is described by 262144-points FFT calculation; and the calculation result of DSP is compared with the result of MATLAB;and the calculation error of the method is 10-4.Finally; on the DSP platform; when the number of FFT points is the same; the calculation time of directly calling the FFT library function is compared with the calculation time using this method; which shows that it has better calculation performance in the ultra-long points FFT calculation.
keywords: dsp, edma, parallel computing, real-time signal processing, tms320c6678, ultra-long points fft calculation
authors: Zhang Jiong;Cheng Hu;Zhu Hongtai;Wang Chunhui;Li Min

title: 基于MQTT协议的微信小程序控制的辅助骑行摔倒报警头盔
abstract: 本文设计了一种基于MQTT协议的智能骑行头盔，通过GPRS网络、MQTT协议将头盔采集的光照、状态、坐标等数据上传至阿里云服务器。头盔以STM32F407为主控芯片，μC/OS-Ⅲ为实时操作系统，配合SIM900A、定位模块、陀螺仪MPU6050、光照传感器、蓝牙CC2541等构建出头盔硬件系统，配合超声波雷达、LED、OLED、蓝牙CC2541等构建出摩托车硬件系统。以微信小程序和服务器后台程序构成软件系统，硬件系统和软件系统共同构成了整个的物联网系统。通过微信小程序可以操控头盔硬件，打开或者关闭头盔的一些功能，还可以选择之前的骑行轨迹进行回放。当骑行者摔倒时会给紧急联系人发送短信。
keywords: gprs, gps, mqtt, stm32f407, μc/os-iii, 微信小程序, 阿里云
authors: 王创;张恩毓;单宇飞;刘宇涛;刘梦雄;郝帅鹏;杨文强

title: 基于Qt5.0的电机电控动力总成智能监控系统设计
abstract: 本文基于Qt5.0等开发工具，设计了一套应用于电机电控动力总成的智能监控系统。本系统以TMS320F2812作为核心控制器，进行电机调速控制、信号采集和CAN通讯，通过CAN总线与上位机实现高速通讯。上位机软件基于Qt5.0进行开发，硬件采用Windows系统的计算机，数据库基于SQL Server，对数据进行存储与管理，完成动力总成的运行数据监控、故障自诊断、程序在线升级、数据统计及管理、预测维保等功能，最终实现电机电控动力总成的智能化、数字化、可视化管理。
keywords: can, qt5.0, tms320f2812, 动力总成, 智能化
affiliations: 长沙硕博电机有限公司

title: 小直径存储式多极子阵列声波信号采集处理电路设计
abstract: 本文针对仪器接收声波信号信噪比低、通道多、数据量大、控制时序复杂等特点，设计了一种基于TMS320F28335 DSP的阵列声波数据采集与处理电路，实现了16路声波信号的并行数据采集。在设计中，根据有用声波信号和干扰信号频谱的特点，用MATLABFDATool工具箱设计了FIR数字滤波器算法，为了减少数据传输时间和存储的数据量，本文实现了ADPCM数据压缩算法，所有算法通过C语言编程在DSP上得到了实现。试验结果表明，该电路工作非常稳定可靠，性能优异，能够满足多极子阵列声波信号采集和处理的要求。
keywords: dsp, 多极子阵列声波, 存储式, 数字滤波器, 数据压缩
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第二十二研究所

title: Design of simulator controller based on STM32H743
abstract: 为了达到更好的控制性能;高动态仿真转台控制系统伺服周期通常为100μs甚至更短;因此对控制器硬件平台的实时计算能力提出了更高的要求。本文通过高性能控制平台设计;研制出了基于STM32H743的硬件平台;运行频率可达480MHz;支持双精度浮点运算。通过移植转台运动控制算法在三轴仿真转台上进行控制性能测试;结果表明;与基于TMS320F28335的转台控制器相比;在速率运动的速率精度、速率平稳度以及正弦运动的跟随误差方面;控制性能均有较大的提升;在仿真转台领域有良好的应用前景。
keywords: arm, 仿真转台, 伺服控制
affiliations: 九江精密测试技术研究所

title: Design of low-power wireless sensor network system in cabin
abstract: In the launch vehicle parameter measurement system; the traditional sensor network is connected by cables. With the increase of test points; the use of a large number of cables not only brings excess load and power consumption; but also takes up a lot of cabin space; causing huge trouble for the layout and installation of other equipment in the rocket cabin. In response to the above problems; we propose a CC1310-based wireless sensor network（WSN） design scheme to realize the cableless test system. In this design; the ultra-low-power RF chip CC1310 with a communication frequency band below 1 GHz（Sub-GHz） is selected as the sensor network controller; the low-power K-type thermocouple AD8495 is used to collect temperature data; and the lithium battery is used for power supply. The software design implements the periodic sleep and wake-up listening mechanism of sensor nodes; and the master node polls and accesses sensor nodes to obtain the function of status and data. The node low power consumption design is completed and the reliability of the data can be guaranteed. The experimental test shows that the system has a reasonable design; low power consumption; stable and reliable data transmission; and the average energy consumption of the system in working state is 88 μA; which can realize long-term measurement of environmental parameters in the rocket cabin.
keywords: cc1310, data acquisition, low power consumption, sub-ghz, wireless sensor network

title: Safety Monitoring System of Hoisting Machinery Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: The crane equipment safety monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network is designed to monitor the crane working safety in real time and avoid dangerous accidents. The system can be divided into three levels: field; local and remote. CC2530 is used as the core chip of ZigBee network hardware; USB and lithium batteries are set as power supply; and other units such as serial port and debugging units are set respectively. The hardware equipment required by the data acquisition module is studied; the monitor module is taken as the core of the system hardware; and related facilities are selected from the monitoring unit and display unit. The distributed assignment mechanism is established in the system software to solve the problem of Web address allocation in ZigBee wireless sensor network. Cluster-tree algorithm is adopted to simplify node functions; formulate a more reasonable routing protocol; reduce system communication loss; design the software flow of security monitoring unit; and complete the system design. Simulation experiments show that the average collection error of the system is within 0.02 V;and the maximum information packet loss rate is 1.81%. When the number of users reaches 200;the information packet loss rate is 75.4%.
keywords: cluster-tree algorithm, hoisting equipment, routing protocol, security monitoring system, zigbee wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Intelligent Engineering, Jinzhong College of Information
source: Core;Chinese Journal of Sensors and Actuators.

title: Research on Internet of Things Acquisition System in Greenhouse Based on the Improved Kalman Data Fusion Algorithm
abstract: In view of the traditional greenhouses’ disadvantages such as low precision of collected data; complicated wiring and huge energy consumption; an internet of things acquisition system in greenhouse based on the improved Kalman data fusion algorithm is studied. Hardware of the system mainly includes CC2530 chip and STM32 microprocessor. It first makes pre-treatment on the collected data with Romanowsky criterion and then carries out static fusion of the data at the nodes of coordinator with Kalman filter algorithm. Temperature is selected to serve as the observing variable for simulation and test. As shown by the result; the error of temperature processed by Kalman data fusion algorithm is no more than 0.089 ℃ and the processed data is closer to the actual value of the environment. The improved Kalman data fusion algorithm optimizes the data collection precision and system stability effectively. The research results could serve as reference for the application of data collection technology in agricultural intelligence.
keywords: data fusion, error, kalman filtering algorithm, romanovsky criterion, wireless sensor network

title: Multi-channel wireless sensor system based on CC1310 chip wtih high speed and low power consumption
abstract: In order to effectively reduce the weight of sensor data acquisition and transmission system for the new-generation launch vehicle; a wireless sensor system based on chip CC1310 was designed and implemented. Multi-node networking and group management are accomplished using frequency division multiplexing（FDM） and time division multiplexing（TDM）. The FDM scheme among groups not only increases the number of nodes; but also improves the transmission rate multiplexing multiple. When there are four groups; the system is capable of supporting more than 100 sub-nodes. In order to ensure high precision synchronization of multi-nodes; avoid node collisions; and obtain the optimal intra-group achievable rate; we also suggested an optimal method of master node timing in combination with a multi-node time-sharing transfer protocol. Moreover; a node wake-up/idle mode switching strategy is designed to reduce system power consumption effectively. The experimental results show that the transmission rate can reach 400 Kbps when two master nodes work in parallel with five sub-nodes; and the transmission rate will increase proportionally when the number of master nodes rises. The power consumption of the single sub-node is less than 60 mW during work hours and less than 12 mW during idle hours. The average power consumption of the single sub-node is 15.2 mW; which meets the requirements of low power consumption. At the same time; the wireless sensor system designed in this paper has good reliability and robustness.
keywords: cc1310, high rate, low power consumption, time synchronization, wireless network communication

title: Design of Indoor Environment Real-time Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high power consumption; high cost; complicated wiring and inability to self-organize the network in the current environmental monitoring system; a real-time monitoring system for indoor environment based on the Internet of Things was designed in this study.The system was developed based on CC2530;and used the ZigBee and GPRS hybrid networking mode to realize wireless transmission of temperature and humidity; smoke concentration; and human infrared information; and was designed and implemented a host computer monitoring system for remote monitoring and alarming by using LabVIEW.According to the test; the system was realized high measurement accuracy; good stability and scalability between nodes; and it has a certain application value in the field of indoor environmental monitoring.
keywords: real-time monitoring system for indoor environment, the internet of things, wireless sensor network

title: Modeling and smulation of SVPWM modulation wave
abstract: This paper analyzes the principle of SVPWM modulation technology and introduces a modulation method AZSPWM based on active zero vector. The three-phase voltage-source inverter controlled by the two modulation methods is modeled by MATLAB. Through simulation; it is verified that the SVPWM modulation method can improve the input voltage utilization rate; and AZSPWM can reduce the common mode voltage. The experimental verification is carried out on the DSP chip based on TMS320F28335.
keywords: azspwm, common mode voltage, dsp verification, matlab simulation, svpwm
affiliations: Wuhan Institute of Marine Electric Propulsion, Institute of Science and Technology , Shenhua Zhunneng Group Co., Ltd

title: Design of CC2530 Wireless Data Acquisition System Based on Photovoltaic Energy
abstract: With the continuous reduction of the urban cultivated field area; more and more people turn their agricultural development to mountain areas. However; due to the constraints of the mountain environment; the development of smart agriculture is limited. Aiming at the difficulty of wireless equipment energy supply in the development of smart agriculture in mountainous areas; this article designed a Wireless Data Collection System which used Photovoltaic self-supplied. The system takes CC2530 as the core; and the Photovoltaic self-supplied unit of this system is constituted by the solar cell; Regulator and BUCK circuit; motor drive circuit and some gearing; which realize automatic collection and remote monitoring of crop information and solve the problem of using wireless devices for energy supply in the process of modern agricultural development in mountainous areas. Pyramid structure solar panel is used by the unit of photovoltaic self-supplied so that the volume of the unit of photovoltaic self-supplied is small; the light energy conversion efficiency is higher; the energy supply is more stable. Experiments show that the system is reliable.
keywords: data collection, photovoltaic self-supplied, solar panel
affiliations: School of Information Science and Engineering,Chengdu University, Chengdu Hui Nong Information Technology Co,Ltd

title: Practical Design and Problem Research of Differential Drive Circuit on HUMS System
abstract: The practical design of differential drive circuit composed of LTC6362 was introduced. The circuit used 3.24 kΩ high precision resistance to attenuate signal for meeting the input signal requirements of ADS1278. And the impact of weak AC/DC signal on multichannel differential drive circuit of HUMS system was analyzed. In addition; through inputing different weak AC/DC signals in the practical circuit; the fault cause was analyzed according to the output signal error of different channels. Moreover; through using Multisim to simulate and combining the simulation data; the impact of the accuracy error of resistance and the offset voltage of operational amplifier on the circuit was analyzed. The differential drive circuit of HUMS system designed was used to condition multichannel vibration signals which were produced by vibration acceleration sensors onboard and provided drive capability for analog-digital converter which provided the conditioned signals for data processing in the follow-up circuits. The actual product design and production verification show that the scheme is feasible; which provides a design reference for relevant practitioners.
keywords: ads1278, differential drive, hums, offset voltage, vibration signal
affiliations: SZTU-SinoGerman Institute of Intelligent Manufacturing

title: Research on Detecting and Tracking Algorithm of Small Moving Targets Based on TMS320C6455
abstract: Based on TMS320C6455;the partial differential factor and inter-frame difference factor are adopted and improved in the paper. Firstly;an image is divided into blocks of the same size. And then the blocks are imported into the chip from the off-chip in turn. Each block is computed and the result is stored. This method solves the problem of insufficient chip storage space effectively. Then a more efficient tracking method is proposed in the tracking mode. A region of interest is obtained based on the target coordinates after searching. In order to meet the accuracy and completeness of the tracking;the paper conducts a search of interest in a block and performs a global search on adjacent block. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm not only reduces the time and space complexity;but also improves the accuracy of tracking targets.
keywords: detecting and tracking algorithm, space complexity, time complexity, tms320c6455

title: Design of Fire Alarm System for Distribution Low-voltage Electrical Appliances Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems of fire alarm in electronic low-voltage distribution system;ZigBee wireless transmission technology is used to realize fire alarm.In hardware;STC89 C52 single chip microcomputer with CC2530 as the core and smoke;temperature and humidity sensor are selected to form hardware equipment combined with ZigBee wireless transmission technology to achieve fire alarm.In software;the compound Kendall-τ trend algorithm is used to judge the ambient data of the building.By comparing data with the preset threshold value;the fire alarm can be sent at the same time.The design scheme can be applied to the fire alarm of electronic low voltage distribution system.

title: Design of Automatic Fire Alarm System Based on Zig Bee
abstract: Large fire control technical problems and limitations exist in traditional wireless fire alarm systems.The emerging alarm method Zigbee automatic alarm technology can fully meet the various functions of the wireless automatic fire warning system.The CC2530 module is used as the core in this article to detect and analyze fire signals.The hardware design mainly includes composite fire detectors;linkage control equipment and other parts.The software design includes coordination node;routing node;automatic fire alarm system;and upper computer display interface design.
keywords: composite fire detector, design of linkage control equipment, ds18b20 data temperature sensor, zigbee

title: Research and Application of Wind Solar Complementary Power Generation System in Street Lamp
abstract: According to the needs of traditional street lamps;grid connection is required to realize lighting and rely on the demand of stable operation.This paper discusses the use of TMS320F2812 chip to control wind solar complementary street lamps.It is proposed to track the maximum power point of photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation and optimize the charge and discharge of battery.Based on the experimental verification;it can be widely used in low-power wind solar complementary street lamp control system.

affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: Self-starting Implementation of TMS320C6713 Based on Flash
abstract: A method of using EMIF’s Flash storage extension to implement automatic loading of user programs is introduced. When the DSP is reset; the internal boot loader loads the secondary boot program located 1 kB before Flash. After successful mounting; the DSP starts executing the second boot program from the 0 x00 address. The function of the secondary boot program is to complete the loading of the user application program and jump to the C program entry point c＿int00 after the loading is completed. Then; the user program is executed to realize the Flash auto start of the user program. If the user program is too large or needs to load some code to run in SDRAM; it needs to load the program multiple times.
keywords: dsp, flash, multiple loading, self-start, user program
affiliations: State-owned Wuhu Machinery Factory

title: Research on Key Technology of On-line Monitoring Sensor for Shunt Capacitor Bus Current
abstract: Capacitor is an important reactive power compensation equipment in power system. Shunt capacitor banks are frequently switched to compensate the reactive power of power grid; which produces serious inrush current and harmonic. The instantaneous large current on the bus poses a great threat to the operation safety of capacitor units. In this paper; an on-line monitoring sensor of shunt capacitor bus current based on wireless sensing technology is designed. Through the analysis of energy acquisition circuit; measurement circuit and protective shell; it is determined that the sensor adopts the structure of high-voltage energy acquisition and Rogowski coil measurement directly on the bus with iron core; which is sealed in an integrated aluminum shell system. Using CC2530 chip with built-in A/D and ZigBee communication protocol stack and special signal processing circuit; the high current measurement of capacitor bus is realized and verified in the laboratory. The device solves the problems of high-level energy extraction and high-current accurate measurement under the magnetic saturation of the iron core; and realizes the overall performance optimization of the sensor field high-voltage insulation; anti-interference and wireless networking design.
keywords: bus current, on-line monitoring, power system, shunt capacitor, zigbee
affiliations: North China Electric Power University, Electric Power Research Institute of Guangdong Power Grid Corporation

title: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Miner’s Lamp Based on Gas Concentration and Personnel Positioning
abstract: In order to solve the problems of single function of miner’s lamp;inability to collect the underground gas concentration;and inability to realize the personnel positioning;an intelligent miner’s lamp based on microcontroller is designed in this paper. The smart miner’s lamp takes the STC15W408AS CPU as the core;uses the gas sensor to collect gas concentration at monitoring point and miner’ s lamp coordinate information; transmits data to the positioning system through CC1101 wireless module; transmits data to data transmission system and ground monitoring system through wired+wireless communication mode.After the energy consumption test;gas concentration test and personnel positioning test;it is verified that the intelligent miner’s lamp operates stably and reliably;and the intelligent level of the miner’s lamp is enhanced.
keywords: cc1101 wireless module, gas concentration, miner’s lamp, personnel positioning, power carrier, stc15w408as cpu

title: DSP Based Brushless DC Motor Double Closed-loop PID Servo System
abstract: Aiming at the key technical problems of traditional DC motors such as mechanical commutation; poor speed regulation performance;small starting torque; and poor anti-interference; a brushless DC motor control system using PID double closed-loop control was studied and designed. The working principle and mathematical model of the brushed DC motor were analysed; the simulation model of the brushless DC motor control system was built based on Matlab/Simulink; and the current-speed double closed-loop PI speed regulation method was used to improve the speed regulation performance of the system; finally; the TMS320F28335 chip was used. In order to control the core; the external drive circuit module; communication circuit module; detection circuit module; protection circuit module; etc. had completed the hardware design of the system; and the software design was developed on the CCS5.2 platform. In order to observe the operating parameters of the motor in real time; based on Labwindow had designed the host computer interface. The designed brushless DC motor control system was tested in the actual environment; and the output display results not only met the design requirements of rapid and stable startup; good dynamic performance;and excellent speed regulation performance; but also the hardware system ran stable and had good control effect; which verified the correctness of the algorithm.
keywords: brushless dc motor, closed-loop control, dsp, servo system, simulation modeling
