title: A Smart Control System for Greenhouse Designed Based on Grey Entropy Correlation Analysis
abstract: 【Background and objective】Facility agriculture growing crops in greenhouses has developed rapidly in China over the past decades. As crop growth and its ultimate yield depend on a multitude of factors; how to control the local environment in greenhouses is important but challenging. The purpose of this paper is to present a smart control system for greenhouses designed based on grey entropy correlation analysis.【Method】A mathematical model for evaluating environmental factors responsible for plant growth in greenhouse was established first; and it was then integrated with the grey entropy weight theory. We took the factors affecting crop growth as multiple attributes to the uncertain decision-making system to calculate the optimal environment; from which we designed a monitoring system including wireless sensor network on chip CC2530; to allocate temperature; humidity; light and other factors into internet to adjust the optimal greenhouse environment for crops to grow.【Result】Test of the system in a greenhouse showed that the packet loss rate of the wireless network communication was less than 1%; meeting the requirements for real-time environmental information collection and stable transmission. It also increased the survival rate of seedlings by 3.1% and saved water use by 14%; compared with traditional method.【Conclusion】The control system we designed based on the grey entropy correlation analysis for greenhouse is stable; reliable and effective; compared with traditional methods that manually adjust environmental parameters in the greenhouse. It hence has a wide application for facility agricultural production by increasing the survival of crop seedlings and saving water usage simultaneously.
keywords: greenhouse seedling, grey entropy, multiple attribute decision making, smart control system
affiliations: Henan Rose Germplasm Innovation and Cultivation Technology Engineering Research Center, Henan Polytechnic Institute, Nanyang Normal University

title: 电力电子变换器故障诊断半实物仿真系统设计
abstract: 对人工智能算法在电力电子技术领域的应用进行了研究。以双有源全桥变换器作为控制对象，采用半实物平台搭建主电路，利用TMS320F28069 MCU搭建控制板，针对双有源全桥变换器的功率管开路故障，设计了一种基于人工智能算法的开路故障诊断方法，能够自动对故障信号进行特征提取，可达到自适应阈值去噪的效果，并对收集的实际信号进行故障诊断。验证了所提出方法的可用性。搭建的平台提高了实验教学的效率，拓展了学生对电力电子技术的领悟和人工智能算法的认同感。
keywords: 人工智能, 开路故障诊断, 电力电子技术, 自适应阈值去噪

title: 开关磁阻电机实验平台的设计与应用
abstract: 设计了开关磁阻电机（SRM）实验平台，包括了硬件电路、速度估计、数学建模、控制系统框架、速度控制律和软件模块。该实验平台实现了SRM传动系统的完整功能，而且还引入了基于多项式插值的瞬时速度估计、基于二阶傅里叶级数的转矩非线性建模，以及带有转矩分配函数的直接瞬时转矩控制策略等一些新颖技术。通过MATLAB仿真和基于数字信号处理器TMS320F28335的实验，验证了实验台的应用效果。仿真和实验结果表明，设计的SRM控制系统可实现准确的速度调节，而且能有效地抑制转矩脉动现象。该实验平台不但支持SRM传动系统的快速原型设计，而且可用于电气和自动化专业学生的控制系统实训，帮助学生学习如何把先进技术用于解决实际问题。
keywords: 实验平台, 开关磁阻电机, 转矩分配函数, 速度控制, 非线性建模

title: 基于无线传感器网络的印刷能耗检测方法研究
abstract: 能耗检测是制造工厂效率评价的重要手段，本研究面向包装印刷智能工厂提出了一种基于Zig Bee无线传感器网络技术的能耗检测系统。该系统包括以芯片CC2530和霍尔传感器作为数据采集节点的数据采集部分、以Zig Bee无线传感器网络为技术基础的无线数据传输部分以及上位机显示界面。相对于传统以智能电表为基础的能耗检测系统，该系统具有采样布置灵活、安装简单、维护方便和低成本等优势。最后通过实验采集印后设备模切机的部分能耗数据，验证了该系统的可行性，为印刷智能工厂能耗数据采集提供了基础，同时对智能工厂其他数据采集提供了参考。
keywords: zig bee, 无线传感器网络, 能耗检测, 霍尔元件
affiliations: 北京印刷学院机电工程学院

title: 基于人工神经网络的永磁电机无传感器控制与实现
abstract: 无传感器控制可以降低永磁电机的成本，并且提高系统的可靠性。永磁电机的电感等参数受运行工况影响会发生变化，因而准确识别电机参数对提高电机的控制精度具有积极意义。基于永磁电机的电感模型，采用人工神经网络对电机电感进行参数辨识，再通过滑模观测器对转子角度进行观测，实现永磁电机无位置传感器的矢量控制。利用TI公司的TMS320F28379d DSP作为控制芯片，搭建了电机控制电路，对所提控制策略进行了验证。结果表明，该控制策略能实时准确地辨识电机参数，提高控制精度，改善控制性能。
keywords: dsp, 人工神经网络, 永磁电机, 滑模观测器
affiliations: 江苏大学机械工程学院

title: 一种脑卒中手部康复设备研究
abstract: 在手部康复设备的帮助下，可以使脑卒中患者手部得到早日恢复，极大提高患者的自理能力。使用这种设备可以缩短康复周期，且复健费用显著降低。文中提出了一种建设性康复设备解决方案，设备基于Arduino Nano和12个微型伺服器SG90制作而成，具有完整的机械结构并可以对手指进行按摩，获得手指的反应力进行生物反馈。使用2、4、6、8或12个伺服器组装Rehab Helper，用于1、2、3、4或5+1（左/右手）根手指。运动力由桥式传感器测量，可以在PC端直观得到手指反应力数据，并对数据做出分析，医护人员可以结合数据对患者进行更精确、快速的评估。
keywords: arduino nano, cc2541, hx711, 伺服器, 手部康复设备, 脑卒中
authors: 王铮;杨博;成尔卓;廖浩添;史建新
affiliations: 南开大学滨海学院

title: 基于物联网技术智慧水产养殖系统的研究设计
abstract: 智慧是科技创新的根源力量;科技创新则为时代的进步提供了强大动力;让万物间的联系更紧密;事物间的信息传递速度更快;数据量更大;因此;让科技服务生活生产的各方面是必然的。尤其在水产养殖方面更是如此;由于水体环境复杂;各项环境指数对水产品的生长、品质和产量有直接的影响;因此基于物联网技术开发了一套智慧水产养殖系统;着力解决水产品养殖遇到的各种问题。系统以TI公司研发的CC2530芯片为主控单元;搭配外围各类数据采集传感器以及控制器;构成ZigBee数据处理网络;实现数据实时传递和共享。将命令传递给控制器后;通过WiFi将数据发送到物联网OneNET云平台;并及时反馈给用户;实现解放劳动生产力;自动化高产高质的现代化水产养殖模式。
keywords: cc2530, onenet云平台, wifi, zigbee, 传感器, 物联网

title: 基于OS2构架的主网新能源安全控制系统设计
abstract: 常规的主网新能源安全控制系统无法有效抑制直流母线电压的冲击，电流环动态性能受到影响，控制效果被削弱。针对这一问题，提出基于OS2构架的主网新能源安全控制系统设计。在原有硬件结构的基础上，选用TMS320F28335型号32位浮点DSP处理器，利用OS2构架主网新能源安全控制系统，实现基于OS2构架的主网新能源安全控制系统设计。实验表明，直流母线电压的冲击降低至754.5V，与常规安全系统相比，更接近于额定参考值，能够有效抑制直流母线电压的冲击，利于系统的稳定运行。
keywords: os2构架, 控制系统, 新能源安全, 直流母线电压
authors: 彭文英;陈丽惠;杨俊峰;李树东;熊红英
affiliations: 云南电网有限责任公司保山供电局

title: 基于射频能量采集的电子标签设计方法
abstract: 根据能量采集应用于标签的特点，在能量采集模块与标签模块之间添加监测电路，并在高低2个阈值设置的基础上，提出能量采集与标签协同工作策略，低阈值选取原则是保证储能模块的储能能够保证标签一次广播，最大限度地防止标签进入掉电状态.从标签设计目标要求的广播间隔与功率出发，根据环境中能够采集到的能量大小与标签不同状态下所需能耗的变化，推导出储能电容最优值、环境中应具备的射频（RF）输入功率最小值与最优值.利用P2110B与CC2640R2F芯片设计了一个基于射频采集的标签进行验证，测试结果表明：采取该方法设计的能量采集标签可以实现能量采集模块和标签模块协同工作，当射频输入功率大于最优值时，标签能够进行持续的“休眠-广播”循环工作，有效地防止标签陷入“能量死锁”，并可自适应地在不同工作状态下转换.
keywords: 协同, 射频, 标签, 能量死锁, 能量采集

title: 一种基于三轴光纤陀螺的小型惯性测量系统设计
abstract: 针对短航时水下航行体自主研制了一款基于三轴光纤陀螺的小型惯性测量系统，该系统由1只三轴光纤陀螺和3只石英加速度计组成敏感元件，结构上进行了一体化设计，整机具有减振功能；硬件电路采用以TMS320F28335主处理器为核心电路的方案，阐述了主要电路设计和采用的关键技术，提供主要芯片国产原位替代对照关系。系统具有软件在线升级功能，升级后产品具有初始对准和导航解算功能。通过静态导航试验和车载导航试验表明：该系统在正常传递对准条件下，15 min持续对准航姿精度可达到航向角误差不大于0.5°;俯仰角、横滚角误差不大于0.35°;具有高可靠性和较强的抗冲击、振动能力。
keywords: 一体化设计, 三轴光纤陀螺, 原位替代, 小型惯性测量系统
authors: 王俊昌;杜彬;李亚;魏鹤怡
affiliations: 西安精密机械研究所

title: 皮带运输机轻载模式运行效率优化控制
abstract: 为解决皮带运输机轻载模式运行效率不高、能源浪费严重的问题，设计了基于粒子群优化（PSO）算法与反向传播（BP）神经网络的皮带运输机轻载模式运行效率最优方案。分析了皮带运输机工作原理以及损耗原理，设计了PSO-BP神经网络算法，动态搜索最优磁通，使得皮带输送机机头/机尾电动机的最小输入有功功率全局最优，铜损、铁损最低。设计了以TMS320LF2407A DSP芯片为核心皮带运输机矢量变频调速方案，实现PSO-BP优化算法功能，完成了该方案的硬件、软件设计。设计了皮带运输机轻载运行效率优化试验，分析了运输机负载启动、负载突变时电机电磁转矩、转子磁通、输入功率以及转速变化曲线。试验结果表明，皮带运输机轻载时，该方案能够提升皮带运输机运行效率，快速寻优，优化电机效率，保证皮带运输机的高效、稳定运行。
keywords: keil arm, 反向传播, 皮带运输机, 粒子群优化, 轻载, 运行效率

title: 基于黑洞粒子群和多层级SVM的低压交流系统短路故障类型辨识
abstract: 针对低压交流系统的短路故障诊断问题，提出一种基于黑洞粒子群优化算法（BHPSO）和多层级SVM的低压交流系统短路故障类型辨识方法.首先，对故障前后0.5 ms电流信号进行小波变换分解，采用小波细节分量标准差构建故障特征向量.其次，以黑洞粒子群算法对SVM的核参数和惩罚因子进行参数优化来构建多层级SVM分类器，实现低压交流系统短路故障类型辨识.最后，采用TMS320F28335 DSP硬件化技术实现故障类型辨识决策模型，通过低压交流系统短路实验证实本方法准确率高，且在噪声干扰、负荷电流变化等工况下均有较好的鲁棒性.
keywords: 低压交流系统, 多层级svm, 短路故障类型辨识, 黑洞粒子群

title: 改进型滑模扰动观测器的感应电机控制系统
abstract: 针对传统PI调节器在负载剧烈突变时控制性能不佳及使用传统滑模观测器抖振严重的问题，文中以感应电机为研究对象，提出了一种基于滑模观测器和传统PI调节器的扰动实时补偿方案。通过改进型的扰动观测器对系统扰动进行实时观测估算，将估算出的扰动反馈至PI调节器进行前馈补偿，从而有效提高电机控制性能，改善抖振现象。文中搭建了基于MATLAB的仿真平台和TMS320F28335 DSP的实验平台，对所研究的改进滑模观测器扰动前馈补偿方法与常规单PI调节、常规滑模观测器扰动补偿进行了对比分析。该结果验证了所提方案的有效性与可行性，速度超调量优化了0.5%;响应时间为30 ms。

title: 一种基于DSP技术的采煤机自动控制系统设计
abstract: 针对当前煤矿综采工作面自动控制能力弱，多数仍以人工操控或遥控器操控为主的现状，基于DSP技术设计一种采煤机的计算机自动控制系统。自动控制系统采用主从双DSP控制内核结构，建立DSP/BIOS即时嵌入式操作系统，由机组传感器对不同数据进行采集，实现实时通讯，确保输入输出的灵活控制，有效完成自动截割等工艺组合，接受远程监控保障安全生产。自动控制系统的主DSP采用32位定点微控制单元（MCU）TMS320F2812，实现采煤机自动控制系统的信息采集、数据传输、交互通信等基本功能；辅DSP采用32位浮点处理单元TMS320F28335，实现自动控制相关的算法处理，缓解软件开发压力；双DSP间经SPI总线接口建立通信渠道。自动控制系统的远距离监控功能将采用CAN总线来连接采煤机与上位机，前者的工况数据传至上位机后，后者直接发布命令指挥采煤机的实时动作。自动控制系统能够实现对煤矿综采工作面采煤机的日常作业工况的数据采集与处理，达到采煤机自动截割、远程监控，组态设计稳定等目的，提升了煤矿综采工作面采煤机的操作自动化水平。
keywords: 煤矿综采, 自动控制系统, 计算机, 采煤机

title: 基于多核TMS320C6678的数据处理与存储系统设计
abstract: 针对当前信号处理领域中数据量大、存储性能低的问题，设计了一种基于TMS320C6678的数字信号处理器，利用多核协同工作完成数据处理与存储。外部数据使用FPGA进行采集，通过SRIO总线将数据传输至DSP的核0，核0完成数据算法处理并通过网络传输至上位机。DSP核0采用核间通信Message Q方式，将通过算法处理后的数据传输至核1来完成数据存储。试验结果表明，使用多核协同处理完成数据处理和存储功能，有效降低了26%的单核资源利用率，在信号处理领域的工程实践中有一定的利用价值。
keywords: tms320c6678, 多核通信, 存储系统, 数据处理
affiliations: 中国兵器装备集团自动化研究所有限公司特种计算机事业部

title: 永磁同步电机模糊自适应控制系统的设计
abstract: 为解决永磁同步电机在阶跃响应中超调量太大的问题，设计了模糊PI控制器来实时调整其比例和积分增益，从而加快系统的动态响应性能。以Ti的TMS320F28335为控制芯片，详细阐述了嵌入式系统中硬件电路和软件程序的设计，包括相电流信号检测电路、速度信号检测电路、驱动电路、保护电路和模糊控制算法在中断函数中的实现流程。搭建了永磁同步电机模糊自适应控制系统，并进行了阶跃响应实验。根据实验结果可知，与PI控制器相比，模糊控制器可以将系统的超调量由30%降低到9%，验证了模糊PI控制器的有效性。
keywords: 嵌入式系统, 模糊控制, 永磁同步电机, 超调量
affiliations: 上海航天控制技术研究所,  中国电子科技集团公司第五十八研究所

title: 基于改进小波阈值的低压电网继电保护输入信号辨识系统设计
abstract: 针对当前低压电网继电保护输入信号辨识系统受到噪声信号干扰;存在信号辨识结果可靠性和精度较低的问题;设计了基于改进小波阈值的低压电网继电保护输入信号辨识系统。根据系统硬件结构;利用A/D转换模块;将电信号转换为数字信号;使用L298N驱动模块驱动直流电机;用以保护过流;使供电与负载供电分离。设计RS485通信接口;将查询信息传送给从机;避免接收错误数据;采用TMS320LF2407 DSP芯片;通过JTAG口将数据传输至仿真器上;实现输入信号辨识。利用改进小波阈值识别算法;在保留初始信号完整的同时;剔除噪声信号;确定低频系数绝对总值和高频系数绝对总值;并设计辨识流程;实现低压电网继电保护输入信号辨识。实验结果表明;通过阶跃信号、正弦信号;验证了该系统的可靠性较高;且识别精度高达0.98;具有精准的识别效果。
keywords: 低压电网继电保护, 改进小波阈值, 输入信号, 辨识系统
affiliations: 国网安徽省电力有限公司马鞍山供电公司

title: 基于冗余存储的车载数据记录仪设计
abstract: 针对传统车载数据记录仪缺少视频数据记录功能，不能实时回放视频数据，存储的数据容易丢失等问题，设计了一种基于冗余存储的车载数据记录仪。采用TMS320DM8168为主要视频处理芯片，实现记录仪的视频数据记录与回放功能；采用数据库管理两个固态硬盘，实现记录仪的冗余存储功能。结合连续工作72 h、高低温贮存实验结果，表明该记录仪运行稳定，视频记录与回放功能实用性强，数据存储的可靠性高。
keywords: tms320dm8168, 冗余存储, 数据记录仪, 视频记录

title: 基于ZigBee技术的结冰风洞温度无线测量系统设计
abstract: 温度是结冰风洞重要的测量参数，“有线式”温度传感器因需长距离布线存在一定局限性，为了提高温度测量的效率，文中设计了一种基于ZigBee技术的结冰风洞温度无线测量系统。温度测量装置采用CC2530驱动Max31865芯片实现对Pt100铂电阻温度信号的采集，通过ZigBee无线网络将温度数据传送给连接到监控主机的协调节点，设计温度采集软件，实现了测温点温度信号的采集、存储与处理，并将该温度测量系统应用于结冰风洞试验中。经实际应用表明，基于ZigBee技术的温度无线测量系统在结冰风洞试验中应用良好，具有较高的测量精度，在-20～0℃范围内的精度可达到0.6℃。
keywords: cc2530, max31865, pt100, zigbee, 温度无线测量, 结冰风洞
authors: 赵照;李自雨;熊建军;冉林;郭向东
affiliations: 中国空气动力研究与发展中心结冰与防除冰重点实验室

title: 基于ZigBee的工程机械安全防护系统设计
abstract: 根据工程机械设备特殊的工作场合，设计了一种工程机械的安全防护系统。该系统在数据传输方式上采用ZigBee无线传输，利用激光测距传感器和超声波测距传感器的返回信息，进行数据融合，得到机械设备到仓底的距离，通过终端节点将数据信息传输到协调器并进行数据显示。塔吊操作者可以根据距离信息，确定设备吊放速度，从而避免硬着陆，可以有效降低设备的故障率。经测试，系统具有低的丢包率，测量误差较小，该方案对于降低工程机械设备的使用成本具有积极的意义。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 工程机械, 数据融合, 测距传感器
affiliations: 济宁学院产业学院
source: 北大核心;国外电子测量技术

title: 基于双锁相环的数据采集时钟电路设计及验证
abstract: 基于模数转换器（Analog-to-Digital Converter;ADC）的数字测量系统，对采样数据的信噪比具有较高要求；在各项因素中，采样时钟的抖动对信噪比的影响最为突出。为滤除输入时钟的抖动，采用德州仪器双环路PLL架构的LMK04610芯片，设计了基于双锁相环的时钟电路；经测试，可以把频率为62.475 MHz源时钟大于7 ps的抖动降低到2 ps以下输出频率为499.8 MHz的时钟信号；提供给ADC芯片采样，其采样数据信噪比接近理论值。双锁相环滤除抖动方案，效果良好，可以为数字测量系统设计人员提供借鉴。
keywords: adc信噪比, 双锁相环, 抖动滤除, 数据采集
authors: 麻惠洲;岳军会;杨静;唐旭辉;杜垚垚;魏书军;高国栋;叶强;刘智;曹建社;李宇鲲;何俊
affiliations: 中国科学院高能物理研究所,  中国科学院大学

title: 基于状态机策略的DSP串口软件升级方案
abstract: TI公司的DSP软件烧写升级通常情况下需要连接仿真器进行，该操作往往需要拆解产品设备，不利于日常维护。针对该问题，以TMS320F2812 DSP平台为例，给出了一种基于状态机策略的DSP串口软件升级方案设计。该方案不仅能够通过串口直接对目标机进行软件升级，而且其采用的状态机策略能够保证软件升级的正确性、可恢复性及重复性。该方案可操作性强且灵活度高，具有很高的实际应用价值。
keywords: dsp软件升级, flash烧写, tms320f2812, 串口软件升级, 状态机策略
affiliations: 中国航空工业集团公司西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 基于档位智能控制的城市节能照明调光系统
abstract: 传统城市节能照明调光系统无法实时预测交通车流量，导致城市电能消耗量仍然较大。为此，设计基于档位智能控制模型的城市节能照明调光系统。设计城市节能照明调光系统硬件电路，并通过CC2530最小系统、控制器等外围电路完成系统硬件设计。在系统软件部分，采用档位智能控制模型预测车流量，调节城市节能照明，实现基于档位智能控制模型的城市节能照明调光系统设计。实验结果表明，文中研究的基于档位智能控制模型的城市节能照明调光系统有效减少了城市电能消耗，并降低了照明调节时长，具备实际应用意义。
keywords: cc2530最小系统, 城市节能, 档位智能控制模型, 照明调光系统
affiliations: 西安市城市规划设计研究院,  长安大学

title: 基于人工智能技术的电压互感器二次绝缘监测系统
abstract: 为了尽早发现电压互感器的二次绝缘故障，设计了基于人工智能技术的电压互感器二次绝缘监测系统。采集电压互感器的三相电压及三相电流值，利用前置处理电路将所采集的信号转化为0～3 V的电压信号，利用A/D转换模块的AD7606-4转换芯片将完成转换的电压信号转换为数字信号，并传送至型号为TMS320F2812的DSP芯片。DSP芯片利用LM算法校正电压互感器稳态误差，利用射频通信模块将完成校正的监测结果传送至上位机，通过上位机显示界面实时展示电压互感器二次绝缘监测结果。测试结果表明，该系统可以监测电压互感器的频率、电容量等众多参数，监测结果的角差和比差降低明显，监测性能优越。
keywords: 二次绝缘, 人工智能技术, 射频通信模块, 模数转换, 电压互感器, 监测系统
authors: 於立峰;余程;马聪;胡凯波
affiliations: 浙江浙能兰溪发电有限责任公司,  浙江浙能技术研究院有限公司

title: 基于ZigBee无线传输协议的数据采集系统设计及应用
abstract: 介绍了一种基于ZigBee无线传输协议的数据采集系统。该系统具有灵活的供电方式、远距离无线通信功能，有着较好的人机交互设计、电路可靠性高，可以连接传感器阵列后，配合模式识别算法等高效灵活的完成传感器相对应数据的采集工作。此外，本研究设计的系统的芯片采用CC2530，该芯片功能较强，通过编写程序完成初步的数据处理工作，例如滤波处理等。该模块可根据不同的采集环境选择相应的传感器或传感器阵列以完成采集工作。该系统弥补了当前多数采集系统体积过大、数据传输复杂耗时，以及供电方式过于单一、不够灵活的缺点。

title: 基于DSP的开关磁阻电机直接转矩控制系统设计与实现
abstract: 针对开关磁阻电机双凸极结构及控制复杂等特点，提出了一种bang-bang调节下的直接转矩控制方法。通过不对称半桥式功率变换器得到定子绕组三电平电压，组成直接转矩控制所需的电压空间矢量。以TMS320F2812型DSP为主控制器，搭建了控制系统的硬件结构，给出了直接转矩控制算法的软件设计。对系统进行了仿真和试验，结果表明，系统输出信号正常可靠，符合开关磁阻电机直接转矩控制要求。方法能有效减小转矩脉动，控制简单，易于实现。
keywords: bang-bang调节, 功率变换器, 开关磁阻电机, 直接转矩控制
affiliations: 陕西国防工业职业技术学院

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感网的起重机械设备安全监控系统
abstract: 设计基于ZigBee无线传感网的起重机械设备安全监控系统，来实时监测起重机工况安全，避免危险事故发生。利用分布式思想将系统分为现场、局域和远程三级架构。以CC2530作为ZigBee网络硬件的核心芯片，设置USB和锂电池共同供电电源、串口与调试等单元。研究数据采集模块所需的硬件设备，将监控器模块作为系统硬件核心，从监控单元和显示单元两方面选取相关设施。系统软件中建立分布式分配机制，解决ZigBee无线传感网网址分配问题。采用Cluster-Tree算法简化节点功能，制定更为合理的路由协议，减少系统通信损耗，设计安全监控单元软件流程，完成系统设计。仿真实验表明，该系统采集误差平均值在0.02 V以内，信息丢包率最大值为1.81%;用户量达到200时其信息丢包率为75.4%。
keywords: cluster-tree算法, zigbee无线传感网, 安全监控系统, 起重机械设备, 路由协议
affiliations: 晋中信息学院智能工程学院

title: 基于改进卡尔曼数据融合算法的温室物联网采集系统研究
abstract: 针对传统温室采集精度不高、布线复杂、能耗大等问题，研究了一种基于改进卡尔曼数据融合算法的温室物联网采集系统。系统硬件主要由CC2530芯片和STM32微处理器构成，运用罗曼诺夫斯基准则对采集的数据进行预处理后，再使用卡尔曼滤波算法在协调器节点处对数据进行静态融合。选取温度作为观测量进行仿真和实验，结果表明，使用改进卡尔曼数据融合算法处理后的温度误差仅为0.089℃;处理后的数据更加接近环境真实值。改进的卡尔曼数据融合算法可以有效地提高数据采集的精度和系统的稳定性，研究结果可为数据采集技术在农业智能化方面的应用提供参考。

title: 荒漠化防治的自供电风速监测系统设计
abstract: 土地荒漠化的扩张严重威胁着生态环境的可持续发展，对区域风速进行实时监测能为荒漠化防治工作提供科学的决策支撑。然而，目前大多数风速监测装置都存在严重依赖外部电源、功耗高的问题。为此，设计了一种基于复合能量采集的自供电风速监测系统。测试结果表明，该系统能够通过能源管理电路对太阳能和风能进行复合采集和储存，以驱动后端电路。无线传输模块将摩擦纳米发电机的输出信号上传至数据终端，最终实现风速信息的显示和存储。此外，低功耗逻辑设计有效延长了传感节点的工作时长。这项工作推动了自供电传感技术在环境监测领域的应用。

title: 基于DSP的轨道交通环境振动监测系统设计
abstract: 设计了一套集振动信号采集、数据处理、数据传输和界面监控于一体的轨道交通环境振动监测系统。监测节点利用DSP数字信号处理器进行1/3倍频程谱分析，得到用于评价环境振动的参数，并通过W5500通信模块将处理后的数据上传到OneNet云平台。监控软件基于VS.NET平台开发，通过HTTP协议读取OneNet云平台上存储的数据，用来监控轨道交通环境振动状况。通过对监测系统的数据采集性能和整体性能进行测试，测试结果表明，该系统信号采集精确，结果与实际相符，达到了设计目的。

title: TMS320C6678的自动代码生成及其应用
abstract: 为优化DSP工程开发方式，将Simulink的可视化模型开发与TMS320C6678相结合，采用可视化的模块设计工具对算法模型和数据流进行建模。模型之间具有标准的数据流传输接口，由代码生成工具根据算法函数模型的描述生成DSP平台上的信号处理程序，完成了MATLAB算法模型到DSP工程的自动代码生成转换。相较于传统的人工翻译成DSP工程的方式，能够在设计阶段就对算法功能进行仿真测试，使得开发者能够更快捷、以更少的成本花费进行开发，也让后期的算法架构修改变得简单。

title: FPGA的超高速数字采集系统设计与实现
abstract: 超宽带雷达具有很高的带宽，因此其具有很高的距离分辨率，同时具有很强的抗干扰能力。数字采集系统作为超宽带雷达系统中的关键组成部分，需要很高的采样率才能完成对超宽带信号的采集。本文以高性能FPGA+超高采样率ADC的结构进行高速数字采集系统的设计，实现两通道、8位、9.4 Gsps信号采样，系统的ENOB优于5.4位，SFDR优于50 dB;性能满足设计需求，具有一定的工程应用价值。

title: 嵌入式图像识别的机器人路径追踪系统
abstract: 为了解决传统路径追踪系统追踪精度低的问题，本文设计了基于嵌入式图像识别的机器人路径追踪系统。系统利用内核驱动层的图像采集模块驱动硬件层的CCD摄像机，采集行驶路径的图像信息并传送至同层的控制模块；控制模块选用TMS320DM6437将图像信息传送至业务支持层的图像识别模块；图像识别模块通过边缘提取等过程识别路径信息，将识别结果传送至路径追踪模块，并在通信模块中利用无线通信网络在追踪界面展示路径追踪结果。实验结果表明：在不同光照强度下，该系统得到的机器人路径追踪结果的位移偏差小于2 cm、角度偏差小于1°;说明该系统具有优越的路径追踪性能。

title: TMS320C6678的超长点FFT并行计算方法
abstract: 针对DSP平台算法移植时遇到的超长点FFT实现和运算效率问题;本文结合TI公司的TMS320C6678的DSP;利用FFT的分解算法和L2内存段高效的访存效率;将DSP内存数据EDMA搬移与FFT分解计算相并行;设计出一种超长点FFT计算并行处理方法;通过262 144点FFT计算描述了该方法的具体实现过程;将DSP计算结果与MATLAB结果比对;统计了该方法的计算误差为10

title: 基于ZigBee网络的家庭燃气阀门智能安全系统
abstract: 物联网家居在我国发展迅速，一大批智能家居逐渐涌现，在此基础上我设计出一款家庭燃气智能安全系统。本产品采用ZigBee网络技术通过MQ-2气体传感器对空气中燃气进行检测采集，从而实现燃气的多处无线监测。当监测到燃气泄漏时，CC2530模块通过控制继电器开关自动关闭电磁燃气阀门并且蜂鸣报警器发出报警声音，与此同时GSM移动通讯模块向用户发送短信提醒。本设计可广泛应用于家庭燃气监测。
keywords: zigbee, 天然气阀门, 物联网技术

title: 光储一体化变流器并网/离网切换控制技术研究
abstract: 针对光伏发电系统和储能系统组成的一体化变流器在并网工作模式与离网工作模式相互切换时采用不同控制策略存在电压畸变和电流冲击的问题;提出基于比例-比例积分（P-PI）的改进下垂控制策略;统一并网/离网控制策略;并在下垂系数中增加积分环节;利用积分环节改善变流器由并网模式切换到离网模式时的稳定性。优化相位修正算法和电压、频率同步控制策略;保证变流器执行并网操作前与电网电压幅值、频率、相位保持一致;实现变流器平滑无缝进入并网工作模式。利用以TMS320F28335数字控制器为核心的光储一体化变流器样机对所设计的并网/离网切换控制策略进行验证;实验结果表明提出的控制策略正确有效;解决了变流器并网/离网工作模式切换过程中电压畸变和电流冲击问题;实现了变流器稳定运行。
keywords: 变流器, 并网/离网切换控制, 改进下垂控制

title: 基于ZigBee技术的建筑火灾低压配电报警系统设计
abstract: 随着火灾的频繁发生，火灾报警系统的应用至关重要，传统的无线火灾报警系统存在很大的消防技术问题和局限性。新兴的报警方式Zigbee自动报警技术能充分满足无线火灾自动预警系统的各种功能。本文以CC2530模块为核心，以ZigBee技术为基础对火灾信号进行检测和分析。本系统广泛适用于多数有火灾报警需求的场所。
keywords: ds18b20数据温度传感器, zigbee, 复合式火灾探测器, 联动控制设备设计
affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: 风光互补发电系统在路灯上的研究及应用
abstract: 根据传统路灯需要并网实现照明且依赖稳定运行的需求。讨论利用TMS320F2812芯片控制风光互补路灯，同时在系统中使用控制策略追踪风电和光电的最大功率点，并提出对蓄电池三段式优化充电方案。通过实验可验证基于TMS320F2812芯片控制路灯在该系统内能够持续稳定运行。
keywords: 最大功率点跟踪, 照明路灯, 风光互补发电系统

title: 基于TMS320F28335控制器实现励磁系统的智能均流控制
abstract: 智能均流控制可以极大提高均流特性，但可能会影响励磁系统调节的响应速度、换向时增加晶闸管的电流冲击强度及掩盖晶闸管元件的实际故障等。本文以TMS320F28335控制器为核心实现励磁系统的智能均流控制，对控制模型的参数进行动态调节，同时采用交流采样和CAN通讯提高了抗干扰能力。最终通过试验验证，该智能均流控制提高系统均流特性的同时又避免了不利影响。
keywords: 励磁系统, 整流桥, 晶闸管, 智能均流
affiliations: 福建水口发电集团有限公司

title: 球磨机衬板提升条厚度测量系统设计与实现
abstract: 衬板提升条是球磨机的易损部件，提升条损坏会导致筒体被磨穿的概率上升进而产生安全隐患。通常对其磨损程度进行检测时都需要停机。文章设计一套球磨机衬板提升条厚度在线测量系统，通过在衬板固定螺栓中预埋电阻传感器的方式获取提升条磨损数据，再采用射频通信进行数据传输，可实现在不停机的情况下，实时监测衬板提升条在工作过程中的厚度变化。此外，采用CC1310主控芯片的超低功耗电路系统设计和采用空中唤醒的无线通信方式使该系统可以连续工作6个月以上，满足工程作业的需要。实验结果表明，该系统的平均测量误差为1.83 mm，使用该系统能够准确有效地测量出衬板提升条的磨损程度，有效保证球磨机的高效安全运行。
keywords: 低功耗, 厚度测量, 实时监测, 衬板提升条

title: 基于ZigBee网络与嵌入式3S技术的农田信息监测系统设计
abstract: 基于土壤结构、气候参数等信息的农田信息采集实现现代数字农业的技术基础。利用双向无线通信技术ZigBee和嵌入式3S技术，设计出了一种农田信息监测系统，能够自动进行农田环境、地理位置等信息实时发送，较为便捷地实现农田信息监测和管理。
keywords: cc2530单片机, gprs网络, zigbee网络, 传感器, 物联网
authors: 夏至波;潘坛;蔡绍硕;徐欢

title: 基于TMS320F28335的煤矿综采监测装置设计
abstract: 随着自动化技术、智能控制技术与信息技术的丰富、深化，面向煤矿安全监测领域设计了一种新型的煤矿综合监测装置.该装置的控制系统采用TMS320F28335型数字处理器，通过指令协调检测模块、监控模块、通讯模块及上位机模块有序工作，完成井下环境指标监测；采用Code Composer Studio平台和YKSe触摸屏软件完成系统编程和上位机界面设计；采用圆筒型防爆外壳实现井下瓦斯浓度、粉尘浓度、风速、温湿度、矿车载重以及巷道状况等多信息的检测、显示和自动报警.通过实验验证了系统上电后能够实现信息采集、信息处理、数据上传、上位机显示及超阈值自动报警等功能.实验验证了设计的可行性.
keywords: 信息采集, 数字处理器, 煤矿综合监测, 防爆外壳
affiliations: 兰州交通大学新能源与动力工程学院

title: 基于改进卡尔曼滤波的窖池水分监测系统
abstract: 针对窖池发酵监测手段落后;人工成本大、数据精度低等问题;利用ZigBee技术和改进卡尔曼滤波算法;设计一套窖池水分无线监测系统。采用符合ZigBee协议标准的CC2530芯片组建无线传感器网络;结合改进卡尔曼滤波算法处理水分信号;再通过RS485总线与上位机通信;实现实时采集和无线监测功能。实验表明:该系统能有效的监测窖池内部的水分变化;还能实现水分数据的远程监控和储存;具有较高准确性。
keywords: cc2530芯片, zigbee技术, 实时采集, 改进卡尔曼滤波, 无线监测, 窖池监测
affiliations: 安徽大学电子与信息工程学院

title: 基于AM3358的煤矿电力电缆状态在线测量系统设计
abstract: 针对煤矿电力电缆绝缘状态测量信号不稳定和绝缘参数准确度低等问题，设计了一款以AM3358处理器为核心的绝缘状态参数远程测量终端RTU，并给出了关于系统的软硬件设计。采用广域测量方案，通过EtherCAT同步电缆两端RTU的控制时序，进而实时采样电缆两端的电压、电流和温度等参数。借助矢量运算，准确计算电缆的绝缘电阻和对地电容，在线评估实际工况下电力电缆的绝缘性能，对大幅提高矿井供电系统的安全可靠性有重要意义。
keywords: am3358, ethercat, 测量系统, 电缆, 绝缘
affiliations: 河南工业和信息化职业学院

title: 基于ZigBee的煤矿救援机器人无线通信系统设计
abstract: 首先针对煤矿救援机器人系统进行总体设计，并分析当前主流的无线通信技术的优缺点，确定在矿道中选用900 MHz的ZigBee组网完成救援机器人的无线通信；然后根据ZigBee技术自身特性设计了无线组网的流程，使无线通信带宽更高，维护更加方便，同时避免了因传输路径占用而无法进行数据传递的问题；最后基于CC2530芯片完成了煤矿救援机器人无线通信系统的硬件设计，并依据设计的通信协议，实现了多机器人协作完成救援任务。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 无线通信, 煤矿救援机器人
affiliations: 河北工程技术学院

title: 基于嵌入式软PLC的压铸机实时控制系统设计
abstract: 为了实现压铸机压射过程的实时控制，以AM3358控制器为核心设计了一种支持多任务实时调度管理的嵌入式软PLC控制系统。硬件上移植Linux操作内核，按压铸机程控思路设计软PLC控制程序和液晶屏交互界面，配置压力和冲头速度采样、压铸状态实时监测等硬件模块。通过嵌入式实时内核在线调用压铸机压力和速度等实时控制功能，监控压射工艺曲线，提高压铸机控制系统的响应速度，对确保压铸生产质量有重要的应用价值。
keywords: am3358控制器, linux, 压射过程, 压铸机, 嵌入式软plc
affiliations: 河北石油职业技术大学

title: 基于AGV泊车设计的驱动控制系统
abstract: 为寻求一种机械化和智能化的自动泊车设备，以提高车辆管理效率、降低泊车成本。提出一种以单片机为核心控制开发了一个差速驱动控制导引小车试验系统，利用相关的运动安全传感器，可完成AGV小车的完整运动控制。采用P+前馈控制作为电机的控制算法。通过运行测试，小车实现了差速转向、路径导引等功能，取得了良好的运动控制效果，达到了预期目标，适合应用于无人智能停车场的运动控制。
keywords: agv, am3359, p+前馈控制, 差速控制
authors: 魏孜倩;李升建;张延良;张国良
affiliations: 潍柴动力股份有限公司电控与软件研究院

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感网的智能家居设计与实现
abstract: 随着现代科学信息技术的进步和发展;日常生活中的电子信息化的程度和质量也得到了相应的提高，同时人们对于生活和环境的安全性、便利性以及舒适性的要求也越来越高。ZigBee技术具有近距离、低功耗、短延时以及组网灵活等优势，已成为物联网技术发展的一个热点，被越来越多地应用于智能家居领域。文章基于ZigBee无线传感网技术设计了一种智能家居系统模型，实时监测和控制家居环境的温湿度、亮度以及有害气体等数据。系统将各个监控节点采集的数据经过CC2530单片机处理后，通过无线传感网发送给移动应用终端，再由移动应用终端实现远程实时监测和控制各个监控节点。
keywords: cc2530单片机, zigbee, 无线传感网, 智能家居
affiliations: 福建船政交通职业学院

title: 智能车辆无线传感定位方法
abstract: 为了实现区域内未知节点定位，减小RSSI接收信号强度稳定性差引起的目标定位误差，提出一种基于物联网的智能车辆无线传感定位方法，建立了带有RSSI引擎的区域传感定位系统。结合智能车辆运动轨迹模型，采用预滤波的序贯质心定位算法进行RSSI测距值校正优化。在运动轨迹测距阶段，将智能车辆信号强度与WSN中基于接收信号强度指示的信标节点间距离同时考虑在质心定位算法内进行RSSI值校正，权值选择阶段出于对智能车辆通信外部环境复杂性的考虑，采用完整的无线信号传播损耗Shadowing模型，基于修正传统权重的路径损失计算方法，进一步修正扩展该模型。通过引入一个服从对数正态分布和零均值高斯分布的随机噪声变量，权值取信标节点距离倒数之和，依据动态参考点群组ZigBee无线传感网络完成辅助定位。经实验验证，加权质心定位算法经权值修正后，充分反映了信标节点影响力，与传统质心定位算法模型相比，RSSI值校正模型在智能车辆无线传感测距和加权定位阶段都有了很大改进，弥补了普通算法利用单节点多跳路由信息交换完成位置估算引起的测距误差。结果表明，此方法具有网络自愈性，RSSI测距误差≤3.5 m，采用多群组动态参考节点定位能够获得较好的定位精度。
keywords: cc2530芯片, shadowing模型, zigbee无线传感网络, 动态参考点, 无线传感定位, 智能车辆, 物联网
affiliations: 西安汽车职业大学电子信息工程学院,  陕西科技大学电气与控制工程学院

title: 基于CC2530的远程可调直流稳压电源设计
abstract: 针对户外无线传感器网络中节点终端多样化供电需求的问题，文中以无线传感器网络芯片CC2530为控制核心，设计一种小功率可调直流稳压电源。该电源利用具备8051CPU内核的CC2530控制芯片，并结合ZigBee协议栈以及PWM电压反馈调节控制原理，实现输出稳压、远程调压、无线组网、监测、异常报警等功能。另外，电源节点端采用CC2530主控芯片端口输出PWM波，采用电压反馈调控占空比完成Buck电路输出工作的同时与协调器端通过无线传感器网络连接，使无线传感器网络芯片CC2530的片上资源得到充分应用。最后，通过搭建实验样机系统进行验证，室内测试采用直流电压源模拟户外光伏输入。测试结果表明，所设计的远程可调直流稳压电源输出电压误差小于0.5%，无线调压步进值为0.5 V，能够满足多种传感器终端设备的供电需求，具有较高的实用价值。
keywords: cc2530, 室内测试, 无线传感器网络, 电源设计, 直流稳压电源, 远程调压, 远端监测
authors: 杨晨;谭建军;刘伟;朱黎;肖雨;李清海
affiliations: 湖北民族大学,  硒食品营养与健康智能技术湖北省工程研究中心

title: 基于虚拟现实技术的少儿体育体感训练系统设计
abstract: 为提高少儿体育体感训练效果;解决传统体育体感系统面临的平衡性误差问题;基于虚拟现实技术设计了新的少儿体育体感训练系统。硬件部分设计了嵌入式体感遥控器、KinectV2体感设备以及CC2540体感训练数据处理器;软件部分首先构建了少儿体育体感训练框架;其次基于虚拟现实技术设计了少儿体育运动识别算法;最后设计了体感训练功能模块;从而实现了有效的少儿体育体感训练。进行系统测试;结果表明;设计的少儿体育体感训练系统的平衡性误差较低;训练性能良好;有一定的应用价值;符合少儿体育体感训练需求。
keywords: 体感训练系统, 少儿体育, 虚拟现实
affiliations: 湖北经济学院

title: 基于物联网技术的环境简便监测与远程管理控制系统
abstract: 人们对居住环境的要求，使居住环境的监测以及居住在简便条件下的智能监控监测变得尤为重要。本文阐述了一种基于物联网技术的环境简便监测与远程管理控制系统。通过传感器来检测与采集环境参数并使用终端的CC2530单片机进行数据的打包处理，利用ZigBee无线网络实现多节点的无线采集。由基于CC2530单片机ZigBee协调器和SimpleLink CC3200无线MCU组成的网关节点，在接收到环境参数之后，使用SimpleLink CC3200无线MCU将检测到的环境参数上传到阿里云服务器，通过手机App来访问服务器，实现远程监测与控制管理。同时，CC2530单片机通过串口与上位机进行通信，上位机将数据存储到本地数据库进行存储。来实现物联网技术下的环境简便检测和远程控制管理。
keywords: 传感器, 无线传感网络, 物联网
affiliations: 1. 武汉南南杨科技有限公司    2. 武汉建春科技有限公司    3. 青岛海纹智慧农业科技有限公司

title: 基于Android的便携式电磁阀性能测试系统设计
abstract: 针对电磁阀性能测试设备不方便携带等问题，设计一套基于单片机和Android手机终端的便携式电磁阀性能测试系统。以Android智能手机为数据处理中心，STC15W408AS单片机为主控芯片，结合511系列压力传感器、CC2540蓝牙模块等设备和控制软件，实现电磁阀状态数据采集、实时显示、性能测试和数据共享等功能。结果表明：借助Android Studio开发的手机APP充分体现人机交互的优势；该系统结构简单、使用方便、测试精度可靠，符合国家电磁阀性能测试标准，能够有效用于电磁阀的现场快速测试。
keywords: android, 便携式系统, 性能测试, 电磁阀
authors: 羊荣金;陈敏捷;朱伟东;张志红

title: 基于Flash的TMS320C6713自启动实现方法
abstract: 介绍了一种利用EMIF的Flash存储扩展来实现用户程序自动加载的方法。当DSP复位时内部引导装载程序会装载位于Flash前1 kB的二次引导程序。装载成功后DSP从0x00地址开始执行二次引导程序。二次引导程序的作用就是完成加载用户应用程序，并且在加载完成后跳到C程序入口点c＿int00处，执行用户程序，实现用户程序的Flash自启动。如果用户程序过大，或需要加载部分代码到SDRAM中运行，就需要使用多次加载的方式实现程序加载。

title: 并联电容器母线电流在线监测传感器关键技术研究
abstract: 电容器是电力系统重要的无功补偿设备，并联电容器组频繁投切补偿电网无功过程中会产生严重的涌流和谐波，母线上瞬间大电流也对电容器单元运行安全威胁极大。设计一种基于无线传感技术的并联电容器母线电流在线监测传感器，通过取能电路、测量电路、保护外壳分析，确定传感器采用铁心直接在母线进行高压取能、罗氏线圈测量的结构，并封装于一体式铝壳体系统中，利用内置A/D、ZigBee通信协议栈的CC2530芯片以及专用信号处理电路实现电容器母线大电流测量，并在实验室进行验证。该装置解决了铁心磁性饱和下高位取能、大电流准确测量问题，实现了传感器现场高压绝缘、抗干扰和无线组网设计的整体性能优化。
keywords: zigbee, 在线监测, 并联电容器, 母线电流, 电力系统

title: 舱内低功耗无线传感网络系统设计
abstract: 在火箭参数测量系统中，传统的传感网络使用电缆进行连接，随着测试点的增加，大量缆线的使用不仅带来了多余的负载和功耗，而且还占用了大量的舱内空间，为火箭舱内其他设备的布局和安装造成巨大的困扰。针对上述问题，提出了一种基于CC1310的无线传感网络（WSN）设计方案，实现测试系统无缆化。该设计选用通信频段低于1 GHz（Sub-GHz）的超低功耗射频芯片CC1310作为传感网络控制器，使用低功耗的K型热电偶AD8495实现温度数据的采集，使用锂电池为传感器节点供电。软件设计实现了传感器节点周期性休眠和唤醒侦听机制，主节点轮询访问传感器节点获取状态和数据的功能，完成了传感器节点低功耗设计并且数据的可靠性可以得到保证。经试验测试，该系统设计合理，具有功耗低、数据传输稳定可靠等显著特点，且系统在组网后工作状态平均能耗为88μA;可实现火箭舱内环境参数的长期测量。
keywords: cc1310, sub-ghz, 低功耗, 数据采集, 无线传感网络

title: 基于太阳能智慧树的多源传感器数据采集与处理
abstract: 针对基于太阳能的智慧多功能树对多源传感器输出的异构数据实时稳定处理需求;设计了一种由支持ZigBee的CC2530芯片运行的嵌入式数据采集与整合处理模块;模块基于边缘算法、结合物联网平台;能够实时将智慧树检测到的模拟、数字、串口等数据进行采集并处理;针对多串口数据采集设计了一种基于流程标识的通讯过程。最后介绍了边缘计算及策略在嵌入式系统中的实现。

title: 基于ZigBee技术的养老院无线呼叫系统设计
abstract: 针对目前养老院的呼叫系统的不完善的问题;设计一种基于ZigBee技术的无线呼叫系统;在老人出现紧急情况时;及时进行呼叫;确保老人身体状况出现异常时能及时得到医治。无线呼叫系统安装简捷;不会对养老院的日常生活造成困扰。给老人提供一个更加安全的生活环境;低成本、高效率的优点也使本系统在养老院、社区等地具有良好的应用前景。

title: 车用异步电机电驱动系统高性能控制平台设计及实现
abstract: 为开展纯电动汽车用异步电机高性能控制策略研究，在分析异步电机数学模型的基础上，分别对矢量控制原理和空间矢量脉宽调制（Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation;SVPWM）进行了研究，在MATLAB/Simulink中完成了对异步电机矢量控制系统模型的搭建。在MATLAB/Simulink和CCS6.2环境中编写了基于TMS320F28335控制的异步电机矢量控制系统代码生成软件，搭建了以智能功率模块（Intelligent power module;IPM）FSBB30CH060为驱动的硬件实验平台，并利用LabVIEW建立了便于数据采集与监控的上位机监控界面。以功率60 W的异步电机为被控对象，研究了异步电机矢量控制系统平台的性能。实验结果表明，该平台能够实现车用异步电机高性能控制策略开发，在研究车用异步电机高性能控制策略中具有重要应用价值。
keywords: 代码生成, 平台设计, 异步电机, 矢量控制, 空间矢量脉宽调制

title: T-BOX车载网联终端设计
abstract: 基于瑞萨RH850微控制器、TI CC2640R2F蓝牙微控制器、高通MDM9628微处理器设计了一款T-BOX车载终端。该终端通过CAN总线技术、GPS定位技术、数据加密技术、蓝牙通信技术、LTE无线数据通信技术等将车辆信息发送至云端车载信息服务提供商，实现鉴权通信、车辆数据主动上报等功能；车载信息服务提供商亦可通过该终端查询车辆信息、远程控制车辆、远程诊断车辆、远程刷新车辆控制器等。实车试验表明：设计的T-BOX车载终端可准确采集、传输车辆信息，能够可靠完成与车辆及车载信息服务提供商的交互。

title: High-gain Ultra-small Streak Camera and Its Integrated Control System
abstract: As a diagnostic instrument with ultra-high temporal and spatial resolution and spectral resolution;the streak camera is widely used in basic research fields such as physics;life sciences;and materials science;as well as in national strategic fields such as detonation physics;lidar;and inertial confinement fusion. Aiming at the requirements of airborne lidar for miniaturized;high-sensitivity;highgain;and high spatiotemporal resolution streak camera;a high-brightness-gain compact streak camera and its new integrated control system are developed.Compared with the general picosecond visible light streak camera;the volume and weight of the camera are reduced by more than 2/3. The selected streak camera adopts the theoretical simulation research of cathode semiconductor and the method of optimizing the process to greatly improve the sensitivity of the cathode. Using a slit acceleration grid improves the photoelectron transmittance;enhances the photoelectron energy to give the fluorescent screen higher luminous efficiency;and optimizes the cathode process to improve the brightness gain. The streak image tube has the characteristics of high sensitivity;large detection field;high brightness gain;and high temporal and spatial resolution.Starting from the principle and control requirements;combined with the theoretical analysis of the defects of the active control system;a new type of high-integration control system is developed for the camera;which fully eliminates the low integration;poor reliability and compatibility of the previous version.defect. The hardware of the new control system adopts the design method of modularization and function reuse;and the PCB adopts the multi-layer board design. Compared with the current version;the degree of integration is increased by 2.36 times to achieve multi-device compatibility. The bottom layer of the system hardware is divided into main control module;power supply module;A/D module;D/A module;digital I/O and extended scan switching module:the main control module takes STM32F107VCT6 as the core and is responsible for the information between each module and the host computer Interaction;the power supply module is divided into a high-voltage power supply part and a low-voltage power supply part;which provide corresponding voltages for the stripe tube and each element of the circuit;the A/D module takes ADS1256 as the core;adds anti-static protection and digital-analog isolation to entirely eliminate noise interference;and uses SPI The protocol communicates with the host computer;the D/A module takes DAC8534 as the core to control the output of analog devices such as MCP and high-voltage power supply;the digital I/O and expansion scan switching module use the microcontroller GPIO as the control;and the24 pins programmable interface supports function multiplexing. The PC-side visualization system realizes human-computer interaction and has functions such as camera control;instant feedback of collected images and data;and operation logs. The interface is concise and optimized;which greatly enhances the operability and maintainability of the camera.Finally;the streak tube static test system is used to test the parameters of the streak image tube:the cathode integral sensitivity is 268 μA/lm;the brightness gain is 20.1;and the time resolution is 36 ps;femtosecond laser;F-P etalon;DG645 delayer;oscilloscope;etc. built a dynamic test system for streak camera;and tested the static/dynamic spatial resolution;time resolution;control system function;etc. of the whole machine. The static spatial resolution is higher than 26 lp/mm;the full-screen scanning time is600 ps;and the functions of control;monitoring and information exchange of the control system are normal.The developed streak camera works well in the laser radar and Inertial Confinement Fusion（ICF）picosecond laser targeting experiments.
keywords: brightness gain, cathode sensitivity, compatibility, control system, integration, streak camera
authors: ZHANG Yuchi;WANG Junfeng;GAO Guilong;LI Shaohui;WANG Xing;ZHAO Wei;LIU Baiyu;LI Zhibing;CHEN Ping;TIAN Jinshou;XUE Yanhua

title: Multi-source optimal dispatching system for active distribution network considering operation risk
abstract: In view of the problem that the previous multi-source optimal dispatching method of active distribution network lacks the thermal inertia analysis of operation risk electrical equipment load;which leads to the problem that the power load control is not flexible;the multi-source optimal dispatching system of active distribution network is designed with full consideration of operation risk.Taking TMS320LF2407 as the center of the main controller;combined with DSP chip;the feeder terminal unit is designed.Through the distribution terminal unit;the power supply is not interrupted power supply.Remote terminal units that use long distance communication to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.IEC61968information exchange bus is designed to realize the bidirectional control of information.Taking full account of the operation risks of electrical equipment and analyzing the flexibility of load scheduling;the objective of three-dimensional multi-source optimal scheduling is determined.The multi-source optimal scheduling scheme is designed to realize the interactive coordination and optimal control of each region.According to the experimental results;the amount of electricity purchased by the nodes from the power grid at different times of the system is consistent with the actual amount;with an error of 0;which ensures the flexible control of power load.
keywords: active distribution network, multisource optimization, operation risk, power load control, scheduling, thermal inertia of load
affiliations: State Grid Mengjin County Electric Power Supply Company

title: Multi-stage loading and dynamic reconfiguration based on TMS320C6678
abstract: For multi-core DSP applications;Boat Load technology and dynamic deployment are the key points. For the purpose of realizing fast;multi-stage loading and online dynamic deployment of multi-core DSP;thispaper designs a multi-stage loading scheme based on EMIF（External Memory Interface）interface and an online dynamic reconfiguration scheme based on Ethernet interface. Starting from the kernel one stage boot;the scheme modifies the traditional two stage boot of EMIF;and the storagearea is partitioned to achieve dynamic reconfiguration. Through the test board developed by ourselves;the results show that the multi-stage loading based on EMIF interface is successful;and the online dynamic deployment can be realized;which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the design.
keywords: dynamic reconfiguration, emif, ethernet interface, multi-stage loading, tms320c6678
affiliations: CETC Rong Wei Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of data processing and storage system based on multi-core TMS320C6678
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large amount of data and low performance of storage in the current signal processing field;a data processing and storage system based on the TMS320C6678 digital signal processor using multi-core collaborative work is designed. The external data is collected using FPGA;and the data is transmitted to the core 0 of the DSP through the SRIO bus. The core 0 completes the algorithm processing and transmits the data to the host computer through the network. The core 0 uses the method of Message Q to transmit the processed data to the core 1.The core 1 completes the work of data storage.The test results show that the use of multi-core collaborative processing to complete data processing and storage functions effectively reduces the utilization rate of single-core resources by 26%;and has a certain value in engineering practice in the field of signal processing.
keywords: data processing, multi-core communication, storage system, tms320c6678
affiliations: Department of Special Computer,Automation Research Institute Co.,Ltd.,of China South Industries Group Corporation

title: Design of low voltage power grid relay protection input signal identification system based on improved wavelet threshold
abstract: The input signal identification system of relay protection in low-voltage power grid is disturbed by noise signal;and the reliability and accuracy of signal identification results are low.A low-voltage power grid relay protection input signal identification system based on improved wavelet threshold is designed.According to the hardware structure of the system;the A/D conversion module is used to convert the electrical signal into digital signal;and the L298N drive module is used to drive the DC motor to protect the over-current and separate the power supply from the load.The RS485 communication interface is designed to transmit the query information to the slave to avoid receiving the wrong data.The TMS320LF2407 is adopted DSP chip transmits the data to the simulator through JTAG port to realize the input signal identification.By using the improved wavelet threshold recognition algorithm;the noise signal is eliminated while the initial signal is intact;and the absolute value of low frequency coefficient and high frequency coefficient are determined.The identification process is designed to realize the input signal identification of low-voltage power grid relay protection.The experimental results show that the system has good reliability through the verification of step signal and sine signal;and the recognition accuracy can be as high as 0.98.
keywords: identification system, improved wavelet threshold, input signal, low voltage power grid relay protection
affiliations: Ma’anshan Power Supply Company of State Grid Anhui Electric Power Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of vehicle data recorder based on redundant storage
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional vehicle data recorder;such as the lack of video data recording function;the inability to playback the video data in real time;and the easy loss of the stored data;a vehicle data recorder based on redundant storage was designed. TMS320 DM8168 was used as the main video processing chip to realize the video data recording and playback function of the recorder. Two solid state hard disks are managed by database to realize the redundancy storage function of the recorder.Combined with the experimental results of 72 hours continuous operation and high and low temperature storage;it is shown that the recorder runs stably;the video recording and playback function is practical;and the data storage reliability is high.
keywords: data recorder, redundant storage, tms320dm8168, video recording

title: Design of wireless temperature measurement system for icing wind tunnel based on ZigBee technology
abstract: Temperature is an important measurement parameter of icing wind tunnel. The wired temperature sensor has some limitations due to its long-distance wiring. In order to improve the efficiency of temperature measurement;a wireless temperature measurement system based on ZigBee technology is designed in this paper. The temperature measurement device uses CC2530 to drive Max31865 chip to realize the temperature signal acquisition of Pt100 platinum resistance. The temperature data is transmitted to the coordination node connected to the monitoring host through ZigBee wireless network. The temperature acquisition software is designed to realize the acquisition;storage and processing of temperature signal at the temperature measurement point. The temperature measurement system is applied to the icing wind tunnel test. The practical application shows that the wireless temperature measurement system based on ZigBee technology has good application in icing wind tunnel test and has high measurement accuracy;the measurement accuracy can reach 0.6 ℃ in the range from-20 ℃ to 0 ℃.
keywords: cc2530, icing wind tunnel, max31865, pt100, wireless temperature measurement, zigbee

title: 一种基于DSP技术的采煤机自动控制系统设计
abstract: 针对当前煤矿综采工作面自动控制能力弱，多数仍以人工操控或遥控器操控为主的现状，基于DSP技术设计一种采煤机的计算机自动控制系统。自动控制系统采用主从双DSP控制内核结构，建立DSP/BIOS即时嵌入式操作系统，由机组传感器对不同数据进行采集，实现实时通讯，确保输入输出的灵活控制，有效完成自动截割等工艺组合，接受远程监控保障安全生产。自动控制系统的主DSP采用32位定点微控制单元（MCU）TMS320F2812，实现采煤机自动控制系统的信息采集、数据传输、交互通信等基本功能；辅DSP采用32位浮点处理单元TMS320F28335，实现自动控制相关的算法处理，缓解软件开发压力；双DSP间经SPI总线接口建立通信渠道。自动控制系统的远距离监控功能将采用CAN总线来连接采煤机与上位机，前者的工况数据传至上位机后，后者直接发布命令指挥采煤机的实时动作。自动控制系统能够实现对煤矿综采工作面采煤机的日常作业工况的数据采集与处理，达到采煤机自动截割、远程监控，组态设计稳定等目的，提升了煤矿综采工作面采煤机的操作自动化水平。
keywords: 煤矿综采, 自动控制系统, 计算机, 采煤机
affiliations: 柳州职业技术学院百色职业学院

title: 基于DSP的六相永磁同步电机控制器的设计
abstract: 由于驱动系统不再受到电机相数的限制，多相电机因控制灵活、系统稳定性强等优点而广泛应用在电力机车牵引、电动/混合燃料汽车驱动等领域。针对六相永磁同步电机SVPWM控制策略的实现，设计了一种以DSP-TMS320F28335为主控板的控制芯片，同时搭载功率模块为Infineon的FS400R07A1E3与驱动模块为Power Integrations的6SP0110T，并配置相对应的外围电路，从而实现了满足六相永磁同步电机可用的电机控制器。以六相永磁同步电机为研究对象，基于电机的数学模型与最优开关次数六相SVPWM的算法，根据控制器主控板的核心处理器DSP-TMS320F28335芯片、英飞凌的IGBT模块、驱动系统的选型，给出了AD采样调理电路、转子位置角检测电路、PWM脉冲信号处理电路等相关外围电路的硬件设计方案。其次，阐述了软件系统的设计方法，设计了主程序处理流程及中断程序处理流程图，并分析了最优开关次数的六相SVPWM算法流程，从而完成六相永磁同步电机控制器的设计。经实验平台验证，该软硬件系统实现了基于最优开关次数六相SVPWM控制策略的以DSP为核心的电机控制器功能，对比分析电机运行的谐波开环控制与谐波闭环控制的实验数据，表明基于最优开关次数六相SVPWM调制算法的电机控制器具有稳定的调速性能，谐波含量控制效果显著，且开关损耗更小，具有一定的工程应用价值。
keywords: dsp, igbt, svpwm, 六相永磁同步电机, 硬件系统, 软件设计

title: DSP Serial Port Software Upgrade Scheme Based on State Machine Strategy
abstract: TI company’s DSP software upgrade usually needs to be connected to the emulator;the operation often needs to disassemble the product equipment;which is not convenient for routine maintenance.To solve this problem;this paper takes TMS320F2812 platform as an example;and gives a DSP serial port software upgrade scheme based on state machine strategy.This scheme can not only upgrade the software of the target machine directly through the serial port;but also ensure the correctness;recoverability and repeatability in software upgrade.The scheme has strong operability and high flexibility;and has high practical application value.
keywords: dsp software upgrade, flash programming, serial port software upgrade, state machine strategy, tms320f2812
affiliations: 中国航空工业集团公司西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 一种基于DSP的惯性寻北组件通讯软件可靠性设计方法
abstract: 惯性寻北组件通讯软件是寻北组件对内部设备、外部设备及上位机通讯的综合处理和控制软件，软件基于TMS320C6713型DSP实现。首先，针对外部接口众多而中断资源有限的情况，提出了一种可靠的软件复用方式，通过轮询查看的方法确保中断服务程序在有限次查询后能够退出，避免了外部接口有高频干扰产生时，中断响应函数无法退出的情况；其次，通过循环队列完成CAN数据发送的方法避免了多帧CAN数据发送时阻塞CAN总线的情况；最后，通过循环队列定时进行EEPROM参数存储的方法，避免多个参数连续写入时影响系统指令和流程处理的情况。
keywords: dsp通讯软件, eeprom读写, 中断复用, 可靠性设计
authors: 李朝阳;李旬;卫瑞;刘建;高艳

title: A voltage transformer secondary insulation monitoring system based on artificial intelligence technology
abstract: In order to find the secondary insulation fault of the voltage transformer as soon as possible; a voltage transformer secondary insulation monitoring system based on artificial intelligence technology is designed. The three-phase voltage and three-phase current values of the voltage transformer are collected; and the collected signals are converted into 0 ～ 3 V voltage signals by using the pre-processing circuit. The voltage signals completed conversion are converted into digital signals by using the AD7606-4 conversion chip of A/D conversion module; and then sent to the DSP chip TMS320F2812.The DSP chip uses LM algorithm to correct the voltage transformer steadystate error; and radio frequency communication module is used to transmit the monitoring results of the calibration to the upper computer;and the secondary insulation monitoring results of the voltage transformer are displayed in real time through the display interface of the upper computer. The test results show that the system can monitor many parameters such as the frequency and capacitance of the voltage transformer; the angle difference and the ratio difference of the monitoring results are significantly reduced; and the monitoring performance is superior.
keywords: analog-to-digital conversion, artificial intelligence technology, monitoring system, radio frequency communication module, secondary insulation, voltage transformer
affiliations: Zhejiang Zheneng Lanxi Electric Power Generation Co.,Ltd., Zhejiang Energy Research Institute Co.,Ltd.

title: Research on Design of Power Communication Operating Maintenance Architecture System and It’s Key Technology
abstract: In order to improve data efficiency and processing capabilities;this research uses CC2530chip circuit and wireless sensor network to realize data collection;applies ZigBee technology transfer network for data transmission;establishes a comprehensive evaluation index system for low-voltage DC power distribution systems. Analytic hierarchy process and entropy weight method are combined to determine the index weights. Grey correlation analysis（GCA）is applied to comprehensive evaluation of power data.The experimental results show that the of the system collection packet loss rate is 0%;and the evaluation model has good calculation performance.
keywords: cc2530 chip, comprehensive evaluation, power information management, sensor network, zigbee communication protocol
affiliations: State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Co.,Ltd.,Taizhou Power Supply Company, State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Co.,Ltd.,Linhai Power Supply Company

title: Design method of electronic tag based on radio frequency energy acquisition
abstract: According to the characteristics of energy acquisition applied to tags; a monitoring circuit was added between the energy acquisition module and the tag module; and the cooperative working strategy of energy acquisition and tags was put forward based on the setting of high and low thresholds. The low threshold selection principle is to ensure that the energy storage of the energy storage module can ensure the one-time broadcasting of the tag and prevent the tag from entering the power down state to the maximum extent. The optimal value of energy storage capacitance; minimum and optimal radio frequency（RF） input power in the environment were deduced by starting from the broadcast interval and power required in the tag design goal according to the amount of energy that can be collected in the environment and the change of energy consumption required by the tag in different states. A tag based on RF acquisition was designed by using P2110B and CC2640R2F chip for verification. Test results show that the energy acquisition tag designed by this method can realize the cooperative work of energy acquisition module and tag module. The tag can carry out continuous “sleep and broadcast” cycle when the RF input power is greater than the optimal value. It can effectively prevent the label from falling into “energy deadlock”; and can adaptively switch in different working states.
keywords: cooperative work, energy acquisition, energy deadlock, radio frequency, tag
affiliations: School of Information and Intelligent Engineering, Zhejiang Wanli University, School of Control Science and Engineering, Zhejiang University

title: Design of smart childrestraint system based on CC2541
abstract: In order to realize the monitoring functions of environment detections; intallation detections; sedentary reminder and children anti-abandonment alert; a smart child restraint system is designed. The design is equipped with CC2541 as the control core; uses SBR sensor; ISOFIX sensor; support leg sensor; ambient temperature and humidity MEMS sensor to collect real-time data. The system uses BLE4.0 to communicate with the mobile terminal; and judge child anti-abandonment via RSSI. The system uploads alarms to the cloud server and push the remote alarm to customers through the mobile terminal’s network. After debugging and testing; the smart child restraint system is realized and it can push the remote alarm to emergency contacts in the form of application; SMS and telephone. So it has a certain market promotion value and development prospect for the safety protection and healthy travel of child passengers.
keywords: anti-abandonment, cc2541, crs, rssi
affiliations: Ningbo Baby First Baby Product CO., LTD., School of Information Science and Engineering, Ningbo Tech University, Ningbo University, Business School of Ningbo University

title: Optimal Control of Operation Efficiency of Belt Conveyor in Light Load Mode
abstract: To solve the problem of inefficient operation of belt conveyor in light load mode and serious energy wastage; the optimal scheme of belt conveyor operation efficiency in light load mode based on the combination of particle swarm optimization（PSO） algorithm and back propagation（BP） neural network is designed. The working principle of the belt conveyor and the loss principle are analyzed; and the PSO-BP optimization algorithm is designed to dynamically search for the optimal flux; so that the minimum input active power of the head/tail motor of the belt conveyor is globally optimal and the copper and iron losses are the lowest. The belt conveyor vector frequency conversion speed control scheme with the TMS320LF2407A DSP chip as the core is designed to realize the PSO-BP optimization algorithm. The hardware and software design of the scheme is completed. The optimization test of belt conveyor light load operation efficiency is designed; and the change curves of motor electromagnetic torque; rotor flux; input power and speed data are analyzed when the conveyor is started; and the load changed suddenly. The test results show that the scheme can improve the belt conveyor operating efficiency when the belt conveyor is lightly loaded; and quickly find the best solution to optimize the motor efficiency and ensure the efficient and stable operation of the belt conveyor.
keywords: back propagation（bp）, belt conveyor, keil arm, light load, operating efficiency, partiole swarm optimization（pso）
affiliations: CCTEG Taiyuan Research Institute Co.,Ltd., Shanxi Tiandi Coal Mining Machinery Co.,Ltd., National Engineering Laboratory for Coal Mining Machinery

title: 基于TMS320F28377D的单相PWM整流器控制系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞相比于传统的二极管、可控硅整流器;单相脉冲宽度调制（Pulse Width Modulation;PWM）整流器具有高功率因素、低电流谐波、能量双向流动等优点;已广泛用于新能源[1-2]、不间断供电电源（Uninterrupted Power Supply;UPS）[3-4]、电力机车牵引系统[5]等工业领域。高性能单相PWM整流器控制存在采样、数据处理、电压/电流环控制、占空比更新等多重任务;采用双核DSP架构的微处理器可并行执行代码;

title: 基于物联网的甘蔗农田数据采集系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞为了实现甘蔗种植的信息化和网络化管理;设计一套物联网甘蔗农田数据采集系统。该系统由甘蔗田间节点;数据集中器、服务器和监控数据中心四大部分组成。采用TI公司的CC2530芯片与技术组建无线网络。系统采用"STC15单片机"+"CC2530单片机"双核设计结构。甘蔗采集节点把采集到的空气温度、湿度、光强强度和土壤湿度值;通过无线网络发送到数据集中器。数据集中器再通过GPRS网络把数据发送到监控数据中心。用户通过手机App界面查看数据。测试结果表明;本系统工作稳定、满足设计要求。蔗糖在人们生活中占有极其重要的地位;
affiliations: 广西民族师范学院物联网技术集成与应用重点实验室

title: ZigBee and Cloud-based Design of Rotary Kiln of Rollers Vibration Monitoring System
abstract: The ZigBee and cloud-based full-coverage rotary kiln of Rollers vibration monitoring system was designed to address the problems of cumbersome wiring;high cost and difficult maintenance and management of wired monitoring of cement rotary kilns.The system consists of several terminal nodes installed on rotary kiln of Rollers and a coordinator;both of which use a low-power;low-cost ZigBee processor CC2530.The coordinator sends the data from multiple end nodes via the serial port to the 4Gmodule;which in turn sends the data to a designated cloud server.The monitor can monitor the pallets’ vibration data in real time through the computer and mobile applications connected to the cloud server for early diagnosis of kiln operation faults.The system has the advantages of simple structure;easy deployment;no wiring;etc.It effectively solves the problem of transmission distance limitation of a single ZigBee network and achieves the expected design effect;which will have a wide engineering application prospect in rotary kiln operation status monitoring.
keywords: rotary kiln, rotary kiln of rollers vibration monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Identification of the parameters of DC bus capacitor for traction system of rail transit vehicles
abstract: 为减少城轨列车非计划故障停车，实现列车故障诊断、故障预测和健康管理，提出基于信赖域算法的直流母线电容参数辨识方法，并结合金属薄膜电容器失效机理提出了一种故障诊断方法。利用TMS320F28335控制器实现，经牵引测试平台试验验证，误差小于3%。
keywords: 参数辨识, 城轨列车, 牵引变流器, 金属薄膜电容器

title: An Improved Architecture Design and DSP Implementation of Turbo Code
abstract: Aiming at the error floor problem of traditional Turbo code in high bit rate scenarios; and the larger bit rate range requirement in data link projects of communication; the scheme of enhanced Turbo code and parallel decoding algorithm are explored. The tail-biting code structure is used to solve the decoding error floor problem. A lower bit rate code structure is designed to meet the lower bit rate range; and the BER（Bit Error Ratio） performance is improved by 0.4～0.6 dB. Finally; combined with the parallel decoding algorithm and the optimizing technology of Digital Signal Processor（TMS320C6678）; the fixed-point implementation of the decoder is optimized; so that the decoding calculation obtains a speedup of 2.6～3.7. Simulation and project verification indicate that the design has good performance and high engineering practice value.
keywords: dsp（digital signal processor）, parallel decoding, sf-max-log-map, tail-biting code, turbo code
affiliations: No.10 Institute of CETC

title: 一种磁共振成像谱仪数字化发射系统设计
abstract: Objective A digital transmit module of an MRI spectrometer is proposed in this paper.Methods The frequency and phase of the pulse signal is modulated in two steps.The NCO within the FPGA generates the slice selection offset frequency and the initial phase of the pulse signal;the NCO within DAC3484 generates the system center frequency.Results The design combines the advantages of fast phase/frequency switching within FPGA and large range adjustment within DAC;and simultaneously meets the pulse signal modulation frequency requirements that from low field 0.07T to high field 7T;also improves the phase accuracy of pulse signal.Conclusion Two-step digital modulation method is used in transmit module to improve the phase accuracy and thus improves the image quality.This method can be widely applied in MRI spectrometer design.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的提出了一种磁共振成像谱仪的数字化发射系统设计.方法该设计将发射脉冲信号载波的频率和相位分两次调制;在FPGA内的NCO产生选层偏移频率以及发射脉冲信号的初始相位;在DAC3484内的NCO产生系统中心频率.结果该设计结合了FPGA内NCO频率、相位快速切换和DAC3484内NCO频率调整范围大的优点;可以实现频率、相位的快速切换;同时满足从低场0.07T到高场7T的脉冲信号发射需求;并提高脉冲信号初始相位精度.结论磁共振成像谱仪数字化发射系统采用两次数字化调制;提高了磁共振系统的发射相位精度进而改善了成像质量;是一种可以通用于MRI谱仪的设计.
keywords: magnetic resonance, modulation, nco, pulse signal
authors: 罗王军;赵科;李加升;吴端
affiliations: 合肥菲特微电子技术有限公司
source: 现代仪器与医疗;2022年第1期56-59;共4页

title: Design of Online Testing System for Coal Power Cable State Based on AM3358
abstract: Aiming at the problems of instability of mine power cable insulation measurement signal and low accuracy of parameters; a remote measurement terminal RTU for insulation parameters based on AM3358 is designed; and also the design of the software and hardware is given. The wide-area measurement scheme is adopted to synchronize the RTU at both ends of the cable using EtherCAT; and then the voltage;current and temperature at both ends are sampled in real time. With the aid of vector calculation; the insulation resistance and the capacitance are calculated; and the online evaluation of the insulation performance of the power cable under actual conditions are of great significance for greatly improving the safety and reliability of the power supply system.
keywords: am3358, cable, ethercat, insulation, testing system
affiliations: Henan Vocational College of Industry and Information Technology

title: Design of Wireless Communication System for Coal Mine Rescue Robot Based on ZigBee
abstract: Firstly; the overall design of the coal mine rescue robot system is carried out; and the advantages and disadvantages of the current mainstream wireless communication technology are analyzed. ZigBee technology is selected to carry out the wireless communication of the rescue robot with the frequency of 900 MHz in the mine tunnel. Then; according to the characteristics of ZigBee technology; the process of wireless networking is designed to make higher bandwidth and the maintenance of wireless communication more convenient; while avoiding the problem of data transmission because of the occupation of transmission path; Finally; the hardware design of the wireless communication system of the mine rescue robot is completed based on CC2530 chip; and according to the communication protocol designed;the multi-robot cooperation to complete the rescue task is realized.
keywords: cc2530, coal mine rescue robot, wireless communication, zigbee
affiliations: Hebei Polytechnic Institute

title: Design of Real-time Control System of Die-casting Machine Based on Embedded Soft PLC
abstract: To realize the real-time control of the injection process of the die-casting machines; the embedded soft PLC control system that supports multi-task real-time scheduling management is designed with AM3358. The Linux operating kernel is transplanted to the hardware; the software PLC control program and the LCD screen interface are designed according to the control scheme od the diecasting machine. The pressure and punch speed sampling; real-time monitoring of die casting status and other hardware modules are configured. The embedded system calls real-time control functions such as pressure and speed of the die-casting machine online; monitors the injection process curve;and improves the response speed of the system; which has important application value for ensuring the quality of die-casting.
keywords: am3358, die-casting machine, embedded soft plc, injection process, linux
affiliations: Hebei University of Petroleum Technology

title: Based on the Kalman Filtering Sub-cellar Water Monitoring System
abstract: Aiming at the problems of outdated monitoring methods for pit fermentation; high labor costs; and low data accuracy; a set of wireless monitoring system for pit moisture was designed using ZigBee technology and improved Kalman filtering algorithm. The CC2530 chip conforming to the ZigBee protocol standard is used to form a wireless sensor network; combined with the improved Kalman filter algorithm to process the moisture signal; and then communicate with the host computer through the RS485 bus to achieve real-time acquisition and wireless monitoring functions. Experiments show that the system can effectively monitor the moisture changes inside the pit; and can also realize remote monitoring and storage of moisture data; with high accuracy.
keywords: cc2530 chip, improved kalman filter, pit monitoring, real-time acquisition, wireless monitoring system, zigbee technology
affiliations: School of Electronics and Information Engineering, Anhui University

title: Design of Monitoring Robot Based on ItChat and Raspberry Pi
abstract: The system takes the car as the base; the Raspberry Pi development board as the center; and is equipped with cameras; sensors and other data acquisition equipment; and the communication between nodes is realized by using CC2530 as sensor processor and ZigBee technology as wireless transmission.Based on ItChat WeChat robot framework; the system secondary develops voice technology embedded in Baidu AI open platform; Chinese environment dialogue technology and smart cloud technology of Turing robot; to achieve the use of WeChat client text or voice input control and management equipment and solve the problem of interconnection and interoperability between household appliances with another one-time or periodic timing function; which enables people to enjoy a comfortable living environment while also saving energy.
keywords: itchat, mobile robot, raspberry pi, smart cloud, wechat robot, zigbee
affiliations: School of Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, Fujian Polytechnic Normal University

title: Design of Farmland Environment Monitoring System Based on CC2530
abstract: Farmland planting is an important link in agricultural production; but farmland environment intelligent monitoring is not popularized in China. In the next few years; China should strengthen the use of high-tech technology in farmland to reduce human and material resources consumption and improve agricultural production efficiency. Therefore; a set of farmland environment monitoring system is designed to realize the real-time collection; transmission and monitoring of farmland environmental data by using ZigBee technology.
keywords: cc2530, farmland monitoring, sensors, wsn, zigbee
affiliations: Henan University Energy-saving Lighting Engineering Technology Research Center
source: Journal of Hunan Post and Telecommunication College.

title: 球磨机衬板提升条厚度测量系统设计与实现
abstract: The lifter bar of liner is a damageable part of a ball mill; and the damage of the lifter bar would cause a rise in the possibility of the liner shell being worn out and cause a potential safety hazard. Usually when the wear degree of the shell liner is tested; it is necessary to stop the ball mill. This paper designs a real-time measuring system for the thickness of the lifter bar of the ball mill’s liner. By embedding the resistancetransducer in the fixed bolt of liner to obtain the wearing data of the lifter bar; and then using radio frequency communication for data transmission; it could realize real-time monitoring of the thickness change of the lifter bar of liner without stopping the ball mill. Additionally; the ultra-low power circuit system using the CC1310 chip and the wireless communication mode of aerial awakening enables the system to work continuously for more than 6 months to meet the needs of engineering operations. The experimental result shows that the average measurement error of the system is 1.83 mm. The system could accurately and effectively measure the wear degree of the lifter bar of liner;and ensure the high-efficiency and safe operation of the ball mill.
keywords: liner lifting bar, low power consumption, real-time monitoring, thickness measurement

title: 太阳能物联网的食用菌无线监测节点设计
abstract: The wireless collection node of edible fungi is an important part of the remote monitoring system of edible fungi. Using the technology of Internet of Things; a wireless monitoring node of edible fungi based on solar Internet of Things is designed and intelligent control technology. The acquisition node is composed of solar panel module; solar charge management module; lithium battery; single-chip microcomputer controller; RS232/485 conversion circuit; CO2 sensor; light sensor; temperature sensor; humidity sensor; LCD touch display module; CC2530 communication module; relay drive module and so on. The network of each node is realized by porting the Zstack2007 protocol stack of TI company; and each acquisition node sends the collected data to the data concentrator wirelessly. The test results show that the system works stably and meets the design requirements.
keywords: edible fungi, internet of things, remote monitoring, wireless monitoring node
authors: 黄梅春;宋俊慷;韦树贡;杨秀增

title: Design and Application of Data Acquisition System Based on ZigBee Wireless Transmission Protocol
abstract: Introduces a data acquisition system based on ZigBee wireless transmission protocol. The system has flexible power supply mode; long-distance wireless communication function; good human-computer interaction design; high circuit reliability; can connect the sensor array; with pattern recognition algorithm and other efficient and flexible completion of the sensor data collection work. In addition; the chip of the system designed in this paper uses CC2530; which has strong function. The preliminary data processing work; such as filtering processing; is completed by programming. The module can select the corresponding sensor or sensor array according to different acquisition environment to complete the acquisition work. The system makes up for the shortcomings of large volume; complicated and time-consuming data transmission; and too simple and not flexible power supply of most current acquisition systems.
keywords: 2530 single chip microcomputer, data acquisition, wireless transmission, zigbee
affiliations: School of Information and Communication Engineering,North University of China

title: Design of the TMS320F28335-based Coal Mine Integrated Mining Monitoring Device
abstract: As automation technology; intelligent control technology and information technology are enriched and developed; a new coal mine safety monitoring device for coal mine safety monitoring is designed.The system adopts TMS320 F28335 digital processor for the orderly work of detection module; monitoring module; communication module and upper computer module through the command; monitoring underground environmental indicators; the Code Composer Studio platform and YKSe touch screen software are used to design system programming and upper computer interface; cylinder explosion-proof housing is adopted to detect; display and automatically alarm the underground gas concentration; dust concentration; wind speed; temperature and humidity; mine car load; and roadway condition; etc.Through the experiment; it can been seen that the system can realize the functions of information collection; information processing; data upload; upper computer display and automatic alarm of over-threshold value after powering up.The feasibility of the design has been proved by the experiment.
keywords: digital processor, explosion-proof housing, information collection, integrated coal mine monitoring
affiliations: School of New Energy and Power Engineering,Lanzhou Jiaotong University

title: Data Acquisition and Processing of Multi-source Sensor Based on Solar Smart Tree
abstract: Aiming at the real-time and stable processing requirements of heterogeneous data output from multi-source sensors by smart multi-function tree based on solar energy; an embedded data acquisition and integration processing module running on CC2530 chip supporting ZigBee is designed. The module is based on edge algorithm and combined with Internet of Things platform; which can realize the real-time processing of analog; digital; serial and other data are collected and processed. For multi serial port data acquisition; a communication process based on process identification is designed. Finally; the implementation of edge computing and strategy in embedded system is introduced.
keywords: data acquisition, edge calculation, internet of things, multi source sensor, solar smart tree
authors: LIU Tianfei;GONG Jiani;ZHOU Nanxu;LIU Liaoyuan;ZHU Yuancai;LV Yongwang
affiliations: School of Information and Electrical Engineering, Jiangsu Vocational and Technical College of Architecture

title: Design of Nursing Home Wireless Call System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: In view of the imperfection of the current call system of nursing homes; a wireless call system based on Zig Bee technology is designed; in case of emergency for the elderly; call in time to ensure that the elderly can be treated in time in case of abnormal physical condition. The wireless call system is easy to install; it will not disturb the daily life of nursing homes. Provide a safer living environment for the elderly; the advantages of low cost and high efficiency also make the system have good application prospects in nursing homes; communities and other places.
keywords: cc2530 chip, wireless call system, zigbee
affiliations: Jiangsu Normal University Jiangsu Shengli Institute of Technology-China Russia Institute

title: Drive Control System Based on AGV Parking Design
abstract: In order to seek a mechanized and intelligent automatic parking equipment to improve the efficiency of vehicle management and reduce the cost of parking. This paper proposes a single-chip microcomputer as the core control and develops a differential drive control guided trolley test system; which can complete the complete motion control of the AGV trolley by using the relevant motion safety sensors. P+ feedforward control is used as the control algorithm of the motor. Through the running test; the car has realized the functions of differential steering and path guidance; achieved good motion control effect and achieved the expected goal; and is suitable for motion control in unmanned intelligent parking lots.
keywords: agv, am3359, differential control, p+feedforward control
affiliations: Ectronic Control and Software Research Institute of WeichaiPower Co.LTD.

title: RSSI-based Weighted Centroid Localization Algorithm for Moving Targets in Mines
abstract: Based on the received signal strength（RSSI） positioning technology; the centroid positioning algorithm and weight factor are optimized to improve the positioning accuracy of moving targets in coal mines. The method performs Gaussian mixture filtering on the RSSI values; uses the maximum expectation algorithm（EM algorithm） to do cluster analysis on the data; and selects the distribution model with the smallest AIC value as the algorithm calculation model according to the Akaike Information Criterion（AIC）. Finally; the weighted centroid algorithm is introduced into the power value to obtain the positioning coordinates. The CC2530 sensor nodes; as the communication nodes; are used in the experimental verification; which shows that the optimized weighted centroid algorithm has less positioning error.
keywords: moving target localization in mines, positioning accuracy, rssi ranging, weight correction, weighted centroid algorithm
affiliations: College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Shanxi Datong University, College of Coal Engineering,Shanxi Datong University

title: Design of Bracket Pressure Sensor Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: In order to simplify the wiring of hydraulic support information transmission system and improve its reliability; a pressure sensor based on wireless network sensing technology is designed. The pressure information of the hydraulic support is collected through the pressure sensor; converted into voltage signal through the differential full bridge circuit; processed by the signal conditioning circuit; sent to the 8051 single chip microcomputer integrated on CC2530 chip; and sent through the RF module; so as to complete the collection; processing and transmission of pressure information.
keywords: pressure sensor, support, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Supply Department, Ximing Coal Mine, Shanxi Xishan Coal Electricity Group Co., Ltd.

title: DSP-FPGA based ADCP system for high sediment concentration flow measurement
abstract: An acoustic Doppler current profiler（ADCP） system based on TMS320C6748 and Spartan-6 is designed for accurate flow measurement under the condition of high sediment concentration. DSP is used to communicate with upper computer; control system; interact with FPGA; receive peripheral data and process signal data. FPGA is used to modulate the measured signal and receive acquired signal. In order to verify the feasibility and accuracy of ADCP system in the high sediment concentration environment; a flow measurement test is carried out in the Yellow River; where the survey vessel is used to install ADCP; which accesses GPS data and Echo sounder data by DSP. Test results show that; in the hydrological environment with sediment concentration of 15.5 kg·m-3; the ADCP system could measure the flow normally and stably; the relative error of flow measurement result is only 1.01%; which meets the requirements of high precision flow measurement system.
keywords: acoustic doppler current profiler（adcp）, dsp-fpga, flow measurement, high sediment content
affiliations: Jiangsu Hi-Target Marine Information Technology Co., Ltd

title: Design and Implementation of High-performance Control Platform for Vehicle Asynchronous Motor Electric Drive System
abstract: In order to study the high-performance control strategy of induction motor for pure electric vehicles; based on the analysis of the mathematical model of induction motor; the vector control principle and space vector pulse width modulation（SVPWM） are studied;and the vector control system model of induction motor is built by using MATLAB/Simulink. In the environment of MATLAB/Simulink and CCS6.2; the code generation software of asynchronous motor vector control system based on TMS320F28335 control is written; the hardware experiment platform driven by intelligent power module（IPM） FSBB30CH060 is built; and the upper computer monitoring interface convenient for data acquisition and monitoring is established by using LabVIEW. Taking the 60 W asynchronous motor as the controlled object; the performance of the asynchronous motor vector control system platform is studied. The experimental results show that the platform; combined with computer simulation and embedded real-time control technology; can realize the development of highperformance control strategy for vehicle asynchronous motor; and has important application value in the research of high-performance control strategy for vehicle asynchronous motor.
keywords: asynchronous motor, code generation, platform design, space vector pulse width modulation, vector control
affiliations: Shaoyang Zishui Technology Co., Ltd., Hunan Key Laboratory of Operation and Control of Multi-power Regional Power Grid

title: 基于ZigBee网络与嵌入式3S技术的农田信息监测系统设计
abstract: 基于土壤结构、气候参数等信息的农田信息采集实现现代数字农业的技术基础。利用双向无线通信技术ZigBee和嵌入式3S技术，设计出了一种农田信息监测系统，能够自动进行农田环境、地理位置等信息实时发送，较为便捷地实现农田信息监测和管理。

title: Soil parameter measurement system based on WSN
abstract: The equipment of soil parameter measurement is less at present; too few detection parameters and unable to query remotely data in real time; a soil parameter measurement system is proposed based on WSN. The system taked CC2530 F256 as the main control chip of wireless sensor network; multi-sensors were used to measure soil parameters; connecting STM32 intelligent gateway; Migrated MQTT protocol and finally send the data to OneNET cloud platform through NB-IoT or WIFI. Users can remotely view historical data and soil real-time parameters through web page or mobile APP. The test results show that the system has the advantages of long communication distance; flexible networking; convenient operation; stable working for a long time and having a wide applications.
keywords: onenet, soil, stm32, wsn, zigbee
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information, Huaibei Normal University

title: 基于ZigBee技术的避雷器放电次数监测装置的设计
abstract: 以牵引变电所内用氧化锌避雷器计数器为应用场景;基于ZigBee技术设计了一款氧化锌避雷器放电次数智能监测装置;完成硬件电路设计和试验;实现了监测终端智能组网、放电次数监测与显示、超次数报警等功能。监测数据能够实时传输至后台服务器;能够融入泛在电力物联网中;实现电力保护设备运行状态的智能监测。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 光电隔离, 避雷器
affiliations: 柳州铁道职业技术学院

title: A highly reliable loading method and implementation of spaceborne multi-core DSP
abstract: In order to respond to the complex intelligent processing application requirements of remote sensing satellites. Single-core DSP can no longer meet real-time requirements. TMS320C6678 is a high-performance multi-core floating-point DSP based on the KeyStone structure; with a main frequency of 1.25 GHz; which meets the needs of satellite application. Regarding the satellite use environment; whether it is FPGA or DSP; configuration loading is very important; and it is about success or failure. This article introduces the loading mode and process of TMS320C6678 in detail; and proposes a high-reliability heterogeneous loading method of Nor Flash based on EMIF16; and a program Bootloader. The test verifies that the TMS320C6678 can operate stably and reliably under the design method of this article.
keywords: 6678, bootloader, emif16, multi-core dsp
affiliations: China Academy of Space Technology(Xi’an)

title: Research on Rotor Angle Detection of Permanent Magnet Motor Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: The rotor angle of permanent magnet motor has an important influence on the control of the motor. At present; the resolver is widely used in the permanent magnet traction motor to detect the rotor angle and speed information. Based on the TMS320 F28377 D dual-core CPU combined with AD2 S1210 decoding chip; a rotor position detection system is formed. Angle segment compensation is used for error correction. Thus; the accurate rotor angle information is provided for the permanent magnet motor control algorithm. The rotor angle information output by the decoding chip under different rotor frequencies is verified by the hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform. The detection method has the characteristics of high precision and strong anti-interference ability. It can meet the requirements of high reliability and stability of the traction system. The results of the simulation and experiments show the feasibility and effectiveness of the angle detection method proposed.
keywords: ad2s1210, permanent magnet motor, resolver, tms320f28377d
affiliations: CRRC Dalian R＆D Co., Ltd.

title: 一种数字控制图腾柱无桥PFC的AC/DC电源
abstract: This paper introduces a critical current mode totem pole bridgeless PFC circuit. Digital control based on DSP TMS320 F28035 replaces traditional analog control and simplifies peripheral circuits. A digital ZCD scheme is proposed; which realizes zero voltage and valley turn-on under different input voltages; and meets the requirements of high efficiency and high power density. Taking the communication power supply as an example; a prototype with 176～265 V ac input and 600 W/28 V DC output was developed. The peak efficiency of the front-end PFC is 98.8%; the peak efficiency of the whole machine is 94.6%; and the power density of the whole machine is 110 W/in~3. The experimental results verify the feasibility and advancement of the design scheme.

keywords: digital control, power supply, resonant converter, totem-pole

title: TMS320C6678的超长点FFT并行计算方法
abstract: Aiming at the problems of ultra-long points FFT implementation and computational efficiency encountered during the migration of DSP platform algorithms; this article combines TI’s TMS320 C6678 DSP;we use the FFT decomposition algorithm and the efficient memory access efficiency of the L2 memory segment to design a parallel processing method for ultra-long points FFT calculation by paralleling the EDMA movement of the DSP memory data and the FFT decomposition calculation.The specific implementation process of the method is described by 262144-points FFT calculation; and the calculation result of DSP is compared with the result of MATLAB;and the calculation error of the method is 10-4.Finally; on the DSP platform; when the number of FFT points is the same; the calculation time of directly calling the FFT library function is compared with the calculation time using this method; which shows that it has better calculation performance in the ultra-long points FFT calculation.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对DSP平台算法移植时遇到的超长点FFT实现和运算效率问题;本文结合TI公司的TMS320C6678的DSP;利用FFT的分解算法和L2内存段高效的访存效率;将DSP内存数据EDMA搬移与FFT分解计算相并行;设计出一种超长点FFT计算并行处理方法;通过262 144点FFT计算描述了该方法的具体实现过程;将DSP计算结果与MATLAB结果比对;统计了该方法的计算误差为10-4。最后;在DSP平台上;在相同FFT点数时将直接调用FFT库函数计算;与使用该方法的计算时间进行比较;说明了其在超长点FFT计算具有更好的运算性能。
keywords: dsp, edma, parallel computing, real-time signal processing, tms320c6678, ultra-long points fft calculation
authors: Zhang Jiong;Cheng Hu;Zhu Hongtai;Wang Chunhui;Li Min

title: 基于物联网的甘蔗农田数据采集系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现甘蔗种植的信息化和网络化管理;设计一套物联网甘蔗农田数据采集系统。该系统由甘蔗田间节点;数据集中器、服务器和监控数据中心四大部分组成。采用TI公司的CC2530芯片与技术组建无线网络。系统采用"STC15单片机"+"CC2530单片机"双核设计结构。甘蔗采集节点把采集到的空气温度、湿度、光强强度和土壤湿度值;通过无线网络发送到数据集中器。数据集中器再通过GPRS网络把数据发送到监控数据中心。用户通过手机App界面查看数据。测试结果表明;本系统工作稳定、满足设计要求。蔗糖在人们生活中占有极其重要的地位;

title: Research on application of TMS320F2812 in main engine speed control system
abstract: The speed control of ship three-phase asynchronous motor determines the output power of the motor. The higher the accuracy of the speed control of the main engine; the more flexible and accurate the output power of the ship power system. In this paper; the mathematical model of three-phase asynchronous motor and SVPWM vector controller of motor are established firstly. Based on this; a speed control system of marine main engine is designed with TMS320 F2812 as the control core; and the speed control process of main engine is simulated with Matlab/Simulink platform.
keywords: main engine speed control system, matlab/simulink platform, svpwm, tms320f2812

title: 带DMM和蓝牙功能手机充电器的研发
abstract: 本文对带DMM和蓝牙功能的手机充电器进行了研究。在手机广泛普及的今天;人们随身携带着手机;充电器是必备配件;同时对于电子行业相关从业人员来说;数字万用表（DMM）是日常必备工具。本文通过大量的实测分析;在手机充电器中加入DMM芯片和符合BLE4.0通讯协议的蓝牙芯片这一种创新组合;除了可以对手机充电外;还兼有万用表的参数测量功能;并能将测量结果通过蓝牙发送到手机上显示和保存起来;必将极大地方便广大的手机用户;在提升电子设备的便利性、实用性等方面;具有广泛的研究价值。
keywords: cc2541, dmm, fs9721, 手机充电器, 蓝牙
