title: 基于CC2530的无线门锁系统设计
abstract: 随着5G、AI、云计算等新一代信息技术的不断发展，万物互联的IoT带来更高效更快捷的信息传输通道，物联网能够支持多个智能家居终端，其功能多样性、性能、安全性都有了较大的提高。然而当前我国市场上的智能家居系统还有种种缺点，如智能化解决方案兼容性差，个性化不足等，所以开发一套扩展性强、具有语音交互、视觉识别等人工智能技术的智能家居系统是很有必要的。本智能家居系统可以实现智能家居终端和移动客户端的双向有效通信：家居设备的状态可以在客户端实时显示，设备也可以执行客户端发送的指令。同时在移动客户端中加入语音交互技术。这套系统有兼容性高、交互方式多样等优点，有着广阔的应用前景。
keywords: android, cc2530, zigbee, 智能家居, 物联网
affiliations: 长春汽车工业高等专科学校电气工程学院

title: Method of CAN Bootloader Program Update Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: A method of TMS320F28335 program update by CAN bootloader is proposed. To realize the method of program update; the TMS320F28335 boot mode is configured as "jump to flash"; the binary update file transmitted by CAN bus from PC through the pre-burned bootloader program is downloaded; and the program to start is guided. The realization principle and the development process of this method are introduced.The experimental result indicates that this method is stable; reliable and practical.
keywords: bin file, bootloader, can bus, dsp, tms320f28335
affiliations: China Key System ＆ Integrated Circuit Co., Ltd.

title: Application of Automatic Code Generation in Train Air-conditioning Power Supply Software
abstract: Automatic code generation is a graphical software writing method. Because of its advantages such as easy to write and easy to verify;it is widely used in electrical control systems in the automotive;rail transit;and power industries. The principle and work flow of Matlab Embedded Coder automatic code generation were introduced firstly. The Simulink model of 160 km/h standard EMU air conditioning inverter control software was then built by using Simulink and Stateflow toolbox;including the realization of start stop sequence;modulation and redundancy logic. After simulation;code was generated automatically from the Simulink model;which was then deployed into the TMS320F28335 controller. The effectiveness of the automatic code generation technology in the product was verified by on-board test. At present;the software has been successfully installed in vehicles.
keywords: automatic code generation, embedded coder toolbox, inverter, rail transit power
authors: SHEN Zhuangzhuang;SHEN Lei;ZHEN Yuanwei;YANG Dongjun;ZHAO Xuqiang;HOU Yunchang
affiliations: CRRC Qingdao Sifang Rolling Stock Research Institute Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of Monitoring System for Landslide Disasters of Slope Along Railway
abstract: In the paper; a monitoring system for slope landslide hazards along railway lines based on ZigBee technology is designed.The system uses a phase laser ranging sensor to collect the surface displacement of the slope landslide body; and sends the collected information to the coordinator through the ZigBee network.The coordinator is connected to the 4 G communication module through the serial port; and the information is remotely transmitted to the ground monitoring center through the 4 G network.It is proved by laboratory test that the system has high measurement precision; stable operation and high application value.
keywords: cc2530, landslide disaster monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: School of Electrical Information Engineering, Dalian Jiaotong University

title: Hardware design and testing for the performance evaluation of transmission link in short-distance wireless sensor networks
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness of transmission performance evaluation of the urban arterial road wireless monitoring system; a node hardware circuit was designed aiming to communication quality evaluation for Wireless Sensor Networks. From the different evaluation perspective of the impact of factors; the propagation characteristics of wireless sensor nodes simulation at 433 MHz frequency on tree-lined trails was explored; and the relationships between signal reception strength value RSSI; link quality indication value LQI and packet reception rate PRR and distance are obtained respectively. The results show that the fitted RSSI value presents the characteristics of logarithmic distance loss model; the value of η is between 2.354 and 2.745; and the LQI value increases with exponential curve; and the PRR keeps decreasing with distance from near to far. It can be known through the analysis of transmission attenuation characteristics; the stability at 60 meters is better; and the nodes can be deployed here to establish a sensor network. Research on performance evaluation of transmission link provides an important foundation for realizing wireless sensor networks to find the optimal ideal communication path and placement point.
keywords: cc1101, propagation performance, short-distance communication, wireless sensor node

title: Control Algorithm Research of EGR Valve on Explosion-Proof Diesel Engine Under Transient Operation
abstract: In order to meet the fourth stage emission standard for explosion-proof diesel engine; the up grade of EGR system is needed. The transient operating condition control algorithm of EGR valve based on TMS320F28335 is designed. The target opening of EGR valve is determined by base MAP and transient air flow; the adaptive extended Kalman filtering algorithm is used in data processing of the transient air flow. The incremental PID which can realize closed-loop control was used to reduce the deviation between target opening and actual opening; and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through experiments.
keywords: control algorithm, egr valve, explosion-proof diesel engine, transient operating condition

title: 基于窗磁传感的中央空调调节系统
abstract: 商用中央空调一般通过定时开关或者人工手动开关来进行有规律的运作;并不会智能地做出回应;造成了不必要的电力资源浪费;同时内置的温湿度传感器高度过高;温度调节不尽如人意。为减少电力资源的浪费;提高中央空调的运作效率;更好地满足人们对适宜温湿度的需求;研发了一种基于窗磁传感的中央空调节能系统。系统可根据窗户的开闭;通过无线通信、窗磁、温湿度传感器等智能控制、调节中央空调;不仅节省了电力资源;更提高了环境舒适度。

title: 无线传感器网络室内空气质量检测系统
abstract: In response to the problems in traditional air quality detection system; based on wireless sensor network; the design scheme of indoor air quality detection system is proposed. The design idea; hardware structure and software design method of indoor air quality detection system are given in details. At the perception level; the CC2530 is used to form a wireless sensor network.Multiple sensor nodes are used to detect indoor carbon monoxide; carbon dioxide; oxygen; formaldehyde; PM2.5 and temperature and humidity. The real-time detection results are displayed and overrun alarm is given.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统空气质量检测系统存在的问题;提出了一种基于无线传感器网络的室内空气质量检测系统。详细阐述了无线传感器网络室内空气质量检测系统的设计思想、硬件结构和软件的设计方法。使用CC2530组成无线传感器网络;采用多个传感器节点对室内一氧化碳、二氧化碳、氧气、甲醛、PM2.5以及温湿度进行检测;实时显示检测结果并进行超限报警。
keywords: air quality, detect, wireless sensor network

title: 基于改进型环路滤波器的单相锁相环
abstract: The filtering performance of a Phase-Lock Loop(PLL) is insufficient because of the saturation suppression of PI controller. Thus a single-phase PLL based on an improved loop filter is proposed. The PLL improves the loop filter and the filter performance by adding an anti-saturation PI controller. Where the input contains both DC and harmonic interference; the phase-locking precision can be clearly improved by tracking the real-time phase of the power grid. Matlab/Simulink platform is used to simulate and analyze the adaptability and anti-interference of the improved single-phase PLL when the power grid is distorted. Experimental verification is conducted based on the experimental platform with the TMS320 F28335 DSP development board as the core. The results show that this method can quickly and accurately track the frequency change of the system and achieve the phase-locking effect.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对单相锁相环(Phase-lock Loop; PLL)受PI控制器饱和抑制造成滤波性能不足这一问题;提出了一种基于改进型环路滤波器的单相锁相环。该锁相环通过增加抗饱和PI控制器;改进环路滤波器;提高滤波性能。在输入同时含有直流和谐波干扰情况下;对电网实时相位进行锁相跟踪;可以明显提高锁相精度。利用Matlab/Simulink平台对改进型单相锁相环在电网畸变时的适应性、抗干扰性进行仿真分析。并基于TMS320F28335 DSP芯片为核心的实验平台进行实验验证;结果表明;该方法能快速准确地跟踪系统频率变化;达到锁相效果。
keywords: anti-saturation controller, dsp, loop filter, single-phase pll

title: TMS320F2812在船舶主机调速系统中的应用
abstract: The speed control of ship three-phase asynchronous motor determines the output power of the motor. The higher the accuracy of the speed control of the main engine; the more flexible and accurate the output power of the ship power system. In this paper; the mathematical model of three-phase asynchronous motor and SVPWM vector controller of motor are established firstly. Based on this; a speed control system of marine main engine is designed with TMS320 F2812 as the control core; and the speed control process of main engine is simulated with Matlab/Simulink platform.
abstract_in_chinese: 舰船三相异步电动机的调速控制决定了电机的输出功率;主机调速控制的精度越高;舰船动力系统输出的动力越灵活和准确。本文首先建立了舰船三相异步电动机的数学模型和电机SVPWM矢量控制器;在此基础上设计了一种TMS320F2812为控制核心的舰船主机调速控制系统;并利用Matlab/simulink平台对主机调速过程进行了仿真试验。
keywords: main engine speed control system, matlab/simulink platform, svpwm, tms320f2812

title: 基于ZigBee与ARM嵌入式系统的档案库房环境监控设计研究
abstract: In order to be able to remotely monitor the specific conditions of the internal operation environment of the archives warehouse in real time;so as to reduce unnecessary manpower;material resources and time investment; this paper puts forward the design idea of archives warehouse environment monitoring based on ZigBee technology and ARM embedded; based on wireless communication;computer control and Internet of Things technology. This paper explains the hierarchical function and frame structure of ZigBee and ARM technologies for each communication protocol.Combined with the functional requirements of system design;this paper designs the internal network wireless sensing technology of ZigBee archives and the overall system architecture. The global architecture of the system is analyzed;and the core system chip CC2530 is introduced into the B/S architecture;which is paired with the Z-Stack protocol to complete the hardware and software design of the system. The hardware platform is based on Mini2400;and the embedded ARM system is successfully transplanted to the Linux operating system. The ARM embedded intelligent communication gateway is designed. The designed system is verified by the system application test. Capable of remote and automated monitoring of the archive environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了能够远程实时监控档案库房的内部运行环境具体情况;从而减少不必要的人力、物力、时间投入;提出基于ZigBee技术、ARM嵌入式的档案库房环境监控设计思路。基于无线通信、计算机控制及物联网技术;说明了ZigBee、ARM技术对各通信协议的层级功能、帧架构;结合系统设计功能需求;设计了ZigBee技术的档案库房内部网络无线传感技术;以及整体系统架构。对系统全局架构组成进行分析;在B/S架构上引入CC2530核心系统芯片;与Z-Stack协议相搭配;完成了系统软硬件设计。并与该系统的实际档案库房环境监控工作运行情况相结合;其中硬件平台基于Mini2400基础实现;并成功移植嵌入式ARM系统和Linux操作系统;设计了ARM嵌入式智能通信网关;经系统运用测试证实;设计的该系统能够远程且自动化监控档案库房环境。
keywords: arm, embedded system, environmental monitoring, zigbee
affiliations: Xi’an Medical University, 西安医学院

title: 电梯门间隙检测装置的研究与设计
abstract_in_chinese: 本文阐述了一种电梯门间隙检测装置的结构、硬件与软件设计。该装置采用激光位移传感器对电梯门门扇与门套之间的间隙进行检测;传感器信号经CC2530处理后无线传输至现场控制平板电脑(PAD)进行处理。与传统的人工检测方式相比;采用该装置进行检测可提高工作效率;减少误差。经实际应用证明;该装置具有一定的实际应用价值。
affiliations: 六盘水师范学院

title: 基于CC1101模块的无线温湿度监测终端设计
abstract_in_chinese: 本文基于CC1101模块设计了一种无线温湿度测量终端应用于仓库内部环境温湿度监测系统。介绍了测量终端的系统组成;设计了基于STC15W4K56S4的单片机最小系统、SHT10传感器接口电路、电源电路。并设计了数据采集与发送程序;实现了终端与无线网关之间的通信。本终端布放方便;可根据需要灵活的增删节点以适配温湿度监测系统的需求。
affiliations: 湖北交通职业技术学院交通信息学院

title: A method of software deployment of TMS320C6678 multicore processor
abstract: Software deployment for the multi-core digital signal processor TMS320C6678 is essential during the software development debugging and engineering deployment;and rapid software deployment is critical to improving system development. Aiming at improving the efficiency of the multicore processor software deployment;the characteristics of TMS320C6678 multicore processor software deployment and software bootloader mode and principle are analyzed;the implementation of the multicore Application software Deployment（MAD） utilities is studied;the production process of multicore application software image files is simplified;and the graphical conversion tools are created using Python language. With extensive engineering validation;the software deployment method and tools meet the usage requirements and significantly improve software deployment efficiency.
keywords: boot mode, multicore application software deployment, tms320c6678, two stage boot
affiliations: Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology

title: 基于DSP28335的永磁同步电机PI矢量控制系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞基于DSP芯片TMS320F28335设计了永磁同步电机的矢量控制系统并采用PI（比例-积分）控制器实现闭环控制;介绍了控制算法的软件实现流程和硬件电路设计。硬件电路包括角度检测反馈电路、电流检测反馈电路和驱动电路。通过电流环和速度环的阶跃响应实验;验证了该控制系统的有效性。该PI矢量控制系统简单有效、易于实现;有效的拓展了永磁同步电机在工程实践中的应用。
affiliations: 中科芯集成电路有限公司

title: 基于TMS320C6678 DSP的雷达数字信号处理软件设计
abstract: 现代雷达处理的信号带宽越来越大;处理算法越来越复杂;为了满足雷达的实时性处理要求;对硬件平台的要求也越来越高;本文介绍了在新型的TMS320C6678 DSP上实现雷达数字信号处理软件的过程及方法。结果表明;该软件实现方法能够满足功能及实时性要求。
keywords: 信号带宽, 实时性, 过程及方法
affiliations: 四川九洲防控科技有限责任公司

title: Design of TMS320F28335 Remote Online Upgrade Method Based on CAN Bus
abstract: Aiming at the problem that TMS320F28335 is difficult to be upgraded by emulator in the field; a remote online upgrade method based on controller area network（CAN） bus is proposed; and the basic principle of the method is introduced in detail. On the basis of not destroying the communication between nodes; this method realizes the function of online upgrade to any node in the CAN network. A large number of experiments are carried out by separately controlling the number of nodes in the network; the length of the CAN bus; the priority of the target node and the network load rate. The experimental results verify the reliability and stability of the method.
keywords: any node, can bus, remote online upgrade, tms320f28335
affiliations: China Key System ＆ Integrated Circuit Co., Ltd.

title: Research on Reliable Two-level Boot Method for Multicore DSP
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of multi-core processor Boot technology; such as difficulty; complex process and high reliability requirements; a reliable two-level Boot method for multi-core DSP is proposed.According to the emif16 Boot mode of TMS320 C6678 multi-core DSP;a two-level Boot scheme is used to Boot the multi-core DSP program; and a detailed engineering solution is given for the generation; burning and loading of the executable program.This method realizes the convenient generation; fast burning and reliable loading of multi-core DSP executable program.Compared with the traditional Boot scheme; the reliability of this method is significantly improved; which has a certain engineering application value.
keywords: multicore dsp, tms320c6678, two-level boot
affiliations: China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology, Beijing MXTronics Corporation

title: Research on Fire Alarm and Escape System Based on CC2530
abstract: The research of fire alarm and escape system in our country started late.With the country’s continuous attention to fire safety;the technology of fire alarm and escape system is now becoming more mature.The key fire safety units identified by the fire department have all put into use various emergency management systems such as automatic fire alarm systems.This paper studies the use of advanced wireless sensors and the IoT cloud platform technology based on the CC2530 chip to form a complete wireless monitoring network.The automatic escape system;which is not in the traditional fire protection system;guarantees the safety of the escaped personnel in the first place.
keywords: cc2530, fire alarm and escape system research, iot cloud platform, wireless sensor
affiliations: Anhui National Defense Science and Technology Vocational College

title: Development of a Narrow Gap Welding Experiment System for Oscillating Arc Sensing
abstract: In order to improve the precision and reliability of oscillating arc sensor in narrow gap welding; as well as to research the influence law of distance between arc and the narrow gap groove side wall on arc sensor characteristic parameters; an arc sensor experiment system which could simultaneously acquire arc image; welding voltage; welding current and welding torch swing position four signals was developed based on TMS320 F2812 and Labview. The main structure design and synchronous acquisition system design of the experimental system were introduced. The developed experiment system was tested by the welding method of P-GMAW. It is proved that the system is reliable and effective. This system has laid the necessary foundation for the further study of the arc sensing characteristics of the narrow gap oscillating arc.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了提高窄间隙焊接摆动电弧传感的精度和可靠性，研究电弧到窄间隙坡口侧壁的距离对电弧传感特征参数的影响规律，基于TMS320F2812和Labview软件，开发了一种能同步采集电弧图像、焊接电压、焊接电流和焊枪摆动位置四路信号的电弧传感试验系统。介绍了试验系统的主体结构设计和同步采集系统设计。采用P-GMAW的焊接方式对开发的试验系统进行测试。结果表明，该系统可靠有效，为深入研究窄间隙摆动电弧传感特征奠定了必要的基础。
keywords: arc sensing, narrow gap, synchronous acquisition

title: Analysis and Research of TMS320F28335 External Interrupt
abstract: With the development and change of information technology; DSP technology has become the frontier technology widely concerned and applied. DSP not only has high reliability; but also has good stability and low power consumption; which can realize large-scale integration. In addition; it greatly improves the signal processing ability and can meet higher real-time requirements. Interrupt processing is a very important link in DSP application system. TMS320 F28335 provides timer and interrupter functions; so it has a wide range of applications in data acquisition; industrial control; intelligent measurement and so on. This paper mainly describes the knowledge and mechanism of external interrupt of DSP chip TMS320 F28335; and describes the process of interrupt processing and example analysis in details.
keywords: external interrupt, interrupt system, tms320f28335
affiliations: College of Eurasian International Studies, Henan University

title: Design of ZigBee experimental system for protocol stack
abstract: Networking exercise is the key content of the ZigBee experiment.And the protocol stack plays an important role in the networking experiment.Combining the characteristics of ZigBee technology and taking environmental monitoring as the application background;a ZigBee experimental system is designed.The experimental system takes CC2530 and digital temperature and humidity sensor as the core to realize data collection and transmission between master and slave nodes;as well as point-to-multipoint and two-point communication.The host computer is designed with LabVIEW;and the mobile client is developed with the aid of the Eclipse4.1 platform;which can communicate with the server through the mobile client.Using this experimental system;can complete networking experiments such as serial ports;buttons;wireless data transmission;wireless lighting etc;as well as mobile client program development and LabVIEW system simulation.It has strong openness and secondary development capabilities;which is beneficial to improve students′ practice innovation ability and ZigBee system development ability.
keywords: environmental monitoring, labview, networking exercise, zigbee
affiliations: School of Communication and Electronic Engineering,Qiqihar University
source: Journal of Science of Teachers’ College and University.

title: 华北油田信息化智能监测技术研究与应用
abstract: ＜正＞随着油田自动化、数字化的快速发展;对于油田建设相配套的网络和通信技术要求越来越高;特别是山间、野外现场集中的油水井数据采集;存在着通讯信号不稳定等问题;对此;不仅要考虑传输速率;还要考虑到稳定性、成本和时延等问题。Zig Bee技术是一种新的无线通信技术;使用CSMA-CA技术解决数据冲突问题;使用16-bit CRC来确保数据的正确性从而达到高效可靠;其中Zig Bee2007协议的SoC芯片CC2530每片价格不到20元;采用1节5号电池可以持续供电三个月时间;低成本、低功耗;
authors: 李新峰;许冬;王磊;史志鹏
affiliations: 华北石油通信有限公司

title: 基于自供电无线传感网的环境监测设计与实现
abstract: 采用ZigBee无线传感网技术设计了一种自供电低功耗无线传感网的环境监测系统。使用太阳能光伏电池板采集环境能量实现自供电功能;超低功耗处理器模块CC2530作为主控芯片降低节点能耗;Mos管及其驱动模块调节占空比以提高太阳能的采集效率。通过对系统数据分析比较;结果表明自供电系统能有效利用太阳能的特性进行充电;实现等效阻抗;系统稳定性可达到95%以上;实现了自供电系统的最优功能。

title: Design of Intelligent Chicken Farm Control System Based on Single-Chip Microcomputer
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in chicken industry at present，an intelligent chicken farm control system based on single-chip microcomputer is designed by using the related technologies of internet of things.Compared with the traditional chicken breeding monitoring systems，the intelligent chicken farm control system based on single-chip microcomputer has better anti-interference ability and can collect a variety of parameters.Combined with the monitoring and alarm system，it can timely judge whether there are problems in the chicken house environment and deal with them accordingly.At the same time，a relatively perfect management system is built to provide interface for future technical expansion.
keywords: cc2530 single-chip microcomputer, chicken house, internet of things
authors: YUAN Dingxin;LUO Hongwei;YANG Xinru;MAO Jingfeng;TIAN Feng
affiliations: Guizhou University of Commerce

title: Hardware Design of Optical Signal Acquisition System Based on CC2530
abstract: In this system; CC2530 processor is used as the core; and a hardware circuit design of optical signal acquisition system based on CC2530 is introduced; The optical intensity signal is transmitted to the terminal node through ZigBee wireless network; and the received data is sent to the PC through the serial port; which is displayed in real time through the serial port assistant. This paper expounds the working principle of the hardware system; the circuit connection mode of each module and the circuit characteristics of each module from the overall structure.Finally; the work content and goal of the next step of system development are introduced.
keywords: cc2530, photosensitive sensor, zigbee hardware design
affiliations: Yangzhou Polytechnic Institute

title: Design Method of Real-Time Temperature and Humidity Monitoring System in Greenhouse
abstract: This design uses ZigBee network transmission technology; and CC3200 single chip microcomputer as microcontroller; as well as temperature and humidity sensor DHT11 and temperature sensor DS18 B20 to monitor and compare temperature and humidity data. The principle is that the microcontroller controls the corresponding sensor to monitor the data for a certain period of time; and the obtained data is transmitted to the terminal through wireless network for easy processing; and the addition of voice module is considered to alert the staff to operate accordingly. This way for professional greenhouse monitoring data accuracy requirements can basically meet the corresponding accuracy; but also simplify the operation of managers. It is proved that this method reduces the cost compared with the professional greenhouse treatment; and increases the automatic monitoring of temperature and humidity; improves the efficiency of greenhouse management and reduces the labor cost; which is of practical significance for increasing the yield of fruits and vegetables compared with the general rural humble greenhouse.
keywords: intelligent greenhouse, mcu, microcontroller, voice, wireless
affiliations: Information Management Center, Nanyang Normal University, School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Nanyang Normal University
source: Journal of Green Science and Technology.

title: TMS320F28335外部中断分析与研究
abstract: With the development and change of information technology; DSP technology has become the frontier technology widely concerned and applied. DSP not only has high reliability; but also has good stability and low power consumption; which can realize large-scale integration. In addition; it greatly improves the signal processing ability and can meet higher real-time requirements. Interrupt processing is a very important link in DSP application system. TMS320 F28335 provides timer and interrupter functions; so it has a wide range of applications in data acquisition; industrial control; intelligent measurement and so on. This paper mainly describes the knowledge and mechanism of external interrupt of DSP chip TMS320 F28335; and describes the process of interrupt processing and example analysis in details.

keywords: external interrupt, interrupt system, tms320f28335

keywords: environmental monitoring, labview, networking exercise, zigbee

title: Research on indoor harmful gas detection device based on STM32

title: Design and Research of Plantar Pressure Sensing System for Lower Limb Exoskeleton Robot
abstract: In response to the demand for real-time acquisition and monitoring of plantar pressure signals required for the control of the lower limb exoskeleton robot; a plantar pressure sensing system for lower limb exoskeleton robot is developed. TMS320 F2812 is used as central control chip in the system. An A/D sampling peripheral circuit is constructed to realize the conversion of analog pressure signals to digital signals. Based on the MAX3232 chip; the RS-232 communication interface circuit is designed. And real-time monitoring interface of the plantar pressure information is developed and compiled based on LabVIEW 14.0. The obtained pressure digital information is transmitted to the upper computer software monitoring interface through the RS-232 serial interface circuit to realize the real-time monitoring of the plantar pressure information. After the hardware circuit connection completed; the baudrate; data format; stop bit; parity bit and other information of the serial port communication in real-time monitoring interface of the plantar pressure information are configured. When the configuration is completed; run the program and apply force on the stress area of the plantar pressure sensor; and observe the monitoring interface in the host computer. It is shown in experiments that in the control of the lower limb exoskeleton robot; the system can accurately collect plantar pressure information and monitor the dynamic response of plantar pressure information in real time.
keywords: labview, lower limb exoskeleton robot, membrane pressure sensor, serial communication, tms320f2812

title: Design of a Servo Control System of Side Lamp FOD Detection Equipment

title: Farmland Soil Moisture Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: The farmland soil moisture monitoring system based on ZigBee is designed in this paper.CC2530 chip is selected as the main control module of the sensor node in the system.The soil moisture sensor is used to collect the moisture data in real time;and the data transmission between the node and the server is realized through the serial port module of the coordinator.The communication between the server and the web browser is realized by combining the Internet;so that the latter can display the visualized farmland soil moisture information in real time.Through the test; the distance between nodes can maintain stable communication within 50 m;which can meet the system’s efficient and accurate detection of farmland soil moisture information.

title: Research on Zigbee Wireless Ad Hoc Network for Goaf Temperature Monitoring
abstract: For the underground mined-out area is complex;easy to produce floating coal;coal;underground pressure will produce a larger self-heating phenomenon;so the temperature monitoring of goaf is particularly important. This paper presents a Zigbee wireless ad hoc method for real-time monitoring of underground goaf temperature;the use of CC2530 integrated module as a communication module;coupled with mature low price of the temperature sensor can be composed of powerful;low power and stable and reliable Hardware platform;through the routing algorithm automatically assigns the address;you can increase the redundancy of the system;the higher the system redundancy;the better the stability of communication. Experiments show that both the transmission distance and the penetrating ability all meet the application environment of the underground mined-out area;and can realize the rapid networking and realize the reliable monitoring of the underground temperature.
keywords: cc2530, goaf, self-heating, temperature monitoring, zigbee

title: Vibration signal simulation system of aero-engine based on DDS
abstract: In order to satisfy the research demands of aero-engine vibration signal; the article designs and implements the aero-engine vibration signal simulation system based on AM3358 and Virtex5.This system is composed of two parts; including the main control module and the signal generation module. The main control module uses the PC terminal host computer and touch screen for signal parameters setting and start-stop control. The signal generation module uses DDS technology to implement simultaneous analog output of vibration signals and speed signals with a wide spectrum range and high amplitude accuracy.
keywords: dds technology, vibration signal simulation, waveform superposition
affiliations: School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiaotong University

title: Design of train axle temperature monitoring system based on ZigBee and cloud terminal
abstract: In order to monitor axle temperature of train in real time;a train axle temperature monitoring and alarm system based on ZigBee and cloud terminal is designed and developed.The train manager can monitor the axle temperature of the train in real time through personal computer（PC）and mobile terminal;and set the temperature threshold to prompt the alarm;so as to avoid the occurrence of danger in an emergency.The design consists of a number of terminal nodes installed on the axle and a monitoring coordinator; both of which are low-power consumption;low-cost ZigBee processor CC2530.The axle temperature data is collected by DS18 B20 high precision temperature sensor and transmitted to terminal node.When terminal node and coordinator are successfully self-organized;the data will be transmitted to the coordinator.The coordinator packages the data of multiple terminal nodes and sends it to upper PC through the serial port.Finally;the upper PC sends the data to the designated cloud terminal server and mobile terminal through the TCP protocol.The design is stable and flexible and has broad application prospect.
keywords: axle temperature, digital temperature sensor ds18b20, processor cc2530, tcp protocol, zigbee
affiliations: College of Automation,Qingdao University

title: Research on Forest Fire Detector Based on Internet Technology
abstract: 随着物联网技术的发展;网络化的火灾探测系统相比较传统的有线探测系统有着低成本、安装方便、高稳定性等突出的优势;因此;本文以CC2530芯片为整个无线网络的核心处理器;利用ZigBee短距离无线传输技术将传感器中的物理信息做数字化处理;再由无线网络通过路由节点向协调器发送;最终数据传送给相应的上位机;以便进行相应数据运算和处理;从而实现森林火灾的预防和报警。

title: 基于虚拟频率的隔离型双向AC/DC变换器最小电流应力控制策略
abstract: We propose a minimum current stress control strategy based on virtual frequency for isolated bidirectional AC/DC converters.First;the switching characteristics of the triple phase shift(TPS)control method are analyzed;and the TPS-based phase-shift full-bridge minimum-current stress control algorithm is designed.Then;according to the non-linear characteristics of the output power compared with the shift;a virtual frequency control method is proposed.This algorithm can simplify the nonlinear control to linearization;and can also realize the single-stage conversion of the AC-DC converter;effectively reducing the intermediate bus capacitance and reducing system current stress.Finally;the experimental platform based on TMS320 F28335 verifies the proposed control strategy.The experimental results show that the control strategy in this paper can effectively reduce the current stress of the converter when the power is transmitted in both directions.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对隔离型双向AC/DC变换器提出一种基于虚拟频率的最小电流应力控制策略。首先;分析了三重移相(triple phase shift;TPS)控制方法的开关特性;并设计了基于TPS的移相全桥最小电流应力控制算法。然后;针对输出功率与移相比呈非线性的特点;提出虚拟频率控制方法;该算法不仅可以将非线性控制简化为线性化;还可实现交直流变换器单级转换;有效减小中间母线电容;降低系统电流应力。最后;基于TMS320F28335的实验平台对所提出的控制策略进行了实验验证。实验结果表明;当功率双向传输时;所提控制策略能有效地减小变换器的电流应力。
keywords: current stress minimization, isolated bidirectional ac/dc converter, single phase converter, triple-phase-shift control, virtual frequency control method
authors: 王弈赫;任春光;孟祥齐;贾燕冰;韩肖清;郭东鑫

title: Design and implementation of a compact microwave synthesizer for atomic interference gravimeter
abstract: In atom interferometer gravity experiments， Raman laser preparation commonly used optical phase-locked loop method. The master and slave laser beat signal is mixed with a 6.8GHz microwave signal source， and then frequency discrimination is performed with direct digital frequency synthesis signal generator， and the feedback signal obtained is used for control to achieve low-noise Raman optical output， its phase noise will directly affect the sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter. This design uses the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller to program and control the LMX2594 digital phase-locked loop chip， and realizes the 6.8 GHz microwave signal source which uses the phase-locked loop frequency synthesis technology. The final experimental results show that the phase noise of the microwave signal source is 65.2 dB@1 Hz，-95.3 dB@1 kHz; ADEV is 2.72×10-11@1 s， output power is greater than 10 dBm， at T=100 ms， the influence of the signal source on the sensitivity of the atom interference gravimeter is 8×10-8 m/s2/Hz1/2， and the resolution is 2×10-8 g@600 s， which can meet the requirements of the microwave reference source of the atom interferometer.
keywords: atom interference gravimeter, microwave signal source, phase noise, pll

title: 基于ZigBee的农田土壤湿度监测系统
abstract: The farmland soil moisture monitoring system based on ZigBee is designed in this paper.CC2530 chip is selected as the main control module of the sensor node in the system.The soil moisture sensor is used to collect the moisture data in real time;and the data transmission between the node and the server is realized through the serial port module of the coordinator.The communication between the server and the web browser is realized by combining the Internet;so that the latter can display the visualized farmland soil moisture information in real time.Through the test; the distance between nodes can maintain stable communication within 50 m;which can meet the system’s efficient and accurate detection of farmland soil moisture information.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了基于ZigBee的农田土壤湿度监测系统。系统中的传感器节点选用CC2530芯片作为主控模块;利用土壤湿度传感器实时采集湿度数据;并通过协调器的串口模块实现节点与服务器之间的数据传输;且结合互联网实现服务器与Web浏览器端之间的通信;使后者实时显示可视化农田土壤湿度信息。通过测试;节点之间的距离在50m内可保持稳定通信;系统满足对农田土壤湿度信息的高效、精准检测的需求。
keywords: cc2530, farmland soil moisture, monitoring systems, zigbee
affiliations: 西南民族大学电气工程学院国家民委重点实验室

title: 基于单片机的温湿度pm2.5检测仪
abstract: In this paper;ZigBee AD hoc network technology is used to build a wireless sensor network for information exchange to achieve intelligent home environment monitoring. The system hardware is based on the CC2530 development board and the wireless sensor network is built through ZigBee coordinator; routing nodes and network nodes; multiple sensor nodes for data acquisition; and the acquisition of the signal amplification; A/D conversion and other processing; to achieve A close distance between the nodes of wireless communication. The user terminal uses the upper computer to write the software code and realize the real-time display of data. The system has the advantages of low power consumption; low cost; convenient installation; compact and beautiful and is suitable for the real-time monitoring of environmental data in the user's residence.
abstract_in_chinese: 为让人们了解到空气质量;该设计利用单片机、温湿度传感器和PM2.5检测模块构成的检测仪;可将空气中温湿度、PM2.5浓度数据实时采集。检测仪分为温湿度检测与PM2.5检测两大部分;采用温湿度传感器DHT11检测空气中的温湿度参数;采用粉尘检测传感器GP2Y1010AU0F测量空气中的PM2.5浓度;然后将收集到的信号经过A/D转换为单片机可辨别的信号;最后在液晶显示屏上显示出数据;从而用来监测PM2.5的含量。
keywords: air quality, dust sensor, single chip microcomputer, temperature and humidity sensor

title: 基于ZigBee和云端的列车轴温监测系统设计
abstract: In order to monitor axle temperature of train in real time;a train axle temperature monitoring and alarm system based on ZigBee and cloud terminal is designed and developed.The train manager can monitor the axle temperature of the train in real time through personal computer(PC)and mobile terminal;and set the temperature threshold to prompt the alarm;so as to avoid the occurrence of danger in an emergency.The design consists of a number of terminal nodes installed on the axle and a monitoring coordinator; both of which are low-power consumption;low-cost ZigBee processor CC2530.The axle temperature data is collected by DS18 B20 high precision temperature sensor and transmitted to terminal node.When terminal node and coordinator are successfully self-organized;the data will be transmitted to the coordinator.The coordinator packages the data of multiple terminal nodes and sends it to upper PC through the serial port.Finally;the upper PC sends the data to the designated cloud terminal server and mobile terminal through the TCP protocol.The design is stable and flexible and has broad application prospect.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实时监控列车的轴温;设计开发了基于ZigBee和云端的列车轴温监测系统。列车管理人员可以通过电脑端和移动终端实时监控列车轴温;并设置温度阈值提示报警;紧急避免危险的发生。系统由多个安装在车轴的终端节点和一个监控协调器组成;终端和协调器均采用低功耗、低成本的ZigBee处理器CC2530。轴温数据通过DS18B20高精度温度传感器采集并传输给终端节点。当终端节点与协调器自组网成功后;将数据传输给协调器。协调器将多个终端节点数据打包通过串口发送给上位机;最后由上位机通过TCP协议发送数据给指定云端服务器和移动终端。系统运行稳定;灵活;具有广阔的应用前景。
keywords: axle temperature, digital temperature sensor ds18b20, processor cc2530, tcp protocol, zigbee
affiliations: 青岛大学自动化学院, Qingdao University, College of Automation

title: CC2530芯片无线收发深入解析
abstract: In the development of the sensing layer of smart home and intelligent agriculture system;ZigBee technology is mainly used.The hardware of ZigBee technology is CC2530 chip with RF transceiver function.In this paper;through the configuration of CC2530 chip register;the chip realizes the wireless transceiver functionthrough the use of registers;the wireless sending function and wireless receiving function are written to realize the data transmission based on basic RF.In depth study of CC2530 chip wireless transceiver mechanism;so as to master the wireless transceiver principle;facilitate better use of the chip;enhance the ability to develop the perception layer of the Internet of things.
abstract_in_chinese: 在智能家居和智能农业系统的感知层开发中主要运用Zigbee技术;实现Zigbee技术的硬件主要为具有射频收发功能的CC2530芯片。该文通过配置CC2530芯片的寄存器;使芯片实现无线收发的功能通过使用寄存器的方式;编写无线发送函数和无线接收函数;实现基于Basic RF的数据传输。深入研究CC2530芯片的无线收发机制;从而掌握无线收发原理;便于更好地利用芯片;增强物联网感知层开发的能力。
keywords: cc2530, chip register, interrupt function, wireless transceiver
affiliations: 大连职业技术学院, Dalian Vocational & Technical College

title: 一种基于物联网技术的智能停车系统研发
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于物联网技术的智能停车系统解决方案。采用CC2530芯片组建ZigBee网络;由协调器负责将停车位信息通过窄带物联网上传到云服务器;实时更新停车位状态;通过Android设备可以快捷方便找到空闲的车位。本文给出了系统设计的总体框架;为智能停车场的实施推广提供了参考。

title: Wireless Monitoring System for Warehouse Environment Based on CC2530
abstract: A wireless monitoring system for warehouse environment is designed for the existing wired monitoring system of warehouse environment parameters;the wiring needs a large number of cables;and the workload of system maintenance or upgrade is large.The system uses CC2530 as the core processor to build network nodes;and sets up ZigBee wireless network to carry out monitoring information transmission.The wireless monitoring system has the advantages of flexible sampling arrangement;simple and quick installation;convenient inspection and maintenance.System expansion;improvement;optimization of flexible;easy to solve the warehouse cable wiring complex environment monitoring system;solve the problem of high cost cable;improve the flexibility of the warehouse environment monitoring system and the continuous improvement of convenience;the environment monitoring system for warehouse field of process improvement and cost control effect significantly;which can help improve the quality and safety of storage items.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, warehouse, wireless network

title: Design of CAN bus communication based on TMS320F28335
abstract: According to CAN bus communication specification and eCAN peripheral features of TMS320-F28335 processor;the connection mode and interface circuit of multi-node communication network of CAN bus are designed. According to TMS320 F28335 processor ecan module setting rules;CAN bus data frame format is designed;and an example setting is given;the module is configured with software;CAN bus multi-node communication is realized.

title: Wireless Visualization Smart Agriculture Management System Based on WSNs
abstract: Based on the advantages of ZigBee and WiFi; a visual intelligent agricultural management system based on ZigBee and WiFi dual-protocol fusion Wireless Sensor Networks（WSNs） technology was proposed based on the advantages of CC2530 chip and ESP8266 chip.STM32 is the main control core of the system.Build a visual cloud computing platform based on ESP8266 WiFi module.Each environmental parameter of greenhouse is sent to ZigBee terminal equipment through serial port.Users can monitor the environmental parameters of greenhouses remotely in real time and control the working status of each actuator through computer and mobile phone clients.The results show that the system has high accuracy of data acquisition; high reliability of work; and can realize accurate remote control.

title: 基于ZigBee技术的可燃气体监测报警系统的设计
abstract: 由于可燃气体泄漏极易造成重大安全事故;危及人们的生命财产安全;因此对可燃气体进行监控极为重用。文中基于ZigBee技术设计了一种可燃气体泄漏报警系统;该系统由传感节点、网关与控制节点、监控中心组成。传感节点由CC2530微控制器和传感器模块组成;网关与控制节点包括CC2530和4G通信模块;监控中心包括PC机和服务器。传感节点将采集的数据通过ZigBee网络传送给网关节点;由监控中心计算后得出气体浓度。当浓度超过设定的阈值时监控中心报警并显示泄漏方位。

title: Smart Home Environmental Detection System Based on ZigBee
abstract: In this paper; ZigBee AD hoc network technology is used to build wireless sensor network for information exchange to achieve intelligent home environmental monitoring. The system hardware takes CC2530 development board as the core; constructs wireless sensor network through ZigBee coordinator; routing nodes and network nodes; collects data from multiple sensor nodes; amplifies the collected signal; and processes A/D conversion and other processing; so as to realize short-range wireless communication between nodes. The user terminal compiles the software code through the upper computer to realize the real-time display of data. The system has the advantages of low power consumption; low cost; convenient installation; small and beautiful; which is suitable for real-time monitoring of environmental data in the user’s residence.

title: Optimized realization of Sobel edge detection algorithm for FT-M7002
abstract: Edge detection is an extremely important method of image analysis in image processing and computer vision. Sobel operator is often used for coarse-precision edge extraction and is widely used in image edge detection. At present， with the research and development of the domestic FT series high-performance DSP， the demand for this platform in the field of image processing is becoming stronger， so the realization of high-performance image processing algorithms for the FT platform urgently needs to be solved. In response to the above problems， proposed and implemented the Sobel edge detection optimization algorithm on the FT-M7002 platform. The program performance is improved through optimization methods such as vector parallel optimization， loop unrolling， DMA transmission optimization， and array transposition. The performance of the original algorithm and the optimized algorithm under various convolution kernel sizes and image scales is compared and analyzed. After verification， the overall performance of the optimized algorithm has increased by 1.66 to 3.14 times. Compared with the results of running on the TMS320C6678 processor， the optimized algorithm can achieve an optimization effect of 1.87 to 2.08 times.
abstract_in_chinese: 边缘检测是图像处理与计算机视觉中极为重要的一种分析图像的方法，Sobel算子常用于粗精度边缘提取，在图像边缘检测中被广泛应用。目前，随着国产飞腾（FT）系列高性能DSP的研究与发展，使该平台在图像处理领域的需求越发强烈，因此面向FT平台的高性能图像处理算法的实现亟需解决。针对上述问题，提出并实现了Sobel边缘检测在FT-M7002平台的优化算法，通过向量并行优化、循环展开、DMA传输优化与数组转置等优化方法提高了程序性能。对比分析了多种卷积核大小及图片规模下原算法与优化后算法的性能，经验证，优化后的算法整体性能提升了1.66～3.14倍。相比于在TMS320C6678处理器上运行结果，优化后算法可达到1.87～2.08倍的优化效果。
keywords: dma transmission optimization, edge detection, high-performance dsp, sobel operator, vector parallel

title: Current Load Distribution Method Based on SOC Parallel Energy Storage System
abstract: An improved current load distribution method based on SOC is proposed， the method adopts three closed-loop structure of the current-sharing loop， the current loop and the voltage loop， among them， the current reference of the current sharing controller is determined by the ideal output power and the energy storage unit SOC. The Matlab/Simulink simulation model and TMS320F28335- based semi - physical simulation platform of parallel storage system are built， the performance of the system under the influence of different parameters is compared and simulated. The bus voltage in parallel energy storage system can stabilize the ideal value， current load is distributed reasonably according to SOC， and each energy storage unit can SOC quickly converge to equilibrium state， the feasibility and rationality of the proposed improved current load distribution method are verified.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种基于SOC的改进电流负荷分配方法，该方法采用均流环、电流环、电压环的三闭环结构，其中均流控制器的电流基准由理想输出功率和储能单元电池荷电状态（State Of Charge，SOC）共同决定。搭建了Matlab/Simulink仿真模型和基于TMS320F28335的并联储能系统半实物仿真平台，对比仿真了不同参数影响下系统的性能。并联储能系统中母线电压能够稳定在理想值，电流负荷能够按SOC合理分配，且各储能单元SOC能够快速收敛到均衡状态，验证了所提改进电流负荷分配方法的可行性和合理性。
keywords: bus voltage, dc microgrid, load distribution, parallel energy storage system, soc

title: Design of three-phase software phase locked loop based on prefilter
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large phase-locked error and slow dynamic response of traditional SPLL(Software Phase Locked Loop) under unbalanced and distorted voltage;a prefilter SPLL based on MAF(Moving Average Filter) is proposed;which is based on the principle of traditional SPLL. A fast unbalanced component suppression and phase delay compensation method is applied to improve the performance of MAF;which effectively improves the dynamic response speed and phase-locked accuracy of the proposed SPLL. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform and TMS320 F28335 DSP(Digital Signal Processor) chip;the control strategy of the proposed SPLL is verified under the condition of three-phase voltage unbalance and voltage distortion. The results show that the SPLL has small phase-locked error;fast dynamic response speed and high stability.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统锁相环在电压不平衡及畸变时锁相误差大、动态响应速度慢的问题，根据软件锁相环（SPLL）的原理提出一种滑动滤波器（MAF）前置锁相环，并通过一种快速不平衡分量抑制及相位延迟补偿的方法来改善MAF性能，有效提高了锁相环的动态响应速度和锁相精度。通过MATLAB/Simulink仿真平台及TMS320F28335数字信号处理器芯片对所提出的锁相环控制策略在三相电压不平衡及电压畸变的条件下进行验证，结果表明该SPLL锁相误差小，动态响应速度快，稳定性高。
keywords: digital signal processor, moving average filter, phase delay compensation, software phase locked loop, voltage distortion

title: 基于反步滑模算法的无人机姿态鲁棒控制系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional UAV attitude robust control system is susceptible to external interference and cannot precisely control the attitude angle; the left rudder surface angle and the right rudder surface angle; resulting in system instability; a back-step sliding mode algorithm is designed. Robust control system for UAV attitude. Use the cascade PID controller of the TMS320 F28335 chip to control the UAV central processing unit. Choose MS-S3 servo drive to ensure high torque operation when the motor is moving at high speed. Use STM32 f407 VGT6 attitude controller to control the rotor attitude. In the software process design process; construct the UAV dynamic model; introduce the backstep sliding mode algorithm to construct the dynamic equation considering the attitude angle; select the Lyapunov function to calculate the error variable; design the sliding mode control law; and realize the software programming with the help of Visual C++6.0; Complete the design of the UAV attitude robust control system. According to the experimental results; when the time is 5 s; the attitude angle of the system reaches 6°; the left rudder surface reaches 0.40°; and the right rudder surface angle reaches 0.20°; which is consistent with the actual control result and has a precise control effect.

title: 基于滤波器前置的三相软件锁相环设计
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large phase-locked error and slow dynamic response of traditional SPLL(Software Phase Locked Loop) under unbalanced and distorted voltage;a prefilter SPLL based on MAF(Moving Average Filter) is proposed;which is based on the principle of traditional SPLL. A fast unbalanced component suppression and phase delay compensation method is applied to improve the performance of MAF;which effectively improves the dynamic response speed and phase-locked accuracy of the proposed SPLL. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform and TMS320 F28335 DSP(Digital Signal Processor) chip;the control strategy of the proposed SPLL is verified under the condition of three-phase voltage unbalance and voltage distortion. The results show that the SPLL has small phase-locked error;fast dynamic response speed and high stability.

title: Design of software development system for internet classroom teaching under Internet plus
abstract: A software development system for internet classroom teaching under Internet plus is designed to improve the storage capacity in software development system of network classroom teaching. The hardware part of the system is mainly designed;including single chip microcomputer and controller. The single chip microcomputer is used to provide the data storage function;and the TMS320LF2407A chip is used as the main controller. In the system software part;the resource database is built;and the constructed resource database can connect with the teaching system used port to transmit data;so as to complete the design of the software development system of the internet classroom teaching under the Internet plus. The experimental results show that the software development system of internet classroom teaching under Internet plus has strong storage ability;maximum concurrent number and fast throughput;and has great advantages.

title: LAMOST Wireless Control System Based on ZigBee
abstract: In the LAMOST（Large Sky Area Multi-Object Fiber Spectroscopy Telescope） system;in order to observe 4000 celestial bodies at the same time;4000 optical fiber units need to be controlled.In order to solve the problems in the LAMOST wireless control system;a set of wireless control system based on ZigBee is designed.The hardware design of the sub-node control board includes the designs of power supply and radio frequency.The power supply is redesigned with switching power supply;which reduces the static power consumption of the sub-node control board.The RF design uses key technologies such as impedance matching;capacitor and resistor fine-tuning impedance;which reduces signal loss and reflection;and greatly improves the wireless communication quality of the sub-node control board.For the master node;the design of STM32 + radio frequency control CC2530 + power amplifier RXF2401 C is adopted;which improves the quality of the wireless signal sent by the master node and the sensitivity of reception.In terms of software;the characteristics of LAMOST control are studied.The control is carried out by group sending and polling one by one.The method of parity check and timeliness query is adopted to improve the communication reliability of the system and reduce the communication time.Tests show that the system has the characteristics of high reliability;high efficiency;low power consumption;etc.;which can fully meet the application of LAMOST Engineering.
keywords: group control, impedance matching, lamost, zigbee wireless control

title: Design of intelligent lock system based on Wi-Fi and face recognition technology
abstract: Aiming at the security problems existing in traditional door locks; an intelligent lock system combining Wi-Fi technology and face recognition technology is designed. The system adopts STM32F103 as the core control device and CC1101 as the commu-nication and transmission module; which can effectively reduce power consumption and realize information interaction. MULBP（ Mul-tiple Uniform Local Binary Patterns; MULBP） face recognition algorithm is put forward at the same time; compared with before im-provement to enhance the image grayscale average and each row; column and diagonal elements; the relationship between value of new LBP operator is more able to reflect the local texture feature; and combined with 2DLDA（ Two-dimensional Linear Discriminant Analysis; 2DLDA） algorithm find the projection matrix; to make the sample more easy to distinguish; easier for feature extraction.The results show that the fusion algorithm not only reduces the feature dimension but also improves the recognition rate; making the system achieve the purpose of intelligent anti-theft.

title: 实验鼠无创生理信号监测系统设计
abstract: Objective To monitor the physiological signals of laboratory rats continuously and noninva-sively in biomedical and pharmaceutical researches;a noninvasive physiological signal monitoring sys-tem for laboratory rats was developed.Methods The system consisted of a wearable terminal;a physi-ological signal receiving master and a monitoring software.The wireless microcontroller CC2640R2F was adopted in the wearable terminal to realize the acquisition and wireless transmission of electrocar-diogram(ECG);body temperature(BT)and activity levels(AL)of laboratory rats.The physiologi-cal signals collected by the wearable terminal through low energy Bluetooth technology were received by the physiological signal receiving master;and transmited to the upper computer.Then the physio-logical signals were filtered by the monitoring software of upper computer in real time;and the heart rate(HR)and RR interval(RRI)were extracted from ECG.Results The size of wearable terminal was 37 mm×28 mm×5 mm;and the weight was 6.8 g.A female SD rat was selected for in vivo ex-periment.The experiment results showed that the ECG waveforms collected by this system were con-sistent with those collected by the Bio-Radio REF BR 500.The HR of rat collected by this system was(429±22)beats/min;and the standard error of the mean(SEM)was±1.11 beats/min;while the HR collected by Bio-Radio was(438±24)beats/min;and the SEM was±1.14 beats/min.The BT of rat collected by this system was(36.98±0.20)℃;and the SEM was±0.03 C;while the BT collect-ed by the medical infrared thermometer AET-R1F1 was(36.95±0.23)℃;and the SEM was±0.04℃.This system could collect AL of rats at rest and during activity.Conclusion This system can monitor the BT;ECG;AL;RRI;and HR of freely moving rats noninvasively;accurately and in real time.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的研制一种实验鼠无创可穿戴生理信号监测系统;实现在生物医学和药学研究中;连续无创地监测实验鼠的生理信号。方法系统由可穿戴终端、生理信号接收主机和监控软件组成。可穿戴终端采用无线微控制器CC2640R2F实现实验鼠心电图(ECG)、体温(BT)和运动量(AL)的采集与无线传输;生理信号接收主机通过低功耗蓝牙技术;接收可穿戴终端采集的生理信号;并将信号传输给上位机;上位机监控软件对生理信号进行实时滤波;并从ECG中提取出心率(HR)和RR间期(RRI)。结果可穿戴终端尺寸为37 mm×28 mm×5 mm;重量为6.8 g。选取1只雌性SD大鼠开展活体实验;实验结果表明;本系统采集的ECG波形与标准心电仪Bio-RadioREFBR-500采集的波形一致;采集的大鼠HR为(429±22)beats/min;均值标准误差(SEM)为±1.11 beats/min;而Bio-Radio采集的HR为(438±24)beats/min;SEM为±1.14 beats/min。本系统采集的大鼠BT为(36.98±0.20)℃C;SEM为±0.03℃;而医用红外体温计AET-R1F1采集的BT为(36.95±0.23)℃;SEM为±0.04℃。本系统可采集大鼠在静息和运动时的AL。结论本系统可无创、准确、实时地监测自主活动大鼠的BT、ECG、AL、RRI和HR等生理指标。
keywords: bluetooth low energy, noninvasive, physiological signal, rat, wearable

title: 基于DSP微处理器的电机转速控制器设计
abstract: Aiming at the rotary speed control of brush DC motor; design the DSP rotary speed controller. Based on DSP chip TMS320 F28335; taking traditional PI control algorithm as core; introduce hardware circuit and control structure of rotary speed controller. Compare ECAP capture module with AD sampling module through clutch joint performance test. The design of speed controller is optimized and improved from an engineering perspective. The results show that the method can optimize design of DSP rotary speed controller and the signal collection accuracy is much higher than AD sampling module.

title: 基于TMS320C6678的雷达杂波处理技术
abstract: One method of the Clutter suppression for clutter suppression in search or tracking radar. Considering the realtime problem of data processing; this design uses high performance 8-core DSP-TEXAS INSTRUMENTS’ TMS320 C6678;it has the High-speed floating-point real-time operation performance. Meanwhile;it can be connected the large storage peripherals;for the processing algorithm with large data storage requirements;it can fully meet the requirements..In this paper the design and implementation of clutter map are described in detail.The experimental results show that the clutter suppression method can effectively eliminate clutter.

title: 激光干涉仪可视化控制系统设计
abstract: In order to improve the measuring accuracy of laser interferometer;a visual control method is proposed. This method realizes the sending of control command and the display of the position of optical adjustment unit synchronously through a simple Windows form application. The control command is sent to the MCU of CC2530;and the MCU completes the corresponding control action according to the commandSTM32 F103 C8 T6 MCU sends the collected position data to the control application;and displays the position of each adjustment unit after application processing. The control system can realize multi-gear and customized fine-tuning control of the laser interferometer;and the display of position makes the control more intuitive. By means of improving the control precision;the optical measuring environment can reach a better state;so as to improve the measurement precision of interferometer.

abstract: In order to avoid battery charging control completely relying on human to calculate time;observe temperature and judge abnormal conditions;ZigBee technology and temperature sensor are applied to battery monitoring to realize automatic control;and the monitoring circuit is designed.Infrared temperature sensor is used to collect signal;ZigBee of CC2530 chip is used for data acquisition;sorting and transmission.Through wireless transmission module;the computer terminal collects data and displays it in real time.The power supply is controlled by contactor to realize over temperature protection. title: Multifunctional Electronic Door Plate Design Based on ZigBee
abstract: For the traditional door sign curing the board;and the door sign can not change the information in real-time and other problems;this paper designs a multifunctional electronic door sign based on ZigBee.The design includes data acquisition;transmission;and processing analysis modules.The system adopts ZigBee wireless sensor network and ESP8266 Wi-Fi module as the communication means;uses CC2530 chip as the main body;collects data through human body identification module and temperature and humidity collection module;and finally displays the received data on the LCD screen to achieve the status of the door sign at any time to change;detect the temperature and humidity information around the door sign;display the current time information and save energy and many other functions.This design not only enhances the intelligence and informatization of the door sign system;but also can be customized according to the individual needs of users;thus solving many problems of traditional door signs such as board curing and lagging information and improving the convenience and comfort of people’s daily life and office.

title: Monitoring System of Aquaculture Water Quality Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Intensive aquaculture has high demands on the quality of culture water.Inaccurate or delayed water quality monitoring will do harm to the regular fishery production.To solve these problems; this study designed a monitoring system of aquaculture water quality based on wireless sensor network.It combined the wireless sensor network with application system together; and realized the real-time monitoring of aquaculture water quality by using ad-hoc network.Under Cotex-M4 ARM architecture; the monitoring system used microprocessors STM32 F405 and wireless RF CC2530 chip as a core.Meanwhile; it developed corresponding underlying hardware; software and application software.In order to enhance the data accuracy; an improved support degree function was applied to fuse multi-sensor data in monitoring system.This system had high measurement accuracy; real-time and stability; which could meet the requirements of aquaculture monitoring.

title: Design of environmental monitoring system for agricultural greenhousebased on Internet of things
abstract: In order to realize the real-time remote monitoring on agricultural greenhouse environment parameter; the study presents a kind of agricultural greenhouse environment monitoring system based on Internet of things technology. The system uses ZigBee as the core technology and CC2530 F256 microcontroller as the main controller. ZigBee nodes is equipped with five sensors including temperature-humidity; gas concentration; light intensity; air pressure and soil humidity; which is used to realize real-time monitoring of environmental parameters. So; the parameter values have been uploaded to the mobile APP through WIFI module. Users can analyze and judge data and issue control instructions; thus the lower computer performs the actions of exhaust; irrigation; alarm; etc.; so to realize remote monitoring and smart management of agricultural greenhouse environment information.

title: Development of seeding rate detection system for precision and small amount sowing of wheat
abstract: Seeding amount determines the distribution density of plants in the field; thereby posing a significant impact on the final yield of crops. Real-time detection of sowing amount is an inevitable trend in precise agriculture. However; the current technology is difficult to rapidly identify overlapping seeds for the total amount of wheat precision seeding. In this study; an accurate detection system with an interpolation sensor was developed to control the seeding amount in a wheat precision planter with a wide seedling strip. Infrared radiation LEDs were used as the sensitive elements; and the 24-bit ADS1256 as the high-precision sampling module. The sampling frequency of the system was determined to be 1×103 Hz. The process of seed falling was analyzed; where the seeds were sampled at least three times when the sensor was scanning over the detection areas. The sampling voltage of one seed; two seeds; and three seeds were obtained when the sensor passed through. Two sampling threshold divisions were set using the peak and the mean value; according to the sampling voltage. In the peak; 489 was the threshold value for 1 and 2 seeds while 616 for 2 and 3 seeds. In the mean; 277 was the threshold value for 1 and 2 seeds while 330 for 2 and 3 seeds. A detection system of precision seeding was realized to integrate with the interaction interface of touch screen personal-computer and drive control of a stepper motor. A field experiment of planter under static state was carried out to verify the detection accuracy of the system; the adaptability for different varieties of wheat and seeding frequency; and further to evaluate the two-threshold division. Three types of wheat were selected as the research objects; including Heng-Guan 35; Ji-Mai 22; and Cun-Mai 11. It was found that the peak detection was optimal; due to the low detection error and good adaptability to different wheat varieties. The peak detection was further revised; where the correction coefficient was 7.08%. A field experiment was also carried out to further verify the performance of the detection system under dynamic conditions. It was found that the absolute detection error of the system ranged from 1.12%-5.63%; and the mean absolute error was 3.12%; indicating a high detection accuracy for the high requirements under various sowing rates and operation speeds; as well as a high resistance to sunlight and dust interference. The finding can provide potential technical support for the design of seed tube sensor; and the rapid detection of seeding amount in the process of precision wheat sowing.

title: Design and implementation of indoor visible light communication system based on high-order PAM
abstract: A high-order pulse amplitude modulation（PAM） method can transmit more bits of information within the same symbol; improving the modulation efficiency and the frequency band utilization of the communication system. However; the high-order PAM system has poor anti-noise ability; and the signal amplitude is easily affected by channel attenuation during transmission. To improve the reliability of high-order PAM systems; an improved PAM symbol waveform structure is proposed. The improved scheme reduces the bit error rate of the system at the same signal-to-noise and modulation order. Using TMS32 C6748 floating-point digital signal processing（DSP） as the control chip of the optical communication system; a visible light communication system based on the high-end PAM room is designed and implemented. The system communication performance of the scheme is verified by an experimental platform. Experimental results show that the communication system has the advantages of low bit error rate and high modulation efficiency; thus meeting the requirements of high-performance indoor visible light communication systems.
keywords: improved pulse amplitude modulation, pulse amplitude modulation, tms320c6748, visible light communication

title: Development of multi-point patrol monitoring system for gantry crane stress based on CC2530
abstract: This paper introduces the development of a multi-point itinerant stress monitoring system for gantry crane based on CC2530. The system uses CC2530 as the core processing unit; and forms a data acquisition network with coordinator nodes and resistance strain sensor monitoring nodes to collect the multi-point stress of different parts of gantry crane in real time. When the stress exceeds the threshold value; it will send an alarm to the user immediately; so as to realize the real-time monitoring and management of gantry crane equipment.
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition network, gantry crane, monitoring system

title: Design and implementation of high speed image processing system based on XC7K325T and TMS320C6678
abstract: According to the characteristics of high-speed image target recognition and tracking system; such as large amount of calculation; high transmission rate and strong real-time performance;A high performance real-time image processing system based on XC7 k325 t and TMS320 c6678 is developed. The system adopts FPGA and multi-core DSP parallel processing and pipeline operation technology;to realize high-speed image target recognition and tracking. The test results show that the system meets the design requirements.

title: Research and Development of Distributed Lantern’s Lighting Control System Based on ZigBee
abstract: The light is controlled by static mode on festive lantern; so it is difficult to realize the original intention accurately in the aspects of luminous flux adjustment; color change; luminous time control and distance control. According to the demand of lantern art for lighting; this paper constructs ZigBee LAN based on CC2530; designs and develops a wireless distributed lantern control system with Raspberry Pi as coordinator. The top layer of the control system is the Internet network layer; which connects the client and the coordinator; and controls the coordinator through the client program; the middle layer is the Zig Bee network layer; which provides the channel for the communication between the coordinator and the terminal node group; the bottom layer is the hardware working layer; which performs the light source control task; and the terminal node adopts the mechanism of "segmented receiving; queue storage" to improve the stability of Zig Bee network. The test results of the control system show that the luminous flux of the light can be cut in the unit of 30 lm and adjusted in the range of 0～255 on demand; the color switching within 0.2 s of the light can be realized; the luminous time can be set arbitrarily; and 255 terminal nodes can be controlled to work at the same time in the range of 100 m.
keywords: festive lantern’s lighting control system, raspberry pi, terminal control node, zigbee

title: 基于ZigBee的智慧农业网络监测系统设计
abstract: 随着物联网技术的发展;智慧农业已成为现代农业未来发展趋势。将现代网络控制技术应用于传统农业;可以使农业生产管理更加科学化;有效提高农业生产效率。本文结合农业温室大棚的应用需求;设计了基于CC2530芯片的ZigBee采集器、控制器、边缘网关和3种传感器;构成了各应用实时采集和远程控制系统。本系统实现了农业智能化监测;弥补了传统农业生产控制不足的情况;节约了大量的人力、物力成本;具有较高的实用价值和现实意义。

title: Rotary Transformer Decoding System Based on TMS320F28379D and Σ-Δ Modulator
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the resolver′s difficulty in solving and the second time delay of the special solving chip; a resolver soft solution system based on TMS320 F28379 D was proposed. A dual sampling circuit of Σ-Δ and ADC was designed based on the resolver and the Σ-Δ sampling. The arctangent method was used to realize the resolver open-loop decoding; the double-precision digital R/D conversion circuit based on the phase-locked loop principle was used to realize the resolver closed-loop decoding. The experimental results show that compared with open-loop decoding; closed-loop decoding improves the accuracy of position calculation at the cost of minimal delay. The resolver soft solution system can realize accurate resolver decoding and reduce the solution delay.
keywords: phase-locked loop, rotary transformers, servo control, sigma-delta sampling, tms320f28379d

title: Design of Pressure Monitoring System for Coal Mine Hydraulic Support Based on MSP430 and ZigBee
abstract: Based on MSP430 and Zig Bee equipment; a micro monitoring system for hydraulic support pressure monitoring through wireless sensor network is designed; and the specific scheme of the system is given. The hardware part designs the pressure acquisition node; signal modulation circuit; Zig Bee wireless communication scheme; CAN bus communication circuit; and the software part describes the flow chart of the main program and the pressure acquisition node CC2530 module subroutine. After field operation test; the system can realize the pressure monitoring of each position of hydraulic support through wireless sensor network; the data transmission is stable; the installation is convenient; and it has certain application value.

title: 智慧教室物联网云平台硬件设计与实现
abstract: 随着无线通信、云计算技术的不断发展和成熟;物联网被广泛应用于各个产业领域;建设面向智慧校园的物联网云平台在高校迅速发展起来。基于此;本文对智慧教室物联网云平台感知层和网络层的硬件结构和网络协议进行设计与实现。基于ZigBee组网;利用无线传感技术;实现了智慧教室多网络节点的感知与控制。选用CC2530为主控芯片;设计基于ZigBee技术的通用模块;实现各种传感数据的采集;同时利用规范的协议参数完成数据包传递的功能。教室内ZigBee网络采用星型组网;实现了教室内控网络的通信;规范了数据帧格式。各教室通过WiFi技术将汇总的传感数据上传到云端服务器的智能教室软件平台;同时接收平台控制指令。经实验验证;所使用的基于ZigBee的通信方式能够有效支撑面向智慧教室的多源异构传感器传输数据的实时性、有效性和稳定性。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 传感器, 智慧教室
affiliations: 邯郸学院

title: BIPV Energy Storage Battery Pack Status Monitoring System Design
abstract: 针对光伏建筑一体化（building integrated PV;BIPV）储能电站蓄电池组的状态监测需求;设计了以 CC2530为控制核心、以高共模差动放大器 INA117 为电压电流信号转换电路、以 DS18B20为温度采集电路的蓄电池状态监测系统;通过多通道模拟开关 ADG732 实现了蓄电池组的单体电池电压、充放电电流和单体温度的低成本远程无线状态监测。对比试验表明;该方案的性能满足施工方的设计要求。
keywords: 供电电路, 光伏建筑一体化, 系统控制, 蓄电池组

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感网络振动加速度的监测与应用
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing mechanical equipment vibration monitoring system; such as cumbersome wiring and poor scalability; a wireless online vibration monitoring system based on Zig Bee technology is designed. The system consists of collection terminal; coordinator; and monitoring center. The CC2530 chip is used as the controller; Using MMA8451 sensor and PC to realize the functions of acquisition; transmission; display and so on. Tests show that the system can effectively replace the wired way to achieve vibration monitoring of most mechanical equipment.

title: 基于CC2530的龙门起重机应力多点巡回监测系统研制
abstract: This paper introduces the development of a multi-point itinerant stress monitoring system for gantry crane based on CC2530. The system uses CC2530 as the core processing unit; and forms a data acquisition network with coordinator nodes and resistance strain sensor monitoring nodes to collect the multi-point stress of different parts of gantry crane in real time. When the stress exceeds the threshold value; it will send an alarm to the user immediately; so as to realize the real-time monitoring and management of gantry crane equipment.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章介绍了一种基于CC2530的龙门起重机应力多点巡回监测系统研制;该系统采用CC2530为核心处理单元;以协调器结点和各电阻式应变传感监测结点组成数据采集网络;实时采集龙门起重机不同部件的多点应力;当应力超过阈值时第一时间向用户发送警报;从而实现龙门起重机设备的实时监测和管理。
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition network, gantry crane, monitoring system

title: 基于物联网的农业大棚环境监控系统设计
abstract: In order to realize the real-time remote monitoring on agricultural greenhouse environment parameter; the study presents a kind of agricultural greenhouse environment monitoring system based on Internet of things technology. The system uses ZigBee as the core technology and CC2530 F256 microcontroller as the main controller. ZigBee nodes is equipped with five sensors including temperature-humidity; gas concentration; light intensity; air pressure and soil humidity; which is used to realize real-time monitoring of environmental parameters. So; the parameter values have been uploaded to the mobile APP through WIFI module. Users can analyze and judge data and issue control instructions; thus the lower computer performs the actions of exhaust; irrigation; alarm; etc.; so to realize remote monitoring and smart management of agricultural greenhouse environment information.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现农业大棚环境参数的实时远程监测;提出了一种基于物联网技术的农业大棚环境监控系统。该系统以ZigBee为核心技术;使用CC2530F256单片机作为主控制器;ZigBee节点搭载温度、气体浓度、光照强度、气压以及土壤湿度等5种传感器实现了对农业大棚内环境参数的实时监测;并通过WIFI模块将参数值上传至手机APP;用户对数据进行分析判断;再发出控制指令;使下位机执行排气、灌溉、报警等动作;以实现农业大棚环境信息的远程监控和智能化管理。
keywords: agricultural greenhouse, internet of things, monitoring system, sensor, zigbee

title: 一种按需加载的DSP程序扩容方法
abstract: Along with the development of software radio;the processing capacity of software radio platform is becoming more and more powerful;the functions realized on the platform are more and more;the hardware structure of the platform is also varied;and the sharing of hardware and software resources can not be realized the platforms.To solve the above problems;this paper provides an on-demand loading DSP program expansion method;which can load different DSP functions according to the need;which is equivalent to the expansion of DSP memory.This method reduces the loading time and does not have to guarantee the running speed of the DSP program.This method is applicable to TI companies;ADI companies and current domestic DSP;models are not limited to TMS320 C6713;TMS320 C6416;TMS320 C6455 and TMS320 C6678.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着软件无线电的发展;软件无线电平台的处理能力越来越强大、平台上实现的功能越来越多;平台的硬件结构也多种多样;各平台之间无法实现软硬件资源的共享;在实现通用数字中频的工作中;DSP程序的扩容需求逐步增大。针对上述问题;本文提供一种按需加载的DSP程序扩容方法;这种方法可以根据需要加载不同的DSP函数;相当于对DSP的内存进行了扩容。这种方法减少了加载时间;并且不必保证DSP程序的运行速度。本方法适用于TI公司、ADI公司以及目前国产化DSP;型号不限于TMS320C6713、TMS320C6416、TMS320C6455、TMS320C6678等。
keywords: dsp, program expansion, tms320c6713

title: 基于ZigBee的多功能电子门牌设计
abstract: For the traditional door sign curing the board;and the door sign can not change the information in real-time and other problems;this paper designs a multifunctional electronic door sign based on ZigBee.The design includes data acquisition;transmission;and processing analysis modules.The system adopts ZigBee wireless sensor network and ESP8266 Wi-Fi module as the communication means;uses CC2530 chip as the main body;collects data through human body identification module and temperature and humidity collection module;and finally displays the received data on the LCD screen to achieve the status of the door sign at any time to change;detect the temperature and humidity information around the door sign;display the current time information and save energy and many other functions.This design not only enhances the intelligence and informatization of the door sign system;but also can be customized according to the individual needs of users;thus solving many problems of traditional door signs such as board curing and lagging information and improving the convenience and comfort of people’s daily life and office.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统门牌固化了板式;且门牌无法实时改变信息等问题;本文设计了一种基于ZigBee的多功能电子门牌;本设计包括数据的采集、传输及处理分析模块。系统采用ZigBee无线传感网络及ESP8266 Wi-Fi模块作为通信手段;利用CC2530芯片作为主体;通过人体识别模块及温湿度采集模块对数据进行采集;最终在LCD屏幕显示接收到的数据;达到随时更改门牌的状态、检测门牌周边温湿度信息、显示当前时间信息及节约能源等多种功能。本设计不仅增强了门牌系统的智能化与信息化;更能根据使用者的个性需求进行定制;从而解决了传统门牌所存在的板式固化、信息滞后等诸多问题;提高了人们日常生活与办公的便利性与舒适性。
keywords: multi-function, wireless transmission, zigbee

title: Research on Wireless Temperature and Humidity Data Acquisition and Storage Module Based on ZigBee and CC2530
abstract: In this paper; a wireless communication module based on wireless sensing and storage is designed for environmental monitoring and control of some process-dependent activities. It mainly conducts temperature and humidity measurement; and collects temperature and humidity data with temperature and humidity sensor DHT11. The system uses ZigBee protocol stack and takes CC2530 as data processing core to realize wireless transmission of data; and uses STC12C5A60S2 single-chip microcomputer and USB2.0 controller CH376 chip to achieve massive data storage. The system has high reliability; low price and strong scalability; and it has broad application prospect and practical value in grain storage and environmental monitoring.
keywords: cc2530, ch376, data storage, dht11, stc12c5a60s2, wireless communication

title: 不同SPWM波形生成算法及其实现
abstract: 本文介绍了对称规则采样法、不对称规则采样法和等效面积法三种不同PWM波形生成算法的运用情况;基于TMS320LF2407在线生成TMS320LF2407波形;通过实地测验可见不同算法运用特征不一;对称规则采样法采集SPWM波形较为方便快捷;速度较快;运用等效面积法采集SPWM波形对称性良好;精密度较高;输出波形谐波小;采用不对称规则法进行SPWM波形采样;运用性能位于对称规则采样法、等效面积法两者之间;变频技术结合实际情况灵活选择运用SPWM波形生成算法。
keywords: spwm波形生成算法, tms320lf2407, 输出波形
affiliations: 泸州职业技术学院

title: Study on Multi-axis Motion Control System Based on TMS320F2812 DSP
abstract: According to the requirement of open motion control;applying TMS320 F2812 Digital Signal Processor as the control core;the multi-axis motion control system is designed based on SCI asynchronous serial communication.The system can realize the motor location;rotation;reverse rotation;and the multisubdivision control.At the same time;two axis interpolation algorithms can be tested in theory;building foundations for the multi-axis linkage.Experiments show that the system hardware and software design is reasonable and practicable;realizing the complex control algorithms with well performance and expected control effects.
keywords: dsp, motion control, serial communication, stepper motor
affiliations: School of Electrical Engineering and Automation,Henan Institute of Technology
