title: Design of selecting geometric parameters of components based on multi-layer fuzzy control
abstract: The traditional selection system does not consider the content of parameter control;which leads to lower accuracy of geometric parameters selection of single and multiple components. In order to avoid this problem;a design system for the selection of geometric parameters of components based on multi-layer fuzzy control is proposed. Analyze the function of each module according to the total system architecture. Design the system hardware structure;select TMS320F2812 digital signal processor;and convert the signal from analog domain to digital domain. Using 45 BF003 stepper motor;the excitation signal can be converted into the corresponding angular or linear displacement value. According to the multi-layer fuzzy controller;two control modes are set. Without considering the special requirements of coordinated control;the reasoning rules for design parameter demand strength are designed;and the geometric parameters of the components are selected according to the rules to realize the system design of the geometric parameters of the components. From the system test results;it is known that the accuracy of the geometric parameter selection of single and multiple components of the system can reach 91% and88% respectively;providing equipment for centralized control of components.
keywords: component geometry, digital signal processor, multi-layer fuzzy control, parameter selection
affiliations: Zhejiang SEOKHO Robot Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Four-sided ranging underground personnel positioning system based on RSSI
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inaccurate personnel positioning in coal mine; a mine positioning system based on quadrilateral ranging algorithm is designed. The system adopts ZigBee technology and consists of wireless sensor network with CC2530 as the main control chip. In the localization module; the sensor node is composed of a mesh network topology; which has the function of information collection; transmission and positioning. Firstly; The positioning algorithm adopts a four-sided ranging positioning algorithm which is different from the traditional three-sided ranging algorithm. The algorithm firstly selects four beacon nodes with the four-sided ranging model. Then USES the weighted mean model to process the RSSI value collected from the same node. Finally; the square of the distance converted from the RSSI value is used as the weighting factor to obtain the unknown node location coordinates. The four-side ranging positioning system has more advantages than the traditional three-side ranging positioning system with higher positioning accuracy and real-time positioning.
keywords: cc2530, mesh network, quadrilateral ranging algorithm, real time positioning, rssi, zigbee
affiliations: Henan Key Laboratory of Optoelectronic Sensing Integrated Application,Henan Normal University, College of Electronic and Electrical Engineering

title: Development of CANopen Communication Function for Wind Power Converter Control System
abstract: The intelligence of wind power system is an important trend; so the development of an independent; flexible and open converter communication system becomes an important task.CANopen communication has the advantages of simple hardware structure; strong anti-interference ability; and high real-time performance; so it is widely used in the field of industrial control.This paper developed CANopen communication function based on the CAN（Controller Area Network） module of TMS320F28377D;so that it could be used in wind power control systems with PLC（Programmable Logic Controller） as the main controller.Finally; the reliability and accuracy of the developed communication function were verified through experiments.
keywords: can, canopen, converter, plc
authors: WU Xiaotian;BIAN Xiaoguang;PU Xiaomin;HE Shengpeng;ZHOU Honglin
affiliations: DEC Academy of Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of low-power wireless smoke alarm
abstract: The traditional smoke alarm has the problems of high power consumption and cannot be interconnected; so it is difficult to meet the requirements of practical applications. This paper designed a low-power wireless smoke alarm; using a lowpower; low-voltage special integrated circuit RE46 C190 for photoelectric smoke detector and an ultra-low-power wireless single-chip CC1310 less than 1 GHz; so that the system standby current is about 14 μA; the theoretical standby life is up to 11 years; and the wireless communication distance reaches 1 km. It satisfactorily meets the requirements of low power consumption and wireless interworking; and provides a new solution for smart fire protection research.
keywords: low power consumption, smoke alarm, wireless communication
affiliations: School of Instrumentation Science and Optoelectronic Engineering,Beijing Information Science and Technology University

title: Research on Catenary Inductive Electricity Warning System with Wireless Monitoring
abstract: In order to ensure the power quality of the contact network power supply; a set of inductive measurement wireless monitoring system for the live state of the contact line was designed.The system used COMSOL to build a simulation model of the electrostatic capacitance space sensor circuit; analyzed the potential distribution characteristics of the single-line contact network and derived the voltage mapping relationship at all levels of the measurement device.The TMS320 F28377 minimum system board was used with OPA2171;CC2530 and other peripheral circuit modules to collect contact line voltage signals.Under the strong interference of the simulated WiFi environment; an HMM-based algorithm was proposed to reduce the ZigBee network packet loss rate; and sent the voltage data to the host computer to realize the remote access to the contact line voltage information by the railway bureau monitoring center.The experiment proves that the device has high accuracy grade and good dynamic range; and has the ability to select the optimal channel when the channels overlap.
keywords: channel interference, dsp, inductive, matlab, voltage measurement, zigbee network
authors: WANG Tian;CHEN Tian-yu;WANG Yu;WANG Si-hua;ZHOU Li-jun
affiliations: College of Automation ＆ Electrical Engineering, Lanzhou Jiaotong University,Rail Transit Electrical Automation Engineering Laboratory of Gansu Province

title: Design and research of vehicle motor controller forPMSM based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In order to optimize the performance of the permanent magnet synchronous motor controller for electric vehicles and enhance the real-time control; a set of permanent magnet synchronous motor（PMSM） controllers for electric vehicles with a floating-point TMS320 F28335 digital signal processor（DSP） as the control core is designed Using the vectorized control technology with id=0 as the permanent magnet synchronous motor control strategy; the motor control model is established; the hardware circuit and control program are designed according to the model; and the control effect of the controller is verified by experiments. Experiments show that the controller has fast response speed; small speed fluctuation and overshoot; ideal control effect; and good dynamic and static response characteristics.
keywords: control strategy, digital signal processor（dsp）, hardware design, permanent magnet synchronous motor（pmsm）, vector controller
affiliations: Aeronautics computing technology research institute

title: Application of TMS320F28379D in Synchronous Control of Dual Motors
abstract: In dual motor synchronous system; it is necessary to transfer the key control parameters to keep its synchronous operation. However; using the common communication bus to transmit information will cause transmission delay; which will affect the synchronization precision. In order to realize the high precision synchronous control of dual motors; a method to realize the synchronous control of dual motors based on TMS320 F28379 D chip with dual CPUs was presented. Firstly; the IPC communication of dual CPUs was designed to avoid the delay of information exchange. Then; the current detection circuit was simplified by using SDFM module of the chip. Finally; different control strategies were proposed for different scenarios of motor operation. Experiments show that this method can realize synchronous control of two servo motors. And it is foreseeable that the chip can be used to achieve up to 4 motor synchronous operation.
keywords: dual-motor, foc（field-oriented control）, ipc（inter-processor communication）, pmsm（permanent magnetic synchronous machine）, synchronous control

title: Design of a High-speed Real-time Video Processing System Based on FPGA and DSP
abstract: A high performance video real-time processing system based on FPGA and DSP is designed.K7 series FPGA chip of Xilinx company is used as the core controller;and TMS320 C6455 of TI company is used as the graphics processor.The high-speed video data is received through Camera Link Bus;and the video is cached in the 64-bit wide external dynamic memory constructed by4 pieces of DDR3-SDRAM.At the same time;according to the frame position of the received video;the interrupt is sent to DSP;and the DSP reads the video data from DDR3 for real-time processing by means of DMA.The experimental results show that the system can stably realize the real-time video tracking algorithm with 1280×1024 resolution;8 bit width and 520 fps frame rate.

title: Vibration Signal Acquisition and Edge Computing System Design Based on Digital Signal Processor
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high occupation of network bandwidth; storage space; and computing resource; as well as high communication cost caused by large data throughput as multi-channel and high-frequency sampling in vibration signal condition monitoring of mechanical equipment; an 8-channel signal acquisition and edge computing system was designed to complete vibration signal acquisition and preliminary processing of signals at the edge based on TMS320 F28335 digital signal processor. Hardware of the system was designed based on main components of the system including micro electro mechanical system accelerometers; AD7606 analog-to-digital conversion sampling chip; and CH395 L ethernet hardware protocol stack chip. Deployment of edge computing algorithm was realized in the system by using sub-band coding technology. The results show that the system can effectively collect vibration signals of mechanical equipment. The edge computing method based on sub-band coding increases information density of vibration signals. The system calculation results show health status of the machine; which can be effectively used for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of mechanical equipment.

title: 基于ZigBee和CC2530的无线温湿度数据采集和存储模块研究
abstract: In this paper; a wireless communication module based on wireless sensing and storage is designed for environmental monitoring and control of some process-dependent activities. It mainly conducts temperature and humidity measurement; and collects temperature and humidity data with temperature and humidity sensor DHT11. The system uses ZigBee protocol stack and takes CC2530 as data processing core to realize wireless transmission of data; and uses STC12C5A60S2 single-chip microcomputer and USB2.0 controller CH376 chip to achieve massive data storage. The system has high reliability; low price and strong scalability; and it has broad application prospect and practical value in grain storage and environmental monitoring.

title: 基于CC2530无线火灾报警系统的设计
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of traditional fire alarm system;a ZigBee wireless fire monitoring and alarm system based on CC2530 as the core control chip is designed. The hardware design and software control of the whole system is introduced in detail. Through many tests;the system has the advantages of stable performance;low power consumption;good scalability;convenient maintenance and low cost;which can be widely used in various environmental fire monitoring.

title: 低功耗无线烟雾报警器的设计
abstract: The traditional smoke alarm has the problems of high power consumption and cannot be interconnected; so it is difficult to meet the requirements of practical applications. This paper designed a low-power wireless smoke alarm; using a lowpower; low-voltage special integrated circuit RE46 C190 for photoelectric smoke detector and an ultra-low-power wireless single-chip CC1310 less than 1 GHz; so that the system standby current is about 14 μA; the theoretical standby life is up to 11 years; and the wireless communication distance reaches 1 km. It satisfactorily meets the requirements of low power consumption and wireless interworking; and provides a new solution for smart fire protection research.

title: Design of Digital High Frequency Q Meter
abstract: A digital high-frequency Q-meter is designed to generate adjustable high-frequency signal based on AD9958. After current expansion by BUF634; it carries out partial voltage impedance transformation and is added into LC resonant circuit. The 24 bit high-precision analog-to-digital converter ADS1256 collects the true RMS of input and output; and is input into STM32 F4 to calculate and display the loop inductance; harmonic frequency; Q value and other parameters. The test results show that the digital high frequency Q-meter has the advantages of high measurement accuracy and simple operation compared with the traditional mechanical Q-meter.
keywords: ads1256, digital high frequency q-meter, impedance transformation, stm32f4

title: The Design of Multi-channel Thermocouple Temperature Measurement Circuit
abstract: In this paper; a multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement system is designed for the heat treatment furnace and product temperature distribution during thermal processing. The system applies the multiplexer HCF4052 to realize the control of multi-channel measurement; and realizes the USB transmission and wireless transmission of data through the interface conversion chip T232 RL and the wireless transmission module CC3200. Experimental results have proved that the multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement circuit can reach a measurement accuracy of 1℃ in the temperature range of（0-1600）℃.
keywords: cold junction compensation, multi-channel temperature measurement, thermocouple

title: Design of Intelligent Security System for College Dormitory Based on ZigBee Network
abstract: Aiming at the intelligent demand of college dormitory security management; this paper designs an intelligent security system for college dormitory based on ZigBee network. The system uses STM32 and CC2530 microcontrollers as the core control modules of the back-end control gateway and hardware nodes of the system; respectively. The hardware node transmits the real-time monitoring environment and security data collected by the sensor to the back-end control gateway through the ZigBee network; and triggers the alarm mechanism in the case of abnormal data; so as to realize the purpose of intelligent management of college dormitory security.
keywords: cc2530, college dormitory, security monitoring, stm32, zigbee

title: Design and implementation of intelligent campus fire warning system
abstract: In view of the deficiency of the existing campus fire monitoring method that can not collect information dynamically in real time; this paper designs a campus fire monitoring system based on CC2530. The function and structure of the fire monitoring system are introduced; and then the system hardware and software are introduced. The experimental testing results of the system show that the upper computer management platform of the server can accurately monitor the environmental temperature; humidity and smoke concentration in real time; providing a real-time and effective method to reduce and avoid fire accidents.

title: Design of Medical Instrument Warehouse Wireless Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: The storage condition of medical instruments is strict; so aiming at the particularity of medical instrument storage; a wireless monitoring system for medical instrument warehouse was designed. With ZigBee chip CC2530 as the main controller; the main control chip; DHT21 digital temperature and humidity sensor and MQ-2 smoke sensor constitute a star topology wireless network structure with the central hub as the center. Through serial communication; the environmental monitoring information was transmitted to the computer terminal equipment; and the environmental monitoring information was transmitted to the computer terminal equipment; and then to the mobile phone terminal through the ESP8266 WiFi module. The system can make alarm response to abnormal conditions in time. The experimental data show that the wireless monitoring system can quickly obtain real-time environmental data; and its performance is stable and reliable. It is a low-power and high-efficiency wireless monitoring system.
keywords: esp8266, medical instrument, wireless monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: Huali College, Guangdong University of Technology, Guangzhou Huantai Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Design of Embedded Piston-temperature Test System for Engine
abstract: In view of the fact that there is no effective means to measure engine piston temperature;this paper designed one feasible embedded piston-temperature testing system.By selecting K-type thermocouple as temperature sensor and combining AD590 with output compensation voltage of one 2.5 Vreference voltage source;it further compensated thermocouple cold-end temperature accordingly.In addition;it adjusted AD8495 set-point voltage under present temperature to output rising edge for achieving function of adjustable trigger temperature.After collecting temperature data upon 3 test points on top of piston via embedded Analog-to-digital converter（ADC）under control of PIC single chip;it turns out this system can send all test results to receiving platform of upper computer via CC2530.Before test;the entire system was also calibrated within high-temperature cabinet.After completing a series of comparisons between actually-tested values and calibrated ones;subsequent tests upon engine bench would be conducted.And these actually-tested results show that test accuracy of the system can reach±1 ℃.It can normally operate even in high temperature environment up to 130℃;demonstrating better stability and reliability.
keywords: piston for engine, storage test, temperature test, wireless communication

title: Research on Farmland Environmental Factor Acquisition System Based on WSN
abstract: Based on WSN; a farmland environmental factor collection system is designed. The main parameters collected by the system are air temperature and humidity; soil moisture and other environmental data; which are suitable for farmland environmental monitoring. The system adopts Zig Bee wireless communication mode; the Zig Bee module adopts the SOC chip of TI company CC2530; the collection of air temperature and humidity is achieved by temperature and humidity sensor DHT11; and the collection of soil moisture is realized by soil moisture sensor YL-69. This system has the advantages of low power consumption; low cost; large network capacity and easy expansibility.
keywords: cc2530, soil moisture sensor, temperature and humidity sensor, wsn, zigbee technology

title: Design of infrared methane detector based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the dermand of methane concentration dynamic monitoring in the new generation of fire safety facilities;a methane gas detection system based on infrared methane sensor is designed by using ZigBee technology. The front-end input of the system is equipped with low-noise operational amplifier with high-precision A/D; supplemented by White chamber structure to increase the optical path;and meanwhile the software adopts a variety of compensation and fitting algorithms to eliminate the interference of complex environment. The wireless signal processing method based on CC2530 chip could effectively avoid the occlusion in the regional ad hoc network. The results show that the infrared methane detector runs stably;and the anti-occlusion performance is improved by more than 80%;and the dynamic range of the detection system can meet the requirements of methane detection in practical application.
keywords: lna, ndir, white cell, zigbee

title: Design of multi-objective uncertainty measurement system based on double-sided tolerance limit
abstract: The traditional multi-objective uncertainty measurement system has a long measurement time and a poor measurement process robustness. In order to solve the above problems;a multi-objective uncertainty measurement system based on bilateral tolerance limit is designed. The hardware of the system includes analog signal generator;data acquisition device;main control unit and human-computer interface. DM3730 processor is selected to process the measurement content. The system software analyzes the characteristics of products;such as look at the small;look at the big;and puts forward the corresponding quality loss function for each product characteristic. The upper and lower limits of bilateral tolerance are determined according to the constraints and objective functions;and the measurement is completed by combining bilateral tolerance and genetic algorithm. The experimental results show that the multi-objective uncertainty measurement system based on the bilateral tolerance limit can effectively shorten the measurement time and improve the measurement stability.
keywords: bilateral tolerance limit, measurement system, multi-objective, uncertainty
affiliations: Inner Mongolia Wulanchabu Product Quality Measurement and Testing Institute

title: 基于zigbee智能无线温湿度采集系统设计
abstract: 随着计算机控制技术的发展迅速;传统的有线传感器网络已经不能满足工业生产的需求;针对传统温湿度检测存在的问题;结合无线传感器网络技术;本文提出在zigbee协议栈的基础上进行应用开发;实现室内点对点温度的采集;解决了传统情况下有线连接给人们的生活到来的诸多不便;并通过实验测试表明;该无线温湿度采集系统运行稳定、组网简单、功耗低、成本低;有良好的实用价值和经济效益。

title: 基于物联网的汽车智能管理系统的开发与设计
abstract: 本文阐述了整个智能汽车管理系统所需要的关键理论技术即Zigbee技术设计智能汽车管理系统;研究z-stck协议栈;通过移植协议栈的方式将其转移到cc2530芯片;进一步实现Zigbee模块;无线数据通信;并且使用GD32F107嵌入主控芯片;可设计Zigbee协议和TCP/IP协议的无缝转换;利用C语言编程以实现芯片外围设备驱动;同时可利用OBD模块连接汽车CAN总线;可解析ECU汽车数据;能够为汽车企业提供工艺优化思路。通过对基于物联网的汽车智能管理系统进行反复测试;该系统能够实现对汽车实时数据的远程监控;实时监测汽车运行数据;针对汽车存在的异常数据能及时通过该系统反馈给用户;以提升汽车的安全性;且具有易于移植和良好的通用性;能够在安卓操作平台中使用;该系统具有较高的市场应用价值。

title: New Method for DSP Reconstruction and Immune Single Particle Flip
abstract: According to the problems of joint test action group（JTAG） being not used during on-orbit satellite controller reconstruction and being difficult to update DSP program due to the limitation of working environment;taking digital signal processing（DSP） TMS320 F28335 as an example; a scheme of online reconstruction DSP controller through serial port is proposed. Because the DSP controller may be knocked over by a single particle while the satellite is in orbit; a method of redundancy of the master control program and periodic or instruction reconstruction of the master program to reduce the possibility of invalid of the controller due to the flip of the single particle is proposed. Experimental results show that the method is simple and suitable; stable and reliable operation; and easy to operate; which can realize the reconstruction program of DSP TMS320 F28335 take over the controller after power on; solve the problem of reconstruction of DSP in orbit; and greatly reduce the possibility of being knocked over by single particle. It can be applied to the commercial aerospace embedded field.
keywords: on-orbit reconstruction, reconstruction booting program, single particle inversion, tms320f28335

title: Design of Ship Engine Room Environmental Monitoring System Based on Z-Stack Protocol Stack
abstract: A monitoring system based on Z-Stack protocol stack is designed; aiming to improve the security in ship engine room and solve the problems in traditional wired monitoring pattern; such as difficulty in wiring; high cost and poor scalability. Owing to its advantages of automatic combination of Zigbee wireless network; flexibility and low power consumption; the system can constitute network nodes on the basis of CC2530 radio-frequency module; by which the sensor node transmits the acquired parameters such as temperature; humidity; CO2 density and air velocity to a coordinator directly or through a router; which in turn transmits to the monitoring interface of the slave computer and thus to indicate and record the real-time values. The test results show that the characteristics of low power consumption; high stability and superior develop ability meet the requirement for the real-time monitoring and data precision; and provide some referenced value for the research on ship automation improvement.
keywords: cc2530, ship engine room, wireless sensor networks, z-stack protocol stack

title: Design of three-phase software phase locked loop based on prefilter
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large phase-locked error and slow dynamic response of traditional SPLL(Software Phase Locked Loop) under unbalanced and distorted voltage;a prefilter SPLL based on MAF(Moving Average Filter) is proposed;which is based on the principle of traditional SPLL. A fast unbalanced component suppression and phase delay compensation method is applied to improve the performance of MAF;which effectively improves the dynamic response speed and phase-locked accuracy of the proposed SPLL. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform and TMS320 F28335 DSP(Digital Signal Processor) chip;the control strategy of the proposed SPLL is verified under the condition of three-phase voltage unbalance and voltage distortion. The results show that the SPLL has small phase-locked error;fast dynamic response speed and high stability.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统锁相环在电压不平衡及畸变时锁相误差大、动态响应速度慢的问题，根据软件锁相环（SPLL）的原理提出一种滑动滤波器（MAF）前置锁相环，并通过一种快速不平衡分量抑制及相位延迟补偿的方法来改善MAF性能，有效提高了锁相环的动态响应速度和锁相精度。通过MATLAB/Simulink仿真平台及TMS320F28335数字信号处理器芯片对所提出的锁相环控制策略在三相电压不平衡及电压畸变的条件下进行验证，结果表明该SPLL锁相误差小，动态响应速度快，稳定性高。
keywords: digital signal processor, moving average filter, phase delay compensation, software phase locked loop, voltage distortion
affiliations: 新疆大学电气工程学院教育部可再生能源发电与并网控制工程技术研究中心, 伊犁师范大学电子与信息工程学院
source: 电力自动化设备 ;Electric Power Automation Equipment ; Editorial E-mail

title: 基于ZigBee技术的数据采集终端设计
abstract: ZigBee technology has the advantages of "ad-hoc network; low power consumption; wireless transmission" and so on. It is widely applied in the occasions including data acquisition; medium-range communication; etc. Building network by adopting ZigBee can effectively avoid the disadvantages of wired data transmission. This paper designs an easy-to-use data acquisition terminal based on CC2530 chip; which supports RS485; single bus and other interfaces; and can collect data such as temperature;humidity and so on.
abstract_in_chinese: ZigBee技术具有"自组网、低功耗、无线传输"等优点;广泛应用于数据采集、中距离通信等场合;采用ZigBee搭建网络可以有效避免有线数据传输的弊端。本研究设计了一种基于CC2530芯片的数据采集终端;支持RS485、单总线等接口;能够采集温度、湿度等数据;具有使用方便的特点。
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition, zigbee

title: 基于ZigBee的医用仪器仓库无线监测系统设计
abstract: The storage condition of medical instruments is strict; so aiming at the particularity of medical instrument storage; a wireless monitoring system for medical instrument warehouse was designed. With ZigBee chip CC2530 as the main controller; the main control chip; DHT21 digital temperature and humidity sensor and MQ-2 smoke sensor constitute a star topology wireless network structure with the central hub as the center. Through serial communication; the environmental monitoring information was transmitted to the computer terminal equipment; and the environmental monitoring information was transmitted to the computer terminal equipment; and then to the mobile phone terminal through the ESP8266 WiFi module. The system can make alarm response to abnormal conditions in time. The experimental data show that the wireless monitoring system can quickly obtain real-time environmental data; and its performance is stable and reliable. It is a low-power and high-efficiency wireless monitoring system.
abstract_in_chinese: 医用仪器对存储条件要求苛刻;故针对医用仪器存储的特殊性;设计了一套医疗仪器仓库无线监测系统。以ZigBee芯片CC2530为主控器;将主控芯片与DHT21数字温湿度传感、MQ-2烟雾传感器组成以中央集线器为中心的星型拓扑无线网络结构;通过串口通信;将环境监测信息传输至计算机终端设备;通过ESP8266 WiFi模块传送到移动电话终端;该系统能对异常情况及时做出报警响应。经实验数据证明;该无线监测系统能快速获取环境实时数据;性能稳定可靠;是一款低功耗、高效率的无线监测系统。
keywords: esp8266, medical instrument, wireless monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: 广东工业大学华立学院, Guangdong University of Technology, 广州欢泰技术有限公司, Guangzhou Huantai Technology Co.

title: 基于系统芯片SOC的NOC通信组网技术应用研究
abstract_in_chinese: 新一代SOC能在单芯片上集成完整的电子系统;NOC是全新的片上网络结构集成电路;其分布式的设计特点在农业物联网领域取得了很好的应用;本文使用CC2530芯片作为Zigbee通信模块建立无线传感器网络;有效的提高了分时通信效率;降低了分布式网络节点全局同步时的能量消耗。
affiliations: 湖南科技学院电子与信息工程学院, 湖南科技学院传媒学院

title: 多路热电偶测温电路设计
abstract: In this paper; a multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement system is designed for the heat treatment furnace and product temperature distribution during thermal processing. The system applies the multiplexer HCF4052 to realize the control of multi-channel measurement; and realizes the USB transmission and wireless transmission of data through the interface conversion chip T232 RL and the wireless transmission module CC3200. Experimental results have proved that the multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement circuit can reach a measurement accuracy of 1℃ in the temperature range of(0-1600)℃.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文针对热加工过程中热处理炉以及产品温度分布采集问题;设计了一种多路热电偶测温系统。该系统利用复用器HCF4052实现多路测量通道的控制;通过接口转换芯片T232RL以及无线传输模块CC3200实现数据的USB传输与无线传输。实验证明;多路热电偶测温电路在0～1600℃温度范围内可以达到1℃的测量精度。
keywords: cold junction compensation, multi-channel temperature measurement, thermocouple
affiliations: 北京长城计量测试技术研究所, Beijing Great Wall Institute of Metrology and Testing Technology

title: 激光位移测量试验系统设计
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and stability of one-dimensional position sensor detector(PSD) laser micro displacement measurement; a displacement measurement experiment system is designed. The system uses PSD as the displacement detection sensor. The current to voltage(I/V) signal conditioning circuit is designed with OPA211 low noise operational amplifier. The single chip microcomputer STM32 F103 is used as the controller to control the moving laser light source by the stepping motor slide; and the ADS1256 is used to collect displacement signal. The automatic displacement and displacement measurement system is realized. The experimental results show that the system has a good linearity in the range of 0-14 mm; the displacement measurement error is small; and the measurement error dose not exceed ±20 μm.
abstract_in_chinese: 为提高一维位置敏感器PSD激光微位移测量的精度和稳定性;设计位移测量试验系统。系统采用PSD作为位移检测传感器;使用OPA211低噪运算放大器设计电流转电压(I/V)信号调理电路;以单片机STM32F103为控制器;控制步进电机滑台移动激光光源;采用ADS1256采集位移信号;实现自动位移及位移测量系统。试验测量结果表明;该系统在0～14 mm范围内具有较好的线性;位移测量误差小;测量误差不超过±20μm。
keywords: automatic displacement, current to voltage circuit, displacement measurement, psd
affiliations: 陕西理工大学机械工程学院, Shaanxi University of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering Department, School of Mechanical Engineering department, 陕西理工大学物理与电信工程学院, School of Physics and Telecommunication Engineering Department, 陕西理工大学电气工程学院

title: 基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统设计
abstract: The traditional multi-objective uncertainty measurement system has a long measurement time and a poor measurement process robustness. In order to solve the above problems;a multi-objective uncertainty measurement system based on bilateral tolerance limit is designed. The hardware of the system includes analog signal generator;data acquisition device;main control unit and human-computer interface. DM3730 processor is selected to process the measurement content. The system software analyzes the characteristics of products;such as look at the small;look at the big;and puts forward the corresponding quality loss function for each product characteristic. The upper and lower limits of bilateral tolerance are determined according to the constraints and objective functions;and the measurement is completed by combining bilateral tolerance and genetic algorithm. The experimental results show that the multi-objective uncertainty measurement system based on the bilateral tolerance limit can effectively shorten the measurement time and improve the measurement stability.
abstract_in_chinese: 传统的多目标不确定度计量系统计量时间较长;计量过程稳健性较差。为了解决上述问题;设计了基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统。系统硬件设计了模拟信号发生器、数据采集装置、主控单元和人机交互界面;选用DM3730处理器处理计量内容。系统软件分析了产品的望目特性、望小特性、望大特性;针对每一个产品特性提出了相应的质量损失函数。根据约束条件和目标函数确定双侧公差上限和双侧公差下限;结合双侧公差限和遗传算法完成计量。实验结果表明;基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统可以有效缩短计量时间;计量稳健性较高。
keywords: bilateral tolerance limit, measurement system, multi-objective, uncertainty
affiliations: Inner Mongolia Wulanchabu Product Quality Measurement and Testing Institute, 内蒙古乌兰察布市产品质量计量检测所

title: Research and Implementation of Intelligent Basketball Counting System
abstract: In view of the difficulty in calculating the hit rate in shooting training and the fairness of campus sports basketball examination;this paper proposes an intelligent basketball counting system based on ZigBee network.The system uses CC2530 hardware chip to build sensor network through ZigBee technology;the network communication uses Socket technology to connect the master computer with the server;the server is built based on MVC three-tier architecture to interact with the user through the Web page.The system realizes the function of real-time monitoring and historical data inquiry of the number of goals;serve and hit rate of the long-distance shooting.The system has the advantages of low power consumption;low cost;simple operation;strong scalability;etc.;and has certain promotion and application value.
keywords: basketball counting, infrared antitube, real-time, web, winform, z-stack, zigbee
affiliations: College of Computer and Communication Engineering,Zhengzhou University of Light Industry

title: Risk Analysis and Early Warning System for Underground Utility Tunnel
abstract: The risk analysis and early warning system for underground utility tunnel is introduced.The perception layer is based on the sensor network.The software defined network（SDN） technology based on CC2650 chip is used for communication layer.Huawei Cloud visualization platform as the data display platform is taken for application layer.The system realizes the automatic acquisition; intelligent transmission and information management of the utility tunnel.
keywords: application layer, communication layer, perception layer, risk analysis and early warning system, utility tunnel
authors: LUO Yuqiu;ZHANG Yang;QIU Shiyin;JIN Yong;GENG Pan
affiliations: Shanghai Maritime University

title: Design of wireless monitoring device for dangerous dated buildings
abstract: As the dangerous dated buildings are becoming more and more common in urban suburbs and rural areas;which causes serious security risks;a monitoring device for ZigBee and GSM wireless communication is designed. In this device;the CC2530 of Zigbee communication is used as the core control unit to collect the important structural environmental parameters such as inclination angle;stress;temperature and humidity of dangerous dated houses;and complete the transmission of local area network. The SIM900 A module of GSM communication is used to complete the remote early warning of data alarm information. The experiments of the actual IoT communication networking and the data acquisition and display were performed.The results show that the monitoring device of dangerous dated house can effectively collect the structured data of dangerous dated house;and accurately reflect the current state of dangerous dated house.
keywords: dangerous dated house, data collection, experimental verification, remote alarm, wireless communication, wireless monitoring
affiliations: School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering,Chengdu University, Sichuan Guoxiang Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Agricultural Greenhouse Automation and Monitoring System Based on Wireless Networking
abstract: In order to solve the monitoring problems of the four environmental parameters of light; gas; air temperature and soil humidity in the greenhouse and realize the automation of the greenhouse control; this paper designs a wireless networking monitoring system based on the microcontroller C2530 and uses O2 to monitor The module JXM-O2; NDIR infrared CO2 detection module; BH1750 light intensity monitoring module; temperature and humidity monitoring module DHT11; capacitive soil humidity sensor module establishes a greenhouse temperature and humidity monitoring system; which effectively solves the low measurement accuracy existing in traditional greenhouses. Problems such as high product prices; cumbersome wiring; and waste of labor resources. The wireless sensor network is established through the ZigBee communication protocol; which can realize the data communication between the microcontroller cc2530 and the host computer cc2530. The WiFi module of the host computer can achieve the goal of data communication between the mobile phone APP or the computer terminal and the host computer; and achieve the goal of data communication through the relay Switch on and off the drip irrigation; exhaust fan; warm light and other external equipment.
keywords: data monitoring, electronic design, zigbee
authors: XU Tao;WANG Juan;SONG Shengfa;HUO Jianzhen;LIN Shanqing
affiliations: School of Automation and Electrical Engineering,Linyi University

title: Research on Hybrid Pulse Width Modulation Strategy Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: The traction inverter is limited by the switching frequency;and the motor current contains rich harmonics.Current harmonics can cause serious motor heating;large system losses;and can also cause motor torque ripple;affecting motor control performance.In order to achieve the symmetry of the output pulse voltage of the inverter in the full speed range and reduce the impact of low-order harmonics on the system;the principle of selective harmonic elimination pulse width modulation（SHEPWM） is analyzed through in-depth analysis of specific harmonics.A hybrid pulse width modulation（PWM） method based on TMS320F28377 D is proposed;which realizes the smooth switching of each modulation mode.This method can satisfy the control algorithm and modulation mode running independently in two cores of a CPU;which improves the reliability and high efficiency;can effectively reduce low-order harmonics;improve system efficiency;simplify digital implementation.It has certain engineering significance.The simulation and experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the hybrid PWM strategy and switching method proposed.
keywords: hybrid pulse width modulation, low-order harmonics, motor
affiliations: CRRC Dalian R＆D Co.,Ltd.

title: 改进线性PID算法的直流电机控制
abstract: ＜正＞直流电机和步进电机的运行特点不同;通过设置步进电机的运转步数来控制转过的角度;而直流电机不能直接精确地实现旋转角度的控制。通常会将电位计和直流电机配合使用;电位计的电位值和电机旋转角度是一一映射关系;通过采集指示直流电机旋转角度的电位值反馈控制直流电机旋转的角度。处理器选择TI的DSP的2000系列处理器TMS320F28335。
affiliations: 中国兵器工业第214研究所

title: 基于ZigBee+GPRS的智慧校园监测系统设计
abstract: 针对目前高校规模越来越大以及校园安全隐患难以排查等问题;提出将Zigbee无线传感网络与GPRS长距离通信技术应用到校园监测系统中。采用以CC2530为核心搭建Zigbee无线传感网络;采集校园火灾、照明能耗和校园人员出入信息;并通过GPRS传输至移动终端和管理系统;实现对数据的存储、分析和显示;达到实时监测和正确决策的目标。
keywords: gprs, zigbee, 实时监测, 智慧校园
affiliations: 贵州商学院

title: Research and Design of Greenhouse Environment Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: The rapid and accurate acquisition of greenhouse environmental information is the basis of agricultural precise control. This paper studies and designs a greenhouse environment monitoring system based on ZigBee technology; using CC2530 microprocessor to control multi-sensor data acquisition and real-time collection of environmental parameters such as temperature and humidity; CO2 concentration and soil moisture in greenhouse. The data is transmitted and uploaded by ZigBee module to realize PC monitoring. By testing; the system has perfect function; low power consumption and stable performance; which can better improve the environment of greenhouse.
keywords: cc2530, greenhouse, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Information Institute of Media,Sanmenxia Polytechnic
source: Journal of Changzhou College of Information Technology.

title: Parellel Processing of Radar Seeker OCOG Altitude Measurement Algorithm Based on TMS320C6678
abstract: The relative altitude of radar platform and imaging areas is an important parameter that affects the accuracy of skew geometric correction in the process of SAR imaging; and the real-time is highly required for radar altitude measurement. Because the size of the hardware using traditional single-core processor is relatively large; requirement of small volume and light weight for missile-borne radar cannot be met. In this paper; a project based on TMS320 C6678 which is published by Texas Instruments（TI） was put forward to solve the above issue. Firstly; the principle of OCOG（Offset Center Of Gravity） altitude measurement algorithm was introduced; secondly; the hardware platform and implementation method of high-speed multi-core parallel processing is introduced; finally; the process was tested and measured to verify the real-time performance and effectiveness of altitude measurement results of the method proposed in this paper.
keywords: ocog altitude measurement, parallel processing, tms320c6678
affiliations: No.38 Research Institute of CETC

title: Design for A New Smart Home Control System Based on ZigBee Wireless Transmission Technology
abstract: This paper is designed smart home system based on wireless transmission; apply TI CC2530 as ZigBee core hardware to design its nodes; the system has four main functions: lighting control; environmental monitoring; health monitoring and security. The function of physiological parameter monitoring as the most important and hot topic in the smart home field is involved in this paper; and related hardware system is selected to realize the function; and the optimized routing algorithm is run and related software flow is designed in the system. Finally; built test platform and verify the improvement algorithm though simulation testing; and the system achieves the desired design goal.
keywords: control system, smart home, wireless transmission, zigbee
affiliations: Logistics Service Center, Kaifeng University

title: Reserch and Realization of CFAR Detection Method for Terminal Tracking of Missile-borne Radar
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of the terminal tracking algorithm of missile borne radar seeker;a dual threshold CFAR detection method based on range and Doppler is proposed. Simulation and measurement results show that under the condition of end tracking;compared with the traditional two-dimensional CFAR detection;the detection performance of this method is close;and the processing efficiency increased by about 68.19%;which provides a new idea for the engineering realization of CFAR detection.
keywords: cfar detection, missle-borne, range-doppler image, tms320c6678
affiliations: Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology

title: Design of landslide detection system based on MEMS acceleration sensor MPU-6050
abstract: In view of the problems existing in slope engineering monitoring; such as low monitoring accuracy; high cost and difficult field layout; the mountain displacement monitoring was taken as the main research object; a monitoring system based on MEMS micro electro mechanical monitoring technology was adopted; the advantages of MEMS acceleration sensor;such as high precision and small volume; were utilized; Zig Bee with CC2530 as the core was used to establish wireless network transmission; and identify the possibility of landslide. The simulation experiment was designed according to the deformation process of landslide; the experimental results show that the MEMS sensor can accurately collect data; and the relative error of detection was less than 2%; and the whole system has low power consumption and fast speed; and can well complete the landslide detection.
keywords: landslide detection, mems acceleration sensor, zigbee
affiliations: School of Safety Engineering, North China University of Science and Technology

title: Design of a Progressive Remote Control Precision Irrigation Device
abstract: To solve the problem that the amount of irrigation can not be controlled reasonably during crop irrigation; a progressive fixed-point precision remote control irrigation device is proposed to realize the functions of precision irrigation; remote control and alarm. Hardware implementation mainly includes metal box; central controller based on CC2530 chip; humidity acquisition equipment; irrigation equipment; wireless communication equipment; and alarm equipment; In the data acquisition and processing stage; firstly; through collecting data with humidity sensor and simulating soil penetration rate table; dynamic watering volume is adjusted; space time is reserved in the middle to wait for water infiltration; and then according to the updated humidity data; the amount of make-up water is automatically adjusted; so as to ensure that appropriate humidit can be adjusted to under the condition of no ponding to achieve accurate irrigation. Through the comparision experiments; the suitable humidity range of soil is obtained; and the apparent effects of segmented irrigation method on overall growth and resource consumption of plants are clarified. It can be concluded that the irrigation method shows a relative stability in the test; compared with the artificial watering operation; the practicality is improved and water consumption is decreased; and the segmented watering method effectively solves the problem of ponding. The irrigation system has good automation function; which can ensure the effect of watering operation; and lay the foundation for realizing large-scale irrigation operation.
keywords: congestion control model, embedded device, precision irrigation, remote control
affiliations: College of Information Technology, Jilin Agricultural University, Precision Agriculture and Big Data Engineering Center of Jilin Province, Institute of Smart Agriculture, Jilin Agricultural University

title: Design of Control System in Intelligent Pressure Glue Machine for Thermal Protection Structure of Motor
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems such as low automation degree;low production efficiency;human factors affecting more;and unstable bonding quality in the thermal protection structure bonding process of solid rocket motor nozzles;the measurement and control system of intelligent press glue machine for the thermal protection structure has been designed.Based on AM5718 DSP+ARM dual core processor development;combined with the interface board of servo drive and data acquisition;the system carries out the facility controlment as a whole by processing multi-axes precision motion control and gathering high precision signal;meanwhile the controlling difficulties and solutions are elaborated;The system adopts techniques such as motion control function method by means of tracking interpolation;Multi tolerance window matching control of pressure and displacement;proportional adjustment control technology to realize coating uniformity control;etc.To realize glue coating uniformity control;rotation exhaust pressure-holding control;precision pressure control in moulding process;Compared with the original processing method;the processing time is reduced by 65%;the rate of glue overflow is reduced by more than 85%;and the qualified rate of one-time bonding is increased by 25%.
keywords: intelligent, interpolation algorithm for motion control, multi-tolerance window control, press glue control, proportional control
authors: Wang Chao;Li Peipei;Bao Le;Wang Jingxian;Wang Xinde
affiliations: No.210 Institute of The Sixth Academy of China Aerospace Science ＆Industry Corporation, Xi’an WeiKong Automation Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of Hydrological Remote Sensing Monitoring System Based on CUAHSI-HIS
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low resolution of remote sensing images of the current hydrological remote sensing monitoring system;which causes the accuracy of hydrological remote sensing monitoring to decrease;a hydrological remote sensing monitoring system based on CUAHSI-HIS is proposed.In the hardware system design;according to the hydrological feature data deployment review content;the hardware operation modules are divided;the ARM single-chip microcomputer is selected as the hydrological remote sensing monitoring sensor;the AT91 SAM9 X35-CU microprocessor chip is used;and the information processing is completed through the CC2530 F256 RHAR microprocessing chip;and the power supply current is used to conduct transform hydrological information by means of characteristics;design system collection modules;and concentrate on compiling and collecting and monitoring hydrological characteristics within the basin.According to CUAHSI-HIS;adjust the hydrological data of the hydrological characteristics of the river basin;and manage the monitoring system software platform according to the adjusted hydrological data;strengthen the management of the platform;sort out the platform transformation information;and execute the software platform system transformation instructions.The experimental results show that the hydrological remote sensing monitoring system based on CUAHSIHIS has high resolution of remote sensing images and can effectively improve the monitoring accuracy.
keywords: cuahsi-his, hydrological remote sensing, monitoring system, remote sensing monitoring
affiliations: College of Physics ＆ Electronic Information,Yan’an University

title: Wireless Sensors and Networks for Real-Time Temperature Measurement of Materials in Microwave Heating
abstract: Microwave is a new type of clean energy source widely used in industrial applications. However; non-uniform heating caused by selective microwave heating and the difficulty of accurate online temperature measurement in microwave field limit the efficient design and application of microwave industrial equipment. To address these problems; a microwave heating temperature measurement system based on wireless sensor network and microcontroller technology is designed; which uses STM32 as microcontroller and CC1101 as wireless transceiver to form a star-type wireless sensor network. A simple upper computer display program to realize real-time temperature measurement at multiple points in microwave heating process is developed. The wireless sensor node（End Device） uses DS18 B20 digital temperature sensor to measure the node position temperature in real time and send data; and the central node（Access Point） receives the data and upload them to PC display through RS232 serial port. The measurement results of the system and the fiber optic thermometer results are compared to verify the feasibility and accuracy of the system. The system is low-cost and flexible in deployment and control; which is suitable for tunneling industrial microwave heating and other applications.
keywords: microwave heating, real-time temperature measurement, wireless sensor networks
authors: YANG Yang;TAO Rui;TAN Yu;ZHU Hua-cheng;HUANG Ka-ma
affiliations: College of Electronic and Information Engineering, Sichuan University

title: Design of Environment Monitoring and Early Warning System of Sheep House Based on Web
abstract: In view of the demand for intelligent environment monitoring and early warning for intensive sheep breeding; this study designs a real-time monitoring and early warning system for sheep house environment. The system achieves accurate collection of environmental parameters through CC2530 terminal node connected with temperature and humidity sensor; light sensor; etc.. It can carry out real-time monitoring of sheep house environment; and analyze; process and display the data. When the environmental parameters exceed the warning value; the system automatically alarms.
keywords: cc2530, environment monitoring, sheep house environment, video monitoring
affiliations: Department of Information Technology, Shenmu Vocational and Technical Education Center, College of Information Engineering, Yulin University

title: 基于三轴加速度计的振动筛运动状态采集装置的设计
abstract: A vibrating screen motion state information acquisition device is developed for effective detection of the operation state of the screen and providing for operation and maintenance reliable related parameters.The device operates with the ADXL 345 chip to measure the acceleration of the screen in X;Y;Z three directions and the data acquired is then transmitted to ATMEL 328 chip via LLC bus.The TTL level is converted into ZigBee to transmit to CC2530 using serial port transmission technology.Through analysis of the acceleration data by the central computer with VISA module function of LABVIEW software;and through both high and low pass filtering and two times integration;the data relating to amplitude;frequency;angle of direction and off-wobbling of the screen is obtained.Result of laboratory test shows with the use of the method;the running state of vibrating screen can be detected in a rapid and accurate manner;which plays a key role in early warning of fault of vibrating screen.
abstract_in_chinese: 为有效地监测振动筛的运行;给生产和维修提供可靠的设备状态参数;设计了一种振动筛运动状态采集装置。该装置采用ADXL345芯片测量振动筛在X、Y、Z三个方向的加速度;并将加速度数据通过IIC总线传输给ATMEL328P芯片;通过串口透传技术;将TTL电平转换成ZigBee传给CC2530转换发射;上位机利用LABVIEW软件的VISA模块功能对加速度数据分析;经过高低通滤波与两次积分得到振动筛的振幅、频率、方向角、偏摆等数据。测试结果表明:该设计能够快速准确地获得振动筛的运行状态;对振动筛的故障预警起到关键作用。
keywords: 3-axis accelerometer, adxl 345 chip, early warning of fault, monitoring of vibrating screen, screen box vibration amplitude, smart sensor
authors: 曹俊云;高鹏;杨硕;高勇;康宁

title: 一种弹载雷达末段跟踪CFAR检测方法研究与实现
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of the terminal tracking algorithm of missile borne radar seeker;a dual threshold CFAR detection method based on range and Doppler is proposed. Simulation and measurement results show that under the condition of end tracking;compared with the traditional two-dimensional CFAR detection;the detection performance of this method is close;and the processing efficiency increased by about 68.19%;which provides a new idea for the engineering realization of CFAR detection.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了提高弹载雷达导引头末段跟踪算法的实时性;提出了距离、多普勒两个维度联合目标检测的双门限CFAR检测方法。仿真与实测结果表明;末段跟踪条件下;与传统二维CFAR检测相比;该方法检测性能接近;处理效率提升约68.19%;为雷达恒虚警检测的工程实现提出了一条新思路。
keywords: cfar detection, missle-borne, range-doppler image, tms320c6678
affiliations: Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology, 中国西南电子技术研究所

title: 基于ZigBee的温室大棚环境监测系统研究设计
abstract: The rapid and accurate acquisition of greenhouse environmental information is the basis of agricultural precise control. This paper studies and designs a greenhouse environment monitoring system based on ZigBee technology; using CC2530 microprocessor to control multi-sensor data acquisition and real-time collection of environmental parameters such as temperature and humidity; CO2 concentration and soil moisture in greenhouse. The data is transmitted and uploaded by ZigBee module to realize PC monitoring. By testing; the system has perfect function; low power consumption and stable performance; which can better improve the environment of greenhouse.
abstract_in_chinese: 温室大棚环境信息的快速、准确获取是农业精准调控的基础。研究设计一套基于ZigBee技术的温室大棚环境监测系统;采用CC2530微处理器控制多传感器数据采集;对温室大棚内的温湿度、CO2浓度、土壤湿度等环境参数进行实时采集;并通过ZigBee模块将数据进行无线传输上传;实现主机PC监测。经过测试;该系统功能完善、功耗低、性能稳定;可以较好地改善温室大棚的环境。
keywords: cc2530, greenhouse, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Information Institute of Media, 三门峡职业技术学院信息传媒学院

title: 基于无线组网的农业大棚自动化与监测系统
abstract: In order to solve the monitoring problems of the four environmental parameters of light; gas; air temperature and soil humidity in the greenhouse and realize the automation of the greenhouse control; this paper designs a wireless networking monitoring system based on the microcontroller C2530 and uses O2 to monitor The module JXM-O2; NDIR infrared CO2 detection module; BH1750 light intensity monitoring module; temperature and humidity monitoring module DHT11; capacitive soil humidity sensor module establishes a greenhouse temperature and humidity monitoring system; which effectively solves the low measurement accuracy existing in traditional greenhouses. Problems such as high product prices; cumbersome wiring; and waste of labor resources. The wireless sensor network is established through the ZigBee communication protocol; which can realize the data communication between the microcontroller cc2530 and the host computer cc2530. The WiFi module of the host computer can achieve the goal of data communication between the mobile phone APP or the computer terminal and the host computer; and achieve the goal of data communication through the relay Switch on and off the drip irrigation; exhaust fan; warm light and other external equipment.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决温室大棚中光照、气体、空气温度和土壤湿度这4个环境参数存在的监测问题以及实现大棚控制自动化;本文设计了一种以单片机C2530为核心的无线组网监测系统;并使用O2监测模块JXM-O2、NDIR红外CO2检测模块、BH1750光照强度监测模块、温湿度监测模块DHT11、电容式土壤湿度传感器模块建立温室大棚温湿度监测系统;有效解决了传统温室大棚中存在的测量精度低、产品价格高、布线烦琐、人工资源浪费等问题。通过ZigBee通信协议组建无线传感网络;可以实现单片机cc2530与上位机cc2530之间的数据通信;通过上位机的WiFi模块可以实现手机APP或电脑终端与上位机进行数据通信的目标;并实现通过继电器开关滴灌、排风扇、暖光灯等外部设备。
keywords: data monitoring, electronic design, zigbee
authors: XU Tao;WANG Juan;HUO Jianzhen;SONG Shengfa;LIN Shanqing
affiliations: 临沂大学自动化与电气工程学院, Linyi University, School of Automation and Electrical Engineering

title: 地下综合管廊风险分析预警系统
abstract: The risk analysis and early warning system for underground utility tunnel is introduced.The perception layer is based on the sensor network.The software defined network(SDN) technology based on CC2650 chip is used for communication layer.Huawei Cloud visualization platform as the data display platform is taken for application layer.The system realizes the automatic acquisition; intelligent transmission and information management of the utility tunnel.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种地下综合管廊风险分析预警系统;其中感知层基于传感器网络;通信层采用基于CC2650芯片的软件定义网络(SDN)自组网技术;应用层以华为云可视化平台为数据展示平台。系统实现了地下综合管廊的自动化采集、智能化传输和信息化管理。
keywords: application layer, communication layer, perception layer, risk analysis and early warning system, utility tunnel
authors: LUO Yuqiu;ZHANG Yang;QIU Shiyin;JIN Yong;GENG Pan
affiliations: Shanghai Maritime University, 上海海事大学

title: 发动机防热结构件智能压粘机控制系统设计
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems such as low automation degree;low production efficiency;human factors affecting more;and unstable bonding quality in the thermal protection structure bonding process of solid rocket motor nozzles;the measurement and control system of intelligent press glue machine for the thermal protection structure has been designed.Based on AM5718 DSP+ARM dual core processor development;combined with the interface board of servo drive and data acquisition;the system carries out the facility controlment as a whole by processing multi-axes precision motion control and gathering high precision signalmeanwhile the controlling difficulties and solutions are elaboratedThe system adopts techniques such as motion control function method by means of tracking interpolation;Multi tolerance window matching control of pressure and displacement;proportional adjustment control technology to realize coating uniformity control;etc.To realize glue coating uniformity control;rotation exhaust pressure-holding control;precision pressure control in moulding processCompared with the original processing method;the processing time is reduced by 65%;the rate of glue overflow is reduced by more than 85%;and the qualified rate of one-time bonding is increased by 25%.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决现有固体火箭发动机喷管防热结构件粘接自动化程度不高、生产效率低、人为因素影响多、粘接质量不稳定等问题;设计防热结构件智能压粘机控制系统基于AM5718 DSP+ARM双核处理器开发;搭载综合驱动采集卡;进行系统多轴运动精准控制及信号精确采集;实现系统整体控制并阐述了设计中的控制难点及解决思路采用运动控制函数跟踪插补控制技术、压力位移多公差窗口匹配控制技术、比例调节控制技术等;实现涂胶均匀度控制、旋转保压排气控制、成型过程精准稳压控制经实际应用与原有加工方式相比;加工时间缩短65%、溢胶率减少85%以上、一次粘接合格率提高25%。
keywords: intelligent, interpolation algorithm for motion control, multi-tolerance window control, press glue control, proportional control
authors: Ltd.;Wang Chao;Li Peipei;Bao Le;Wang Jingxian;Wang Xinde
affiliations: Xi’an WeiKong Automation Technology Co., No.210 Institute of The Sixth Academy of China Aerospace Science &Industry Corporation, 中国航天科工集团第六研究院二一零所, 西安维控自动化科技有限公司

title: 基于ZigBee+GPRS的智慧校园监测系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前高校规模越来越大以及校园安全隐患难以排查等问题;提出将Zigbee无线传感网络与GPRS长距离通信技术应用到校园监测系统中。采用以CC2530为核心搭建Zigbee无线传感网络;采集校园火灾、照明能耗和校园人员出入信息;并通过GPRS传输至移动终端和管理系统;实现对数据的存储、分析和显示;达到实时监测和正确决策的目标。

title: Design of Environment Monitoring and Early Warning System of Sheep House Based on Web
abstract: In view of the demand for intelligent environment monitoring and early warning for intensive sheep breeding; this study designs a real-time monitoring and early warning system for sheep house environment. The system achieves accurate collection of environmental parameters through CC2530 terminal node connected with temperature and humidity sensor; light sensor; etc.. It can carry out real-time monitoring of sheep house environment; and analyze; process and display the data. When the environmental parameters exceed the warning value; the system automatically alarms.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前羊只集约化养殖对智能化环境监测和预警的需求;本文设计了羊舍环境实时监控预警系统。该系统通过CC2530终端节点外接温湿度传感器、光照传感器等实现对环境参数的精确采集;能够对羊舍环境进行实时监测;并对数据进行分析、处理及显示;当环境参数超过预警值时;系统自动报警。
keywords: cc2530, environment monitoring, sheep house environment, video monitoring
affiliations: 神木市职业技术教育中心信息技术系, 榆林学院信息工程学院
source: 榆林学院学报 ;Journal of Yulin University ; Editorial E-mail ;2021(02)

title: Design of wireless monitoring device for dangerous dated buildings
abstract: As the dangerous dated buildings are becoming more and more common in urban suburbs and rural areas;which causes serious security risks;a monitoring device for ZigBee and GSM wireless communication is designed. In this device;the CC2530 of Zigbee communication is used as the core control unit to collect the important structural environmental parameters such as inclination angle;stress;temperature and humidity of dangerous dated houses;and complete the transmission of local area network. The SIM900 A module of GSM communication is used to complete the remote early warning of data alarm information. The experiments of the actual IoT communication networking and the data acquisition and display were performed.The results show that the monitoring device of dangerous dated house can effectively collect the structured data of dangerous dated house;and accurately reflect the current state of dangerous dated house.
abstract_in_chinese: 危旧房屋在城市郊区和农村越来越普遍;存在严重的安全隐患;为此;文中设计一种ZigBee和GSM无线通信的监测装置。该装置利用ZigBee通信的CC2530为核心控制单元;对危旧房屋的倾角、应力、温湿度等重要结构环境参数进行采集;并完成局域网传输;同时采用GSM通信的SIM900A模块完成对数据报警信息的远程发送预警。通过实际物联网通信组网实验以及数据采集显示实验表明;该危旧房监测装置能够有效采集危旧房屋结构数据;并准确地反应当前危旧房屋的状态。
keywords: dangerous dated house, data collection, experimental verification, remote alarm, wireless communication, wireless monitoring
affiliations: 四川国祥科技有限公司, 成都大学电子信息与电气工程学院

title: 基于TH71221的无源声表面波传感信号读取器
abstract: 针对无源声表面波传感读取器信号处理软件算法影响参数多、分立元件硬件设计复杂等问题;通过Matlab对传感信号进行模拟和仿真;确定了算法涉及的关键参数;从硬件系统实现角度进一步对射频链路关键器件进行分析、比较并选型。设计了以两颗高集成度射频芯片TH71221分别作为收发前端的系统架构;并据此实现了读取器的总体电路设计。与基于分立器件实现的系统相比;该读取器具有成本低、尺寸小;易于实现的特点。
keywords: th71221, tms320f28335, 传感信号读取器, 传感器, 射频前端芯片, 无源声表面波
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团第五十八研究所

title: 基于ZigBee与ARM嵌入式系统的档案库房环境监控设计研究
abstract: 为了能够远程实时监控档案库房的内部运行环境具体情况;从而减少不必要的人力、物力、时间投入;提出基于ZigBee技术、ARM嵌入式的档案库房环境监控设计思路。基于无线通信、计算机控制及物联网技术;说明了ZigBee、ARM技术对各通信协议的层级功能、帧架构;结合系统设计功能需求;设计了ZigBee技术的档案库房内部网络无线传感技术;以及整体系统架构。对系统全局架构组成进行分析;在B/S架构上引入CC2530核心系统芯片;与Z-Stack协议相搭配;完成了系统软硬件设计。并与该系统的实际档案库房环境监控工作运行情况相结合;其中硬件平台基于Mini2400基础实现;并成功移植嵌入式ARM系统和Linux操作系统;设计了ARM嵌入式智能通信网关;经系统运用测试证实;设计的该系统能够远程且自动化监控档案库房环境。
keywords: arm, zigbee, 嵌入式系统, 环境监控
affiliations: 西安医学院

title: TMS320C6678多核处理器软件部署方法
abstract: TMS320C6678多核数字信号处理器软件部署在软件开发调试和工程部署阶段不可或缺;同时;软件的快速部署在提高系统开发效率方面非常关键。针对提高该多核处理器软件部署效率的目的;分析了TMS320C6678多核处理器软件部署特点和软件引导加载模式及原理;研究了基于多核应用软件部署（Multicore Application Deploy;MAD）工具集的实现方式;简化了多核应用软件映像文件的制作流程;并采用Python语言开发了图形化自动转换工具。通过大量实际工程的使用;验证了该软件部署方法及工具满足使用要求;同时将部署效率提高了一个数量级。
keywords: tms320c6678, 二级加载, 加载模式, 多核应用软件部署
affiliations: 中国西南电子技术研究所

title: 采用TMS320F28335的多节点CAN总线通信设计
abstract: 根据CAN总线通信规范和TMS320F28335处理器eCAN外设特点;设计了CAN总线多节点通信网络连接方式及接口电路;根据TMS320F28335处理器eCAN模块的配置规则;设计了CAN总线数据帧格式;并给出了设置示例;对该模块进行了软件配置;实现了CAN总线多节点的收发通信。
keywords: can总线, tms320f28335, 多节点网络, 通信协议
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第二十七研究所

title: 基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统设计
abstract: 传统的多目标不确定度计量系统计量时间较长;计量过程稳健性较差。为了解决上述问题;设计了基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统。系统硬件设计了模拟信号发生器、数据采集装置、主控单元和人机交互界面;选用DM3730处理器处理计量内容。系统软件分析了产品的望目特性、望小特性、望大特性;针对每一个产品特性提出了相应的质量损失函数。根据约束条件和目标函数确定双侧公差上限和双侧公差下限;结合双侧公差限和遗传算法完成计量。实验结果表明;基于双侧公差限的多目标不确定度计量系统可以有效缩短计量时间;计量稳健性较高。
keywords: 不确定度, 双侧公差限, 多目标, 计量系统

title: 基于DSP的ART算法实现研究
abstract: 针对通用处理器在实现ART算法时的各种限制;提出了基于高性能DSP-TMS320C6678的算法计算方案。该方案结合ART算法的原理;利用TL-XDS560V2硬件仿真器通过USB接口和标准的JTAG接口实现PC端和DSP的连接并使用SDRAM作为数据缓存;从而实现大量数据在两者之间精准快速的传输并在PC端显示验证结果。通过C语言编写DSP片内算法计算程序并对其进行优化以降低图像重建时间;最终实验以某发动机模拟件为实验对象;实验结果证实了方案的可行性。
keywords: art算法, dsp, pc, sdram, 图像重建
authors: 王明泉;张俊生;方子彬;黄康;姜康

title: 基于体域网的低能耗多协议转换网关设计
abstract: 针对体域网中多传感设备之间存在不同协议转换的实际需求;设计了一个多元异构传感设备之间数据集成协议转换的网关。该网关由基于ARM Cortex-M3内核的主控模块、基于CC2530的ZigBee模块、Wi-Fi模块、电源模块四个部分组成。首先给出了一种面向体域网应用的系统网关总体设计体系;然后介绍了硬件和软件设计过程;同时阐述了硬件工作原理、网关工作流程和数据上云的过程。最后利用串口调试助手和网络调试助手抓取数据并上传至云平台;对网关的丢包率、延迟等性能指标进行了实验仿真。通过对30轮次多组数据包的实际抓取测试;最终计算出500个数据包丢包率低于1;并计算其时延、能耗;结果均比较理想。实验表明;文中设计的网关在体域网协议转换与数据上云过程中具有有效性和可用性。
keywords: wi-fi, 云计算, 体域网, 多协议, 网关
affiliations: 安徽师范大学皖江学院,  安徽师范大学计算机与信息学院

title: 基于ZigBee的冷库环境监测系统设计
abstract: 文章以温湿度和二氧化碳浓度作为监测参数;选择CC2530作为系统节点的核心芯片;设计并实现了基于ZigBee技术的冷库环境监测系统;进行了其他相关硬件电路的设计;完成了节点的硬件设计;在硬件的基础上结合ZigBee协议栈对协调器、路由节点和终端节点的软件以及传感器采集数据程序进行了设计;最后对系统的上位机进行了设计与实现。
keywords: zigbee, 冷库贮藏, 环境监测系统, 系统设计

title: 基于CC2530的龙门起重机应力多点巡回监测系统研制
abstract: 文章介绍了一种基于CC2530的龙门起重机应力多点巡回监测系统研制;该系统采用CC2530为核心处理单元;以协调器结点和各电阻式应变传感监测结点组成数据采集网络;实时采集龙门起重机不同部件的多点应力;当应力超过阈值时第一时间向用户发送警报;从而实现龙门起重机设备的实时监测和管理。
keywords: cc2530, 数据采集网络, 监测系统, 龙门起重机

title: 基于ZigBee网络的高校宿舍智能安防系统设计
abstract: 针对高校宿舍安防管理智能化的需求;设计了一种基于ZigBee网络的高校宿舍智能安防系统。系统分别采用STM32和CC2530单片机作为系统后端控制网关和硬件节点的核心控制模块。硬件节点将传感器实时监测采集的环境及安防数据通过ZigBee网络传输至后端控制网关处理;并在出现异常数据的情况下触发报警机制;实现高校宿舍安防智能化管理的目的。
keywords: cc2530, stm32, zigbee, 安防监控, 高校宿舍
affiliations: 襄阳职业技术学院建筑工程学院
source: 襄阳职业技术学院学报

title: 低功耗无线烟雾报警器的设计
abstract: 传统的烟雾报警器存在高功耗且不能互联互通等问题;因而难以满足实际应用的要求。本文设计了一种低功耗无线烟雾报警器;采用低功耗、低电压的光电型烟雾探测器专用集成电路RE46C190和超低功耗、低于1 GHz的无线单片机CC1310;使系统待机电流大约为14μA;理论待机寿命长达11年;无线通信距离达到1 km;很好地满足了低功耗和无线互通的要求;为相关智慧消防建议提供了一种新的解决方案。
keywords: 低功耗, 无线通信, 烟雾报警器
authors: 郝思聪;贺庆;程杰;张青超
affiliations: 北京信息科技大学仪器科学与光电工程学院
source: 北大核心;消防科学与技术

title: 基于XC7K325T+TMS320C6678的高速图像处理系统设计与实现
abstract: 根据高速图像目标识别与跟踪系统计算量大、传输速率高、实时性强等特点;文章研制了一种基于XC7K325T和TMS320C6678的高性能实时图像处理系统。系统采用FPGA与多核DSP并行处理及流水线操作技术;实现了高速图像目标识别与跟踪;测试结果表明;该系统满足设计要求。
keywords: rapidio, tms320c6678, xc7k325t, 多处理内核, 高速图像处理系统

title: 绿色建筑3D仿真系统设计
abstract: 针对传统的仿真系统中由于多边形网络数目过多导致的可识别能力下降的问题;文中设计一种绿色建筑3D仿真系统。在硬件设计上;使用全景相机获得绿色建筑全角度图像;在ZigBee底板的支持下;利用CC2530芯片控制传感器获得建筑空间位置和倾斜角度信息;在软件设计上;采用面向对象的方法设计绿色建筑基础;考虑安全性和造价成本优化桩基础设计;在搭建出绿色建筑框架后;采用虚拟视景技术对框架进行纹理贴图和无缝衔接处理。至此;系统设计完成。测试结果表明;设计的绿色建筑3D仿真系统在仿真过程中贴图完整、建筑构件一致性高;并且可识别能力得到提升。
keywords: 3d仿真, 性能测试, 数据采集, 无缝衔接, 系统设计, 纹理贴图, 绿色建筑

title: 一种基于DSP+FPGA架构的软件在线升级实现
abstract: 为了解决在外场频繁升级DSP程序所带来的困扰;基于TI公司的TMS320C6416芯片平台;提出了一种基于DSP+FPGA硬件架构的软件程序在线升级方法;研究并实现DSP程序的在线升级过程以及上电后的启动引导流程。经项目实际验证该方法具有实现简单、可靠性高等优点。

title: 工业伺服系统大范围位置控制器的设计与验证
abstract: 针对带有惯性阻尼环节的工业位置伺服系统;设计了一种能实现大范围快速定点运动的控制器。控制器根据系统速度的大小;在时间最优控制律与线性控制律之间进行平滑切换。采用线性控制的闭环极点阻尼系数和自然频率作为可调参数;设计了近似时间最优伺服控制律;为了对速度（未量测）和未知负载扰动进行估计;设计了一个能实现动态增益的非线性扩展状态观测器。此控制器被用于一个永磁同步电机位置伺服系统;进行了MATLAB仿真;以及基于TMS320F28335 DSC的实验测试;结果显示伺服系统在空载、半载和满载三种未知扰动情况下都能对给定的目标位置进行准确的跟踪;且超调量低于2%;具有理想的控制性能。这个设计可用于工业伺服传动系统的高性能位置调节。
keywords: 伺服系统, 参数化, 扰动抑制, 时间最优控制, 观测器

title: 多路热电偶测温电路设计
abstract: 本文针对热加工过程中热处理炉以及产品温度分布采集问题;设计了一种多路热电偶测温系统。该系统利用复用器HCF4052实现多路测量通道的控制;通过接口转换芯片T232RL以及无线传输模块CC3200实现数据的USB传输与无线传输。实验证明;多路热电偶测温电路在0～1600℃温度范围内可以达到1℃的测量精度。
keywords: 冷端补偿, 多路测温, 热电偶
authors: 崔海佟;陈炜;唐亚曼;杨新圆

title: 基于DSP的状态监测及预警系统
abstract: 为了保障机电设备的安全可靠运行;研究并设计了基于DSP芯片TMS320F28335的状态监测及预警系统。通过DSP片上及外扩的A/D转换器采集设备运行的关键状态参数;循环写入外扩的数据存储器中;为可能出现的故障提供数据支持;建立了包括预警编码、上电时间、断电时间在内的设备工作日志;开发了系统与上位机的通信接口及相关协议以实现二者间的数据传输。目前;系统已应用于静电悬浮设备;能够满足其运行状态监测及故障预警的需求。
keywords: dsp, 工作日志, 状态监测, 预警

title: 数字信号处理器单粒子功能性瞬态故障预估方法研究
abstract: 结合特定应用下数字信号处理器单粒子功能故障的产生机理和表征模式;定义了单粒子功能性瞬态故障的概念;提出了利用数字信号处理器内部存储区数据位翻转截面和数据位缓存时间有效占比预估功能性瞬态故障截面的方法。在西安200 MeV质子应用装置上开展了TMS320C6455型数字信号处理器质子辐照实验;对预估方法的有效性进行了验证。实验得到了被测器件的功能性瞬态故障截面和内部存储区数据位翻转截面;并利用预估方法计算得到被测器件功能性瞬态故障截面预估值;实验结果与预估值相对偏差小于5%。
keywords: 功能性瞬态故障, 单粒子效应, 数字信号处理器, 质子应用装置, 预估方法
authors: 刘卧龙;赵铭彤;王茂成;王迪;盛江坤;王忠明;姚志斌;杨业;许鹏;罗尹虹

title: 数字式高频Q表设计
abstract: 设计一款数字式高频Q表;基于AD9958产生可调高频信号;经BUF634扩流后进行分压阻抗变换;加入到LC谐振回路;由24位高精度模数转换器ADS1256采集输入输出的真有效值输入到STM32F4中;计算及显示回路电感、谐振频率及Q值等参数.测试结果表明;较传统机械Q表;数字式高频Q表具有测量精度高、操作简单等优点.

title: 接触网感应式有电示警无线监测装置研究
abstract: 为保证接触网越区供电的电能质量;设计了一套针对接触线带电状态的感应式测量无线监测系统。系统基于COMSOL搭建静电电容空间传感器电路仿真模型;分析单线接触网电位分布特性并推导测量装置各级的电压映射关系。采用TMS320F28377最小系统板搭配OPA2171、CC2530等外围电路模块采集接触线电压信号。在模拟WiFi环境的强干扰下;提出基于HMM的算法降低ZigBee网络丢包率;并将电压数据发送至上位机;实现铁路局监控中心对接触线电压信息的远程访问。实验证明:装置精度等级高、动态范围良好;具备信道重叠时择优跳信道能力。

title: 基于多核处理器的声光复合一体化探测系统设计
abstract: 介绍一种以多核处理器AM5728为核心处理器的声光复合探测系统;结合现场可编程逻辑门阵列（Field Programmable Gate Array;FPGA）处理器实现对音视频数据采集、信号处理、目标识别及跟踪定位的功能;详细阐述了基于多核处理器的高集成度系统设计方案。实验结果证明;通过一体化设计;该系统将传统声光探测系统融合为一体;既提升了系统探测效能;又提升了系统应用的便携性。

title: 专用电源嵌入式控制系统DSP端口问题研究
abstract: 针对目前被广泛应用在电力电子和电源控制领域的TMS320F28335 DSP;结合在开发专用电源嵌入式控制系统过程中发现的GPIO端口问题开展研究工作。对产生的问题进行了复现试验;发现在使用同一分组GPIO的情况下;通过GPxDAT寄存器控制程序指令无法控制2个及以上端口产生相应动作的问题。经分析提出导致问题产生的3种假设并进行相应的验证试验;试验结果表明第3种假设情况为产生问题的原因。在此基础上提出了3种基于软件编程的解决方案;并对解决方案进行了验证。最后;对TMS320F28x系列其他5种常用型号的DSP进行拓展试验;均发现了相似的问题。采用提出的3种解决方案进行测试;结果证明提出的解决方案都是有效可行的。
keywords: 串行外设接口, 嵌入式控制系统, 数字信号处理器, 通用输入输出端口
affiliations: 核工业理化工程研究院

title: 面向多核DSP的可靠二级Boot方法研究
abstract: 针对多核处理器Boot技术难度大、流程复杂、可靠性要求高等特点;提出一种面向多核DSP的可靠二级Boot方法。方法针对TMS320C6678多核DSP的emif16引导方式;采用二级Boot的方案进行多核DSP程序引导;针对可执行程序生成、烧写、加载等环节;给出了详细的工程解决方案。该方法实现了多核DSP可执行程序的便捷生成、快速烧写及可靠加载;与传统Boot方案相比;可靠性有明显提升;具备一定的工程应用价值。

title: 一种按需加载的DSP程序扩容方法
abstract: 随着软件无线电的发展;软件无线电平台的处理能力越来越强大、平台上实现的功能越来越多;平台的硬件结构也多种多样;各平台之间无法实现软硬件资源的共享;在实现通用数字中频的工作中;DSP程序的扩容需求逐步增大。针对上述问题;本文提供一种按需加载的DSP程序扩容方法;这种方法可以根据需要加载不同的DSP函数;相当于对DSP的内存进行了扩容。这种方法减少了加载时间;并且不必保证DSP程序的运行速度。本方法适用于TI公司、ADI公司以及目前国产化DSP;型号不限于TMS320C6713、TMS320C6416、TMS320C6455、TMS320C6678等。
keywords: dsp, tms320c6713, 程序扩容
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第十研究所
source: 单片机与嵌入式系统应用

title: 基于ZigBee的互联网+智慧农业系统设计
abstract: 针对如今基于物联网技术构建的智慧农业系统表现出的一些问题;提出了一种改良的设计方案。其进一步减轻了资金上的成本负担与农民使用的学习成本;除大规模农场化的种植集团外;还可推广至普通的个体种植户。通过ZigBee技术进行组网;将终端设备分布在农作物周围;用户可以通过手机应用程序远程获取终端设备附近的环境信息;并利用继电器开关实现远程浇水等功能。由于采用光伏-蓄电池供电与子节点可以进行低功耗休眠的方案;该系统达到了低成本、低功耗和高可靠性三者的平衡。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee技术, 智慧农业, 物联网
source: 单片机与嵌入式系统应用

title: 基于虚拟频率的隔离型双向AC/DC变换器最小电流应力控制策略
abstract: 针对隔离型双向AC/DC变换器提出一种基于虚拟频率的最小电流应力控制策略。首先;分析了三重移相（triple phase shift;TPS）控制方法的开关特性;并设计了基于TPS的移相全桥最小电流应力控制算法。然后;针对输出功率与移相比呈非线性的特点;提出虚拟频率控制方法;该算法不仅可以将非线性控制简化为线性化;还可实现交直流变换器单级转换;有效减小中间母线电容;降低系统电流应力。最后;基于TMS320F28335的实验平台对所提出的控制策略进行了实验验证。实验结果表明;当功率双向传输时;所提控制策略能有效地减小变换器的电流应力。
keywords: 三重移相控制, 单相变换器, 双向ac/dc变换器, 最小电流应力, 虚拟频率控制
authors: 王弈赫;任春光;孟祥齐;贾燕冰;韩肖清;郭东鑫

title: 基于安卓系统的课程资源共享平台的开发
abstract: "互联网+教育"是将互联网信息技术与教育相结合的一种新教育形式。利用互联网快捷方便、传播迅速的特点;这种新型教育形式将在未来的教育领域中起到不可忽视的作用。目前;大部分学习平台都是基于一些独立的课程;缺乏与整个专业课程体系的紧密联系。该平台以辅助高校学生专业课程学习为目进行设计;在学生进行专业课程线下课堂学习的同时;还可以在该平台上进行查漏补缺;也可以在平台学习到课外专业相关的资讯和知识;提升学生在专业领域能力的同时;也能够增加专业课程学习的趣味性。目前;该平台已经实现大部分主要基础功能;该文将从各个层面对已完成的功能和实现的具体方式进行阐述介绍。
keywords: android, 专业课程, 互联网, 在线资源平台

title: 基于滤波器前置的三相软件锁相环设计
abstract: 针对传统锁相环在电压不平衡及畸变时锁相误差大、动态响应速度慢的问题;根据软件锁相环（SPLL）的原理提出一种滑动滤波器（MAF）前置锁相环;并通过一种快速不平衡分量抑制及相位延迟补偿的方法来TMS320F28335数字信号处理器芯片对所提出的锁相环控制策略在三相电压不平衡及电压畸变的条件下进行验证;结果表明该SPLL锁相误差小;动态响应速度快;稳定性高。
keywords: 数字信号处理器, 滑动滤波器, 电压畸变, 相位延时补偿, 软件锁相环

title: 面向协议栈的ZigBee实验系统设计
abstract: 组网演练是ZigBee实验的关键内容;协议栈在组网实验中发挥着重要作用.结合ZigBee技术的特点;以环境监控为应用背景;设计了一种ZigBee实验系统.该实验系统以CC2530和数字温湿度传感器为核心;实现主从节点的数据采集和传输;以及一点对多点、两点之间的通信.利用LabVIEW设计了上位机;借助于Eclipse4.1平台开发了手机客户端;可以通过手机客户端与服务器进行通信.利用该实验系统;可以完成串口、按键、无线数据传输、无线点灯等组网实验;以及手机客户端程序开发和LabVIEW系统仿真;具有较强的开放性和二次开发能力;有利于提高学生的实践创新能力和ZigBee系统开发能力.
keywords: labview, zigbee, 环境监控, 组网演练

title: 基于DSP和CAN的机电环境设备监控系统模块化设计
abstract: 为提升机电环境设备监控系统的实时性和准确性;降低机电环境设备的故障率;模块化设计基于DSP和CAN的机电环境设备监控系统。模块化设计综合采集模块、通信管理模块和分析模块。综合采集模块选取DSP为核心处理器;实现信号的实时采集;并将信号转换成电参量;传输至通信管理模块;通信管理模块以CAN总线的控制器TMS320LF2407A作为核心处理器;通过CAN2.0B协议;实现CAN总线数据的实时通信;提升通信的可靠性和抗干扰能力;分析模块采用改进传统连接树传播方法;实现设备故障的实时检测。经实验验证:该系统采集的频率误差全部未大于2 Hz;具有较好的信号采集能力;故障检测率始终在95%以上;故障隔离率始终保持在96%以上。该系统的安全性与可管理性较强;存储形式简便;数据库并未出现较大空间限制;设备故障的实时监控效果好;能够降低机电环境设备的故障率。

title: 基于ZigBee的干涉仪测控系统设计
abstract: 针对传统干涉仪需要手工调节机械装置;自动化程度低等问题;该文设计了一套以Zig Bee-CC2530为核心的无线测控系统。该系统将2个CC2530节点分别作为射频信号收发器;以点对点通信的方式实现无线控制功能。同时利用微软基础类库MFC（Microsoft Foundation Classes）设计了上位机软件;通过串口通信控制精密电机的运转;并在仪器内部基于不同条件设计了对应的行程限位解决方案;使得精密电机可以满足测控要求定点制动;提高了干涉仪的测量效率和精度。

title: 基于ZigBee的农田土壤湿度监测系统
abstract: 设计了基于ZigBee的农田土壤湿度监测系统。系统中的传感器节点选用CC2530芯片作为主控模块;利用土壤湿度传感器实时采集湿度数据;并通过协调器的串口模块实现节点与服务器之间的数据传输;且结合互联网实现服务器与Web浏览器端之间的通信;使后者实时显示可视化农田土壤湿度信息。通过测试;节点之间的距离在50m内可保持稳定通信;系统满足对农田土壤湿度信息的高效、精准检测的需求。

title: 基于CC2530的仓库环境无线监控系统设计
abstract: 对于现有的仓库环境参数有线监控系统;存在布线需要大量电缆、系统维护或者升级工作量大的问题;设计了一种仓库环境无线监控系统;该系统以CC2530为核心处理器构建网络节点;组建ZigBee无线网络进行监控信息的传输。无线监控系统采样布置灵活;安装简单快速;检查维护方便;系统扩充、改进、优化的方式灵活易行;解决了仓库有线环境监控系统布线复杂、线缆成本高的问题;提高了仓库环境监控系统的灵活性和持续改进的便捷性;对于仓库环境监控系统的工艺领域改进和成本控制作用显著;有利于保证仓储物品的质量和安全。
keywords: cc2530, 仓库, 无线网络, 环境监控

title: 基于ZigBee的AGV小车电池充电监控系统
abstract: 为避免电池充电控制完全依靠人来计算时间、观察温度以及判断异常等情况;将ZigBee技术、通过Wi-Fi网络联入IP网络;最终实现个人控制终端对电池充电温度的监控;设计监控回路。采用红外温度传感器采集信号;CC2530芯片的ZigBee进行数据的采集、整理、传输;通过无线传输模块;电脑端收集数据、实时显示并通过接触器控制电源的通断进而实现超温保护。达到了在较少人员的直接参与下;按照要求;经过自动检测、信息处理、分析判断;实现预期的目标:监控温度;防止事故。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 实时监控
affiliations: 苏州工业园区职业技术学院

title: 矿用电缆卷放车智能追踪系统设计
abstract: 电缆卷放车是露天煤矿中匹配电铲作业的一种供电辅助设备;为了实现电缆卷放车自动追踪电铲的目标;设计一种专用于露天矿山的电缆卷放车智能追踪系统。该系统包括图像采集与处理模块、智能追踪控制策略模块、执行模块。其中;图像采集与处理模块以FPGA芯片EP4CE6F17C8为核心;采用HSV颜色空间转换算法提取目标电铲特征;智能追踪控制策略模块以DSP芯片TMS320F2812为核心;通过DSP外部接口与FPGA通信;采用偏移量和车距估计方法获取目标电铲相对于电缆卷放车的方向和距离;执行模块以PLC芯片S7-1200为核心;采用MAX485与DSP通信;控制电缆卷放车的前进、后退、调速、停止;实现对目标电铲的智能追踪。在电铲的静态和动态运动下;通过实验对模型进行了验证。结果表明;该系统能够快速识别与追踪目标电铲;验证了提出方法的可行性和有效性。
keywords: fpga, 偏移量, 图像处理, 智能追踪, 目标识别, 车距

title: 微波加热中物料实时温度测量无线传感器及其网络
abstract: 微波作为新型的清洁能源在工业生产中得到广泛应用。然而;微波选择性加热导致的加热不均匀和微波场中温度难以准确实时测量的问题限制了微波工业设备的高效设计与应用。针对以上问题;本文设计了一种基于无线传感器网络和单片机技术的微波加热温度测量系统;该系统以STM32作为微控制器、CC1101作为无线收发器组成星型无线传感器网络;并开发简易的上位机显示程序;实现了微波加热过程中多点位置的实时温度测量。其中无线传感器节点（End Device）采用DS18B20数字温度传感器实时测量节点位置温度值并发送数据;中央节点（Access Point）接收数据并通过RS232串口上传至PC机显示。本文使用该系统测量结果和光纤温度计结果作为比对;验证了该系统的可行性和准确性;且该系统成本低廉、布控灵活;适用于隧道式工业微波加热等多种应用场景。
keywords: 单片机技术, 微波加热, 无线传感器网络, 温度实时测量

title: 基于TMS320C6678的雷达导引头OCOG测高算法的并行实现
abstract: 雷达平台与成像区域的相对高度是合成孔径雷达成像过程中影响斜地几何校正精度的重要参数;同时雷达测高实时性要求高。采样传统规模单核处理实现需要的硬件规模比较庞大;难以满足弹载雷达在体积和重量方面的要求。本文设计了基于TI公司TMS320C6678多核DSP实现方案;首先介绍了OCOG（Offset Center Of Gravity）测高算法的原理;其次介绍了硬件平台及高速多核并行处理的实现方法;最后进行实测数据的处理;验证了本文所提的方案的实时性和测高结果的有效性。

title: 实验鼠无创生理信号监测系统设计
abstract: 目的 研制一种实验鼠无创可穿戴生理信号监测系统，实现在生物医学和药学研究中，连续无创地监测实验鼠的生理信号。方法 系统由可穿戴终端、生理信号接收主机和监控软件组成。可穿戴终端采用无线微控制器CC2640R2F实现实验鼠心电图（ECG）、体温（BT）和运动量（AL）的采集与无线传输；生理信号接收主机通过低功耗蓝牙技术，接收可穿戴终端采集的生理信号，并将信号传输给上位机；上位机监控软件对生理信号进行实时滤波，并从ECG中提取出心率（HR）和RR间期（RRI）。结果 可穿戴终端尺寸为37 mm×28 mm×5 mm;重量为6.8 g。选取1只雌性SD大鼠开展活体实验，实验结果表明，本系统采集的ECG波形与标准心电仪Bio-Radio REF BR-500采集的波形一致；采集的大鼠HR为（429±22）beats/min;均值标准误差（SEM）为±1.11 beats/min;而Bio-Radio采集的HR为（438±24）beats/min; SEM为±1.14 beats/min。本系统采集的大鼠BT为（36.98±0.20）℃;SEM为±0.03℃;而医用红外体温计AET-R1F1采集的BT为（36.95±0.23）℃;SEM为±0.04℃。本系统可采集大鼠在静息和运动时的AL。结论 本系统可无创、准确、实时地监测自主活动大鼠的BT、ECG、AL、RRI和HR等生理指标。

title: 基于ZigBee的抛光布轮直径及喷枪工作状态监控系统设计
abstract: 设计了ZigBee协议为通信协议;目的是建立一个运用于喷枪生产车间的无线传感器网络。单片机CC2530作为主控芯片的远程监测系统;对工作状态进行实时检测以及对布轮的磨损监测;在喷枪不能正常工作时或布轮磨损超过阈值时;进行报警。对机械喷枪使用时工作状态的检测以及抛光布轮磨损的程度进行观察;利用无线传感器网络实现抛光工艺的远程监控;并在协调器的OLED上显示相应的数据;可提高自动化程度;大大减少企业人力成本。

title: 基于STM32的非侵入式负荷监测系统设计
abstract: 传统的侵入式负荷监测方法在实际应用中安装复杂;成本高;无法满足日益发展的电力系统需求。为此设计了一种基于STM32的非侵入式负荷监测系统;系统以STM32F103芯片为主控制器;利用AD8629放大器和ADS1256芯片进行高精度电信号采样;通过USB与上位机通信;在Labview界面中进行实时显示;并建立卷积神经网络算法模型进行负荷识别。将嵌入式系统与辨识算法进行结合;通过实验验证了用电负荷监测与识别的可行性;且系统实时性好;测量精度高;成本低;有较强的实用性。

title: 基于MSP430和ZigBee的煤矿液压支架压力监测系统设计
abstract: 基于MSP430和ZigBee设备;设计了一套可通过无线传感网络进行液压支架压力监测的微型监测系统;并给出系统的具体方案。硬件部分的设计内容有压力采集节点、信号调制电路、ZigBee无线通信方案、CAN总线通信电路等的设计;软件部分的设计内容有主程序和压力采集节点CC2530模块子程序的流程框图。经过现场运行测试;该系统可通过无线传感网络实现对液压支架各个位置的压力监测;数据传输稳定;安装便捷;具有一定的应用价值。

title: 永磁同步电动机高性能位置控制实验研究
abstract: 针对永磁同步电动机伺服系统;在磁场定向矢量控制模式下;分别采用自抗扰控制和鲁棒快速伺服控制技术设计了电动机位置-速度环的伺服控制器;用于实现位置调节。通过MATLAB仿真和基于数字信号处理器TMS320F28335的实验;比较了设计方案的性能差异。设计方案用于本科生运动控制课的实验演示和研究生伺服工程课的科研训练;帮助学生从中领悟先进控制技术的潜力;并学习如何把所学知识用于解决具体工程问题。

affiliations: 福州大学电气工程与自动化学院

title: 不同SPWM波形生成算法及其实现
abstract: 本文介绍了对称规则采样法、不对称规则采样法和等效面积法三种不同PWM波形生成算法的运用情况;基于TMS320LF2407在线生成TMS320LF2407波形;通过实地测验可见不同算法运用特征不一;对称规则采样法采集SPWM波形较为方便快捷;速度较快;运用等效面积法采集SPWM波形对称性良好;精密度较高;输出波形谐波小;采用不对称规则法进行SPWM波形采样;运用性能位于对称规则采样法、等效面积法两者之间;变频技术结合实际情况灵活选择运用SPWM波形生成算法。
keywords: spwm波形生成算法, tms320lf2407, 输出波形
affiliations: 泸州职业技术学院

title: 基于ZigBee和CC2530的无线温湿度数据采集和存储模块研究
abstract: 针对一些过程依赖性活动的环境监测和控制;设计了一款基于无线传感和存储的无线通信模块。以温湿度测量为例;用温湿度传感器DHT11采集温湿度数据;系统使用ZigBee协议栈;以CC2530作为数据处理内核;实现数据的无线传输;并使用STC12C5A60S2单片机和USB2.0控制器CH376芯片实现海量数据的存储功能。该模块的数据传输可靠性较高且价格低廉;系统可扩展性较强;在粮食贮藏、环境监测等方面具有较为广阔的应用前景和实用价值。
keywords: cc2530, ch376, dht11, stc12c5a60s2, 数据存储, 无线通信
authors: 罗雪雪;陈敏;丁真真;朱泉水

title: 防爆柴油机EGR阀瞬态工况控制算法研究
abstract: 我国非道路移动机械用柴油机第四阶段排放标准即将实施;防爆柴油机EGR系统的升级改造迫在眉睫。文章设计了基于TMS320F28335的EGR阀瞬态工况控制算法;通过在EGR阀开度基础MAP上;加上经自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波算法处理的瞬态空气流量修正;来确定阀的目标开度;通过增量PID减小目标开度与实际开度的偏差;实现瞬态工况EGR率的闭环控制;并通过实验验证了算法的有效性。
keywords: egr阀, 控制算法, 瞬态工况, 防爆柴油机

title: 基于Sysbios实时操作系统的数据采样处理系统设计
abstract: 本文面向数据采样处理的系统应用需求;设计了"dsp+fpga"的硬件架构;基于sysbios实时操作系统实现了多线程并发调度;实现了低耦合分层架构设计。该设计方案简单可靠;实时性高;具有一定的工程价值。

title: 基于TMS320C6678的雷达杂波处理技术
abstract: 文中针对搜索或者跟踪雷达中遇到的杂波抑制问题;设计了一种杂波抑制方法;考虑到处理数据的实时性问题;采用了高性能的8核DSP-德州仪器的TMS320C6678;具有高速的浮点实时运算性能;并且可以挂接大容量的存储外设;对于有大数据量存储需求的处理算法可充分满足要求。文中详细阐述所采用的杂波图设计实现过程;并通过外场试验结果表明此杂波抑制方法的实现可以有效地达到去除杂波的作用。
