title: 基于FPGA+DSP的高速视频实时处理系统设计
abstract: 设计了一种基于FPGA+DSP的高性能视频实时处理系统;采用Xilinx公司的K7系列FPGA芯片作为核心控制器;采用TI公司TMS320C6455作为图形处理器。通过Camera Link总线接收高速视频数据;并将视频数据缓存在由4片DDR3-SDRAM构造64位宽的外部动态存储器内;同时根据接收视频的帧位置向DSP发送中断;DSP根据中断信息通过DMA的方式从DDR3中读取视频数据进行实时处理。试验结果表明;系统能够稳定实现分辨率1280×1024、位宽8bit、帧频520FPS的视频实时跟踪处理算法。
keywords: camera link, ddr3-sdram, dsp, fpga, 实时处理, 高速视频
affiliations: 北京青云航空仪表有限公司

title: 基于ZigBee技术的数据采集终端设计
abstract: ZigBee技术具有"自组网、低功耗、无线传输"等优点;广泛应用于数据采集、中距离通信等场合;采用ZigBee搭建网络可以有效避免有线数据传输的弊端。本研究设计了一种基于CC2530芯片的数据采集终端;支持RS485、单总线等接口;能够采集温度、湿度等数据;具有使用方便的特点。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 数据采集
affiliations: 天津理工大学中环信息学院

title: 基于负温度系数热敏电阻多通道高精度可穿戴式体温采集系统的设计
abstract: 体温通常用于筛查传染病、监测治疗。为了确定皮肤表面温度。通过恒压式测温电路测电阻的方法;研究设计了可穿戴式多点体温监测系统;以STM32F103C8T6芯片为核心处理器;负温度系数热敏电阻（negative temperature coefficient; NTC）作为感温元器件;ADS1256芯片为温度信号调理器;蓝牙模块为无线传输单元;用LABVIEW设计上位机界面。热敏电阻及分压电阻构成的恒压式电桥电路进行8路温度数据的采集;24bits超高精度模数转换模块配置差分输入对模拟信号进行放大、滤波以及模数转换;转换后的数据在单片机中处理和运算;最终通过蓝牙将数据传至上位机。采用Stein-hart方程的四阶公式对热敏电阻作线性补偿。从软件和硬件上减少环境干扰和体温分布不均的影响。分析了温传感器的温度测量误差。实验结果表明;测量系统分辨率达0.01℃;测温准确度可达±0.02℃。此设计方案;具有较高的稳定性和精确性;并且该电路结构简单、体积小、低功耗;可用于需要精密测体温场合。
keywords: 8路体温测量, 可穿戴式, 负温度系数热敏电阻, 高精度
authors: 罗辉卿;陶杰;汪平;任航宁;郭图聖;居来提·买提肉孜
affiliations: 新疆大学机械工程学院,  浙江清华柔性电子技术研究院
source: 北大核心;科学技术与工程

title: 基于DSP的机械手臂舵机控制系统
abstract: 基于无刷直流电机的机械手臂舵机控制系统设计;硬件以DSP芯片TMS320F2812为处理器;手臂由4个关节舵机及其支撑连接杆组成;通过位置传感器实现位置信号的采集与反馈;实现对舵机运动角度的精确闭环控制;从而实现机械手臂4自由度旋转控制。系统的软件包括DSP2812主控程序、初始化程序、A/D信号采集程序、误差计算及控制算法实现程序;以及PWM占空比计算及分配程序。操作者能通过上位机输入指令控制机械手的运行。
keywords: dsp, 机械手臂, 舵机控制
affiliations: 四川建筑职业技术学院

title: 基于DSP的多级带式输送机智能控制系统设计
abstract: 多级带式输送机系统普遍存在能耗高、煤炭运输效益低等问题;采用变频驱动有助于优化机组运行状态;但由于煤炭产量的不确定性;很难实现多级带式输送机的智能控制。分析了阻力和运煤量等能耗影响因素;利用BP神经网络建立带式输送机输出功率优化模型;以TMS320F2812 DSP控制器为核心设计变频驱动和实时测量系统。在运煤过程中;由实际运煤量和BP神经网络模型优化带式输送机运行;既提高煤炭运输效益;又实现多级带式输送机系统的智能控制。
keywords: bp神经网络, dsp, 多级带式输送机, 智能控制
affiliations: 山西工程职业学院

title: 基于CC2530的火灾报警与逃生系统研究
abstract: 我国火灾报警与逃生系统的研究起步较晚。随着国家对消防安全的越来越重视;火灾报警与逃生系统的技术日趋成熟;消防部门确定的消防安全重点单位均已经投入使用了火灾自动报警系统等各类应急管理系统。本研究采用先进的无线传感器和基于CC2530芯片的物联网云平台技术组成完善的无线监控网络;附加了传统消防系统中缺少的自动化逃生系统;从而更好地保障逃生人员的生命安全。
keywords: cc2530, 无线传感器, 火灾报警与逃生系统研究, 物联网云平台
affiliations: 安徽国防科技职业学院城市建设学院

title: 基于ZigBee和云端的列车轴温监测系统设计
abstract: 为了实时监控列车的轴温;设计开发了基于ZigBee和云端的列车轴温监测系统。列车管理人员可以通过电脑端和移动终端实时监控列车轴温;并设置温度阈值提示报警;紧急避免危险的发生。系统由多个安装在车轴的终端节点和一个监控协调器组成;终端和协调器均采用低功耗、低成本的ZigBee处理器CC2530。轴温数据通过DS18B20高精度温度传感器采集并传输给终端节点。当终端节点与协调器自组网成功后;将数据传输给协调器。协调器将多个终端节点数据打包通过串口发送给上位机;最后由上位机通过TCP协议发送数据给指定云端服务器和移动终端。系统运行稳定;灵活;具有广阔的应用前景。
keywords: tcp协议, zigbee, 处理器cc2530, 数字温度传感器ds18b20, 轴温
affiliations: 青岛大学自动化学院
source: 北大核心;传感器与微系统

title: 智能低压直流断路器的设计
abstract: 介绍了智能低压直流断路器的基本组成和控制系统方案。详细介绍了其核心部件智能保护装置的硬件设计和软件实现。装置以高性能DSP芯片TMS320F28335为核心;采用16位高精度ADC芯片AD7606采集模拟量;并进行了双机热备的容错设计和自诊断设计;有效提高了设备的精确度和可靠性。文中介绍了快速脱扣器驱动模块。针对断路器的应用船进行了分断试验;并给出了试验波形;结果表明断路器具有良好的快速性。
keywords: ad7606, dsp, 容错设计, 智能低压直流断路器
affiliations: 武汉船用电力推进装置研究所
risk.affiliations: Wuhan Marine Electric Propulsion Equipment Research Institute (武汉船用电力推进装置研究所)

title: 基于DSP的臭氧发生器逆变电源设计
abstract: 臭氧发生器逆变电源性能是提高其产量的关键;基于此;这里提出采用数字信号处理器（DSP）控制技术对臭氧发生器逆变电源进行总体方案设计;包括主回路和控制回路方案设计。其中;主回路包括三相电源、三相整流电路、LC滤波电路、全桥逆变电路、升压电路以及负载电路;控制回路包括DSP最小系统、逆变器脉宽调制（PWM）驱动电路、信号采样电路、故障检测电路以及通讯接口电路。采用DSP TMS320F28335作为系统的主控芯片;以构成电源系统中的交流信号采样、状态指示和相位调节系统。最后;对硬件电路进行了软件调试;包括PWM驱动信号调试、移相整定功率输出调试、锁相环频率跟踪调试以及整体输出实验调试。软件调试的结果表明;这里提出的基于DSP控制的臭氧发生器逆变电源系统具有较好的正弦特性和抗干扰性以及较低的谐波失真度。
keywords: 数字信号处理器, 臭氧发生器, 逆变电源
authors: 王新春;刘景霞;李少波;张自雷
affiliations: 内蒙古科技大学信息工程学院
source: 北大核心;电力电子技术

title: 基于LC滤波直流变换地铁车辆整流装置的研制
abstract: 对一款应用于国产化地铁车辆辅助电源系统的整流装置进行设计。该装置采用了主预充回路、三相不控整流桥、基于LC滤波的移相全桥方波逆变器和全桥整流电路;主控CPU芯片为TMS320F28335。主控芯片通过对模拟量、数字量采集进行系统的核心算法控制及整流装置运行逻辑控制;在软件控制基础上优化LC参数提高输入输出电压精度及稳定性。应用Matlab进行了系统仿真之后;组装了一台样机。试验结果表明设计方案正确、输出特性效果良好。该方案的设计为后续产品推广市场打下了良好基础。
keywords: 全桥整流, 整流装置, 移相全桥方波逆变器
authors: 宫钰明;刘金晶;邹存祚;毕洪大
affiliations: 中车大连电力牵引研发中心有限公司
source: 北大核心;电力电子技术

title: 基于TMS320F28377D的混合脉宽调制策略研究
abstract: 牵引逆变器受开关频率的限制;电机电流含有丰富的谐波。电流谐波会引起电机发热严重;系统损耗大;同时还会导致电机转矩脉动;影响电机控制性能。为实现全速范围内逆变器输出脉冲电压的对称性;减小低次谐波对系统的影响;在此通过对特定次谐波消除脉宽调制（SHEPWM）原理的深入分析;提出了一种基于TMS320F28377D的混合脉宽调制（PWM）方法;实现了各调制方式的平滑切换。该方法可以满足控制算法和调制策略在一个CPU的两个核中独立运行;提高了程序运行的可靠性和高效性;可有效降低低次谐波;提高系统效率;简化了数字实现;具有一定的工程意义;仿真和实验结果表明了所提混合PWM策略及其切换方法的可行性和有效性。
keywords: 低次谐波, 混合脉宽调制, 电机
authors: 王乃福;周鹏;宋君健;黄凯
affiliations: 中车大连电力牵引研发中心有限公司
source: 北大核心;电力电子技术

title: 基于双核DSP稳定平台控制系统设计研究
abstract: 为了实现两轴稳定平台的控制，并满足系统小型化、集成化的要求，设计了一种基于双核DSP TMS320F28377D架构的伺服控制系统。描述了该系统的组成及工作原理，并给出了对陀螺与编码器信号的采集与处理、驱动电路设计、与上位机之间的RS-422通讯、双核DSP中CPU1核和CPU2核之间的信息交互及软件流程设计。与常用的DSP+FPGA硬件方案的控制系统相比，该控制系统具有体积小、性能高的优点。
keywords: tms320f28377d, 控制系统, 稳定平台
authors: 姜涛;朱业鹏;柳华勃;闫康;雷莹

title: 基于NDK的DSP网络通信技术研究
abstract: 针对TMS320C6678 DSP的嵌入式网络实现方案;对该DSP的网络控制模块和NDK进行了深入地研究与分析;实现了SYS/BIOS系统下NDK组件的初始化及配置。并以PC与DSP之间网络通信为例;介绍了PC端Winsock与DSP的NDK开发流程;通过PC与DSP的网络通信数据传输的测试;分析了影响网络通信速率的几个因素。实验结果表明;使用NDK提供的组件;可以方便快捷地实现网络应用开发。

title: 基于DSP的变压器差动保护装置的设计
abstract: 差动保护是变压器主保护之一;可靠系数高;是变压器保护装置能否准确、及时和可靠动作的关键因素之一。在分析传统差动保护装置的基础上;结合当前微机保护的发展;设计了以DSP为核心的变压器差动保护装置。首先论述了国内外变压器保护系统发展现状;建立了以全波傅里叶算法为微机保护的核心算法。根据以上理论依据;设计了以TMS320F28335芯片为控制核心的硬件系统;系统采用模块化设计;通过保护系统和管理系统完成整个保护装置的运行;最后给出软件的设计流程;实现变压器差动保护装置的设计。
keywords: 不平衡电流, 全波傅里叶算法, 励磁涌流, 硬件系统

title: 高压断路器状态实时监测与故障诊断系统研究
abstract: 高压断路器是电力系统中关键部件;对于电力系统的安全、稳定、可靠运行至关重要;因此对高压断路器的状态进行实时监测十分有意义;能及时发现高压断路器的异常运行情况;提高其运行可靠性。基于TMS320F2812芯片设计了高压断路器的实时监测与故障诊断系统;该系统由数据采集单元和数据处理单元组成;数据采集单元负责信号的整定、采样;数据处理单元负责故障诊断、状态监控、数据存储等;两个单元通过RS-485总线进行数据通信。该系统能对高压断路器的运行状态进行实时监测;并对其故障进行准确诊断;具有很高的应用价值。
keywords: 实时监测, 故障诊断, 高压断路器

title: 实现DSP重构以及免疫单粒子翻转的新方法
abstract: 针对在轨卫星控制器重构时无法使用JTAG烧录;其工作环境限制而导致更新DSP程序难的问题;以DSPTMS320F28335为例;提出一种通过串口方式在线重构DSP控制器的方案;又由于卫星在轨时DSP控制器有可能被单粒子打翻;文中提出一种主控程序冗余;以及定期或指令形式重构主程序的方法;降低单粒子翻转使控制器失效的可能性。实验结果证明;该方法简单适用;运行稳定可靠;易操作;可实现DSP TMS320F28335上电后由重构引导程序接管;解决DSP在轨重构的问题;有效降低被单粒子打翻的可能性;可应用于商业航天航空嵌入式领域。
keywords: tms320f28335, 单粒子翻转, 在轨重构, 重构引导程序

title: zigbee技术的物联网智能家居系统设计
abstract: <正>随着科学技术不断进步和发展;人们生活质量有了很大提升;越来越多的人追求家庭居住环境的智能化。传统智能家居组件的网络结构过于简洁;连接节点较少;网络稳定性不强。因此;本文根据人们对智能家居系统的实际需求;在zigbee技术的基础上;设计出一种实用性强的智能家居系统;并对单片机、上位机进行设计;用来进行数据信息的采集与控制。zigbee技术具有低功耗、低成本、组网能力强等优点;在智能家居系统设计中应用该技术;可以缩短开发应用时间;减少生产成本。开发该系统设计应用CC2530芯片;能够提高相关硬件系统的拓展性。

title: 电梯门间隙检测装置的研究与设计
abstract: 本文阐述了一种电梯门间隙检测装置的结构、硬件与软件设计。该装置采用激光位移传感器对电梯门门扇与门套之间的间隙进行检测;传感器信号经CC2530处理后无线传输至现场控制平板电脑（PAD）进行处理。与传统的人工检测方式相比;采用该装置进行检测可提高工作效率;减少误差。经实际应用证明;该装置具有一定的实际应用价值。
keywords: cc2530, 激光位移传感器, 电梯门, 间隙检测

title: 基于TMS320C6678 DSP的雷达数字信号处理软件设计
abstract: 现代雷达处理的信号带宽越来越大;处理算法越来越复杂;为了满足雷达的实时性处理要求;对硬件平台的要求也越来越高;本文介绍了在新型的TMS320C6678 DSP上实现雷达数字信号处理软件的过程及方法。结果表明;该软件实现方法能够满足功能及实时性要求。

title: 一种远距离ZigBee模组中的射频放大器的设计实现
abstract: 该文以Octotech公司的2.4GHz IEEE 802.15.4射频信号放大器8TR8201为例;结合TI的CC2530;介绍了一种超低功率CMOS无线射频芯片的设计概要;从电路设计到程序开发两个方面来讲述8TR8201应用过程中需要注意的地方;文章结尾通过sniffer软件来抓包分析PA实现前后的信号强度;验证了该射频放大设计能满足zigbee网络中对增强信号和远距离传输的要求。

title: 基于ZigBee+GPRS的智慧校园监测系统设计
abstract: 针对目前高校规模越来越大以及校园安全隐患难以排查等问题;提出将Zigbee无线传感网络与GPRS长距离通信技术应用到校园监测系统中。采用以CC2530为核心搭建Zigbee无线传感网络;采集校园火灾、照明能耗和校园人员出入信息;并通过GPRS传输至移动终端和管理系统;实现对数据的存储、分析和显示;达到实时监测和正确决策的目标。

title: 基于ZigBee的分布式彩灯控制系统研发
abstract: 彩灯灯组采用静态方式控制光源;在光源的光通量调节、颜色变化和发光时间长短控制、距离控制等方面;难以准确实现彩灯艺术设计的原始意图。针对彩灯艺术对灯光的需求;基于CC2530构建ZigBee局域网;以树莓派为协调器;设计开发一种无线分布式彩灯控制系统。控制系统顶层为Internet网络层;连接客户端与协调器;通过客户端程序控制协调器工作;中间层为ZigBee网络层;为协调器与终端节点群的通信提供信道;底层为硬件工作层;执行光源控制任务;终端节点采取"分段接收;队列存储"机制;以提高ZigBee网络的稳定性。建立的彩灯控制系统测试结果表明;该系统能实现光源光通量以30 lm为单元进行裁剪并在0～255范围内按需调节;能实现光源0.2 s内颜色切换;发光时间任意设置;能控制255个终端节点在100 m范围内同时工作。

title: 基于数字信号处理器的振动信号采集及边缘计算系统设计
abstract: 针对机械设备振动信号状态监测中多通道高频采样时数据吞吐量大导致的网络带宽、存储空间和计算资源占用高及通信成本高的问题;基于TMS320F28335型数字信号处理器设计一种8通道信号采集及边缘计算系统;完成振动信号的采集以及信号在边缘端的初步处理;基于该系统主要元件包括微机电系统加速度计、 AD7606型模数转换采样芯片和CH395L型以太网协议栈芯片;完成系统的硬件设计;并利用子带编码技术;实现边缘计算算法在该系统的部署。结果表明;该系统能有效地采集机械设备的振动信号;基于子带编码的边缘计算方法提高了振动信号的信息密度;系统计算结果表示了机器的健康状态;可有效地用于机械设备的状态监测与进一步故障诊断。

title: 基于高阶PAM室内可见光通信系统设计与实现
abstract: 高阶脉冲幅度调制（Pulse Amplitude Modulation; PAM）方式在相同码元内可以传输更多比特信息，进一步提升了通信系统的调制效率和频带利用率。但高阶PAM调制系统的抗噪声性能较差，信号振幅在传输过程中易受信道衰减的影响。为了提升高阶PAM系统的可靠性，提出一种改进的PAM码元波形结构，改进方案使系统在相同信噪和调制阶数下误码率降低。将TMS32C6748浮点型数字信号处理器（Digital Signal Processing; DSP）作为光通信系统的控制芯片，设计并实现了基于高阶PAM室内的可见光通信系统。通过搭建实验平台验证了该方案下的系统通信性能，实验结果表明该通信系统具有误码率低、调制效率高等优点，满足高性能室内可见光通信系统的要求。

title: Design of Medium and High Voltage Soft Start Controller
abstract: Direct start of electric power will produce a strong impact current;which will reduce the service life of the motor and will also have a great impact on the power grid. In this paper;a kind of current limiting PI regulating pressure-relief soft start is designed. The soft start takes TMS320F28335 as the control core;and it collectes the current and voltage signals at the start of the motor under the action of synchronous signals. The control of the trigger angle conduction and shift direction of the thyristor realizes the adjustment of the three-phase start-up voltage and current of the motor. The parameters during the start-up process of the motor can be set according to the different load characteristics of the motor. The circuit of over-voltage and overflow detection and motor protection circuit are designed to ensure the safe and steady start of motor during the start-up process. The simulation and experimental verification of the design project show that under the same load;the start-up current of 5-7 times the rated current intensity will be generated when the motor is started under the same load;and it will be reduced to about 2 times in the soft start-up mode. It is proved that the design can significantly reduce the electric current and the voltage of the motor.
keywords: asynchronous motor, digital signal processing（dsp）, soft start, three-phase voltage regulation

title: Design of Multi-protocol Conversion Gateway in Low Energy-consuming Based on Body Area Network
abstract: For the requirement of different protocol conversion among multiple sensor devices in body area network（BAN）;we design a gateway for data integration protocol conversion among multiple and heterogeneous sensor devices. The gateway consists of a main control module based on the ARM Cortex-M3 core; a ZigBee module based on CC2530;a WiFi module and a power module. An overall design of system gateway for BAN is firstly designed. Then the hardware and software design process are introduced; and the hardware working principle; gateway workflow and the process of cloud on data are described. Finally; the serial assistant and network assistant are used to grab the data and upload them to the cloud platform. The packet loss rate; delay and other performance indicators of the gateway are simulated. After more than 30 rounds of data packet capture are tested; the packet loss rate of 500 packets is less than 1;and the delay and energy consumption are satisfactory. The experiment indicates that the designed multi-protocol conversion gateway has effectiveness and usability in the BAN.
keywords: body area network, cloud computing, gateway, multi-protocol, wi-fi

title: TMS320F28335外部中断分析与研究
abstract: 随着信息科技的发展与变革;DSP技术已成为人们广泛关注与应用的前沿技术。DSP不仅可靠性较高;而且稳定性较好、功耗较低;可以实现大规模集成。此外;它很大程度上提高了信号处理能力;可以满足更高的实时性要求。中断处理是DSP应用系统中非常重要的一个环节。TMS320F28335提供了定时器和中断器功能;因此;在数据采集、工业控制、智能测量等方面具有广泛的应用。论文主要阐述DSP芯片TMS320F28335外部中断的相关知识和中断机制;并详细说明了中断处理过程及实例分析。

title: 基于TTCAN多级网络时钟同步与加载方案研究
abstract: 针对TTP分布式实时控制系统在节点较多且存在部分节点功能简单时;大量使用TTP节点将使系统成本急剧上升的问题;论文基于TMS320F28335设计了一种多主节点余度、高可靠、高同步精度的时间触发TTCAN总线;并将其作为TTP总线网络的补充子网;实现全网络时钟同步与时间触发;满足高可靠、高确定性大型分布式实时控制系统的控制、同步、加载与成本要求;具有重要的工程应用价值。
keywords: ttcan总线, ttp总线, 分布式加载, 分布式控制
affiliations: 中国航发控制系统研究所

title: CC2530芯片无线收发深入解析
abstract: 在智能家居和智能农业系统的感知层开发中主要运用Zigbee技术;实现Zigbee技术的硬件主要为具有射频收发功能的CC2530芯片。该文通过配置CC2530芯片的寄存器;使芯片实现无线收发的功能;通过使用寄存器的方式;编写无线发送函数和无线接收函数;实现基于Basic RF的数据传输。深入研究CC2530芯片的无线收发机制;从而掌握无线收发原理;便于更好地利用芯片;增强物联网感知层开发的能力。
keywords: cc2530, 中断函数, 无线收发, 芯片寄存器

title: Design and Implementation of Defect Detection System for Packing Case Type Mark
abstract: The work aims to design a defect detection system for packing case type mark based on image processing; in order to realize the real-time and dynamic detection of the type mark defects on the air-conditioning packing case. The hardware platform of the control system was designed based on AM5728 controller; which mainly including the control unit; image acquisition and processing unit; imaging unit; etc.; and the actual test research was carried out. Several key methods were adopted; including image enhancement; morphology; defect detection; dynamic threshold segmentation algorithm; etc.; and the registration area was selected according to the characteristics of the packing case type mark image. At the same time; a dynamic threshold segmentation algorithm was given to realize defect detection by various algorithms. 250 bar code samples are collected; and the monitoring data are obtained by using the method in this paper. The accuracy rate is as high as 97.2%; and the rate of missing inspection is 0.This method has high reliability and generality and can realize the defect detection of the type mark of the packing case quickly; and solve the practical engineering problem of the real-time dynamic defect detection of the type mark on the air-conditioning packing case.
keywords: defect detection, image processing, packing case, type mark
affiliations: Gree Electric Appliances, Zhuhai Gree Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of wireless temperature sensor network based on CC2530
abstract: This paper discusses the design of wireless temperature sensor network based on CC2530;and discusses the hardware system design;software system design and system test;hoping to provide certain reference and reference for the effective design of wireless temperature sensor network.
keywords: cc2530, network design, temperature sensor, wireless
affiliations: Electric Power Research Institute of Yunnan Power Grid Co., Ltd

title: Control Algorithm Research of EGR Valve on Explosion-Proof Diesel Engine Under Transient Operation
abstract: In order to meet the fourth stage emission standard for explosion-proof diesel engine; the up grade of EGR system is needed. The transient operating condition control algorithm of EGR valve based on TMS320F28335 is designed. The target opening of EGR valve is determined by base MAP and transient air flow; the adaptive extended Kalman filtering algorithm is used in data processing of the transient air flow. The incremental PID which can realize closed-loop control was used to reduce the deviation between target opening and actual opening; and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through experiments.
keywords: control algorithm, egr valve, explosion-proof diesel engine, transient operating condition
affiliations: Taiyuan Research Institute Company Limited, China Coal Technology and Engineering Group, School of Energy and Power Engineering, North University of China

title: Design of Embedded Piston-temperature Test System for Engine
abstract: In view of the fact that there is no effective means to measure engine piston temperature;this paper designed one feasible embedded piston-temperature testing system.By selecting K-type thermocouple as temperature sensor and combining AD590 with output compensation voltage of one 2.5 Vreference voltage source;it further compensated thermocouple cold-end temperature accordingly.In addition;it adjusted AD8495 set-point voltage under present temperature to output rising edge for achieving function of adjustable trigger temperature.After collecting temperature data upon 3 test points on top of piston via embedded Analog-to-digital converter（ADC）under control of PIC single chip;it turns out this system can send all test results to receiving platform of upper computer via CC2530.Before test;the entire system was also calibrated within high-temperature cabinet.After completing a series of comparisons between actually-tested values and calibrated ones;subsequent tests upon engine bench would be conducted.And these actually-tested results show that test accuracy of the system can reach±1 ℃.It can normally operate even in high temperature environment up to 130℃;demonstrating better stability and reliability.
keywords: piston for engine, storage test, temperature test, wireless communication
affiliations: State Key Laboratory for Engine Reliability, Military Representative Bureau of Army Eqcaprhent Department in Beijing, Weichai Power Co.,Ltd., Key Laboratory of Instrumentation Science ＆ Dynamic Measurement,Ministry of Education,North University of China

title: Design of Control System in Intelligent Pressure Glue Machine for Thermal Protection Structure of Motor
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems such as low automation degree;low production efficiency;human factors affecting more;and unstable bonding quality in the thermal protection structure bonding process of solid rocket motor nozzles;the measurement and control system of intelligent press glue machine for the thermal protection structure has been designed.Based on AM5718 DSP+ARM dual core processor development;combined with the interface board of servo drive and data acquisition;the system carries out the facility controlment as a whole by processing multi-axes precision motion control and gathering high precision signal;meanwhile the controlling difficulties and solutions are elaborated;The system adopts techniques such as motion control function method by means of tracking interpolation;Multi tolerance window matching control of pressure and displacement;proportional adjustment control technology to realize coating uniformity control;etc.To realize glue coating uniformity control;rotation exhaust pressure-holding control;precision pressure control in moulding process;Compared with the original processing method;the processing time is reduced by 65%;the rate of glue overflow is reduced by more than 85%;and the qualified rate of one-time bonding is increased by 25%.
keywords: intelligent, interpolation algorithm for motion control, multi-tolerance window control, press glue control, proportional control
authors: Wang Chao;Li Peipei;Bao Le;Wang Jingxian;Wang Xinde
affiliations: No.210 Institute of The Sixth Academy of China Aerospace Science ＆Industry Corporation, Xi’an WeiKong Automation Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: BIPV Energy Storage Battery Pack Status Monitoring System Design
abstract: 针对光伏建筑一体化（building integrated PV;BIPV）储能电站蓄电池组的状态监测需求;设计了以 CC2530为控制核心、以高共模差动放大器 INA117 为电压电流信号转换电路、以 DS18B20为温度采集电路的蓄电池状态监测系统;通过多通道模拟开关 ADG732 实现了蓄电池组的单体电池电压、充放电电流和单体温度的低成本远程无线状态监测。对比试验表明;该方案的性能满足施工方的设计要求。
keywords: 供电电路, 光伏建筑一体化, 系统控制, 蓄电池组

title: Vibration signal simulation system of aero-engine based on DDS
abstract: In order to satisfy the research demands of aero-engine vibration signal; the article designs and implements the aero-engine vibration signal simulation system based on AM3358 and Virtex5.This system is composed of two parts; including the main control module and the signal generation module. The main control module uses the PC terminal host computer and touch screen for signal parameters setting and start-stop control. The signal generation module uses DDS technology to implement simultaneous analog output of vibration signals and speed signals with a wide spectrum range and high amplitude accuracy.
keywords: dds technology, vibration signal simulation, waveform superposition
affiliations: School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiaotong University

title: Parellel Processing of Radar Seeker OCOG Altitude Measurement Algorithm Based on TMS320C6678
abstract: The relative altitude of radar platform and imaging areas is an important parameter that affects the accuracy of skew geometric correction in the process of SAR imaging; and the real-time is highly required for radar altitude measurement. Because the size of the hardware using traditional single-core processor is relatively large; requirement of small volume and light weight for missile-borne radar cannot be met. In this paper; a project based on TMS320 C6678 which is published by Texas Instruments（TI） was put forward to solve the above issue. Firstly; the principle of OCOG（Offset Center Of Gravity） altitude measurement algorithm was introduced; secondly; the hardware platform and implementation method of high-speed multi-core parallel processing is introduced; finally; the process was tested and measured to verify the real-time performance and effectiveness of altitude measurement results of the method proposed in this paper.
keywords: ocog altitude measurement, parallel processing, tms320c6678
affiliations: No.38 Research Institute of CETC

title: Design of interferometer measurement and control system based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the problems that traditional interferometers need to manually adjust mechanical devices and the degree of automation is low;a wireless measurement and control system with ZigBee-CC2530 as the core is designed. The system use two CC2530 nodes as radio frequency signal transceivers to implement wireless control functions in a point-to-point communication manner. At the same time;the Microsoft basic class library MFC（ Microsoft Foundation Classes） is used to design the host computer software to control the operation of the precision motor through serial communication;and the corresponding travel limit solution is designed based on different conditions in the narrow and compact space of the interferometer;so that the precision motor can meet the measurement and control requirements for fixed-point braking;improve the measurement efficiency and accuracy of the interferometer.
keywords: interferometer, microsoft foundation classes host computer, wireless control
affiliations: Suzhou H＆L Instruments LLC, School of Optical-Electrical and Computer Engineering,University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

title: Wireless Monitoring System for Warehouse Environment Based on CC2530
abstract: A wireless monitoring system for warehouse environment is designed for the existing wired monitoring system of warehouse environment parameters;the wiring needs a large number of cables;and the workload of system maintenance or upgrade is large.The system uses CC2530 as the core processor to build network nodes;and sets up ZigBee wireless network to carry out monitoring information transmission.The wireless monitoring system has the advantages of flexible sampling arrangement;simple and quick installation;convenient inspection and maintenance.System expansion;improvement;optimization of flexible;easy to solve the warehouse cable wiring complex environment monitoring system;solve the problem of high cost cable;improve the flexibility of the warehouse environment monitoring system and the continuous improvement of convenience;the environment monitoring system for warehouse field of process improvement and cost control effect significantly;which can help improve the quality and safety of storage items.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, warehouse, wireless network

title: Design of Monitoring Circuit for Battery Charging Based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to avoid battery charging control completely relying on human to calculate time;observe temperature and judge abnormal conditions;ZigBee technology and temperature sensor are applied to battery monitoring to realize automatic control;and the monitoring circuit is designed.Infrared temperature sensor is used to collect signal;ZigBee of CC2530 chip is used for data acquisition;sorting and transmission.Through wireless transmission module;the computer terminal collects data and displays it in real time.The power supply is controlled by contactor to realize over temperature protection. Under the direct participation of less personnel;according to the requirements;through automatic detection;information processing;analysis and judgment;the expected goal is achieved:monitoring temperature;preventing accidents.
keywords: cc2530, real-time monitoring, zigbee
affiliations: 苏州工业园区职业技术学院

title: The design of the database historical hidden data collection system based on the single-chip microcomputer
abstract: The currently designed database historical hidden data collection system has low data collection accuracy;resulting in poor data acceptance rate. Based on the single-chip microcomputer;a new historical hidden data collection system is designed. The CC2530 F256 RHAR micro-processing chip and ARM9 core processor manufactured by Texas Instruments are selected as the hardware core equipment to construct a user communication module. By continuously adjusting the position of the collected data;the effective data in the database is transferred to the main control system;and the information is excluded and collected. Inconsistent external data;strengthen the management of collected data;control the circulation of collected information;transmit collected data remotely;analyze the data collection structure of the platform;and realize the design of the data collection system. The experimental results show that the historical hidden data collection system based on the single-chip microcomputer can effectively improve the accuracy of data collection and enhance the data acceptance rate.
keywords: data collection system, database, historical hidden, single-chip microcomputer
affiliations: Department of Information Engineering,Xinjiang Institute of Engineering, Institute of Control Engineering,Xinjiang Institute of Engineering

title: Passive surface-acoustic wave sensor-signal reader based on TH71221
abstract: Aiming at the problems of passive surface acoustic wave sensor reader;such as the difficulty of the hardware design;the complicate of signal processing software algorithm;this paper first to simulate the sensing signal by Matlab;meantime the key parameters involved in the algorithm are determined. Then;from the perspective of hardware system implementation;the key components of RF link are further analyzed;compared and selected. by two highly integrated RF chips TH71221;used as the system architecture of the transmit-receive in front-end;the overall circuit design of the reader is realized accordingly. Compared with the system based on discrete components;it has the characteristics of low cost;small size and easy implementation.
keywords: passive surface-acoustic, rf front-end chip, sensor, sensorsignal reader, th71221, tms320f28335
affiliations: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation No.58 Research Institute

title: Research on the design of environmental monitoring of archives warehouse based on ZigBee and ARM embedded system
abstract: In order to be able to remotely monitor the specific conditions of the internal operation environment of the archives warehouse in real time;so as to reduce unnecessary manpower;material resources and time investment; this paper puts forward the design idea of archives warehouse environment monitoring based on ZigBee technology and ARM embedded; based on wireless communication;computer control and Internet of Things technology. This paper explains the hierarchical function and frame structure of ZigBee and ARM technologies for each communication protocol.Combined with the functional requirements of system design;this paper designs the internal network wireless sensing technology of ZigBee archives and the overall system architecture. The global architecture of the system is analyzed;and the core system chip CC2530 is introduced into the B/S architecture;which is paired with the Z-Stack protocol to complete the hardware and software design of the system. The hardware platform is based on Mini2400;and the embedded ARM system is successfully transplanted to the Linux operating system. The ARM embedded intelligent communication gateway is designed. The designed system is verified by the system application test. Capable of remote and automated monitoring of the archive environment.
keywords: arm, embedded system, environmental monitoring, zigbee
affiliations: Xi’an Medical University

title: A method of software deployment of TMS320C6678 multicore processor
abstract: Software deployment for the multi-core digital signal processor TMS320C6678 is essential during the software development debugging and engineering deployment;and rapid software deployment is critical to improving system development. Aiming at improving the efficiency of the multicore processor software deployment;the characteristics of TMS320C6678 multicore processor software deployment and software bootloader mode and principle are analyzed;the implementation of the multicore Application software Deployment（MAD） utilities is studied;the production process of multicore application software image files is simplified;and the graphical conversion tools are created using Python language. With extensive engineering validation;the software deployment method and tools meet the usage requirements and significantly improve software deployment efficiency.
keywords: boot mode, multicore application software deployment, tms320c6678, two stage boot
affiliations: Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology

title: Design of selecting geometric parameters of components based on multi-layer fuzzy control
abstract: The traditional selection system does not consider the content of parameter control;which leads to lower accuracy of geometric parameters selection of single and multiple components. In order to avoid this problem;a design system for the selection of geometric parameters of components based on multi-layer fuzzy control is proposed. Analyze the function of each module according to the total system architecture. Design the system hardware structure;select TMS320F2812 digital signal processor;and convert the signal from analog domain to digital domain. Using 45 BF003 stepper motor;the excitation signal can be converted into the corresponding angular or linear displacement value. According to the multi-layer fuzzy controller;two control modes are set. Without considering the special requirements of coordinated control;the reasoning rules for design parameter demand strength are designed;and the geometric parameters of the components are selected according to the rules to realize the system design of the geometric parameters of the components. From the system test results;it is known that the accuracy of the geometric parameter selection of single and multiple components of the system can reach 91% and88% respectively;providing equipment for centralized control of components.
keywords: component geometry, digital signal processor, multi-layer fuzzy control, parameter selection
affiliations: Zhejiang SEOKHO Robot Technology Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of intelligent schoolbag based on BLE4.0
abstract: With bluetooth module CC2541 as the control core;an intelligent schoolbag based on BLE4.0 is designed by using relevant sensor technology.The host bluetooth module and the slave bluetooth module build a bluetooth wireless transmission network. The host can obtain the receiving signal strength indicator value from the slave.Through the host internal MCU processing data.After the data processing is expected to be completed;the instruction is written to the slave machine;andslave machine according to the instructions to achieve the intelligent schoolbag automatic follow.Through testing;the intelligent schoolbag can achieve automatic follow;it will automatically alarm when the distance between the host and the slaveexceeds the safe distance or is overweight.Further;it makes up the defects of the existing school bags and has important value of popularization and application.
keywords: automatic follow, ble4.0, cc2541, master-slave connection, rssi
authors: WANG Chuangchao;YANG Yanning;MENG Fanlong;ZHANG Lu;ZHU Peng;LIU Ding
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information,Yan’an University

title: Design of ZigBee experimental system for protocol stack
abstract: Networking exercise is the key content of the ZigBee experiment.And the protocol stack plays an important role in the networking experiment.Combining the characteristics of ZigBee technology and taking environmental monitoring as the application background;a ZigBee experimental system is designed.The experimental system takes CC2530 and digital temperature and humidity sensor as the core to realize data collection and transmission between master and slave nodes;as well as point-to-multipoint and two-point communication.The host computer is designed with LabVIEW;and the mobile client is developed with the aid of the Eclipse4.1 platform;which can communicate with the server through the mobile client.Using this experimental system;can complete networking experiments such as serial ports;buttons;wireless data transmission;wireless lighting etc;as well as mobile client program development and LabVIEW system simulation.It has strong openness and secondary development capabilities;which is beneficial to improve students′ practice innovation ability and ZigBee system development ability.
keywords: environmental monitoring, labview, networking exercise, zigbee
affiliations: School of Communication and Electronic Engineering,Qiqihar University
source: Journal of Science of Teachers’ College and University.

title: TMS320C6678平台软件设计优化策略综述
abstract: ＜正＞德州仪器公司2010年推出的8核DSP芯片TMS320C6678是目前商用市场上计算性能最高的DSP之一;已在图像处理、无线电通信基站、雷达和声纳等领域得到了一定范围的应用。相比上一代被广泛应用的TS201芯片;其优点是硬件规模大、工作主频高、对外传输能力强和大容量外部存储空间;缺点是平均内存小、架构复杂、共享资源竞争激烈和调度复杂。
affiliations: 杭州应用声学研究所

title: 改进线性PID算法的直流电机控制
abstract: ＜正＞直流电机和步进电机的运行特点不同;通过设置步进电机的运转步数来控制转过的角度;而直流电机不能直接精确地实现旋转角度的控制。通常会将电位计和直流电机配合使用;电位计的电位值和电机旋转角度是一一映射关系;通过采集指示直流电机旋转角度的电位值反馈控制直流电机旋转的角度。处理器选择TI的DSP的2000系列处理器TMS320F28335。
affiliations: 中国兵器工业第214研究所

title: 电梯门间隙检测装置的研究与设计
abstract: 本文阐述了一种电梯门间隙检测装置的结构、硬件与软件设计。该装置采用激光位移传感器对电梯门门扇与门套之间的间隙进行检测;传感器信号经CC2530处理后无线传输至现场控制平板电脑（PAD）进行处理。与传统的人工检测方式相比;采用该装置进行检测可提高工作效率;减少误差。经实际应用证明;该装置具有一定的实际应用价值。
keywords: cc2530, 激光位移传感器, 电梯门, 间隙检测
affiliations: 六盘水师范学院

title: 基于TMS320C6678 DSP的雷达数字信号处理软件设计
abstract: 现代雷达处理的信号带宽越来越大;处理算法越来越复杂;为了满足雷达的实时性处理要求;对硬件平台的要求也越来越高;本文介绍了在新型的TMS320C6678 DSP上实现雷达数字信号处理软件的过程及方法。结果表明;该软件实现方法能够满足功能及实时性要求。
keywords: 信号带宽, 实时性, 过程及方法
affiliations: 四川九洲防控科技有限责任公司

title: 一种远距离ZigBee模组中的射频放大器的设计实现
abstract: 该文以Octotech公司的2.4GHz IEEE 802.15.4射频信号放大器8TR8201为例;结合TI的CC2530;介绍了一种超低功率CMOS无线射频芯片的设计概要;从电路设计到程序开发两个方面来讲述8TR8201应用过程中需要注意的地方;文章结尾通过sniffer软件来抓包分析PA实现前后的信号强度;验证了该射频放大设计能满足zigbee网络中对增强信号和远距离传输的要求。
keywords: 8tr8201, cc2530, pa, zigbee
affiliations: 深圳市麦驰安防技术有限公司

title: Design of High Precision Multichannel Wearable Body Temperature Measurement System Based on Negative Temperature Coefficient
abstract: Body temperature is commonly used to screen patients for infectious diseases; monitor therapy. In order to determine the skin temperature. A wearable multichannel temperature monitoring system was designed by means of constant voltage Bridge circuit. STM32 F103 C8 T6 was taken as the CPU; NTC（negative temperature coefficient） thermistor as the temperature sensing component; ADS1256 as the temperature signal conditioning module; Bluetooth as the wireless transmission module. Display device was designed by LABVIEW. A bridge circuit composed of NTC thermistors and resistors was used to collect eight-channel temperature signals. A 24-bit high precision ADC module was used to amplify filter and convert analog voltage signals and to access body temperature data. Then Transmission the data to the computer through Bluetooth. Meanwhile; A Stein-hart equation is used to fit the temperature-resistance curve of NTC thermistor. The impact of environmental interference and uneven distribution of body temperature was reduced by the means of software and hardware.The measurement error of temperature sensor was analyzed. The experiment show that the resolution of the measurement system is 0.01 ℃; and the accuracy of temperature measurement can reach ±0.02 ℃. This system presents a new design scheme; which has strong stability and high practical measurement accuracy. The Measuring circuit has the advantages of simple structure; low cost; low power consumption and small volume; and can be used in the system that needs precise temperature measurement.
keywords: eight-channel body temperature measurement, high precision, ntc thermistor, wearable
authors: TAO Jie;GUO Tu-sheng;LUO Hui-qing;WANG Ping;JULAITI Maitirouzi;REN Hang-ning
affiliations: Mechanical Engineering College, Xinjiang University, Institute of Flexible Electronic Technology of Tsinghua

title: Four-sided ranging underground personnel positioning system based on RSSI
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inaccurate personnel positioning in coal mine; a mine positioning system based on quadrilateral ranging algorithm is designed. The system adopts ZigBee technology and consists of wireless sensor network with CC2530 as the main control chip. In the localization module; the sensor node is composed of a mesh network topology; which has the function of information collection; transmission and positioning. Firstly; The positioning algorithm adopts a four-sided ranging positioning algorithm which is different from the traditional three-sided ranging algorithm. The algorithm firstly selects four beacon nodes with the four-sided ranging model. Then USES the weighted mean model to process the RSSI value collected from the same node. Finally; the square of the distance converted from the RSSI value is used as the weighting factor to obtain the unknown node location coordinates. The four-side ranging positioning system has more advantages than the traditional three-side ranging positioning system with higher positioning accuracy and real-time positioning.
keywords: cc2530, mesh network, quadrilateral ranging algorithm, real time positioning, rssi, zigbee
affiliations: Henan Key Laboratory of Optoelectronic Sensing Integrated Application,Henan Normal University, College of Electronic and Electrical Engineering
source: Core;Journal of Henan Normal University(Natural Science Edition).

title: 基于TMS320F28335的直流无刷电机控制技术应用
abstract: 近年来直流无刷电机以质量轻、调速范围精确和故障率低等优点被应用于汽车、工业机器人和家用电器等领域;根据电机调速特性;可分为直接转矩控制和脉宽调速控制;按照直流无刷电机导通形式可分为三三导通和两两导通;在闭环控制中;直流无刷电机控制方式有PID控制、抗扰控制、模糊控制和自适应控制等多种形式。其中;电机高性能的精确控制需要电机本体、驱动和控制器组成;常见的直流无刷电机控制芯片是由TI公司生产的TMS320F28335芯片;它具有专门的霍尔输入模块和电机换相、死区补偿等模块;参考不同的应用环境和要求;可选择适合直流无刷电机特性的控制方式。
keywords: pid, 异步交流电机, 直流无刷电机, 调速

title: 基于自供电无线传感网的环境监测设计与实现
abstract: 采用ZigBee无线传感网技术设计了一种自供电低功耗无线传感网的环境监测系统。使用太阳能光伏电池板采集环境能量实现自供电功能;超低功耗处理器模块CC2530作为主控芯片降低节点能耗;Mos管及其驱动模块调节占空比以提高太阳能的采集效率。通过对系统数据分析比较;结果表明自供电系统能有效利用太阳能的特性进行充电;实现等效阻抗;系统稳定性可达到95%以上;实现了自供电系统的最优功能。

title: 基于蓝牙通信的LED智能照明系统设计
abstract: 随着生活质量的提高与智能手机的广泛使用;人们越来越注重生活的智能化、简便化及人性化;而智能照明就是当前探究的热点课题。文章根据日用消费级设备特征;使用CC2541芯片使智能移动设备和STC89C52RC单片机完成蓝牙通信;通过无线形式传递一系列智能照明信号;最后基于LED驱动模块使得LED灯处于照明状态。经PWM调节完成LED灯光的启闭、强弱和颜色等操控;通过实验检验具有可操作性;满足设计所需。

title: Clutter Suppression Technology of Search Radar based on TMS320C6678
abstract: One method of the Clutter suppression for clutter suppression in search or tracking radar. Considering the realtime problem of data processing; this design uses high performance 8-core DSP-TEXAS INSTRUMENTS’ TMS320 C6678;it has the High-speed floating-point real-time operation performance. Meanwhile;it can be connected the large storage peripherals;for the processing algorithm with large data storage requirements;it can fully meet the requirements..In this paper the design and implementation of clutter map are described in detail.The experimental results show that the clutter suppression method can effectively eliminate clutter.

title: The Design of Data Acquisition Terminal Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: ZigBee technology has the advantages of "ad-hoc network; low power consumption; wireless transmission" and so on. It is widely applied in the occasions including data acquisition; medium-range communication; etc. Building network by adopting ZigBee can effectively avoid the disadvantages of wired data transmission. This paper designs an easy-to-use data acquisition terminal based on CC2530 chip; which supports RS485; single bus and other interfaces; and can collect data such as temperature;humidity and so on.

title: Design of Absolute Encoder Interface Circuit Based on Beaglebone Black
abstract: In order to improve the resolution and measurement accuracy of absolute encoder without increasing volume and weight; the interface circuit of absolute encoder is studied and designed. Among them; Beaglebone black based on AM3358 processor is selected as the Linux embedded development platform; the system control is unified in the open source framework of Python language; and the control signal is sent by the communication mode of SSI protocol; so as to detect the basic performance of absolute encoder. Through the test experiment; it is proved that the design scheme of the interface circuit of the absolute value encoder is feasible and has reliable measurement accuracy and resolution of the absolute value encoder.
keywords: absolute encoder, beaglebone black, python, ssi protocol
affiliations: State Nulclear Power Plant Serivice Company

title: Design of environmental monitoring system for agricultural greenhousebased on Internet of things
abstract: In order to realize the real-time remote monitoring on agricultural greenhouse environment parameter; the study presents a kind of agricultural greenhouse environment monitoring system based on Internet of things technology. The system uses ZigBee as the core technology and CC2530 F256 microcontroller as the main controller. ZigBee nodes is equipped with five sensors including temperature-humidity; gas concentration; light intensity; air pressure and soil humidity; which is used to realize real-time monitoring of environmental parameters. So; the parameter values have been uploaded to the mobile APP through WIFI module. Users can analyze and judge data and issue control instructions; thus the lower computer performs the actions of exhaust; irrigation; alarm; etc.; so to realize remote monitoring and smart management of agricultural greenhouse environment information.
keywords: agricultural greenhouse, internet of things, monitoring system, sensor, zigbee
authors: WANG Ming-wu;WU Jia-qi;LI Wu-lin;ZHANG Jun;YANG Li

title: Research on Wireless Temperature and Humidity Data Acquisition and Storage Module Based on ZigBee and CC2530
abstract: In this paper; a wireless communication module based on wireless sensing and storage is designed for environmental monitoring and control of some process-dependent activities. It mainly conducts temperature and humidity measurement; and collects temperature and humidity data with temperature and humidity sensor DHT11. The system uses ZigBee protocol stack and takes CC2530 as data processing core to realize wireless transmission of data; and uses STC12C5A60S2 single-chip microcomputer and USB2.0 controller CH376 chip to achieve massive data storage. The system has high reliability; low price and strong scalability; and it has broad application prospect and practical value in grain storage and environmental monitoring.
keywords: cc2530, ch376, data storage, dht11, stc12c5a60s2, wireless communication

title: Design of Wireless Fire Alarm System Based on CC2530
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of traditional fire alarm system;a ZigBee wireless fire monitoring and alarm system based on CC2530 as the core control chip is designed. The hardware design and software control of the whole system is introduced in detail. Through many tests;the system has the advantages of stable performance;low power consumption;good scalability;convenient maintenance and low cost;which can be widely used in various environmental fire monitoring.
keywords: cc2530, fire alarm, sensor, wireless network, zigbee

title: 智能交通专业车辆监控实训系统开发
abstract: 智能交通实训设备的投入需要大量资金;并且只针对某个实训项目;不能满足学生实训要求;因此;利用现有资源进行车辆监控实训系统的开发具有现实意义。通过TMS320F28335型处理器;利用ZigBee无线网络技术;结合学院现有沙盘;开发了车辆监控系统;节约经费的同时;实现教研相长。

title: Design of Visual Control System for Laser Interferometer
abstract: In order to improve the measuring accuracy of laser interferometer;a visual control method is proposed. This method realizes the sending of control command and the display of the position of optical adjustment unit synchronously through a simple Windows form application. The control command is sent to the MCU of CC2530;and the MCU completes the corresponding control action according to the command;STM32 F103 C8 T6 MCU sends the collected position data to the control application;and displays the position of each adjustment unit after application processing. The control system can realize multi-gear and customized fine-tuning control of the laser interferometer;and the display of position makes the control more intuitive. By means of improving the control precision;the optical measuring environment can reach a better state;so as to improve the measurement precision of interferometer.
keywords: cc2530, laser interferometer, stm32f103c8t6, visual control
affiliations: Suzhou H＆L Instruments Ltd., School of Optical-Electrical and Computer Engineering,University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

title: Three-phase AC Motor Control System based on Python Serial Port
abstract: In this paper;DSP TMS320F28335 is used as the main control chip.The voltage;current and speed signals sampled by ADC and eQep modules are transmitted to the DSP for processing;and then the DSP sends the data to the host computer for display through the serial port.At the same time;the host computer software programmed using Python can also control the start and stop;forward and reverse rotation;acceleration and deceleration of the motor in its interface.
keywords: python, serial port, tms320f28335
authors: Li Xuebin;Peng Hao;Shi Shaobing;Zhang Sanlin;Zhang Hao

title: Design of a Servo Control System of Side Lamp FOD Detection Equipment
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of servo control system of side lamp FOD detection equipment，and introduces the design and implementation of servo control system from three aspects：turntable frame design，servo controller hardware design and servo controller software design.In the structure，the stepping motor is decelerated by planetary reduction mechanism and gear pair，the hardware of servo controller adopts TMS320F28335 as the main processing chip，and the software is designed and implemented by modular method.The servo control system has been realized and has passed the environmental tests of high and low temperature and vibration shock，which can meet the requirements of working mode，accuracy，environmental adaptability and remote update.
keywords: fod, servo control software, servo controller, turntable structure design

title: Research and Implementation of Intelligent Basketball Counting System
abstract: In view of the difficulty in calculating the hit rate in shooting training and the fairness of campus sports basketball examination;this paper proposes an intelligent basketball counting system based on ZigBee network.The system uses CC2530 hardware chip to build sensor network through ZigBee technology;the network communication uses Socket technology to connect the master computer with the server;the server is built based on MVC three-tier architecture to interact with the user through the Web page.The system realizes the function of real-time monitoring and historical data inquiry of the number of goals;serve and hit rate of the long-distance shooting.The system has the advantages of low power consumption;low cost;simple operation;strong scalability;etc.;and has certain promotion and application value.
keywords: basketball counting, infrared antitube, real-time, web, winform, z-stack, zigbee

title: Development of multi-point patrol monitoring system for gantry crane stress based on CC2530
abstract: This paper introduces the development of a multi-point itinerant stress monitoring system for gantry crane based on CC2530. The system uses CC2530 as the core processing unit; and forms a data acquisition network with coordinator nodes and resistance strain sensor monitoring nodes to collect the multi-point stress of different parts of gantry crane in real time. When the stress exceeds the threshold value; it will send an alarm to the user immediately; so as to realize the real-time monitoring and management of gantry crane equipment.
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition network, gantry crane, monitoring system

title: Design and implementation of high speed image processing system based on XC7K325T and TMS320C6678
abstract: According to the characteristics of high-speed image target recognition and tracking system; such as large amount of calculation; high transmission rate and strong real-time performance;A high performance real-time image processing system based on XC7 k325 t and TMS320 c6678 is developed. The system adopts FPGA and multi-core DSP parallel processing and pipeline operation technology;to realize high-speed image target recognition and tracking. The test results show that the system meets the design requirements.
keywords: high speed image processing system, multiprocessing kernel, rapidio, tms320c6678, xc7k325t
affiliations: China Institute of Flight Testing

title: Design of Intelligent Security System for College Dormitory Based on ZigBee Network
abstract: Aiming at the intelligent demand of college dormitory security management; this paper designs an intelligent security system for college dormitory based on ZigBee network. The system uses STM32 and CC2530 microcontrollers as the core control modules of the back-end control gateway and hardware nodes of the system; respectively. The hardware node transmits the real-time monitoring environment and security data collected by the sensor to the back-end control gateway through the ZigBee network; and triggers the alarm mechanism in the case of abnormal data; so as to realize the purpose of intelligent management of college dormitory security.
keywords: cc2530, college dormitory, security monitoring, stm32, zigbee

title: Design of low-power wireless smoke alarm
abstract: The traditional smoke alarm has the problems of high power consumption and cannot be interconnected; so it is difficult to meet the requirements of practical applications. This paper designed a low-power wireless smoke alarm; using a lowpower; low-voltage special integrated circuit RE46 C190 for photoelectric smoke detector and an ultra-low-power wireless single-chip CC1310 less than 1 GHz; so that the system standby current is about 14 μA; the theoretical standby life is up to 11 years; and the wireless communication distance reaches 1 km. It satisfactorily meets the requirements of low power consumption and wireless interworking; and provides a new solution for smart fire protection research.
keywords: low power consumption, smoke alarm, wireless communication
affiliations: School of Instrumentation Science and Optoelectronic Engineering,Beijing Information Science and Technology University

title: Design of environmental monitoring system for cold storage based on ZigBee
abstract: Taking temperature;humidity and carbon dioxide concentration as monitoring parameters;CC2530 is selected as the core chip of the system node;and a cold storage environment monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is designed and implemented;other related hardware circuits are also designed;and the hardware design of the node has been completed.On the basis of hardware;the software of coordinator;routing node and terminal node and the data acquisition program of sensor are designed combined with ZigBee protocol stack.Finally;the upper computer of the system is designed and implemented.
keywords: cold storage, environmental monitoring system, zigbee
affiliations: Institute of Mechanical Engineering

title: Risk Analysis and Early Warning System for Underground Utility Tunnel
abstract: The risk analysis and early warning system for underground utility tunnel is introduced.The perception layer is based on the sensor network.The software defined network（SDN） technology based on CC2650 chip is used for communication layer.Huawei Cloud visualization platform as the data display platform is taken for application layer.The system realizes the automatic acquisition; intelligent transmission and information management of the utility tunnel.
keywords: application layer, communication layer, perception layer, risk analysis and early warning system, utility tunnel
authors: LUO Yuqiu;ZHANG Yang;QIU Shiyin;JIN Yong;GENG Pan
affiliations: Shanghai Maritime University

title: Design of 3D simulation system for green building
abstract: In order to solve the problem of recognition ability reduction caused by the excessive number of polygonal networks in the traditional simulation system;a 3 D simulation system for green building was designed. In the hardware design;the panoramic camera is used to obtain the full-angle images of the green building;and with the support of the ZigBee baseboard;the CC2530 chip is used to control the sensor to obtain the building space position and tilt angle information. In the software design;the object-oriented method is adopted to design the green building foundation;and the design of the pile foundation is optimized in consideration of safety and cost. The virtual visual technology is used for texture mapping and seamless connection of the framework after constructing the green building framework. The test results show that the designed 3 D simulation system for green building has complete texture mapping; high consistency of building components during the simulation process;and hith identifiable ability.
keywords: 3d simulation, data acquisition, green building, performance testing, seamless connection, system design, texture mapping
affiliations: Hebei University of Engineering

title: WSN mobile node three-dimensional localization system based on RSSI and LSSVR
abstract: A design method of three-dimensional localization system for mobile nodes in wireless sensor network（WSN）is proposed in this paper on the basis of received signal strength indication（RSSI）ranging method and the least square support vector regression（LSSVR） localization algorithm. The ranging principle of RSSI and the mobile node three-dimensional localization principle of LSSVR are introduced. Then the hardware architecture is given;which is composed of CC2530;data processing computer and remote control tracked vehicle with unknown node. The networking method of localization system and the realization flow of node software are given;in which the joint development technology using C#.NET;Matlab and Javascript is adopted. The test experiment for mobile node localization is carried out with the designed localization system. The experimental results show that the localization system can locate the unknown mobile nodes at the speed of 20 cm/s and 40 cm/s;and the average localization error is 14.62% and 15.55% respectively. The localization system has a high localization accuracy and can meet the practical application requirements of three-dimensional localization for WSN mobile nodes.
keywords: 3d localization system, hardware architecture, least squares support vector regression, mobile node localization, received signal strength indication, wireless sensor network
affiliations: College of Mechanical and Control Engineering,Guilin University of Technology

title: Research on photoelectric sensor wireless communication module based on CCD charge coupler
abstract: In the current CCD（charge coupled device）video image sensor;the wired data transmission or wireless local area network are used for the information transmission;which brings in wiring difficulties;high wiring costs;dependence on infrastructure and limited application scenarios. In view of this;a wireless sensor based on the CCD integrated chip TCD142 D and CC2530 is designed. In addition;a photoelectric sensor wireless communication module based on 2.4 GHz communication is designed. An experiment was designed for effectiveness verification. In the experiment;the acquisition end is responsible for the perception of the image information;and the optical signals of the perceived information were converted into the charge signals by a CCD; and then the charge signals were converted into voltage signals by the charge transfer principle to realize photoelectric conversion. The wireless communication module is responsible for the modulation and transmission of the perceived signals. The receiver is responsible for the demodulation and restoration after receiving the signals and the presentation of the picture with PC. The effectiveness of the wireless communication module has been verified effectively.
keywords: charge coupler, charge transfer, demodulation, photoelectric conversion, photoelectric sensor, wireless communication module

title: Design of software development system for internet classroom teaching under Internet plus
abstract: A software development system for internet classroom teaching under Internet plus is designed to improve the storage capacity in software development system of network classroom teaching. The hardware part of the system is mainly designed;including single chip microcomputer and controller. The single chip microcomputer is used to provide the data storage function;and the TMS320LF2407A chip is used as the main controller. In the system software part;the resource database is built;and the constructed resource database can connect with the teaching system used port to transmit data;so as to complete the design of the software development system of the internet classroom teaching under the Internet plus. The experimental results show that the software development system of internet classroom teaching under Internet plus has strong storage ability;maximum concurrent number and fast throughput;and has great advantages.
keywords: data storage, data transmission, internet classroom teaching, internet plus, software development system, system design

title: Depth Analysis of CC2530 Chip Wireless Transceiver
abstract: In the development of the sensing layer of smart home and intelligent agriculture system;ZigBee technology is mainly used.The hardware of ZigBee technology is CC2530 chip with RF transceiver function.In this paper;through the configuration of CC2530 chip register;the chip realizes the wireless transceiver function;through the use of registers;the wireless sending function and wireless receiving function are written to realize the data transmission based on basic RF.In depth study of CC2530 chip wireless transceiver mechanism;so as to master the wireless transceiver principle;facilitate better use of the chip;enhance the ability to develop the perception layer of the Internet of things.
keywords: cc2530, chip register, interrupt function, wireless transceiver
affiliations: Dalian Vocational ＆ Technical College

title: Design and Research of Plantar Pressure Sensing System for Lower Limb Exoskeleton Robot
abstract: In response to the demand for real-time acquisition and monitoring of plantar pressure signals required for the control of the lower limb exoskeleton robot; a plantar pressure sensing system for lower limb exoskeleton robot is developed. TMS320 F2812 is used as central control chip in the system. An A/D sampling peripheral circuit is constructed to realize the conversion of analog pressure signals to digital signals. Based on the MAX3232 chip; the RS-232 communication interface circuit is designed. And real-time monitoring interface of the plantar pressure information is developed and compiled based on LabVIEW 14.0. The obtained pressure digital information is transmitted to the upper computer software monitoring interface through the RS-232 serial interface circuit to realize the real-time monitoring of the plantar pressure information. After the hardware circuit connection completed; the baudrate; data format; stop bit; parity bit and other information of the serial port communication in real-time monitoring interface of the plantar pressure information are configured. When the configuration is completed; run the program and apply force on the stress area of the plantar pressure sensor; and observe the monitoring interface in the host computer. It is shown in experiments that in the control of the lower limb exoskeleton robot; the system can accurately collect plantar pressure information and monitor the dynamic response of plantar pressure information in real time.
keywords: labview, lower limb exoskeleton robot, membrane pressure sensor, serial communication, tms320f2812

title: The Design of Multi-channel Thermocouple Temperature Measurement Circuit
abstract: In this paper; a multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement system is designed for the heat treatment furnace and product temperature distribution during thermal processing. The system applies the multiplexer HCF4052 to realize the control of multi-channel measurement; and realizes the USB transmission and wireless transmission of data through the interface conversion chip T232 RL and the wireless transmission module CC3200. Experimental results have proved that the multi-channel thermocouple temperature measurement circuit can reach a measurement accuracy of 1℃ in the temperature range of（0-1600）℃.
keywords: cold junction compensation, multi-channel temperature measurement, thermocouple

title: Design of Digital High Frequency Q Meter
abstract: A digital high-frequency Q-meter is designed to generate adjustable high-frequency signal based on AD9958. After current expansion by BUF634; it carries out partial voltage impedance transformation and is added into LC resonant circuit. The 24 bit high-precision analog-to-digital converter ADS1256 collects the true RMS of input and output; and is input into STM32 F4 to calculate and display the loop inductance; harmonic frequency; Q value and other parameters. The test results show that the digital high frequency Q-meter has the advantages of high measurement accuracy and simple operation compared with the traditional mechanical Q-meter.
keywords: ads1256, digital high frequency q-meter, impedance transformation, stm32f4
affiliations: School of Information Science and Engineering, Hunan Institute of Science and Technology

title: Wireless Sensors and Networks for Real-Time Temperature Measurement of Materials in Microwave Heating
abstract: Microwave is a new type of clean energy source widely used in industrial applications. However; non-uniform heating caused by selective microwave heating and the difficulty of accurate online temperature measurement in microwave field limit the efficient design and application of microwave industrial equipment. To address these problems; a microwave heating temperature measurement system based on wireless sensor network and microcontroller technology is designed; which uses STM32 as microcontroller and CC1101 as wireless transceiver to form a star-type wireless sensor network. A simple upper computer display program to realize real-time temperature measurement at multiple points in microwave heating process is developed. The wireless sensor node（End Device） uses DS18 B20 digital temperature sensor to measure the node position temperature in real time and send data; and the central node（Access Point） receives the data and upload them to PC display through RS232 serial port. The measurement results of the system and the fiber optic thermometer results are compared to verify the feasibility and accuracy of the system. The system is low-cost and flexible in deployment and control; which is suitable for tunneling industrial microwave heating and other applications.
keywords: microwave heating, real-time temperature measurement, wireless sensor networks
authors: YANG Yang;TAO Rui;TAN Yu;ZHU Hua-cheng;HUANG Ka-ma

title: Agricultural Greenhouse Automation and Monitoring System Based on Wireless Networking
abstract: In order to solve the monitoring problems of the four environmental parameters of light; gas; air temperature and soil humidity in the greenhouse and realize the automation of the greenhouse control; this paper designs a wireless networking monitoring system based on the microcontroller C2530 and uses O2 to monitor The module JXM-O2; NDIR infrared CO2 detection module; BH1750 light intensity monitoring module; temperature and humidity monitoring module DHT11; capacitive soil humidity sensor module establishes a greenhouse temperature and humidity monitoring system; which effectively solves the low measurement accuracy existing in traditional greenhouses. Problems such as high product prices; cumbersome wiring; and waste of labor resources. The wireless sensor network is established through the ZigBee communication protocol; which can realize the data communication between the microcontroller cc2530 and the host computer cc2530. The WiFi module of the host computer can achieve the goal of data communication between the mobile phone APP or the computer terminal and the host computer; and achieve the goal of data communication through the relay Switch on and off the drip irrigation; exhaust fan; warm light and other external equipment.

title: 基于ZigBee的多功能电子门牌设计
abstract: 针对传统门牌固化了板式;且门牌无法实时改变信息等问题;本文设计了一种基于ZigBee的多功能电子门牌;本设计包括数据的采集、传输及处理分析模块。系统采用ZigBee无线传感网络及ESP8266 Wi-Fi模块作为通信手段;利用CC2530芯片作为主体;通过人体识别模块及温湿度采集模块对数据进行采集;最终在LCD屏幕显示接收到的数据;达到随时更改门牌的状态、检测门牌周边温湿度信息、显示当前时间信息及节约能源等多种功能。本设计不仅增强了门牌系统的智能化与信息化;更能根据使用者的个性需求进行定制;从而解决了传统门牌所存在的板式固化、信息滞后等诸多问题;提高了人们日常生活与办公的便利性与舒适性。
keywords: zigbee, 多功能, 无线传感
affiliations: 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: 基于无线传感器网络的水产养殖水质监测系统
abstract: 集约化的水产养殖对养殖水体水质有较高的要求;不准确的测量和延迟的数据采集会影响养殖生产的顺利进行。设计了一种基于无线传感器网络的水产养殖水质监测系统;将无线传感器网络与上层应用系统有机结合;在自组网情况下实现了水产养殖相关数据的实时监测。该系统在Cotex-M4 ARM架构下以微处理器STM32F405与无线射频芯片CC2530为核心;对系统底层硬件、底层软件、应用层软件进行了开发。同时;为提高数据的准确性;采用新型支持度函数加权融合算法对系统采集的多传感器数据进行融合。整个系统测量精度高;实时性强、运行稳定;能够较好地满足水产养殖水质监测的要求。
keywords: cc2530, stm32f405, zigbee, 水产养殖, 水质监测
authors: 张红燕;匡亮;施珮;袁永明
affiliations: 中国水产科学研究院淡水渔业研究中心农业农村部淡水渔业和种质资源利用重点实验室,  江苏信息职业技术学院物联网工程学院

title: 包装箱型号标记缺陷检测系统设计与实现
abstract: 目的为了实现空调包装箱上型号标记缺陷的实时动态检测;基于图像处理技术设计包装箱型号标记缺陷检测系统。方法基于AM5728控制器设计控制系统硬件平台;主要包括控制单元、图像采集与处理单元、成像单元等;并进行实际测试研究。采用几个关键方法;包括图像增强处理、形态学、缺陷检测、动态阈值分割算法等;并根据包装箱型号标记图像特征选择配准区域;同时给出一种动态阈值分割算法;利用各种算法实现缺陷检测。结果采集了250个包装箱条码样本;采用文中方法获取到了监测数据;正确率高达97.2%;漏检率为0。结论该方法具有较高的可靠性、通用性;可实现包装箱型号标记的缺陷快速检测;解决了空调包装箱上的型号标记实时动态缺陷检测的实际工程问题。
keywords: 包装箱, 图像处理, 型号标记, 缺陷检测
affiliations: 珠海格力电器股份有限公司, 珠海格力智能装备有限公司

title: 用于充电桩的三相交错LLC谐振变换器实验平台
abstract: 三相交错并联LLC谐振变换器可以提高变换器的功率等级、降低输出电流的纹波;适用于大功率及高频的场合;在电动汽车充电中应用广泛。分析交错并联结构的特点及其对纹波的影响;设计三相交错并联LLC谐振变换器的拓扑结构。采用数字信号处理器TMS320F28035作为控制器;设计电压采样电路、电流采样电路、驱动电路以及控制器外围辅助电路;基于C语言开发系统软件;采用碳化硅材料的功率器件搭建了谐振变换器的实验平台。该实验平台有助于学生深入学习设计电力电子电路及其系统;熟悉电力电子学科前沿知识及其应用;有效提升学生的工程实践能力。
keywords: 交错并联, 电流纹波, 谐振变换器, 软开关
affiliations: 中国石油大学(华东)新能源学院

title: 基于CC2530的无线温度传感器网络的设计探析
abstract: 文章针对以CC2530为基础的无线温度传感器网络设计进行讨论;并从硬件系统设计、软件系统设计以及系统测试等方面入手展开论述;希望能够为无线温度传感器网络的有效设计提供一定的参考和借鉴。
keywords: cc2530, 无线, 温度传感器, 网络设计

title: 基于改进滑模观测器的PMSM控制系统
abstract: 针对永磁同步电机（PMSM）控制系统中常用位置传感器来获取速度反馈信息造成的系统体积大、成本高的问题;采用一种自适应滑模观测器（SMO）代替传统位置传感器来估计PMSM的位置和速度信息。基于磁场定向控制（FOC）理论;在Matlab/Simulink平台搭建基于改进滑模观测器的PMSM双闭环控制系统。以TMS320F28335微控制器和EPM570T144C5可编程逻辑器件为核心设计硬件实验平台。仿真和实验结果均表明;改进的滑模观测器较好地抑制了系统抖振并提高了速度观测的准确性;PMSM控制系统的动态性能也得到了改善。
keywords: 抖振, 永磁同步电机, 滑模观测器, 磁场定向控制理论
affiliations: 西北工业大学航海学院

title: 一种边灯式FOD探测设备伺服控制系统设计
abstract: 文章分析了边灯式FOD探测设备伺服控制系统的特点;从转台框架设计、伺服控制器硬件设计和伺服控制器软件设计三个方面介绍了伺服控制系统的设计与实现。结构上采用步进电机经行星减速机构及齿轮副减速的形式;伺服控制器硬件采用TMS320F28335作为主处理芯片;软件采用模块化方法进行设计和实现。该伺服控制系统已完成实现;并已通过了高低温及振动冲击环境试验;能够满足工作方式、精度、环境适应性和远程更新等需求。
keywords: fod, 伺服控制器, 伺服控制软件, 转台结构设计

title: 基于大数据聚类的智能探测机器人运动控制系统设计
abstract: 为了减小智能探测机器人运动轨迹误差;实现精准控制;提高智能探测机器人运动控制效率;设计基于大数据聚类的智能探测机器人运动控制系统;采用TMS320LF2407A主控芯片;集成650 V功率管;在电感电流断续模式下工作;提供系统驱动能量;设置光电耦合器;处理控制信号发射;调整控制电路内部电流关系;选用6ES7214-1AG40-0XB0控制器以及信号和通信模块扩展;控制机器人运动轨迹;结合内部驱动装置;整合运动数据信息进行存储;实现运动控制系统硬件结构设计;通过调节程序开始数据;结合内部脉冲数据;构建软件平台管理模块;获取机器人运动轨迹数据;采用大数据聚类技术;建立控制系统大数据分布结构模型;模拟非线性时变LFM控制信号;提取特征并聚类运动轨迹数据;获取精准运动轨迹数据;减少运动轨迹偏差程度;完成运动控制系统软件设计;实验结果表明;基于大数据聚类的运动控制系统的运动轨迹误差较小;能够有效实现精准控制;提高运动控制效率。
keywords: 大数据聚类, 探测机器人, 控制系统, 运动控制
affiliations: 陕西警官职业学院信息技术系

title: 基于反步滑模算法的无人机姿态鲁棒控制系统设计
abstract: 针对传统无人机姿态鲁棒控制系统易受到外部干扰影响;无法精准控制姿态角、左侧舵面角和右侧舵面角;导致系统不稳定的问题;设计了基于反步滑模算法的无人机姿态鲁棒控制系统;使用TMS320F28335芯片的串级PID控制器;控制无人机中央处理机;选择MS-S3型伺服驱动器保证电机高速运动时的高转矩运行;使用STM32f407VGT6型号姿态控制器;控制旋翼姿态;在软件流程设计过程中;构建无人机动力学模型;引入反步滑模算法构建考虑姿态角动态方程;选择Lyapunov函数计算误差变量;设计滑模控制律;借助Visual C++6.0实现软件程序编写;完成无人机姿态鲁棒控制系统设计;由实验结果可知;在时间为5 s时;该系统姿态角达到6°、左侧舵面达到0.40°、右侧舵面角达到0.20°;与实际控制结果一致;具有精准控制效果。
keywords: 反步滑模算法, 姿态角, 无人机姿态, 鲁棒控制
affiliations: 成都理工大学工程技术学院

title: 嵌入式发动机活塞温度测试系统设计
abstract: 针对发动机活塞温度缺乏有效的测试手段;设计了一种嵌入式活塞温度测试系统;选用K型热电偶作为温度传感器;利用AD590配合2.5V基准电压源输出补偿电势对热电偶冷端温度进行了补偿;通过调节AD8495设定点电压在预设温度下输出上升沿实现了可调触发温度功能;系统在PIC单片机控制下通过内置模数转换器（ADC）采集活塞顶部3个测点的温度数据后;通过CC2530将测试结果发送至上位机接收平台;测试前在高温箱内对系统进行了标定;将实测值与标定值进行了对比并在发动机台架上进行了试验;实测结果表明:系统测量误差为±1℃;在130℃的高温环境下仍能正常工作;具有良好的稳定性和可靠性。
keywords: 发动机活塞, 存储测试, 无线通信, 测温

title: 基于5G通信及遥感卫星的气象观测站数据监测系统设计
abstract: 针对传统气象观测站数据监测系统受到干扰数据影响而导致监测精准度低的问题;提出了基于5G通信及遥感卫星的气象观测站数据监测系统设计;根据系统平台架构;将系统分为应用层、插件层、数据层和软件硬件支撑层4个层次;使用CC2530采集终端采集空气温湿度、土壤湿度等数据;利用5G通信技术将数据发送至物联网关;再通过Web将数据存储到手机中;使用PCIE数据采集卡采集遥感卫星气象观测站数据;选择MSOP8监测器监测串口通信数据;完成系统硬件设计;选择后台遥感卫星气象观测站数据库;利用平均算子分析滤波器降噪情况;得到异常数据模型;确定正常数据;实现气象观测站数据监测系统设计;由实验结果可知;该系统监测最高监测效果可达到99%;能够为气象观测站提供设备支持。
keywords: 5g通信, 数据监测, 气象观测站, 遥感卫星
affiliations: 延安大学物理与电子信息学院

title: 发动机防热结构件智能压粘机控制系统设计
abstract: 为解决现有固体火箭发动机喷管防热结构件粘接自动化程度不高、生产效率低、人为因素影响多、粘接质量不稳定等问题;设计防热结构件智能压粘机控制系统;基于AM5718 DSP+ARM双核处理器开发;搭载综合驱动采集卡;进行系统多轴运动精准控制及信号精确采集;实现系统整体控制;并阐述了设计中的控制难点及解决思路;采用运动控制函数跟踪插补控制技术、压力位移多公差窗口匹配控制技术、比例调节控制技术等;实现涂胶均匀度控制、旋转保压排气控制、成型过程精准稳压控制;经实际应用与原有加工方式相比;加工时间缩短65%、溢胶率减少85%以上、一次粘接合格率提高25%。
keywords: 压粘控制, 多公差窗口控制, 智能化, 比例调节, 运动插补算法
authors: 李培培;包乐;王景贤;王超;王新德
affiliations: 1. 西安维控自动化科技有限公司    2. 中国航天科工集团第六研究院二一零所

title: 基于TMS320F28335的直流无刷电机控制技术应用
abstract: 近年来直流无刷电机以质量轻、调速范围精确和故障率低等优点被应用于汽车、工业机器人和家用电器等领域;根据电机调速特性;可分为直接转矩控制和脉宽调速控制;按照直流无刷电机导通形式可分为三三导通和两两导通;在闭环控制中;直流无刷电机控制方式有PID控制、抗扰控制、模糊控制和自适应控制等多种形式。其中;电机高性能的精确控制需要电机本体、驱动和控制器组成;常见的直流无刷电机控制芯片是由TI公司生产的TMS320F28335芯片;它具有专门的霍尔输入模块和电机换相、死区补偿等模块;参考不同的应用环境和要求;可选择适合直流无刷电机特性的控制方式。
keywords: pid, 异步交流电机, 直流无刷电机, 调速
affiliations: 南阳农业职业学院机电工程系,  洛阳职业技术学院机电工程学院

title: 基于DSP的串联H桥逆变器研究
abstract: 目前，串联H桥逆变器已广泛应用于无功补偿系统、可再生能源发电系统，及高压变频调速等场合。以DSP TMS320F2812芯片为核心，搭建了一个单相两级级联逆变器。主要设计了整流桥电路、IGBT驱动电路、过流保护电路以及直流母线电压采样电路，并编写了基于不对称规则采样法的载波移相控制程序。最后进行软硬件的联合调试，仿真与实验结果证明多级串联的H桥逆变器具有用低压实现高压输出的优势，适用于高压大功率场合。
keywords: dsp, 不对称规则采样法, 串联h桥逆变器
affiliations: 陕西国防工业职业技术学院智能制造学院

title: 考虑死区效应单相逆变器开关频率分析
abstract: 针对逆变器死区效应引起的输出波形畸变问题;以单相电压型双极性SPWM逆变器为研究对象;提出一种以输出电压THD值最小为指标的选取逆变器开关频率的方法。首先;利用双重傅里叶变换和贝塞尔函数;推导了考虑死区效应情况下输出SPWM的傅里叶级数展开式。通过对输出SPWM电压进行频谱分析;研究了THD值和不同开关频率的关系。经研究发现;存在最优开关频率使得输出电压的THD值最小。其次;采用分段线性拉格朗日插值法;拟合不同死区时间选取最优开关频率的公式。最后;以TMS320F28335为控制芯片;搭建了单相双极性全桥逆变器试验样机;验证了理论分析与所提方法的有效性。实验结果表明;所提出的逆变器开关频率选取方法在减小输出电压THD的同时;减小了开关损耗;提高了直流侧电压利用率。
keywords: thd, 傅里叶变换, 单相逆变器, 开关频率, 死区效应
authors: 陈蒙娜;巫付专;周元浩;向乃皇
affiliations: 中原工学院河南省先进控制与新能源科技国际联合实验室

title: 基于改进型环路滤波器的单相锁相环
abstract: 针对单相锁相环（Phase-lock Loop; PLL）受PI控制器饱和抑制造成滤波性能不足这一问题;提出了一种基于改进型环路滤波器的单相锁相环。该锁相环通过增加抗饱和PI控制器;改进环路滤波器;提高滤波性能。在输入同时含有直流和谐波干扰情况下;对电网实时相位进行锁相跟踪;可以明显提高锁相精度。利用Matlab/Simulink平台对改进型单相锁相环在电网畸变时的适应性、抗干扰性进行仿真分析。并基于TMS320F28335 DSP芯片为核心的实验平台进行实验验证;结果表明;该方法能快速准确地跟踪系统频率变化;达到锁相效果。
keywords: dsp, 单相锁相环, 抗饱和控制器, 环路滤波器
authors: 刘启德;王维庆;张振波;王海云
affiliations: 新疆大学电气工程学院,  教育部可再生能源发电与并网控制工程技术研究中心

title: BIPV储能电池组状态监测系统设计
abstract: 针对光伏建筑一体化（building integrated PV;BIPV）储能电站蓄电池组的状态监测需求;设计了以 CC2530为控制核心、以高共模差动放大器 INA117 为电压电流信号转换电路、以 DS18B20为温度采集电路的蓄电池状态监测系统;通过多通道模拟开关 ADG732 实现了蓄电池组的单体电池电压、充放电电流和单体温度的低成本远程无线状态监测。对比试验表明;该方案的性能满足施工方的设计要求。

title: 一种新型ZigBee无线传输智能家居控制系统
abstract: 设计了一个基于ZigBee无线传输技术的新型智能家居控制系统.选用美国德州仪器公司的CC2530作为ZigBee的核心硬件;设计智能家居系统的节点.该系统具备四大功能:照明控制功能、环境监测功能、医保监护功能、安防功能.因为"健康"是当前的热门话题;因此医保监护功能（即生理参数监护功能）是智能家居系统最重要的功能;选用了相应的硬件支持该功能设计.在此硬件系统上运行优化的路由算法;并为各种功能设计了独自的软件流程.最终;通过搭建模拟测试系统进行测试仿真;验证了改进的路由算法的可靠性;智能家居控制系统达到了预期的设计目标.
keywords: zigbee, 控制系统, 无线传输, 智能家居系统

title: 基于STM32和比例阀的精密微压控制系统设计与分析
abstract: 在水位传感器的螺栓初始位置调试过程中;需要精密的微压源;为此设计了一个基于STM32和比例阀的精密微压控制系统。该微压控制系统由与气室气路相连的风压变送器检测气室的压力;STM32通过ADS1256采集风压变送器输出的气压模拟量;当检测气压小于设定值时;控制气泵向气室充气;当检测气压大于设定值时;采用PID控制比例阀使气室向外界环境排气。实验结果表明;所设计的精密微压控制系统响应速度快、精度高、稳定性好;能够满足水位传感器螺栓初始位置调试的需求。
keywords: stm32, 比例阀, 气压控制
affiliations: 嘉兴学院信息科学与工程学院

title: 双馈感应风力发电系统实验平台的设计与实现
abstract: 基于在亚同步和超同步工作模式下实现能量转换的双馈感应风力发电工作原理;设计了双馈感应风力发电系统实验平台;主回路包含三相绕线式异步电机、代替风力机的直流调速电机、直流伺服驱动器、双PWM励磁变换模块和各类低压电器;控制电路包含TMS320F28335型DSP、EP1C12Q240I8型FPGA芯片、采样电路、驱动电路和PLC控制回路;监控电路主要包含PLC上位机监控系统;通过组态软件对风速进行控制和监控;最终实现了双馈感应风力发电系统实验平台的实物研制。
keywords: 双馈感应, 实验平台, 风力发电
affiliations: 苏州市职业大学电子信息工程学院

title: Development of data acquisition system for CO and CH
abstract: Accurate detection of CO and CH4 gas concentrations is of great significance for safety production of coal mining enterprises and industrial process control. TDLAS technology is a real-time and high-precision gas detection method; which can be used for CO and CH4 dual gas detection. For TDLAS CO and CH4 dual gas detection system; a DSP dual data acquisition system is designed in this paper. After the laser signal is selected and absorbed by CO and CH4; the FD10D transforms the optical signal into a current signal; and the faint current signal is converted and amplified into a voltage signal through the OPA2387 preamplifier circuit. The ADC chip collects the data; returns it to the DSP main control chip TMS320C6748. The processed data is stored to the flash chip M25P16; then uploaded to the upper computer. After testing; the system can collect data stably and accurately; and is suitable for other TDLAS dual gas detection systems.
keywords: ch, co, photodetector, tms320c6748
authors: ZHANG Rui;LIAN Houquan;CHENG Linxiang;DAI Tongxin;YU Yongbo;WANG Biao

abstract: 新一代SOC能在单芯片上集成完整的电子系统;NOC是全新的片上网络结构集成电路;其分布式的设计特点在农业物联网领域取得了很好的应用;本文使用CC2530芯片作为Zigbee通信模块建立无线传感器网络;有效的提高了分时通信效率;降低了分布式网络节点全局同步时的能量消耗。

title: Design and implementation of indoor visible light communication system based on high-order PAM
abstract: A high-order pulse amplitude modulation（PAM） method can transmit more bits of information within the same symbol; improving the modulation efficiency and the frequency band utilization of the communication system. However; the high-order PAM system has poor anti-noise ability; and the signal amplitude is easily affected by channel attenuation during transmission. To improve the reliability of high-order PAM systems; an improved PAM symbol waveform structure is proposed. The improved scheme reduces the bit error rate of the system at the same signal-to-noise and modulation order. Using TMS32 C6748 floating-point digital signal processing（DSP） as the control chip of the optical communication system; a visible light communication system based on the high-end PAM room is designed and implemented. The system communication performance of the scheme is verified by an experimental platform. Experimental results show that the communication system has the advantages of low bit error rate and high modulation efficiency; thus meeting the requirements of high-performance indoor visible light communication systems.
keywords: improved pulse amplitude modulation, pulse amplitude modulation, tms320c6748, visible light communication
affiliations: School of Information and Communication, Guilin University of Electronic Science and Technology

title: Research on Fire Alarm and Escape System Based on CC2530
abstract: The research of fire alarm and escape system in our country started late.With the country’s continuous attention to fire safety;the technology of fire alarm and escape system is now becoming more mature.The key fire safety units identified by the fire department have all put into use various emergency management systems such as automatic fire alarm systems.This paper studies the use of advanced wireless sensors and the IoT cloud platform technology based on the CC2530 chip to form a complete wireless monitoring network.The automatic escape system;which is not in the traditional fire protection system;guarantees the safety of the escaped personnel in the first place.
keywords: cc2530, fire alarm and escape system research, iot cloud platform, wireless sensor

title: Design of Monitoring System for Landslide Disasters of Slope Along Railway
abstract: In the paper; a monitoring system for slope landslide hazards along railway lines based on ZigBee technology is designed.The system uses a phase laser ranging sensor to collect the surface displacement of the slope landslide body; and sends the collected information to the coordinator through the ZigBee network.The coordinator is connected to the 4 G communication module through the serial port; and the information is remotely transmitted to the ground monitoring center through the 4 G network.It is proved by laboratory test that the system has high measurement precision; stable operation and high application value.
keywords: cc2530, landslide disaster monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: School of Electrical Information Engineering, Dalian Jiaotong University

title: Research on Reliable Two-level Boot Method for Multicore DSP
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of multi-core processor Boot technology; such as difficulty; complex process and high reliability requirements; a reliable two-level Boot method for multi-core DSP is proposed.According to the emif16 Boot mode of TMS320 C6678 multi-core DSP;a two-level Boot scheme is used to Boot the multi-core DSP program; and a detailed engineering solution is given for the generation; burning and loading of the executable program.This method realizes the convenient generation; fast burning and reliable loading of multi-core DSP executable program.Compared with the traditional Boot scheme; the reliability of this method is significantly improved; which has a certain engineering application value.
keywords: multicore dsp, tms320c6678, two-level boot

title: DSP Program Expansion Method Based on Demand Loading
abstract: Along with the development of software radio;the processing capacity of software radio platform is becoming more and more powerful;the functions realized on the platform are more and more;the hardware structure of the platform is also varied;and the sharing of hardware and software resources can not be realized the platforms.To solve the above problems;this paper provides an on-demand loading DSP program expansion method;which can load different DSP functions according to the need;which is equivalent to the expansion of DSP memory.This method reduces the loading time and does not have to guarantee the running speed of the DSP program.This method is applicable to TI companies;ADI companies and current domestic DSP;models are not limited to TMS320 C6713;TMS320 C6416;TMS320 C6455 and TMS320 C6678.
keywords: dsp, program expansion, tms320c6713
