title: Xilinx与德州仪器联合开发高能效5G无线电解决方案
abstract: ＜正＞赛灵思公司（Xilinx;Inc.）宣布与德州仪器（TI）展开合作;共同开发可扩展且灵活应变的数字前端（DFE）解决方案;以提升较少天线数的无线电应用能效。该解决方案运用赛灵思灵活应变的IP来强化射频性能;提升室内与室外无线电应用能效。通过将赛灵思业界领先的Zynq UltraScale+MPSoC系列和灵活应变的射频IP与TI的AFE7769四通道射频收发器相结合;开发者能够更好地解决大型运营商和专用网络面临的运营成本（OPEX）和资本支出（CAPEX）问题。

title: Design of Internet+Smart Agricultural System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at some problems presented by the smart agriculture system based on the Internet of Things technology;an improved design scheme is proposed.It further reduces the cost burden on capital and the learning cost used by farmers.In addition to large-scale farming cultivation groups;it can also be extended to ordinary individual growers.Through ZigBee technology for networking;the terminal equipment is distributed around the crops.Users can remotely obtain environmental information near the terminal equipment through the mobile phone app;and use relay switches to achieve remote watering and other functions.Due to the use of photovoltaic-battery power supply and sub-nodes can sleep with low power consumption;the system has reached a balance of low cost;low power consumption and high reliability.
keywords: cc2530, internet of things, smart agriculture, zigbee technology
affiliations: East-China Institute of Computing Technology

title: Indoor Air Quality Detection System Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: In response to the problems in traditional air quality detection system; based on wireless sensor network; the design scheme of indoor air quality detection system is proposed. The design idea; hardware structure and software design method of indoor air quality detection system are given in details. At the perception level; the CC2530 is used to form a wireless sensor network.Multiple sensor nodes are used to detect indoor carbon monoxide; carbon dioxide; oxygen; formaldehyde; PM2.5 and temperature and humidity. The real-time detection results are displayed and overrun alarm is given.
keywords: air quality, detect, wireless sensor network

title: 基于ZigBee的校园共享智能储物柜设计
abstract: 基于ZigBee技术并结合RFID技术;采用CC2530通讯芯片、STM32F103ZET6主控制芯片、MFRC522读卡芯片、LCD12864液晶屏、AT42QT2160触摸按键;各小柜模块构成储物柜的硬件系统。Zig Bee协调器节点、无线采集终端节点、无线控制终端节点、上位机设计为软件系统;实现存取物品功能;显示功能;状态检测和维护调控功能;视频监控功能;存储、处理、监测、查询功能;APP提示功能。

title: 基于ZigBee技术的农业大棚灯光智能控制系统
abstract: 科技兴农是农业发展的必由之路;通信技术融入到传统农业大棚环境监测是其典型代表。为确保农业大棚设置合理的照明系统;必须对大棚内光照强度进行精度监测。针对当前棚内照明强度不能调节、布线复杂、成本高等缺点;提出了一种基于ZigBee技术的智能灯光控制系统。采用了TI公司的无线射频芯片CC2530作为系统的硬件平台;根据农业大棚的实际场景对协议栈Z-Stack进行修改;利用拓扑网络实现自动组网;所提出的智能灯光控制系统具有低成本、低功耗的特点;此外;也可以在其他以无线传感网络为依托的场合中有一定的应用;具有良好的拓展功能。

title: Smart Home Environmental Detection System Based on ZigBee
abstract: In this paper; ZigBee AD hoc network technology is used to build wireless sensor network for information exchange to achieve intelligent home environmental monitoring. The system hardware takes CC2530 development board as the core; constructs wireless sensor network through ZigBee coordinator; routing nodes and network nodes; collects data from multiple sensor nodes; amplifies the collected signal; and processes A/D conversion and other processing; so as to realize short-range wireless communication between nodes. The user terminal compiles the software code through the upper computer to realize the real-time display of data. The system has the advantages of low power consumption; low cost; convenient installation; small and beautiful; which is suitable for real-time monitoring of environmental data in the user’s residence.
keywords: environmental detection, smart home, wireless sensor, zigbee
authors: 潘学文;黄堂森;李玲香;唐明星

title: Design and test of intelligent monitoring system for organic rice field planting environment in southern Shaanxi Province
abstract: 根据陕南汉中有机水稻种植环境智能化监测的需求;基于ZigBee、NB-IoT技术设计有机水稻环境监测系统;利用带射频功率放大的CC2530模块设计ZigBee网络节点和协调器;采用自定义Channel、PanID、MAC等ZigBee协议参数;以此提高ZigBee无线通信距离和抗干扰能力;实现稻田大气环境和土壤环境的自动监测与分析;具有异常状态语音告警、基于OneNET云平台和手机App的稻田环境远程监测功能。测试结果表明;本系统中ZigBee无线传输距离最远可达400 m以上;并对其他ZigBee组网信号具有良好的抗干扰能力;OneNET云平台接入及数据上传通信延迟为5～10 s;系统各项功能运行较为稳定;能够满足汉中有机稻田环境智能化监测的基本需求。
keywords: 云平台, 无线传感网, 有机稻田, 环境监测, 窄带物联网

title: Design and implementation of synchronization method for paired nodes in energy saving wireless sensor network
abstract: Aiming at the problem of energy consumption constraint of time synchronization for paired nodes in Wireless Sensor Network（WSN）;an energy saving one-Way communication Bayesian estimation Synchronization Algorithm（OWBSA） was proposed.Firstly;a one-way model of time signaling was established.Then;the standard deviation of the observation error was estimated by using Bayesian estimation theory;and then the local clock estimate of the reference node was obtained.The traditional Two-way communication Point-to-Point Synchronization Algorithm（TP-PSA） and O-WBSA were implanted into the Zigbee platform built by CC2530 and other hardware to run in the laboratory.The experimental results show that both algorithms can achieve synchronization and the effect is superior after synchronization.Theoretical analysis shows that the energy consumption of O-WBSA is only half that of TP-PSA.
keywords: bayesian estimation, frequency offset, paired node synchronization, phase offset, time synchronization, wireless sensor network（wsn）
affiliations: College of Electronic Information Engineering, Inner Mongolia University, College of Computer ＆ Information Management, Inner Mongolia University of Finance and Economics

title: Design of Pressure Monitoring System for Coal Mine Hydraulic Support Based on MSP430 and ZigBee
abstract: Based on MSP430 and Zig Bee equipment; a micro monitoring system for hydraulic support pressure monitoring through wireless sensor network is designed; and the specific scheme of the system is given. The hardware part designs the pressure acquisition node; signal modulation circuit; Zig Bee wireless communication scheme; CAN bus communication circuit; and the software part describes the flow chart of the main program and the pressure acquisition node CC2530 module subroutine. After field operation test; the system can realize the pressure monitoring of each position of hydraulic support through wireless sensor network; the data transmission is stable; the installation is convenient; and it has certain application value.
keywords: hydraulic support, msp430, pressure monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Zigbee-based Polished Cloth Wheel Diameter and Spray Gun Working Condition Monitoring System Design
abstract: ZigBee protocol was designed as the communication protocol;the purpose was to establish a wireless sensor network used in spraygun production workshop.CC2530 as the remote monitoring system of the main control chip;can detect the working state in real time andmonitor the wear of the cloth wheel.When the spray gun can not work normally or the cloth wheel wear exceeds the threshold;it will give analarm.The working state of the mechanical spray gun and the wear degree of the polishing cloth wheel were observed.The remote monitoring ofthe polishing process was realized by using wireless sensor network;and the corresponding data was displayed on the OLED of the coordinator;which can improve the degree of automation and greatly reduce the labor cost of the enterprise.

title: 基于CC1101模块的无线温湿度监测终端设计
abstract: 本文基于CC1101模块设计了一种无线温湿度测量终端应用于仓库内部环境温湿度监测系统。介绍了测量终端的系统组成;设计了基于STC15W4K56S4的单片机最小系统、SHT10传感器接口电路、电源电路。并设计了数据采集与发送程序;实现了终端与无线网关之间的通信。本终端布放方便;可根据需要灵活的增删节点以适配温湿度监测系统的需求。

title: Design and implementation of intelligent campus fire warning system
abstract: In view of the deficiency of the existing campus fire monitoring method that can not collect information dynamically in real time; this paper designs a campus fire monitoring system based on CC2530. The function and structure of the fire monitoring system are introduced; and then the system hardware and software are introduced. The experimental testing results of the system show that the upper computer management platform of the server can accurately monitor the environmental temperature; humidity and smoke concentration in real time; providing a real-time and effective method to reduce and avoid fire accidents.
keywords: cc2530, fire surveillance system, system hardware, system software, upper computer

title: Design of Remote Meter Reading System Based on ZigBee
abstract: This paper proposes a solution of remote meter reading system based on ZigBee communication.The system consists of terminal acquisition node; gateway module and server.As a terminal acquisition node; the smart electricity meter mainly reads the electrical parameters collected by the metering chip through STM32 as the main control chip; and transmits the data to the CC2530 module through the serial port; which is then sent to the gateway module by the CC2530.The gateway module acts as the coordinator in the ZigBee network to collect all terminal data; and then transmits data to the server based on the LwIP protocol.The server can remotely control and monitor the running state and measurement parameters of each electricity meter and change the switching state of each electricity meter; so as to realize the remote acquisition and switching control of user’s electricity meter data.Finally; the performance of data acquisition and networking communication is tested by setting up a test network in the indoor environment.The test results show that the smart meter can control the active power error within ±2%;and the system can complete data transmission in the ISM 2.4 GHz band.
keywords: lwip protocol, smart meter system, stm32, zigbee communication

title: Research on Zigbee Wireless Ad Hoc Network for Goaf Temperature Monitoring
abstract: For the underground mined-out area is complex;easy to produce floating coal;coal;underground pressure will produce a larger self-heating phenomenon;so the temperature monitoring of goaf is particularly important. This paper presents a Zigbee wireless ad hoc method for real-time monitoring of underground goaf temperature;the use of CC2530 integrated module as a communication module;coupled with mature low price of the temperature sensor can be composed of powerful;low power and stable and reliable Hardware platform;through the routing algorithm automatically assigns the address;you can increase the redundancy of the system;the higher the system redundancy;the better the stability of communication. Experiments show that both the transmission distance and the penetrating ability all meet the application environment of the underground mined-out area;and can realize the rapid networking and realize the reliable monitoring of the underground temperature.
keywords: cc2530, goaf, self-heating, temperature monitoring, zigbee

title: Design of landslide detection system based on MEMS acceleration sensor MPU-6050
abstract: In view of the problems existing in slope engineering monitoring; such as low monitoring accuracy; high cost and difficult field layout; the mountain displacement monitoring was taken as the main research object; a monitoring system based on MEMS micro electro mechanical monitoring technology was adopted; the advantages of MEMS acceleration sensor;such as high precision and small volume; were utilized; Zig Bee with CC2530 as the core was used to establish wireless network transmission; and identify the possibility of landslide. The simulation experiment was designed according to the deformation process of landslide; the experimental results show that the MEMS sensor can accurately collect data; and the relative error of detection was less than 2%; and the whole system has low power consumption and fast speed; and can well complete the landslide detection.
keywords: landslide detection, mems acceleration sensor, zigbee

title: zigbee技术的物联网智能家居系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞随着科学技术不断进步和发展;人们生活质量有了很大提升;越来越多的人追求家庭居住环境的智能化。传统智能家居组件的网络结构过于简洁;连接节点较少;网络稳定性不强。因此;本文根据人们对智能家居系统的实际需求;在zigbee技术的基础上;设计出一种实用性强的智能家居系统;并对单片机、上位机进行设计;用来进行数据信息的采集与控制。zigbee技术具有低功耗、低成本、组网能力强等优点;在智能家居系统设计中应用该技术;可以缩短开发应用时间;减少生产成本。开发该系统设计应用CC2530芯片;能够提高相关硬件系统的拓展性。
affiliations: 茂名职业技术学院

title: Research on Hybrid Pulse Width Modulation Strategy Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: The traction inverter is limited by the switching frequency;and the motor current contains rich harmonics.Current harmonics can cause serious motor heating;large system losses;and can also cause motor torque ripple;affecting motor control performance.In order to achieve the symmetry of the output pulse voltage of the inverter in the full speed range and reduce the impact of low-order harmonics on the system;the principle of selective harmonic elimination pulse width modulation（SHEPWM） is analyzed through in-depth analysis of specific harmonics.A hybrid pulse width modulation（PWM） method based on TMS320F28377 D is proposed;which realizes the smooth switching of each modulation mode.This method can satisfy the control algorithm and modulation mode running independently in two cores of a CPU;which improves the reliability and high efficiency;can effectively reduce low-order harmonics;improve system efficiency;simplify digital implementation.It has certain engineering significance.The simulation and experimental results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the hybrid PWM strategy and switching method proposed.
keywords: hybrid pulse width modulation, low-order harmonics, motor
affiliations: CRRC Dalian R＆D Co.,Ltd.

title: Design and Research of Dual-core DSP Stabilized Platform Control System
abstract: In order to realize the control of two-axis stable platform and meet the requirements of miniaturization and integration of system; a servo control system based on dual-core DSP TMS320 F28377 D architecture is designed. This paper describes the composition and working principle of the system; and gives the specific hardware circuit design and related software design; mainly including the gyro with the encoder signal acquisition and processing; drive circuit design; and RS-422 communication between upper computer; dual-core DSP CPU1 and CPU2 nuclei in the interaction between information and the design of the software process. Compared with the traditional DSP+FPGA hardware scheme of control system; the control system has the advantages of small size and high performance.
keywords: control system, stable platform, tms320f28377d
authors: LEI Ying;LIU Huabo;YAN Kang;JIANG Tao;ZHU Yepeng
affiliations: Xi ’an Modern Control Technology Research Institute, Xi’an Guidance Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 基于无线传感网的高速公路防大雾路灯控制系统设计
abstract: 高速公路在出现大雾等极端天气情况下;路面能见度下降;司机视线受阻;给行车安全带来了隐患。遗憾的是;传统的路灯照明系统无法根据天气能见度控制路灯开灭和亮暗;本文设计出一种基于无线传感网的高速公路防大雾路灯控制系统可以满足这种情况下的需求;该系统以CC2530作为核心器件;用于实时采集现场温湿度数据;并根据这些数据调节路灯的开关从而实现智能照明。经过实验研究:本路灯控制系统可以满足高速公路防大雾的照明需求。
keywords: cc2530, 无线传感网, 路灯控制系统, 高速公路
affiliations: 福州工商学院信息工程系

title: 基于无线传感网的智能家居环境控制系统设计与实现
abstract: 随着无线通信技术的发展;智能家居环境控制系统也取得了快速发展。如果业主希望在还没有回到家就开启室内空调等设备;这样到家的时候;室内环境温湿度都将更加温馨适宜;或者只要房间内温湿度超出了一定范围;空调等设备就会自动开启使房间内温湿度回归正常范围。为此;本文提出一种基于无线传感网的智能家居环境控制系统设计方案;该系统主要采用CC2530器件;实时采集每个房间的温度和湿度等数据;并根据这些数据自动调控房间空调和加湿器等设备。实验表明:该系统足够智能且价格低廉;可以满足智能家居的需求。
keywords: cc2530, 无线传感网, 智能家居
affiliations: 福州工商学院工学院

title: Design of transformer differential protection device based on DSP
abstract: Differential protection is one of the main protections of transformers. It has a high reliability coeffcient and is one of the key factors for accurate; timely and reliable operation of transformer protection devices. Based on the analysis of traditional differential protection devices; this article designs a transformer differential protection device with DSP as the core in combination with the current development of microcomputer protection. First; it discusses the development status of transformer protection systems at home and abroad; and establishes a full-wave Fourier algorithm as the core algorithm of microcomputer protection. Based on the above theoretical basis; a hardware system with the TMS320F28335 chip as the control core is designed. The system adopts a modular design and completes the operation of the entire protection device through the protection system and the management system. Finally; the design process of software is given to realize design of differencetial protection device of transformer.
keywords: full-wave fourier algorithm, hardware system, magnetizing inrush current, unbalanced current
affiliations: Construction Comprehensive Survey Research and Design Institute Co., Ltd.

title: DSP-based Embedded Control System with Dual Vision Feedback of Infrared and Visible Light
abstract: In the process of pipe bottom welding; there are various interferences; deformations and workpiece defects in the real environment. If they are not adjusted; the welding deviation will gradually affect the welding quality. In response to this phenomenon; an embedded control system with infrared and visible visual feedback is developed. Infrared thermal imaging camera takes images of molten pool; and visible light camera takes images of the weld; which are input to the image processing unit based on TMS320 DM6437.After a series of processing such as denoising; filtering and edge detection; the offset of weld and weld pool is calculated. The signal is transmitted to the motion control unit based on TMS320 F2812 to generate a control signal to drive the motor on the cross carriage of the welding gun to perform deviation correction. In the preliminary application of the embedded control system in the pipeline prefabrication system; the deviation correction accuracy is above 0.8 mm. The image of the welding process is transmitted to the monitor through the video output interface; which is convenient for the operator to monitor the welding process.
keywords: correction, dual vision feedback, embedded control system, tms320dm6437, tms320f2812
affiliations: Yangtze Delta Region Institute of Tsinghua University

title: Research and Design of Greenhouse Environment Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: The rapid and accurate acquisition of greenhouse environmental information is the basis of agricultural precise control. This paper studies and designs a greenhouse environment monitoring system based on ZigBee technology; using CC2530 microprocessor to control multi-sensor data acquisition and real-time collection of environmental parameters such as temperature and humidity; CO2 concentration and soil moisture in greenhouse. The data is transmitted and uploaded by ZigBee module to realize PC monitoring. By testing; the system has perfect function; low power consumption and stable performance; which can better improve the environment of greenhouse.
keywords: cc2530, greenhouse, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Information Institute of Media,Sanmenxia Polytechnic
source: Journal of Changzhou College of Information Technology.

title: Design Method of Real-Time Temperature and Humidity Monitoring System in Greenhouse
abstract: This design uses ZigBee network transmission technology; and CC3200 single chip microcomputer as microcontroller; as well as temperature and humidity sensor DHT11 and temperature sensor DS18 B20 to monitor and compare temperature and humidity data. The principle is that the microcontroller controls the corresponding sensor to monitor the data for a certain period of time; and the obtained data is transmitted to the terminal through wireless network for easy processing; and the addition of voice module is considered to alert the staff to operate accordingly. This way for professional greenhouse monitoring data accuracy requirements can basically meet the corresponding accuracy; but also simplify the operation of managers. It is proved that this method reduces the cost compared with the professional greenhouse treatment; and increases the automatic monitoring of temperature and humidity; improves the efficiency of greenhouse management and reduces the labor cost; which is of practical significance for increasing the yield of fruits and vegetables compared with the general rural humble greenhouse.
keywords: intelligent greenhouse, mcu, microcontroller, voice, wireless
affiliations: Information Management Center, Nanyang Normal University, School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Nanyang Normal University
source: Journal of Green Science and Technology.

title: Design of train axle temperature monitoring system based on ZigBee and cloud terminal
abstract: In order to monitor axle temperature of train in real time;a train axle temperature monitoring and alarm system based on ZigBee and cloud terminal is designed and developed.The train manager can monitor the axle temperature of the train in real time through personal computer（PC）and mobile terminal;and set the temperature threshold to prompt the alarm;so as to avoid the occurrence of danger in an emergency.The design consists of a number of terminal nodes installed on the axle and a monitoring coordinator; both of which are low-power consumption;low-cost ZigBee processor CC2530.The axle temperature data is collected by DS18 B20 high precision temperature sensor and transmitted to terminal node.When terminal node and coordinator are successfully self-organized;the data will be transmitted to the coordinator.The coordinator packages the data of multiple terminal nodes and sends it to upper PC through the serial port.Finally;the upper PC sends the data to the designated cloud terminal server and mobile terminal through the TCP protocol.The design is stable and flexible and has broad application prospect.
keywords: axle temperature, digital temperature sensor ds18b20, processor cc2530, tcp protocol, zigbee
affiliations: College of Automation,Qingdao University

title: Multifunctional Electronic Door Plate Design Based on ZigBee
abstract: For the traditional door sign curing the board;and the door sign can not change the information in real-time and other problems;this paper designs a multifunctional electronic door sign based on ZigBee.The design includes data acquisition;transmission;and processing analysis modules.The system adopts ZigBee wireless sensor network and ESP8266 Wi-Fi module as the communication means;uses CC2530 chip as the main body;collects data through human body identification module and temperature and humidity collection module;and finally displays the received data on the LCD screen to achieve the status of the door sign at any time to change;detect the temperature and humidity information around the door sign;display the current time information and save energy and many other functions.This design not only enhances the intelligence and informatization of the door sign system;but also can be customized according to the individual needs of users;thus solving many problems of traditional door signs such as board curing and lagging information and improving the convenience and comfort of people’s daily life and office.
keywords: multi-function, wireless transmission, zigbee
affiliations: School of Electrical and Computer,Jilin Jianzhu University

title: Reserch and Realization of CFAR Detection Method for Terminal Tracking of Missile-borne Radar
abstract: In order to improve the real-time performance of the terminal tracking algorithm of missile borne radar seeker;a dual threshold CFAR detection method based on range and Doppler is proposed. Simulation and measurement results show that under the condition of end tracking;compared with the traditional two-dimensional CFAR detection;the detection performance of this method is close;and the processing efficiency increased by about 68.19%;which provides a new idea for the engineering realization of CFAR detection.
keywords: cfar detection, missle-borne, range-doppler image, tms320c6678
affiliations: Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology

title: 基于ZigBee的家居环境监测系统硬件设计
abstract: Based on Zig Bee technology; the home environment monitoring system is designed to realize the real-time monitoring of fire smoke; combustible gas leakage; outsiders' invasion and other information in the home environment; so as to deal with it in time to improve the home safety. The system has the advantages of convenient networking; low power consumption; low cost; low false alarm rate and strong expansibility; and has strong practical value and good market application prospect.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于ZigBee技术设计家居环境监测系统;实现家居环境中的火灾烟雾、可燃气体泄漏、外人入侵等信息的实时监测;以便及时进行处理;从而提高家居安全。该系统有组网方便、功耗低、成本低、误报率低、可扩展性强等优点;具有较强的实用价值和很好的市场应用前景。
keywords: cc2530, environment monitoring, smart home, zigbee technology
affiliations: 河南省高校节能照明工程技术研究中心, Henan Province University Energy-saving Lighting Engineering Technology Research Center, Intelligent Manufacturing Department, 三门峡职业技术学院智能制造学院

title: 基于ZigBee的干涉仪测控系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problems that traditional interferometers need to manually adjust mechanical devices and the degree of automation is low;a wireless measurement and control system with ZigBee-CC2530 as the core is designed. The system use two CC2530 nodes as radio frequency signal transceivers to implement wireless control functions in a point-to-point communication manner. At the same time;the Microsoft basic class library MFC( Microsoft Foundation Classes) is used to design the host computer software to control the operation of the precision motor through serial communication;and the corresponding travel limit solution is designed based on different conditions in the narrow and compact space of the interferometer;so that the precision motor can meet the measurement and control requirements for fixed-point braking;improve the measurement efficiency and accuracy of the interferometer.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统干涉仪需要手工调节机械装置;自动化程度低等问题;该文设计了一套以Zig Bee-CC2530为核心的无线测控系统。该系统将2个CC2530节点分别作为射频信号收发器;以点对点通信的方式实现无线控制功能。同时利用微软基础类库MFC(Microsoft Foundation Classes)设计了上位机软件;通过串口通信控制精密电机的运转;并在仪器内部基于不同条件设计了对应的行程限位解决方案;使得精密电机可以满足测控要求定点制动;提高了干涉仪的测量效率和精度。
keywords: interferometer, microsoft foundation classes host computer, wireless control
affiliations: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, School of Optical-Electrical and Computer Engineering, 苏州慧利仪器有限责任公司, Suzhou H&L Instruments LLC, 上海理工大学光电信息与计算机工程学院

title: 基于ZigBee技术的农业大棚灯光智能控制系统
abstract_in_chinese: 科技兴农是农业发展的必由之路;通信技术融入到传统农业大棚环境监测是其典型代表。为确保农业大棚设置合理的照明系统;必须对大棚内光照强度进行精度监测。针对当前棚内照明强度不能调节、布线复杂、成本高等缺点;提出了一种基于ZigBee技术的智能灯光控制系统。采用了TI公司的无线射频芯片CC2530作为系统的硬件平台;根据农业大棚的实际场景对协议栈Z-Stack进行修改;利用拓扑网络实现自动组网;所提出的智能灯光控制系统具有低成本、低功耗的特点;此外;也可以在其他以无线传感网络为依托的场合中有一定的应用;具有良好的拓展功能。

title: 基于ZigBee组网技术的智慧病房系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对病房环境难以实时监测和医护人员工作量大等问题;提出一种基于ZigBee组网的智慧病房系统设计。系统以CC2530芯片为核心;采集病房温湿度、病人体温和临床求助呼叫等数据;利用ZigBee组网等相关技术;以无线传输方式将数据传输至上位机;并储存至服务器端;便于医护人员实时掌握数据。从而克服了现有系统成本高、布线复杂、维护困难等问题。实验表明:本系统可以对病人体温和病房环境进行无线监测;同时具有临床求助呼叫功能;满足病房管理与服务的需求。
affiliations: 哈尔滨医科大学附属第二医院, 哈尔滨石油学院

title: 基于CC2530的无线温度传感器网络的设计探析
abstract: This paper discusses the design of wireless temperature sensor network based on CC2530;and discusses the hardware system design;software system design and system test;hoping to provide certain reference and reference for the effective design of wireless temperature sensor network.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章针对以CC2530为基础的无线温度传感器网络设计进行讨论;并从硬件系统设计、软件系统设计以及系统测试等方面入手展开论述;希望能够为无线温度传感器网络的有效设计提供一定的参考和借鉴。
keywords: cc2530, network design, temperature sensor, wireless
affiliations: 云南电网有限责任公司电力科学研究院, Electric Power Research Institute of Yunnan Power Grid Co.

title: 基于Beaglebone Black的绝对式编码器接口电路设计
abstract: In order to improve the resolution and measurement accuracy of absolute encoder without increasing volume and weight; the interface circuit of absolute encoder is studied and designed. Among them; Beaglebone black based on AM3358 processor is selected as the Linux embedded development platform; the system control is unified in the open source framework of Python language; and the control signal is sent by the communication mode of SSI protocol; so as to detect the basic performance of absolute encoder. Through the test experiment; it is proved that the design scheme of the interface circuit of the absolute value encoder is feasible and has reliable measurement accuracy and resolution of the absolute value encoder.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现在不增加体积和重量的前提下提高绝对值编码器分辨率和测量精度;对绝对值编码器接口相关电路进行了研究和设计。其中;选用基于AM3358处理器的Beaglebone Black作为Linux嵌入式开发平台;将系统控制统一在Python语言的开源框架中;采用SSI协议的通讯方式发送控制信号;以此检测绝对编码器的基本性能。通过测试实验;证明了该绝对值编码器接口电路设计方案可行;具有可靠的绝对值编码器测量精度和分辨率。
keywords: absolute encoder, beaglebone black, python, ssi protocol
affiliations: 国核电站运行服务技术有限公司, State Nulclear Power Plant Serivice Company

title: Design of Medium and High Voltage Soft Start Controller
abstract: Direct start of electric power will produce a strong impact current;which will reduce the service life of the motor and will also have a great impact on the power grid. In this paper;a kind of current limiting PI regulating pressure-relief soft start is designed. The soft start takes TMS320F28335 as the control core;and it collectes the current and voltage signals at the start of the motor under the action of synchronous signals. The control of the trigger angle conduction and shift direction of the thyristor realizes the adjustment of the three-phase start-up voltage and current of the motor. The parameters during the start-up process of the motor can be set according to the different load characteristics of the motor. The circuit of over-voltage and overflow detection and motor protection circuit are designed to ensure the safe and steady start of motor during the start-up process. The simulation and experimental verification of the design project show that under the same load;the start-up current of 5-7 times the rated current intensity will be generated when the motor is started under the same load;and it will be reduced to about 2 times in the soft start-up mode. It is proved that the design can significantly reduce the electric current and the voltage of the motor.
abstract_in_chinese: 直接启动电动机会产生很强的冲击电流;降低了电动机的使用寿命;对电网也会造成很大的冲击。设计一种限流PI调节降压式软启动;该软启动以TMS320F28335为控制核心;通过在同步信号作用下;采集电动机启动时电流、电压信号;对晶闸管触发角移相的控制实现电动机启动电压和电流的调节;电动机启动过程中的参数可以根据电动机不同负载特性来设置;启动过程设计了过压、过流检测电路和电动机保护回路;可以确保电动机安全平稳的启动。对该设计方案进行仿真和实验验证;仿真和实验表明在相同负载下;直接启动方式下电动机启动时会产生5～7倍额定电流强度的启动电流;而在软启动方式下减小到2倍左右;验证了本设计能显著地降低电机启动电流。
keywords: asynchronous motor, digital signal processing(dsp), soft start, three-phase voltage regulation
affiliations: 西安科技大学理学院, 西安科技大学电气与控制工程学院
source: 实验室研究与探索 ;Research and Exploration in Laboratory ; Editorial E-mail ;2021(01)

title: Research on monitoring and early-warning system based on DSP
abstract: In order to ensure the safe and reliable operation of mechanical and electrical equipment;a monitoring and early-warning system is researched and designed based on TMS320 F28335 DSP chip.The key state parameters of the equipment are collected by on-chip and external A/D converter;and the parameters are written into the data storage circularly to provide data support for the possible faultsthe equipment working log including early-warning code;power on time and power off time is establishedthe communication interface and related protocol between the system and the host computer are developed to realize the data transmission.At present;the system has been applied to the electrostatic suspension equipment;which can meet the needs of its operation condition monitoring and fault early warning.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了保障机电设备的安全可靠运行;研究并设计了基于DSP芯片TMS320F28335的状态监测及预警系统。通过DSP片上及外扩的A/D转换器采集设备运行的关键状态参数;循环写入外扩的数据存储器中;为可能出现的故障提供数据支持建立了包括预警编码、上电时间、断电时间在内的设备工作日志开发了系统与上位机的通信接口及相关协议以实现二者间的数据传输。目前;系统已应用于静电悬浮设备;能够满足其运行状态监测及故障预警的需求。
keywords: condition monitoring, dsp, early-warning, work log
affiliations: 清华大学精密仪器系

title: Design of Internet+Smart Agricultural System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at some problems presented by the smart agriculture system based on the Internet of Things technology;an improved design scheme is proposed.It further reduces the cost burden on capital and the learning cost used by farmers.In addition to large-scale farming cultivation groups;it can also be extended to ordinary individual growers.Through ZigBee technology for networking;the terminal equipment is distributed around the crops.Users can remotely obtain environmental information near the terminal equipment through the mobile phone app;and use relay switches to achieve remote watering and other functions.Due to the use of photovoltaic-battery power supply and sub-nodes can sleep with low power consumption;the system has reached a balance of low cost;low power consumption and high reliability.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对如今基于物联网技术构建的智慧农业系统表现出的一些问题;提出了一种改良的设计方案。其进一步减轻了资金上的成本负担与农民使用的学习成本;除大规模农场化的种植集团外;还可推广至普通的个体种植户。通过ZigBee技术进行组网;将终端设备分布在农作物周围;用户可以通过手机应用程序远程获取终端设备附近的环境信息;并利用继电器开关实现远程浇水等功能。由于采用光伏-蓄电池供电与子节点可以进行低功耗休眠的方案;该系统达到了低成本、低功耗和高可靠性三者的平衡。
keywords: cc2530, internet of things, smart agriculture, zigbee technology

title: 基于ZigBee技术的农业大棚灯光智能控制系统

title: Design and Implementation of Defect Detection System for Packing Case Type Mark
abstract: The work aims to design a defect detection system for packing case type mark based on image processing; in order to realize the real-time and dynamic detection of the type mark defects on the air-conditioning packing case. The hardware platform of the control system was designed based on AM5728 controller; which mainly including the control unit; image acquisition and processing unit; imaging unit; etc.; and the actual test research was carried out. Several key methods were adopted; including image enhancement; morphology; defect detection; dynamic threshold segmentation algorithm; etc.; and the registration area was selected according to the characteristics of the packing case type mark image. At the same time; a dynamic threshold segmentation algorithm was given to realize defect detection by various algorithms. 250 bar code samples are collected; and the monitoring data are obtained by using the method in this paper. The accuracy rate is as high as 97.2%; and the rate of missing inspection is 0.This method has high reliability and generality and can realize the defect detection of the type mark of the packing case quickly; and solve the practical engineering problem of the real-time dynamic defect detection of the type mark on the air-conditioning packing case.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的为了实现空调包装箱上型号标记缺陷的实时动态检测;基于图像处理技术设计包装箱型号标记缺陷检测系统。方法基于AM5728控制器设计控制系统硬件平台;主要包括控制单元、图像采集与处理单元、成像单元等;并进行实际测试研究。采用几个关键方法;包括图像增强处理、形态学、缺陷检测、动态阈值分割算法等;并根据包装箱型号标记图像特征选择配准区域;同时给出一种动态阈值分割算法;利用各种算法实现缺陷检测。结果采集了250个包装箱条码样本;采用文中方法获取到了监测数据;正确率高达97.2%;漏检率为0。结论该方法具有较高的可靠性、通用性;可实现包装箱型号标记的缺陷快速检测;解决了空调包装箱上的型号标记实时动态缺陷检测的实际工程问题。
keywords: defect detection, image processing, packing case, type mark

title: Design of interferometer measurement and control system based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the problems that traditional interferometers need to manually adjust mechanical devices and the degree of automation is low;a wireless measurement and control system with ZigBee-CC2530 as the core is designed. The system use two CC2530 nodes as radio frequency signal transceivers to implement wireless control functions in a point-to-point communication manner. At the same time;the Microsoft basic class library MFC( Microsoft Foundation Classes) is used to design the host computer software to control the operation of the precision motor through serial communication;and the corresponding travel limit solution is designed based on different conditions in the narrow and compact space of the interferometer;so that the precision motor can meet the measurement and control requirements for fixed-point braking;improve the measurement efficiency and accuracy of the interferometer.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统干涉仪需要手工调节机械装置;自动化程度低等问题;该文设计了一套以Zig Bee-CC2530为核心的无线测控系统。该系统将2个CC2530节点分别作为射频信号收发器;以点对点通信的方式实现无线控制功能。同时利用微软基础类库MFC(Microsoft Foundation Classes)设计了上位机软件;通过串口通信控制精密电机的运转;并在仪器内部基于不同条件设计了对应的行程限位解决方案;使得精密电机可以满足测控要求定点制动;提高了干涉仪的测量效率和精度。
keywords: interferometer, microsoft foundation classes host computer, wireless control

title: 基于ZigBee组网技术的智慧病房系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对病房环境难以实时监测和医护人员工作量大等问题;提出一种基于ZigBee组网的智慧病房系统设计。系统以CC2530芯片为核心;采集病房温湿度、病人体温和临床求助呼叫等数据;利用ZigBee组网等相关技术;以无线传输方式将数据传输至上位机;并储存至服务器端;便于医护人员实时掌握数据。从而克服了现有系统成本高、布线复杂、维护困难等问题。实验表明:本系统可以对病人体温和病房环境进行无线监测;同时具有临床求助呼叫功能;满足病房管理与服务的需求。

title: Research on ZigBee-based Family Ornamental Fish Breeding Water Quality Monitoring System
abstract: 观赏鱼养殖作为我国渔业的一个崭新领域;拥有着良好的发展机遇。由于观赏鱼对养殖水质环境的要求较高;而且传统的养殖方式和人工监测手段难以保证水质参数的实时性和准确性;因此利用ZigBee无线传感网络;设计了一种家庭观赏鱼养殖水质监测系统;实现对水温和pH值等重要水质参数的采集和实时传输。

title: Program interaction mechanism design based on multi-chip TMS320C6678
abstract: In order to solve the problem of complex program interaction mechanism in multiprocessor multicore signal processing system;a multiprocessor multicore program interaction mechanism based on master-slave mode is designed. In this mechanism;the hierarchical design of program communication architecture is carried out;and SRIO(Serial RapidIO)is adopted to realize the communication of the processor;the communication of the core in the processor is realized through inter-core interrupt Notify and shared variables;and the communication of each thread in the core is realized through semaphore. In order to verify the practicability and efficiency of the mechanism;a signal processing experiment of large amount of data is carried out. Through the analysis of the experimental results;the function of each module of the program is stable;the data interaction is smooth;and the communication time is about 2%;which verifies that the interaction mechanism of the program has certain application value in engineering practice.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对多处理器多核心信号处理系统程序交互机制复杂的问题;设计了一种基于主从模式的多处理器多核心程序交互机制。该机制将程序通信架构进行层级化设计;采用SRIO(Serial RapidIO)实现处理器间通信;通过核间中断Notify以及共享变量实现处理器内核心间通信;通过信号量实现核心内各线程间通信。为验证该机制的实用性与高效性;进行了大量的数据信号处理实验;通过实验结果分析;程序各模块功能稳定;数据交互流畅;通信耗时占比在2%左右;验证了该程序交互机制在工程实践中有一定的应用价值。
keywords: interthread communication, master-slave mode, multicore communication, multiprocessor interaction, tms320 c6678

title: 基于CC2530的ZigBee RFID读写应用研究
abstract: The paper uses CC2530 chip of T1 company to design a RFID card reading and writing detection system based on ZigBee.The RFID module (MFRC522) supports various types of microcontroller interface that can be directly connected;such as SPI;I2C and Serial UARA.Considering that SPI interface can handle data transmission rate up to 10Mbits / s;the following uses SPI bus to test and realize the communication between RFID and MCU module.

title: 基于ZigBee的室外篮球场智能照明控制系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 随着我国全民健身深入推进与篮球热潮持续掀起;篮球场等公共体育设施建设不足问题日益凸显。如今;众多年轻人将打球时间安排在傍晚或晚上;室内篮球场数量有限且需要付费;大量室外篮球场因为缺乏照明而无法在晚间被有效利用起来。针对该问题;设计一套基于ZigBee的室外篮球场智能照明控制系统。该系统以CC2530为核心芯片;通过多传感器采集篮板上的光照度、压力和湿度等数据;随后通过ZigBee网络多点分布式输出至协调器;协调器根据一定规则处理数据并输出控制信号至照明开关;从而实现室外球场照明系统的智能控制。该系统能做到"有人打球时自动开灯、无人打球时自动关灯";为新型室外灯光球场的建设提供了技术方法与节能策略;为驱使更多年轻人利用晚间空余时间走向篮球场提供了助力。

title: 基于物联网的智能天气识别系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 文中将传感技术、无线传输技术和Scikit-learn相结合;设计一种基于物联网的智能天气识别系统;可实时播报天气情况。该系统采用DS18B20测温模块、DHT11湿度采集模块收集温湿度信息;通过Arduino UNO R3开发板采集天气信息;由CC2530模块将采集到的温度、湿度信息通过无线网络传输给上位机;通过上位机的Scikit-learn训练模型实现对天气状况的实时识别。实验表明;所提系统可获取当前小范围地区较精确的天气信息;实验结果良好。

title: Research on multi parameter monitoring system of home environment based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the traditional smart home;this paper studies a low-power;low-cost wireless access system for home gateway based on ZigBee technology.Stm32f103rct6 is used as the hardware control platform;and the power supply module;clock module and EEPROM module are combined to complete the construction of the smart home gateway system.ZigBee uses the wireless communication module with CC2530 as the main chip;and esp8266 communication module with practical function is used in WiFi part to realize the real-time monitoring of home environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统智能家居存在的问题;本文研究一种基于ZigBee技术的低功耗、低成本家庭网关无线接入系统;采用STM32F103RCT6单片机作为硬件控制平台;结合供电模块、时钟模块和EEPROM模块等外围电路;来完成智能家居网关系统的组建。ZigBee部分采用主芯片为CC2530的无线通信模块;WiFi部分采用功能实用的ESP8266通信模块;实现对家居环境的实时监控。

title: DSP Based automatic Recognition System forhome appliance’s tip sound
abstract: It is easy to cause hearing fatigue and mis-judgment for human being to detect the tip sound of the buzzer in the noisy environment for long time.Therefore;We designed an automatic Recognition System for home appliance’s tip sound based on a floating point DSP of TMS320F28335 of Ti in this paper.The FIR bandpass filter was used to filter the signal;using FFT to extract the spectrum features;and using the maximum similarity to classify.Using DMA module todesign the ping-pong cache;and realize the synchronization mechanism of real-time acquisition and signal processing.The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can recognize the pattern of the sound correctly and meets FISHER’s criterion.
abstract_in_chinese: 长期在噪声环境下采用人耳检测蜂鸣器的鸣叫音;易产生听觉疲劳、判断错误;因此;本文设计了基于TI公司的浮点型DSP-TMS320F28335的电器鸣叫音自动识别系统。采用FIR带通滤波器对信号进行滤波;利用FFT提取频谱特征;基于最大相似度进行分类。利用DMA模块设计了乒乓缓存器;保证了实时采集和信号处理同步进行。实验表明:本文的算法可以实现鸣叫音模式的正确识别;且具备FISHER准则的典型特征。
keywords: fft, fir bandpass filtering, pattern recognition, ping-pong cache, tms320f28335
affiliations: 安徽建筑大学电子与信息工程学院, 惠而浦(中国)全球研发中心

title: Design of Farmland Intelligent Irrigation System Based on ZigBee
abstract: A farmland intelligent irrigation system is designed based on ZigBee technology.The system collects irrigation water flow informations through Hall flow sensor;water temperature sensor and other sensors;and uses ZigBee wireless sensor network to realize communication.The interface of MFC upper computer is designed to display irrigation water flow informations in real time;which is convenient for staff to view and control.The system has the advantages of low power consumption;high precision;convenient use and maintenance;and easy to expand.It can accurately control speed of irrigation water flow;display the information of irrigation water flow speed;flow rate and temperature in real time;and basically meet the complex needs of the current irrigation industry.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于ZigBee技术设计了农田智能灌溉系统。该系统通过霍尔流量传感器、水温传感器等多种传感器采集灌溉水流信息;利用ZigBee无线传感网络实现通信;设计了MFC上位机界面实时显示灌溉水流信息;方便工作人员查看、控制。该系统具有功耗低、精度高、使用和维护便捷、易于扩展等优点;能够精确控制灌溉水流速度;实时显示灌溉水流速度、流量、温度等信息;基本能够满足当前灌溉行业的复杂需求。
keywords: cc2530, intelligent irrigation system, mfc pc, wsn, zigbee technology

title: 智能侦察机器人运动控制系统设计

title: The application and exploration of image processing technology used on household electric appliances testing
abstract: The application of image processing technology in household electric appliances performance test can achieve clearer and more intuitive results; taking the oil smoke test of automatic cooker as an example; the composition and frame of the whole system were designed. TMS320 DM6437 as the core component of data processing in the system; background difference method as the main method to extract feature targets and the system focuses on the design of feature target extraction process and related algorithms. In addition; the application of image processing technology in household electric appliances test was discussed through the analysis of the oil smoke test of automatic cooker.
abstract_in_chinese: 将图像处理技术运用在产品性能检测上;可以取得更加清晰直观的效果;以炒菜机油烟量测试为例;设计了整体系统的组成及框架。系统中硬件采用TMS320DM6437作为数据处理的核心部件;利用背景差分法作为提取特征目标的主要方法;系统重点设计了特征目标提取的流程及相关算法。另外通过炒菜机油烟量测试的应用分析;探讨了图像处理技术在家电检测上的运用。

title: Simulation of Night Vehicle Detection Based on Mixed Features of Color Channels
abstract: Vehicle detection at night is an indispensable part of the advanced driving assistance system. In this paper; a new night vehicle detection algorithm was proposed based on HSV and RGB color space; and the system simulation was implemented on the hardware platform of TMS320 DM6437. Firstly; the extracted(R-G)×V mixed features of color channels were used to segment the image preliminarily Secondly; combined with the basic rules of tail lamp matching; we can finish the screening of taillight Finally; the detection of night vehicles was realized based on the detected taillights. The method was simulated on the hardware platform. The simulation results show that the night vehicle detection algorithm based on the mixed features of color channels can locate the night vehicle quickly and accurately.
abstract_in_chinese: 夜间环境下的车辆检测;是高级驾驶辅助系统中不可缺失的一环。结合HSV与RGB两种颜色空间;提出一种新的夜间车辆检测算法;并在TMS320DM6437硬件平台上进行了系统仿真实现。首先;通过提取得到的(R-G)×V颜色通道混合特征完成对图像的初步分割之后;再结合尾灯配对的基本准则完成尾灯对的筛选最后;根据检测到的尾灯对实现夜间车辆的检测。上述方法在硬件平台上进行了系统仿真。仿真结果证明;基于颜色通道混合特征的夜间车辆检测算法能够快速准确地定位夜间车辆。
keywords: hardware platform, mixed features of color channels, night vehicle, taillight matching

title: Design of DSP Data Acquisition System for Attitude Parameters of Rotary Steering Drilling Tools
abstract: The development of rotary steerable drilling technology requires more precise measurement of tool attitude parameters; namely well angle I;tool face angle T; azimuth angle A; etc. which are the key factors to achieve precise control of downhole steering and ensure that the borehole trajectory is optimally designed Drilling through paths to complete oil drilling and production tasks. In this paper; based on the technical characteristics of rotary steering drilling; based on the existing drilling tool attitude measurement theory; a DSP-based drilling tool attitude data acquisition and processing system design scheme is proposed. The system uses TMS320F28335 as the core processing chip to carry out system hardware. Circuit design; meanwhile; ADC correction circuit is designed to improve TMS320F28335 internal ADC sampling conversion accuracy.
abstract_in_chinese: 旋转导向钻井技术的发展要求更加精准的测量工具姿态参数;即井斜角I、工具面角T、方位角A等;是实现井下导向精准控制的关键因素;能确保井眼轨迹按最佳设计路径钻进;完成石油钻采任务。根据旋转导向钻井的技术特点;在已有的钻井工具姿态测量理论的基础上;提出一种基于DSP的钻井工具姿态数据采集与处理系统设计方案;系统以TMS320F28335作为核心处理芯片;进行系统硬件电路设计;同时为提高TMS320F28335内部ADC采样转换精度还设计ADC校正电路。
keywords: attitude parameters, data acquisition, dsp

title: 基于ZigBee的医院病房呼叫系统设计
abstract: In recent years;intelligent technologies such as wireless technology have developed rapidly;among them;ZigBee technology belongs to short-distance wireless communication technology;which has the characteristics of large network capacity;low transmission rate;low cost;low power consumption;stability and flexibility;and has attracted wide attention from all walks of life.This paper mainly discussed the wireless ward call system designed according to ZigBee technology to meet the hospital’s demand for the ward call system;facilitate patient application;improve the quality of nursing service;provide more high-quality;comprehensive and systematic services for the majority of patients;and improve patient satisfaction.This design uses the CC2530 chip as the main control chip;equipped with an LCD display and buttons;and has functions such as alarm and vibration;which facilitates real-time communication and communication between medical staff and patients.This design adopts C language programming and has undergone simulation demonstration;which can ensure the efficient operation of the system and help to meet the treatment and rehabilitation needs of patients in time.
abstract_in_chinese: 近年来;无线技术等智能化技术发展迅猛;其中;ZigBee技术属于短距离无线通信技术;具有网络容量大、传输速率低、成本小、功耗低、稳定和灵活等特点;受到社会各界广泛的关注。本文主要探讨根据ZigBee技术设计的无线病房呼叫系统;以满足医院对病房呼叫系统的需求;方便患者应用;提高护理服务质量;为广大患者提供更加优质、全面、系统的服务;提高患者的满意度。本设计方案以CC2530型芯片作为主控芯片;配有液晶显示屏和按键;兼具报警、振动等功能;便于医护人员与患者进行实时交流和沟通。本设计采用C语言编程并经过仿真论证;能够确保系统高效运转;有助于及时满足患者的治疗和康复需求。
keywords: hospital ward call system, network capacity, patient satisfaction, power consumption, transmission rate, zigbee
affiliations: 南阳理工学院, Nanyang Institute of Technology

title: 基于多片TMS320C6678的程序交互机制设计
abstract: In order to solve the problem of complex program interaction mechanism in multiprocessor multicore signal processing system;a multiprocessor multicore program interaction mechanism based on master-slave mode is designed. In this mechanism;the hierarchical design of program communication architecture is carried out;and SRIO(Serial RapidIO)is adopted to realize the communication of the processor;the communication of the core in the processor is realized through inter-core interrupt Notify and shared variables;and the communication of each thread in the core is realized through semaphore. In order to verify the practicability and efficiency of the mechanism;a signal processing experiment of large amount of data is carried out. Through the analysis of the experimental results;the function of each module of the program is stable;the data interaction is smooth;and the communication time is about 2%;which verifies that the interaction mechanism of the program has certain application value in engineering practice.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对多处理器多核心信号处理系统程序交互机制复杂的问题;设计了一种基于主从模式的多处理器多核心程序交互机制。该机制将程序通信架构进行层级化设计;采用SRIO(Serial RapidIO)实现处理器间通信;通过核间中断Notify以及共享变量实现处理器内核心间通信;通过信号量实现核心内各线程间通信。为验证该机制的实用性与高效性;进行了大量的数据信号处理实验;通过实验结果分析;程序各模块功能稳定;数据交互流畅;通信耗时占比在2%左右;验证了该程序交互机制在工程实践中有一定的应用价值。
keywords: interthread communication, master-slave mode, multicore communication, multiprocessor interaction, tms320 c6678

title: Design of Low Power Bluetooth module based on CC2541
abstract: This paper designs an ultra-low power Bluetooth module based on TI company cc2541;which can connect quickly and exchange data in two directions.The circuit composition and principle of the ultra-low power Bluetooth module are introduced in detail;and the power performance and stability of the module are analyzed from the perspective of current and data integrity.

title: 基于TMS320F28335的数字伺服舰载稳定平台
abstract_in_chinese: 稳定平台通过不断地采集载体的运动姿态;对平台上物体的姿态进行反方向补偿;使平台上的物体不受载体运动的影响;始终相对水平面保持一个既定位置。从而使安装在平台上的装备能实现快速精准的跟踪、扫描等功能。稳定平台被广泛应用于车载、机载、舰载等军事和民用领域。本设计基于DSP TMS320F28335数字伺服控制处理芯片;采用了分轴稳定结构形式、交流伺服系统位置环控制、增量式PID控制器。最后将呈现实际应用结果。

title: 低功耗热电偶无线传感器节点设计与实现
abstract: At present; industrial temperature measurement sensor nodes generally use wired connections. When the number of sensor nodes continues to increase; there is serious wear and tear on the cables; and the cable layout is intricate and complicated; which brings unnecessary trouble for later maintenance. In view of the above problems; a low-power thermocouple wireless sensor node for industrial temperature measurement is designed and developed. In terms of hardware; the slave node adopts a modular design; including a wireless communication acquisition module; a thermocouple sensor module and a power module in terms of software; in the non-working state; the slave node uses the asynchronous periodic sleep and wake mechanism to listen to the command of the master node; which makes the system have the advantage of low power consumption. In the working state; the master node uses the polling method to control the slaves in turn. The nodes complete the data collection and transmission to ensure the stability and reliability of the system data transmission. Experimental tests show that the system has the advantages of stable and reliable data transmission; wide coverage area; and low power consumption.
abstract_in_chinese: 目前工业上测温传感器节点普遍采用有线连接;当传感器节点不断增多时;线缆之间存在严重的磨损;错乱的线缆摆放;为将来维护也带来不便。针对以上问题;设计并开发了一种用于工业温度测量的低功耗热电偶无线传感器节点。在硬件方面;从节点采用模块化设计;由无线通信采集模块;热电偶传感器模块和电源模块组成在软件方面;非工作模式下从节点采用异步周期性休眠唤醒机制来侦听主控节点命令;使系统具有低功耗的优势;工作模式下主控节点采用轮询的方法依次控制从节点完成数据的采集与发送;保证系统数据传输的稳定可靠。经过实验测试表明;该系统具有数据传输稳定可靠、覆盖面积广、低功耗等优势。

title: 基于Android的智能家居系统设计与研究
abstract_in_chinese: 从20世纪80年代智能家居概念的提出至今已有30多年;智能家居已经历了4代的发展。家居智能控制系统价格低;性价比高;越来越受欢迎。将具有Android操作系统的智能手机或者平板电脑作为智能家居系统的控制终端;以CC2530单片机最小系统作为硬件电路及控制器;设计ZigBee、WIFI及315M射频网络软件;通过RT5350与CC2530的串口连接将ZigBee和WIFI连接起来;设计并开发本基于Android的智能家居系统。

title: 基于MATLAB/Simulink的TMS320F28335代码自动生成及其应用
abstract: The C2000 series DSP chips of TI company are mainly for digital control and motion control. It occupies a leading position in the field of motor control. However; traditional code development methods have long cycles; low efficiency; sometimes poor readability; and are difficult to modify and maintain. With the development of industrial technology; the development process of control system requires lower cost and shorter cycle; and MATLAB/Simulink with TI DSP just provides a good platform for automatic code generation development. It shortens the development cycle; improves the reliability; and simplifies the modification of parameters during debugging. Users can download the code directly to the target board and run the code in Simulink environment; which simplifies the code development process and improves the development efficiency.
abstract_in_chinese: TI公司C2000系列的DSP芯片主要面向数字控制、运动控制领域。在电机控制领域占有主导的地位。但是传统的代码开发方法周期较长;效率不高;有时可读性较差;难以修改、维护。随着工业技术的发展;控制系统的开发流程要求更低的成本和更短的周期;而MATLAB/Simulink配合TI公司的DSP正好为此提供一个很好的代码自动生成开发平台。缩短开发周期;提高可靠性;简化在调试过程中对参数的修改。用户可以在Simulink环境中将代码直接下载到目标板并运行代码;简化代码开发过程;提高开发效率。

title: 基于物联网的智能天气识别系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 文中将传感技术、无线传输技术和Scikit-learn相结合;设计一种基于物联网的智能天气识别系统;可实时播报天气情况。该系统采用DS18B20测温模块、DHT11湿度采集模块收集温湿度信息;通过Arduino UNO R3开发板采集天气信息;由CC2530模块将采集到的温度、湿度信息通过无线网络传输给上位机;通过上位机的Scikit-learn训练模型实现对天气状况的实时识别。实验表明;所提系统可获取当前小范围地区较精确的天气信息;实验结果良好。

title: 基于ZigBee技术的家居环境多参数监测系统研究
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the traditional smart home;this paper studies a low-power;low-cost wireless access system for home gateway based on ZigBee technology.Stm32f103rct6 is used as the hardware control platform;and the power supply module;clock module and EEPROM module are combined to complete the construction of the smart home gateway system.ZigBee uses the wireless communication module with CC2530 as the main chip;and esp8266 communication module with practical function is used in WiFi part to realize the real-time monitoring of home environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统智能家居存在的问题;本文研究一种基于ZigBee技术的低功耗、低成本家庭网关无线接入系统;采用STM32F103RCT6单片机作为硬件控制平台;结合供电模块、时钟模块和EEPROM模块等外围电路;来完成智能家居网关系统的组建。ZigBee部分采用主芯片为CC2530的无线通信模块;WiFi部分采用功能实用的ESP8266通信模块;实现对家居环境的实时监控。

affiliations: 江苏安全技术职业学院电气工程系, Jiangsu College of Safety Technology

title: 基于DSP的电器鸣叫音自动识别系统
abstract: It is easy to cause hearing fatigue and mis-judgment for human being to detect the tip sound of the buzzer in the noisy environment for long time.Therefore;We designed an automatic Recognition System for home appliance’s tip sound based on a floating point DSP of TMS320F28335 of Ti in this paper.The FIR bandpass filter was used to filter the signal;using FFT to extract the spectrum features;and using the maximum similarity to classify.Using DMA module todesign the ping-pong cache;and realize the synchronization mechanism of real-time acquisition and signal processing.The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can recognize the pattern of the sound correctly and meets FISHER’s criterion.
abstract_in_chinese: 长期在噪声环境下采用人耳检测蜂鸣器的鸣叫音;易产生听觉疲劳、判断错误;因此;本文设计了基于TI公司的浮点型DSP-TMS320F28335的电器鸣叫音自动识别系统。采用FIR带通滤波器对信号进行滤波;利用FFT提取频谱特征;基于最大相似度进行分类。利用DMA模块设计了乒乓缓存器;保证了实时采集和信号处理同步进行。实验表明:本文的算法可以实现鸣叫音模式的正确识别;且具备FISHER准则的典型特征。
keywords: fft, fir bandpass filtering, pattern recognition, ping-pong cache, tms320f28335
affiliations: 惠而浦(中国)全球研发中心, Global R&d Center, 安徽建筑大学电子与信息工程学院, Anhui Jianzhu University, School of Electronics and Information Engineering, China

title: 基于ZigBee的农田智能灌溉系统研究设计
abstract: A farmland intelligent irrigation system is designed based on ZigBee technology.The system collects irrigation water flow informations through Hall flow sensor;water temperature sensor and other sensors;and uses ZigBee wireless sensor network to realize communication.The interface of MFC upper computer is designed to display irrigation water flow informations in real time;which is convenient for staff to view and control.The system has the advantages of low power consumption;high precision;convenient use and maintenance;and easy to expand.It can accurately control speed of irrigation water flow;display the information of irrigation water flow speed;flow rate and temperature in real time;and basically meet the complex needs of the current irrigation industry.

keywords: cc2530, intelligent irrigation system, mfc pc, wsn, zigbee technology

title: 基于ZigBee的家庭观赏鱼养殖水质监测系统研究
abstract_in_chinese: 观赏鱼养殖作为我国渔业的一个崭新领域;拥有着良好的发展机遇。由于观赏鱼对养殖水质环境的要求较高;而且传统的养殖方式和人工监测手段难以保证水质参数的实时性和准确性;因此利用ZigBee无线传感网络;设计了一种家庭观赏鱼养殖水质监测系统;实现对水温和pH值等重要水质参数的采集和实时传输。

title: Speed Estimation Algorithm for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Novel Super-twisting Adaptive Observer
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance and robustness of the traditional MRAS（model reference adaptive system）-based speed estimation strategy; we proposed a novel speed estimation strategy based on supertwisting-algorithm adaptive observer（STA-AO）. Firstly; a corrective feedback loop was added to the STA-AO which is based on the structure of the model reference adaptive system（MRAS） by which the convergence speed of the difference between the outputs of the reference model and the adjustable model was improved. Then; the super twisting algorithm was introduced into an STA-AO to replace the proportional–integral（PI） adaptive mechanism; by which the robustness of the observer was improved. Finally; the simulation and experimental tests were performed with the Matlab/Simulink software and a 500 W permanent magnet synchronous motor（PMSM） controlled by the TMS320F28335 DSP. The results show that; compared with the MRAS-based speed estimation method; the STA-AO can make the speed estimation error converge to zero faster; and the speed estimation of the STA-AO is more negligibly affected by motor parameter perturbation. Therefore; the STA-AO-based estimation strategy has better dynamic performance and robustness than the MRAS-based estimation strategy.

title: Design and Research of Monitoring System for Spot Welding Production of Agricultural Machinery Frame Based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to realize the remote visual monitoring of spot welding production of agricultural machinery frame and improve the precision and efficiency of the process; this paper designed a monitoring system of spot welding production of agricultural machinery frame based on Zig Bee technology. Firstly; the design requirements and hardware structure of the system are summarized. Secondly; the system hardware selection and networking mode are described. Finally; the system software development environment and the compiling idea of spot welding production monitoring program are described. This system mainly includes two parts: upper computer and lower computer. It can realize remote wireless visual monitoring of agricultural machine frame spot welding production; and has certain advanced and application.

title: 基于新型超螺旋滑模自适应观测器的永磁同步电机转速估计策略
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance and robustness of the traditional MRAS(model reference adaptive system)-based speed estimation strategy; we proposed a novel speed estimation strategy based on supertwisting-algorithm adaptive observer(STA-AO). Firstly; a corrective feedback loop was added to the STA-AO which is based on the structure of the model reference adaptive system(MRAS) by which the convergence speed of the difference between the outputs of the reference model and the adjustable model was improved. Then; the super twisting algorithm was introduced into an STA-AO to replace the proportional–integral(PI) adaptive mechanism; by which the robustness of the observer was improved. Finally; the simulation and experimental tests were performed with the Matlab/Simulink software and a 500 W permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) controlled by the TMS320F28335 DSP. The results show that; compared with the MRAS-based speed estimation method; the STA-AO can make the speed estimation error converge to zero faster; and the speed estimation of the STA-AO is more negligibly affected by motor parameter perturbation. Therefore; the STA-AO-based estimation strategy has better dynamic performance and robustness than the MRAS-based estimation strategy.

title: 基于DSP的矿用巡检机器人控制系统设计
abstract: Mine inspection robot has important application value for realizing unmanned(or less humanized)production in coal mine;and eliminating blind spots and safety blind areas in underground monitoring.In order to improve the stability;reliability and endurance;the floating-point DSP controller TMS320 F28335 was used to develop and design the inspection robot control system. The system hardware uses modular design to reduce the hardware development cycle and control system complexity. The software uses the main program scan and external interrupt source to trigger;which is further taking advantage of the fast floating-point operation of DSP. The system can realize the efficient centralized processing of monitoring signals and data of the inspection robot in the process of underground operation; and it has the advantages of strong real-time stability; reliable operation and high computational efficiency.

title: 一种提高MLS角度精度的综合测量方法
abstract: The angle measurement of Microwave Landing System(MLS) is studied;and a comprehensive method for improving the accuracy of angle measurement is proposed.In this method;symmetry of the to-and-fro scanning beams is used to suppress multipath interference;the peak detection algorithm based on intersection of straight lines of position is presented to improve angle measurement accuracy;and digital filtering is used to mitigate the impact of noise.The proposed method has been verified by the digital signal processing system based on TMS320 F2812 DSP.The testing results show that the method has the advantages of high measurement accuracy;robustness to multipath interference and easy engineering implementation.

title: Design of Primary and Secondary Students Positioning System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: In recent years;the security of primary and secondary schools has gradually received the wide attention of the whole society. To obtain the location information of students in real time and prevent and avoid risks; a student indoor positioning system is designed based on Zig Bee technology;with the CC2530 chip as the core module. The positioning algorithm flow based on RSSI ranging;the overall structure of the system;the schematic diagram for node hardware and the software design scheme are given. title: Wireless Detection System in Intelligent Ward
abstract: STM32 F103 RGT6 and STM32 F429 IGT6 were used as the control core to design an intelligent ward wireless detection system; which could detect the temperature and humidity of the ward by temperature and humidity module; detect the ambient brightness of the ward by photosensitive sensor module; detect the gas concentration of the ward by gas sensor module; and detect whether the patient in the ward or not by human infrared sensor module; and watch the patient’s status by camera module; etc. The minimum system module of CC2530 was used as the controller to control DHT11 sensor module; photosensitive sensor module;MQ-2 gas sensor module and human infrared sensor module to collect environmental information in the ward. The minimum system module of STM32 F429 IGT6 was used to control OV5640 image sensor to collect real-time picture information in the ward. ZigBee wireless transmission module and MT8266 WIFI data transmission module were used. The system communicates with STM32 F103 RGT6 main control board and computer host computer; displays and stores the acquired data information by TFTLCD and host computer; and realizes the intelligent detection and monitoring of the ward environment.

title: Application and Realization of RTC Module in DSP System
abstract: Series C2000 DSP is widely used in many fields such as industrial control and aerospace. In these applications; the real-time acquisition is particularly important; because accurate time can enhance the overall real-time performance of the system and improve the efficiency of the system. Although the peripherals of the series C2000 DSP are relatively abundant; there is no real-time clock module on the chip. Therefore; this paper proposes a method of designing the real-time clock system based on Texas Instruments(TI) TMS320 F28335 DSP. A real-time clock system based on the TMS320 F28335 chip is constructed by taking this DSP type as the main control chip; expanding the real-time clock chip based on the I~2C communication mode; and combining other necessary components of the DSP minimum system. After experimental tests; the real-time clock part of the system can automatically use the clock perpetual calendar function; provide effective and reliable real-time time to the CPU; and lay a time foundation for the follow-up work and data processing of the DSP.

keywords: dsp, i~2c communication, perpetual calendar, real-time clock

title: Research and development of hardware-in-the-loop simulation teaching platform for control course group
abstract: The hardware-in-the-loop simulation teaching system is designed for the practical teaching of control courses; which consists of three modules such as the dual core floating-point digital signal processor(DSP) TMS320 F28379D; isolated analog digital output interface and man-machine interface. In the dual core floating-point DSP; one core(simulation core) is used to simulate the experimental object; and the other core(control core) is used to control the experimental object. The data interaction between the two cores can realize the open-loop characteristic test and closed-loop control of the experimental object. By setting the model of the experimental object by the teachers and the model of control core actions and observing the waveform online by the students; this teaching platform can effectively fill the missing link between simulation and hardware modulation in practice teaching. The effectiveness and practicability of the teaching platform are verified by the experiments of typical second-order system Buck circuit and double tank system.

title: Design of Fault Recorder Equipment Based on AM3358 Chip
abstract: A fault recording device based on AM3358 is designed;which is simpler than he traditional multi chip system solutions such as MCU plus DSP or MCU plus FPGA. This design relies on the advantages of the real-time PRU module in AM3358 chip and the highspeed ARM core;which makes the fault recording equipment run on a single control platform. It can not only meet the highperformance requirements of the power system recording equipment;but also reduce the design complexity of the recording equipment.The device meets the requirements of embedded integrated industrial design. It improves the recording reliability;reduces the cost and reference;and meets the requirements of wide area measurement and stability of the power system. The recording and unification of the acquisition and analysis process are achieved;which has better practical application value.

abstract: STM32 F103 RGT6 and STM32 F429 IGT6 were used as the control core to design an intelligent ward wireless detection system; which could detect the temperature and humidity of the ward by temperature and humidity module; detect the ambient brightness of the ward by photosensitive sensor module; detect the gas concentration of the ward by gas sensor module; and detect whether the patient in the ward or not by human infrared sensor module; and watch the patient’s status by camera module; etc. The minimum system module of CC2530 was used as the controller to control DHT11 sensor module; photosensitive sensor module;MQ-2 gas sensor module and human infrared sensor module to collect environmental information in the ward. The minimum system module of STM32 F429 IGT6 was used to control OV5640 image sensor to collect real-time picture information in the ward. ZigBee wireless transmission module and MT8266 WIFI data transmission module were used. The system communicates with STM32 F103 RGT6 main control board and computer host computer; displays and stores the acquired data information by TFTLCD and host computer; and realizes the intelligent detection and monitoring of the ward environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 以STM32F103RGT6和STM32F429IGT6为控制核心设计了一款智能病房无线检测系统。可通过温湿度模块检测病房的温湿度;根据光敏传感器模块检测病房的环境亮度;采用气体传感器模块检测病房的气体浓度;并通过人体红外传感器模块检测病人是否在病房内以及采用摄像头模块观看病人的状态等。以CC2530最小系统模块作为控制器控制DHT11传感器模块、光敏传感器模块、MQ-2气体传感器模块和人体红外传感器模块采集病房内的环境信息;通过STM32F429IGT6最小系统模块控制OV5640图像传感器采集病房内的实时画面信息;采用ZigBee无线传输模块和MT8266 WIFI数据传输模块与STM32F103RGT6主控板和电脑上位机进行信息交互;采用TFT LCD和上位机显示并存储获取到的数据信息;实现了对病房内环境的智能检测和监控。
keywords: cc2530, information exchange, pc, real-time, wireless detection
authors: Ltd.;He Weichao;Li Chaoping;Ling Zhongfa;Guan Peixian;Wu Yongshen;Long Jiale;Hu Liangpei

title: 基于单片机的智能家居控制系统的设计
abstract_in_chinese: 作为智能家居之一的智能窗帘可以通过外界阳光照射强度自行判断窗帘开合的程度。光照强度数据是以CC2530作为底层硬件平台实时采集的;以实时数据作为参考标准;以此标准来让stm32单片机协调FPGA来控制步进电机来调节窗帘进行移动;同时采用了ZigBee来搭建无线通信网络节点;再通过串口技术将节点内的信息通过wifi实时传送给手机;使用手机app来控制窗帘移动。如果手机不在身边也可以通过语音识别模块来间接控制窗帘的开合过程。
affiliations: 同济大学浙江学院

title: 2.4GHz频段倒F印刷天线的设计与研究
abstract: A printed inverted-F antenna in 2. 4 GHz is designed for wireless sensor networks（ WSNs）. The size of antenna is only 25. 7 mm × 7. 5 mm. By using the 3 D electromagnetic simulation tool HFSS13. 0 modeling;the influence of parameters such as PCB thickness;and antenna size on the antenna is obtained;and thus different parameters is optimized to achieve the best design effect. When thickness of the PCB board H = 0. 8 mm;resonance length L2= 16. 4 mm;the resonant frequency of the antenna is 2. 45 GHz;echo loss S11=-25. 3 d B. Normalized input impedance is（ 0. 946 4 + 0. 092 0 i） Ω. Experimental result indicates that under 2. 4 GHz;relative bandwidth of 12. 5 % is obtained;and the standing wave ratio is approximate 1. 7（ VSWR &lt 2）. The antenna is used in practical engineering on the basis of CC2530 chip. PCB layout of the antenna is designed by using the tool of Altium Designer. The wireless network node with inverted-F antenna is actually manufactured and communication distance between two nodes is measured.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种2.4 GHz频段下用于无线传感器的倒F印刷天线。天线的尺寸为25.7 mm×7.5 mm。使用3D电磁仿真工具HFSS13.0建模仿真研究印刷电路板（PCB）的板厚H和天线自身的谐振长度L2变化对天线通信性能的影响;通过对两个参数的优化来获得最佳的设计效果。从仿真可知:在PCB厚度H为0.8 mm;谐振长度L2为16.4mm时;天线的谐振频率为2.45GHz;回波损耗S11为-25.3d B;归一化输入阻抗为（0.9464+0.0920i）Ω。通过矢量网络分析仪实测后结果表明:在2.4 GHz下;该倒F天线获得了12.5%的相对带宽;驻波比约为1.7（VSWR小于2）。将此天线用于实际工程中;在CC2530芯片基础上;用Altium Designer设计出PCB图;实际作出带有倒F天线的无线网络节点并对两节点之间的通信距离进行了测试。
keywords: 2.4ghz, inverted-f, printed circuit board(pcb), vswr
authors: TIAN Mingxing;WANG Quanyu;JIANG Shangjie;CHEN Xiaoqiang;LIU Zhuopeng
affiliations: Eahison Commnuication Co Ltd, 兰州交通大学电子与信息工程学院, School of Electronic and Information Engineering, 甘肃省轨道交通电气自动化工程实验室(兰州交通大学), 粤海信通讯有限公司, Lanzhou Jiaotong University, Rail Transit Electrical Automation Engineering Laboratory of Gansu Province

title: Design of state information monitoring system for freight trains
abstract: In order to ensure the safe driving of railway wagons under high-speed and heavy-duty conditions. This design proposes a Zigbee-based wireless sensor network for freight train status information detection and transmission scheme.The system designs the node’s power supply circuit according to the characteristics of the railway truck’s non-power generating device. The main state information of the simulated car node;such as the shaft temperature;the dynamic gas pressure;and the air temperature and humidity in the cabin;are collected and transmitted to the main control center through Zigbee technology.The GPRS module is used to simulate the vehicle-to-ground transmission;and the information is sent to the ground monitoring center for display. The system has stable performance and can meet the needs of freight train safety monitoring after testing in the laboratory.
keywords: cc2530, detection of status information, freight train, zigbee technology
authors: ZOU Juan;GUO Yong-wei;ZHANG Yu-meng;XU Chuang;ZENG Jie
affiliations: School of Software,Dalian Jiaotong University, School of Electrical Engineering,Dalian Jiaotong University

title: An Error Detection Device for 4 Semi-digital Multimeter
abstract: To solve the problem that measurement accuracy of common digital multimeters needs to be measured regularly; an error detection device based on LM399 H high-precision bandgap reference source is designed. This device through the LM399 H voltage regulation output; and then through the resistance voltage or operation amplifier circuit; can design 1. 5 V; 6. 5 V and 10 V gear voltage. The dc output voltage is collected by ADS1256 and processed by STM32 microcontroller. The output is displayed on the TFT LCD screen. Through actual circuit test; the device can detect and measure the error of dc voltage gear of 4 semi-digital multimeter. The device has low cost; stable performance and potential application value.
keywords: a/d sampling, lm399h, operation amplification, resistance partial pressure
authors: LI Xiaofei;LIANG Dongmei;ZHOU Yuming;WEI Cuilian;CHEN Chunyou

title: 基于DSP的弧压采集与弧长跟踪控制系统的设计与研究
abstract: The arc length tracking control system applied to multiple arc types of TIG( tungshen inert gas welding) was designed. This system used TMS320F28335 as the main control chip. The welding voltage signal of the electric welder was collected by the ADC function module of the DSP chip(digital signal processor); and there was a complicated multistage filter processing by the hardware circuit and the software algorithm. The closed-loop control of motor position; direction and speed could be completed by the cooperation between the eQEP function module of the DSP chip and XC3S250 E. The information interaction between the system and the PLC was realized by the SCI function module of DSP. And then arc length tracking and efficient welding control were achieved finally. Through a variety of realistic TIG welding test; the consequent of arc length tracking and control experiment was good. The expected welding effect was achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一套适用于TIG焊多种电弧类型的弧长跟踪控制系统;该系统以TMS320F28335作为主控芯片。通过DSP的ADC功能模块;采集焊接过程中电焊机输出端电压信号;经过硬件电路及软件算法进行数据多级滤波处理。通过DSP的eQEP功能模块与XC3S250E配合完成电机位置、方向和速度的闭环控制。通过DSP的SCI功能模块与PLC实现信息交互;最终实现弧长跟踪及高效焊接控制。通过多种TIG焊试验验证;弧长跟踪及控制效果良好;达到预期的焊接效果。
keywords: arc length tracking, digital signal processor, dsp, filter processing, tungsten inert gas welding
authors: ZHAO Hui;HONG Jianfeng;CHEN Wenxiang;ZHANG Hongguo;CHEN Yongming

title: Design and implementation of intelligent power supply control unit based on DSP
abstract: Using the high efficiency floating-point operation ability of TMS320F28335 chip and the abundant peripherals on the chip of TI company;an intelligent power control unit with high reliability is designed and implemented.The control unit periodically carries out self inspection and maintenance for peripheral devices on each chip;completes multi-channel load control;real-time monitoring of voltage and current;indicates;processes and reports faults;and provides human-computer interface to update status information.After verification;the control unit works stably and has good engineering application value.
keywords: dsp control, fault isolation, intelligent power, self detection
affiliations: Xi’an Aeronautics Computing Technique Research Institute,AVIC

title: 基于物联网的盆栽远程监控技术应用分析
abstract: 针对室内盆栽长期无人看守养护的情况;研究设计了一种利用物联网技术的盆栽远程监测和控制系统。首先;该系统根据ZigBee轻型无线通信协议建立了由CC2530作为感知终端控制器的无线传感器网络;然后主控单元树莓派三代与感知层节点串口通信;并通过搭建Web服务器和数据库实现数据存储和互联网服务;最后远程用户可由Internet与Web服务器的信息交互;实现盆栽的远程监测和控制。通过现场演示证明;该盆栽物联网监控系统具有良好的可靠性。
keywords: web服务器, zigbee, 物联网, 盆栽, 远程监控
authors: 周利杰;高波;邢世杰;王志勇;李兆泽;彭程

title: An Improved Control Strategy of Four Switch Buck-Boost Converter
abstract: To solve the problem of high complexity and low efficiency of four switch Buck-Boost（FSBB）converter based on the traditional control strategy;an improved tri-mode control strategy with reduced control variables and variable frequency technology was proposed. Then;the working principle of the novel control strategy was analyzed and the control method for high efficient operation was introduced in detail with the wide input voltage range. Finally;a prototype with input 30～66 V and output 48 V/4 A was built based on the digital control chip TMS320F28027. The experimental results show that the improved tri-mode control strategy enables the FSBB converter to realize zero voltage switching（ZVS）and higher efficiency under the situation of a wide input voltage range and the whole load range;with an efficiency up to 97.5% at full load.
keywords: four switch buck-boost（fsbb）converter, high efficiency converter, variable frequency control, zero voltage switching（zvs）technology
authors: WU Tianwen;LIU Jianbin;WU Peng;CHEN Wenwei;LI Youxin
affiliations: College of Information Engineering,Guangdong University of Technology

title: Computer Room Power and Environment Monitoring System Based on MQTT Protocol
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex wiring;less advanced system architecture and insufficient effectiveness of message push in the power and environment monitoring system of the computer room;apower environment monitoring system of the computer room based on MQTT protocol is designed by introducing the mainstream four-tier architecture of the internet of things.The data acquisition nodes of the device layer gather data to the edge devices through ZigBee wireless communication.The edge devices access the internet of things cloud platform through MQTT protocol.The client obtains the real-time status of the monitoring object through the application server.The test results show that the design of the scheme is reasonable;the stability is good and the performance is superior;which provides a solution for the power and environment monitoring of the computer room.
keywords: cc2530, freertos, mqtt, stm32f407, wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Information and Manufacture,Minxi Vocational and Technical College

title: Design of Low-power Remote Monitor Intelligent Optical Cross Box Lock Based on CC2541
abstract: A intelligent optical cross box lock based CC2541 is designed;which can be opened by mobile phone and can realize remote opening and status monitoring.Combined with the APP developed on the mobile phone;through the Bluetooth 4.2 related protocol;the mobile phone with authority can lock the intelligent optical delivery box.Through the GPRS communication module;the intelligent optical delivery box lock can transmit the current status to the server for monitoring the status of the intelligent optical delivery box lock.When the mobile phone cannot be turned on;you can apply to the server for remote turning on via GPRS.
keywords: cc2541, gprs, optical cross box lock, remote turning
affiliations: 718th Research Institure of CSIC

title: 基于Zigbee的矿井远程监控系统设计
abstract: 为了提高煤矿安全信息化水平;提出了一种基于ZigBee的矿井无线监测系统的设计方案。该方案借鉴ZigBee技术的低功耗、高安全性、易扩展性等特点;结合以太网网络远程数据传输的优势;利用系统及射频芯片CC2530设计多种类型传感器节点;采用簇-树网络拓扑结构;通过监测矿井下多种可燃性气体浓度和温湿度等环境参数的变化;为发生异常情况时采取相应的措施提供有效数居和决策依据。该方案相比于传统矿井监测系统具有功耗低、成本低、实时性高、扩张方便、应用灵活等特点;具有一定的实用价值和推广意义。
keywords: cc2530芯片, sht30传感器, zigbee技术, 远程监控系统
affiliations: 西安航空学院计算机学院

title: A Hybrid Method to Improve the Angle Measurement Accuracy of MLS
abstract: The problem of MLS angle measurement is studied; and a hybrid method to improve the accuracy of angle measurement is proposed in this paper. In this method; symmetry principle is used to suppress multipath interference; peak detection algorithm based on intersection of straight lines of position is presented to improve angle measurement accuracy; and digital filter is designed to mitigate the impact of noise. The proposed method is verified by the digital signal processing system based on TMS320F2812 DSP. Testing results show that the method has the advantages of high accuracy; robustness to multipath interference and easy engineering implementation.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文研究了MLS的角度测量问题，提出了一种提高测角精度的综合测量方法。该方法利用往返扫描波束的对称性抑制多径干扰，利用提出的线交叉寻峰算法改善角度测量精度，利用数字滤波技术减小噪声的影响，并用以TMS320F2812 DSP为核心的数字信号处理系统对提出的方法进行了实验验证。测试结果表明：提出的方法具有测量精度高、对多径干扰具有鲁棒性以及便于工程实现的优点。
keywords: array antenna, azimuth, elevation, microwave landing system(mls), multipath interference
affiliations: 空军工程大学信息与导航学院, 西安培华学院智能科学与信息工程学院
