title: Research on Soil Water Flux System Based on Pyboard
abstract: Soil water flux measurement is very important in agriculture; but there is currently no mature measurement equipment. Through technical analysis; a new soil water flux sensor was designed using Pyboard control unit; MicroPython programming language and ADS1256 analog-to-digital conversion chip. Using Python software and Matplotlib functions in the Math library; the host computer software is designed. Through sensor function tests; soil thermal diffusion coefficient; volumetric heat capacity; thermal conductivity; and soil water flow measurement can be achieved. Four kinds of soil samples were selected for testing; and the calculated values ??were obtained according to the maximum dimensionless temperature difference （MDTD） method and the ratio (Td/Tu) method; which were compared with the actual water flow. The test results show that the system has high measurement accuracy and stable operation. In the application of the algorithm; the linearity between the calculation results of the two algorithms and the actual values ??is good. The coefficient of determination R2 of the MDTD algorithms of the four soils are 0.9677; 0.9798; 0.9780; 0.9647; and the coefficient of determination R2 of the Td/Tu algorithm are 0.9845; 0.9985; 0.9989; 0.9986; indicating that the system has good measurement accuracy. Through adaptability evaluation; the correlation between the calculated values ??of Td/Tu and actual values ??in the four soils is better; the error is lower; and the calculation results are better than the MDTD method; which provides guidance for the selection of system algorithms.
abstract_in_chinese: 土壤水通量测量在农业中非常重要，但目前没有成熟的测量设备。通过技术分析，使用Pyboard控制单元，MicroPython编程语言和ADS1256模数转换芯片，设计了一款土壤水通量传感器。使用Python软件，利用Math库中的Matplotlib函数设计了上位机软件，通过传感器功能测试，可实现土壤热扩散系数、容积热容量、热导率以及土壤水流通量测量。选用4种土样进行试验，根据最大无量纲温度差（MDTD）法和比率(Td/Tu)法得出计算值，与实际水流通量进行对比。试验结果表明，该系统测量精度高、运行稳定。在算法应用上，两种算法的计算结果与实际值之间线性度良好，4种土样的MDTD算法决定系数R2分别为0.9677、0.9798、0.9780、0.9647，Td/Tu算法的决定系数R2分别为0.9845，0.9985，0.9989、0.9986，表明系统具有很好的测量精度。通过适应性评价，4种土壤中Td/Tu法计算值与实际值之间的相关性更好，误差更低，计算效果优于MDTD法，这为系统算法选择提供了指导。
keywords: mdtd, pyboard, ratio method, sensor, soil moisture transfer
affiliations: 西北农林科技大学旱区农业水土工程教育部重点实验室, 西北农林科技大学机械与电子工程学院

title: Excel Serial Debugging Based on LabVIEW
abstract: According to the current industrial control generally using remote control and traditional industrial field testing with low efficiency; a system model based on the two-way communication between TMS320 F28335 DSP and LabVIEW is established; so that LabVIEW uses Excel to complete the analysis of transmission data and equipment debugging functions. The contents of the Excel file are read into a LabVIEW table. LabVIEW uses its powerful ability to process table data to complete the processing and analysis of single and batch parameters. The experiment results verified this system can more conveniently and effectively complete the serial device debugging and process transmission data.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对现今工业控制普遍采用远程操控和传统工业现场测试效率低下的现状;建立基于TMS320F28335 DSP与LabVIEW双向通信的系统模型;实现LabVIEW利用Excel对传输数据分析和设备调试的功能。将Excel文档内容读入到LabVIEW表格;LabVIEW利用自身表格对数据强大的处理能力;完成单个和批量参数的处理与分析。经过实验验证;此系统可以更加方便和有效地实现串口设备调试和处理传输数据。
keywords: activex control parts, excel, labview, serial communication

title: 基于物联网的盆栽远程监控技术应用分析
abstract_in_chinese: 针对室内盆栽长期无人看守养护的情况;研究设计了一种利用物联网技术的盆栽远程监测和控制系统。首先;该系统根据ZigBee轻型无线通信协议建立了由CC2530作为感知终端控制器的无线传感器网络;然后主控单元树莓派三代与感知层节点串口通信;并通过搭建Web服务器和数据库实现数据存储和互联网服务;最后远程用户可由Internet与Web服务器的信息交互;实现盆栽的远程监测和控制。通过现场演示证明;该盆栽物联网监控系统具有良好的可靠性。
affiliations: 河北水利电力学院电气工程学院

title: Design of Low-power Remote Monitor Intelligent Optical Cross Box Lock Based on CC2541
abstract: A intelligent optical cross box lock based CC2541 is designed;which can be opened by mobile phone and can realize remote opening and status monitoring.Combined with the APP developed on the mobile phone;through the Bluetooth 4.2 related protocol;the mobile phone with authority can lock the intelligent optical delivery box.Through the GPRS communication module;the intelligent optical delivery box lock can transmit the current status to the server for monitoring the status of the intelligent optical delivery box lock.When the mobile phone cannot be turned on;you can apply to the server for remote turning on via GPRS.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计一款以CC2541为主控制器;GPRS通信模组作为通信介质;可通过手机开启并且能够实现远程开启和状态监控的智能光交箱锁。结合手机上开发的APP;通过蓝牙4.2相关协议;具有权限的手机可以将智能光交箱锁开启。通过GPRS通信模组;智能光交箱锁可以将当前状态传送到服务器端;用于监控智能光交箱锁的状态。手机无法开启时;可通过GPRS向服务器申请远程开启。
keywords: cc2541, gprs, optical cross box lock, remote turning
affiliations: 中国船舶重工集团公司第七一八研究所

title: 基于Zigbee的矿井远程监控系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 为了提高煤矿安全信息化水平;提出了一种基于ZigBee的矿井无线监测系统的设计方案。该方案借鉴ZigBee技术的低功耗、高安全性、易扩展性等特点;结合以太网网络远程数据传输的优势;利用系统及射频芯片CC2530设计多种类型传感器节点;采用簇-树网络拓扑结构;通过监测矿井下多种可燃性气体浓度和温湿度等环境参数的变化;为发生异常情况时采取相应的措施提供有效数居和决策依据。该方案相比于传统矿井监测系统具有功耗低、成本低、实时性高、扩张方便、应用灵活等特点;具有一定的实用价值和推广意义。

title: 现代智慧农业设施大棚环境监测系统设计
abstract: In China’s modern intelligent agricultural facilities greenhouse has been widely used.Whether the environment is suitable for the growth and development of crops is very important;which directly determines whether the high yield and harvest can be achieved.In order to ensure that the crops can be in the most suitable growth environment in the greenhouse;the environmental parameters in the shed must be accurately monitored.Aiming at the problems of high cost and complicated wiring;a design scheme of indoor environment monitoring system based on close-range wireless network communication technology is proposed.This scheme selects the SHT21、TSL2561、CCS811 to detect the environmental parameters such as temperature and humidity;light intensity and carbon dioxide gas concentration in the shed.The CC2530 microprocessor is used to collect the environmental parameters of the sensor in real time;and the data is transmitted and uploaded wirelessly through the ZigBee module to realize the host PC monitoring.The temperature error of the system does not exceed±0.3℃in the actual test;the humidity error does not exceed±2% RH;the packet loss rate of the network data in the range of use distance does not exceed 2%;the system runs stably and has strong reliability;which can meet the design requirements.
abstract_in_chinese: 在我国;现代智慧农业设施大棚得到了大面积的推广使用棚内环境是否适宜对作物的生长发育至关重要;直接决定了能否实现丰产丰收;为了确保作物在大棚中能处于最合适的生长环境;必须要对棚内的环境参数进行精确的监测针对当前所存在的棚内环境监测系统成本较高;布线复杂等问题;提出了一种基于近距离无线组网通信技术的棚内环境监测系统设计方案该方案选用SHT21、TSL2561、CCS811对棚内的温湿度、光强度以及二氧化碳气体浓度等环境参数进行检测;应用CC2530微处理器;对传感器检测的环境参数进行实时采集;通过ZigBee模块将数据进行无线传输上传实现主机PC监测系统在实际测试中温度误差不超出±0.3℃;湿度误差不超出±2%RH;在使用距离范围内的网络数据丢包率不超过2%;系统运行稳定;可靠性强;可以满足设计要求。
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, facility greenhouse, sensors, zigbee
affiliations: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Shjiazhuang University, 石家庄学院机电学院

title: 一种基于MQTT协议的机房动力环境监控系统
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex wiring;less advanced system architecture and insufficient effectiveness of message push in the power and environment monitoring system of the computer room;apower environment monitoring system of the computer room based on MQTT protocol is designed by introducing the mainstream four-tier architecture of the internet of things.The data acquisition nodes of the device layer gather data to the edge devices through ZigBee wireless communication.The edge devices access the internet of things cloud platform through MQTT protocol.The client obtains the real-time status of the monitoring object through the application server.The test results show that the design of the scheme is reasonable;the stability is good and the performance is superior;which provides a solution for the power and environment monitoring of the computer room.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决机房动力环境监控系统布线复杂、系统架构不够先进以及消息推送有效性不足等问题;引入主流的物联网开发四层架构;设计了一种基于MQTT协议的机房动力环境监控系统。设备层各数据采集节点通过ZigBee无线通信方式将数据汇聚到边缘设备;边缘设备通过MQTT协议接入物联网云平台;客户端通过应用服务器获取监控对象的实时状态。测试结果表明;该方案架构设计合理;稳定性较好;性能较优越;为机房动力环境监控提供了一种解决方案。
keywords: cc2530, freertos, mqtt, stm32f407, wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Information and Manufacture, Minxi Vocational and Technical College, 闽西职业技术学院信息与制造学院

title: 基于DSP2812的舰载光电跟踪仪伺服控制系统设计
abstract: In this system; TI’s TMS320 F2812 is used as the main controller; and a fusion PID algorithm combining lead-lag is adopted. The two serial ports RS422 communicate with the upper computer and the tracker respectively; the rotating transformer realizes the position closed loop; the fiber optic gyro realizes the speed closed loop; and the sea area is observed; tracked and video recorded in real time. The design takes full advantage of the high-speed operation of DSP and is suitable for complex algorithm. The servo control system has high response speed; small overshoot; less oscillation times; high tracking precision and stable precision; the dynamic performance and static performance of the system are guaranteed.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种舰载光电跟踪仪伺服控制系统;该系统的主控制器为TI公司的TMS320F2812;采用超前-滞后相结合的融合PID算法;两个串口RS422分别与上位机和跟踪器通讯;旋转变压器实现位置闭环;光纤陀螺实现速度闭环;实时对海面区域进行观察、目标跟踪和视频记录。该设计充分发挥了DSP的高速运算、适合复杂算法的特点;伺服控制系统的响应速度快、超调量小、振荡次数少、跟踪精度和稳定精度高;保证了系统的动态性能和静态性能。
keywords: dsp, fusion pid control algorithm, shipboard electro-optical tracking system
affiliations: Hebei Hanguang Industry Co., China State Shipbuilding Corporation Limited, 中国船舶集团河北汉光重工有限责任公司

title: Design and Implementation of a Fuzzy Adaptive Control System
abstract: 基于电子信息技术应用;为实现机电一体化设备参数控制;实现良好的控制性能、电源节能和环境噪声控制。模糊自适应控制系统是一种解决电子设备散热及状态监控问题的装置。此控制装置属于电子设备的一部分。控制系统调整变频直流电机转速和风机转速;控制压力、流量、散热温度和系统压力;根据加固计算机的热负载情况改变散热能力;同时控制噪声;并接收操作命令和显示数据。
keywords: matlab, pid, tms320f28027, 嵌入式软件, 模糊自适应

title: Design and Implementation of Personal Weather System Based on ZigBee and Raspberry Pi
abstract: This article is based on ZigBee wireless sensor network; Raspberry Pi has designed a personal weather system. The system selects temperature and humidity; rainfall; and light sensors to collect and store environmental parameters in real time. The system uses the CC2530 radio frequency chip to complete the Zigbee protocol function; combines ESP8266 as a gateway to transmit data to the Raspberry Pi; and the Raspberry Pi acts as a server to store relevant data. By accessing the Raspberry Pi; users can grasp the changes of the weather in real time. The experimental results show that the system can achieve certain environmental monitoring and can be expanded in a wide range.
keywords: esp8266, lan, raspberry pi, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: School of Computer And Information Technology, Northeast Petroleum University

title: Realization of parking space detection system based on ultrasonic and ZigBee
abstract: In order to meet the demand of intelligent parking lots for monitoring the status of parking spaces and facilitate the operation of parking lots;a detecting system of multi-parking space status was developed. The ultrasonic ranging module HC-SR04 is utilized in the system to collect the status data of parking spaces. The coordinator and end devices in the wireless system are set up with CC2530 development boards based on the ZigBee technology to transmit the status data of parking spaces.An upper computer is designed with Visual Studio 2010 to receive the data from RS 232 serial port;display parking space status;and calculate the parking time;parking charge;the number of total parking spaces and remaining parking spaces. The testing result indicates that the designed system can achieve the desired effect and has practical reference value.
keywords: data acceptance, parking space detection, serial port communication, ultrasonic ranging, wireless transmission, zigbee technology
affiliations: Department of Mechanical ＆ Electrical Engineering,Guangdong Communication Polytechnic, School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering,South China University of Technology

title: Research on microcomputer anti-skid braking system for mine electric locomotive based on DSP28335
abstract: On the basis of the microcomputer anti-skid braking system of mine electric locomotive;modular designs for the hardware and software of anti-skid braking system of mine electric locomotive are respectively conducted with DSP TMS320F28335 as the core to better improve the working efficiency and safety when the mine electric locomotive works at high speed. The designed system can better prevent the electric locomotive from sliding;speed up the system detection;and realize the real-time monitoring. The sliding mode variable structure control algorithm is used to simulate the proposed system in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the mine electric locomotive anti-skid braking system with the sliding mode variable structure control algorithm has a better braking effect.
keywords: dsp28335, electronic control unit, microcomputer anti-skid braking system, mine electric locomotive, real-time monitoring, sliding mode variable structure
affiliations: College of Mechanical Engineering,Xi’an University of Science and Technology

title: 基于ZigBee的温湿度监测系统设计
abstract: 过去温湿度监测大多采取的是有线的连接方式;这种连接方式具有成本较高;不适宜复杂环境;系统脆弱等缺点。随着传感器技术和无线通信技术的发展;温湿度测量逐步走向无线的方向;ZigBee技术作为一种新型的短距离无线通信技术;在无线感知传输方面具有很大的优点;本文探究了ZigBee中各节点的入网行为;之后分别从硬件和软件部分进行了设计。硬件方面选择CC2530作为主控芯片;DHT11作为传感器;软件方面则以IAR软件为基础;结合德州仪器公司推出的Z-Stack协议栈;分别进行了不同节点的软件设计;最后进行功能的测试;结果显示设计基本符合要求。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee技术, 温湿度, 节点
affiliations: 华北计算机系统工程研究所

title: Research and Implementation of Online Program Loading Based on DSP
abstract: With the development of modern digital control technology;digital signal processor（DSP） has been widely used. It is very inconvenient for the program to upgrade the software of the product after delivery by JTAG download. It needs to dismantle and open the cover;which costs a lot of manpower and material resources and is inefficient. Therefore;the in-depth study of DSP online program loading technology has realized that the product can be loaded without breaking away from the system;which has strong practicability. Based on DSP chip;TMS320F2812 is used to carry out the research;and online loading is realized through communication bus. The results show that the proposed DSP online loading technology can upgrade the DSP program online without disassembling the product;which not only improves the work efficiency;but also greatly reduces the maintenance cost of the product.
keywords: communication bus, dsp, online loading
affiliations: Sichuan Changhong Power Supply Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of Combined Initial Alignment Algorithm for Strapdown Inertial Navigation System Based on DSP
abstract: In view of the problems of slow convergence;low precision and poor stability in the traditional compass method;the fast alignment method based in inertial frame is combined with the Kalman filter precise alignment method. Due to the rapidity of coarse initial alignment in inertial frame;the initial value of the Kalman filter state is determined within 2 min;and finally the precise initial alignment is completed within 14 min using kalman filter algorithm. TI’s TMS320F28335 high-speed DSP chip is used as the initial alignment processor;and the combination alignment program design and debugging is completed based on CCS programming software. The comparison test of the fiber optic gyro strapdown inertial navigation prototype is carried out by the project team.The results from experments indicate that the combined method has faster convergence speed;better alignment precision and higher stability than the traditional compass alignment method.
keywords: combined initial alignment, compass alignment, dsp28335, inertial frame, inertial navigation, kalman filter
affiliations: School of Electrical Engineering,Naval University of Engineering

title: Based on TMS320F28035+DRV8412 two-phase hybrid stepper motor drive circuit design
abstract: In order to simplify the circuit and improve the driving ability of two-phase hybrid stepping motor;a design scheme of two-phase stepping motor driving circuit based on DSP+DRV8412 is proposed.TMS320 F28035 is used as the main control chip to generate PWM wave for the system. As a special driver chip;DRV8412 has high driving power. The stepper motor is controlled by software. The test results show that PWM and its frequency division can be produced accurately by DSP and achieve the expected effect. In practical application;the motor runs smoothly.
keywords: driver circuit, drv8412, stepping motor, tms320f28035
authors: LIU Wei;CUI Rui-long;NI Xiao-yu;LI Jun;JIAO Xu-guang;ZHOU Ming-yu

title: 基于ZigBee的家庭火灾报警系统设计与实现
abstract: ＜正＞针对家居火灾事故的应用需求和特点;文章对火灾报警系统进行深入的分析和细致的研究;提出家居火灾智能报警系统的设计与实现。该智能报警系统选用CC2530芯片作为核心控制解决方案;建搭ZigBee无线传感网络与Android嵌入式网关平台。经实际运行验证;

title: Design of Low Power Wireless Sensor Network Routing Node Based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the routing nodes in traditional wireless sensor networks need to be powered on all the time; a routing node which can wake up from sleep is designed and manufactured with CC2530 and CC2591 chips. In hardware; low-power sleep chip and peripheral circuit are selected; and new routing protocol is used in software; so that the routing node can work with the selected sleep wake-up cycle. Experimental results show that the routing node works stably and has low power consumption.
keywords: low power consumption, routing node, sleep wake-up, wireless sensor network

title: Fast Analysis and Location Method of Product Bottom Software Fault
abstract: During the development of the project;once the prototype is debugged and the program is burned to DSP;if there are new problems in the test process;the project personnel will analyze and locate the causes of the failure;mainly relying on finding and analyzing the source code;which is not flexible and intuitive.In the project practice;it is a very fast and efficient method to analyze and locate the faults.That is;first design the monitoring software with LabWindows CVI2010;then analyze the data of all variables that may cause faults in the bottom program received from the CAN bus;last display the data curve and the test man check it to achieve the purpose of locating the faults.
keywords: fault analysis, labwindows cvi2010, monitoring software, tms320f28335

title: Design of Ten Way Servo Motor System Based on DSP Control
abstract: To solve the problem of synchronization control of multi-channel servo motors;a ten way servo motor system based on DSP control was designed.The 32-bit floating-point microcontroller unit TMS320F28379D was used as the core processor;and object-oriented method was used to design control interface under VC++.At the same time;the database was used to collect dynamic data such as speed;time and distance of each servo motor.At present;it has been used in the smart home industry;and good results are obtained.
keywords: dsp, dynamic data, servo motor
affiliations: Foshan Polytechnic Institute

title: Field Loading Software for Airborne Equipment According to DO-178C
abstract: The field-loading function is widely supported for the airborne systems or equipments of various aircrafts;which can significantly improve the maintainability of airborne equipments. The applicable certification consideration being completely converted into specific design strategies is essential for the design of the fieldloading software. The system safety considerations relating to field-loadable software( FLS) in DO-178C forms the basic certification and safety requirements for the field-loading software design. A generic field-loading software design strategy for airborne equipments with limited memory resource based on ARINC825 CAN bus is provided. Several key design strategies are described to ensure compliance with all DO-178C FLS safety considerations;including: robust data transfer protocol;data integrity verification;activation of field-loading function;software/hardware compatibility check;and inadvertent activation protection. It’s demonstrated in an airborne equipment project that both the data transmission speed and software loading safety are ensured;and the maintainability of the equipment is effectively improved.
abstract_in_chinese: 外场加载广泛应用于国内外各型号民用飞机的机载系统或设备，可显著地提升机载系统或设备的维护性。将适用的适航审定要求转换为具体设计策略是机载系统或设备加载软件设计的关键。DO-178C所列关于外场加载的系统安全性考虑构成了加载软件设计的基本审定和安全性要求。以满足DO-178C的安全性考虑为前提，针对TMS320F28335 DSP平台有限RAM和Flash存储资源，提出了一种基于ARINC825总线的机载设备通用外场软件设计策略。该设计策略全面考虑了数据传输协议健壮性、数据完整性校验、加载功能激活方式、软硬件兼容性检查、异常激活保护等多个方面安全设计措施，全面落实了适航审定对外场加载的安全性要求。某机载设备实践证明根据该策略实现的机载加载软件兼顾了数据传输速率和加载安全，有效提升了设备维护性。
keywords: airborne equipment, do-178c, field loading, inadvertent activation, safety, software/hardware compatibility
affiliations: 航空工业上海航空电器有限公司
source: 测控技术 ;Measurement & Control Technology ; Editorial E-mail

title: Research on soil environmental monitoring IOT model based on JSON
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low scalability; poor real-time performance and low data reliability of current farmland soil environmental parameter collection system; an IOT(Internet of things) system based on perceptive source trust evaluation is designed and implemented. The system takes CC2530 chip as ZigBee network core and STM32 as MCU to collect environmental parameters such as temperature; humidity and light intensity. Compared with the traditional soil environmental parameter acquisition module; the innovation of this system lies in using JSON to characterize the soil environment parameters. In addition; in the process of environmental monitoring; each data parameter is operated by three sensors simultaneously; with a reliable data and sensor state calculated by the model. Experimental results show that the system works normally and that the accuracy rate of data acquisition; transmission and storage is up to 90%. The introduction of JSON sensor resource description method enables other types of sensor devices to be easily introduced into the system; improving the flexibility and expansibility of the IOT system.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对当前土壤环境参数采集系统可扩展性低、实时性差、数据可靠性不高等问题，设计并实现了基于JSON数据格式的感知源信任评价的土壤环境参数实时无线采集系统。系统以CC2530芯片为ZigBee组网核心，以STM32为MCU，选取适合土壤环境的温度、湿度、光照强度等环境参数，相对于传统的土壤环境参数采集模块，系统的创新点在于使用JSON刻画了土壤环境参数；另一方面，环境监测过程中每路数据参数均由3路传感器同时工作，并基于感知源信任评价的可靠数据保障模型计算出一个可靠的数据和传感器状态。实验结果表明，系统工作正常，数据采集传输存储正确率高达90%以上，感知源信任评价的可靠数据保障模型的引入提高了系统的数据可靠性。JSON传感资源描述方法的引入，使其他类型的传感设备能够很便捷地引入到系统中，提高了物联网系统的灵活性和可扩展性。

title: Design and Implementation of Personal Weather System Based on ZigBee and Raspberry Pi
abstract: This article is based on ZigBee wireless sensor network; Raspberry Pi has designed a personal weather system. The system selects temperature and humidity; rainfall; and light sensors to collect and store environmental parameters in real time. The system uses the CC2530 radio frequency chip to complete the Zigbee protocol function; combines ESP8266 as a gateway to transmit data to the Raspberry Pi; and the Raspberry Pi acts as a server to store relevant data. By accessing the Raspberry Pi; users can grasp the changes of the weather in real time. The experimental results show that the system can achieve certain environmental monitoring and can be expanded in a wide range.

title: Realization of parking space detection system based on ultrasonic and ZigBee
abstract: In order to meet the demand of intelligent parking lots for monitoring the status of parking spaces and facilitate the operation of parking lots;a detecting system of multi-parking space status was developed. The ultrasonic ranging module HC-SR04 is utilized in the system to collect the status data of parking spaces. The coordinator and end devices in the wireless system are set up with CC2530 development boards based on the ZigBee technology to transmit the status data of parking spaces.An upper computer is designed with Visual Studio 2010 to receive the data from RS 232 serial port;display parking space status;and calculate the parking time;parking charge;the number of total parking spaces and remaining parking spaces. The testing result indicates that the designed system can achieve the desired effect and has practical reference value.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了满足智能停车场对车位状态监控的需求;便于停车场的运营;开发了一种可实现多车位状态检测的系统。首先;使用HC-SR04超声波测距模块采集车位状态数据然后;使用CC2530开发板和ZigBee技术组建无线系统的协调器和终端设备;传输车位状态数据最后;使用Visual Studio 2010设计上位机以接收RS 232串口数据;显示车位状态;且计算出停车时长和停车费用、车位总数以及剩余车位数量。经测试表明;所设计系统可达到预期效果;具有实用参考价值。

title: Research on microcomputer anti-skid braking system for mine electric locomotive based on DSP28335
abstract: On the basis of the microcomputer anti-skid braking system of mine electric locomotive;modular designs for the hardware and software of anti-skid braking system of mine electric locomotive are respectively conducted with DSP TMS320F28335 as the core to better improve the working efficiency and safety when the mine electric locomotive works at high speed. The designed system can better prevent the electric locomotive from sliding;speed up the system detection;and realize the real-time monitoring. The sliding mode variable structure control algorithm is used to simulate the proposed system in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the mine electric locomotive anti-skid braking system with the sliding mode variable structure control algorithm has a better braking effect.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了更好地提高矿用电机车在较高速度下的工作效率和安全性;在矿用电机车微机防滑制动系统的基础上;以DSP TMS320F28335为核心对矿用电机车防滑制动系统的硬件和软件分模块设计;该设计可以更好地防止电机车产生滑行;加快了系统检测速度;可达到实时监控的目的。采用滑模变结构控制算法;在Matlab/Simulink中进行仿真;仿真结果表明;采用滑模变结构控制算法的矿用电机车防滑制动系统具有更好的制动效果。

abstract_in_chinese: 过去温湿度监测大多采取的是有线的连接方式;这种连接方式具有成本较高;不适宜复杂环境;系统脆弱等缺点。随着传感器技术和无线通信技术的发展;温湿度测量逐步走向无线的方向;ZigBee技术作为一种新型的短距离无线通信技术;在无线感知传输方面具有很大的优点;本文探究了ZigBee中各节点的入网行为;之后分别从硬件和软件部分进行了设计。硬件方面选择CC2530作为主控芯片;DHT11作为传感器;软件方面则以IAR软件为基础;结合德州仪器公司推出的Z-Stack协议栈;分别进行了不同节点的软件设计;最后进行功能的测试;结果显示设计基本符合要求。

title: Development of Intelligent Mobile Monitoring System of Facility Agriculture Based on WSN
abstract: In view of complicated layout;high power consumption;expensive equipment and difficult maintenance of traditional facility agriculture management;a smart mobile agricultural monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless communication technology and CC2530 is designed for remote management and monitoring of facility agriculture. The main contents of the design include the main frame of the system;hardware;software;ZigBee and WIFI gateway;mobile monitoring and PC. Firstly;the terminal collection node is combined with the intelligent tracking car;and various sensors for collecting farmland data information are installed on the vehicle body. The smart car tracks the movement monitoring and sends the collected data to the PC and mobile through the ZigBee and WIFI transmission links. The smart car and each sensing device are intelligently controlled on the PC end or the mobile phone end;so that the car automatically tracks and collects data. The intelligent mobile monitoring system provides a feasible solution for agricultural intelligence and informatization with low cost and saves labor saving.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统设施农业管理的布局繁杂、功耗大;设备昂贵并且难以维护等问题;设计一种基于ZigBee无线通信技术;以CC2530为主芯片的智慧设施农业移动监控系统;对设施农业进行远程管理监控。设计的主要内容包括系统的主体框架设计、硬件设计、软件设计、ZigBee与WIFI网关设计、移动监控设计和上位机设计。首先将终端采集节点与智能循迹小车结合工作;在车身安装各种采集农田数据信息的传感器;然后智能小车循迹移动监控;并将采集的数据通过ZigBee和WIFI传输链路发送到PC端和手机端;在PC端或手机端对智能小车和各个传感设备进行智能控制;实现小车自动循迹和数据采集。智能移动监控系统为农业智能化、信息化提供一个可行的解决方案;且成本低廉、节约劳动力。

abstract_in_chinese: 基于电子信息技术应用;为实现机电一体化设备参数控制;实现良好的控制性能、电源节能和环境噪声控制。模糊自适应控制系统是一种解决电子设备散热及状态监控问题的装置。此控制装置属于电子设备的一部分。控制系统调整变频直流电机转速和风机转速;控制压力、流量、散热温度和系统压力;根据加固计算机的热负载情况改变散热能力;同时控制噪声;并接收操作命令和显示数据。

title: Dual-Phase Shift Control of High Frequency Isolated DC-DC Converter for Locomotive Power Electronic Transformer
abstract: In this paper; the research of phase-shift control for the dual active full-bridge isolated DC-DC converter is carried out. Firstly; the working principle of the converter under phase shift control is analyzed; and the mathematical model of the transmission power of the converter under single-phase shift and dual-phase shift control is derived. Then; the reactive power model of the converter under single-phase phase shift and dual-phase shift is established; and the reactive power of the two control methods is compared by simulation. Finally; the comparison experiment was carried out with a 1 kW SiC experimental prototype with TMS320F28335 as the control core. The experimental results show that compared with the single-phase shift control; the dual-phase shift control can effectively reduce the reactive power and improve the efficiency of the converter; which verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the simulation.
keywords: dual active full-bridge isolated dc-dc converter, dual-phase shift control, efficiency, reactive power, sic mosfet
authors: ZHAO Zhen;MA Chi;XIE Bingruo;WANG Yongxiang;LIU Yang

title: 一种新能源汽车充电桩控制系统设计方案
abstract: 本文从电动汽车直流充电桩的具体要求出发;设计了一种人机交互界面友好、运行稳定可靠、能实现双枪同时充电的直流充电桩控制系统。该控制系统主要分为两个部分:计费控制单元和充电设备控制器。计费控制单元作为整个系统的控制中心;采用了TI公司的32位微处理器TMS320F28335作为主控芯片。通过RS485通信采集电能表的信息并在触摸屏上进行显示;同时具备IC卡读卡及结算功能。通过向充电设备控制器下发开始充电或停止充电相关指令来间接控制整个充电流程;同时接收充电设备控制器上传的电压、电流、SOC及报警等实时信息来进行控制和显示。最后对整个控制系统做了相关实验及测试;测试数据表明该直流充电桩控制系统运行稳定、操作方便;达到了预期设计目的。

title: Intelligent Monitoring System of Forest Berry Cold Chain Transportation Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: Taking the transportation process of wild berries in the forest area of Xing’an Mountains in Heilongjiang as the research object; according to the special transportation conditions of wild berries in forest areas; the paper studied the berry quality change monitoring system during the transportation process. Using the ZigBee CC2530 low-power short-range radio frequency communication technology and integrating multiple functional sensors; it established the berry transportation status monitoring sensing node and aggregating node; and rationally planned the layout of the nodes to realize real-time monitoring of the operation status of the cold chain transportation vehicle and the quality of the berries. Besides; it adopted the short messaging function of the Beidou positioning communication satellite to relay the vehicle transportation status data to the backstage enterprise management platform; and management instructions of the backstage management personnel to the vehicle system and thus establish the intelligent monitoring management system for the berry transportation process based on the Beidou communication system; which could improve the management level of the transportation process; reduce the impact of the transportation process on the quality of the berries; expand market access for natural wild berries from forest areas and propel the high-quality development of the forest economy.
keywords: cold chain transportation, forest berry, intelligent monitoring, iot technology, zigbee wireless sensor network
affiliations: College of Engineering ＆ Technology, Northeast Forestry University

title: Design of large network database mining system based on clustering optimization
abstract: As for the traditional database mining system based on the rough set method has poor efficiency of system operation when facing huge amount of data;large network database mining system based on clustering optimization is designed.The sensor node structure required for data collection is built;CC3200 is selected as the main control chip;and the RF communication circuit is introduced into the original circuit to realize the wireless transmission of data. On this basis;the data in the database is preprocessed;and data mining is realized by means of the optimized clustering algorithm and software program;so that the system design is completed. The testing results show that;in comparison with the traditional database mining system;the large network database mining system based on clustering optimization keeps high efficiency when dealing with large amount of data;which is suitable for application in large network database.
keywords: clustering optimization, data transmission, database mining system, large networks, simulation test, system design
affiliations: School of Information Technology,Henan University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

title: Towards a collaborative framework for client-cloud based on smart home
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional smart home system is difficult to realize the intelligent management of users’ home life;a smart cloud-based client-cloud collaborative framework is designed.The framework uses the RK3288 microprocessor as the core of the main controller which uses UHomeOS as a development environment.The main controller uses the CC2530 chip as the ZigBee and uses wireless transceiver module to communicate with the cloud platform through the Ethernet protocol.The cloud platform can determine the health status of the user according to the user’s physical data collected in real time;and according to the health status of the user;combined with the storage condition of the medicine/food in the smart home;a health plan with a high degree of user fit is generated.The framework enables home life management based on user vitals data;drugs;and food storage data;enabling users to obtain the best possible solution for feasibility and fit.
keywords: client-cloud, iot, operating system, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: Qingdao Haier Technology Co.,Ltd

title: A Design of Serial Programming on TMS320F2812 Platform
abstract: In view of the tedious operation when upgrading software using the emulator or dismantling the equipment in the later software maintenance on TMS320 F2812 platform products;this paper presents a scheme design of flashing program through serial port.In this design;the loading program is used to receive the application program from the serial port;and burn it into the corresponding FLASH area.With this method;the software upgrade operation gets rid of the simulator and development environment.The loading program designed in the scheme is exquisite.When upgrading;it only needs to be transmitted through the upper computer and run in RAM space;and there is no need to burn it into FLASH in advance;thus reducing the difficulty of product upgrade and maintenance.The scheme given in this paper is easy to use;widely used and has a higher practical value.
keywords: application program, loading program, serial flash programming, software upgrade and maintenance, tms320f2812
affiliations: Xi′an Aeronautics Computing Technique Research Institute,AVIC

title: RSSI Indoor Ranging Method Based on Bluetooth Combining Hybrid Filtering and Neural Network
abstract: In order to solve the problems of sampled value fluctuations and instability of the received signal strength indicator（ RSSI） data in indoor ranging and positioning based on Bluetooth technology;an improved indoor ranging method combining hybrid filtering and multilayer neural network is proposed. By combining the advantages of various single filtering algorithms;a weighted hybrid filtering algorithm was used to smooth the data effectively;and the multi-hidden layer neural network of machine learning algorithm was introduced to construct the nonlinear mapping relationship between RSSI and the distance from the anchor node to the signal receiver. In addition;an anchor node based on CC2640R2F and a verification platform using a mobile phone as a Bluetooth receiver were also established to verify the proposed ranging method. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the average error of the indoor ranging results of the proposed method is about 0. 13 m;which can effectively reduce the ranging error. It has the characteristics of easy layout;low power consumption;and low cost;and has high application value in improving the stability and accuracy of indoor positioning.
keywords: bluetooth, hybrid filtering, neural network, ranging method, rssi

title: The Research of Forest Fire Early Warning and Prevention System Based on Zigbee
abstract: In order to study Zigbee’s forest fire early warning and prevention and control system; this system first collects temperature; humidity and smog density data in the forest through sensors; uses Zigbee to establish a wireless communication network; selects CC2530 single-chip microcomputer to collect and transmit key parameters; and uses Zigbee protocol stack software Development to ensure the stable operation of network communications. Finally; the data is transmitted to a computer or mobile phone for real-time monitoring. Experiments have proved that this system can complete the detection of relevant environmental data; and successfully transmit data through wireless communication; which enables forest guards to make timely judgments and quickly adopt measures; effectively improving forest fire early warning capabilities.
keywords: fire warning and prevention system, sensor, zigbee

title: Application of Automatic Code Generation in Train Air-conditioning Power Supply Software
abstract: Automatic code generation is a graphical software writing method. Because of its advantages such as easy to write and easy to verify; it is widely used in electrical control systems in the automotive; rail transit; and power industries. Matlab Embedded Coder is a mainstream software tool that implements automatic code generation. The principle and work flow of Matlab automatic code generation was introduced firstly. The Simulink model of 160 km/h standard EMU air conditioning inverter control software was then build; including the realization of start stop sequence; modulation and redundancy logic. After simulation; code was generated automatically from the Simulink model; which was then deployed into the TMS320F28335 controller. The effectiveness of the automatic code generation technology in the product is verified by on-board test. At present; the software has been successfully installed in vehicles.

title: Design of Sensorless Control System Based on Freewheeling Diode Method
abstract: Firstly;the principle of freewheeling diode detection method is introduced.Based on freewheeling diode method;TI DSP chip TMS320F28335 is the main control chip;and ccs4.1.2 is the software platform.The design of sensorless control system for brushless DC motor is realized;which makes the motor run normally.By comparing the experimental waveforms of speed at different given speeds;it can respond quickly and achieve stability;which verifies the feasibility of the design of sensorless control system based on freewheeling diode method.

title: Design of multi-channel multi-point wireless bridge strain monitoring system based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of safety monitoring in bridge construction and operation;a multi-channel and multi-point wireless bridge strain monitoring system based on Zig Bee is proposed. This system acquires multipoint strain data and wirelessly transmit the data to gateway and upper personal computer( PC) via multi-channel based on CC2530 and STM32;then uploads data to cloud sever;thus overcomes the problems of high cost;complex wiring;and difficult maintenance in traditional bridge monitoring system. The experimental results show that the system can monitor static and dynamic strain wirelessly;which meets the requirement of bridge state monitoring.

title: Two Methods of Generating Phase-Shifted PWM Based on TMS320F2812
abstract: Phase-shifted PWM wave is a driving pulse signal commonly used in many switching power supplies. The bidirectional-full-bridge DC-DC converter requires four complementary phase-shifted PWM waves in the dual-phase-shift control mode. Two methods for generating phase-shifted PWM based on TMS320 F2812 DSP are presented in this paper.In order to improve the safety and reliability of the bidirectional-full-bridge DC-DC converter; dead time is set for the phase-shifted PWM wave. The proposed method is tested with good test results; which is of great significance for the construction of closed-loop control system of the bidirectional full-bridge DC-DC converter.
abstract_in_chinese: 移相PWM波是很多开关电源常用的驱动脉冲信号。双向全桥直流变换器(Bidirectional-Full-Bridge DCDC Converter;BDC)在双重移相控制方式下时需要4组两两互补的移相PWM波。文章基于TMS320F2812型DSP(Digital Signal Processor)分析了2种生成移相PWM的方法。为提高双向全桥直流变换器工作的安全性和可靠性;为移相PWM波设置死区时间。对所提出的方法进行测试后结果良好;对于双向全桥直流变换器闭环控制系统的构建具有重要意义。
keywords: bidirectional-full-bridge dc-dc converter, dual-phase-shift control, tms320f2812

title: Design on Variable Frequency Speed Regulation System of Mine Blower
abstract: SVPWM technology applied in variable frequency speed regulation system have high DC voltage utilization;little switch loss and small harmonic current advantages.In this paper;a SVPWM variable frequency speed regulation system of mine blower employing a core TMS320LF2407A-type DSP chip was presented;and designed circuit structure and components parameter for main circuit;power-switching circuit;speed detection circuit and soft part.Theoretical analysis and experiment show that the variable frequency speed regulation method is especially suitable for mine blower load.

title: The Research of Forest Fire Early Warning and Prevention System Based on Zigbee
abstract: In order to study Zigbee’s forest fire early warning and prevention and control system; this system first collects temperature; humidity and smog density data in the forest through sensors; uses Zigbee to establish a wireless communication network; selects CC2530 single-chip microcomputer to collect and transmit key parameters; and uses Zigbee protocol stack software Development to ensure the stable operation of network communications. Finally; the data is transmitted to a computer or mobile phone for real-time monitoring. Experiments have proved that this system can complete the detection of relevant environmental data; and successfully transmit data through wireless communication; which enables forest guards to make timely judgments and quickly adopt measures; effectively improving forest fire early warning capabilities.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了研究Zigbee的森林火灾预警防控系统;本系统先通过传感器采集森林中的温湿度和烟雾浓度数据;利用Zigbee建立无线通信网络;选取CC2530单片机进行关键参数的搜集和传输;采用Zigbee协议栈软件开发保证网络通信稳定运行。最后将数据传输到电脑或者手机进行实时监测。实验证明;本系统能够完成对相关环境数据的检测;并通过无线通信成功传输数据;能够让护林人员及时做出判断和迅速采取手段;有效地提高森林火灾预警能力。

title: 基于STM32的拾振器自校准系统设计
abstract: In this paper;a servo-type self-calibration system for vibration pickup is developed by using the STM32 single chip microcomputer as the main control board;with the adoption of modular design scheme. The self-calibration system is composed of several modules;including but not limited to excitation signal module;acquisition signal module;communication module. The excitation signal module generates a sine wave signal to excite the vibration pickup by a programmable waveform generator AD9833. The acquisition signal module is composed of a 24-bit high-precision analog-to-digital converter ADS1256 to acquire the analog signal output from the vibration pickup. The communication module communicates with the upper computer through MAX3232.
abstract_in_chinese: 以STM32单片机最小系统作为主控板;采用模块化设计方案;由激励信号、采集信号、通讯等模块组成一个伺服式拾振器的自校准系统。激励信号模块由可编程波形发生器AD9833产生正弦波信号;从而激励拾振器采集信号模块由24位的高精度模数转换器ADS1256采集拾振器输出的模拟信号通讯模块通过MAX3232与上位机进行通讯。
keywords: acquisition signal, single-chip microcomputer, vibration pickup, waveform generator

title: 基于Zigbee客车车内环境系统的设计
abstract: Bus is an indispensable means of transportation for people's daily travel in China;and the environment inside the bus should be controlled in real time.Make effective response according to the situation under control;eliminate potential safety hazards;and effectively ensure the travel safety of the people.In this paper;in order to accurately understand the bus interior environment;the ZigBee module with CC2530 as the main control chip is selected to build and design the bus interior environment system;and the upper computer interface is designed to realize the automatic monitoring and control of the bus interior environment.The system has the characteristics of low cost;simple and fast network connection and less energy consumption for network operation.

title: 动态无线充电循迹小车系统的设计与实现
abstract: This design is a dynamic wireless charging system for electric car based on CC2530 processor. The car system consists of core control module; track module; drive module and wireless charging module. The tracing module consists of the tracing core module and four infrared induction modules. The driving module consists of two 2.7 V/10 F farad capacitors; the core driving module and two motors; so that the car can run normally after charging and meet the circuit voltage. The wireless charging module consists of an oscillator; a coupling coil and a rectifier voltage regulator circuit to achieve the purpose of wireless charging. The car designed in this paper is stable after testing and can achieve the desired purpose.
abstract_in_chinese: 本设计是以CC2530为处理器的电动小车动态无线充电系统。小车系统由核心控制模块、循迹模块、驱动模块、无线充电模块构成。循迹模块由循迹核心模块和四个红外感应构成;驱动模块由两个2.7V/10F的法拉电容和核心驱动模块以及两个电机构成;使小车在充电后可以正常运行;满足电路电压。无线充电模块由振荡器、耦合线圈和整流稳压电路构成;达到无线充电的目的。本次设计的小车经过测试运行比较稳定;可以达到预期目的。

title: 基于Zigbee通信技术的智能家居系统设计
abstract: 针对家居智能化的研究现状;设计并实现了一种低成本、低功耗、安全性高的无线通讯智能家居系统。该系统采用cc2530微控制器的Zigbee无线协议栈。网关主控器采用ST公司生产的STM32F103C8T6处理器采集来自温湿度、烟雾、人体红外、光照强度等传感器收集到的数据;并驱动风扇、照明灯、加湿器等家用设备。通过组建Zigbee无线通讯网络实现网关端协调器与底层环境监测传感器和电气设备控制模块的数据通信;实现网关接收平台对家庭设备的控制。该方案以微信小程序作为主要的人机交互界面;极大地提升了远程控制体验。本方案是一套以节省能源、高效、准确;可扩展为前提的行之有效的智能家居系统的解决方案;同时该系统实用性强;具有良好的发展前景和广阔的市场。

title: Design of BLDCM Control on TMS320F2812 Platform
abstract: BLDCM is a widely used type of motor;whose speed regulation often needs to be controlled by a controller;and the control algorithm is the core of the system.In view of the requirements of the BLDCM system for the stability and response speed in the process of speed regulation;this paper designs a double closed-loop control scheme of speed and current regulation on the platform of TMS320 F2812;which has the advantages of high stability;fast response speed;small overshoot;and has good engineering application value.

title: Hardware Design of Solution for Improving Air Quality System in Home Environment by ZigBee Technology
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology; people’s living standards continue to improve; people’s requirements for air quality in the home environment are also constantly improving. We now know that formaldehyde; PM2.5（fine particulate matter into the lungs）; CO and other substances are the main components of indoor air pollution. The emergence of these substances in domestic life not only pollutes the air environment; but also poses a serious threat to human health. This paper presents a solution to improve the quality of home air environment. Based on ZigBee technology; CC2530 chip is used to detect and collect the data of various detection indicators in the air through the hardware of home environment air sensor; and the data is transmitted to wireless monitoring devices such as computers and cloud platforms through transmission sub-nodes. So upload to cloud platform. Through data comparison; if the collected data is higher than the standard range; the platform controls the execution equipment to improve the air quality. If the collected data is within the standard range; the air improvement execution equipment will not work.
keywords: cc2530 chip, cloud platform, home environment improvement, zigbee

title: Design of SIFT Corner Matching System Based on Multi-Core DSP
abstract: Proposes to design a SIFT corner matching system based on 6000 series DSP. The design of the entire system allows the SIFT algorithm to be executed with high efficiency and stability. The system also has reliable design such as data verification; user prompts; and algorithm progress.

abstract: In this paper; the intelligent home control system is constructed based on edge computing. The whole system is divided into terminal sensing layer; edge processing layer and control application layer. Specifically; CC2530 chip equipped with Zig Bee protocol stack is used for design; networking and perception in the sensing layer; Tiny6410 development board equipped with Android system is used as the upper computer in the edge processing layer; the control application layer is easy to choose and open-source Android intelligent device development. title: Micro Capacitance On-Line Detection System Based on STM32 and ZigBee
abstract: In order to construct wireless micro capacitance sensor network;an on-line micro capacitance detection system is designed based on STM32 microcontroller and ZigBee. The system is composed of host computer and slave computer;and uses the CC2530 ZigBee module of TI Company for wireless communication. STM32 F103 is utilized as the slave computer;which controls AD7746 to detect capacitance data and subsequently sends it through ZigBee router node. Through the ZigBee coordinator node;the host computer receives the data wirelessly;which can be displayed by the software developed based on Visual Studio 2015 in real time. The system;with the characteristics of low power consumption;convenient networking;stable and reliable transmission;can measure the capacitance signal accurately;thus;has a good application prospect.

title: 采用ZigBee技术改善家居环境中空气质量系统方案硬件设计
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology; people’s living standards continue to improve; people’s requirements for air quality in the home environment are also constantly improving. We now know that formaldehyde; PM2.5(fine particulate matter into the lungs); CO and other substances are the main components of indoor air pollution. The emergence of these substances in domestic life not only pollutes the air environment; but also poses a serious threat to human health. This paper presents a solution to improve the quality of home air environment. Based on ZigBee technology; CC2530 chip is used to detect and collect the data of various detection indicators in the air through the hardware of home environment air sensor; and the data is transmitted to wireless monitoring devices such as computers and cloud platforms through transmission sub-nodes. So upload to cloud platform. Through data comparison; if the collected data is higher than the standard range; the platform controls the execution equipment to improve the air quality. If the collected data is within the standard range; the air improvement execution equipment will not work.

abstract: Aiming at the problems of low real-time data processing efficiency and poor implantability of intelligent control algorithms for PLC system; an electronic control system scheme using S7-300 PLC as the main controller and TMS320F2812 DSP as the slave controller for the electric haulage shearer was designed. PLC hardware system configuration and DSP circuit design was discussed in detail. The control function of S7-300 PLC was optimized; the running status of the motor was monitored by DSP in real time; through the DSP output provided a reference for PLC control; which can optimize the state of the traction motor; the position of the ranging arm and the drum under different prodution conditions.The electronic control system has the advantages of PLC and DSP control at the same time; and provides reliable guarantee for the efficiently coal cutting under various complex production conditions.

title: 基于深度学习的四旋翼无人机控制系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the control system of the traditional quadrotor UAV is affected by external interference and cannot avoid obstacles in time;the control accuracy is low.A design of quadrotor drone control system based on deep learning is proposed.According to the overall structure of the quadrotor drone control system;an ultrasonic ranging module is added.According to the system hardware block diagram;the TMS320 F28335 main control chip is used to achieve intelligent analysis of key situations.Take the control object of the cascade PID controller as the drone attitude angle to control the motor speed.According to the PWM signals with different duty ratios sent by the DSP;the drone’s flight attitude is changed;and the equilibrium state of the drone is ensured according to the driving principle of the actuator.Use infrared remote control system;apply encoding/decoding to control integrated circuit chip;adopt TS0 P1738 infrared receiver;suitable for infrared remote control data transmission.Construct a deep learning target control model;use the similarity principle of the burst array method and the triangle to calculate the pixel size;and obtain the distance from the obstacle to the current position of the drone;to avoid interference from external obstacles.Adaptive extended Kalman filter technology effectively reduces the measurement error of the UAV automatic control system and accurately tracks the maneuvering target.According to the system debugging results;when the turntable angle is 0°;the system controls a pitch angle of31°;a heading angle of 186°;and a roll angle of 0°;which are consistent with the actual values;which is of great significance for handling sudden group events.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统四旋翼无人机控制系统受到外界干扰;无法及时躲避障碍物而导致控制精准度低的问题;提出了基于深度学习的四旋翼无人机控制系统设计根据四旋翼无人机控制系统总体结构;加入超声波测距模块依据系统硬件框图;采用TMS320F28335型号主控芯片;实现关键态势智能分析以串级PID控制器的控制对象为无人机姿态角度;控制电机转速根据DSP发出不同占空比的PWM信号;改变无人机飞行姿态;依据执行机构驱动原理;保证无人机飞行时的平衡状态使用红外遥控系统;应用编/解码操控集成电路芯片;采用TS0P1738型号红外线接收器;适合于红外线遥控数据传输构建深度学习目标控制模型;利用处突阵法与三角形相似原理;计算像素尺寸;获取障碍物距无人机当前位置距离;避免受到外界障碍物干扰自适应扩展Kalman滤波器技术对无人机自动控制系统有效减小测量误差;准确地对机动目标进行追踪由系统调试结果可知;当转台角度为0°;该系统控制的俯仰角为31°、航向角为186°、横滚角为0°与实际值一致;对处理突发性群体事件具有重要意义。
keywords: burst method, deep learning, four-rotor uav, infrared receiver, pid controller

title: Design of Water Leakage Location Test System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Due to the problems of traditional regional water leakage monitoring system;such as complicated wiring;aging of the line and high production cost;a regional water leakage monitoring system based on ZigBee Internet is demanded. The design takes CC2530 as the core and forms a self-organizing network with Multi-hop according to the ZigBee protocol. The sensor node of the terminal distributed in the monitoring area transmitte information to the network center coordinator immediately by the router. Finally the digital signal is displayed in the host computer. The experimental results show that the positioning accuracy of the system is ± 0. 5 m. And the stability and reliability of the signal are high.
keywords: cc2530, data collection, leaking water, multi-hop, wireless transmission, zigbee

title: Design and Implementation of Wireless Scoring System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: In view of the common problem of timing and scoring in all kinds of competition activities at present; it is impossible for multiple referees to directly take the initiative to deal with and display multiple sets of scores in real time. A wireless scoring design solution with small site limitation; high efficiency; low cost and low power consumption is proposed. The automatic network is realized based on ZigBee technology; the wireless scoring system is designed and developed by using C ++; and the scoring data release is realized based on Web. In this paper; the structure of software and hardware and the design and implementation of the system are described in detail. Through the analysis of the results of the system in the actual competition; the new wireless scoring system has a very high application value.
keywords: cc2530, internet of things, vc++, web server, zigbee
affiliations: College of Humanities and Engineering, Guangzhou Open University

title: Design of attitude measurement and three-dimensional model display system of four-axis UAV
abstract: The attitude of a four-axis UAV changes in the air by human factors or uncertain factors in the environment. If the operator can’t judge correctly; the mistakes made on the remote control will cause damage to the UAV and even injury to person. Aiming at this kind of problem; a set of attitude measurement and threedimensional model display system of four-axis UAV based on STM32 was designed. The system used the STM32 of the ARM Cortex-M3 core as the main controller; read the output of the 9-axis sensor which combined with motion processing device MPU6050 and the magnetometer HMC5883 L; and obtained the attitude angle of the UAV through the quaternion algorithm. The CC1101 chip sent the attitude angle data to the ground receiving end. LabVIEW received data through the serial port and completed the analysis and processing of the data; and realized the real-time display of the three-dimensional image of the four-axis UAV.The results show that the attitude calculation is stable and reliable. The system has simple structure; low cost;strong portability and certain practicability.
keywords: attitude calculation, labview, motion processing components, uav, wireless transmission
affiliations: China Special Equipment Inspection and Research Institute, School of Measurement and Testing Engineering,China Jiliang University

title: Implementation of Multi-stage Load Mode for TMS320C6678
abstract: In order to provide independent starting; in-place debugging and remote loading capabilities forTMS320 C6678 products; multiple communication interfaces and resources; as well as a set of ROM boot loader on chip are used to design and implement a flexible; configurable multi-stage program loading mode to meet the application requirements.

title: A New Zigbee-Based Fruit and Vegetable Basket Control System Featured with Intelligent Weighing and Pricing
abstract: Electronic scale adopts manual input of good names to match the unit price;and then calculates the total price of the product.This method has low weighing efficiency;high labor cost and is prone to errors.To solve the above problems;a set of ZigBee-based fruit and vegetable basket control system featured with intelligent weighing and pricing is designed.In the system;CC2530 is adopted as the core chip;multiple weight nodes and coordinator are inter connected through ZigBee wireless network;and the coordinator and the host computer are connected through serial port.The weight node is embedded at the bottom of the fruit and vegetable basket and numbered one by one;and the mass of the selected items is automatically obtained by the weight node and sent to the coordinator.Then;the coordinator reads the weight node number and the mass and outputs them to the host computer;which generates;displays and prints the item information.The system automatically identifies items and intelligently weighs and prices goods with no manual operation;thus significantly improving the efficiency of weighing and pricing as well as reducing labor costs.
keywords: cc2530, control system, fruit and vegetable basket, intelligent weighing and pricing, zigbee

title: Design of Self-powered Wireless Network Sensor Node Based on Wind Energy Harvesting
abstract: Aiming at the problems of battery replacing difficulty and possible environmental pollution for traditional wireless sensor network node power supply; a self-powered wireless sensor network node design scheme based on wind energy harvesting was proposed. A piezoelectric wind energy harvester is designed to harvest the wind energy for powering the wireless sensor network nodes. Based on the parallel synchronous switch inductor circuit and voltage regulator chip MAX1672; an energy managing circuit with a supercapacitor as the energy storage element is designed. It solves the problem that the wind energy harvester cannot directly supply power to the node. With cores consist of CC2530 and SHT20; a wireless sensor network node with temperature and humidity monitoring function is manufactured. The experimental results show that the starting wind speed of the wind energy harvesteris 3 m/s.The optimal electric load is 30 kΩ. The maximum output power is 220 uW. The node can work normally under a 90 s data transmission cycle.
keywords: energy management circuit, self-powered, wind energy harvesting, wireless sensor network node

title: Serial Port Expansion Design Based on UART
abstract: With the extensive application of embedded technology; more and more products need the coordination between DSP and computer. FIFO provided by DSP chip cannot meet the communication demands of big data; so it is necessary to use UART chip to extend DSP serial port. This paper introduces the use of EXAR company’s asynchronous communication transceiver XR16C2852 to expand the serial port; realize the serial port communication between DSP and computer. It offers detailed description of the UART register configuration; detailed hardware circuit design and software programming design.

abstract: 本文针对校园环境监测的需求;设计一种基于CC2530芯片的无线传感器网络节点;节点采用太阳能模块供电;有效避免了因能量耗尽而失效的问题;传感器节点采用温湿度传感器、光强度传感器等传感器对环境中温度、湿度和光强度等进行采集;满足对环境的基本监测功能。

title: Hardware Circuit Design of Frameless Torque Motor Diver Based on DSP
abstract: This paper mainly designs the hardware circuit of fdm6021-4803 frameless motor driver. Taking TMS320F28335 chip as the control core; the practical driving function of a kind of frameless AC servo motor is realized by building DSP peripheral control circuit; designing modules such as multi power matching circuit; PWM driving circuit; MOSFET inverter circuit; current detection circuit; speed detection circuit and protection circuit. The parameters and selection of the components of each circuit module are described in detail. Finally; the experimental debugging is carried out through the eeep1000n power electronic experimental device on the hardware platform. While the armature current of the motor is controlled based on SVPWM modulation technology; the operation state of the motor is observed by the upper computer software of cspacewatch. The verification shows that the driver can control the motor reliably and has high performance index and interference energy Force can be used in engineering practice.

title: Research on construction of intelligent physics laboratory in information age
abstract: The physical laboratory is the base of cultivating students’ practical ability and innovation ability. The construction of intelligent physical laboratory is conducive to further improving the management level and experimental teaching effect of physical laboratory. This paper has designed an intelligent laboratory architecture based on the integration of software and hardware of the sensing layer; information processing layer and system management layer. By adding the experiment black box designed by ZigBee wireless sensor network based on CC2530; the old instruments can be intelligentized quickly. The big data processing based on lambda architecture improves the processing ability and expansion ability of the information processing layer. The management layer designed with B/S architecture has good interaction and rich functions.

title: Design and Implementation of Wireless Early Warning and Monitoring System for Failure of Railway Signal Lamp
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the design and implementation of a wireless early warning and monitoring system for railway signal lamp failure under the control of CC2530.The system uses CC2530 as the core controller and bh1750 light intensity sensor module as the measurement core to measure the change of signal light intensity.The measured data is uploaded to CC2530 module to obtain the change of signal light intensity;which corresponds to the feature database;sends out the warning or failure information;and transmits it to the control center through ZigBee network to monitor the use of railway signal lights.
abstract_in_chinese: 笔者主要介绍了一种在CC2530控制下的铁路信号灯失效无线预警监测系统的设计与实现。该系统以CC2530为核心控制器;以BH1750光强传感器模块为测量核心;实现对信号灯光强变化的测量;测量到的数据上传到CC2530模块;获得信号灯光强变化;以此特征对应特征数据库;发出预警或者失效信息;并通过ZigBee组网传到控制中心;监测铁路信号灯的使用情况。
keywords: bh1750fvi light intensity sensor, cc2530 module, zigbee protocol
affiliations: 临沂大学

title: Research on soil environmental monitoring IOT model based on JSON
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low scalability; poor real-time performance and low data reliability of current farmland soil environmental parameter collection system; an IOT(Internet of Things) system based on perceptive source trust evaluation is designed and implemented. The system takes CC2530 chip as ZigBee network core and STM32 as MCU to collect environmental parameters such as temperature; humidity and light intensity. Compared with the traditional soil environmental parameter acquisition module; the innovation of this system lies in using JSON to characterize the soil environment parameters. In addition; in the process of environmental monitoring; each data parameter is operated by three sensors simultaneously; with a reliable data and sensor state calculated by the model. Experimental results show that the system works normally and that the accuracy rate of data acquisition; transmission and storage is up to 90%. The introduction of JSON sensor resource description method enables other types of sensor devices to be easily introduced into the system; improving the flexibility and expansibility of the IOT system.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对当前土壤环境参数采集系统可扩展性低、实时性差、数据可靠性不高等问题;设计并实现了基于JSON数据格式的感知源信任评价的土壤环境参数实时无线采集系统。系统以CC2530芯片为ZigBee组网核心;以STM32为MCU;选取适合土壤环境的温度、湿度、光照强度等环境参数;相对于传统的土壤环境参数采集模块;系统的创新点在于使用JSON刻画了土壤环境参数另一方面;环境监测过程中每路数据参数均由3路传感器同时工作;并基于感知源信任评价的可靠数据保障模型计算出一个可靠的数据和传感器状态。实验结果表明;系统工作正常;数据采集传输存储正确率高达90%以上;感知源信任评价的可靠数据保障模型的引入提高了系统的数据可靠性。JSON传感资源描述方法的引入;使其他类型的传感设备能够很便捷地引入到系统中;提高了物联网系统的灵活性和可扩展性。
keywords: iot, json, perceptual source trust evaluation, soil environmental parameter, zigbee

title: 基于多核DSP的雷达信号分选设计与实现
abstract: Aiming at the real-time requirement of radar signal sorting in practical application; a parallel processing architecture of radar signal sorting based on TMS320 C6678 multi-core DSP is proposed; which adopts the signal sorting structure combining pre-sorting and master-sorting; realizes multi-core parallel processing in master-slave mode; and improves the efficiency of radar signal sorting. The experimental results show that this method can realize the rapid sorting of radar signals effectively and shorten the time of signal sorting process.

title: Improved Single-phase Transformerless Y-source PV Grid-connected Inverter
abstract: In order to solve the problem of common mode current when a traditional Y-source photovoltaic（PV） inverter is connected to a grid; a line-frequency or high-frequency transformer is usually connected in series between the grid and PV system to ensure galvanic isolation. However; the line-frequency transformer is heavy and big; and the high-frequency transformer needs additional energy conversion circuits; which leads to complex control and low efficiency. Thus; a novel transformerless Y-source PV grid-connected inverter is proposed. This new topology connects the negative terminal of PV array to the neutral line of the grid directly; the virtual dc link is introduced; and the pulse width modulation（PWM） strategy is modified. Moreover; the voltage and current stresses are analyzed; and capacitances of capacitors are optimized to solve the voltage drop during the negative half cycle. Finally; a 200 W laboratory prototype based on TMS320F28335 is built to verify the performance of the proposed topology. Simulation and experimental results indicate that the new topology guarantees the quality of the grid-connected current while the loop of common mode current is bypassed and the common mode current is completely eliminated. The proposed transformerless Y-source inverter topology can reduce the volume and cost of inverter; and can provide support for the connection of PV to the grid.

title: Design of the EtherCAT Master Based on Embedded Linux Platform
abstract: An EtherCAT master scheme based on embedded Linux platform was proposed here in view to the poor controlling problems of real-time and synchronous multi-axis control. An operating system with Xenomai-based hard real-time Linux was developed on the BeagleBone embedded platform with AM3358 as its core processor. The ARM’s network chip driver was rewritten to improve the master’s communication speed and response capability. The clock mechanism was proposed to compensate the slave clocks dynamically so as to achieve synchronization between the slaves. Finally; the verification of a platform with one master and two servo slaves was conducted. The maximum scheduling delay of the master is 36.397 μs（3.640%）; and the minimum is 1.952 μs（0.195%） under the 1 ms periodic task; and the accuracy of multi-axis synchronization error is at the ns level; which obtains high synchronous capabilities.

title: Life Cycle Monitoring Strategy for Bag Filter Wearer
abstract: Aiming at the problem of life cycle monitoring system of filter bag in precipitator;a monitoring strategy of filter bag life cycle based on Internet of things sensor technology is proposed. The filter bag pressure in the precipitator is monitored in real time by the chip type pressure sensor MS5611;and the data is transmitted to the main control receiver by the CC2530 wireless communication module integrated with ZigBee protocol. The main control receiver receives the data through the wireless module with the same ZigBee protocol; stores;analyzes and processes the received data;and calculates the current operation status of the filter bag and the working efficiency of the dust collector. The operation results show that the system has real-time performance and can respond flexibly to the change of environment; so that different schemes can be made for the change of filter bags according to different climate and seasons;which has practical significance.

title: Design of Control System for Three-phase 12/8 Pole Switched Reluctance Motor
abstract: Taking the three-phase 12/8 pole switched reluctance motor as the research object; the speed control system of the switched reluctance motor with the chip of TMS320 F28335 as the main control unit is designed. The speed regulation system is composed of software and hardware. The software part mainly completes the double closed-loop PI control. The current is feedback inner loop and the speed is feedback outer loop. Based on the given speed signal; position signal and protection signal; the driving signal corresponding to the conducting phase PWM is calculated. The hardware part is mainly composed of switched reluctance motor;power converter; current detection; position detection; keyboard and LED dynamic displaying. Combining position signal; speed signal and current feedback signal; the control strategy of switched reluctance motor is adjusted to work under voltage chopper control mode. After parameter adjustment experiment; the reasonable proportional and integral coefficients of PI control are selected finally.The rationality of the design of the control system is verified by the optimization; comparison and analysis of the experimental data.

title: Low Power Domestic Water Detection Device Based on Aacceleration Sensor
abstract: A low power device is designed to detect domestic water consumption behavior. The system is composed of ADXL362 acceleration sensor unit; MSP430 FR6989 low power microcontroller unit; CC2530 ZigBee Ad-Hoc network unit and so on. The vibration signal from the pipe can be used to detect whether there is water flowing through the pipe and the flowing condition can be uploaded to background through ZigBee. A three-level sleeping mechanism is applied to dramatically decrease the power consumption of the system. Adaptive threshold setting method is adopted to add the adaptation of the detector. Results of the tests show that domestic water behavior can be detected effectively.

abstract: A scheme of building a highly integrated EtherCAT slave for multi-axis servo motor drive motion control system on the heterogeneous multi-core processor AM3359 platform has been proposed; and the servo motion control profile Ci A402 has been realized up to 8-axis real-time control. The overall structure has been described firstly and then the hardware and software design have been introduced; focusing on describing the process and principles of multi-axis system construction. The experimental results show that the multi-axis EtherCAT slave station based on AM3359 can meet the control requirements of high speed; high accuracy and high reliability.

title: Design of fault-tolerant drive circuit for two phase hybrid stepping motor
abstract: A fault-tolerant drive circuit for two phase hybrid stepping motor is designed. Although the hardware cost raises; the double H-bridge driving circuits have largely improved ability of permitting the mistakes by adding redundant bridge arm. This paper analyzes the topology of the main circuit in detail; and gives the block diagram of its normal operation. In order to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme; the test bench is built with TI controller TMS320 F28335. A part of function of the designed circuits is validated by the prototype.

title: 机场智能驱鸟系统中的网关设计
abstract: Bird collision is one of the important factors threatening aviation safety;which seriously affects the safety of human life and property.Therefore;effective measures must be taken to prevent such incidents.According to the problems existing in the existing ways and methods of bird-repelling;this paper proposes a scheme of constructing an airport bird-repelling linkage system by using the Internet of Things technology.Because Zigbee network has its own shortcomings and is limited by the characteristics of airport geographic environment;it is necessary to solve the problem of long-distance communication between bird control center and bird repellent equipment.In this paper;STM32 is used as the core processor and combined with CC2530;CC2591 and GPRS modules to construct the gateway of bird-repelling intelligent system.The communication distance between Zigbee terminal and bird-repelling device is about 400 m;while the transmission power reaches the maximum +22 dBm and the acceptance sensitivity is-99.2 dBm.In SIM900 terminal;due to its mobile operation;the gateway of bird-repelling intelligent system is constructed.Businessmen networked to achieve full coverage within the airport;and solved the data exchange between bird control center and bird-repelling equipment.

title: 基于嵌入式Linux平台EtherCAT主站设计
abstract: An EtherCAT master scheme based on embedded Linux platform was proposed here in view to the poor controlling problems of real-time and synchronous multi-axis control. An operating system with Xenomai-based hard real-time Linux was developed on the BeagleBone embedded platform with AM3358 as its core processor. The ARM’s network chip driver was rewritten to improve the master’s communication speed and response capability. The clock mechanism was proposed to compensate the slave clocks dynamically so as to achieve synchronization between the slaves. Finally; the verification of a platform with one master and two servo slaves was conducted. The maximum scheduling delay of the master is 36.397 μs(3.640%); and the minimum is 1.952 μs(0.195%) under the 1 ms periodic task; and the accuracy of multi-axis synchronization error is at the ns level; which obtains high synchronous capabilities.

title: 基于加速度传感器的低功耗居家用水行为检测装置
abstract: A low power device is designed to detect domestic water consumption behavior. The system is composed of ADXL362 acceleration sensor unit; MSP430 FR6989 low power microcontroller unit; CC2530 ZigBee Ad-Hoc network unit and so on. The vibration signal from the pipe can be used to detect whether there is water flowing through the pipe and the flowing condition can be uploaded to background through ZigBee. A three-level sleeping mechanism is applied to dramatically decrease the power consumption of the system. Adaptive threshold setting method is adopted to add the adaptation of the detector. Results of the tests show that domestic water behavior can be detected effectively.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种可以检测居家用水行为的低功耗装置。系统由ADXL362加速度传感器单元、MSP430FR6989低功耗微控制器单元、CC2530 ZigBee自组网单元等组成。可以通过采集水管的震动信号判断水管中是否有水流流过;并通过ZigBee将水流状态上传到后台。提出了一种三级休眠机制;大大降低了系统的功耗。同时采用阈值自适应设定的方法;增强了检测装置的适应性。测试结果表明;该装置可以有效检测居家用水行为。
keywords: acceleration sensor, low power, vibration signal, water flow

title: 一种电力巡检机器人控制系统设计与实现
abstract: Aiming at the working environment and work content of intelligent electric power patrol robot;an intelligent electric power patrol robot is designed based on TMS320 F2812 digital processor and PC104. The power inspection robot based on the embedded control chip can perform various types of power inspection operations. It uses various sensors;high-definition video collector;GPS locator;wireless telecommunication equipment;etc.;to test the power circuit and power equipment;at the same time data interaction is carried out through the large database and control station. By simulating the environment of electric power inspection in the laboratory;the design target is basically achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 对电力巡检智能机器人的工作环境与工作内容;文中设计了一种基于TMS320F2812数字处理器并结合PC104的电力巡检智能机器人。基于该嵌入式控制芯片的电力巡检机器人能够进行各类电力巡检作业;通过其自身携带的各类传感器、高清视频采集器、GPS定位仪、无线远程通信设备等;对电力线路及电力设备进行检测;同时通过大数据库和控制基站进行数据交互。通过在实验室内模拟电力巡检作业环境进行系统联调测试;基本实现了设计目标。
keywords: control system, electric power, inspection, robot

title: 基于CC2530的无线温度采集装置的研究
abstract: In view of the problem that the wired temperature measuring instrument of environmental test equipment and sterilization device cannot be detected;a wireless temperature acquisition device based on CC2530 is designed. The overall design and structure of the system are analyzed;and the author presents the detailed the hardware and software design of system networking;temperature measurement and wireless wake-up. Test and applications show the scheme achieve the desired results.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对密闭环境试验设备和高温高压灭菌装置有线温度测量仪表无法检测的问题;该文设计了一种基于CC2530的无线温度采集装置;介绍了系统整体设计思路和结构;详细介绍了系统组网、温度测量方法、无线唤醒等软硬件设计方案;经分析试验及应用;取得了预期效果。

title: 基于STM32和CC1101的受限空间关键气体浓度检测系统
abstract: Due to the complicated internal environment of the confined space;harmful gas is easy to accumulate;and it is easy for the rescuers to be poisoned if they enter the restricted space.Therefore;a gas detection device design based on STM32 and CC1101 was proposed.STM32 was used as the main control chip of the system.The electrochemical sensors collected the concentration signals of three key gases;CO;H2S and O2.Then the signals were processed by chips called LMP91000;converted by the internal A/D converter of microcontroller and displayed by liquid crystal display module.Meanwhile;CC1101; as a wireless transmission chip;was used to transfer the data to the outside.If the concentration of gas exceeded the threshold;an alarm will be given.The system has good real-time performance;high accuracy and low cost;and has high application value in confined space rescue.
abstract_in_chinese: 由于受限空间内部环境复杂;容易积聚有害气体;发生意外时救援人员贸然进入容易发生中毒现象;故提出了一种基于STM32和CC1101的气体检测装置设计。采用STM32为系统的主控芯片。由电化学传感器采集CO;H2S和O2 3种关键气体的浓度信号;并由LMP91000芯片信号处理后;利用单片机内部的A/D转换器进行模数转换;由液晶显示模块显示。与此同时;CC1101为无线传输芯片;将数据传输到外界。如果浓度超出了阈值;则会进行报警。该系统实时性好、精度高、成本低;在受限空间救援中具有极高的应用价值。
keywords: cc1101, confined space, electrochemical sensor, lmp91000, stm32
