title: The Design and Implementation of of an X-band PLL Frequency Synthesizer
abstract: The phase-locked frequency source is one of the most important core components in the satellite communication system.In this paper;the X-band low-phase noise frequency source is designed by using the new generation of phase-locked frequency synthesizer chip lmx2594 which integrates VCO function;which is newly introduced by TI company.The test results of the physical circuit meet the design requirements.The scheme is simple;convenient;compact and has a wide application prospect.
keywords: frequency synthesizer, lmx2594, microcomputer, pll
affiliations: Nanjing Panda Han Da Technology Co.,Ltd.,Satellite Communications Technology Institute

title: The Design and Implementation of Frequency Synthesizer of LMX2572 Based on Microcomputer Control
abstract: In the satellite communication system;the performance of the frequency synthesizer has an important impact on the performance of the entire communication system. This paper uses ATMEL’s single-chip ATTINY9 combined with TI’s auxiliary design tool to design a C based on the LMX2572 phase-locked loop chip. Frequency band low phase noise frequency synthesizer;and made physical test;the test result meets the design requirements;the scheme is simple and space size small;low power consumption;can be widely used in the satellite communication system.
keywords: frequency synthesizer, lmx2572, microcomputer, pll
affiliations: Nanjing Panda Han Da Technology Co.,Ltd.,Satellite Communications Technology Institute

title: Research and Implementation of Online Program Loading Based on DSP
abstract: With the development of modern digital control technology;digital signal processor（DSP） has been widely used. It is very inconvenient for the program to upgrade the software of the product after delivery by JTAG download. It needs to dismantle and open the cover;which costs a lot of manpower and material resources and is inefficient. Therefore;the in-depth study of DSP online program loading technology has realized that the product can be loaded without breaking away from the system;which has strong practicability. Based on DSP chip;TMS320F2812 is used to carry out the research;and online loading is realized through communication bus. The results show that the proposed DSP online loading technology can upgrade the DSP program online without disassembling the product;which not only improves the work efficiency;but also greatly reduces the maintenance cost of the product.
keywords: communication bus, dsp, online loading
affiliations: Sichuan Changhong Power Supply Co.,Ltd.

title: Research on multi parameter monitoring system of home environment based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the traditional smart home;this paper studies a low-power;low-cost wireless access system for home gateway based on ZigBee technology.Stm32f103rct6 is used as the hardware control platform;and the power supply module;clock module and EEPROM module are combined to complete the construction of the smart home gateway system.ZigBee uses the wireless communication module with CC2530 as the main chip;and esp8266 communication module with practical function is used in WiFi part to realize the real-time monitoring of home environment.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: Jiangsu College of Safety Technology

title: DSP Based automatic Recognition System forhome appliance’s tip sound
abstract: It is easy to cause hearing fatigue and mis-judgment for human being to detect the tip sound of the buzzer in the noisy environment for long time.Therefore;We designed an automatic Recognition System for home appliance’s tip sound based on a floating point DSP of TMS320F28335 of Ti in this paper.The FIR bandpass filter was used to filter the signal;using FFT to extract the spectrum features;and using the maximum similarity to classify.Using DMA module todesign the ping-pong cache;and realize the synchronization mechanism of real-time acquisition and signal processing.The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can recognize the pattern of the sound correctly and meets FISHER’s criterion.
keywords: fft, fir bandpass filtering, pattern recognition, ping-pong cache, tms320f28335
affiliations: School of Electronics and Information Engineering, Anhui Jianzhu University, Whirlpool(China)Global R＆d Center

title: Design of Signal Generator Based on AM3359 Microprocessor
abstract: Signal generator is an important application in many fields of science and technology;For example;control systems and industrial automation industries are widely used;This article introduces A design of a signal generator based on AM3359 microprocessor;Realization of Many kinds of Standard Signal Output;Current frequency;voltage frequency;analog current;analog voltage;etc.This design can measure most of the instruments on the market.It provides a more convenient and reliable testing method for users
keywords: ad420, am3359, signal generator
affiliations: Chenzhou Vocational Technical College

title: Design of Home Wireless Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: In this design;STM32 is used as the core to build a monitoring terminal;an expandable wireless sensor network;and use NB-IOT technology to transmit data to the cloud for data analysis and processing to achieve the comprehensive acquisition of monitoring object behavior information.Based on STM32 series controller;CC2530 RF chip and monitoring sensor;the hardware platform and software of monitoring system terminal;wireless sensor network and data acquisition nodes are modularized.Through the test system;the design can effectively complete the all-round monitoring of the monitoring object.
keywords: comprehensive monitoring, monitoring terminal, nb-iot, wireless sensor network
affiliations: School of Electrical and Information Engineering,Dalian Jiaotong University

title: Design of Farmland Intelligent Irrigation System Based on ZigBee
abstract: A farmland intelligent irrigation system is designed based on ZigBee technology.The system collects irrigation water flow informations through Hall flow sensor;water temperature sensor and other sensors;and uses ZigBee wireless sensor network to realize communication.The interface of MFC upper computer is designed to display irrigation water flow informations in real time;which is convenient for staff to view and control.The system has the advantages of low power consumption;high precision;convenient use and maintenance;and easy to expand.It can accurately control speed of irrigation water flow;display the information of irrigation water flow speed;flow rate and temperature in real time;and basically meet the complex needs of the current irrigation industry.
keywords: cc2530, intelligent irrigation system, mfc pc, wsn, zigbee technology
affiliations: Henan province university energy-saving lighting engineering technology research center

title: Design on Variable Frequency Speed Regulation System of Mine Blower
abstract: SVPWM technology applied in variable frequency speed regulation system have high DC voltage utilization;little switch loss and small harmonic current advantages.In this paper;a SVPWM variable frequency speed regulation system of mine blower employing a core TMS320LF2407A-type DSP chip was presented;and designed circuit structure and components parameter for main circuit;power-switching circuit;speed detection circuit and soft part.Theoretical analysis and experiment show that the variable frequency speed regulation method is especially suitable for mine blower load.
keywords: dsp, svpm, variable frequency speed regulation
affiliations: School of Mechanical ＆ Electrical Engineering,Nanchang Institute of Technology

title: Design of Smart Lighting Control System Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
abstract: With the advent of the digital age; people have put forward higher requirements for their own quality of life. People’s pursuit and dependence on smart home is ever-growing; and the advantages of smart lighting are increasingly prominent. The smart lighting control system combines various advanced intelligent control technologies and embedded technologies. The design of this paper is based on CC2530 single-chip microcomputer; combined with sensor information detection and data processing technology; using C/C++ embedded development to realize the control of lighting equipment in different modes.
keywords: coordinator, gateway, mcu
affiliations: Network Information Center, Taiyuan Institute of Technology
source: Journal of Shanxi Datong University(Natural Science Edition).

title: Detection System of Key Gas Concentration in Confined Space Based on STM32 and CC1011
abstract: Due to the complicated internal environment of the confined space;harmful gas is easy to accumulate;and it is easy for the rescuers to be poisoned if they enter the restricted space.Therefore;a gas detection device design based on STM32 and CC1101 was proposed.STM32 was used as the main control chip of the system.The electrochemical sensors collected the concentration signals of three key gases;CO;H2S and O2.Then the signals were processed by chips called LMP91000;converted by the internal A/D converter of microcontroller and displayed by liquid crystal display module.Meanwhile;CC1101; as a wireless transmission chip;was used to transfer the data to the outside.If the concentration of gas exceeded the threshold;an alarm will be given.The system has good real-time performance;high accuracy and low cost;and has high application value in confined space rescue.
keywords: cc1101, confined space, electrochemical sensor, lmp91000, stm32
affiliations: School of Measurement and Testing Engineering,China Jiliang University

title: Strain Data Acquisition System Based on ZigBee Wireless Network
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional stress-strain data transmission distance;complicated wiring and aging of the line;a strain data acquisition system based on ZigBee wireless network was designed.The introduction of ZigBee wireless network made the whole system easy to operate and simplistic;greatly improved the transmission distance of strain signals;and the data maintained high linearity and high accuracy.The nonlinear errors of many experiments were kept below 0.3%.The practical application of a certain type of monitoring system show that the strain data acquisition system of Zig Bee wireless network should have a wider application prospect.
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition, fpga, strain, wireless transmission, zigbee

title: Small Unmanned Rotorcraft Data Acquisition System Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: The collection of atmospheric data plays a key role in the control of small unmanned rotorcraft flight. An atmospheric data acquisition system for the acquisition device of a small unmanned rotorcraft was designed by a digital MEMS sensor and TMS320 F28335 chip based on the flight control needs of small unmanned rotorcraft. The space velocity required to control the flight of the unmanned rotorcraft is calculated in real time by collecting data with the sensor; and some algorithms such as linear interpolation are used to improve the calculation performance. The system can meet the needs of small unmanned rotorcraft because of its small size; low power consumption; and strong antiinterference ability; which has made some theoretical work for the practical application of small unmanned rotorcraft data acquisition system.

title: Design and Implementation of Wireless Early Warning and Monitoring System for Failure of Railway Signal Lamp
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the design and implementation of a wireless early warning and monitoring system for railway signal lamp failure under the control of CC2530.The system uses CC2530 as the core controller and bh1750 light intensity sensor module as the measurement core to measure the change of signal light intensity.The measured data is uploaded to CC2530 module to obtain the change of signal light intensity;which corresponds to the feature database;sends out the warning or failure information;and transmits it to the control center through ZigBee network to monitor the use of railway signal lights.
keywords: bh1750fvi light intensity sensor, cc2530 module, zigbee protocol

title: Design and Implementation of Wireless Telemetry and Telecontrol Radio Based on CC1200
abstract: With the wide application of wireless communication technology;wireless telemetry and telecontrol technology with high integration and strong anti-interference capability has attracted more and more attention.A wireless telemetry and telecontrol radio based on TI’s wireless RF transceiver chip CC1200 and FPGA is designed.The overall scheme design is introduced.It is divided into two parts:the scheme design of the wireless transceiver system and the baseband signal processing design.Finally;the design of the hardware board and software program of the whole system is realized.The results show that the whole system meets the requirements of various parameters in the actual application scenario and provides a reference for engineering practices.
keywords: cc1200, fpga, radio, wireless telemetry and telecontrol
affiliations: College of Electronic Information Engineering,North China University of Technology

title: Design of Wireless Radio Frequency Remote Reading and Writing System
abstract: In order to solve the problem of short reading and writing distance of radio frequency;the ZigBee long-distance reading and writing method of radio frequency is studied;and the design of radio frequency identification and wireless access point is designed in a hybrid system to realize RFID remote reading write and realize data transmission through ZigBee.The wireless terminal node is composed of RFID reader and wireless access point.In the hardware structure;CC2530 is used as the microcontroller and radio frequency module for ZigBee wireless communication;and Si522 is used as the reader radio frequency chip.The system has the characteristics of good flexibility;strong scalability;high reliability;safe data transmission and low cost;and the communication distance of RFID is extended and its application range is widened..
keywords: cc2530, remote reading and writing system, rfid, si522, zigbee
affiliations: Wuhan Vocational College of Communications and Publishing

title: 一种新能源汽车充电桩控制系统设计方案
abstract: 本文从电动汽车直流充电桩的具体要求出发;设计了一种人机交互界面友好、运行稳定可靠、能实现双枪同时充电的直流充电桩控制系统。该控制系统主要分为两个部分:计费控制单元和充电设备控制器。计费控制单元作为整个系统的控制中心;采用了TI公司的32位微处理器TMS320F28335作为主控芯片。通过RS485通信采集电能表的信息并在触摸屏上进行显示;同时具备IC卡读卡及结算功能。通过向充电设备控制器下发开始充电或停止充电相关指令来间接控制整个充电流程;同时接收充电设备控制器上传的电压、电流、SOC及报警等实时信息来进行控制和显示。最后对整个控制系统做了相关实验及测试;测试数据表明该直流充电桩控制系统运行稳定、操作方便;达到了预期设计目的。
keywords: can, tms320f28335, 控制系统, 直流充电桩
affiliations: 青岛科技大学青岛黄海学院

title: 基于ZigBee和CC2530的农业大棚温湿度采集系统设计
abstract: 农业大棚在农业生产中可以减少恶劣气候环境对农作物的破坏;可以在恶劣的气候环境条件下使用;农业大棚还可以减少农作物对季节的依赖;以提高农作物的年产量。通过分析ZigBee协议及无线传输技术构建无线传感网络;利用CC2530和DHT11数字温湿度传感器技术;完成了农业大棚温湿度采集系统的硬件和软件设计。通过节点数据采集模块设计、网络模块设计和数据封装设计;完成了农业大棚的温度、湿度环境的信息采集;从而为实现智能农业大棚的环境信息采集提供了一种科学方法。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 农业大棚, 温湿度采集
affiliations: 成都农业科技职业学院

title: Development of Gearbox Wireless Monitoring System Based on STM32 and Zigbee
abstract: At present; most of the traditional monitoring systems for gearbox use wired data transmission for monitoring; while the traditional monitoring system is prone to the phenomenon of monitoring and management disconnection. Aiming at these problems;a coordinator composed of stm32f103c8t6 and CC2530 with 32-bit Cortex-M3 core is designed. Through the construction of ZigBee wireless local area network; the information collected by the sensor is sent to the upper computer monitoring interface in real time.The experimental results show that compared with the traditional monitoring method; wireless monitoring can improve the stability of monitoring to the greatest extent in the same efficiency; so as to provide a feasible scheme for wireless monitoring of gearbox.
keywords: gearbox, stm32, wireless monitoring, zigbee technology
affiliations: School of Aeronautical Manufacturing Engineering, Nanchang Hangkong University

title: Design of Wireless Watt-Hour Meter Data Acquisition System Based on Zigbee
abstract: In order to realize the remote acquisition of power grid operation data and remote real-time monitoring of the operation status of watt-hour meters;a wireless watt-hour meter data acquisition system based on Zigbee technology was designed.The wireless solution of the system terminal and the design of the wireless watt-hour meter based on CC2530 development platform was introduced.The wireless terminal was mainly used to perform data acquisition;data display and wireless transmission.Considering the construction efficiency and scalability of system network;Zigbee technology was mainly adopted in the wireless scheme of the data acquisition system to set up the network;complete the transmission and aggregation of the data collected by the wireless meter;and uploading it to remote host computer through GPRS network.Experiments showed that the system could gather and upload multi-terminal data stably and efficiently.
keywords: real time, systematic design, wireless communication, wireless watt-hour meter, zigbee
affiliations: State Grid Xinjiang comprehensive energy service Co.,Ltd., State Grid Xinjiang Electric Power Research Institute, School of Information Science and Engineering,Chongqing Jiaotong University

title: Vehicle-mounted Wireless Temperature Intelligent Monitoring System
abstract: In view of the complex internal mechanism of tracked vehicles;the internal data transmission of vehicles through cables;and low integration;a wireless temperature intelligent monitoring system was designed. The system incorporates innovative technologies of the Internet of Things;collects temperature data through a wireless sensor network;uses the CC2530 radio frequency module to build a ZigBee network to realize wireless transmission of temperature data within the vehicle;an in-vehicle intelligent terminal built on the basis of the Raspberry Pi 3 B + realizes temperature data Real-time monitoring and processing. The system function was tested in a laboratory environment.The test showed that the whole system can realize intelligent monitoring of the vehicle’s internal temperature.
keywords: data communication, intelligent temperature monitoring, internet of things（iot）, raspberry pi, vehicle-mounted, zigbee network
affiliations: JinXi Industries Group Co.,Ltd., Key Laboratory of Instrument Science and Dynamic Testing,Ministry of Education,North University of China

title: Design of Self-powered Wireless Network Sensor Node Based on Wind Energy Harvesting
abstract: Aiming at the problems of battery replacing difficulty and possible environmental pollution for traditional wireless sensor network node power supply; a self-powered wireless sensor network node design scheme based on wind energy harvesting was proposed. A piezoelectric wind energy harvester is designed to harvest the wind energy for powering the wireless sensor network nodes. Based on the parallel synchronous switch inductor circuit and voltage regulator chip MAX1672; an energy managing circuit with a supercapacitor as the energy storage element is designed. It solves the problem that the wind energy harvester cannot directly supply power to the node. With cores consist of CC2530 and SHT20; a wireless sensor network node with temperature and humidity monitoring function is manufactured. The experimental results show that the starting wind speed of the wind energy harvesteris 3 m/s.The optimal electric load is 30 kΩ. The maximum output power is 220 uW. The node can work normally under a 90 s data transmission cycle.
keywords: energy management circuit, self-powered, wind energy harvesting, wireless sensor network node

title: Design of RDDV Valve Controller Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: Rotary direct drive valve is a kind of servo valve. It is used to directly drive the sliding valve of servo valve through the eccentric mechanism of the motor and realize the high-precision detection of the position of the valve core;thus controlling the flow rate. This paper designs a rotary direct drive servo valve controller based on TMS320F28335. Using digital control technology;the hardware and software of the controller are designed and tested. The results show that the controller is characteristic of simple circuit structure;fast operation speed and flexible control.
keywords: controller, design, servo valve, tms320f28335
affiliations: Aviation Science and Technology Key Laboratory of Aviation Mechanical and Electrical System,China Aviation Industry Nanjing Electrical and Hydraulic Engineering Research Center

title: Design of Low Power Bluetooth module based on CC2541
abstract: This paper designs an ultra-low power Bluetooth module based on TI company cc2541;which can connect quickly and exchange data in two directions.The circuit composition and principle of the ultra-low power Bluetooth module are introduced in detail;and the power performance and stability of the module are analyzed from the perspective of current and data integrity.
keywords: bluetooth module, cc2541, low power consumption
affiliations: The 718TH Research Institure Of CSIC

title: 基于ZigBee的隧道电气化设备除冰系统研究
abstract: 冬季;隧道冰害严重影响电气化铁路的安全运行。针对现有铁路隧道除冰方式仍存在的问题;提出了基于ZigBee和PLC的除冰系统;系统主要包括温湿度采集、CC2530模块、上位机、PLC控制等模块。通过研究寒区隧道温度场分布规律;依据隧道进口受隧道外界温度影响较大;距洞口越远影响越小的特点;确定了设备在隧道内的安装位置。
keywords: plc, zigbee, 温度场, 除冰系统
affiliations: 柳州铁道职业技术学院动力技术学院

title: An Error Detection Device for 4 Semi-digital Multimeter
abstract: To solve the problem that measurement accuracy of common digital multimeters needs to be measured regularly; an error detection device based on LM399 H high-precision bandgap reference source is designed. This device through the LM399 H voltage regulation output; and then through the resistance voltage or operation amplifier circuit; can design 1. 5 V; 6. 5 V and 10 V gear voltage. The dc output voltage is collected by ADS1256 and processed by STM32 microcontroller. The output is displayed on the TFT LCD screen. Through actual circuit test; the device can detect and measure the error of dc voltage gear of 4 semi-digital multimeter. The device has low cost; stable performance and potential application value.
keywords: a/d sampling, lm399h, operation amplification, resistance partial pressure
authors: LI Xiaofei;LIANG Dongmei;ZHOU Yuming;WEI Cuilian;CHEN Chunyou

title: 某船用保护装置现场测试系统的设计
abstract: 基于模块化、小型化、通用性、可拓展性等设计理念;设计了该测试系统。通过应用ADS1256、DAC8830等先进芯片;提高了系统的技术先进性和集成化程度;针对被测对象信号输入输出多样性的问题;设计了适应性极高的信号处理电路;采取冗余设计思想;设计了多达4路模拟信号输出通道和4路模拟信号测量通道;提高了测试系统的可拓展性。
keywords: ads1256, dac8830, 信号处理, 冗余设计

title: 基于TMS320F28035+DRV8412两相混合式步进电机驱动电路设计
abstract: 在两相混合式步进电机驱动电路中;为了简化电路、提高驱动能力;提出了一种基于DSP+DRV8412的两相步进电机驱动电路的设计方案。利用TMS320F28035作为主控芯片;为系统产生PWM波。DRV8412作为一款专用的驱动芯片;其驱动功率大。通过软件实现对步进电机控制。试验结果表明;PWM波及其分频;都可以由DSP准确无误地产生;达到了预期的效果。在实际的应用中;电机运行平稳。
keywords: drv8412, tms320f28035, 步进电机, 驱动电路
authors: 崔瑞龙;周明雨;刘威;焦旭光;黎俊;倪晓宇
affiliations: 江西中船航海仪器有限公司

title: 一种跳频信号解调的多核DSP设计方法
abstract: 针对非合作跳频信号的实时解调难题;文中搭建了以多核DSP TMS320C6678为核心的跳频信号实时处理系统;基于MSK信号的非相干解调原理;利用多DSP核的同步通信、任务调度和软件优化;并行完成了多个不同码元速率的跳频网台信号实时解调。测试结果表明;文中所提出的多核DSP设计方法能够有效提升跳频信号实时解调性能。
keywords: msk解调, 多核dsp, 跳频信号, 非相干
affiliations: 通信信息控制和安全技术重点实验室  ,   中国电子科技集团公司第三十六研究所

title: 一种车用碳化硅DC/DC变换器分布式监控系统优化设计
abstract: 车载双向DC/DC变换器实现了复合储能系统的能量转换;针对纯电动汽车DC/DC变换器数据流动复杂;需要数据采集系统实现对观测量以及控制量的实时监控;在整车驱动系统结构基础上;以TMS320F28027为主控制器;采用双路CAN总线通信结构;设计了分布式结构的监控系统;搭建了基于CAN总线的双向DC/DC变换器分布式监控系统实验环境;最后通过采集两端的电压电流来验证设计的监控系统;实验结果表明;设计的监控系统能够实时准确地采集数据;快速响应系统的指令;整个系统无超调。
keywords: can总线, 双向dc/dc变换器, 监控系统, 纯电动汽车
affiliations: 咸阳职业技术学院汽车学院

title: 基于ZVS全桥变换器的有轨电车充电机的研制
abstract: 设计了一款用于国产化现代有轨电车辅助电源系统平台的充电机功率模块。该模块的主电路拓扑采用了基于移相控制的全桥零电压开关（ZVS）变换器和倍流整流（CDR）电路;主控制芯片采用了TMS320F28335。主控制芯片发出的移相脉宽调制（PWM）脉冲控制信号经过IGBT的驱动模块2sc0435T进行功率放大和隔离后传输至IGBT的门极;以实现移相全桥变换器主功率开关的ZVS。在进行了ZVS软开关参数、系统软件和硬件的设计以及系统模型仿真之后;组装了一台实验样机。实验结果表明设计方案正确;软开关效果良好;并将实验样机产品化后推广至市场应用。
keywords: 倍流整流电路, 充电机, 移相全桥变换器
authors: 葛艳华;宫钰明;刘金晶;许明夏
affiliations: 中车大连电力牵引研发中心有限公司
source: 北大核心;电力电子技术

title: 一种提高MLS角度精度的综合测量方法
abstract: 研究了MLS的角度测量问题;提出了一种提高测角精度的综合测量方法。该方法利用往返扫描波束的对称性抑制多径干扰;利用提出的线交叉寻峰算法改善角度测量精度;利用数字滤波技术减小噪声的影响;并用以TMS320F2812 DSP为核心的数字信号处理系统对提出的方法进行了实验验证。测试结果表明:提出的方法具有测量精度高、对多径干扰具有鲁棒性以及便于工程实现的优点。
keywords: 仰角, 多径干扰, 微波着陆系统, 方位角, 阵列天线
authors: 田孝华;何晶;赵颖辉;邹鲲
affiliations: 西安培华学院智能科学与信息工程学院,  空军工程大学信息与导航学院

title: 基于UART的串口扩展设计
abstract: 随着嵌入式的广泛应用;越来越多的产品需要DSP与计算机之间进行协调工作。单片DSP芯片自身提供的FIFO不能满足大数据的通信;所以需要采用UART芯片扩展DSP串口。因此;介绍利用EXAR公司的异步通信收发器XR16C2852扩展串口;实现DSP与计算机之间的串口通信;详细说明了UART寄存器配置;同时提供了详细的硬件电路设计和软件编程设计。
keywords: tms320f2812, uart, xr16c2852, 串口扩展
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第三研究所

title: 基于模型设计方法的两级式光伏并网系统开发
abstract: 为了提高光伏并网系统开发过程效率;解决DSP传统手动编程复杂、时间周期长的问题;提出了基于模型设计方法的光伏并网系统开发方法。首先在Matlab/Simulink下搭建了两级式光伏并网系统仿真模型:前级采用最大功率点追踪（MPPT）算法及Boost型DC/DC升压环节;后级采用三相全桥变流器实现有功功率及无功功率的分别调节;实现可靠并网。然后在对系统完成仿真验证的基础上;对嵌入式控制算法部分及外设建立Embedded Coder模型;实现了从Simulink模型到嵌入式代码的自动生成。最后将自动生成的代码在基于TMS320F28379D控制芯片的两级式光伏并网系统上进行了实验验证。实验结果及开发过程表明;这种基于模型设计的开发过程提升了Simulink建模的实用价值;降低了控制系统算法实现的难度;可以加速模型验证和项目开发。
keywords: 光伏并网, 基于模型的设计, 自动代码生成
affiliations: 天津市信息传感与智能控制重点实验室  ,   天津职业技术师范大学自动化与电气工程学院

title: CC1312R的射频无线温湿度传感器设计
abstract: 本文设计了一款基于CC1312R单片机的低功耗无线射频温湿度传感器。介绍了系统的硬件设计;主要包括单片机最小系统、温湿度采集模块、液晶显示模块、无线通信模块、电源模块等;并在硬件设计的基础上完成软件的设计。最后;搭建实验系统并对实验数据进行最小二乘法修正;修正后温湿度传感器的温度误差为±0.2℃;相对湿度误差为±1%;符合博物馆监测终端要求。
keywords: cc1312r, 射频无线通信, 最小二乘法, 温湿度采集

title: CC2541的低功耗远程监控智能光交箱锁设计
abstract: 设计一款以CC2541为主控制器;GPRS通信模组作为通信介质;可通过手机开启并且能够实现远程开启和状态监控的智能光交箱锁。结合手机上开发的APP;通过蓝牙4.2相关协议;具有权限的手机可以将智能光交箱锁开启。通过GPRS通信模组;智能光交箱锁可以将当前状态传送到服务器端;用于监控智能光交箱锁的状态。手机无法开启时;可通过GPRS向服务器申请远程开启。
keywords: cc2541, gprs, 光交箱锁, 远程开启
source: 单片机与嵌入式系统应用

title: 支持向量机与微波传感器在手势识别中的应用
abstract: 提出一种基于10.525GHz微波传感器和支持向量机（Support Vector Machine;SVM）算法相结合的手势识别方法。微波传感器输出的多普勒信号经过放大和ADS1256采样后;发送给BCM2837B0SoC;再利用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）提取手势特征;最后借助SVM进行分类。实验结果表明;本方法能够分别以87%、84%和83%的平均准确率识别2种、4种和6种手势;具有较强的扩展性和较高准确率。
keywords: ads1256, bcm2837b0, fft, svm, 微波传感器, 手势识别

title: 基于Android的智能家居系统设计与研究
abstract: 从20世纪80年代智能家居概念的提出至今已有30多年;智能家居已经历了4代的发展。家居智能控制系统价格低;性价比高;越来越受欢迎。将具有Android操作系统的智能手机或者平板电脑作为智能家居系统的控制终端;以CC2530单片机最小系统作为硬件电路及控制器;设计ZigBee、WIFI及315M射频网络软件;通过RT5350与CC2530的串口连接将ZigBee和WIFI连接起来;设计并开发本基于Android的智能家居系统。
keywords: wifi, zigbee, 基于android, 智能家居

title: 一种电力巡检机器人控制系统设计与实现
abstract: 对电力巡检智能机器人的工作环境与工作内容;文中设计了一种基于TMS320F2812数字处理器并结合PC104的电力巡检智能机器人。基于该嵌入式控制芯片的电力巡检机器人能够进行各类电力巡检作业;通过其自身携带的各类传感器、高清视频采集器、GPS定位仪、无线远程通信设备等;对电力线路及电力设备进行检测;同时通过大数据库和控制基站进行数据交互。通过在实验室内模拟电力巡检作业环境进行系统联调测试;基本实现了设计目标。
keywords: 巡检, 控制系统, 机器人, 电力
affiliations: 广州供电局有限公司

title: 基于Zigbee通信技术的智能家居系统设计
abstract: 针对家居智能化的研究现状;设计并实现了一种低成本、低功耗、安全性高的无线通讯智能家居系统。该系统采用cc2530微控制器的Zigbee无线协议栈。网关主控器采用ST公司生产的STM32F103C8T6处理器采集来自温湿度、烟雾、人体红外、光照强度等传感器收集到的数据;并驱动风扇、照明灯、加湿器等家用设备。通过组建Zigbee无线通讯网络实现网关端协调器与底层环境监测传感器和电气设备控制模块的数据通信;实现网关接收平台对家庭设备的控制。该方案以微信小程序作为主要的人机交互界面;极大地提升了远程控制体验。本方案是一套以节省能源、高效、准确;可扩展为前提的行之有效的智能家居系统的解决方案;同时该系统实用性强;具有良好的发展前景和广阔的市场。
keywords: zigbee, 微信小程序, 智能家居系统, 环境监测
affiliations: 曲阜师范大学,  山东大学(威海)
risk.affiliations: Shandong University (山东大学)

title: 一种TMS320F2812平台下串口烧写程序的方案
abstract: 针对TMS320F2812平台产品后期软件维护升级过程中需要使用仿真器并拆机的繁琐操作问题;给出了一种通过串口烧写程序的方案。方案设计了一种加载程序;能够将应用程序从串口接收并烧写进相应的FLASH区域;使软件固化升级操作脱离了仿真器和开发环境。方案所设计的加载程序精巧;升级时只需要通过上位机传输并在RAM空间运行;不需提前烧录进产品FLASH中;从而降低了产品的升级维护难度。方案应用方便;适用场合广泛;具有较高的实用价值。
keywords: tms320f2812, 串口flash固化, 加载程序, 应用程序, 软件升级维护
affiliations: 航空工业西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 基于阿里云物联网平台的自动气象站设计
abstract: 针对于国家气象部门所用气象站维护难度大、专业要求高等问题;提出一种基于阿里云物联网平台的民用自动气象站设计方案。系统设计方案包括硬件部分和软件部分。其中;硬件部分包括以AM3358为主控制器的核心电路、Modbus传感器数据采集电路、4G通信模块等;软件部分包括设备端Link kit软件开发、云服务器端IoT Studio网站应用UI界面开发、后台数据服务开发、消息流转等内容。整个系统实现了六要素自动气象站的全部功能;并增加了一些实用功能;如在出现特定气象参数时;将消息发送至手机APP群组。实践测试表明其具有维护简单、成本低廉等优点;特别适用于农业生产、车站、港口等非气象部门中对气象要素的观测需求。
keywords: modbus, mqtt, 自动气象站, 阿里云物联网
affiliations: 武汉市江夏区气象局,  贵州省遵义市气象局

title: 单相非隔离型改进Y源光伏并网逆变器
abstract: 为了解决传统Y源光伏逆变器并网时的共模电流问题;通常需要在电网和逆变器之间串联工频或者高频变压器实现电气隔离;但是工频变压器体积大、成本高;而高频变压器需要加入新的能量变换电路;控制复杂;效率较低。为此;提出了一种新型的无隔离变压器型Y源光伏并网逆变器拓扑结构;将光伏阵列负端与电网中性线直接相连;引入虚拟直流母线并改进脉冲宽度调制（pulse width modulation; PWM）策略;同时通过电压电流应力分析优化电容容值;解决负半周期电压跌落的问题。最终;搭建了一台基于TMS320F28335的实验样机来验证所提拓扑的有效性。仿真和实验结果表明;新型拓扑可以在确保并网电流质量的情况下;旁路共模电流回路;从而完全消除共模电流。所提非隔离型Y源逆变器拓扑可以减小逆变器的体积和成本;为光伏并网提供支撑。
keywords: pwm, y源逆变器, 光伏发电系统, 共地拓扑, 共模电流, 容值优化
affiliations: 哈尔滨工业大学电气工程及自动化学院,  山东电力设备有限公司交流设计部

title: 基于CC2530的无线温度采集装置的研究
abstract: 针对密闭环境试验设备和高温高压灭菌装置有线温度测量仪表无法检测的问题;该文设计了一种基于CC2530的无线温度采集装置;介绍了系统整体设计思路和结构;详细介绍了系统组网、温度测量方法、无线唤醒等软硬件设计方案;经分析试验及应用;取得了预期效果。
keywords: cc2530, 无线传感网络, 无线传输, 无线唤醒

title: 基于ZigBee技术的粮库监测系统的设计与实现
abstract: 针对传统粮库监测系统存在的布线复杂、成本高等问题;设计了一种基于ZigBee技术的多传感器粮库监测系统设计方案。系统以CC2530为无线通信芯片;通过多种传感器采集环境参数;利用Z-Stack协议栈实现数据的无线传输。经串口实现与PC机的即时通信;开发上位机监控软件;实现对粮库环境数据的实时查看、数据分析及预测调度功能。经实际测试;该系统成本低、检测精度较高、无线通信稳定;满足了粮库的实际需求。
keywords: zigbee技术, 传感器, 无线通信, 环境监测
affiliations: 兰州理工大学电气工程与信息工程学院

title: 基于CAN通信多通道数据采集系统设计
abstract: 实时准确采集康复下肢外骨骼机器人传感器信息对于机器人下一时刻的动作尤为重要。设计了一款基于CAN总线的多通道数据采集系统;以TMS320F2812为核心芯片实现A/D转换;转换后的数据信息通过CAN总线发送至上位机软件CANTest实现数据的读取;实验结果表明;所设计采集系统硬件电路简单;采集精度高;抗干扰能力强;工作迅速可靠。
keywords: can总线, tms320f2812, 下肢康复外骨骼机器人, 多通道, 数据采集, 系统设计
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第二十一研究所

title: 基于DSP和PLC的电牵引采煤机电控系统优化设计
abstract: 针对传统PLC控制存在的数据实时处理效率低、智能控制算法在PLC系统中可植入性差等问题;设计了一种以S7-300 PLC为主控制器、TMS320F2812 DSP为从控制器的电牵引采煤机电控系统方案;详细介绍了PLC硬件系统配置和DSP关键电路设计。优化了S7-300 PLC的控制功能;利用DSP实时监测截割电机运行状态;通过DSP输出为PLC控制提供参考;在不同的生产工况下优化牵引电机状态、摇臂和滚筒位置。该电控系统同时具有PLC和DSP控制的优越性;为采煤机在各种复杂生产工况下高效截煤提供可靠保障。
keywords: dsp, plc, 电控系统, 电牵引采煤机
affiliations: 苏州市职业大学  ,  中南林业科技大学

title: 基于ZigBee的隧道电气化设备除冰系统研究
abstract: 冬季;隧道冰害严重影响电气化铁路的安全运行。针对现有铁路隧道除冰方式仍存在的问题;提出了基于ZigBee和PLC的除冰系统;系统主要包括温湿度采集、CC2530模块、上位机、PLC控制等模块。通过研究寒区隧道温度场分布规律;依据隧道进口受隧道外界温度影响较大;距洞口越远影响越小的特点;确定了设备在隧道内的安装位置。
keywords: plc, zigbee, 温度场, 除冰系统
affiliations: 柳州铁道职业技术学院动力技术学院

title: 基于CC2541的低功耗蓝牙模块的设计
abstract: 设计一款以TI公司CC2541为核心器件;能够快速连接并且可以进行双向数据交换的超低功耗蓝牙模组。对该超低功耗蓝牙模组电路组成及原理进行了详细介绍;并从电流以及数据完整性的角度对该模块的功耗性能与稳定性进行了分析。
keywords: cc2541, 低功耗, 蓝牙模块

title: 动态无线充电循迹小车系统的设计与实现
abstract: 本设计是以CC2530为处理器的电动小车动态无线充电系统。小车系统由核心控制模块、循迹模块、驱动模块、无线充电模块构成。循迹模块由循迹核心模块和四个红外感应构成;驱动模块由两个2.7V/10F的法拉电容和核心驱动模块以及两个电机构成;使小车在充电后可以正常运行;满足电路电压。无线充电模块由振荡器、耦合线圈和整流稳压电路构成;达到无线充电的目的。本次设计的小车经过测试运行比较稳定;可以达到预期目的。
keywords: cc2530, 处理器, 无线充电模块, 驱动模块
authors: 赵国帅;周梦洁;张哲祎;张振宇;尹婷;关志艳

title: 基于ZigBee和ESP8266的远程灌溉控制平台设计
abstract: 为了便于农户使用移动终端查看土壤数据;判断墒情;控制水泵灌溉农田;远离带电设备;节约劳作时间;本文设计了基于ZigBee和ESP8266的远程灌溉控制平台。该灌溉控制平台采用CC2530单片机作为控制器组建协调器和传感器节点;在协调器中ESP8266通过串口与CC2530进行通信;协调器通过传感器节点采集农田数据发送给移动终端;移动终端通过无线局域网控制ESP8266进而实现CC2530的灌溉功能。试验结果表明;该灌溉控制平台工作稳定;通信可靠;移动终端能够实时显示土壤数据;可以灵活控制水泵的开启;实现了远程灌溉控制平台的功能。
keywords: esp8266, zigbee, 灌溉控制平台

title: 基于改进小波阈值的激光通信信号识别系统设计
abstract: 信号识别是激光通信的重要组成部分;是后续信息处理环节的基础与前提;因此;设计了基于改进小波阈值的激光通信信号识别系统。系统中的激光通信接收模块接收激光脉冲信号传输至A/D转换模块中;A/D转换模块利用流水线结构转换方式预处理脉冲信号并将其转换为电信号传输至信号识别模块中;信号识别模块采用TMS320LF2407 DSP芯片;该芯片内集成基于改进小波阈值的激光通信信号识别算法;通过改进小波函数;确定小波函数阈值消除电信号内噪声;去噪后的信号利用傅立叶变换确定信号频谱数据的相对频率值;根据频率值实现激光通信信号识别。实验结果显示;该系统具有较高的信号识别精度;信噪比高于对比系统;能耗低。
keywords: dsp芯片, 信号识别, 去噪, 改进小波阈值, 激光通信, 系统设计
affiliations: 郑州商学院信息与机电工程学院

title: 基于DSP的光通信系统设计与实现
abstract: 光通信系统容易受信道串扰影响数据传输性能;为提升通信效率设计基于DSP的光通信系统;将TMS320F28335型浮点DSP作为光通信系统的控制芯片;系统发射端部分利用DSP控制模块调制数据并发送至激光驱动模块中;通过激光实现数据传输;由发射端控制软件实现数码管显示、按键扫描以及发送数据;系统接收端控制软件控制数码管判读和显示数据;接收端利用光电接收模块中的PIN光电二极管接收激光驱动模块发送数据后将光信号转化至电信号;电信号通过功率放大缓冲后利用RXD引脚发送至DSP判读;DSP控制模块将判读数据发送至PC端显示;其中DSP数据处理主要包括还原发射端原始信号以及求逆接收信号矩阵2部分。通过搭建实验平台验证该系统通信性能;实验结果表明;该系统通信精准性高;具有极强的可靠性;信噪比高于72 dB;满足高性能通信要求。
keywords: dsp, 光, 实现, 系统, 设计, 通信
affiliations: 江西应用科技学院人工智能学院

title: 基于USB-HID接口的高速数据采集系统设计
abstract: 介绍了基于USB-HID（Human Interface Device）接口的高速数据采集系统的开发过程;详细阐述了系统硬件设计、软件设计及其应用。通过EZ-USB FX2芯片CY7C68013和DSP处理器TMS320F2812实现与外部设备之间的数据传输和采集。该系统具有传输速度快、结构简单、实时性和可靠性高等优点;可自动被识别为HID设备。该系统可应用于高速数据和红外图像的传输和采集;传输平均速度可达40 MB/s;响应速度可达10 ms;能较好地满足数据实时传输要求。
keywords: usb-hid, 数据采集, 红外图像, 高速
authors: 熊焱;徐玉娇;刘鑫;朱正鹏;朱旭锋
affiliations: 北京航天自动控制研究所

title: 基于ZigBee控制下的节能智慧照明系统设计与实现
abstract: 智能照明系统能结合智能家居为人们提供良好的视觉效果和灵活方便的控制。设计采用ZigBee芯片cc2530作为主控芯片;借助cc3200强大的处理能力与精确的程序有机结合;采集周围环境相关数据。系统配备烟雾报警器MQ-2模块、人体热释电红外检测模块、温湿度模块以及照明系统;通过wifi网关将采集的数据实时传输到手机;通过手机APP端实现对数据的监控显示以及双向控制。建立了一套节能智慧照明系统;用户可通过手机APP进行相应的控制和管理。
keywords: wifi, 智能照明, 环境监测, 红外检测模块
authors: 郭黎;李润泽;王曼然;卜慎慎;陈锦皓

title: 奶粉自动配料称量控制系统设计
abstract: 为实现奶粉生产的自动配料、自动称量、自动监控;提高生产企业自动化程度;设计一种基于DSP芯片TMS320F2812的自动配料称量控制系统。分析奶粉自动配料称量工艺的整体流程;给出奶粉称量的控制原理;对控制系统硬件进行设计;在硬件结构基础上对控制系统软件进行设计;结果表明;控制系统可自动完成奶粉配料称量;对提升企业自动化程度、提高企业生产效率具有应用价值。
keywords: dsp, 硬件, 自动配料, 软件
affiliations: 河源职业技术学院电子与信息工程学院

title: 基于DSP电磁振动式食品分装机控制系统设计
abstract: 为了提高颗粒食品定量称量效率、降低工人劳动强度、提高称量精度;设计一款基于DSP的食品定量分装机控制系统。分析颗粒食品定量分装机结构;并介绍定量称重工艺流程。基于TMS320F2812 DSP设计了控制系统硬件结构;设计DSP驱动电机控制电路;为提高称重系统称量精度通过INA122放大器对传感器信号进行放大。对食品定量称重控制系统软件采用模块设计方法;实现粗料和精料定量同时进行;提高称量精度及称量效率。系统经过现场安装调试后;能够稳定可靠运行。
keywords: dsp, 分装机, 硬件, 食品定量称重

title: 三相12/8极开关磁阻电动机控制系统设计
abstract: 以三相12/8极开关磁阻电机作为研究对象;设计了以TMS320F28335芯片作为主控单元的开关磁阻电机调速系统。调速系统由软件部分和硬件部分组成。软件部分采用双闭环PI进行控制;电流为内环;转速为外环;在综合考虑速度给定信号、位置信号、保护信号的基础上;计算得出对应导通相的PWM驱动信号;硬件部分主要由开关磁阻电机、功率变换器、电流检测、位置检测、键盘和数码管显示屏组成。结合位置信号、速度信号、电流反馈信号;对开关磁阻电机的控制策略进行调整;让其在电压斩波控制方式下工作。经过参数调整实验;最后选择合理的PI控制比例系数和积分系数。通过实验数据优化、对比、分析;验证了此控制系统设计的合理性。

title: 用于控制课程群的硬件在环仿真教学平台研发
abstract: 该文设计了适用于控制类课程实践教学的硬件在环仿真教学系统。系统由双核浮点数字信号处理器（DSP）TMS320F28379D、隔离式模拟数字输出接口和人机接口3大模块构成。双核浮点DSP中的一个核（仿真核）用于仿真实验对象;另一个核（控制核）用于控制实验对象;双核的数据交互可以实现对实验对象的开环特性测试和闭环控制。该教学平台通过授课教师预设实验对象模型、学生设置控制核动作且在线观测波形的模式;可以有效填补实践教学中由仿真到硬件调制中间缺失的硬件仿真环节。通过典型二阶系统Buck电路以及双容水箱系统实验;验证了该教学平台的有效性与实用性。

title: 信息化时代构建智慧型物理实验室的研究
abstract: 物理实验室是培养大学生动手能力和创新能力的基地;建设智慧型物理实验室有利于进一步提升物理实验室管理水平和实验教学效果。该文设计了基于感知层、信息处理层、系统管理层软硬一体的智慧实验室构架;通过加装基于CC2530的无线传感网ZIGBEE设计的实验黑盒;使老旧仪器快速实现智能化;并基于Lambda Architecture架构的大数据处理提升了信息处理层的处理能力和扩展能力。采用B/S架构设计的管理层交互性好;功能丰富。

title: 基于DSP的数字信号处理“口袋实验室”设计
abstract: 为了满足实验及创新教学需求;研发了基于DSP的数字信号处理"口袋实验室"。采用TI公司的TMS320F28335作为核心芯片;采用模块化设计方法;具有便携性和高扩展性等优点。该"口袋实验室"改变了原有的教学和实验方法。通过使用该"口袋实验室";将理论知识的学习和实践环节有机结合;取得了良好的实践教学效果。

title: 通用型电机数字控制实验平台
abstract: 基于DSP研制了一套通用型电机数字控制实验系统。该平台以DSPTMS320F28335为控制核心;集成了电源模块、液晶显示、功率变换器主电路、驱动电路、隔离电路等功能模块。利用6个半桥组成电机控制系统通用主电路;可完成有刷/无刷直流电机、开关磁阻电机、永磁同步电机、单相/三相异步电机和步进电机等多种电机的调速实验。综合了电力电子技术、电机学、微特电机、电机拖动以及DSP控制等相关专业知识;有助于学生深入学习和理解不同电机的控制原理以及数字调速控制方法。

title: 四轴无人机姿态测量及三维模型显示系统设计
abstract: 四轴无人机在空中受人为或环境中不定因素的影响;姿态发生变化。操作员如不能正确判断;在遥控上产生的失误会造成无人机损坏甚至人员伤害。针对这类问题;设计一套基于STM32的四轴无人机姿态测量和三维模型显示系统。系统以ARM Cortex-M3核的STM32为主控制器;读取运动处理器件MPU6050和磁力计HMC5883L组合成9轴传感器的输出并通过四元数姿态解算得到无人机的姿态角;经过CC1101芯片将姿态角数据发送给地面接收端。LabVIEW通过串口接收数据并完成对数据的分析与处理;实现四轴无人机三维图像实时显示。结果表明;姿态解算稳定可靠;系统结构简单;成本低;可移植性强;具有一定的实用性。
keywords: labview, 姿态解算, 无人机, 无线传输, 运动处理组件

title: 基于光电容积描记的心率监测系统设计
abstract: 为实时监测运动状态下的心率;基于光电容积描记术监测心率;采用MAX30102反射式光电传感器采集信号;经滤波、放大调整再送入微控制器STM32F407处理。借助CC2540蓝牙模块实现与上位机的无线通信实时显示;在心率失常时给出报警信号。经测试检测运动状态心率准确率达到98%以上;可有效检测心率。
keywords: 光电传感器max30102, 光电容积描记术, 心率, 蓝牙

title: 基于Zigbee的森林火灾预警防控系统研究
abstract: 为了研究Zigbee的森林火灾预警防控系统;本系统先通过传感器采集森林中的温湿度和烟雾浓度数据;利用Zigbee建立无线通信网络;选取CC2530单片机进行关键参数的搜集和传输;采用Zigbee协议栈软件开发保证网络通信稳定运行。最后将数据传输到电脑或者手机进行实时监测。实验证明;本系统能够完成对相关环境数据的检测;并通过无线通信成功传输数据;能够让护林人员及时做出判断和迅速采取手段;有效地提高森林火灾预警能力。
keywords: zigbee, 传感器, 火灾预警防控系统

title: 基于物联网的温室环境监控系统设计
abstract: 为了实现远程监控温室农作物生长环境;设计了一种基于物联网的温室环境监控系统。系统采用CC2530、传感器模块、控制模块设计ZigBee协调器和ZigBee终端节点组成无线传感器网络;负责采集温室环境数据和执行环境调控命令;采用STM32单片机作为微控制器;ESP8266模组作为Wi-Fi模块设计温室网关;负责无线传感器网络与远端云平台的数据交互;采用机智云平台和手机APP作为远程监控端;用户可使用手机实现对温室环境数据的远程监测和实时调控。经测试;系统运行稳定;采集的数据准确;能够实现温室环境的远程监控功能。
keywords: wi-fi, zigbee, 温室环境, 物联网, 远程监控
source: 陕西理工大学学报(自然科学版)

title: 一种X频段锁相频率合成器的设计与实现
abstract: 锁相频率源是卫星通信系统中最重要的核心部件之一;文章利用TI公司集成了VCO功能的锁相频合器芯片LMX2594设计了一款X频段低相噪频率源;模拟仿真并进行了实物电路测试;结果满足设计要求。该方案简单便捷;结构紧凑;具有广泛的应用前景。

abstract: 在卫星通信系统中;对锁相频率源要求很高;利用ATMEL公司的单片机ATTINY9结合TI公司的辅助设计工具基于集成VCO的锁相芯片LMX2572设计了一种C频段低相噪频率源;并制板出实物电路进行了测试;测试结果符合设计要求;该方案空间尺寸小、功耗低;可以广泛应用于卫星通信系统。

title: 车载电力电子变压器的高频隔离DC-DC变换器双相移控制
abstract: 以双有源全桥隔离DC-DC变换器为研究对象;开展相移控制的研究。首先;分析变换器在相移控制下的工作原理;分别推导了单相移和双相移控制下变换器的传输功率数学模型。然后;建立了变换器在单相相移和双相移下的回流功率模型;通过仿真对比了两种控制方法下的变换器回流功率。最后;通过以TMS320F28335为控制核心的1 kW SiC试验样机进行对比实验;试验结果表明:与单相移控制相比;双相移控制能有效降低回流功率;提升变流器的效率;验证了所建模型和仿真分析的正确性。

title: 车载无线温度智能监测系统
abstract: 针对履带式车辆内部机构复杂;车辆内部数据通过线缆传输、集成度低的现状;设计了无线温度智能监测系统。该系统融合物联网创新技术;通过低功耗的无线传感网络采集温度数据;利用CC2530射频模块搭建ZigBee网络;实现车辆内部温度数据的无线传输;以树莓派3B+为基础搭建的车载智能终端实现对温度数据的实时监测与处理。在实验室环境下对系统功能进行验;试验表明系统整体可以实现对车辆内部温度的智能监测。

title: 基于ZigBee的家庭观赏鱼养殖水质监测系统研究
abstract: 观赏鱼养殖作为我国渔业的一个崭新领域;拥有着良好的发展机遇。由于观赏鱼对养殖水质环境的要求较高;而且传统的养殖方式和人工监测手段难以保证水质参数的实时性和准确性;因此利用ZigBee无线传感网络;设计了一种家庭观赏鱼养殖水质监测系统;实现对水温和pH值等重要水质参数的采集和实时传输。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 串口通信, 水质监测

title: 一种模糊自适应控制系统的设计与实现
abstract: 基于电子信息技术应用;为实现机电一体化设备参数控制;实现良好的控制性能、电源节能和环境噪声控制。模糊自适应控制系统是一种解决电子设备散热及状态监控问题的装置。此控制装置属于电子设备的一部分。控制系统调整变频直流电机转速和风机转速;控制压力、流量、散热温度和系统压力;根据加固计算机的热负载情况改变散热能力;同时控制噪声;并接收操作命令和显示数据。

title: 尾矿库在线安全监测系统的设计
abstract: 针对尾矿库传统人工监测的局限性;结合华源矿业尾矿库的实际情况;本文设计了尾矿库安全监测系统;确定了在线监测项目和节点的分布位置;系统以CC2530作为控制器;通过不同传感器采集尾矿库的浸润线、坝体位移、库水位、降雨量等参数;利用无线网络传送到监控中心;监控中心对数据进行实时显示和处理。该方案简单易行;成本低;对矿山尾矿库的现代化管理有一定的借鉴意义。

title: 基于小波变换的地铁移频信号特征自动提取系统设计
abstract: 常规的地铁移频信号特征自动提取系统存在系统资源占用率过高的问题。为了改善常规系统中存在的不足;设计基于小波变换的地铁移频信号特征自动提取系统。首先确定系统硬件结构;根据其结构完成系统硬件设计;主要包括PNP信号传感器;CAN总线和TMS320C6713芯片;其次利用小波变换方法进行降噪和滤波处理;排除干扰信号完成软件设计;最后结合硬件和软件实现信号特征自动提取。测试结果表明;基于小波变换的地铁移频信号特征自动提取系统提取的信号有效滤除了噪声信号及干扰信号;该系统资源占用率与常规信号特征提取系统相比降低了32%;适合于地铁移频信号特征自动提取。
keywords: 地铁, 小波变换, 移频信号特征, 系统设计, 自动提取

title: 呼吸机管路温湿度监测控制系统
abstract: 本研究针对呼吸机患者回路温湿度无监控、精度不够的情况;设计一种基于Zigbee无线通信技术的患者回路温湿度无线监控系统。系统采用单片机CC2530和SHT35温湿度传感器;实现对呼吸机患者回路温湿度数据进行无线采集;通过CC2530芯片无线通信将终端采集到的温湿度监测值传输至协调器;经过协调器驱动加热丝和雾化片对呼吸机患者回路进行温湿度调控;具有温湿度监测精度高、误差小、系统稳定、操作方便等优点。经过测试;本研究设计的温湿度无线监控系统实现了对呼吸机患者回路的温湿度精确测量;解决了患者回路温湿度无监控、不精确的问题;提升了呼吸机对呼吸系统疾病患者的辅助治疗效果。

title: 基于TMS320F28335的高压变频调速系统逻辑控制单元设计
abstract: 高压变频调速系统需与DCS通信;对进出线断路器、接触器等电气设备进行状态检测、动作控制;并对这些开关量的时序进行记录与查询;以提高系统的安全性和智能化水平。现针对高压变频调速系统的开关量信号检测、控制、记录与查询;介绍了基于DSP的逻辑控制单元的原理、硬件和软件设计。
keywords: dsp, 开关量, 逻辑控制单元, 高压变频调速系统

title: 基于加速度传感器的低功耗居家用水行为检测装置
abstract: 设计了一种可以检测居家用水行为的低功耗装置。系统由ADXL362加速度传感器单元、MSP430FR6989低功耗微控制器单元、CC2530 ZigBee自组网单元等组成。可以通过采集水管的震动信号判断水管中是否有水流流过;并通过ZigBee将水流状态上传到后台。提出了一种三级休眠机制;大大降低了系统的功耗。同时采用阈值自适应设定的方法;增强了检测装置的适应性。测试结果表明;该装置可以有效检测居家用水行为。
keywords: 低功耗, 加速度传感器, 水流, 震动信号
affiliations: 滁州学院
source: 廊坊师范学院学报(自然科学版)

title: 基于6LoWPAN的低功耗长距离海洋环境监测系统
abstract: 海洋环境监测具有监测节点分散、节点数量多、测量数据种类复杂、信息交换和通信业务多样性的特点。无线传感器网络可以减少线路连接;降低部署和运维成本。6LoWPAN（IPv6 over Low-Power Wireless Personal AreaNetworks）技术基于IEEE802.15.4实现了IPV6数据包在无线传感器网络中的传输;是实现无线传感器网络和因特网互联的理想技术。在研究Contiki 6LoWPAN网络拓扑结构和协议的基础上;文中采用TI CC1310平台搭建了无线传感器节点和边缘路由器;节点数据经过边缘路由器和互联网;最终发送到服务器监控系统;实现海洋数据的动态监测。通过实验证明;该系统具有组网简单、传输距离远、成本和功耗低等优势。
keywords: cc1310, ipv6, 无线传感器网络, 海洋环境监测

title: 基于DSP的捷联惯导系统组合初始对准算法设计
abstract: 针对传统罗经法对准存在收敛速度慢、精度和稳定性较差的问题;将基于惯性系的快速对准方法和基于卡尔曼滤波精对准方法进行有机结合;利用惯性系对准的快速性;在2min内确定卡尔曼滤波状态的初始值;最后再利用卡尔曼滤波在14min内完成精对准。以TI公司的TMS320F28335高速DSP芯片作为初始对准的处理器;基于CCS编程软件完成了组合对准程序设计与调试;利用项目组自研光纤陀螺捷联惯导样机进行了比对验证试验。试验结果表明;该组合方法比传统罗经对准方法具有更快的收敛速度、更好的对准精度和更高的稳定性。
keywords: dsp28335, 卡尔曼滤波器, 惯性导航, 惯性系, 组合初始对准, 罗经对准
affiliations: 海军工程大学电气工程学院

title: 基于DSP（TMS320F2812）的电机微机保护平台设计与开发
abstract: 通过对电动机微机保护原理的分析研究;设计开发一种基于DSP的新型电动机综合保护平台;目的在于依托数字信号处理器（DSP）强大的运算能力和控制能力;检测电机运行过程中出现的各种故障类型;并对电机运行进行较为全面的保护。平台以TI公司生产的32位DSP（TMS320F2812）作为核心;在微机保护平台硬件和软件设计方面均采用模块化设计思路;以电机保护功能为设计指标;对各模块单元均采用了自顶向下;分层设计的方法;为电机微机保护领域提供了一种自动化程度高、反应迅速、抗干扰能力强、性能可靠的设计方案。
keywords: dsp, 微机保护, 故障类型, 模块化设计
affiliations: 安徽机电职业技术学院机械工程学院
source: 桂林航天工业学院学报

title: 基于MicroPython和CC3200的智能家居数据采集与控制系统设计
abstract: 为了解决多种网络通信协议共存给智能家居应用开发带来的不便;更好地实现家居的智能化;基于MicroPython和CC3200设计了一种智能家居数据采集与控制系统。该系统采用CC3200作为工作节点;通过微信公众号和OneNet平台获取系统采集的数据;并在云服务器中进行判断和相应处理;较好地解决了多种网络通信协议共存的问题;实现了智能家居数据采集与控制功能。实验测试结果表明:系统运行稳定;有较好的人机交互体验;具有较高的实际应用价值。
keywords: cc3200, micropython, 微信公众号, 数据采集与控制, 智能家居, 阿里云服务器

title: 一种基于ZigBee的低功耗无线传感器网络路由节点设计
abstract: 针对传统无线传感器网络路由节点需要一直上电工作的缺点;用CC2530及CC2591芯片设计制作了一款能休眠唤醒工作的路由节点。在硬件上选用低功耗睡眠芯片及外围电路;软件上采用新的路由协议;使路由节点能以选定的休眠唤醒周期进行工作。实验结果表明;该路由节点工作稳定;且具有较低的功耗。
keywords: 休眠唤醒, 低功耗, 无线传感器网络, 路由节点

title: 低功耗热电偶无线传感器节点设计与实现
abstract: 目前工业上测温传感器节点普遍采用有线连接;当传感器节点不断增多时;线缆之间存在严重的磨损;错乱的线缆摆放;为将来维护也带来不便。针对以上问题;设计并开发了一种用于工业温度测量的低功耗热电偶无线传感器节点。在硬件方面;从节点采用模块化设计;由无线通信采集模块;热电偶传感器模块和电源模块组成;在软件方面;非工作模式下从节点采用异步周期性休眠唤醒机制来侦听主控节点命令;使系统具有低功耗的优势;工作模式下主控节点采用轮询的方法依次控制从节点完成数据的采集与发送;保证系统数据传输的稳定可靠。经过实验测试表明;该系统具有数据传输稳定可靠、覆盖面积广、低功耗等优势。
keywords: cc1310, 低功耗, 多节点, 无线传输, 热电偶传感器

title: 基于VPX标准的雷达信号处理平台的设计与实现
abstract: 随着各国的国防科技竞争越来越激烈;传统的雷达信号处理平台架构;已经无法满足目前越来越严格的需求。VPX总线标准不仅实时性强、带宽高、抗恶劣环境能力强;而且具有灵活的拓扑结构、通用性强;非常适合雷达信号处理平台。设计并使用了一种基于VPX标准的6U雷达信号处理平台;包含FPGA（Xilinx V6）、DSP（TMS320C6678）和PowerPC（MPC8640D）3种处理器结合的方式来实现超高速数据处理性能;采用Serial RapidIO、PCIe和RocketIO 3种高速串行总线。各板卡间采用灵活的Serial RapidIO互连;可实现板卡即插即用;具有较强的可扩展性和维修性。不同处理器间可完成数据的高速交换;板卡间传输实际速度达7.8 Gb/s;可满足目前绝大多数雷达信号处理系统的要求。
keywords: vpx标准, 雷达信号处理平台, 高速数据交换
affiliations: 陆军工程大学军械士官学校

title: 一种舰载传感器图像编码实现方法
abstract: 针对舰船传感器视频信号高清化和数字视频总线传输实时化需求;分析多核DSP并行处理和JPEG编码算法的基础上;提出了基于多核DSP的JPEG图像编码实现方法;以TI公司TMS320C6678数字信号处理器为硬件平台;实现了多核DSP核间高效通信和任务级并行处理。实验测试JPEG算法核心组件;优化编码子系统可进一步提升系统处理能力;实验结果表明;基于八核DSP的JPEG编码系统的实时处理能力比单核系统提升了5倍;提高了视频图像压缩效率;满足数字视频总线实时性传输要求。
keywords: jpeg编码, 图像处理, 多核dsp, 数字视频总线
affiliations: 江苏自动化研究所
source: 北大核心;火力与指挥控制

title: 基于DSP的矿用巡检机器人控制系统设计
abstract: 矿用巡检机器人对实现煤矿无人化（或少人化）生产、消除井下监控死角和安全盲区等具有重要应用价值。为了提高稳定性、可靠性和续航能力;开发设计了一种基于浮点型DSP控制器TMS320F28335的巡检机器人控制系统。系统硬件利用模块化设计;降低硬件开发周期和控制系统复杂度;软件利用主程序扫描和外部中断源触发;进一步发挥DSP控制器浮点运算速度快的优势。该系统可实现巡检机器人在井下作业过程中监测信号和数据的高效集中处理;具有实时稳定性强、运行可靠和运算效率高等优点。
keywords: dsp, 巡检机器人, 控制系统, 煤矿
affiliations: 黄淮学院

title: 采用CC3200与微信公众号的智能家居系统
abstract: 为克服智能家居系统受第三方云平台的限制;以及智能手机操作系统带来的APP开发与安装问题;以内置Wi-Fi模块的CC3200作为数据采集与处理核心、自建服务器作为数据存储转发中心、微信公众号作为控制程序;设计并实现Wi-Fi+微信公众号+自建服务器的智能家居系统。系统运行时;CC3200将采集到的数据通过Wi-Fi通信方式上传到自建服务器中;服务器存储接收到的数据;并通过微信服务器进行转发;用户通过微信公众号就可以监测和控制远端的家居环境。测试结果表明;该系统可以稳定地运行在Android或iOS平台的智能手机上;并具有良好的数据安全性和可靠性。
keywords: cc3200, wi-fi, 微信公众号, 智能家居系统, 自建服务器
authors: 纪华志;陈威;冯陈伟;卢先国

title: 基于DSP的高精度电机转速测量系统的设计
abstract: 在工农业生产生活中;大量用到电机的转速测量。随着计算机微电子技术朝着高精度高速发展;对电机转速测量的精度和频率响应要求越来越高。为了达到电机高精度转速测量控制的目的;本文采用数字信号处理器TMS320F28035芯片作为控制核心;以高精度光电编码器为检测元件;设计了基于DSP控制的高精度电机转速测量仪。实验结果表明;该转速测量系统方案可行;实现了转速的测量。
keywords: 光电编码器, 异步串行通信, 数字信号处理器, 正交编码
affiliations: 济源职业技术学院

title: 基于Zigbee客车车内环境系统的设计
abstract: 客车是中国人民日常出行不可或缺的交通工具;车内环境情况应当得到实时掌控。根据掌控的情况做出有效应对;消除可能发生的安全隐患;有效保障人民群众的出行安全。本文为了准确的了解客车车内环境情况;选择使用以CC2530为主控芯片的Zigbee模块;来搭建与设计客车车内环境系统;并设计上位机界面来实现对客车车内环境的自动监测与调控。该系统拥有成本低、网络连接简单快捷、网络运行所需能耗少等特点。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 上位机界面, 客车车内环境
authors: 刘莉;陈子锟;谢应广;雷钦文;彭石林;张云翔

title: 新型动力电池组智能管理系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞此动力电池管理系统以TMS320F2812为控制模块;采用TI公司的bq76PL536A-Q1监视器作为动力电池组的电压、电流与温度的数据采集模块;可实时了解电池组性能及保护;针对动力电池组不一致性带来的不利影响;给出了新的控制策略;并根据bq76PL536A-Q1的特性设计了均衡模块。最后对均衡模块进行了实验验证;结果表明此均衡模块可有效地解决电池组不一致性的问题。磷酸铁锂电池除了具有高能量密度、无记忆效应、自放电率低等优点;它还因不含重金属及稀有金属而对环境无污染。

title: 两相混合式步进电机容错型驱动电路设计
abstract: 该文设计一种具有稳定性容错能力的两相混合式步进电机驱动电路。它在传统的双H桥驱动电路中增加了冗余桥臂;虽然小幅增加硬件成本;但大幅增强其容错能力。详细分析主电路拓扑;并给出正常运行工况的控制框图。为验证所提方案的可行性;利用TI控制器TMS320F28335搭建试验台架。实验样机验证所设计电路的部分功能。

title: 三端口隔离双向DC-DC变换器模型预测控制技术
abstract: 为提高直流微电网中三端口隔离双向DC-DC变换器的动态性能;针对三有源桥（TAB）DC-DC变换器;该文提出一种模型预测控制（MPC）策略。考虑TAB变换器各端口的控制目标;基于移相控制和平均值模型建立TAB变换器离散化预测模型;通过MPC问题最优求解设计预测控制器;以实现端口间的解耦控制效果。进一步分析系统参数偏差对MPC策略控制效果的影响;设计抑制稳态误差的TAB变换器MPC控制方案。基于TMS320F28335+FPGA

title: 基于DSP的大气数据解算卡串行通信接口设计
abstract: 针对现代飞行器在飞行过程中对大气数据参数实时采集处理的要求不断提高;提出一种基于DSP和4通道UART芯片TL16C554A的大气数据解算卡串行通信接口设计方法。解算卡以高性能浮点DSP TMS320C6713为核心处理器;介绍了通信接口硬件电路实现原理和串口通信参数配置方法;详细阐述了外部扩展串口芯片TL16C554A的异步串行通信实现过程;并增加CRC循环冗余校验提高数据传输的准确性和可靠性;通过上位机对接口通信功能进行了测试。测试结果表明:该串行通信接口可实时进行数据传输;数据刷新快;无误码;能够满足大量数据稳定可靠传输的目的。此串行通信接口已成功应用于某FADS系统（嵌入式大气传感系统）;可靠性高;通用性强;具有一定的应用参考价值。

abstract: 基于物联网思想;设计了一种采用ZigBee无线通信技术以CC2530芯片作为各终端节点主控芯片的智能家居系统;实现了终端设备（温湿度终端、气体监测终端、安防终端等）数据信息的采集。通过测试;系统通信基本稳定;能有效实现家居控制的智能化。

title: 双电源转换开关电网信号检测电路设计
abstract: 风能的波动性、间接性和随机性等特性对接入风电的电网运行特性和电能质量（如电压、频率偏差）造成影响。双电源转换开关作为电网中连续供电的一种保障;广泛应用于各种重要负载场合。完成电网信号现场参量及其检测是双电源转换开关的首要任务之一。针对风电机组并网运行中的电网电能质量问题;就双电源转换开关电网信号检测电路分别进行了硬件和软件设计。硬件设计以TMS320F28335数字信号处理器为核心控制模块;利用其内部的模/数转换器和捕获模块对电网中的电压和频率进行检测;软件设计则编写了电压和频率的采样和算法程序。该电网信号检测电路具有采样精度高、硬件成本低、检测算法简单等优点;可以最大化保障重要负载的连续供电。
keywords: 双电源转换开关, 数字信号处理器, 电网, 电网信号检测, 电能质量
affiliations: 湖南工程学院电气与信息工程学院,  闽光电气实业有限公司

title: 基于物联网的智能天气识别系统设计
abstract: 文中将传感技术、无线传输技术和Scikit-learn相结合;设计一种基于物联网的智能天气识别系统;可实时播报天气情况。该系统采用DS18B20测温模块、DHT11湿度采集模块收集温湿度信息;通过Arduino UNO R3开发板采集天气信息;由CC2530模块将采集到的温度、湿度信息通过无线网络传输给上位机;通过上位机的Scikit-learn训练模型实现对天气状况的实时识别。实验表明;所提系统可获取当前小范围地区较精确的天气信息;实验结果良好。
keywords: arduino uno r3, scikit-learn, 信息采集, 天气识别, 机器学习, 物联网

title: 基于TMS320F28335的三相PWM变流器设计与实现
abstract: 为了分布式光伏发电以储能微电网的形式接入到本地电网中并加以利用;设计制作了一套基于DSP处理器的并网型变流器.以TMS320F28335作为系统主控芯片;同时采用空间矢量脉宽调制（SVPWM）控制算法;通过软件和硬件的结合在代码编译器（CCS）和DSP平台上进行了调试和试验验证.实验结果表明该变流器可以稳定、快速、高功率因数输出三相交流电能.该变流器在光伏发电储能微电网领域有较好的发展前景.
keywords: dsp, svpwm, tms320f28335, 变流器
authors: 范丽波;高帅;王鹏;黄日帆;杨龙团;顾波
affiliations: 许昌学院电气工程学院,  华北水利水电大学电力学院

title: 基于FPGA与STM32的多通道数据采集系统
abstract: 为了实现对水声信号的采集与存储;并针对声呐系统水下接收系统对多通道、高精度、低功耗、小体积的技术要求;设计了一种基于FPGA和STM32的工作通道数量和采样频率可变的多通道信号采集存储系统。该系统采用8块8通道24 bit高动态范围的Δ-Σ型ADC芯片ADS1278对多路模拟信号进行同步采集. FPGA作为采集时序及逻辑控制;读取并整理ADC芯片数据;写入内部一位大容量FIFO;并根据FIFO在实际应用中的特性增加相应的操作。SMT32单片机通过与FPGA的高速SPI接口;读取FIFO数据并检测数据检验位;最终将数据写入大容量SD卡中。经实验测试;该系统具有稳定可靠、配置方便、低功耗等特点;可以保证多通道数据的串行传输、存储准确无误。最多可同时对64路模拟信号进行实时采集存储;最高采样率20 kHz;系统总功率约为3 W;数据率最高可达100 Mb/s;完全满足水声采集系统的需求。
keywords: fpga, stm32, 多通道, 数据采集, 高精度
affiliations: 西北工业大学航海学院

title: 基于ZigBee技术的家居环境多参数监测系统研究
abstract: 针对传统智能家居存在的问题;本文研究一种基于ZigBee技术的低功耗、低成本家庭网关无线接入系统;采用STM32F103RCT6单片机作为硬件控制平台;结合供电模块、时钟模块和EEPROM模块等外围电路;来完成智能家居网关系统的组建。ZigBee部分采用主芯片为CC2530的无线通信模块;WiFi部分采用功能实用的ESP8266通信模块;实现对家居环境的实时监控。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 智能家居, 环境监测

title: 基于DSP的电器鸣叫音自动识别系统
abstract: 长期在噪声环境下采用人耳检测蜂鸣器的鸣叫音;易产生听觉疲劳、判断错误;因此;本文设计了基于TI公司的浮点型DSP-TMS320F28335的电器鸣叫音自动识别系统。采用FIR带通滤波器对信号进行滤波;利用FFT提取频谱特征;基于最大相似度进行分类。利用DMA模块设计了乒乓缓存器;保证了实时采集和信号处理同步进行。实验表明:本文的算法可以实现鸣叫音模式的正确识别;且具备FISHER准则的典型特征。
keywords: fft, fir带通滤波, tms320f28335, 乒乓缓存, 模式识别
affiliations: 惠而浦(中国)全球研发中心,  安徽建筑大学电子与信息工程学院

title: 基于AM3359微处理器的信号发生器的设计
abstract: 信号发生器在许多科技领域有重要应用;如在控制系统和工业自动化产业中应用都非常广泛;已经是一种不可或缺的重要设备。本文介绍了一款基于AM3359微处理器的信号发生器的设计;实现多种标准信号输出:电流频率、电压频率、模拟电流、模拟电压等。该设计可以对市面上大多数仪表进行计量。为用户提供了一种更加方便、可靠的测试方式。
keywords: ad420芯片, am3359, 信号发生器
affiliations: 郴州职业技术学院

title: 基于ZigBee的农田智能灌溉系统研究设计
abstract: 基于ZigBee技术设计了农田智能灌溉系统。该系统通过霍尔流量传感器、水温传感器等多种传感器采集灌溉水流信息;利用ZigBee无线传感网络实现通信;设计了MFC上位机界面实时显示灌溉水流信息;方便工作人员查看、控制。该系统具有功耗低、精度高、使用和维护便捷、易于扩展等优点;能够精确控制灌溉水流速度;实时显示灌溉水流速度、流量、温度等信息;基本能够满足当前灌溉行业的复杂需求。
keywords: cc2530, mfc上位机, zigbee技术, 无线传感器网络, 智能灌溉系统
affiliations: 河南省高校节能照明工程技术研究中心,  三门峡职业技术学院

title: 基于DSP的智能电源控制单元设计与实现
abstract: 本文利用TI公司TMS320F28335芯片高效的浮点运算能力;结合片上丰富的外设;设计并实现了一种具有高可靠性的智能电源控制单元。该控制单元周期性地对各片上外设进行自检维护;完成多路负载通道控制、电压、电流的实时监控;并对故障进行指示、处理和上报;同时提供人机交互界面更新状态信息。经过验证;该控制单元工作稳定;具备良好的工程应用价值。
keywords: dsp控制, 故障隔离, 智能电源, 自检测
affiliations: 航空工业西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 一种新能源汽车充电桩控制系统设计方案
abstract: 本文从电动汽车直流充电桩的具体要求出发;设计了一种人机交互界面友好、运行稳定可靠、能实现双枪同时充电的直流充电桩控制系统。该控制系统主要分为两个部分:计费控制单元和充电设备控制器。计费控制单元作为整个系统的控制中心;采用了TI公司的32位微处理器TMS320F28335作为主控芯片。通过RS485通信采集电能表的信息并在触摸屏上进行显示;同时具备IC卡读卡及结算功能。通过向充电设备控制器下发开始充电或停止充电相关指令来间接控制整个充电流程;同时接收充电设备控制器上传的电压、电流、SOC及报警等实时信息来进行控制和显示。最后对整个控制系统做了相关实验及测试;测试数据表明该直流充电桩控制系统运行稳定、操作方便;达到了预期设计目的。
keywords: can, tms320f28335, 控制系统, 直流充电桩
affiliations: 青岛黄海学院, 青岛科技大学

title: 基于CC2530的ZigBee通信网络的应用设计分析
abstract: 本文以CC2530芯片为基础;分别从硬件、天线设计、软件设计;对ZigBee无线传感通信网络进行设计;望能为此领域设计研究提供些许借鉴。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 设计, 通信网络

title: 智能侦察机器人运动控制系统设计
abstract: 本文介绍了采用DSP TMS320F28335为核心控制器的智能侦察机器人运动控制系统设计。该机器人实现外界环境温度数据采集、光照信息采集、运动控制、显示器控制等功能。论文主要研究了智能侦察机器人的整体构建和设计实现;包括DSP F28335为核心的控制器软硬件设计、电机驱动电路、舵机云台控制电路、DC-DC变换、传感器电路等;电机控制采用PID增量型算法;取得了较好的控制效果。
keywords: dsp, pid算法, 云台, 机器人, 直流减速电机
affiliations: 国家知识产权局专利局专利审查协作天津中心,  国家天津市电力公司东丽供电分公司

title: 基于DSP在线程序加载的研究与实现
abstract: 随着现代数字控制技术的发展;数字信号处理器（DSP）得到了广泛应用。程序通过JTAG下载的方式对交付后使用的产品进行软件升级极为不便;需要拆卸开盖操作;人力、物力耗费较大;效率低。因此;针对DSP的在线程序加载技术进行深入研究;实现了产品不脱离系统即可程序加载;具有很强的实用性。研究基于DSP芯片采用TMS320F2812开展;通过通信总线实现在线加载。利用现有产品进行实验验证;结果表明提出的DSP在线加载技术可以实现在不对产品进行拆卸的情况下在线升级DSP程序;不仅提高了工作效率;而且大大降低了产品的维护成本。
keywords: dsp, 在线加载, 通信总线
affiliations: 四川长虹电源有限责任公司

title: 一种多制式通信信号处理模块的设计
abstract: 为了满足军事通信系统对无线电台多制式通信的需求;设计了一种基于多核DSP TMS320C6678的多制式通信信号处理模块;采用主从处理模型进行并行设计;采用本地模式和远程模式进行动态重构设计;以并行处理技术和可重构技术为核心进行研究;并对该模块进行测试;使用开发工具CCS对多核DSP中各核处理数据进行跟踪;其波形显示多核同时进行着各自的任务;并对核x进行数据跟踪;其波形显示核x数据发生改变。结果表明:该模块实现了多种调制解调方式的并发执行;达到无线电台多制式通信需求;实现了调制解调方式的动态重构;达到无线电台的可扩展性和兼容性需求。本文的设计简化了电台硬件结构;促进了各种电台之间的相互兼容和通信。
keywords: dsp, 动态重构, 多制式通信信号, 并行处理, 无线电台

title: 基于CC1200的无线测控电台设计与实现
abstract: 随着无线通信技术的广泛应用;高集成度、抗干扰能力强的无线测控技术越来越受到人们的重视。设计了一种基于TI公司推出的无线射频收发芯片CC1200和FPGA的无线测控电台;介绍了总体方案设计;主要分为无线收发系统的方案设计和基带信号处理设计;最终实现了整机的硬件板卡和软件程序的设计。结果表明整机在实际应用场景下;满足各项参数指标要求;具有一定的工程实践价值。
keywords: cc1200, fpga, 无线测控, 电台

title: 基于DSP的弧压采集与弧长跟踪控制系统的设计与研究
abstract: 设计了一套适用于TIG焊多种电弧类型的弧长跟踪控制系统;该系统以TMS320F28335作为主控芯片。通过DSP的ADC功能模块;采集焊接过程中电焊机输出端电压信号;经过硬件电路及软件算法进行数据多级滤波处理。通过DSP的eQEP功能模块与XC3S250E配合完成电机位置、方向和速度的闭环控制。通过DSP的SCI功能模块与PLC实现信息交互;最终实现弧长跟踪及高效焊接控制。通过多种TIG焊试验验证;弧长跟踪及控制效果良好;达到预期的焊接效果。
keywords: dsp, tig焊, 弧长跟踪, 滤波处理

title: 基于dsp的多通道数据采集系统的设计
abstract: 针对DSP内部AD采样电路精度低等问题;设计了一种以AD7606高精度实时的模数转换器;进行采集交流信号;并介绍分析了AD7606得硬件电路和软件设计。最后通过实验对比了DSP TMS320F28335内部AD和AD7606这两种模数转换得精度;相对于DSP TMS320F28335内部AD;AD7606具有采样精度更高;误差小;能够高速采样;适用于永磁同步电机的数据得采集转换。
keywords: ad7606, 硬件电路, 高速采样
affiliations: 曲阜师范大学

title: 基于ZigBee和树莓派的个人气象系统设计与实现
abstract: 本文基于ZigBee无线传感网;树莓派设计了一款个人气象系统。该系统选择温湿度;雨量;光照传感器对环境参数进行实时的采集与存储。系统利用CC2530射频芯片完成Zigbee协议功能;结合ESP8266作为网关将数据传给树莓派;树莓派作为服务器实现对相关数据的存储。用户通过访问树莓派即可实时掌握天气的变化情况。实验结果表明;该系统能实现一定的环境监测;可扩展的范围广。
keywords: esp8266, zigbee, 传感器, 局域网, 树莓派
affiliations: 东北石油大学计算机与信息技术学院

title: 基于DSP与ZigBee的电缆绝缘状态监测系统设计
abstract: 工矿开采设备在较为恶劣的环境中长期运转易造成电缆绝缘老化;通过检测电缆绝缘状态可排除安全隐患。传统绝缘状态监测系统大多采用有线方式;布线难度大。因此设计一种基于DSP与ZigBee技术的绝缘状态实时无线监测系统。该系统采用TMS320F28335为主控器;对采集的电压和电流信号进行同相计算;并将计算得到的电阻值通过串口传送给ZigBee模块进行压缩打包;通过多跳方式传送至监测终端进行显示、存储并发出预警信息。系统软件部分采用C语言设计实现。测试结果表明;该系统检测精度高、实时性好;具有一定的应用价值。
keywords: tms320f28335, zigbee, 实时监测, 绝缘状态
authors: 赵爽;李梦轲;孙中皋;王新军
affiliations: 辽宁师范大学物理与电子技术学院

title: 基于DSP的智能车控制系统设计
abstract: 本文设计的智能小车控制系统以TMS320F2812 DSP芯片为控制核心;采用模块化结构设计;通过混合多种传感器实时采集道路信息;光电编码器检测智能车车速;PID控制算法调节智能车的运行方向和速度;完成了对智能小车运行的实时控制。通过试验;实现了智能小车在预定车道上的自主寻迹。
keywords: pid, 智能车, 自主寻迹

title: 基于DSP的矿用巡检机器人控制系统设计
abstract: 矿用巡检机器人对实现煤矿无人化（或少人化）生产、消除井下监控死角和安全盲区等具有重要应用价值。为了提高稳定性、可靠性和续航能力开发设计了一种基于浮点型DSP控制器TMS320F28335的巡检机器人控制系统。系统硬件利用模块化设计降低硬件开发周期和控制系统复杂度软件利用主程序扫描和外部中断源触发进一步发挥DSP控制器浮点运算速度快的优势。该系统可实现巡检机器人在井下作业过程中监测信号和数据的高效集中处理具有实时稳定性强、运行可靠和运算效率高等优点。
keywords: dsp, 巡检机器人, 控制系统, 煤矿

title: 基于ZigBee无线网络的应变数据采集系统
abstract: 针对传统应力应变数据传输距离有限、布线复杂、线路易老化等问题设计了一种基于ZigBee无线网络的应变数据采集系统。ZigBee无线网络的引入使得整个系统易操作、简单化极大地提高了应变信号的传输距离且数据保持高线性度、高精确性多次实验的非线性误差均保持在0.3%以下。在某型号监测系统实际应用表明ZigBee无线网络的应变数据采集系统应该具有更加广泛的应用前景。

title: Study on the Design and Development of Motor Microcomputer Protection Platform Based on DSP(TMS320F2812)
abstract_in_chinese: 通过对电动机微机保护原理的分析研究;设计开发一种基于DSP的新型电动机综合保护平台;目的在于依托数字信号处理器(DSP)强大的运算能力和控制能力;检测电机运行过程中出现的各种故障类型;并对电机运行进行较为全面的保护。平台以TI公司生产的32位DSP(TMS320F2812)作为核心;在微机保护平台硬件和软件设计方面均采用模块化设计思路;以电机保护功能为设计指标;对各模块单元均采用了自顶向下;分层设计的方法;为电机微机保护领域提供了一种自动化程度高、反应迅速、抗干扰能力强、性能可靠的设计方案。

title: Design of Wireless Watt-Hour Meter Data Acquisition System Based on Zigbee
abstract: In order to realize the remote acquisition of power grid operation data and remote real-time monitoring of the operation status of watt-hour meters;a wireless watt-hour meter data acquisition system based on Zigbee technology was designed.The wireless solution of the system terminal and the design of the wireless watt-hour meter based on CC2530 development platform was introduced.The wireless terminal was mainly used to perform data acquisition;data display and wireless transmission.Considering the construction efficiency and scalability of system network;Zigbee technology was mainly adopted in the wireless scheme of the data acquisition system to set up the network;complete the transmission and aggregation of the data collected by the wireless meter;and uploading it to remote host computer through GPRS network.Experiments showed that the system could gather and upload multi-terminal data stably and efficiently.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决电网营运数据的远程采集;实现电能表运行状态的远程实时监控;设计了一种基于Zigbee的无线电能表数据采集系统。详细介绍了系统终端的无线解决方案;并在CC2530模块开发平台上完成了系统终端无线电能表的设计。该无线终端主要完成电量的数据采集、显示和无线传输功能。考虑到整个系统的网络组建效率和网络的可扩展性;数据采集系统的无线方案实现主要采用Zigbee技术进行网络搭建;完成无线电能表采集数据的传输和汇总;最终通过GPRS模块将数据上传到远程上位机。试验证明;该系统能够稳定地采集多路终端数据;并上传数据;满足了电能表数据远程采集和上传的需求。

title: Design of RDDV Valve Controller Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: Rotary direct drive valve is a kind of servo valve. It is used to directly drive the sliding valve of servo valve through the eccentric mechanism of the motor and realize the high-precision detection of the position of the valve core;thus controlling the flow rate. This paper designs a rotary direct drive servo valve controller based on TMS320F28335. Using digital control technology;the hardware and software of the controller are designed and tested. The results show that the controller is characteristic of simple circuit structure;fast operation speed and flexible control.
abstract_in_chinese: 旋转直接驱动阀是伺服阀的一种;它通过电机的偏心机构直接驱动伺服阀的滑阀;还能实现阀芯位置的高精度检测;从而控制流量。设计了一种基于TMS320F28335的旋转直接驱动伺服阀控制器;运用数字控制技术;对控制器进行硬件和软件设计;并进行试验验证。结果表明;控制器具有电路结构简单、运算速度快、控制灵活的特点。
keywords: controller, design, servo valve, tms320f28335

title: Development of Gearbox Wireless Monitoring System Based on STM32 and Zigbee
abstract: At present; most of the traditional monitoring systems for gearbox use wired data transmission for monitoring; while the traditional monitoring system is prone to the phenomenon of monitoring and management disconnection. Aiming at these problems;a coordinator composed of stm32f103c8t6 and CC2530 with 32-bit Cortex-M3 core is designed. Through the construction of ZigBee wireless local area network; the information collected by the sensor is sent to the upper computer monitoring interface in real time.The experimental results show that compared with the traditional monitoring method; wireless monitoring can improve the stability of monitoring to the greatest extent in the same efficiency; so as to provide a feasible scheme for wireless monitoring of gearbox.
abstract_in_chinese: 目前针对齿轮箱的传统监测系统多数都是采用有线数据传输的方式进行监测;而传统的有线监测距离短、成本高、灵活性差。针对这些问题设计了一种以32位Cortex-M3内核STM32F103C8T6和CC2530组成无线收发模块;通过构建Zigbee无线局域网络的形式;将传感器采集到的信息实时发送到上位机监测界面。实验结果表明;该无线监测系统工作稳定;能够实时掌握齿轮箱的运行状态;相较于传统有线监测在一定程度上扩大了监测距离;为齿轮箱的无线监测手段提出一种可行的方案。
keywords: gearbox, stm32, wireless monitoring, zigbee technology

title: Smart Home System Based on CC3200 and WeChat Official Account
abstract: In order to achieve home intelligence beyond the limit of third-party cloud platform;a smart home system based on CC3200 and WeChat official account was designed and implemented;where a CC3200 with built-in Wi-Fi functioned as the data collecter and processor;a self-built server as the data storage and forwarder;and a WeChat official account as the data controller. Data collected is transferred through Wi-Fi by CC3200 to the self-built server;the server stores the data and forwards the data to the WeChat official account;and users can then monitor and control the home environment remotely through the WeChat official account. The test results show that the system can be run on a smartphone based on Android or iOS platform stably;and the data can be transmitted securely and reliably.
abstract_in_chinese: 为克服智能家居系统受第三方云平台的限制;以及智能手机操作系统带来的APP开发与安装问题;以内置Wi-Fi模块的CC3200作为数据采集与处理核心、自建服务器作为数据存储转发中心、微信公众号作为控制程序;设计并实现Wi-Fi+微信公众号+自建服务器的智能家居系统。系统运行时;CC3200将采集到的数据通过Wi-Fi通信方式上传到自建服务器中;服务器存储接收到的数据;并通过微信服务器进行转发;用户通过微信公众号就可以监测和控制远端的家居环境。测试结果表明;该系统可以稳定地运行在Android或iOS平台的智能手机上;并具有良好的数据安全性和可靠性。
keywords: cc3200, self-built server, smart home, wechat official account, wi-fi

title: Design of low cost environmental parameter acquisition terminal based on CC2530
abstract: With the development of modern agriculture; accurate environmental parameter monitoring is the premise to realize the transformation from traditional agriculture to intelligent agriculture and smart agriculture. This article addresses the many options currently used to monitor the agricultural environment;the optimization design idea of using only CC2530 as a single processor is put forward; and the ZigBee protocol stack is developed again while environmental parameters are processed; thus achieving lower economic cost and higher reliability.Test results show that with a PA amplifier acquisition terminal transmission distance up to 80 meters to 120 meters can collect temperature; humidity; illumination and CO2 concentration; transport a complete information collected every 10 minutes; other time auto sleep; only use number 5 dry battery can work for about 8 months; providing a low-cost; highly practical technical product for the cultivation of farmers’ intelligent greenhouses.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着现代农业的収展;精准的环境参数监测是实现传统农业到智能农业以及智慧农业转变的前提。针对目前监测农业环境的众多方案;提出了仅用CC2530作为单处理器的优化设计思想;在处理环境参数的同时对ZigBee协议栈二次开収;实现了更低经济成本和更高的可靠性。测试结果表明;一个带PA放大的采集终端传输距离可达80～120 m;可采集温度;湿度;光照度及CO2浓度;每10 min传输一次完整的采集信息;其它时间自动休眠;仅利用两节5号干电池即可工作8个月左右;为农户智能大棚的种植提供了低成本、高实用性的技术产品。
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, intelligent agriculture, zigbee protocol stack

title: Design of Data Acquisition and Control System Based on MicroPython and CC3200 for Smart Home
abstract: In order to solve the inconvenience caused by the coexistence of various network communication protocols in the development of smart home applications;and to better realize the smart home;a smart home data acquisition and control system based on MicroPython and CC3200 is designed. The system uses CC3200 as the working node;obtains the data collected by the system through the WeChat official account and OneNet platform;and makes judgment and corresponding processing in the cloud server;which solves the problem of coexistence of various network communication protocols;and realizes the data acquisition and control function of smart home. Experimental results show that the system runs steadily;has a good human-computer interaction experience;and has high practical application value.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决多种网络通信协议共存给智能家居应用开发带来的不便;更好地实现家居的智能化;基于MicroPython和CC3200设计了一种智能家居数据采集与控制系统。该系统采用CC3200作为工作节点;通过微信公众号和OneNet平台获取系统采集的数据;并在云服务器中进行判断和相应处理;较好地解决了多种网络通信协议共存的问题;实现了智能家居数据采集与控制功能。实验测试结果表明:系统运行稳定;有较好的人机交互体验;具有较高的实际应用价值。

title: Temperature Monitoring System for Wireless Sensor Network Distribution Room Based on FDSI
abstract: In the paper;FDSI network distribution room environment temperature monitoring system is designed based on wireless sensor node dynamic sampling strategy.The system is composed of DS18 B20 temperature sensor;MSP430 MCU and CC1101 data transmission module.The temperature data is collected and transmitted by adaptive dynamic sampling strategy.The test results prove that the system realizes the real-time monitoring of the ambient temperature of the distribution room and has the advantages of low energy consumption;good stability;low information loss rate.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了基于自适应动态采样策略的无线传感器网络配电室环境温度监测系统。该系统由DS18B20温度传感器、MSP430单片机、CC1101数据发送模块组成;采用自适应动态采样策略采集温度数据和发送温度数据。试验结果表明;该系统能准确实时监测配电室环境温度;且具有能耗低、稳定性好、信息丢失率低等优点。

title: Design of environment monitoring and diagnosis system for evaporative duct
abstract: In order to obtain the meteorological and hydrological parameters of the air-sea boundary layer in real time and calculate the profile of modified refractivity index;so as to evaluate the influence of the evaporation duct on the electromagnetic wave propagation on the spot;an environment monitoring and diagnosis system for the evaporation duct is designed. The system is based on ZigBee technology for multi-sensor networking; which can measure temperature; humidity and air pressure parameters at different altitudes. The adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to calculate the measurement terminal posture;and the height and strength parameters of the evaporative duct are quickly acquired by calculation. Thus;the system has the advantages of high real-time performance and wide measurement range. The experimental results show that the system can meet the measurement requirements under normal sea conditions and provides a new hardware-based method for real-time monitoring and diagnosis of evaporation duct environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实时获取海气分界层气象水文参数;计算修正折射率指数廓线从而现场评估蒸发波导对海上电磁波的传播影响;设计了蒸发波导环境监测与诊断系统。该系统基于ZigBee技术进行多传感器组网;可以测量不同高度层的温度、湿度、气压参数;采用自适应卡尔曼滤波算法解算测量终端姿态;通过计算快速获取蒸发波导高度、强度参数;具有实时性强、测量范围广等优势。实验结果表明;一般海况下该系统可以满足测量要求;为蒸发波导环境实时监测与诊断提供了新的硬件方法。
keywords: adaptive kalman filtering algorithm, cc2530, evaporation duct, meteorological data collection, modified refractivity index, sensor network, zigbee

title: Design and Implementation of Wireless Telemetry and Telecontrol Radio Based on CC1200
abstract: With the wide application of wireless communication technology;wireless telemetry and telecontrol technology with high integration and strong anti-interference capability has attracted more and more attention.A wireless telemetry and telecontrol radio based on TI’s wireless RF transceiver chip CC1200 and FPGA is designed.The overall scheme design is introduced.It is divided into two parts:the scheme design of the wireless transceiver system and the baseband signal processing design.Finally;the design of the hardware board and software program of the whole system is realized.The results show that the whole system meets the requirements of various parameters in the actual application scenario and provides a reference for engineering practices.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着无线通信技术的广泛应用;高集成度、抗干扰能力强的无线测控技术越来越受到人们的重视。设计了一种基于TI公司推出的无线射频收发芯片CC1200和FPGA的无线测控电台;介绍了总体方案设计;主要分为无线收发系统的方案设计和基带信号处理设计;最终实现了整机的硬件板卡和软件程序的设计。结果表明整机在实际应用场景下;满足各项参数指标要求;具有一定的工程实践价值。

title: 基于ZigBee远程通信的水质监测系统设计
abstract: ZigBee is widely used in various fields due to its advantages such as low power consumption; low cost; short time delay; high security and AD hoc network. In this paper; CC2530 is used as the communication chip and STMF103 as the main control chip as the hardware circuit and software part of the system. The information of conductivity module; p H module and DS18B20 temperature module is transmitted to the upper computer; and ZigBee AD hoc network can be used to read the information of water bodies at different positions in a sea area on the upper computer. The experimental results show that the water quality monitoring produced in this paper has the advantages of low power consumption and high real-time performance.

keywords: ad-hoc network, water quality monitoring, zigbee

title: 基于单片机的智能家居照明控制系统设计
abstract: With the advent of the digital age; people have put forward higher requirements for their own quality of life. People's pursuit and dependence on smart home is ever-growing; and the advantages of smart lighting are increasingly prominent. The smart lighting control system combines various advanced intelligent control technologies and embedded technologies. The design of this paper is based on CC2530 single-chip microcomputer; combined with sensor information detection and data processing technology; using C/C++ embedded development to realize the control of lighting equipment in different modes.

title: 基于ZigBee无线网络的应变数据采集系统
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional stress-strain data transmission distance;complicated wiring and aging of the line;a strain data acquisition system based on ZigBee wireless network was designed.The introduction of ZigBee wireless network made the whole system easy to operate and simplistic;greatly improved the transmission distance of strain signals;and the data maintained high linearity and high accuracy.The nonlinear errors of many experiments were kept below 0.3%.The practical application of a certain type of monitoring system show that the strain data acquisition system of Zig Bee wireless network should have a wider application prospect.

abstract: In order to obtain the meteorological and hydrological parameters of the air-sea boundary layer in real time and calculate the profile of modified refractivity index;so as to evaluate the influence of the evaporation duct on the electromagnetic wave propagation on the spot;an environment monitoring and diagnosis system for the evaporation duct is designed. The system is based on ZigBee technology for multi-sensor networking; which can measure temperature; humidity and air pressure parameters at different altitudes. The adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to calculate the measurement terminal posture;and the height and strength parameters of the evaporative duct are quickly acquired by calculation. Thus;the system has the advantages of high real-time performance and wide measurement range. The experimental results show that the system can meet the measurement requirements under normal sea conditions and provides a new hardware-based method for real-time monitoring and diagnosis of evaporation duct environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实时获取海气分界层气象水文参数;计算修正折射率指数廓线从而现场评估蒸发波导对海上电磁波的传播影响;设计了蒸发波导环境监测与诊断系统。该系统基于ZigBee技术进行多传感器组网;可以测量不同高度层的温度、湿度、气压参数;采用自适应卡尔曼滤波算法解算测量终端姿态;通过计算快速获取蒸发波导高度、强度参数;具有实时性强、测量范围广等优势。实验结果表明;一般海况下该系统可以满足测量要求;为蒸发波导环境实时监测与诊断提供了新的硬件方法。
keywords: adaptive kalman filtering algorithm, cc2530, evaporation duct, meteorological data collection, modified refractivity index, sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: 国家海洋技术中心, National Ocean Technology Center

title: 混合型分簇MAC协议在无线传感器网络中的实现
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the MAC protocol research still mostly remains in the stage of software simulation;a hybrid MAC protocol suitable for two-layer wireless sensor networks was designed;and hardware simulation was realized by means of nodes. The threshold service mode is adopted within the cluster. After receiving the wake-up notification;each node sends data in sequence according to the polling list issued by the cluster head in order to realize collision-free communication. Random multiple accesses are adopted among clusters;and each cluster head randomly contends for a channel to send data to the sink node. The protocol is designed based on Z-Stack;and the wireless sensor network is built by CC2530 node to realize the protocol finally. The experimental results show that the system using this protocol can operate correctly;and the experimental values of throughput;average delay and average queue length are in line with the theoretical values.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对当前MAC协议的研究大多停留在软件仿真阶段的问题;设计一种适用于两层无线传感器网络的混合型MAC协议;并利用节点实现硬件仿真。簇内采用门限服务方式;各节点接到唤醒通知后;依据簇头发布的轮询列表;按照顺序发送数据;实现无冲突通信。簇间采用随机多址接入;各簇头随机争用信道;向汇聚节点发送数据。基于Z-Stack进行协议设计;最后利用CC2530节点搭建无线传感器网络;实现该协议。实验结果表明;使用该协议的系统能够正确运行;吞吐量和平均时延、平均排队队长的实验值与理论值一致。
keywords: hardware simulation, mac protocol design, polling service, random multi-access, threshold service, wsn
authors: ZHANG Yingjie;DING Hongwei;XIONG Chengbiao;YANG Jundong;DONG Fazhi
affiliations: School of Information Science and Engineering, 云南大学信息学院, Yunnan University

title: 基于CC1200的无线测控电台设计与实现
abstract: With the wide application of wireless communication technology;wireless telemetry and telecontrol technology with high integration and strong anti-interference capability has attracted more and more attention.A wireless telemetry and telecontrol radio based on TI’s wireless RF transceiver chip CC1200 and FPGA is designed.The overall scheme design is introduced.It is divided into two parts:the scheme design of the wireless transceiver system and the baseband signal processing design.Finally;the design of the hardware board and software program of the whole system is realized.The results show that the whole system meets the requirements of various parameters in the actual application scenario and provides a reference for engineering practices.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着无线通信技术的广泛应用;高集成度、抗干扰能力强的无线测控技术越来越受到人们的重视。设计了一种基于TI公司推出的无线射频收发芯片CC1200和FPGA的无线测控电台;介绍了总体方案设计;主要分为无线收发系统的方案设计和基带信号处理设计;最终实现了整机的硬件板卡和软件程序的设计。结果表明整机在实际应用场景下;满足各项参数指标要求;具有一定的工程实践价值。
keywords: cc1200, fpga, radio, wireless telemetry and telecontrol
affiliations: North China University of Technology, College of Electronic Information Engineering, 北方工业大学电子信息工程学院

title: 基于ZigBee的物联网智能家居系统的设计与实现
abstract: Based on the idea of Internet of Things; a smart home system using ZigBee wireless communication technology and CC2530 chip as the main control chip of each terminal node is designed. The data acquisition of terminal equipment(temperature and humidity terminal; gas monitoring terminal; security terminal and etc.) can be realized. Through the test; the communication of the system is basically stable; which can effectively realize the intelligence of home control.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于物联网思想;设计了一种采用ZigBee无线通信技术以CC2530芯片作为各终端节点主控芯片的智能家居系统;实现了终端设备(温湿度终端、气体监测终端、安防终端等)数据信息的采集。通过测试;系统通信基本稳定;能有效实现家居控制的智能化。
keywords: internet of things, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: Information Media Institute, 三门峡职业技术学院信息传媒学院

title: 某船用保护装置现场测试系统的设计
abstract: Based on the design concepts of modularization; miniaturization; versatility and expandability; the high-precision multi-channel signal acquisition and output system is designed. By applying advanced chips such as ADS1256 and DAC8830; the technological advancement and integration degree of the system are improved. For the problem of signal input and output diversity of the measured object; a highly adaptable signal processing circuit is designed Up to 4 analog signal output channels and 4 analog signal measurement channels have been designed to improve the scalability of the test system.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于模块化、小型化、通用性、可拓展性等设计理念;设计了该测试系统。通过应用ADS1256、DAC8830等先进芯片;提高了系统的技术先进性和集成化程度针对被测对象信号输入输出多样性的问题;设计了适应性极高的信号处理电路采取冗余设计思想;设计了多达4路模拟信号输出通道和4路模拟信号测量通道;提高了测试系统的可拓展性。
keywords: ads1256, dac8830, redundant design, signal processing
affiliations: 海军工程大学核科学技术学院, Naval University of Engineering Nuclear Science and Technology

title: 基于ZigBee和ESP8266的远程灌溉控制平台设计
abstract: In order to facilitate farmers to use mobile terminals to view soil data; determine public opinion; control water pump irrigation of farmland; away from live equipment; and save labor time; this paper designs a remote irrigation control platform based on ZigBee and ESP8266. The irrigation control platform uses the CC2530 single-chip microcomputer as the controller to establish the coordinator and sensor node. In the coordinator; the ESP8266 communicates with the CC2530 through the serial port. The coordinator collects farmland data through the sensor node and sends it to the mobile terminal. The mobile terminal controls the ESP8266 through the wireless local area network to achieve the irrigation function of CC2530. The test results show that the irrigation control platform works stably and the communication is reliable. The mobile terminal can display the soil data in real time; and can flexibly control the opening of the water pump to realize the function of the remote irrigation control platform.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了便于农户使用移动终端查看土壤数据;判断墒情;控制水泵灌溉农田;远离带电设备;节约劳作时间;本文设计了基于ZigBee和ESP8266的远程灌溉控制平台。该灌溉控制平台采用CC2530单片机作为控制器组建协调器和传感器节点;在协调器中ESP8266通过串口与CC2530进行通信;协调器通过传感器节点采集农田数据发送给移动终端;移动终端通过无线局域网控制ESP8266进而实现CC2530的灌溉功能。试验结果表明;该灌溉控制平台工作稳定;通信可靠;移动终端能够实时显示土壤数据;可以灵活控制水泵的开启;实现了远程灌溉控制平台的功能。
keywords: esp8266, irrigation control platform, zigbee
affiliations: School of Information and Electronics Technology, 佳木斯大学信息电子技术学院, Jiamusi University

title: 实时控制技术满足实时工业通信发展的需求——第4部分
abstract_in_chinese: 本系列博客文章的第1部分介绍了用于C2000TM微控制器（MCU）的EtherCAT从站堆栈解决方案的市场机遇;以及从站堆栈开发快速入门的三个阶段指南。第2部分详细说明了TI C2000 MCU EtherCAT实施的特点和优势。第3部分分别介绍了使用EtherCAT从站和C2000 Delfino MCU controlCARD套件自行开发从站节点应用程序的三个阶段;并介绍了TI C2000 controlSUITETM软件中的EtherCAT包如何为每个阶段提供支持。本篇博文作为本系列文章的第4部分将介绍如何利用最新的C2000 TMS320F28388D实时控制器自行开发EtherCAT从站控制器。

title: 煤矿特种防爆车辆VTC650用SRM牵引控制系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high failure rate; difficult maintenance and small starting torque of DC motor and asynchronous motor commonly used in traction motor of underground accumulator car in coal mine; a scheme of replacing the traction motor with switched reluctance motor; a SRM speed control system based on DSP TMS320 F28335 and resolver as speed and position detection is designed.The system has been successfully applied to the traction transformation of VTC650 carrier truck; which improves the reliability and stability of the whole machine.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对煤矿井下蓄电池车常用直流电机、异步电机作为牵引电机中存在的故障率高、维护困难、起动转矩小等问题;采用SRM替代原牵引系统电机的方案;设计了1套基于数字信号处理器TMS320F28335为控制核心;以旋转变压器作为速度位置检测的开关磁阻电机调速系统;将该系统成功应用于VTC650支架搬运车的牵引改造;提高了整机的可靠性和稳定性。
keywords: bracket carrier, dsp, resolver, srm

title: 基于Zigbee的无线安防监控系统设计
abstract: 本文选择了CC2530微控制器作为无线通信的核心板芯片;并选用LHI778这款红外传感器实时监测指定区域的入侵状态。利用Zigbee无线通信协议将实时状态信息进行无线传送至协调器;并利用LCD显示器在终端节点进行实时状态信息的显示;最后选用RS232串口通信协议把实时状态信息传送到协调器节点上。设计了完整的硬件拓扑电路结构;选用最新的图形化软件编写环境Labview编写了简单实用的图形化上位机界面。整个设计开发出了一套完整的无线安防监测系统;可以完成指定区域入侵状态的实时在线监测。

title: Design of portable RPV steel irradiation embrittlement detection system based on MBN
abstract: Reactor pressure vessel（RPV）operating under intense neutron irradiation for a long time will suffer radiation damage;which will affect its service life.Aiming at this problem;based on the principle of magnetic Barkhausen noise（MBN）effect;a three-dimensional simulation model of Barkhausen sensor is established.The validity of sensor structure and its optimal parameters are verified by simulation results.At the same time;a portable detection system for irradiation embrittlement of small size RPV steel is developed;which is based on the development board of TMS320F28335.Then;the repeatability and stability of the system are further verified.
keywords: finite element simulation, magnetic barkhausen noise, portable, reactor pressure vessel
authors: WANG Rongyao;QIAN Wangjie;LIU Xiangbing;WANG Haitao;JIANG Menghao;WANG Jiaxing

title: Design of inverter repetitive control system based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In view of the difficult industrial application of repetitive controller to inverter; this paper studies the repetitive controller design and the software implementation of repetitive controller. The notch filter; the low pass filter and phase lead compensator are designed respectively to meet the requirement of the inverter stability and the steady error. In this paper; an inverter repetitive controller system is built based on TMS320F28335 chip. And the software implementation of all parts of repetitive controller is elaborated. A series of experiments about the inverter repetitive control system verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

title: Application of ZigBee Technology in Medium Wave Broadcasting Room
abstract: This paper uses TI’S CC2530 RF chip;with different sensors and ZigBee wireless networking technology to comply broadcasting environment data monitoring of a medium wave studio in Shanghai.Compared with the traditional data transmission in studio room;the system is more scalable;efficient and easier to maintain.

title: Design of multi-channel wireless data acquisition system based on FPGA
abstract: Aiming at the problems in traditional multi-factor complex areas of difficult data monitoring and small amount of transmitted data; this paper designs a multi-channel wireless data acquisition system based on FPGA. The system used FPGA as the control core; adopted CC2530 chip to realize ZigBee standard wireless communication; completed multi-channel data acquisition by analog switch and AD converter; realized framed and wireless transmission of corresponding channel data through FPGA control. The test results show that the system can realize multi-channel data acquisition and wireless transmission; and provide reference for multifactor regional data acquisition.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统多因素复杂区域存在的数据监测困难、传输数据量小等问题;设计一种基于FPGA的多路无线数据采集系统。系统以FPGA为控制核心;采用CC2530芯片实现ZigBee标准无线通信;通过模拟开关及AD转换器完成多路数据采集;经FPGA控制实现相应通道数据的编帧及无线传输。测试结果表明;该系统可实现多路不同信号的数据采集及无线传输;为多因素区域数据采集提供参考。
keywords: data acquisition, fpga, wireless transmission, zigbee

title: Development of Data Acquisition System with a Large Dynamic Range for Pulsed Radiation Field Diagnosis
abstract: A high-speed data acquisition system(DAS)with dynamic range of 100 dB is developed to meet the special needs of pulsed radiation diagnosis;which realizes the function of front-end waveform digitization of output signal of pulsed radiation field.By using both attenuation circuit and over-voltage protection circuit; the designed analog signal conditioning module can ensure the accurate measurements of large signal and small signal at same time;and avoid the error caused by overlapping measurement of oscilloscope channel range.The LMX2594 chip is used to produce 2-channel;1 GHz high quality homologous clock signals;while the time delay between them can be adjusted.The firmware programmed realizes the functions of receiving high-speed parallel sampling data;cyclic storage;sequential readout;and so on.The results of amplitude calibration and time calibration show that the linearity of the system is good and the triggered sloshing is less than 1 ns.The field test results show that the developed DAS can effectively acquire analog electrical signals with dynamic range of 100 dB from pulsed radiation field.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对脉冲辐射场诊断的特殊需求;研制了动态范围为100dB的高速数据采集系统;可实现脉冲辐射场输出信号波形前端数字化的功能。设计的模拟信号调理模块配合使用衰减电路和过压保护电路;可同时保证对大信号和小信号的准确测量;避免了示波器信道量程搭接的问题;采用LMX2594芯片产生了2路、1GHz的高品质同源时钟信号;2路时钟信号之间的延时可调;设计的固件程序可实现高速并行采样数据的接收、循环存储和顺序读出等功能。系统的电压幅值标定和时间标定结果表明;系统电压幅值线性良好;触发晃动小于1ns;现场测试表明;系统可以有效获取脉冲辐射场输出的动态范围为100dB的模拟电信号。
keywords: clock de-jitter, cyclic storage, ip core, sampling data, source synchronization clock
authors: LI Hai-tao;LI Bin-kang;RUAN Lin-bo;TIAN Geng;ZHANG Yan-xia;Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology;State Key Laboratory of Intense Pulsed Radiation Simulation and Effect;
