title: Hardware Design of Oxygen Concentration Monitoring Device Based on DSP
abstract: According to the problems existing in domestic oxygen concentration monitoring; a new oxygen concentration monitoring device based on electrochemical sensor is developed. Using DSP microprocessor TMS320 F28335 as the main control chip; the oxygen concentration collection module; power supply module; A/D conversion module; sound and light alarm module; key setting module; communication module and LCD1602 LCD display module are designed. Physical production and testing are carried out. The test results show that the device can meet the requirements of high precision and high stability of gas environment parameter detection.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前国内氧气浓度监测存在的问题;研制出一种基于电化学式传感器的符合国家标准的氧气浓度监测装置。采用TI公司的DSP微处理器TMS320F28335作为主控芯片;设计了氧气浓度采集模块、电源模块、A/D转换模块、声光报警模块、按键设置模块、通信模块和LCD1602液晶显示模块;并进行了实物制作和测试。测试结果表明;该装置能满足气体环境参数检测的高精度和高稳定性等要求。
keywords: dsp, electrochemistry, power carrier communication
authors: CAO Xiao-yan;GUO Ming-liang;ZHAO Yan;WANG Peng;Institute of Electrical and Control Engineering; Heilongjiang University of Science and Technology;
affiliations: 黑龙江科技大学电气与控制工程学院

title: Research on detection technology of cable joint current and temperature for 10kV ring cabinet
abstract: In this paper;the CC2530 F256 controller is used to study the current and temperature measurement technology of cable joints for 10 kV ring cabinet. The system uses DS18 B20 temperature sensor and SCT254 K current transformer as measurement unit;CC2530 F256 controller as control core of data acquisition and signal transmission;and ZigBee wireless transmission technology to realize wireless transmission of measurement data. Compared with temperature measurement technology and traditional measurement technology;the error of temperature measurement and current measurement in this paper is less than 5% and 3%. The research content of this paper is of great significance for the accurate detection of the current and temperature of the cable joint of 10 kV ring cabinet.
abstract_in_chinese: 文中针对10 kV环网柜电缆接头电流与温度在线监测的实际应用需求;利用CC2530F256微控制器研究了电缆接头电流与温度测量技术。该系统利用DS18B20型温度传感器及SCT254K型电流互感器作为测量单元;采用CC2530F256控制器作为数据采集、信号传输的控制核心;并采用ZigBee无线传输技术实现测量数据的无线传输。文中研究的电流、温度测量技术与传统测量技术相比;其温度测量误差<5%;电流测量误差<3%。文中的研究内容对于实现10 kV环网柜电缆接头电流与温度的准确检测具有重要意义。
keywords: data acquisition, on-line monitoring, temperature sensor, wireless transmission, zigbee technology
authors: HUANG Ying-min;SHAO Yuan-peng;GAO Wei-guang;XU Cui-shan;R&D Center;Guangzhou Panyu Cable Group Co.;Ltd.;

title: Application Research of Big Data in the Internet of Things
abstract: With big data and the Internet of things technology integration as the background; the mass data generated in the industry is effectively collected; stored and analyzed; the product yield and the quality are improved by utilizing the data value; In this scheme; hadoop is used as big data processing platform to provide technical support for big data's storage and calculation. CC2530 and CC2430; which is the sensor in industry; are used as the acquisition and control node of the Internet of things. The two are organically combined by web technology to realize the application of big data in the Internet of things.
abstract_in_chinese: 以大数据和物联网技术融合为背景;对工业当中产生的海量数据进行有效采集、存储和分析;利用数据价值提高产品产量和品质;产生企业效益。该方案采用了Hadoop作为大数据处理平台为大数据的存储和计算提供了技术支撑;使用工业当中的传感器CC2530、CC2430作为物联网络的采集和控制节点;通过Web技术将两者有机结合;实现大数据在物联网上的应用。
keywords: big data, hadoop, sensor network, the internet of things
authors: Zhang Baoyan;School of Information Technology & Engineering; Jinzhong University;
affiliations: 晋中学院信息技术与工程学院

title: A Study on Detection to Elder People Falling Posture
abstract: The MPU6050 six-axis sensor detects the acceleration and inclination values of the elder people in three directions and transmits the data to the CC2530 microprocessor.After CC2530 adjusting the data;Zigbee wireless communication technology is used to transmit the data to the main controller of smart terminal STM32 in the nursing home.The main controller determines whether the elder people falls or not by combining with the multi-threshold algorithm for judging falls.After the fall;an alarm is issued and an alarm prompt is displayed on the host screen.This paper is mainly used to judge falling posture.By comparing the regional acceleration intensity SMA and SMV values of acceleration intensity as well as the difference of inclination angles under different static and motion states;it can distinguish falling from other daily behavior events.
abstract_in_chinese: 通过MPU6050六轴传感器在3个方向上检测老年人的加速度和倾斜度值;并将数据传输到CC2530微处理器。经过CC2530调整数据后;使用Zigbee无线通信技术将数据传输到养老院中的智能终端STM32主控制器。主控制器结合多阈值判断跌倒算法确定老人是否摔倒;摔倒后发出警报;并在主机界面上显示警报提示。主要用于解决跌倒姿态的判断;通过对比人不同静止与运动状态下区域加速度强度SMA和加速度强度SMV的值以及倾斜角的不同;区分出人跌倒与日常其他行为事件。
keywords: fall posture judgment, mpu6050, multi-threshold algorithm for judging falls
affiliations: 长春工程学院

title: Design of Electro-optical Scanning Speed Regulation System Based on Brushless DC Motor
abstract: In order to control brushless direct current(DC) motor accurately; the speed control system with the high performance digital signal processor TMS320 F28335 is designed. The hardware is designed in the system; the software is introduced and the corresponding flow chart is drawn. The structure of the system is simple; and the speed control of the brushless DC motor can be realized effectively.

keywords: brushless direct current(dc) motor, speed control, tms320f28335

title: Application of ZigBee Technology in Medium Wave Broadcasting Room
abstract: This paper uses TI’S CC2530 RF chip;with different sensors and ZigBee wireless networking technology to comply broadcasting environment data monitoring of a medium wave studio in Shanghai.Compared with the traditional data transmission in studio room;the system is more scalable;efficient and easier to maintain.

title: NandFlash Intelligent Design Scheme Applied to Small Missile-Borne Solution Platform
abstract: In order to adapt to the complex field test environment and meet the application requirements of the small-volume and large-capacity data storage of the missile-borne navigation solution platform;we design a scheme for storing information such as navigation solution application;field parameters and navigation solution data in a single NandFlash(K9 K8 G08 U0 M)under the control of TMS320 C6748.The solution can simultaneously complete the self-start function after the DSP powered;which greatly increases the use efficiency of NandFlash;and it is beneficial to increase the stability and reliability of the navigation system application.The design scheme is suitable for the space-bound dynamic parameter testing environment with limited space;and has certain engineering promotion and application value.The test is verified to be reasonable and effective.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了适应复杂外场试验环境以及满足弹载导航解算平台的小体积、大容量数据存储的应用需求;设计了一种通过TMS320C6748控制解算应用程序、外场参数与导航解算数据等信息存储于单块NandFlash(K9K8G08U0M)的设计方案;该方案能同时完成DSP上电后自启动功能;大大增加了NandFlash的使用效率;而且有利于增加导航系统应用的稳定性与可靠性;该设计方案适用于空间有限的弹载动态参数测试环境;具有一定的工程推广应用价值;通过试验验证;该设计合理有效.

title: Design of wireless temperature acquisition system based on ESP8266
abstract: A wireless temperature acquisition system based on Esp8266 is designed in this paper; and the hardware system and software design of the temperature acquisition system are discussed and studied. The CC2530 single chip microcomputer is used as the control chip and ESP8266-WiFi is used as the wireless communication chip to transmit the collected temperature data wirelessly. At the same time; the socket communication on the Android side is also studied; which is used to collect and display the temperature value. The system has the characteristics of convenience; low power consumption; long distance; simple design and so on.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章设计了基于ESP8266的无线温度采集系统;主要针对温度采集系统的硬件系统和软件设计进行探讨和研究;重点研究了以CC2530单片机为控制芯片;以ESP8266-WiFi为无线通信芯片;把采集的温度数据进行无线发送。同时还研究了Android端的Socket通信;用于采集显示温度值。此系统具有方便、低功耗、距离远、设计简单等特点。
keywords: android, cc2530, esp8266, temperature acquisition

title: Design of portable RPV steel irradiation embrittlement detection system based on MBN
abstract: Reactor pressure vessel(RPV)operating under intense neutron irradiation for a long time will suffer radiation damage;which will affect its service life.Aiming at this problem;based on the principle of magnetic Barkhausen noise(MBN)effect;a three-dimensional simulation model of Barkhausen sensor is established.The validity of sensor structure and its optimal parameters are verified by simulation results.At the same time;a portable detection system for irradiation embrittlement of small size RPV steel is developed;which is based on the development board of TMS320F28335.Then;the repeatability and stability of the system are further verified.
abstract_in_chinese: 反应堆压力容器(Reactor Pressure Vessel;RPV)长期工作在强中子辐照环境下;材料会受到辐照损伤;从而影响其使用寿命。针对这一问题;基于磁巴克豪森噪声(Magnetic Barkhausen Noise;MBN)效应原理;建立巴克豪森传感器的三维仿真模型;仿真结果验证了传感器结构的有效性;确定了传感器的最优参数。同时以TMS320F28335开发板为核心研制了一套针对小尺寸RPV钢辐照脆化的便携式检测系统;验证了该系统的重复性与稳定性。
keywords: finite element simulation, magnetic barkhausen noise, portable, reactor pressure vessel

title: Enhanced Composite Nonlinear Control of a Linear Motor Position Servo System
abstract: A position controller design was proposed to achieve fast and accurate set-point motion in linear servo motors typically used in high-performance mechatronics systems. The controller adopted a combination of linear control and smooth nonlinear control. A reduced-order linear state observer was adopted to estimate the un-measured motor speed. An integral action was also inserted to remove the steady-state error induced by unknown disturbance. The controller design was fully parameterized and could implement dynamic gain control; which facilitated the online tuning of parameters for performance optimization. The control scheme was applied to a permanent magnet linear motor servo system; and experimental verification using a TMS320 F28335 DSC was conducted. The results show that the servo system is capable of tracking various target positions accurately with a desirable transient performance.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对高性能机电系统中常用的直线伺服电机;设计了一个能实现快速与准确的定点运动的位置控制器。控制器采用线性控制律与平滑非线性控制律相结合的方案;并利用一个降阶线性状态观测器对电机运动速度(未量测)加以估计。为了消除未知扰动带来的稳态误差;控制律中嵌入了积分控制作用。整个控制律采用全参数化设计;可实现动态增益控制;方便了在线参数整定与性能优化。控制方案应用于一个实际的永磁直线电机位置伺服系统;基于TMS320F28335 DSC进行了试验测试;结果表明系统能对各目标位置进行准确的跟踪;且具有理想的瞬态性能。
keywords: composite nonlinear control, linear motor, observer, parameterization, servo system

title: Design of intelligent agriculture monitoring system based on ZigBee and 4G heterogeneous Network
abstract: In order to solve the problem of controllability of meteorological conditions such as temperature; humidity and soil moisture in crops; greenhouse agriculture; animal breeding; etc.; we can better realize meteorological services for agriculture; design a intelligent agriculture monitoring system. The terminal nodes are designed using the CC2530 system-on-chip with integrated Zigbee module; the hardware and software of the gateway node are designed and developed by S3C2440 microprocessor; 4G module; IAR integrated development environment and J-LINK simulator; The system communication transmission protocol is developed. The user interaction software was designed. The comparison test shows that the system error is small and the transmission delay is basically negligible; eliminating the wiring and maintenance requirements in the complicated environment; and avoiding the possibility of the line being cut during the cultivation process. The problem of the transmission distance limitation of a single ZigBee network is effectively solved; and the expected design effect is achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决农作物、大棚农业、动物养殖业等现场温湿度、土壤水分等气象条件可控性的难题;更好地实现气象为农服务;设计了智慧农业监控系统。研究采用集成Zigbee模块的CC2530片上系统设计了终端节点;采用S3C2440微处理器、4G模块、IAR集成开发环境和J-LINK仿真器设计开发了网关节点的硬软件;制定了系统通信传输协议;并对用户端交互软件进行了功能设计。相同条件下通过对比测试表明:系统误差小;传输延时基本可以忽略不计;还省去了繁杂环境中的布线和维护需求;避免了耕种过程中线路被挖断的可能性;有效解决了单一ZigBee网络传输距离限制的问题;达到了预期设计效果。
keywords: heterogeneous network, multimode gateway, smart agriculture, zigbee
authors: Bao Leilei;Wu Jiawei;Jiang Shuyang;Miao Mingrong;Nantong Meteorological Bureau;

abstract_in_chinese: 嵌入式设备装入整机或系统后;拆卸进行软件升级非常困难。本文以TMS320F2812为例;提出一种通过串口进行软件更新的方法。借鉴sci-A更新方式;不需要更改相关硬件端口;通过默认内部flash启动;借助F2812内部存储及API函数完成更新操作。实验证明;该方法烧写效率高;准确稳定;操作简单;能够应用于嵌入式软件的在线升级。

title: Design of large traction AGV brushless DC motor drive based on FOC control
abstract: A permanent magnet brushless DC motor driver is designed for a large traction AGV hub motor. Higher frequency GaN switching transistors are used on three-phase full-bridge inverters to reduce motor losses and torque ripple by increasing the switching frequency. Based on the TMS320 F28069 chip;the control circuit adopts a FOC control algorithm;and introduces the theory of field-oriented control theory in detail. Based on this;a brushless DC motor position sensorless system is designed. The rotor is used to estimate the rotor. Position and speed. This paper analyzes the drive circuit and sampling circuit of the motor. The driver design of this paper has the characteristics of small size;good heat dissipation and high frequency. It can be well applied to large traction AGV cars.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对某种大牵引力AGV轮毂电机;设计了一种永磁无刷直流电机驱动器。在三相全桥逆变上采用更高频率的GaN开关管;通过提高开关频率以减少电机的损失和扭矩波动。控制电路以TMS320F28069芯片为基础;采用了一种FOC控制算法;详细介绍了磁场定向控制理论原理;并在此基础上设计了无刷直流电机无位置传感器系统;通过滑模观测器法来估算转子位置和转速;并对电机的驱动电路和采样电路进行了分析。本次设计的驱动器具有体积小、散热好、适用于高频的特点;能够很好的适用于大牵引力AGV小车。
keywords: field-oriented control, permanent magnet brushless dc motor, sliding mode observer, without position sensor
authors: ZHAO Ya-zhou;YANG Yan;Qingdao University School of Electrical Engineering;

title: The System of Solar and Rainwater Flower Based on Zigbee
abstract: In order to monitor and manage the growth of large-scale and different kinds of flowers in real time; a design scheme of intelligent flower management system based on Zigbee ad hoc network was proposed. The system consists of Zigbee sensor network; optical fiber supplement; solar power supply; water storage and water level detection. In the sensor network of the system; the sensor nodes are grouped and numbered to distinguish different flower growth information. The data are collected and processed by coordinator. The user inquires the flower information by inputting the number on the mobile terminal.; The project also has the function of optical fiber to supplement light in some areas with insufficient lighting; to promote photosynthesis; so that plants can grow normally. The project can achieve water-saving effect by watering different kinds of plants in different degrees and combining with rainwater storage part. The energy-consuming pumps in the system are supplied by solar energy to achieve energy-saving purposes. The system has the characteristics of green environmental protection and intelligent management; and has a good application prospect for large-scale places of flowers.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现对大规模以及不同种类花卉的生长状况进行实时监测和管理;提出一个基于Zigbee自组网的智能花卉管理系统的设计方案。系统由Zigbee传感CC2530网络部分;光纤补光部分;太阳能供电部分;蓄水及水位检测部分构成。系统的传感网络中;通过对各传感节点进行分组和编号;以区分不同的花卉生长信息;然后通过协调器对各数据进行汇总及处理;最后用户通过手机端输入编号查询各花卉信息。另外该项目还具有光纤补光功能;对某些采光不足的区域进行补光;促进其进行光合作用;使植物能正常生长。该项目预设不同类别的植物进行不同程度的浇水;再结合其中的雨水蓄集部分;能达到节水效果;另外系统中耗能较大的水泵由太阳能进行供能;达到节能目的。该系统具有绿色环保、智能管理等特点;对于花卉规模较大的场所有很好的应用前景。
keywords: iot, optical fiber lighting, rainwater collection, smart flower watering, smart home, solar energy, zigbee

title: 无线体域网的人体实时监测系统的设计
abstract_in_chinese: 本系统是无线体域网(Wireless Body Area Networks;WBAN)的人体实时监测系统的设计;系统在各个人体信息采集节点布置了DS18B20温度传感器和PulseSensor脉搏传感器;传感器将采集到的体温信息和脉搏信息发送至中央芯片CC2540进行数据处理;该芯片可以很好地兼容低功耗蓝牙(Bluetooth low energy;BLE)协议;通过与TI的低功耗蓝牙协议栈配合;可以连接到用户的智能手机或平板电脑等移动设备进行无线数据传输;实现人体信息的实时监测。本系统大大提高了人体信息监测的操作灵活性;降低了监测设备的成本;使无线体域网和低功耗蓝牙技术在医疗健康领域有更加广泛的应用。

title: 基于定点DSP的自然对数运算快速算法
abstract_in_chinese: 针对定点DSP在进行取自然对数运算时运算速度慢;无法满足日益增长的高速数字信号处理需求这一问题提出一种快速算法。该算法在分析浮点数据存储格式的基础上推导出该快速算法;并用C语言在TMS320C6455平台上进行了仿真实现;仿真验证了该算法可以极大提高取自然对数运算速度。

title: Traction Inverter Multi-Section Synchronous SVPWM Strategy FPGA Program Design and Implementation
abstract: Due to low switching frequency of high-power traction drive system; in wide operation range of train; multi-mode modulation algorithm is widely adopted in the traction inverters. This paper presents a multi-mode modulation algorithm based on selective harmonic elimination pulse width modulation(SHEPWM) and studies the smooth switching method between different modulation modes. After that; a design and realization scheme of this modulation algorithm based on FPGA is given in detail; and the top-level design logic and communication method between DSP and FPGA chips are analyzed. Finally; the hardware-in-loop(HIL) RT-LAB experiment platform with DSP(TMS320 F28335) + FPGA(SPARTAN XC3 S400) controllers has been designed and developed; and the FPGA implementation scheme of multi-mode modulation algorithm is shown. HIL experimental results have verified the correctness of the adopted multi-mode modulation algorithm and the feasibility of the FPGA design.
abstract_in_chinese: 大功率牵引传动系统具有低开关频率的特点;在列车运行全速域范围内;牵引逆变器广泛采用多模式调制算法。该文给出了一种基于特定次谐波消除脉宽调制(SHEPWM)的多模式调制算法;并加入切换控制算法以保证不同模式之间平滑切换。然后;给出该算法基于现场可编程逻辑门阵列(FPGA)的详细设计方案;分析顶层设计逻辑和通信方法。最后;搭建基于DSP(TMS320F28335)+FPGA(SPARTAN XC3S400)为控制器的RT-LAB半实物实验平台;对该多模式调制算法进行了半实物实验研究;并给出多模式调制算法的FPGA实现设计方案。半实物实验结果验证了该算法的正确性和FPGA设计方案的可行性。
keywords: multi-section modulation, programming design in fpga, selected harmonic eliminating pulse width modulation, smooth commutation, traction inverter

title: Current Stress Optimized Scheme with Model-Based Feedforward for Dual-Active-Bridge DC-DC Converters
abstract: In order to reduce the current stress; improve the efficiency and enhance the dynamic response of dual-active-bridge(DAB) DC-DC converters; a current stress optimized scheme with model-based feedforward is proposed in this paper. Through developing the discrete model of output voltage; introducing feedforward control and combining the current stress optimized calculation; the efficiency and dynamic performance of DAB converters under the input voltage fluctuation and load disturbance conditions can be improved significantly. In addition; the proposed control scheme can effectively improve the starting characteristics of the converter; so that the output voltage reaches the desired value directly without overshoot. Finally; three control schemes; i.e. traditional voltage-closed control based on single phase-shift; current stress optimized control based on dual phase-shift and the proposed current stress optimized scheme with model-based feedforward; are compared in a DAB converter scale-down experimental prototype based on SiC MOSFET with TMS320F28335 as the core controller. The experimental results have verified the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了减小双有源全桥DC-DC变换器的电流应力;提高变换器的效率;同时显著增强变换器的动态性能;本文在双重相移控制的基础上提出一种基于模型前馈的电流应力优化方法。该方法通过建立变换器输出电压的离散模型并引入前馈控制;同时结合电流应力优化计算;可以实现变换器效率优化并显著地提高其对于负载突变和输入电压突变的响应能力。同时;该方法可以有效地改善变换器的起动特性;使得输出电压在无明显超调的情况下直接达到给定电压值。最后;搭建了以TMS320F28335为核心控制器的基于SiC MOSFET的双有源全桥DC-DC变换器小功率实验样机;以传统的单重相移电压闭环控制方法和双重相移电流应力优化控制为参考;对所提出的基于模型前馈的电流应力优化方法进行对比实验;实验结果验证了所提控制方法的正确性与有效性。
keywords: dual phase-shift control, dual-active-bridge dc-dc converters, dynamic response, efficiency, model-based feedforward

title: Design of formaldehyde monitoring system based on ZigBee and WIFI
abstract: The traditional formaldehyde detector can not simultaneously detect multiple monitoring points;which has the problems of long time and low efficiency. This paper designs an effective multinode indoor formaldehyde concentration fast detection scheme. The formaldehyde concentration data are detected at different locations by multiple wireless sensor nodes at the same time;and sent to the coordinator through ZigBee network.The formaldehyde concentration data is sent to the smart phone through WIFI module for display;thus realizing real-time and effective detection of formaldehyde concentration in multiple spaces.

title: Enhanced Composite Nonlinear Control of a Linear Motor Position Servo System
abstract: A position controller design was proposed to achieve fast and accurate set-point motion in linear servo motors typically used in high-performance mechatronics systems. The controller adopted a combination of linear control and smooth nonlinear control. A reduced-order linear state observer was adopted to estimate the un-measured motor speed. An integral action was also inserted to remove the steady-state error induced by unknown disturbance. The controller design was fully parameterized and could implement dynamic gain control; which facilitated the online tuning of parameters for performance optimization. The control scheme was applied to a permanent magnet linear motor servo system; and experimental verification using a TMS320 F28335 DSC was conducted. The results show that the servo system is capable of tracking various target positions accurately with a desirable transient performance.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对高性能机电系统中常用的直线伺服电机;设计了一个能实现快速与准确的定点运动的位置控制器。控制器采用线性控制律与平滑非线性控制律相结合的方案;并利用一个降阶线性状态观测器对电机运动速度(未量测)加以估计。为了消除未知扰动带来的稳态误差;控制律中嵌入了积分控制作用。整个控制律采用全参数化设计;可实现动态增益控制;方便了在线参数整定与性能优化。控制方案应用于一个实际的永磁直线电机位置伺服系统;基于TMS320F28335 DSC进行了试验测试;结果表明系统能对各目标位置进行准确的跟踪;且具有理想的瞬态性能。
keywords: composite nonlinear control, linear motor, observer, parameterization, servo system

title: Design of Servo Motor Drive System Based on EtherCAT Communication
abstract: For the EtherCAT communication technology in the servo control application;the slave station needs to use the MCU.A design scheme for integrating the EtherCAT control chip into the servo motor drive system was proposed;and the hardware and software design and experiment were carried out verification.Firstly;the communication principle of EtherCAT protocol was expounded.Then the EtherCAT communication controller ET1100 and DSP chip TMS320 F28335 were used as the core of the system.The magnetic field orientation algorithm was combined with the intelligent power module IPM;current sensor ACS712-20 and PHY chip KS8721 to realize the hardware and software design of the servo motor drive system.Finally;the effectiveness of the system EtherCAT data communication and motor control was proved by experiments;which is suitable for industrial automation.

keywords: et1100, ethercat communication, servo motor, tms320f28335

title: Design of wireless temperature acquisition system based on ESP8266
abstract: A wireless temperature acquisition system based on Esp8266 is designed in this paper; and the hardware system and software design of the temperature acquisition system are discussed and studied. The CC2530 single chip microcomputer is used as the control chip and ESP8266-WiFi is used as the wireless communication chip to transmit the collected temperature data wirelessly. At the same time; the socket communication on the Android side is also studied; which is used to collect and display the temperature value. The system has the characteristics of convenience; low power consumption; long distance; simple design and so on.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章设计了基于ESP8266的无线温度采集系统;主要针对温度采集系统的硬件系统和软件设计进行探讨和研究;重点研究了以CC2530单片机为控制芯片;以ESP8266-WiFi为无线通信芯片;把采集的温度数据进行无线发送。同时还研究了Android端的Socket通信;用于采集显示温度值。此系统具有方便、低功耗、距离远、设计简单等特点。

title: Design of environmental quality monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network
abstract: The wireless sensor network is built with CC2530 module as the core. The collected environmental data such as dust;temperature; humidity and illumination are transmitted to the remote monitoring center. The environmental data is read and stored by the host computer software to realize remote monitoring of environmental parameters. According to the functional design of the system; the software design of the terminal node and the coordinator node monitoring center is completed.
abstract_in_chinese: 以CC2530模块为核心构建无线传感网络;将采集的粉尘、温湿度、光照等环境数据传输至远程监测中心;通过上位机软件读取与储存环境数据;实现环境参数远程监测。文章根据系统的方案;设计其硬件电路功能;并设计了终端传感器节点、中间协调器节点以及监控中心的软件流程。

title: 基于TMS320F28335的电动舵机控制系统设计
abstract: In order to realize the small size and low cost design of the circuit board of electromechanical actuator(EMA);TMS320 F28335 is used as the main control chip;and with its capture interrupt and timing interrupt functions;closed loop control of electromechanical actuator(EMA)is realized. Firstly;control strategy of EMA and driving principle of brushless direct current motor(BLDCM)are presented.Secondly;the design method of software and hardware of EMA is given. Finally;experiments are carried out to validate the method. The motor can operate stably at a constant speed by inputting 200 rpm speed instruction. The EMA system can operate stably at all positions by the EMA command angles of 1 °;3 °;5°;7°and 9°. Experimental results show that this method reduces costs and circuit board volume;make the EMA working more stable.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现电动舵机电路板小体积、低成本设计;以TMS320F28335作为主控芯片;利用其自身的捕获中断和定时中断功能;实现了电动舵机控制。首先给出电动舵机的控制策略及电机驱动原理;其次给出了电动舵机的软硬件设计方法;最后进行实验验证。输入200 rpm的电机速度指令;电机能够匀速稳定运行给定舵机的指令角度分别为1°、3°、5°、7°、9°;系统能够稳定运行在各个位置;实验结果表明该方法降低成本、减小电路板体积;使舵机稳定工作。
keywords: bldcm, capture interrupt, ema, phase change control word

abstract_in_chinese: 本文主要针对家庭等小型应用场所;提出基于以单片机CC2530作为控制器的智能烟雾报警系统;通过MQ-2气体传感器来检测烟雾浓度;在单片机的A/D模块转化后;并配合蜂鸣元器件实现声音报警功能。

title: 基于CC1101的智能门锁无线低功耗休眠唤醒机制设计
abstract: For the micro wireless node's low power wake-up mechanism design problem in the short frame and low throughput wireless sensor networks; by the low power wake-up mechanism research in a smart door locks application with duplex abrupt communication and less than 500 ms response time features; the commonly used low power wake-up mechanisms at the MAC layer are analyzed. And with the low cost; low power hardware platform based on STM8 L MCU+Sub-1 G wireless chip CC1101; according to the application features of smart door lock and combined with the supported hardware mechanism of CC1101 wireless chip; the low power wake-up mechanism which meeting the application requirements is designed and realized. The power consumption of the wireless node is measured; and the power consumption of smart door lock is evaluated; the results show that the system is stable and reliable; and the low-power performance is good.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对短帧、低吞吐量特性的无线传感网中微型节点的低功耗休眠唤醒机制设计问题;通过对支持双向突发通信、响应时间小于500 ms需求的智能门锁应用具体场景下的低功耗休眠唤醒机制的研究;分析了常用的MAC层低功耗休眠唤醒机制。并以STM8L MCU+Sub-1G射频芯片CC1101的低成本、低功耗硬件平台为基础;根据智能门锁的应用特性;结合CC1101射频芯片底层硬件机制;设计并实现了满足应用要求的低功耗休眠唤醒机制。通过对节点模块功耗的测量;并结合智能门锁应用场景进行功耗评估;结果表明系统稳定可靠;且低功耗特性表现良好。
keywords: low-power, smart door lock, wake-up mechanism, wireless node

title: 基于TMS320F28335叉车异步电机FOC控制器设计
abstract: In this paper; TMS320 F28335 micro control chip is used to design a controller of the motor of electric forklift. According to the problem that inverter bridge of forklift is not able to afford the high current; design a hardware circuit as well as the software; including the circuit diagram of Inverter Bridge; MOS driver circuit; voltage regulator circuit and current detection circuit; etc. The software system structure is FOC control system structure; and the program flow chart is given. The core internal data were obtained through serial communication; and the waveforms of speed; current; Id and Iq were obtained. The experimental results show that the response characteristics of the system are good and meet the design requirements.
abstract_in_chinese: 采用TMS320F28335微控制芯片;设计一个电动叉车行走电机的控制器。在针对叉车控制器逆变电路中不能通过大电流的问题;设计了一套硬件电路;同时也给出了软件设计;其中硬件上给出了逆变电桥、Mos驱动电路、稳压电路、电流检测电路等电路图;软件系统结构为FOC控制系统结构;给出程序流程图。通过串口通信方式获取芯内部数据;得到转速、电流、Id、Iq波形图。实验表明;系统响应特性较好;达到了设计要求。

title: 基于定点DSP的自然对数运算快速算法
abstract_in_chinese: 针对定点DSP在进行取自然对数运算时运算速度慢;无法满足日益增长的高速数字信号处理需求这一问题提出一种快速算法。该算法在分析浮点数据存储格式的基础上推导出该快速算法;并用C语言在TMS320C6455平台上进行了仿真实现;仿真验证了该算法可以极大提高取自然对数运算速度。

title: 基于CC2540的蓝牙4.0物品标签识别系统
abstract: With TI CC2540 ultra-low power bluetooth chip system as the core device; a set of built-in BLE4.0 protocol item label automatic identification and alarm system is designed. The hardware framework and software flow of Bluetooth wireless communication item label recognition are described. The system seamlessly interfaces with the BLE4.0 protocol item label and is designed around minimal power consumption; which has the characteristics of low power consumption; miniaturization; good reliability and low production cost.
abstract_in_chinese: 以TI公司CC2540超低功耗蓝牙片上系统为核心器件;设计了一套内置BLE4.0协议物品标签自动识别与报警系统。阐述了蓝牙无线通信物品标签识别的硬件框架及软件流程;该系统可与BLE4.0协议的物品标签进行无缝连接;围绕最小功耗设计;具有功耗低、小型化、可靠性好、生产成本低的特点。

title: 基于Python语言的串行通信实现方法分析
abstract_in_chinese: 在单片机、嵌入式等课程的教学过程中;串行通信是最基础、最重要的知识点之一。在以往的教学中;常使用串口调试助手作为联调工具;由于其源代码不开源;不利于学生对串行通信原理的理解。该文利用Python语言第三方库设计、开发串口调试上位机;并实现与CC2530单片机进行串行通信;有利于老师的教学和学生对串行通信知识的掌握。

title: 基于激光传感器的钣金喷涂粉尘浓度无线监控技术
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of dust concentration in spraying process of sheet metal surface; a wireless monitoring technology of dust concentration based on laser sensor was proposed. The optical detection structure was designed by using the dust concentration measurement algorithm of laser scattering method. The dust concentration information collected by laser sensor is sent to the PC of the control room for visual display by using wireless ZigBee network based on the CC2530 chip. The dust concentration in sheet metal spraying chamber measured by laser sensor was compared with that measured by traditional weighing method. The results showed that the measurement error of laser sensor meets the requirements of sheet metal spraying process.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对钣金表面喷涂处理过程中对粉尘浓度的要求;提出了一种基于激光传感器的粉尘浓度无线监控技术。利用激光散射法的粉尘浓度测量算法设计了光学检测结构;利用基于CC2530芯片的无线ZigBee网络将激光传感器采集到的粉尘浓度信息发送到总控室PC上进行可视化显示。对比激光传感器测量的钣金喷涂室粉尘浓度与传统称重法的结果可知;激光传感器的测量误差满足钣金喷涂工艺要求。
keywords: automatization, dust concentration, laser sensor, monitoring, sheet metal spraying, wireless network
affiliations: 重庆工程学院, Chongqing Engineering Institute

title: 基于ZigBee组网的智慧教室环境感知方法研究
abstract_in_chinese: 物联网技术的快速发展为智慧教室从概念走向实际应用提供了良好的契机。智慧教室作为现代教育技术发展中的重要环境支持有望为教学过程的高效开展提供重要的硬件保证。本文基于Zigbee短距离无线自组网技术;提出一种能够自动感知教室环境信息;并实现数据高效转发的智慧教室情境感知方法;阐述了该系统的软硬件设计流程和组网方法。通过CC2530芯片与ESP 8266 WiFi模块及各种传感器实时监测教室内的温湿度、噪声、光线等因素;实现对物理环境的调节;达到适宜学生身心健康的状态。
affiliations: 陕西师范大学计算机科学学院

title: 高精度UUV浮力调节装置控制驱动技术研究
abstract: In the analysis of buoyancy regulation device’s framework and function; the controller and driver’s hardware and program design for buoyancy regulation device is put forward. The core control chip of the controller and driver is TMS320 LF28335. In order to control the volume of the buoyancy regulation device more accurately; the control structure is consist of position closed-loop; speed closed-loop and current closed-loop. With the method of load the pump of the device by a simulated loading station; we verified the load performance of the controller and driver. Respectively;we validated the control precision of the volume control algorithm on the multi-stage hydraulic cylinder; which indicates the controller and driver in this article satisfied the performance requirements of the buoyancy regulation device.
abstract_in_chinese: 在分析高精度浮力调节装置结构及功能的基础上;提出了该装置的控制驱动器硬件及软件设计方案。该控制驱动器选用TMS320F28335作为主控制芯片;采用容积、速度、电流三闭环控制以实现控制驱动器对浮力调节装置容积的高精度控制采用模拟加载台对该浮力调节装置中的泵进行加载试验;验证了该控制驱动器的带载性能采用试验验证了基于多级液压缸的容积控制算法的控制精度;表明该控制驱动器能够满足高精度浮力调节装置的性能要求。
keywords: buoyancy regulation device, controller and driver, motor, pump, uuv
authors: LI Zhen-shan;JIANG Li-ting;TIAN Guan-zhi;SONG Xian-cheng;YUAN Li-wei

title: 智能家用监护系统设计
abstract: According to the protection of the children; elders and disables; a domestic monitoring system with mobile phone reminder and intelligent lighting was designed. The system adopted modular structure. Monitoring terminal with CC2530 microcontroller as the core realized the sensor data acquisition; signal sending or receiving and automatic lighting. The gateway included ZigBee coordinator and RT5350 module. Its function is to realize the communication between terminal and mobile phone. When the phone received the terminal button or sensor signal; it vibrates and rings a bell to remind the monitor. The phone can also control the lamp on the terminal. The communication quality of the system is good and the performance is stable. It is flexible and convenientvery much. It can meet the needs of homemonitoring well.

title: 基于FPGA的多路无线数据采集系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problems in traditional multi-factor complex areas of difficult data monitoring and small amount of transmitted data; this paper designs a multi-channel wireless data acquisition system based on FPGA. The system used FPGA as the control core; adopted CC2530 chip to realize ZigBee standard wireless communication; completed multi-channel data acquisition by analog switch and AD converter; realized framed and wireless transmission of corresponding channel data through FPGA control. The test results show that the system can realize multi-channel data acquisition and wireless transmission; and provide reference for multifactor regional data acquisition.

title: 基于CC2530的Zigbee无线传感网络的设计与实现

abstract: According to the problems existing in domestic oxygen concentration monitoring; a new oxygen concentration monitoring device based on electrochemical sensor is developed. Using DSP microprocessor TMS320 F28335 as the main control chip; the oxygen concentration collection module; power supply module; A/D conversion module; sound and light alarm module; key setting module; communication module and LCD1602 LCD display module are designed. Physical production and testing are carried out. The test results show that the device can meet the requirements of high precision and high stability of gas environment parameter detection.

abstract: Aiming at the position error; designs ADC conversion error and interference noise; the design of the drilling tool attitude measurement correction system to improve the attitude measurement accuracy of the drilling tool. The system uses AD7606 analog-to-digital converter and TMS320 F2812 DSP produced by TI as ADC sampling chip and controller. Designs a multi-channel data acquisition system based on DSP.Presents the overall system design of the system; and implements the hardware circuit of the system. Design and compilation of software.Design and manufacture of circuit boards; verifies the feasibility and rationality of the system through experiments.

title: 基于物联网技术的温室大棚种植园环境监测系统
abstract: In view of the defects and insufficiency of the existing greenhouse plantation environmental monitoring;a remote monitoring system for greenhouses is designed by means of the Internet of Things(IoT)technology. A fuzzy power control algorithm is proposed for this system;which takes the received signal strength and packet loss rate as the input of the fuzzy controller to realize the automatic adjustment of the transmit power of the sensor node. Besides;low power consumption CC2530 is used as processor. The sensor node module is adopted to collect data;and then send the data to the sink node module;by which the data is transmitted to the gateway node module. Finally;the data is uploaded to the server through the GPRS module;so as to realize the monitoring of the PC upper computer. The experimental results show that the system operates stably and the collected data is accurate. It can realize the environmental monitoring of the greenhouse plantation.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对现有温室大棚种植园环境监测的缺陷和不足;采用物联网技术;设计对温室大棚远程监控的系统。文中提出了模糊功率控制算法;以接收信号强度和丢包率变化作为模糊控制器的输入;实现对传感器节点的发射功率自动调整。以低功耗CC2530为处理器;通过传感器节点模块采集数据后传输到汇聚节点模块;再由汇聚节点模块传输数据到网关节点模块;最后通过GPRS模块将数据上传到服务器。实验结果表明;所提系统运行稳定;采集的数据准确;可以实现对温室大棚种植园的环境监测。
keywords: data acquisition, data uploading, environmental monitoring, greenhouse, iot technology, sensor technology

abstract: A wireless temperature acquisition system based on Esp8266 is designed in this paper; and the hardware system and software design of the temperature acquisition system are discussed and studied. The CC2530 single chip microcomputer is used as the control chip and ESP8266-WiFi is used as the wireless communication chip to transmit the collected temperature data wirelessly. At the same time; the socket communication on the Android side is also studied; which is used to collect and display the temperature value. The system has the characteristics of convenience; low power consumption; long distance; simple design and so on.

title: Design of Vehicle Vegetable Monitoring System
abstract: In view of the difficulty in real-time monitoring of on-board environment and large distribution loss in the process of urban fruit and vegetable distribution in China;the ZigBee-based on-board fruit and vegetable monitoring system is studied. System is mainly composed of sensor module;the coordinator module;power module and the display parts;sensor module is made up of multiple temperature and humidity sensor;the coordinator module uses CC2591 chip connected with CC2530 chip;and designed for the CC2591 chip enhanced transmission gain new balance circuit;power supply module using solar-lithium battery can double power supply. The system uses ZigBee technology to form a network. The data collected by sensors are processed by coordinator and forwarded to the LCD display panel of cab. According to the temperature and humidity of fruit and vegetable;the fan and rain valve are controlled by relay. The specifications of the refrigerated vehicle are about 7.2 meters long;2.3 meters wide and 2.7 meters high. The designed system fully meets the actual needs and realizes the real-time control of the temperature and humidity of the vehicle environment.

title: Research of Speed Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of quick response and strong robustness for PMSM（Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor） speed control; after analyzing the mathematical model of PMSM and discrete wavelet transform algorithm; a speed controller was designed with an optimal mother wavelet transform function of "db4" and a decomposition level of 2. Based on the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform; a PMSM drive system simulation model and a control system code model were established; and using the experiment platform based on the TMS320F2812 DSP（Digital Signal Processing） of permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system; the performance of the discrete wavelet transform speed controller was verified by simulation and experiment. The simulation and experiment results indicated that compared with the traditional PID（Proprotional Integral Derivative） controller; the discrete wavelet transform speed controller improved the dynamic response speed to get to a steady state and; when the load abruptly changed; it showed a small speed drop and had strong anti-load-disturbance ability. Therefore; it is an effective method to promote the robustness and stability of permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control.
keywords: discrete wavelet transform（dwt）, model-based design, permanent magnet synchronous motor（pmsm）, speed control

title: Design and Implementation of μC/OS-Ⅱ Transplantation on TMS320F2812
abstract: The μC/OS-Ⅱ system is a preemptive multitask real-time operation system kernel with good portability.Aiming at the complex problem of task management in software development process on the TMS320 F2812 platform;this paper transplants the μC/OS-Ⅱsystem to the target platform;and realizes the function of task creation;deletion and priority setting based on the μC/OS-Ⅱ system;which greatly reduces the difficulty of multitask development.It has been proved that this method has high application value;and it can provide a reference for multitask project development.

title: Design of Single Phase Phase-locked Loop Based on Fuzzy PR Control
abstract: At present;the generalized integrator has been widely used in PLL design. In order to solve the problem that PI control in PLL is difficult to keep the input signal and control parameters unchanged without static error;PR controller is proposed to replace PI controller to adjust PLL. At the same time;the fuzzy controller is added to solve the problem that the control parameters in the generalized integrator are constant and can not adapt to the influence of uncertain factors such as parameter changes and system disturbances in the control process. The feasibility of single-phase PLL based on Fuzzy PR control is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation model;and TMS320 F28335 is used as the control core to build a singlephase PLL test prototype based on Fuzzy PR control. From the simulation results and experimental platform waveforms;it can be concluded that the optimization method can improve the accuracy and anti-interference ability of single-phase PLL to a certain extent.
abstract_in_chinese: 目前;广义积分器在锁相环设计中已经得到了广泛应用。针对锁相环中PI调节较难做到无静差跟踪输入信号与控制参数固定不变而影响锁相效果的问题;提出以PR控制器代替PI控制器调节锁相环;同时加入模糊控制器以解决广义积分器中控制参数恒定不变、在控制过程中无法适应参数变化和系统扰动等不确定因素影响的问题。通过Matlab/Simulink搭建仿真模型验证基于模糊PR控制的单相锁相环的可行性;并以TMS320F28335作为控制核心;搭建了一台基于模糊PR控制的单相锁相环的试验样机进行验证。由仿真结果及实验平台波形可得出;该优化方法可以在一定程度上提高单相锁相环的准确性和抗干扰能力。
keywords: fuzzy control, pr control, second-order generalized integral, single phase phase-locked loop
authors: WU Jun-feng;WU Wen-jie;ZHANG Wei-jie;Institute of Electrical and Control Engineering;Heilongjiang University of Science and Technology;

title: Research on Matching Network and Frequency Tracking System of Ultrasonic Power Supply
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high power loss in traditional ultrasonic power supply;which causes the energy of transducer to drop or even stop vibration;the voltage and current at both ends of transducer are kept in the same phase by adjusting the switch frequency of ultrasonic power supply. In the way of series inductor;TMS320 F28335 control chip is used to capture the phase of output voltage and current;adjust the phase difference;and make the transducer work in the best resonant state. The experimental results show that:compared with the traditional frequency tracking method;the phase control method is faster in frequency acquisition and faster in dynamic response of the system.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统的超声波电源存在功率损耗高、致使换能器能量大幅度下降甚至停振的问题;通过调节超声波电源输出的开关频率;使得换能器两端的电压和电流保持同一相位;并且采用串联电感的方式;通过TMS320F28335控制芯片对换能器输出电压和电流时刻进行相位捕捉;调整其相位差;促使换能器工作在最佳谐振状态。实验表明:与传统的频率跟踪方法相比;相位控制法采集频率速度更快;能加快系统的动态响应速度。
keywords: phase capture, resonance, transducer

title: Design of Dual-stator PMSM Control System Based on DSP
abstract: According to the demand of vehicle for large torque and high load rate;dual-stator permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) is choosen as research object.In order to realize the control of the system;the mathematical model of the double synchronous rotating coordinate system is established by coordinate transformation;and the control strategy is proposed based on the model.Then;a digital vector controller based on TMS320 F28335 digital signal processor(DSP) is designed;and the hardware and software systems are completed.The experimental results show that the control system has good performance;stability and reliability;and meets the requirements of vehicle power system.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对电动汽车大转矩驱动和高负载率行驶的需求;选用控制灵活的双定子永磁同步电机(PMSM)为研究对象。为实现其控制;通过坐标变换建立电机在双同步旋转坐标系下的数学模型;并基于此模型提出双绕组电流控制策略。在此基础上;设计了以TMS320F28335数字信号处理器(DSP)为控制核心的数字化矢量控制器;完成了硬件和软件系统的研制。实验结果证明;该控制系统性能良好;稳定可靠;满足车用动力系统的要求。
keywords: control strategy, dual-stator permanent magnet synchronous motor, system design
authors: SONG Jian-guo;MIAO Shi-liang;ZHANG Chen-hao;Engineering Research Center of Digital Community;Ministry of Education and Beijing Laboratory for Urban Mass Transit;Beijing University of Technology;

title: Design of Automobile Tire Pressure Monitoring System Based on CC2530 Technology
abstract_in_chinese: 基于CC2530和SP12技术优势;建立一种低功耗、低成本、低时延的汽车胎压实时检测结构模型;设计易扩充、易维护的无线终端节点模块和中控模块硬件电路及其程序代码。测试结果证明;本设计能精确反应汽车轮胎压力的变化;不仅可以及早发现轮胎故障;提高汽车行驶安全性;还可以提高汽车操纵稳定性、延长轮胎使用寿命。

title: Research of Speed Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of quick response and strong robustness for PMSM(Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor) speed control; after analyzing the mathematical model of PMSM and discrete wavelet transform algorithm; a speed controller was designed with an optimal mother wavelet transform function of "db4" and a decomposition level of 2. Based on the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform; a PMSM drive system simulation model and a control system code model were established; and using the experiment platform based on the TMS320F2812 DSP(Digital Signal Processing) of permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system; the performance of the discrete wavelet transform speed controller was verified by simulation and experiment. The simulation and experiment results indicated that compared with the traditional PID(Proprotional Integral Derivative) controller; the discrete wavelet transform speed controller improved the dynamic response speed to get to a steady state and; when the load abruptly changed; it showed a small speed drop and had strong anti-load-disturbance ability. Therefore; it is an effective method to promote the robustness and stability of permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对永磁同步电机驱动系统转速快响应和强鲁棒性的速度控制需求;在分析永磁同步电机数学模型和离散小波变换技术的基础上;设计了最优小波函数为"db4";分解级数为2的永磁同步电机离散小波变换速度控制器;并基于Matlab/Simulink仿真平台;建立了永磁同步电机(Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor; PMSM)驱动系统仿真模型和控制系统代码模型;结合基于TMS320F2812 DSP(Digital Signal Processing)的永磁同步电机驱动系统实验平台;通过负载扰动工况仿真、空载阶跃输入工况仿真与实验来验证永磁同步电机离散小波变换速度控制器的性能.仿真和实验结果表明:相比于传统比例积分微分(Proprotional Integral Derivative; PID)速度控制器;离散小波变换速度控制器达到稳态转速的速度更快;动态性能更优;在负载突变时;转速跌落小;抗负载扰动能力更强;是一种提升永磁同步电机速度控制器鲁棒性和稳定性的有效方法.

title: Design of Vehicle Recognition System Based on Single Chip Microcomputer
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent vehicle identification system based on MCU. CC2530 is used as the core processor; radio frequency RC522 module is used to collect vehicle information; and OLED is used to display data. When the vehicle identification card enters the card reading area; the induction card reader collects the IC card signal and transmits it to the MCU for processing. Then the MCU transmits it to the OLED LCD screen; displaying the license plate information of the vehicle; including the ID number of the IC card and the owner's name; and finally uploads it to the PC. The system uses radio frequency identification technology to realize intelligent identification and management of vehicle information.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文设计了基于单片机的车辆智能识别系统;采用CC2530为核心处理器;无线射频RC522模块进行车辆信息采集;OLED进行数据显示。当车辆识别卡进入读卡区时;感应读卡器收集到IC卡信号后;会传送给单片机进行处理;然后由单片机传输给OLED液晶屏;显示出这个车辆的车牌信息;包括IC卡的ID号码以及车主姓名;最后上传给上位机。本系统采用无线射频识别技术实现了对车辆信息的智能识别和管理。

title: Research on control strategy of single-phase voltage type full-bridge inverter
abstract: Since the traditional single-phase grid connected control strategy can make the system output contain numerous harmonics;the basic operation principle and the topology of the single phase full-bridge inverter are analyzed in this paper. The virtual vector orthogonal to the actual current and voltage is constructed by using control mode based on virtual vector and the delay of the actual vector. The mathematical model is established respectively in two phase stationary coordinates and synchronous rotational coordinates. The related coupling components on the dq axis of the LCL type filter are decoupled by means of the block diagram equivalent method of feedforward compensation. The double closed-loop control strategy of capacitance current and grid connected current based on virtual vector is determined;which is verified by simulation experiment with Matlab simulation software. The DSP experiment platform based on TMS320 F28335 was built to verify the control strategy. The experimental results verified the correctness and effectiveness of the control strategy.
abstract_in_chinese: 传统的单相并网控制策略会使得系统的输出含有大量的谐波;该文对单相全桥逆变器的拓扑以及工作的基本原理进行分析;采用基于虚拟矢量的控制方式;利用对实际量的延迟;构建与实际电流、电压相正交的虚拟矢量;分别在两相静止坐标和同步旋转坐标下建立了数学模型;利用前馈补偿的框图等效方法;对LCL型滤波器在dq坐标轴上相关的耦合分量;进行了解耦;确定了基于虚拟矢量的电容电流与并网电流双闭环控制策略;并利用Matlab仿真软件进行仿真验证。最后;搭建基于TMS320F28335的DSP实验平台;对控制策略进行了实验验证;其实验结果验证了控制策略的正确性和有效性。

title: Brushless DC Motor Control Based on Field Oriented Control Theory
abstract: Field oriented control(FOC) theory was the most common control method for permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM); which required instantaneous position of the rotor. This limited its application to brushless DC motor(BLDCM) using Hall position sensors. In order to apply the FOC theory to the control of BLDCM without increasing the cost of the motor; based on the existing Hall position sensor; an estimation method of the rotor precise position by calculating the average speed of the previous sector based on the output signal of the Hall sensor was proposed. This estimation method was simulated using MATLAB/Simulink software. The experimental system based on TMS320 F28069 DSP was built. The algorithm was programmed by automatic code generation technology. Both simulation and experiment results showed that the method could be used well in the control of BLDCM; and it could replace PMSM in some low cost applications.
abstract_in_chinese: 磁场定向控制(FOC)理论是永磁同步电机(PMSM)最常用的控制方法之一。该方法需要电机转子瞬时精确位置;因此限制了其在使用霍尔位置传感器的无刷直流电机(BLDCM)上的应用。为了能够在BLDCM上应用FOC理论;又不增加电机成本;在现有霍尔位置传感器的基础上;提出了一种根据霍尔传感器的输出信号;通过计算前一个扇区平均转速的方法估计转子精确位置。使用MATLAB/Simulink软件对该估算方法进行了仿真;并搭建了以TI的TMS320F28069 DSP为核心的试验系统;通过自动代码生成技术完成算法的编程;可以较好地应用于BLDCM的控制;在一些应用场合可以代替PMSM从而降低使用成本。

title: Partial Discharge Monitoring System of Ring Main Unit Based on Ultraviolet Pulse Detection and ZigBee Positioning Technology
abstract: In this paper;a discharge monitoring system using ultraviolet pulse detection and ZigBee technology was built. The characteristics of the discharge points were collected by a large number of UV photoelectric sensors distributed in the ring network cabinet;and the number of UV pulses was used to represent the partial discharge. The CC2530 chip supporting ZigBee protocol was used to form wireless networking with RSSI centroid positioning algorithm to achieve monitoring point positioning. Data was sent to the coordinator through the ZigBee node to achieve wireless serial communication;and finally sent to the real-time monitoring of the computer. The system could be popularized for discharge monitoring of electrical equipment such as RMU;switch cabinets;and indoor substations.
abstract_in_chinese: 搭建结合紫外光脉冲检测和ZigBee定位技术的放电监测系统。由分布在环网柜内的紫外光电管传感器采集放电点特征信息;实现紫外光脉冲个数表征局放量;采用支持ZigBee协议的CC2530芯片形成无线组网;结合RSSI质心定位算法实现监测点定位;数据通过ZigBee节点发送到协调器实现无线串口通信;最终在电脑端进行实时监测。该系统可推广用于环网柜、开关柜、室内变电站等的电气设备放电监测。

title: Research and Implementation of Three-Level Inverter Control Technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the topological structure and working principle of three-level inverter circuit; describes in detail the single-machine inverter control technology scheme and the multi-machine parallel inverter control technology scheme based on CAN bus; and points out that the three-level inverter control technology scheme can be applied to the modular fire emergency power supply product based on TMS320 F28335 control chip; which has realized the marketization at present.

title: Control and drive techniques for the high-precision buoyancy regulation device of UUV
abstract: In the analysis of buoyancy regulation device's framework and function; the controller and driver's hardware and program design for buoyancy regulation device is put forward. The core control chip of the controller and driver is TMS320 LF28335. In order to control the volume of the buoyancy regulation device more accurately; the control structure is consist of position closed-loop; speed closed-loop and current closed-loop. With the method of load the pump of the device by a simulated loading station; we verified the load performance of the controller and driver. Respectively;we validated the control precision of the volume control algorithm on the multi-stage hydraulic cylinder; which indicates the controller and driver in this article satisfied the performance requirements of the buoyancy regulation device.
abstract_in_chinese: 在分析高精度浮力调节装置结构及功能的基础上;提出了该装置的控制驱动器硬件及软件设计方案。该控制驱动器选用TMS320F28335作为主控制芯片;采用容积、速度、电流三闭环控制以实现控制驱动器对浮力调节装置容积的高精度控制;采用模拟加载台对该浮力调节装置中的泵进行加载试验;验证了该控制驱动器的带载性能;采用试验验证了基于多级液压缸的容积控制算法的控制精度;表明该控制驱动器能够满足高精度浮力调节装置的性能要求。
keywords: buoyancy regulation device, controller and driver, motor, pump, uuv

title: Rear leg control system of wheeled-legged climbing wheelchair based on fuzzy-PID
abstract: In order to realize the action requirements of the rear leg mechanism of wheelchair;a real-time control strategy should be designed. A compound fuzzy-PID control system for rear leg position and posture is designed by using TMS320 F2812 as the core control chip. Firstly;according to the functional requirements of the climbing wheelchair;the action requirements of the rear leg mechanism are given;and the reasonable installation position of the sensor is determined. Then;the hardware structure of the control system is built up;the fuzzy-PID control system model is set up;the control rules are made;and the software is developed. Finally;the monitoring interface of upper PC based on VC + + 6. 0 is constructed;and the control system is tested and analyzed. The experimental results show that the system reduces the overshoot and steady-state error in the regulation process to a certain extent;and improves the response speed.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现爬楼轮椅后腿机构的动作要求;需要一套实时控制策略。采用TMS320F2812作为核心控制芯片;设计了一种复合式模糊比例—积分—微分(PID)后腿位姿调节控制系统。首先;根据爬楼轮椅的功能需求;给出了后腿机构的动作要求;并确定出合理的传感器安装位置;然后;搭建了控制系统的硬件结构;建立了模糊PID控制系统模型;制定出控制规则;并进行了软件开发。最后;构建了基于VC++6. 0的上位机监控界面;并对该控制系统进行了测试和结果分析。实验结果表明:该系统在一定程度上降低了调节过程中的超调现象和稳态误差;提高了系统响应速度。
keywords: climbing wheelchair, fuzzy proportion-integration-differentiation(fuzzy-pid), position and posture adjustment, rear leg mechanism
authors: DI Weixiang;CAO Dongxing;ZHANG Qi;GAN Xiaomeng;College of Mechanical Engineering;Hebei University of Technology;
affiliations: 河北工业大学机械工程学院

abstract_in_chinese: 针对定点DSP在进行取自然对数运算时运算速度慢;无法满足日益增长的高速数字信号处理需求这一问题提出一种快速算法。该算法在分析浮点数据存储格式的基础上推导出该快速算法;并用C语言在TMS320C6455平台上进行了仿真实现;仿真验证了该算法可以极大提高取自然对数运算速度。

title: Design of Ward Call System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Based on the wireless communication technology; aiming at the problem of inconvenient communication between ward and medical staff;develops a medical ward call system based on ZigBee wireless technology by using low-power chip CC2530 and Z-stack protocol stack of TI company and IAR software design platform. ZigBee node is used as the terminal of the ward pager; and three call levels are set: emergency rescue; dressing change and life help; which are triggered by buttons respectively. The patient triggers the key pager to send the call information to the coordinator; which sends it to the upper computer through the serial port. The upper computer displays the call information sent from the ward on the screen. The nurse judges the corresponding countermeasures through the information displayed on the computer.
abstract_in_chinese: 以无线通信技术为手段;针对病房与医护人员间的通信不便的问题;用低功耗芯片CC2530结合TI公司的Z-Stack协议栈;以IAR软件设计平台开发基于ZigBee无线技术的医疗病房呼叫系统。以ZigBee节点做为病房呼叫器的终端;设置三个呼叫等级:紧急抢救、换药和生活帮助;分别按键触发。病患触发按键呼叫器把呼叫信息发送给协调器;由协调器通过串口发送给电脑上位机;上位机在屏幕上显示病房里发来呼叫信息。护士通过电脑上位机显示的信息判断相应的应对措施。
keywords: cc2530, ward calling system, zigbee
authors: LIU Xue-feng;SUN Wen-hui;Qingdao University of Technology;
affiliations: 青岛工学院

title: Design and research of a novel soft switching half bridge converter
abstract: Increasing the voltage gain of the Direct Current(DC) boost circuit of the DC energy-fed electronic load has theoretical and practical value for improving the working characteristics of the energy-feeding electronic load. This paper presents a zero-voltage switching active clamp current-fed half-bridge isolated voltage doubling step-up converter. The primary side clamp switch of the converter shares a clamp capacitor; which reduces the circuit components the secondary side uses a voltage doubling diode rectifier to further increase the voltage gain. The converter controls the duty cycle of the switching tube through the DSP TMS320 F28035; so that all switching tubes in the entire load range realize zero voltage turn-on and realize constant current input. Running the experimental prototype; the output voltage is 79.5 V and the voltage gain is 16; which verifies that the converter has the function of increasing the voltage gain.
abstract_in_chinese: 提高直流能馈电子负载的直流升压电路的电压增益;对提高能馈电子负载的工作特性具有理论意义和实用价值。提出了一种零电压开关有源箝位电流馈电半桥隔离倍压整流升压变换器。该变换器初级侧箝位开关共用一个箝位电容器;减少了电路元件次级侧采用倍压二极管整流器;进一步提升了电压增益。该变换器通过DSP TMS320F28035控制开关管的占空比;使整个负载范围内所有开关管实现了零电压开通并实现了恒流输入。运行实验样机;得到的输出电压为79.5 V;电压增益为16;验证了变换器具有提高电压增益的功能。
keywords: active clamp, current-fed, high gain, isolated boost converter, voltage doubling rectifier, zero voltage switching
affiliations: 江南大学电气工程与智能装备研究所
source: 电子测量技术 ;Electronic Measurement Technology ; Editorial E-mail ;2019(11)

abstract_in_chinese: 为了提升用户家居生活体验;更好的帮助用户实现智能化家居生活;本文以ZigBee无线通信技术为基础;设计了一种物联网智能家居系统。本系统以CC2530芯片为核心建立ZigBee协调器和终端模块;配合各种传感器和执行器;实现了温湿度采集、光照采集、空气质量采集、照明电路控制、红外报警控制等系统功能。通过ZigBee无线网络的组建;系统实现了数据的上下传输;再配合上位机的应用软件;可以方便用户对系统进行控制和操作;最终形成了一套稳定、高效、可扩展的系统;实现了智能家居的网络化、人性化。

title: 基于MSP430和CC2530的环境监测系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 近年来;无线通讯技术和微机处理技术的融合应用成为设施农业环境监控系统的关键技术。本文基于MSP430单片机和CC2350芯片设计的无线环境数据监测系统能够实现多个环境数据的实时采集、无线传输、远程监测;系统具有低功耗、多节点、响应快、性能稳定等特点。

title: 基于TMS320F2812的ARINC429总线通信软件设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对现代总线控制管理计算机系统的发展趋势;结合某型飞机航空通信总线控制管理的实际需求;设计了一种基于TMS320F2812的ARINC429总线通信软件。运行在DSP TMS320F2812上;负责ARINC429总线通信的控制和管理;ARINC429协议芯片采用DEI1016和BD429相配合方式;软件通过读写FPGA逻辑地址对协议芯片进行访问和数据处理;实现了ARINC429总线系统的通信需求。软件做了有效的测试;结果表明本设计满足航空电子系统总线控制、管理和通信的要求。
affiliations: 航空工业西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 基于模糊PR控制的单相锁相环设计
abstract: At present;the generalized integrator has been widely used in PLL design. In order to solve the problem that PI control in PLL is difficult to keep the input signal and control parameters unchanged without static error;PR controller is proposed to replace PI controller to adjust PLL. At the same time;the fuzzy controller is added to solve the problem that the control parameters in the generalized integrator are constant and can not adapt to the influence of uncertain factors such as parameter changes and system disturbances in the control process. The feasibility of single-phase PLL based on Fuzzy PR control is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation model;and TMS320 F28335 is used as the control core to build a singlephase PLL test prototype based on Fuzzy PR control. From the simulation results and experimental platform waveforms;it can be concluded that the optimization method can improve the accuracy and anti-interference ability of single-phase PLL to a certain extent.
abstract_in_chinese: 目前;广义积分器在锁相环设计中已经得到了广泛应用。针对锁相环中PI调节较难做到无静差跟踪输入信号与控制参数固定不变而影响锁相效果的问题;提出以PR控制器代替PI控制器调节锁相环;同时加入模糊控制器以解决广义积分器中控制参数恒定不变、在控制过程中无法适应参数变化和系统扰动等不确定因素影响的问题。通过Matlab/Simulink搭建仿真模型验证基于模糊PR控制的单相锁相环的可行性;并以TMS320F28335作为控制核心;搭建了一台基于模糊PR控制的单相锁相环的试验样机进行验证。由仿真结果及实验平台波形可得出;该优化方法可以在一定程度上提高单相锁相环的准确性和抗干扰能力。
keywords: fuzzy control, pr control, second-order generalized integral, single phase phase-locked loop

title: 超声波电源匹配网络和频率跟踪系统的研究
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high power loss in traditional ultrasonic power supply;which causes the energy of transducer to drop or even stop vibration;the voltage and current at both ends of transducer are kept in the same phase by adjusting the switch frequency of ultrasonic power supply. In the way of series inductor;TMS320 F28335 control chip is used to capture the phase of output voltage and current;adjust the phase difference;and make the transducer work in the best resonant state. The experimental results show that:compared with the traditional frequency tracking method;the phase control method is faster in frequency acquisition and faster in dynamic response of the system.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统的超声波电源存在功率损耗高、致使换能器能量大幅度下降甚至停振的问题;通过调节超声波电源输出的开关频率;使得换能器两端的电压和电流保持同一相位;并且采用串联电感的方式;通过TMS320F28335控制芯片对换能器输出电压和电流时刻进行相位捕捉;调整其相位差;促使换能器工作在最佳谐振状态。实验表明:与传统的频率跟踪方法相比;相位控制法采集频率速度更快;能加快系统的动态响应速度。
keywords: phase capture, resonance, transducer

title: 基于Zigbee的太阳能雨水灌溉花卉系统的设计
abstract: In order to monitor and manage the growth of large-scale and different kinds of flowers in real time; a design scheme of intelligent flower management system based on Zigbee ad hoc network was proposed. The system consists of Zigbee sensor network; optical fiber supplement; solar power supply; water storage and water level detection. In the sensor network of the system; the sensor nodes are grouped and numbered to distinguish different flower growth information. The data are collected and processed by coordinator. The user inquires the flower information by inputting the number on the mobile terminal.; The project also has the function of optical fiber to supplement light in some areas with insufficient lighting; to promote photosynthesis; so that plants can grow normally. The project can achieve water-saving effect by watering different kinds of plants in different degrees and combining with rainwater storage part. The energy-consuming pumps in the system are supplied by solar energy to achieve energy-saving purposes. The system has the characteristics of green environmental protection and intelligent management; and has a good application prospect for large-scale places of flowers.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现对大规模以及不同种类花卉的生长状况进行实时监测和管理;提出一个基于Zigbee自组网的智能花卉管理系统的设计方案。系统由Zigbee传感CC2530网络部分;光纤补光部分;太阳能供电部分;蓄水及水位检测部分构成。系统的传感网络中;通过对各传感节点进行分组和编号;以区分不同的花卉生长信息;然后通过协调器对各数据进行汇总及处理;最后用户通过手机端输入编号查询各花卉信息。另外该项目还具有光纤补光功能;对某些采光不足的区域进行补光;促进其进行光合作用;使植物能正常生长。该项目预设不同类别的植物进行不同程度的浇水;再结合其中的雨水蓄集部分;能达到节水效果另外系统中耗能较大的水泵由太阳能进行供能;达到节能目的。该系统具有绿色环保、智能管理等特点;对于花卉规模较大的场所有很好的应用前景。
keywords: iot, optical fiber lighting, rainwater collection, smart flower watering, smart home, solar energy, zigbee
authors: DU Jiang;YANG Tao;GAO Song;SU Xuecai;HUANG Ganghua;GUO Jinxin;LIU Hongxin
affiliations: Beihua University, 北华大学电气与信息工程学院, College of Electrical and Information Engineering

title: Optimization of Temperature Compensation Of Air Posture Sensor
abstract: In this article CC2530 is the core of the compensation circuit;building the Zigbee internet of temperature sensor and posture sensor;getting real compensation.The range of compensation includes zero-voltage compensation and temperatue-sensitivity compensation.The experiment results show that:the sensitivity flowing because of environment temperature is smaller than ≤0.9%;the working temperature range expands from normal temperature to 35° C;in this range zero-voltage decreases from ≤0.24 Vto ≤0.007 V;lowering the sensitivity change based on the change of environment temperature;increasing the measurement of air posture sensor.
keywords: cc2530, ieee802.15.4, posture sensor, temperature compensation
affiliations: Informaation and computer department Anhui Institute of foreign economics and technology
source: The Journal of Shandong Agriculture and Engineering University.

title: Design of indoor environment monitoring system based on CC2530 and CC3200
abstract: An indoor environment monitoring system based on CC2530 and CC3200 is designed to realize real-time monitoring and storage management of indoor air temperature;air humidity;smoke concentration;indoor population and other environment parameters. The indoor environment parameters are collected in real time by means of the terminal nodes and the core processing unit CC2530. The ZigBee coordinating end is used to build a star network for wireless transmission of data. The ZigBee coordinator is connected to the upper computer and CC3200 respectively for communication by using the RS-232 serial port communication mode. The upper computer is used to conduct real-time monitoring and storage of the received data;and the CC3200 is used to upload the received data to the Web server by means of the WiFi;so as to provide a better way for users to monitor and store the indoor environment parameters.
keywords: data acquisition, data storage management, data upload, indoor environment monitoring, star network, system design
affiliations: Shenzhen Key Laboratory of Electromagnetic Control,Shenzhen University, CIMC Intelligent Technology Company Limited,Shenzhen

title: 基于ZigBee技术的智能草莓大棚控制系统设计
abstract: 近几年;物联网行业迅猛发展;物联网的定义是指通过射频识别;红外感知;全球定位系统;激光扫描等信息传感设备;按照约定的协议。把何物体与互联网连接起来;进行信息交换和通信;以实现智慧化识别定位、跟踪监控和管理的一种网络。由于传统草莓大棚管理繁琐;人力成本高;效率低;我们将物联网技术与传统大棚相结合;设计了一种基于ZigBee的智能草莓大棚控制系统。本文主要通过ZigBee网络;终端节点采集出来信息;发送给协调器;反馈到PC机进行数据对比;判断并作出对策使棚内温度、湿度、CO2浓度等指标控制在正常范围内。
keywords: cc2530, internet of things, zigbee, 智能草莓大棚
affiliations: 河北农业大学

title: Design of active power filter control system based-on the DSP
abstract: Aiming at the fast tracking adaptability and good compensation effect of active power filter（APF）to power network parameters and load changes;a three-phase shunt active power filter control system was designed.The working principle of the filter was introduced and the mathematical model was established.And two strategies of detecting and compensating harmonics were expounded.On this basis;the system hardware platform taking DSP TMS320F2812 as the control core was built;and the system software was developed under the development environment of CCS2.2.Finally;the performance of the system was tested based on hardware and software.The results shows that the system can sample various control signals quickly and accurately;and the output of compensation current is correct.
keywords: active power filter, debugging, dsptms320f2812, harmonic suppression
affiliations: Xi′an Aeronautical Polytechnic Institute

title: Sliding Mode Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Fast Reaching Law
abstract: In order to reduce the torque ripple of the permanent magnet synchronous motor( PMSM);improve the ability of the system to adjust the speed adaptively;thereby reducing the system energy consumption and improving the endurance of the new energy electric vehicle;a new sliding mode approach law was designed.The control system under the new reaching law was compared with the traditional sliding mode control system and PI control system. The new sliding mode control algorithm was verified on the hardware circuit based on DSP chip TMS320 F28335.The parameters of the motor drive control system during operation were communicated with the host computer based on LabVIEW through the CAN protocol.The simulation results show that compared with the traditional exponential approach law and PI controller;the phase current quality and torque jitter of the designed control system motor were significantly improved;and the robustness of the system was improved.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了降低永磁同步电机的转矩波动;提高系统趋近速度自适应调节的能力;进而减少系统能量消耗;提高新能源电动汽车的续航能力;设计了一种新型滑模趋近律。并将新型趋近律下的控制系统与传统滑模控制系统及PI控制系统进行了比较。在基于TMS320F28335搭建的硬件电路上对新型滑模控制算法进行了验证。电机驱动控制系统在运行过程中的各项参数通过CAN协议与基于LabVIEW的上位机进行通讯。仿真实验结果表明;与传统指数趋近律以及PI控制器相比;该控制系统电机的相电流品质和转矩抖动得到明显的改善;同时提高了系统的鲁棒性。
keywords: electric vehicle, permanent magnet synchronous motor(pmsm), sliding-mode control(smc), vector control
authors: ZONG Xue-jun;ZHU Qing-xue;ZHANG Ju-hua;School of Information and Engineering;Shenyang University of Chemical Technology;
affiliations: 沈阳化工大学信息与工程学院

title: Research on a CPS-SPWM Realization Method in Cascaded H-bridge Multilevel Converter
abstract: The modulation principle of CPS-SPWM(carrier phase shift sinusoidal pulse width modulation) technology in cascaded H-bridge multilevel converter is analyzed and a specific implementation scheme based on TMS320 F28377 D processor is proposed. A 5-level cascaded H-bridge multilevel converter is tested by experiments. The results show that the CPS-SPWM technology can easily implemented by TMS320 F28377 D processor and the quality of the step voltage waveform output from the converter is higher. The design scheme reduces the hardware development costs and has a good application prospect.
abstract_in_chinese: 对级联H桥多电平变流器的CPS-SPWM技术调制原理进行分析;提出了基于TMS320F28377D处理器的CPSSPWM具体实现方案;并使用5电平级联H桥多电平变流器进行了实验验证。实验结果表明;TMS320F28377D处理器能够方便地实现CPS-SPWM技术;变流器输出的阶梯电压波形质量较高。该设计方案减少了硬件开发成本;具有较好的应用前景。
keywords: carrier phase shift, cascaded h-bridge converter, multilevel, sinusoidal pulse width modulation
authors: WU Ning;XIAO Jing;FENG Yubin;YANG Yiyun;Electric Power Research Institute of Guangxi Power Grid Co.; Ltd.;
affiliations: 广西电网有限责任公司电力科学研究院

title: Temperature and Humidity Wireless Monitoring System Based on ZigBee and WiFi
abstract: In order to realize the requirement of multi-point distributed temperature and humidity wireless monitoring;a wireless temperature and humidity monitoring system based on ZigBee and WiFi was designed. The system uses CC2530 as the core processor to connect multiple monitoring terminal nodes with coordinator node through ZigBee network;and used RTL8710 as the WiFi communication chip to transmit data to the host computer;while the coordinator node and RTL8710 are connected through serial port. The host computer displays the values and curves in real time and saves the data to the database. After testing;the system has the advantages of convenient networking;stable and reliable operation;and can meet the needs of multi-point distributed temperature and humidity wireless monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现多点分布式温湿度的无线监测需求;设计了基于ZigBee和WiFi的温湿度无线监测系统。该系统以CC2530为核心处理器;将多个监测终端节点与协调器节点通过ZigBee网络进行连接;以RTL8710为WiFi通信芯片将数据传输到上位机;而协调器节点与RTL8710之间则通过串口连接;上位机实时显示数值和曲线并将数据保存到数据库中。经过测试;该系统组网方便;运行稳定可靠;满足多点温湿度无线监测需求。
keywords: monitoring system, temperature and humidity measurement, wifi, wireless communication, zigbee
authors: FAN Xing-nan;Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering;Taiyuan University;
affiliations: 太原学院机械与电气工程系

title: Traction Inverter Multi-Section Synchronous SVPWM Strategy FPGA Program Design and Implementation
abstract: Due to low switching frequency of high-power traction drive system; in wide operation range of train; multi-mode modulation algorithm is widely adopted in the traction inverters. This paper presents a multi-mode modulation algorithm based on selective harmonic elimination pulse width modulation(SHEPWM) and studies the smooth switching method between different modulation modes. After that; a design and realization scheme of this modulation algorithm based on FPGA is given in detail; and the top-level design logic and communication method between DSP and FPGA chips are analyzed. Finally; the hardware-in-loop(HIL) RT-LAB experiment platform with DSP(TMS320 F28335) + FPGA(SPARTAN XC3 S400) controllers has been designed and developed; and the FPGA implementation scheme of multi-mode modulation algorithm is shown. HIL experimental results have verified the correctness of the adopted multi-mode modulation algorithm and the feasibility of the FPGA design.
abstract_in_chinese: 大功率牵引传动系统具有低开关频率的特点;在列车运行全速域范围内;牵引逆变器广泛采用多模式调制算法。该文给出了一种基于特定次谐波消除脉宽调制(SHEPWM)的多模式调制算法;并加入切换控制算法以保证不同模式之间平滑切换。然后;给出该算法基于现场可编程逻辑门阵列(FPGA)的详细设计方案;分析顶层设计逻辑和通信方法。最后;搭建基于DSP(TMS320F28335)+FPGA(SPARTAN XC3S400)为控制器的RT-LAB半实物实验平台;对该多模式调制算法进行了半实物实验研究;并给出多模式调制算法的FPGA实现设计方案。半实物实验结果验证了该算法的正确性和FPGA设计方案的可行性。

title: An Improved Strategy on Sliding Mode Variable Structure Method of PMSM
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive chattering of permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM)with traditional sliding mode variable structure control;an improved sliding mode observer was studied to reduce chattering. On the basis of constructing a hyperbolic tangent function to replace the traditional switching function;the speed and position signals of PMSM were calculated according to the motor back EMF. The improved sliding mode observer could effectively suppress the chattering problem of traditional sliding mode observer;reduce the influence of system disturbance on speed and rotor position estimation. Compared with traditional sliding mode observer;the dynamic performance and accuracy were improved. Finally;an experimental platform of TMS320 F2812 was built to verify the correctness and feasibility of the algorithm.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对基于传统型滑模变结构控制的永磁同步电机(PMSM)存在抖振过大的问题;主要研究一种改进的滑模观测器;用于减弱抖振问题;构造一种双曲正切函数替代传统的开关函数的基础上;根据电机反电势计算出电机的转速以及位置信号。改进型滑模观测器能有效地抑制传统型滑模观测器中的抖振过大问题;降低了系统干扰对转速及转子位置估计的影响;而且与传统滑模观测器相比;在动态性能和精度上都有所提高。最后搭建TI公司的TMS320F2812实验平台;验证了该算法的正确性及可行性。

title: Research on Control Strategy of a Solid State Transformer Isolated Stage DAB Converter
abstract: Solid-state transformer is a new type of electrical equipment which applies power electronics technology to power transformer. The isolation stage of solid-state transformer adopts DAB converter;which is suitable for high power applications and easy to realize ZVS(Zero-Voltage Switching). Based on phase-shifting control;the flow direction of power and energy is adjusted by changing phase-shifting duty cycle;by introducing compensation link in closed-loop control;static error of the system is eliminated and dynamic response speed is improved;the simulation model is built to verify the working state of the DAB converter under phase-shifting control;the experimental platform based on TMS320 F28335 verifies that the DAB converter can realize DC voltage conversion function and the output voltage can be stabilized at a set value. Finally;the power frequency AC voltage is generated through the inverter stage;which verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy.
abstract_in_chinese: 固态变压器是一种将电力电子技术运用到电力变压器中的新型电气设备。固态变压器隔离级采用DAB变换器;适用于大功率场合;易于实现零电压关联ZVS(Zero-Voltage Switching)。基于移相控制;通过改变移相占空比来调节传输功率和能量的流动方向;通过在闭环控制中引入补偿环节;消除了系统的静态误差;提高了动态响应速度;搭建仿真模型;验证了移相控制下DAB变换器的工作状态;通过基于TMS320F28335的实验平台验证了DAB变换器能够实现直流变压功能;并且输出电压能够稳定在设定值;最终经逆变级产生了工频交流电压;验证了控制策略的有效性。
keywords: closed-loop control, compensation link, dab converter, duty cycle, phase shift control

title: Real-time detection for critical parts of aerial reconnaissance balloons
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing image target detection method is difficult to take into account both accuracy and real-time performance;a algorithm based on curvature characteristic in polar coordinate system was proposed to detect the critical parts of reconnaissance balloons. Firstly; the image was subjected to a grayscale projection by calculating third-order post-difference.Then;the polar coordinates of the balloons were transformed and the balloon boundary was extracted.Finally;according to the curvature of the balloon boundary;the coordinates of the critical parts were determined.The algorithm used the curvature characteristics of balloon in polar coordinate system to detect the critical parts.Experimental results show that the algorithm can meet the requirements of accuracy and real-time;which can achieve a processing speed of 200 frames per second on DSP(TMS320 C6678) while maintaining a high detection accuracy of >94%.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对算法同时兼顾准确性与实时性这一现有图像目标检测方法难以解决的问题;提出一种在极坐标系统下的基于曲率特征的气球要害部位检测算法.该算法首先对图像进行灰度投影及三阶向后差分计算;然后对气球进行极坐标转换;并提取气球边界;最后;根据气球边界的曲率特征确定要害部位的位置.该算法利用气球在极坐标系统下的曲率特征进行要害部位的快速识别.实验结果表明:该算法能够同时满足准确性和实时性的要求;在DSP(TMS320C6678)上可处理200帧/s的红外视频;且有较高的检测准确率;检测准确率高于94%.
keywords: critical part, curvature characteristic, digital signal processing(dsp), object detection, reconnaissance balloon

title: Research on Action Path Tracking System of Atmospheric Pollution Particles based on Java Technology
abstract: In order to improve the tracking accuracy of the action path of atmospheric pollution particles and improve the control of atmospheric environmental pollution; the measurement model established by traditional C++ was abandoned and the Java technology was introduced to study the new tracking system of the action path of atmospheric pollutants. The core hardware of the system is particle sensor; which has built-in ultrasonic data probe. By applying the Arduino microcontroller and CC2530 docking device to the sensor framework; the internal sensing part is built using Light Weight fixed IP interface protocols and PPtruer communication protocol of particles path information monitoring. The transplantation was completed Based on Java technology; the adaptive characteristics and testing protocol; based on the current data node design transport nodes format; generating control registry; Starting from the three directions of inner; outer; ring and outer; the particle path obstacle avoidance was completed to generate the initial path; and finally the circular path error was eliminated to realize the path tracking.

keywords: air pollution, path error, path tracking, registry
authors: Chen Guozheng;Xinjiang Shihezi Vocational Technical College;

title: Optimization of Temperature Compensation Of Air Posture Sensor
abstract: In this article CC2530 is the core of the compensation circuit;building the Zigbee internet of temperature sensor and posture sensor;getting real compensation.The range of compensation includes zero-voltage compensation and temperatue-sensitivity compensation.The experiment results show that:the sensitivity flowing because of environment temperature is smaller than ≤0.9%;the working temperature range expands from normal temperature to 35° C;in this range zero-voltage decreases from ≤0.24 Vto ≤0.007 V;lowering the sensitivity change based on the change of environment temperature;increasing the measurement of air posture sensor.
abstract_in_chinese: CC2530作为传感器数据处理电路主要微控制器;建立温度传感器和水平姿态传感器的Zigbee网络;对姿态传感器的温度补偿及线性度补偿可以在线进行。结果显示因为温度变化引起的灵敏度变化下降到≤0.9%;工作温度范围从常温扩展到35°C;在这个工作温度范围内;零点电压的大小从≤0.25V下降到了≤0.008V;减少因为温度变化带来的灵敏度的变化;水平姿态传感器的测量准确度进一步提高。
keywords: cc2530, ieee802.15.4, posture sensor, temperature compensation
authors: Li Bai-hua;Qin jie;Informaation and computer department Anhui Institute of foreign economics and technology;

title: Research on WIFI Measurement on Temperature and Humidity in Agricultural IoT
abstract: Temperature and humidity are common physical quantities; while temperature and humidity can cause a qualitative change in a substance. The agricultural Internet of Things(IoT) temperature and humidity measurement system with CC3200 chip as the core is proposed to study the temperature and humidity measurement of WIFI in agricultural IoT. The sensor composition and electronic circuit are designed; and the block diagram of the main program flow chart of the IoT temperature and humidity measurement system and the block diagram of the temperature and humidity data acquisition flow are given; then the paper completes the hardware and software design of the system.
abstract_in_chinese: 温湿度是常见的物理量;但是温湿度可以使物质发生质的改变。基于此;提出以CC3200芯片为核心的农业物联网温湿度测量系统;对WiFi在农业物联网中温湿度的测量展开研究;设计了传感器组成与电子电路;给出物联网温湿度测量系统主程序流程图框图和温湿度数据采集流程框图;完成系统的硬件和软件设计。
keywords: cc3200 chip, data acquisition, iot, temperature and humidity
authors: Xie Shiyuan;Jiang Chongran;Wang Xilin;Wang Xu;Zhang Wendan;School of Information and Electronics Technology; Jiamusi University;Jiamusi University Jiamusi;School of Basic Medicine; Jiamusi University;
