title: Design of wireless monitoring system for power transformer based on ZigBee
abstract: The urban and rural distribution load is increasing day by day.The maintenance and overhaul of power transformers is also increasingly complicated.For the problem of complex wired data monitoring and monitoring rate reduction of power transformers;based on the working principle of power transformer monitoring;ZigBee communication mode is constructed as the guide;STM32 F417 is The software and hardware architecture of the wireless monitoring system of the power transformer of the main control unit proposes a layered monitoring strategy;which uses the distributed monitoring system to optimize the accuracy of the three performance characterization parameters of the voltage;temperature and insulation of the power transformer.The real-time live test of performance parameters was carried out in the experimental environment of the built monitoring system.The test results show that the designed monitoring strategy can achieve the high-precision data acquisition and fast monitoring rate of the power transformer.
abstract_in_chinese: 城乡配电负荷与日俱增;电力变压器的维护检修也日益复杂;针对电力变压器的有线数据监测复杂、监测速率下降的问题;在电力变压器监测工作原理的基础上;构建了ZigBee通信方式为导向;STM32F417和CC2530为主控单元的电力变压器的无线监测系统软硬件架构;提出了一种分层式的监测策略;利用该分布式监测系统对电力变压器的电压、温度以及绝缘3大性能表征参数进行精度优化;并在搭建的监测系统实验环境中进行性能参数实时仿真试验;试验结果表明;设计的监控策略能够实现电力变压器高精度的数据采集与快速的监测速率双重目标。
keywords: data monitoring, monitoring rate, power transformer, wireless monitoring system, zigbee communication
authors: Shi Linyun;College of Mechanical and Electrical Information;Baoji Vocational Technology College;
affiliations: 宝鸡职业技术学院机电信息学院

title: Design of active power filter control system based-on the DSP
abstract: Aiming at the fast tracking adaptability and good compensation effect of active power filter(APF)to power network parameters and load changes;a three-phase shunt active power filter control system was designed.The working principle of the filter was introduced and the mathematical model was established.And two strategies of detecting and compensating harmonics were expounded.On this basis;the system hardware platform taking DSP TMS320F2812 as the control core was built;and the system software was developed under the development environment of CCS2.2.Finally;the performance of the system was tested based on hardware and software.The results shows that the system can sample various control signals quickly and accurately;and the output of compensation current is correct.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对有源电力滤波器(APF)具有对电网参数及负载变化的快速跟踪适应能力和良好的补偿效果;设计了三相并联型有源电力滤波控制系统。介绍滤波器的工作原理并建立了数学模型;阐述了两种对谐波进行检测补偿控制的策略;然后在此基础上完成了以DSPTMS320F2812为控制核心的系统硬件平台搭建;并在CCS2.2开发环境下对系统软件进行了开发;最后基于软硬件完成了对系统性能的测试。结果表明;系统对各种控制信号的采样迅速、准确;补偿电流的输出正确。
keywords: active power filter, debugging, dsptms320f2812, harmonic suppression
authors: Liu Shaojun;Wang Yuyu;Xi′an Aeronautical Polytechnic Institute;

title: DESIGN OF GAS WALL-HUNG BOILER REMOTE MONITORING SYSTEM BASED ON ANDROID
abstract: In order to realize the monitoring of indoor temperature without central heating in winter; this paper designed a gas boiler remote monitoring system based on Android. The system used CC2530 to form a star wireless sensor network. The sensor node transmitted the measured temperature and harmful gas concentration information to the coordinator. The coordinator transmitted the data to the cloud server through the connected W5500 gateway. Finally; the data was displayed on Android phone APP. APP could send commands through mobile phone; and the coordinator controlled the intelligent switch connect with the gas boiler; thus realizing the adjustment of indoor temperature. The experimental results show that the acquisition and remote real-time control of indoor temperature are realized by mobile APP. When the harmful gas exceeds the standard; the gas boiler can be automatically closed. The system is safe; economical and practical; and has been successfully implemented and applied.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现在冬季对无集中供暖室内温度的监控;设计基于Android的燃气壁挂炉远程监控系统。该系统以CC2530组成星型无线传感器网络;由传感器节点把测得的温度、有害气体浓度等信息传递给协调器;协调器通过相连的W5500网关;把数据传递给云端服务器;最终将数据显示在Android手机的APP中。手机APP可以发送命令;通过协调器控制与燃气壁挂炉相连接的智能开关;从而实现对室内温度的调节。实验结果表明;通过手机APP实现了对室内温度的采集和远程实时控制;在有害气体超标时能使燃气壁挂炉自动关闭。该系统安全经济实用;并已成功实现并应用。
keywords: android, cloud server, data acquisition, remote control, smart switch

title: Research on Communication Network Architecture of Smart Home
abstract: Reliable and applicable communication network is an important part of smart home. A typical home communication network can be composed of terminal;main gateway;server and client.The terminal adopts the ZigBee protocol microprocessor CC2530 launched by TI company;and forms the ZigBee LAN;including nodes;routers and coordinators.The main gateway adopts mediatech7688 hardware +OpenWrt system;and USES the open platform of China mobile Internet of things as the server background to realize data interaction.The feasibility of the intelligent home communication network architecture is verified through the test of temperature and humidity status display and remote operation of platoon and plug.
abstract_in_chinese: 可靠、适用的通讯网络是智能家居的重要组成环节;一个典型的家居通讯网络可以由终端、主网关、服务器、客户端所组成。其中终端采用TI公司推出的具有ZigBee协议的微处理器CC2530;并构成ZigBee局域网;包括节点、路由器、协调器;主网关采用联发科7688硬件+OpenWrt系统;使用中移物联网开放平台做服务器后台;实现数据的交互。通过温湿度状态显示以及排插远程操作的测试;验证了智能家居通信网络架构的可行性。

title: Bluetooth 4.0 Item Label Recognition System Based on CC2540
abstract: With TI CC2540 ultra-low power bluetooth chip system as the core device; a set of built-in BLE4.0 protocol item label automatic identification and alarm system is designed. The hardware framework and software flow of Bluetooth wireless communication item label recognition are described. The system seamlessly interfaces with the BLE4.0 protocol item label and is designed around minimal power consumption; which has the characteristics of low power consumption; miniaturization; good reliability and low production cost.

keywords: antenna and matching circuit, ble4.0, cc2540, item tag recognition, over distance alarm

title: Design of Intelligent Domestic Monitoring System
abstract: According to the protection of the children; elders and disables; a domestic monitoring system with mobile phone reminder and intelligent lighting was designed. The system adopted modular structure. Monitoring terminal with CC2530 microcontroller as the core realized the sensor data acquisition; signal sending or receiving and automatic lighting. The gateway included ZigBee coordinator and RT5350 module. Its function is to realize the communication between terminal and mobile phone. When the phone received the terminal button or sensor signal; it vibrates and rings a bell to remind the monitor. The phone can also control the lamp on the terminal. The communication quality of the system is good and the performance is stable. It is flexible and convenientvery much. It can meet the needs of homemonitoring well.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对小孩、老人或行动不便人员的监护;设计了一种具有手机提醒和智能照明功能的家用监护系统。系统采用模块化结构;监护终端以CC2530单片机为核心;实现传感数据采集、信号发送和接收、自动照明;网关包括ZigBee协调器和RT5350模块;实现终端和手机之间的通信;手机接收到终端按钮或声音传感的信号时;震动并响铃提醒;且能通过APP控制终端上的灯。该系统通信质量好、性能稳定且灵活方便;满足了家庭监护的需求。
keywords: android, domestic monitoring, sensor, wifi, zigbee

title: Real-time detection for critical parts of aerial reconnaissance balloons
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing image target detection method is difficult to take into account both accuracy and real-time performance;a algorithm based on curvature characteristic in polar coordinate system was proposed to detect the critical parts of reconnaissance balloons. Firstly; the image was subjected to a grayscale projection by calculating third-order post-difference.Then;the polar coordinates of the balloons were transformed and the balloon boundary was extracted.Finally;according to the curvature of the balloon boundary;the coordinates of the critical parts were determined.The algorithm used the curvature characteristics of balloon in polar coordinate system to detect the critical parts.Experimental results show that the algorithm can meet the requirements of accuracy and real-time;which can achieve a processing speed of 200 frames per second on DSP(TMS320 C6678) while maintaining a high detection accuracy of >94%.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对算法同时兼顾准确性与实时性这一现有图像目标检测方法难以解决的问题;提出一种在极坐标系统下的基于曲率特征的气球要害部位检测算法.该算法首先对图像进行灰度投影及三阶向后差分计算然后对气球进行极坐标转换;并提取气球边界最后;根据气球边界的曲率特征确定要害部位的位置.该算法利用气球在极坐标系统下的曲率特征进行要害部位的快速识别.实验结果表明:该算法能够同时满足准确性和实时性的要求;在DSP(TMS320C6678)上可处理200帧/s的红外视频;且有较高的检测准确率;检测准确率高于94%.
keywords: critical part, curvature characteristic, digital signal processing(dsp), object detection, reconnaissance balloon

title: Digitized Implementation of Beat-frequency Suppression Algorithm Based on One-cycle Control for Traction Motors
abstract: The AC-DC-AC transmission system has been widely used in railway locomotive systems. Due to the potential characteristics of the single-phase rectifier; there exists DC-link voltage fluctuation with twice of the grid frequency. In order to meet the train lightweight requirements;when there is no LC resonant circuit; beat-less control strategy is one of the effective solutions. First; this paper analyzed the mechanism of the beat frequency phenomenon. Then; the principle of beat-frequency suppression based on traditional modulation compensation and frequency compensation was analyzed; respectively. On this basis; according to the traditional analog one-cycle control(OCC) idea; a digital OCC scheme based on voltage linear interpolation compensation was presented; to suppress the beat frequency phenomenon in the square wave region. Combined with multi-mode modulation;the overshoot problem of switching transition between segmented synchronous modulation and square-wave mode with OCC scheme was solved. A RT-LAB hardware in-loop experimental platform with TMS320 F28335 DSP +SPARTAN6 FPGA controller was used to compare and verify the three beat frequency suppression algorithms with traditional modulation compensation; frequency compensation and OCC. The experimental results show that the adopted digital OCC scheme can effectively suppress the beat frequency phenomenon; and can realize the smooth switching from the segment synchronous modulation mode to square wave mode with OCC scheme.
abstract_in_chinese: 交直交传动系统广泛应用于铁路系统中。由于单相整流器自身特点;其输出直流电压存在两倍电网频率的脉动。为满足列车轻量化要求;在取消LC谐振电路的情况下;研究拍频抑制控制策略是解决方案之一。该文首先分析拍频现象的产生机理然后;分别分析传统调制度补偿和频率补偿的拍频抑制算法原理;在此基础上;基于传统模拟单周期控制(one-cycle control;OCC)思想;给出一种基于电压线性插值补偿的数字化单周期控制算法;将其应用于方波区;可有效实现对拍频现象的抑制;并结合多模式调制算法的特点;解决了分段同步调制与单周期方波控制之间的切换冲击问题。基于DSP TMS320F28335+FPGA SPARTAN6为控制器的RT-LAB半实物实验平台;分别对传统调制度补偿、频率补偿和单周期控制的3种拍频补偿算法进行半实物实验对比验证;实验结果表明:该数字单周期控制拍频补偿算法可有效抑制拍频现象;且可以实现分段同步调制与单周期方波区控制的平稳切换。
keywords: beat-less control, linear interpolation fitting, one-cycle control, smooth switching, zero-order hold error

title: Design of indoor environment monitoring system based on CC2530 and CC3200
abstract: An indoor environment monitoring system based on CC2530 and CC3200 is designed to realize real-time monitoring and storage management of indoor air temperature;air humidity;smoke concentration;indoor population and other environment parameters. The indoor environment parameters are collected in real time by means of the terminal nodes and the core processing unit CC2530. The ZigBee coordinating end is used to build a star network for wireless transmission of data. The ZigBee coordinator is connected to the upper computer and CC3200 respectively for communication by using the RS-232 serial port communication mode. The upper computer is used to conduct real-time monitoring and storage of the received data;and the CC3200 is used to upload the received data to the Web server by means of the WiFi;so as to provide a better way for users to monitor and store the indoor environment parameters.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了更灵活地实现室内空气温度、空气湿度、烟雾浓度值、室内人数等环境参数实时监控与存储管理;设计一种基于CC2530与CC3200的室内环境监测系统。以CC2530为核心处理单元;通过终端节点对室内环境参数进行实时采集;利用ZigBee协调端建立星型网络进行数据无线传送;并采用RS 232串口通信方式将ZigBee协调器分别与上位机和CC3200进行通信。最终上位机对接收到的数据进行实时监控与存储;CC3200对接收到的数据通过WiFi的形式上传到Web服务器;从而为用户对室内环境参数监测与存储提供更好的途径。
keywords: data acquisition, data storage management, data upload, indoor environment monitoring, star network, system design

abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统的环境采集系统存在的诸多局限性;本文基于ZigBee协议栈在2.4GHz的开放频段上搭建一个无线传感网络监控系统。该系统主要由温湿度传感器模块、烟雾传感器模块、无线传输模块、串口传输模块和显示模块等组成;以协调器为中心;采集各个分散终端的温湿度信息并实时显示;从而完成对一片区域的环境监测。系统硬件电路采用了射频CC2530芯片、DHT11传感器、MQ2传感器和显示屏OLED12864等关键器件;并完成了软件设计。经测试;系统能在50米范围内实现无线温湿度采集和实时显示功能。该系统的优点是使用简单、成本低廉、功能完善;在智慧农业领域有较好的应用前景。

abstract_in_chinese: 随着科技的不断进步;人民生活水平持续提高;人们对于家居环境中空气质量的要求也在不断的提高;我们目前知道甲醛、PM2;5(可入肺细颗粒物)、CO等物质是在室内中对于空气进行污染的主要物质成分。在家居生活中这些物质的出现不仅仅污染了空气环境更是对于人的身体健康造成了严重威胁。本文提出了一种家居空气环境质量提高的解决方案;该方案基于ZigBee技术利用CC2530芯片通过家居环境空气传感器硬件来检测与采集空气中各项检测指标数据;并将数据通过传输子节点传到无线的监控设备如计算机、云平台等;从而上传到云端平台。通过数据比对;如果采集数据高于标准值范围;平台控制执行设备来改善空气质量;如采集数据在标准范围之内则空气改善执行设备不工作。

title: 无人值守的点滴智能监测控制系统

title: 气流式水平姿态传感器的温度补偿优化
abstract: In this article CC2530 is the core of the compensation circuit;building the Zigbee internet of temperature sensor and posture sensor;getting real compensation.The range of compensation includes zero-voltage compensation and temperatue-sensitivity compensation.The experiment results show that:the sensitivity flowing because of environment temperature is smaller than ≤0.9%the working temperature range expands from normal temperature to 35° Cin this range zero-voltage decreases from ≤0.24 Vto ≤0.007 V;lowering the sensitivity change based on the change of environment temperature;increasing the measurement of air posture sensor.
abstract_in_chinese: CC2530作为传感器数据处理电路主要微控制器;建立温度传感器和水平姿态传感器的Zigbee网络;对姿态传感器的温度补偿及线性度补偿可以在线进行。结果显示因为温度变化引起的灵敏度变化下降到≤0.9%工作温度范围从常温扩展到35°C在这个工作温度范围内;零点电压的大小从≤0.25V下降到了≤0.008V;减少因为温度变化带来的灵敏度的变化;水平姿态传感器的测量准确度进一步提高。
keywords: cc2530, ieee802.15.4, posture sensor, temperature compensation

title: Multifunction LED light control system based on CC2530
abstract: The LED lighting system has been widely applied to smart home with the continuous development of semiconductor technology. Aiming at the problems of wiring difficulty and simple function of LED control system at present;A multifunction LED light wireless control system based on CC2530 was proposed in this paper.In order to meet the different needs of the human;achieve energy-saving and get environmental protection;green lighting. This system realized any dimming and color grading function of LED light through two steps. Fist; It must get the relationship between the chromaticity coordinates and the duty cycle. Second;The duty cycle of R;G;B three LED lamps were controlled by PWM. The experiment proved that this system can satisfy with the requirements of smart home lighting and can be widely applied to home decoration.
keywords: cc253, multifunction led light, pwm signal, trichromatic

abstract: Based on short-range wireless communication technology;a wireless monitoring system of propellant gas is developed and the data monitoring of propellant gas concentration is realized.Using the ZigBee signal in the transmission of signal strength parameters;the design algorithm carries on the calculation of communication distance.So as to realize the position location of the system for the positioning terminal.System hardware is based on CC2530 and Z-Stack protocol stack;software is based on IAR Embedded Workbench for 8051 and Visual Studio 2012 platform.

title: SDI high definition image processing system based on FPGA ＆ DSP
abstract: In view of the large amount of computation and high real-time requirement in the process of video image processing;this paper designs a DSP+FPGA high-definition image real-time processing system based on SDI interface;which mainly includes hardware circuit design and software programming debugging.The main processor of the system adopts Xilinxseries of Spartan-6FPGA and TMS320C6748 DSP of TICompany.Data receiving and transmitting units adopt two new chips;GV7704 and GV7700;which are newly listed by SEMTECHCompany.The system software part includes data acquisition and logic control on the FPGA;data reception and processing on the DSP;and data communication between the two through the UPP and EMIF interfaces.The experimental results show that the system can realize the acquisition of the video image of the SDI camera;and output the imagedata through the VGA interfacecircuit;with high definition.
keywords: dsp, fpga, hd-sdi, image processing

In this paper;the hardware and software of endpoint detection of voice signal are designed;and the automatic endpoint detection of voice signal is realized.

abstract: With the rapid development of Zigbee wireless sensor communication technology and WIFI communication technology;in order to realize android mobile terminal wireless collection of illumination information and control stepper motor devices functions;a system is designed based on Android Studio development platform to realize the acquisition of illumination information and stepper motor control operation using JAVA programming.The system hardware is composed of intelligent gateway modules based on CC2530 chip and ESP8266 chip;Zigbee terminal communication module;photosensitive sensor and stepper motor equipment.The experimental results demonstrate that the system performance is stable and the operation is convenient with certain application prospects.

title: Study on tri-axial array induction experimental device
abstract: There is no tri-axial induction logging tool independently-developed in China. Therefore;an experimental device was developed for the tri-axial array induction. The sine waves of 6 kHz and 18 kHz were generated by DDS integration chip AD9833 which is controlled by the main chip TMS320F2812;and sent to transmitter coil system after power amplification. The data processing and transmissions are performed by EP4CE6E22C8 and TMS320F2812 after the received signal is sampled by AD7606. The receiving signals obtained by measuring the coil systems in horizontal direction and vertical direction show that the receiving voltage in the horizontal direction is less than that of in the vertical direction;and the experimental results are consistent with theoretical analysis. The device is suitable for the study of response characteristics of the tri-axial array induction;and provides the experimental basis for the design of the actual instrument.
keywords: array induction, coil system, receiving circuit, response characteristic, transmitting circuit, tri-axial

abstract: zigbee技术作为一种快捷、低功耗、低成本的无线传感器技术在物联网应用领域得到了较好的应用。本文以CC2530位核心底板;则由选择了部分环境监测传感器;实现了对小型花卉生长环境的实时监测。该系统从网络搭建、数据采集、数据传输和上位机处理模块;实现对小型花卉中不同植物的生长环境进行检测、控制;对于借助于无线传输技术推广物联网技术的应用起到了积极的作用;并进行了实地的测试和跟踪实验。

abstract: A missile-borne SAR（synthetic aperture radar） signal processing system based on the hardware structure of the cooperative processing of FPGA and DSP is presented in this paper in view of the heavy calculation and the poor real time performance. The XC2VP30 of Xilinx company and TMS320C6416 of TI company is used to realize the preprocessing of echo data and the processing of imaging algorithm respectively. title: Wireless monitoring of dust concentration based on laser sensor in sheet metal spraying
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of dust concentration in spraying process of sheet metal surface; a wireless monitoring technology of dust concentration based on laser sensor was proposed. The optical detection structure was designed by using the dust concentration measurement algorithm of laser scattering method. The dust concentration information collected by laser sensor is sent to the PC of the control room for visual display by using wireless ZigBee network based on the CC2530 chip. The dust concentration in sheet metal spraying chamber measured by laser sensor was compared with that measured by traditional weighing method. The results showed that the measurement error of laser sensor meets the requirements of sheet metal spraying process.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对钣金表面喷涂处理过程中对粉尘浓度的要求;提出了一种基于激光传感器的粉尘浓度无线监控技术。利用激光散射法的粉尘浓度测量算法设计了光学检测结构;利用基于CC2530芯片的无线ZigBee网络将激光传感器采集到的粉尘浓度信息发送到总控室PC上进行可视化显示。对比激光传感器测量的钣金喷涂室粉尘浓度与传统称重法的结果可知;激光传感器的测量误差满足钣金喷涂工艺要求。
keywords: automatization, dust concentration, laser sensor, monitoring, sheet metal spraying, wireless network

title: Design of a Digital Voltage Regulator for Aircraft HVDC Generator
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large size;heavy weight and slow response of traditional aircraft voltage regulator;a digtal voltage regulator suitable for aircraft high voltage DC power supply system is designed. The voltage regulator adopts DSP(TMS320 F2812) as the control core. Through the design of matching hardware and software;the integration of voltage regulation and protection is realized;the volume weight of the voltage regulator is reduced;and the restarting step of the aircraft generator is simplified. Compared with traditional aircraft analog voltage regulators;it has the advantages of fast response;small error;easy ground maintenance and easy debugging.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决传统飞机电压调节器体积重量大、反应慢的问题;该文设计了一种适用于飞机高压直流电源系统的数字式电压调节器。该电压调节器采用DSP(TMS320F2812)作为控制核心;通过设计配套的硬件及软件;实现了调压与保护的一体化;减小了电压调节器的体积重量;简化了飞机发电机的重启步骤。与传统飞机模拟式电压调节器相比;具有响应快、误差小、易于地面维护、便于调试的优点。

title: Design of Wireless Window Control System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: In this paper; a wireless intelligent window control system is designed based on ZigBee technology. It is composed of PC monitoring center; coordinator; ZigBee network module and each window control node. The hardware module is mainly the hardware circuit of the terminal node designed for wireless window control system based on the CC2530 chip. It is divided into power module and drive module. The power module is used for motor power supply; and the drive module is used for motor control. The software is mainly designed for the purposes of wireless window control. The design of the whole system is not only for intelligent control; but also for effective energy saving.
abstract_in_chinese: 本设计是基于ZigBee技术对窗控系统的一种无线智能控制;系统整体由PC监控中心、协调器、ZigBee网络模块和各窗控节点共同构成。硬件模块主要是基于CC2530芯片设计制作无线窗控系统终端节点的硬件电路;分为电源模块和驱动模块;其中电源模块用于电机供电;驱动模块用于控制电机;软件部分主要针对无线窗控系统所需要实现的功能予以设计。整个无线窗控系统的设计既能满足智能控制的要求;又能实现资源的有效节能。
keywords: cc2530, energy saving, intelligent control, zigbee

title: Hardware and Software Design of Endpoint Detection of Voice Signal Based on TMS320F28335
abstract: The endpoint detection of voice signal is the key technology to realize seamless connection between telephone and radio station. This technology is widely used in voice scheduling of air traffic control communication;voice scheduling of coastal radio station communication and voice scheduling of emergency communication. In this paper;the hardware and software of endpoint detection of voice signal are designed;and the automatic endpoint detection of voice signal is realized.
abstract_in_chinese: 语音信号的端点检测是实现电话与无线电台无缝连接的关键技术。这种技术广泛应用于空管通信的语音调度、海岸电台通信的语音调度以及应急通信的语音调度。因此;设计了语音信号端点检测的硬件与软件;实现了语音信号端点的自动检测。

title: Design of Intelligence Tire Pressure Monitoring System Based on Bluetooth 4.0
abstract: This paper designs a tire pressure monitoring system(TPMS) by using Bluetooth 4.0 wireless technology.The system mainly contains three function units:sensor monitoring unit based on MPXY8020A;main control unit CC2540 and a smart phone for display.The sensor unit acquires tire data like pressure;temperature as well as battery voltage.Information of each tire are sent to the main control unit and transmitted to a smart phone.The tire data can be displayed on smart phone in real time;parameters like alarm thresholds can also be set.
abstract_in_chinese: 绝大部分的的轮胎故障由轮胎欠压、过压、漏气及胎温过高造成。蓝牙4.0规范的核心是蓝牙低功耗技术(BLE)。设计了一种基于蓝牙4.0的智能汽车轮胎监测系统;系统由传感器MPXY8020A、蓝牙模块主控芯片CC2540和智能手机终端组成;传感器完成轮胎内部压力和温度的采集;蓝牙模块内置80C51单片机;获取传感器数据;将数据处理后发送给手机用户终端。该系统具有能耗低;结构简单、无线传输的优点。
keywords: bluetooth 4.0, mpxy8020a, smart phone, tire pressure monitoring system(tpms)

title: Design of a Data Acquisition System Based on LabVIEW
abstract: The system uses CC2530 to collect the temperature of the dispersed nodes through Pt100;and displays the temperature on the LabVIEW interface of the host computer in real time. It can realize the remote query; display and storage of the temperature by using LabVIEW; which can effectively meet the requirements of multi-measurement points; mobility and convenience in the process of industrial and agricultural testing; and has a very broad application prospect.

title: Design of Soil Condition Monitoring System Based on WSN
abstract: In view of the waste of resources and pollution of orchard environment caused by unreasonable fertilization;pesticide application and other agricultural activities in apple production;the influence of environmental and climatic conditions on apple industry in northern shaanxi mountains was considered.An orchard soil environment monitoring system based on wireless sensor network was proposed.The design uses CC2530 as the core chip;and uses TI′s Z-Stack protocol stack and development platform to build a wireless sensor network combining mesh topology and star topology.The system has been tested to operate stably under low power consumption;providing an effective way to implement orchard environmental monitoring in northern Shaanxi.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对苹果生产时不合理的施肥、施药等农事活动造成的资源浪费并污染了果园环境等问题;同时考虑到陕北山地环境和气候条件对苹果产业的影响;提出了一种基于无线传感器网络的果园土壤环境监测系统。该设计选用CC2530作为核心芯片;采用TI公司Z-Stack协议栈和开发平台搭建了以网状拓扑和星状拓扑相结合的无线传感器网络。经测试该系统能够在低功耗状态下稳定运行;为在陕北地区实行果园环境监测提供一种有效途径。
keywords: cc2530, orchard soil monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Design of Intelligent Enterprise Management System Based on ZigBee and Cloud Platform Technology
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of the Internet of Things; the intelligent enterprise management system based on Zig Bee and cloud platform technology is designed and implemented. This system consists three parts: hardware; software and the real-time acquisition module of the cloud platform. The hardware part consists the CC2530 chip main control unit; ZigBee sensor node; control node; four-input analog quantity; etc.The software part consists of the information processing and display module of the host computer. The system realizes the real-time collection of current environmental data and control of some devices in the enterprise. It can quickly monitor the current environmental changes and display them in the cloud in time.Therefore; the system has broad practical applications.
abstract_in_chinese: 在物联网高速发展的大背景下;设计并实现基于ZigBee和云平台技术的智慧企业管理系统。本系统由CC2530芯片主控制单元、ZigBee传感器节点、控制节点、四输入模拟量等所构成的硬件部分;基于上位机的信息处理与显示模块构成的软件部分以及云平台实时采集模块三部分组成;实现了当前环境数据实时采集和企业部分区域的设备控制;可以快速监测当前环境变化;并及时在云端显示;有较强的实际应用。
keywords: cloud platform, design, enterprise, intelligence, management system, zigbee
affiliations: 苏州市职业大学计算机工程学院

title: Scale model design of nodes power control network based on ZigBee
abstract: The large scale model for displays usually need to be equipped with multiple power control points for the purpose of lighting and motors;but the traditional wired control method is not flexible enough to achieve complex control effects. In this paper;a wireless network node control system based on ZigBee protocol is designed;which can realize the node separate control and group control of the scale model power supply with the benefit of increase or decrease in the number of nodes dynamically;which also can effectively overcome the shortcomings of the traditional control method. The ZigBee node design is based on SoC chip of CC2530;and the ZigBee protocol stack depends on the ZStack of TI Company. The specific control protocol is designed in the system;and the host computer software is used for some complex control effect;which could obtain the working state of the node.
abstract_in_chinese: 大型展示用沙盘通常配置多个照明与电机电源控制点;传统的有线控制方式不够灵活;难以实现复杂的控制效果。本文设计了一种基于ZigBee协议的无线网络节点控制系统;可实现沙盘电源的节点单独控制与成组控制;节点可动态增减;有效地克服了传统控制方式的缺点。节点设计基于CC2530片上系统;ZigBee协议栈采用TI公司的ZStack。设计了控制协议;利用上位机软件可做出复杂的控制效果和获取节点的工作状态。
keywords: network design, node control, scale model, zigbee

abstract_in_chinese: <正>研制了一种针对储能装置的协调控制系统;该系统是基于DSP+CPLD构成;采用DSP芯片TMS320F28335为核心;在逻辑电路中采用CPLD芯片EPM570F256C5N来实现对系统开入开出量的监测及通信控制;DSP芯片通过总线与CPLD芯片通讯连接。使用DSP内部自带的12位A/D来完成16路电压和电流信号的采样;完成进线侧电压电流信息的采集及处理;同时监测BMS和储能整流模块的运行状态;完成同上级监控和本地监控的以太网通讯;以实现对监控系统和BMS、储能整流模块的协调控制。

title: Research on Online Indoor Environment Monitoring Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a current popular technology in the field of indoor environment monitoring. In order to realize real-time online monitoring of indoor humidity; temperature; light and other factors; an indoor environment online monitoring system based on ZigBee bidirectional wireless communication technology is designed in this paper. The chip model of ZigBee communication module is CC2530. The communication mode of system gateway is GPRS mode. The data collected is processed online and real-time by data analysis model. After testing; the designed indoor environment real-time acquisition and monitoring system can run stably; acquire indoor environment data in real time; and update real-time on the server side of the system through the network management of the system; so as to realize the real-time monitoring and adjustment of indoor environment parameters.
abstract_in_chinese: 无线传感网络在室内环境监测领域中是当前热门技术;为了实现对室内湿度、温度、光照等因素的实时在线监测;设计了基于ZigBee双向无线通讯技术的室内环境在线监测系统;系统ZigBee的通信模块选用的芯片型号为CC2530;系统网关的通信模式选用GPRS模式;并利用数据分析模型对采集的数据进行了在线实时处理.经测试;设计的室内环境实时采集监测系统能够稳定运行;能够实时获取室内的环境数据并通过系统的网管在系统的服务器端实时更新;实现室内环境参数的实时监视与调节.
keywords: sensors, wireless sensor network, zigbee
authors: XU Rong;School of Information Engineering; Anhui Open University;

title: Design of wireless transmission module for multi-channel sensor signal acquisition
abstract: In allusion to the problems of internal cable complexity and low payload ratio of aircrafts;a wireless transmission pattern is proposed. The wireless module in CC3200 is applied to improve the use flexibility of the sensor and reduce the complexity caused by wire arrangement;which can effectively improve the payload ratio of the aircraft. The STM32F103 series single-chip microcomputer of internal integrated ADC is used to collect the sensor analog signal. A coaxial feed antenna that can be pasted is selected to enhance the signal strength. The design can realize that the type of each sensor is identified and a sensor with a high transmission rate requirement is connected to a network with less interference. The experimental results show that the transmission speed of each sensor can reach 320.17 KB/s;and the IP address of each sensor can be clearly obtained by the upper computer;so as to effectively identify the sensor type. The sensor has higher integration and stronger reliability in comparison with other sensors in the market.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对现在飞行器内部线缆复杂性和有效载荷比低;提出采用无线传输的模式;应用CC3200中的无线模块来提升传感器的使用灵活性;同时减少因为布线而导致的复杂问题;能够有效提高飞行器的有效载荷比。传感器模拟信号的采集使用内部集成ADC的STM32F103系列单片机;同时为了增强信号强度;再选用能够粘贴式的同轴馈电天线。该设计可实现识别每个传感器的种类;并且把传输速率要求高的传感器连接到干扰较少的网络上。实验得出;每个传感器的传输速度达到320.17 KB/s;通过上位机可清晰得到每个传感器的IP地址;从而有效识别传感器种类。结果表明;该传感器与市面上其他传感器相比集成度高;可靠性强。
keywords: antenna selection, collect analog signal, payload ratio, sensor, sensor type recognition, wireless transmission

title: Design of propellant gas wireless monitoring and positioning algorithm based on ZigBee
abstract: Based on short-range wireless communication technology;a wireless monitoring system of propellant gas is developed and the data monitoring of propellant gas concentration is realized.Using the ZigBee signal in the transmission of signal strength parameters;the design algorithm carries on the calculation of communication distance.So as to realize the position location of the system for the positioning terminal.System hardware is based on CC2530 and Z-Stack protocol stack;software is based on IAR Embedded Workbench for 8051 and Visual Studio 2012 platform.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于ZigBee短距离无线通信技术;开发了推进剂气体无线监测系统;实现了推进剂气体浓度数据监测。利用ZigBee信号传输中信号强度参数;设计算法进行通信距离的计算;从而实现系统对定位终端的位置定位。系统硬件基于CC2530和Z-Stack协议栈;软件基于IAR Embedded Workbench for 8051和Visual Studio 2012平台。

title: SDI high definition image processing system based on FPGA & DSP
abstract: In view of the large amount of computation and high real-time requirement in the process of video image processing;this paper designs a DSP+FPGA high-definition image real-time processing system based on SDI interface;which mainly includes hardware circuit design and software programming debugging.The main processor of the system adopts Xilinxseries of Spartan-6FPGA and TMS320C6748 DSP of TICompany.Data receiving and transmitting units adopt two new chips;GV7704 and GV7700;which are newly listed by SEMTECHCompany.The system software part includes data acquisition and logic control on the FPGA;data reception and processing on the DSP;and data communication between the two through the UPP and EMIF interfaces.The experimental results show that the system can realize the acquisition of the video image of the SDI camera;and output the imagedata through the VGA interfacecircuit;with high definition.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对在视频图像处理过程中计算量大、实时性高的要求;设计了一个基于串行数字接口(SDI)的DSP+FPGA高清图像实时处理系统;主要包括硬件电路设计和软件编程调试。系统硬件电路主处理器采用Xilinx公司Spartan-6系列FPGA和TI公司TMS320C6748系列DSP;数据接收单元和数据发送单元采用SEMTECH公司新上市的GV7704和GV7700两款芯片。系统软件部分包括FPGA端数据采集和逻辑控制、DSP端数据接收和处理以及二者通过UPP和EMIF接口的数据通信。实验结果表明;系统能实现SDI摄像头视频图像的采集;并通过VGA接口电路将接收到的图像输出显示;清晰度较高。
keywords: dsp, fpga, hd-sdi, image processing

title: Application research of Z-Source inverter in agricultural electric vehicles
abstract: The working condition of agricultural electric vehicles has the characteristics of poor road conditions and short transportation distance. When the vehicle starts frequently and accelerates rapidly; the power supply voltage of the drive system is unstable; which affects the dynamic performance of the vehicle. In this paper; the Z-source inverter with pass-through boost regulation is used as the main circuit of the drive system; and the control circuit with TMS320 LF2407 A as the core is designed. Based on the analysis of the working principle of the Z-source inverter; the specific circuit parameters are given; and the traditional vector control algorithm of the motor is improved to achieve the maximum boost ratio. The experiment shows that the system ensures the stability of the motor supply voltage when the DC power supply voltage drops by the addition of the pass-through zero vector; the DC bus voltage is increased; the motor speed range is widened; and the vehicle's dynamic performance is enhanced.
abstract_in_chinese: 农用电动车辆的工况具有路况差、运输距离短的特点;车辆在频繁起动、急加速时会造成驱动系统供电电压的不稳定;影响车辆的动力性能。采用具有直通升压稳压特性的Z源逆变器作为驱动系统的主电路;并设计以TMS320LF2407A为核心的控制电路。在分析Z源逆变器工作原理的基础上给出具体的电路参数;并对电机传统的矢量控制算法进行了改进;实现最大的升压比。试验表明:该系统通过直通零矢量的加入保证直流电源电压跌落时电机供电电压的稳定;提高直流母线电压;拓宽电机的转速范围;增强车辆的动力性能。

title: Design of Remote Control Inverse Power Supply Base on TMS320F2812
abstract: According to the functional requirements of remote control inverter power supply in the new energy power generation system;a hardware design scheme of a two-stage power transformation structure is proposed.Using the digital signal processor TMS320 F2812 as the control core;the signal acquisition;communication and control circuits are designed and the flow chart of the control program is given.Adjusting the inverse parameters through the monitoring system;feasibility of the scheme and correctness of the control program are verified by the output waveforms.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对新能源发电系统对逆变电源远程控制要求;提出两级功率变换结构的硬件设计方案.控制系统以数字信号处理器TMS320F2812为核心;设计了相应的信号采集、通讯及驱动电路;并给出控制程序设计流程图.通过监控系统调节逆变参数;由观测到的输出交流电压波形验证了设计方案的可行性和控制程序的正确性.

title: Research on Temperature Measure-monitoring System of Power System High Voltage Switchgear Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: This study designed a temperature measure-monitoring system for high voltage switchgear based on ZigBee technology. The system uses the low-power DS18 B20 temperature sensor and CC2530 chip to build a real-time acquisition module for temperature signals. The ZigBee communication protocol is used to complete the networking with the host computer to realize real-time acquisition; remote transmission and centralized control of temperature data. The system runs stably and reliably; and the integrated package is easy to install.
abstract_in_chinese: 本研究设计了一种基于ZigBee技术的高压开关柜温度测控系统。该系统采用低功耗DS18B20温度传感器和CC2530芯片构建温度信号的实时采集模块;经ZigBee通信协议完成与上位机的组网;实现温度数据的实时采集、远程传输和集中控制等功能。系统运行稳定可靠性好;集成封装便于安装。

title: Intelligent Agricultural system based on embedded Development
abstract: The state of modern agriculture in China is still dominated by the traditional mode; with low production efficiency and inadequate ability to collect and control agricultural data. However; with the progress of the times; smart agriculture will become a new trend of agricultural development. The smart agriculture technology based on ZigBee technology has great significance in real-time acquisition and remote control.In order to realize intelligent agriculture; the Z-stack semi-open source protocol stack is proposed to develop and realize the collection and transmission of temperature; humidity; light and other information. The remote communication function is realized by using external cloud server. The system makes full use of the characteristics of ZigBee network; such as stable transmission and long transmission distance; and solves the difficult problem of agricultural data acquisition. Combining with the data processing ability of ARM development board; it can meet the needs of intelligent agriculture.
abstract_in_chinese: 中国现代农业的状态依然以传统的模式为主;生产效率低下;对农业数据的采集以及控制能力不足。然而随着时代的进步;智慧农业即将成为农业发展的新潮流;其中基于Zig Bee技术的智慧农业技术在实时采集和远程控制方面拥有着重大的意义。为了实现智慧农业;提出了使用Z-stack半开源协议栈进行开发;实现温度;湿度;光照等信息的采集传输。通过使用外部云端服务器实现远程通讯功能。该系统充分利用了Zig Bee网络的传输稳定;传输距离远的特性;解决农业在数据采集上的难题;并结合ARM开发板的数据处理能力;能满足智慧农业的需求。
keywords: arm, cc2530, intelligent agriculture, zigbee
authors: Wan Chenwei;Finance and Economics University Of Jiangxi;
affiliations: 江西财经大学

title: Design of Medical Inflatable Automatic Dilatation Rod
abstract: Objective Aiming at the shortcomings of existing cervical dilatation rods;an inflatable automatic dilatation rod is designed.Methods The inflatable automatic dilatation rod used TMS320 F28335 as the main control chip;and controlled the gas pressure inside the rod using adaptive control method.The pressure was sent to the controller after A/D conversion;and the controller controlled the electric proportional valve to make the gas pressure in the rod meet the clinical requirements.Results An inflatable automatic dilatation rod was successfully designed.Comparative experiments showed that the automatic dilatation rod eliminated the pain the and risk of excessive bleeding caused by repeated insertion and removal of the traditional cervical dilatation rod.Compared with traditional steel rod;automatic dilatation rod had obvious advantages.Conclusion The inflatable automatic dilatation rod is convenient to operate;and can obviously relieve the pain caused by cervical dilatation;which has high clinical application value.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的针对现有扩宫棒存在的缺点;设计一种充气式自动扩宫棒。方法采用TMS320F28335作为主控芯片和自适应控制方法;通过采集棒体内气体压力;模数转换后送入控制器;控制器处理后控制电气比例阀;从而使棒体内气体压力满足临床要求。结果成功设计了一款充气式自动扩宫棒。通过对比实验;自动扩宫棒免去了反复插拔钢棒给患者带来的痛苦;并减小了出血过多带来的风险。与传统钢棒相比具有明显优势。结论充气式自动扩宫棒操作方便;能明显改善扩宫对患者造成的痛苦;具有较高的临床应用价值。
keywords: cervical dilatation rod, cervical screening, gynecologic surgery, inflatable automatic dilatation rod
authors: CHEN Renjin;SUN Xiaoyang;YANG Bo;PANG Haowen;SHI Xiangxiang;Department of Oncology;The Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University;

title: Design of Inverter Experiment System for Power Electronics Technology Course
abstract: The inverter experimental system with high-performance MCU-TMS320 F28335 as the digital control was designed; and the corresponding teaching experiment content was developed to meet the requirements of the teaching experiment of Power Electronics Technology course. After analyzing the structure of the instrument of the teaching experiment based on three-phase full-bridge converter; the frequency control strategy; square wave inverter control strategy; phase shift voltage regulation control strategy and SPWM inverter voltage regulation control strategy were applied in the teaching experiment instrument prototype; the inverter verification experiments of a specific single-phase square wave and three-phase square wave; single-phase SPWM and three-phase SPWM fo cusing on the voltage regulation function and the frequency adjustment function are planned.
abstract_in_chinese: 研制了以高性能MCU-TMS320F28335为数字控制核心的逆变实验系统;配套设计相应教学实验内容;满足"电力电子技术"课程的教学实验要求。分析了基于三相全桥变换器的教学实验平台结构;设计了频率控制策略、方波逆变控制策略、移相调压控制策略和SPWM逆变的调压控制策略;还给出了教学实验平台样机。最后围绕电压调节功能和频率调节功能设计了具体的单相方波逆变验证实验、三相方波逆变验证实验、单相SPWM逆变验证实验和三相SPWM逆变验证实验。
keywords: digital control, experiment instrument, power electronic technology, spwm inversion, square wave inversion

title: DESIGN OF WIRELESS GAS METER READING SYSTEM BASED ON MSP430
abstract: A low-power consumption gas meter reading system is designed to relieve meter readers of their hard work on high floor. Distinctive in wireless awakening and relay transmission functions; this design offers a systematic introduction to the working process and working principle of lower computer by recording data with MSP430 and achieving wireless transmission through CC1101. The practical application shows that this design can meet the meter reading requirements and massively reduce the workload of meter readers.

keywords: low-power consumption, meter reading system, msp430 single chip

title: Design of smart door lock’s wireless low power wake-up mechanism based on CC1101
abstract: For the micro wireless node's low power wake-up mechanism design problem in the short frame and low throughput wireless sensor networks; by the low power wake-up mechanism research in a smart door locks application with duplex abrupt communication and less than 500 ms response time features; the commonly used low power wake-up mechanisms at the MAC layer are analyzed. And with the low cost; low power hardware platform based on STM8 L MCU+Sub-1 G wireless chip CC1101; according to the application features of smart door lock and combined with the supported hardware mechanism of CC1101 wireless chip; the low power wake-up mechanism which meeting the application requirements is designed and realized. The power consumption of the wireless node is measured; and the power consumption of smart door lock is evaluated; the results show that the system is stable and reliable; and the low-power performance is good.

title: Design of forklift asynchronous motor FOC controller based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In this paper; TMS320 F28335 micro control chip is used to design a controller of the motor of electric forklift. According to the problem that inverter bridge of forklift is not able to afford the high current; design a hardware circuit as well as the software; including the circuit diagram of Inverter Bridge; MOS driver circuit; voltage regulator circuit and current detection circuit; etc. The software system structure is FOC control system structure; and the program flow chart is given. The core internal data were obtained through serial communication; and the waveforms of speed; current; Id and Iq were obtained. The experimental results show that the response characteristics of the system are good and meet the design requirements.

title: Design of missle-borne SAR signal processing system based on FPGA and DSP
abstract: A missile-borne SAR(synthetic aperture radar) signal processing system based on the hardware structure of the cooperative processing of FPGA and DSP is presented in this paper in view of the heavy calculation and the poor real time performance. The XC2VP30 of Xilinx company and TMS320C6416 of TI company is used to realize the preprocessing of echo data and the processing of imaging algorithm respectively. The system improved the efficiency of image processing and solved the problems of parallelism and speed. The feasibility of the system is verified by the orbital experiment in the field.

title: Design of an Illumination Acquisition Control Program for Mobile Terminals Based on Zigbee Technology and ESP8266WIFI Platform
abstract: With the rapid development of Zigbee wireless sensor communication technology and WIFI communication technology;in order to realize android mobile terminal wireless collection of illumination information and control stepper motor devices functions;a system is designed based on Android Studio development platform to realize the acquisition of illumination information and stepper motor control operation using JAVA programming.The system hardware is composed of intelligent gateway modules based on CC2530 chip and ESP8266 chip;Zigbee terminal communication module;photosensitive sensor and stepper motor equipment.The experimental results demonstrate that the system performance is stable and the operation is convenient with certain application prospects.

title: Research on the SHEPWM technique applied to inverter based on differential evolution algorithms
abstract: Aiming at solving the nonlinear equations of two-level selective harmonic elimination; a method of solving the nonlinear transcendental equations of two-level inverters harmonic elimination model by Differential Evolution(DE) algorithm is proposed. DE solves the SHEPWM equations and overcomes the shortage of initial values in numerical methods. The switching angle trajectory with modulation degree of 0 to 1.15 is given. Compared with the genetic algorithm solution; the DE solution has higher accuracy. In order to verify the correctness and feasibility of the differential evolution algorithm; a simulation study is carried out with Matlab/Simulink; and a two-level inverter based on DSP(TMS320F28335) is built for experiment. The simulation and experimental results prove the correctness and feasibility of the differential evolution algorithm.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对两电平特定谐波消除(Selective Harmonic Elimination Pulse Width Modulation; SHEPWM)非线性方程组的求解;提出采用差分进化算法(Differential Evolution Algorithm;DE)对两电平逆变器消谐模型的非线性超越方程组求解的方法。DE求解SHEPWM方程组克服了数值方法需要初值的不足。给出调制度0～1.15下的开关角轨迹;和遗传算法求解进行对比;得出DE求解具有更高的精度。为验证差分进化算法求解的正确性和可行性;用Matlab/Simulink进行仿真研究;并以DSP(TMS320F28335)为核心搭建了两电平逆变器进行实验。仿真和实验结果证明了差分进化算法求解的正确性和可行性。
keywords: differential evolution algorithms, inverter, nonlinear transcendental equations, pulse width modulation, selective harmonics elimination

title: 基于蓝牙通信的LED智能照明系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 随着人民生活水平的提高和智能手机的普及应用;照明的智能控制是当下热门研究课题。方案设计结合日用消费级产品特点进行优化选型;采用CC2541芯片让智能移动终端与STC89C52RC单片机实现蓝牙通信;以无线方式传输各种智能照明控制指令;最后通过LED驱动模块来驱动LED灯实现所需的照明状态。系统通过PWM调节等实现LED灯光的开关、强弱及颜色等的控制变化;经过实验验证方案可行;达到设计要求效果。

title: Multifunction LED light control system based on CC2530
abstract: The LED lighting system has been widely applied to smart home with the continuous development of semiconductor technology. Aiming at the problems of wiring difficulty and simple function of LED control system at present;A multifunction LED light wireless control system based on CC2530 was proposed in this paper.In order to meet the different needs of the human;achieve energy-saving and get environmental protection;green lighting. This system realized any dimming and color grading function of LED light through two steps. Fist; It must get the relationship between the chromaticity coordinates and the duty cycle. Second;The duty cycle of R;G;B three LED lamps were controlled by PWM. The experiment proved that this system can satisfy with the requirements of smart home lighting and can be widely applied to home decoration.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着半导体技术的不断发展;LED统布线困难;功能简单等问题。本文提出一种基于CC2530的多功能LED灯无线控制系统;利用三基色(R;G;B)混色原理;得到色品坐标与占空比之间的关系式;通过PWM信号控制R;G;B 3组LED灯的占空比;实现LED灯任意调光与调色功能;以满足人民各种不同的需要;达到节能环保、绿色照明。实验证明;该多功能LED装饰中。

title: SDI high definition image processing system based on FPGA & DSP
abstract: In view of the large amount of computation and high real-time requirement in the process of video image processing;this paper designs a DSP+FPGA high-definition image real-time processing system based on SDI interface;which mainly includes hardware circuit design and software programming debugging.The main processor of the system adopts Xilinxseries of Spartan-6FPGA and TMS320C6748 DSP of TICompany.Data receiving and transmitting units adopt two new chips;GV7704 and GV7700;which are newly listed by SEMTECHCompany.The system software part includes data acquisition and logic control on the FPGA;data reception and processing on the DSP;and data communication between the two through the UPP and EMIF interfaces.The experimental results show that the system can realize the acquisition of the video image of the SDI camera;and output the imagedata through the VGA interfacecircuit;with high definition.

title: Design of missle-borne SAR signal processing system based on FPGA and DSP
abstract: A missile-borne SAR(synthetic aperture radar) signal processing system based on the hardware structure of the cooperative processing of FPGA and DSP is presented in this paper in view of the heavy calculation and the poor real time performance. The XC2VP30 of Xilinx company and TMS320C6416 of TI company is used to realize the preprocessing of echo data and the processing of imaging algorithm respectively. The system improved the efficiency of image processing and solved the problems of parallelism and speed. The feasibility of the system is verified by the orbital experiment in the field.

title: Design of a Digital Voltage Regulator for Aircraft HVDC Generator
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large size;heavy weight and slow response of traditional aircraft voltage regulator;a digtal voltage regulator suitable for aircraft high voltage DC power supply system is designed. The voltage regulator adopts DSP(TMS320 F2812) as the control core. Through the design of matching hardware and software;the integration of voltage regulation and protection is realized;the volume weight of the voltage regulator is reduced;and the restarting step of the aircraft generator is simplified. Compared with traditional aircraft analog voltage regulators;it has the advantages of fast response;small error;easy ground maintenance and easy debugging.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决传统飞机电压调节器体积重量大、反应慢的问题;该文设计了一种适用于飞机高压直流电源系统的数字式电压调节器。该电压调节器采用DSP(TMS320F2812)作为控制核心;通过设计配套的硬件及软件;实现了调压与保护的一体化;减小了电压调节器的体积重量;简化了飞机发电机的重启步骤。与传统飞机模拟式电压调节器相比;具有响应快、误差小、易于地面维护、便于调试的优点。

title: Study on tri-axial array induction experimental device
abstract: There is no tri-axial induction logging tool independently-developed in China. Therefore;an experimental device was developed for the tri-axial array induction. The sine waves of 6 kHz and 18 kHz were generated by DDS integration chip AD9833 which is controlled by the main chip TMS320F2812;and sent to transmitter coil system after power amplification. The data processing and transmissions are performed by EP4CE6E22C8 and TMS320F2812 after the received signal is sampled by AD7606. The receiving signals obtained by measuring the coil systems in horizontal direction and vertical direction show that the receiving voltage in the horizontal direction is less than that of in the vertical direction;and the experimental results are consistent with theoretical analysis. The device is suitable for the study of response characteristics of the tri-axial array induction;and provides the experimental basis for the design of the actual instrument.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对国内没有自主研发的三分量感应测井仪器;设计三分量阵列感应的实验装置。使用主控芯片TMS320F2812控制DDS集成芯片AD9833产生6 kHz和18 kHz的正弦波;经功率放大后发送至发射线圈系;接收信号经AD7606采样;由EP4CE6E22C8和TMS320F2812共同完成数据的处理和传输。通过测量水平方向线圈系和垂直方向线圈系的接收信号表明;空气中水平方向的接收电压小于垂直方向的接收电压;实验结果与理论一致;可以用于三分量感应的响应特性研究;同时为实际仪器设计提供实验基础。
keywords: array induction, coil system, receiving circuit, response characteristic, transmitting circuit, tri-axial

title: Design of Intelligent Enterprise Management System Based on ZigBee and Cloud Platform Technology
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of the Internet of Things; the intelligent enterprise management system based on Zig Bee and cloud platform technology is designed and implemented. This system consists three parts: hardware; software and the real-time acquisition module of the cloud platform. The hardware part consists the CC2530 chip main control unit; ZigBee sensor node; control node; four-input analog quantity; etc.The software part consists of the information processing and display module of the host computer. The system realizes the real-time collection of current environmental data and control of some devices in the enterprise. It can quickly monitor the current environmental changes and display them in the cloud in time.Therefore; the system has broad practical applications.

abstract: The endpoint detection of voice signal is the key technology to realize seamless connection between telephone and radio station. This technology is widely used in voice scheduling of air traffic control communication;voice scheduling of coastal radio station communication and voice scheduling of emergency communication. In this paper;the hardware and software of endpoint detection of voice signal are designed;and the automatic endpoint detection of voice signal is realized.

title: Design of bridge dynamic monitoring system based on STM32
abstract: According to the requirements of wireless dynamic monitoring;the bridge wireless dynamic monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is designed by STM32 processor and visual studio software platform.Signals such as pressure and temperature are collected by multi-channel sensors and sent to the STM32 processor for processing and analysis;and transmitted to the host computer through the wireless transceiver module.The upper computer monitoring system was designed and developed by using the visual studio software platform;the design of the whole dynamic monitoring system was completed.The experimental results show that the system can accurately monitor the pressure and temperature of the bridge.The near-field dynamics theory is used to analyze the damage of the bridge structure;which provides reliable prediction for the safety of the bridge.It has good practical value.

title: A High Precision Rotary Transformer Decoding Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high cost and poor precision of traditional resolver decoding;a new decoding algorithm was proposed. Firstly;the specific method was to use the resolver output the signal. Secondly;after the signal was demodulated and normalized and a series of hybrid operations to obtain a pseudo-linear signal;the signal was logically partitioned and judged;and according to the judgment result to obtain an uncompensated angle signal. Finally;the decoding accuracy was improved by nonlinear precision compensation. The results show that the algorithm can realize high-precision decoding without using the look-up table method and additional reference signals. After theoretical calculation;the uncompensated pre-decoding error was not higher than 0. 072 1° in the range of 0° to 360°;the compensated decoding error is not higher than 8. 65° × 10~(-5). The algorithm has been experimentally verified in TMS320F28335. The results show that the angle information can be accurately solved;and the decoding error is 0. 000 389°;which verifies the feasibility of the algorithm.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统旋转变压器解码成本高和精度差等问题;提出了一种新的解码算法;利用旋转变压器输出信号进行解调和归一化处理后;再经过一系列混合运算得到伪线性信号后;对此信号进行逻辑分区判断;根据判断结果进行计算得到未补偿的角度信号;最后通过非线性精度补偿以提高解码精度。研究结果表明;该算法的实现不需要利用查表法和附加参考信号就可以实现高精度解码。经过理论计算;在0°～360°;未补偿前解码误差不高于0. 072 1°;补偿后解码误差不高于8. 65°×10~(-5)。该算法在TMS320F283 35中经过实验验证;结果表明其可以准确解得角度信息;解码误差为0. 000 389°;验证了算法的可行性。

title: Smart Home based on ZigBee Wireless Network Control System Design
abstract: This paper based on ZigBee wireless network technology has carried on the design of smart home control system;the system selected CC2530 for hardware development platform;software development using Z-Stack based programming;selected PC for home gateway;connected to the Internet and smart home system;finally realizes the remote control family internal sensors;improve the sense of convenience and comfort of People's Daily life.

title: Design of control system for EMA based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In order to realize the small size and low cost design of the circuit board of electromechanical actuator(EMA);TMS320 F28335 is used as the main control chip;and with its capture interrupt and timing interrupt functions;closed loop control of electromechanical actuator(EMA)is realized. Firstly;control strategy of EMA and driving principle of brushless direct current motor(BLDCM)are presented.Secondly;the design method of software and hardware of EMA is given. Finally;experiments are carried out to validate the method. The motor can operate stably at a constant speed by inputting 200 rpm speed instruction. The EMA system can operate stably at all positions by the EMA command angles of 1 °;3 °;5°;7°and 9°. Experimental results show that this method reduces costs and circuit board volume;make the EMA working more stable.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现电动舵机电路板小体积、低成本设计;以TMS320F28335作为主控芯片;利用其自身的捕获中断和定时中断功能;实现了电动舵机控制。首先给出电动舵机的控制策略及电机驱动原理;其次给出了电动舵机的软硬件设计方法;最后进行实验验证。输入200 rpm的电机速度指令;电机能够匀速稳定运行;给定舵机的指令角度分别为1°、3°、5°、7°、9°;系统能够稳定运行在各个位置;实验结果表明该方法降低成本、减小电路板体积;使舵机稳定工作。

title: Target Temperature Data Transmission System Based ZigBee Protocol
abstract: In order to evaluate the detection performance of infrared optical systems under harsh environmental conditions;this paper develops a wireless target system that can be transmitted wirelessly by simulating the thermal radiation of various large objects. Firstly;based on the principle of ZigBee wireless communication;a wireless data transmission system composed of a three-level communication structure such as a total control computer;a data relay station and a target board system is designed. Then;a high-speed serial A/D analog-to-digital conversion hardware acquisition card is designed with ARM as the core processor;and the temperature data of each target unit can be wirelessly transmitted to the relay computer;Furthermore;based on TI's CC2530 chip;the coordination group hardware transmitted between the target communication module and the relay station is designed. Based on VC++;the upper computer software including the target terminal;router and coordinator is developed. Finally;communication with the host computer through the relay station is displayed by the master control unit to monitor the temperature control of each target unit. The target temperature data transmission system based on Zigbee wireless communication has the advantages of flexible network node combination;no spatial hypothesis order;and can greatly reduce the advantages of the data transmission line in the system;and the wireless transmission distance is effective within 100 m.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了评价恶劣环境条件下红外光学系统的探测性能;通过模拟各种大型物体的热辐射;研制了一种可无线传输的红外靶标系统数据传输系统。首先;基于ZigBee无线通信原理;设计了由总控计算机、数据中继站、靶板系统等三级通信结构组成的无线数据传输系统;然后以ARM为核心处理器设计了高速串行A/D模数转换的硬件采集卡;可将各个靶标单元的温度数据通过无线传输至中继计算机;进而;基于TI公司CC2530芯片设计了靶板通信模块与中继站之间传输的协调组硬件;又基于VC++开发了包含靶板终端、路由器、协调器三部分通信的上位机软件;最后;通过中继站与上位机通信由总控上位机显示;监控每个靶元温控情况。该种基于Zigbee无线通信的靶标温度数据传输系统;具有网络节点组合灵活、空间假设次序无要求;且可大量减少系统中数据传输线路的优点;其无线传输距离在100m内有效。

title: Bearing Quality Detection System Based on Multiple Ultrasonic Sensors
abstract: The principle of ultrasonic distance measurement was used for the bearing profile quality detection system.The TMS320 F28377 D with dual-core architecture was the core;and a dual-core motor control module;data acquisition module;and RS485 communication module were designed.Based on the hardware platform;the Modbus-based "DSP+HMI" device communication module and the filtering algorithm-based data acquisition and processing module software were designed.By detecting the inner diameter;outer diameter and height of the bearing profile;the detection error range was calculated within 0.008 mm.The experiment analyzes the detection accuracy and proves that the control system is effective and stable for bearing profile inspection in the industrial field.
abstract_in_chinese: 将超声波测距原理用于轴承形廓质量检测系统;以双核架构的TMS320F28377D为核心;设计基于双核的电机控制模块、数据采集模块、RS485通讯模块等。基于硬件平台;设计基于Modbus的"DSP+HMI"设备通讯模块、基于滤波算法的数据采集及处理模块软件。通过对轴承形廓内径、外径以及高度进行检测;计算检测误差范围在0.008 mm内。实验对检测精度进行分析;证明控制系统用于轴承形廓检测工业现场效果良好;稳定可靠。

title: Design of bridge dynamic monitoring system based on STM32
abstract: According to the requirements of wireless dynamic monitoring;the bridge wireless dynamic monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is designed by STM32 processor and visual studio software platform.Signals such as pressure and temperature are collected by multi-channel sensors and sent to the STM32 processor for processing and analysis;and transmitted to the host computer through the wireless transceiver module.The upper computer monitoring system was designed and developed by using the visual studio software platform;the design of the whole dynamic monitoring system was completed.The experimental results show that the system can accurately monitor the pressure and temperature of the bridge.The near-field dynamics theory is used to analyze the damage of the bridge structure;which provides reliable prediction for the safety of the bridge.It has good practical value.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对无线动态监测需求;采用STM32处理器和Visual Studio软件平台设计了基于ZigBee技术的桥梁无线动态监测系统。通过多路传感器采集压力、温度等信号并传入到STM32处理器进行处理分析;并通过无线收发模块传输到上位机。采用Visual Studio软件平台设计开发了上位机监控系统;完成了整个动态监测系统的设计。通过实验测试结果表明;系统可以较为精确的监测桥梁的压力、温度等信息;后续通过近场动力学理论对桥梁结构破坏进行分析;为桥梁的安全提供可靠地预测;有较好的实用价值。

title: Design of Terminal Monitoring Node of Forest Environment Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: A terminal monitoring node of forest environment intelligent monitoring system is designed based on Internet of Things technology. The terminal selects STM32 as the main controller; combines the sensors to collect and judge the surrounding environment data of the nodes; and controls the operation of the peripheral devices and the entire terminal monitoring node system. CC2530 is selected as the data transmission main controller for receiving the alarm sent by the STM32 serial port. Data; and through the ZigBee network; the collected environmental data and positioning information are wirelessly sent to the coordinator server; and real-time alarms to complete real-time monitoring and processing of forest environment data.

title: Design of Software Radio Platform Based on FPGA+DSP
abstract: With the rapid development of modern chip technology; various high-performance digital signal processing chips have emerged; and high-speed signal processing boards operating in multi-core are widely used in the field of communication and automation control.Since the multi-core signal processing device has broadened the signal processing and data transmission capabilities; TI and Xilinx high-performance processing devices have been selected in this design to improve signal processing capability and computation speed.This paper introduces the hardware and software design of high-speed serial digital signal multicore hardware platform composed of XC5 VLX85 T1136 and TMS320 C6678 and the implementation process of related technologies.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着现代芯片工艺的飞速发展;各种高性能数字信号处理芯片不断出现;多核运行的高速信号处理板在通信领域、自动化控制领域等都得到是十分广泛的应用。由于多核信号处理器件扩宽了信号处理和数据传输能力;在本设计中选用TI和Xilinx的高性能处理器件;提高了信号处理能力和运算速度。本文具体介绍由XC5VLX85T1136和TMS320C6678组成的高速串行数字信号多核硬件平台的软硬件设计及相关技术的实现过程。

title: Research and implementation of active balancing control system for lithium-ion batteries based on state of charge
abstract: A new lithium-ion battery active equalization control system is designed to solve the energy imbalance problem of power battery pack. The system contained the main control chip TMS320 F28335; the detection circuit; the DC/DC circuit; the equalization circuit; and the drive circuit.Unscented Kalman filter algorithm is used to estimate the charge state of lithium-ion battery pack in real time. The energy storage inductance equalization circuit is designed based on battery characteristics. The PWM signal is modulated by fuzzy-PI control algorithm to realize the active balancing of battery pack energy. The hardware experiments manifested the new lithium battery active equalization control system exhibited excellent property.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决动力电池组能量不均衡的问题;本文设计了锂离子电池主动均衡控制系统。系统由主控芯片TMS320F28335、检测电路、DC/DC电路、均衡电路、驱动电路等组成。系统利用无迹卡尔曼滤波算法实时估算锂离子电池组的荷电状态;设计基于电池特性的储能电感式均衡电路;以模糊-PI控制算法调制PWM信号以实现电池组能量的主动均衡。搭建均衡控制系统的硬件实验平台;实验结果达到了预期目标。
keywords: active balancing, fuzzy-pi control, lithium-ion battery pack, unscented kalman filter
authors: Yu Yue;Lin Cong;Zhang Heng;College of Electronic and Information Engineering; Guangdong Ocean University;

abstract_in_chinese: 本系统是无线体域网(Wireless Body Area Networks;WBAN)的人体实时监测系统的设计;系统在各个人体信息采集节点布置了DS18B20温度传感器和PulseSensor脉搏传感器;传感器将采集到的体温信息和脉搏信息发送至中央芯片CC2540进行数据处理;该芯片可以很好地兼容低功耗蓝牙(Bluetooth low energy;BLE)协议;通过与TI的低功耗蓝牙协议栈配合;可以连接到用户的智能手机或平板电脑等移动设备进行无线数据传输;实现人体信息的实时监测。本系统大大提高了人体信息监测的操作灵活性;降低了监测设备的成本;使无线体域网和低功耗蓝牙技术在医疗健康领域有更加广泛的应用。

title: An Intelligent Shuttlecock Design Based on STM8 Single Chip Microcomputer
abstract: This paper designs a smart shuttlecock based on stm8 single chip microcomputer; which can realize automatic counting and transmit the result of counting to mobile APP for real-time display by CC2541 Bluetooth. The APP can also display "kicking times" compared with others; as well as additional functions such as calorie consumption. The design of smart shuttlecock has low cost and is acceptable to ordinary people. The integration of modern technology and traditional Chinese culture is conducive to the dissemination of this ancient and convenient sport.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计出一款基于列单片机控制的智能毽球;内嵌STM8S103F3P6单片机和CC2541芯片实现自动计算毽球连续踢起的次数;并将计数结果由蓝牙芯片CC2541传输到手机APP;实现实时显示。在手机APP上还可以显示与他人的连续踢起次数比拼和运动所消耗卡路里等附加功能。设计的智能毽球成本较低;普通人们都可以接受;有利于传统文化的发扬和推广。

title: Design and implementation of intelligent heating monitoring system based on mobile network
abstract: In view of the waste of heating resources caused by manual on-duty monitoring in traditional heating monitoring system;an intelligent heating monitoring system based on web mobile network is proposed. This paper mainly expounds the hardware structure and software structure of the intelligent heating monitoring system. The hardware structure of the system mainly uses CC2530 as the core to construct the hardware platform of wireless temperature controller to realize data acquisition and communication. In the software structure of the system;the establishment of the system model;the settings of each functional module of the system client;user flow query;historical flow bill query;information modification;heating control and heating settings are proposed. Data storage and association in background database;data exchange between Web layer and hardware layer;and data acquisition in system. Through research and testing;the solution of this system will certainly bring about the reform of traditional heating mode;save energy and improve the utilization rate of energy.

abstract: 穿戴式的心电监测系统有广泛的应用前景。基于AD8232集成模拟前端和低功耗处理器MSP430F5529;设计了一套穿戴式心电监测系统。结合CC2540蓝牙芯片;实现了系统功耗低、体积小、无线传输的优点。配合基于微信小程序的手机上位机和基于LabView的PC端上位机;可以满足使用者随时观测、及时预警的需求。通过验证;所设计系统满足日常家庭生活场景下的使用;且在用户静息、走动、跑跳等多种状态下保持着稳定的性能;可用于中老年人群、心血管疾病康复人群的日常监护与早期预警。

title: Design of Multi-Functional and Movable Household Planting Pond Based on Internet of Things
abstract: In order to ensure the green and environmental protection of household edible vegetables;a multifunctional and movable household planting pool is designed.Its mechanical structure is in the form of layered expansion;which can be flexibly adjusted and moved according to the environmental space;and the monitoring and regulating equipment of environmental parameters reguired for vegetable growth can be reasonably arranged.The control system of the device constructs three levels of Internet of things;which are monitoring transmission layer;comprehensive controlling layer and remote terminal management layer.The CC2530 is used as the control core;and the enviromental parameters such as temperature;humility and pH of the soil in planting pond;are monitored and adjusted in real-time by ZigBee technology.The host computer monitoring interface is designed by LabVIEW;which can realize remote monitoring.Through the comparative experiment of spinach planting in different environments;the device can realize stable growth of vegetables;shorten the growth period;and have good popularization and application value.
keywords: cc2530, host computer monitoring, household planting pool, internet of things, zigbee
authors: TANG Jian-feng;CHEN Ze-hua;JIANG Qing-gui;LIU Yu-qing;HAN Biao;CAO Shou-qi

title: Application of SRIO Interconnection Technology based on TMS320C6455
abstract: Rapid IO is a new type of switching bus. It has a lightweight transmission protocol; fast data transmission rate; and few physical connections. It can flexibly form multiple forms of transmission networks.Rapid IO is applied mostly between ships or boards. The TMS320 C6455（DSP6455 for short） is a highperformance digital signal processor with a processor running at up to 1.2 GHz. The DSP6455 has a SRIO（Serial Rapid IO） module that can be configured as four 1 x communication ports or as a 4 x communication port. A multi-tasking platform is designed using the DSP6455 as the main processor and internal high-speed data interaction channel. The platform is highly versatile and scalable. It is verified by experiments that the SRIO transmission rate is high and the platform data transmission is reliable and stable.
keywords: dsp6455, multitasking platform, srio
affiliations: No.30 Institute of CETC

title: Design and implementation of multi-channel serial communication interface based on TMS320C6748
abstract: In the embedded flight control system; to meet it ′ s miniaturization and integration; it needs to control multi-serial ports to communicate with external equipments. TMS320 C6748 is used to be a processor; which interfaces to TL16 C754 by DSP ′ s EMIF;enlarges multi-selective signals to make use of 74 LS138; and achieves multi-serial ports communication function with TL16 C754.The driver is designed with the real-time operating system SYS/BIOS; which minishes design difficulty; and cuts empolder period.The test results show that the design method can achieve complete reception of multi-channel data; and the data transmission is complete and reliable.
keywords: 74ls138, emif, multi-channel serial communication interface, tl16c754, tms320c6748
affiliations: Hunan Vanguard Group Co .,Ltd.

title: Design and Implementation of IPv6 and ZigBee Internet Gateway
abstract: Aiming at the problem that ZigBee wireless sensor network and IPv6 network cannot be directly interconnected;an embedded internet gateway based on Contiki operating system and cc2530 hardware platform is proposed.The gateway architecture is innovatively deployed on the Sink node in the ZigBee network;and the 6 LoWPAN technology is used to realize the interconnection and interworking between ZigBee network and IPv6 network.The header compression method on the 6 LoWPAN adaptation layer is improved;and the data exchanges between Zigbee protocol on the interface layer and IPv6 protocol on the network layer is realized.In the case of heavy transmission load;simulation results show that the gateway in this paper has the characteristics of low delay and low power consumption;and the effectiveness of the gateway is verified.
keywords: 6lowpan technology, contiki operating system, header compression, ipv6 protocol, wireless sensor network, zigbee protocol
authors: ZHAI Zhibo;FAN Zhihui;LI Jing;HE Xiangfu;WANG Hui

title: Design and Implementation of signs smart ear tag for dairy cows in farms
abstract: The cow signs monitoring system is an important part of the farm farming system. It is an important indicator point for judging the signs; diseases; estrus and milk quality of dairy cows. The existing discriminating method is to manually measure the rectal temperature; which is time-consuming and not suitable for large-scale breeding. In this paper; a smart ear tag based on WIFI is designed to measure the body signs of cows with body temperature and food intake. CC3200 is used as WIFI transmitter and processor; combined with high-precision non-contact temperature sensor TMP102 to measure the temperature of the ear; and the film pressure sensor measures the food intake; and realizes the body temperature and ear temperature difference compensation algorithm in the software. The ear tag sends the collected body temperature and food intake as a topic message to the MQTT server; and the display terminal receives the information by subscribing to the related topic message. Powered by button battery; CC3200 low power management; the life of the ear tag can reach more than two years. While saving manpower; it has improved the efficiency of dairy cow monitoring.

title: Design and implementation of multi-channel serial communication interface based on TMS320C6748
abstract: In the embedded flight control system; to meet it ′ s miniaturization and integration; it needs to control multi-serial ports to communicate with external equipments. TMS320 C6748 is used to be a processor; which interfaces to TL16 C754 by DSP ′ s EMIF;enlarges multi-selective signals to make use of 74 LS138; and achieves multi-serial ports communication function with TL16 C754.The driver is designed with the real-time operating system SYS/BIOS; which minishes design difficulty; and cuts empolder period.The test results show that the design method can achieve complete reception of multi-channel data; and the data transmission is complete and reliable.

title: Design and application of propellant leakage monitoring alarm system based on ZigBee wireless technology
abstract: In view of the serious harm of propellant leakage; a monitoring alarm system for propellant leakage based on CC2530 microcontroller and ZigBee wireless technology is proposed in this paper. The system mainly consists of wireless propellant leakage monitoring gas sensor; dual mode monitoring alarm host and master computer. The sensor and the alarm host transmit the signal through the ZigBee wireless technology. The alarm host and the master computer in the monitoring room transmit the data collected by the alarm host through Ethernet. The experimental results show that the wireless transmission of the system is reliable; and the monitoring error of propellant is less than 3%. The system realizes the wireless monitoring of propellant leakage; greatly reduces the installation time of the system; and has a strong mobility; not only realizes the fixed mode propellant leakage monitoring; but also realizes the leakage monitoring under the maneuver mode.

title: A kind of full digital TIG welding machine with the welding heat input monitoring
abstract: Aiming at the demands for welding heat input monitoring in the welding construction of nuclear power plant;a full digital IGBT inverter TIG welding machine with the welding heat input monitoring is designed and developed. This welding machine adopts DSP +ARM dual processor with TMS320F28335 digital signal processor and LPC2388FBD144 microcomputer;which realizes the digitalization of the main circuit control;human-computer interaction and external interface. By automatically recording the arc voltage;welding current and welding time during the welding process and manually inputting the length of the weld;the data of welding heat input is automatically calculated and displayed on the welding machine. The data of welding heat input can be saved in the local welding machine or USB flash disk through the USB interface;or can be uploaded to the host computer centralized control system for data transmission and monitoring through digital communication interface. The research shows that the welding machine can accurately record and monitor the welding heat input data during welding process;and meet the welding quality control requirements of nuclear power plant construction;which has broad application prospects.

title: Design and Implementation of IPv6 and ZigBee Internet Gateway
abstract: Aiming at the problem that ZigBee wireless sensor network and IPv6 network cannot be directly interconnected;an embedded internet gateway based on Contiki operating system and cc2530 hardware platform is proposed.The gateway architecture is innovatively deployed on the Sink node in the ZigBee network;and the 6 LoWPAN technology is used to realize the interconnection and interworking between ZigBee network and IPv6 network.The header compression method on the 6 LoWPAN adaptation layer is improved;and the data exchanges between Zigbee protocol on the interface layer and IPv6 protocol on the network layer is realized.In the case of heavy transmission load;simulation results show that the gateway in this paper has the characteristics of low delay and low power consumption;and the effectiveness of the gateway is verified.

title: 基于μC/OS-Ⅲ的主动悬架控制软件的研究和设计
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the active suspension control system has many control tasks;large amount of operation;high real-time and high stability;the vehicle active suspension control system software based on digital signal processor TMS320 F2812 and embedded real-time operating systemμC/OS-Ⅲ is researched and designed;and the μC/OS-Ⅲ is transplanted on the TMS320 F2812 DSP.The underlying hardware driver functions and related task functions of the various functional modules of the active suspension control software were written;and the preparation of the main function was completed. Finally;all the resources and tasks of the active suspension control system are assigned to the unified scheduling by μC/OS-Ⅲ.The test results show that the real-time operating system μC/OS-III running on the TMS320 F2812 can correctly schedule the tasks of the active suspension control system.Through the test;it can complete the decentralized decoupling tasks related to the active suspension control strategy;PID parameter self-tuning task and PID operation task in real time. The control software structure proposed in this paper is feasible.

title: 基于zigbee的即时土壤监测系统
abstract_in_chinese: 随着物联网技术的发展;基于zigbee技术的应用越来越广泛。解决耕地单位面积产量;增加农作物产量刻不容缓。本设计以CC2530和WiFiesp8266模块问核心;通过串口连接构建了一个zigbee终端节点的16位短地址和RSSI值发送给协调器;协调器通过串口将接收数据发送给WiFi模块;通过WIFI信号发送给wifi路由器接入核心网络;将所有数据传送至云端服务器;通过服务器整理后再将数据可观地发送至移动端显示。该系统基本实现了通过移动设备通过无线网络对网关进行访问;实时接收查看zigbee网络发送的数据;为更为详细的田间管理检测提供了保证。
