title: 基于DSP和HI-6121的1553B远程终端通讯技术研究
abstract: With 1553B bus becoming the main standard of avionics bus;UAVs with limited load space and power supply put higher requirements for the miniaturization;low power consumption and low cost of 1553B bus airborne equipment;which cannot be met by previous technical schemes.Based on the research of 1553B bus remote terminal technology and the specific requirements of a certain type of hanging missile;and comparing the functions;package size;power consumption and price of several 1553B protocol chips at home and abroad;a 1553B remote terminal technology scheme with DSP(TMS320 F2812)as the control core and HI-6121 as the protocol chip is proposed.The technical characteristics of HI-6121;system hard technical scheme and flow chart of system software design are introduced in detail.The scheme has been applied to a certain type of hanging missile and missile simulator;and has passed various performance tests and environmental adaptability tests in engineering and modeling stages.The test results show that the communication between remote terminal based on DSP and HI-6121 and 1553B bus control terminal is stable and reliable;which meets the requirements of miniaturization;low power consumption and low cost of UAV-borne equipment;and has high reliability and versatility.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着1553B总线成为航电总线的主要标准;载荷空间与电源功率有限的无人机;对1553B总线机载设备的小型化、低功耗和低成本提出了更高的要求;以往的技术方案已无法满足通过对1553B总线远程终端技术的研究;结合某型挂飞训练弹的具体要求;对比国内外多款1553B协议芯片的功能、封装尺寸、功耗和价格后;提出了一种以DSP (TMS320F2812)为控制核心;HI-6121为协议芯片的1553B远程终端技术方案;详细介绍了HI-6121的技术特点;技术方案硬件设计原理和软件设计流程该方案已应用于某型挂飞训练弹与导弹模拟器中;通过了工程阶段和定型阶段的各种性能试验与环境适应性试验;试验结果表明基于DSP和HI-6121的远程终端与1553B总线控制端的通信稳定、可靠;满足了无人机机载设备小型化、低功耗和低成本的需求;可靠性高;通用性好。
keywords: 1553b, dsp, hi-6121, rt
affiliations: Luoyang, 凯迈(洛阳)测控有限公司, Measurement &control Equipments Co.

title: Design of Digital Integrated Protector for Mine High Pressure Explosion-proof Switch
abstract: 针对井下供电系统常出现的供电事故类型;结合马兰矿井下供电系统实际情况;确定了高压防爆开关数字综合保护器的功能;基于微机保护的应用现状;设计了DSP芯片TMS320LF2407和单片机（AT89C55）协同工作的双CPU智能一体化高压防爆开关数字综合保护器系统;同时给出了该系统应对干扰的各项措施。该综合保护器具有工作并行、分工明确的优点;既提高了保护装置的数据处理速度;又使该保护器具有较高的可靠性;同时可实现保护、测量、控制、通信等智能一体化。

title: 基于Zigbee的环境参数监测系统设计与实现
abstract: 快速有效的检测养殖场的环境参数是养殖业所面临的重要问题;本文以养殖场的环境参数检测为目标;设计了环境参数监测系统。该系统使用DHT11传感器、MQ135气体传感器、光照传感器、CC2530单片机;利用Zigbee无线通信技术;对养殖场的温湿度、氨气浓度和光照强度等环境参数进行实时检测;并实现了上位机和下位机的实时显示;可以随时观察环境参数的变化。经实验;该系统具有监控范围广、速度快、精度高、无需现场布线等优点;有效地实现了对环境参数的实时监测;为养殖业生态环境信息系统的综合使用提供了技术支持。
keywords: zigbee技术, 养殖场, 检测, 环境参数

title: 基于物联网设备对特殊环境的多项数据检测与分析
abstract: 针对特殊地区环境参数采集存在布线繁琐、误报率高、危险性大等缺点;文章介绍了一种针对特殊环境多项数据检测与分析的方法。该方案采用ZigBee无线技术;以CC2530为主控制中心;选用温湿度、一氧化碳、二氧化碳、甲烷、硫化物等传感器;通过ZigBee无线网络实现了对特殊环境下多测量点的实时采集;监控中心通过串口获取ZigBee无线网络传来的传感器值后实时显示在界面上。此外还可通过监控中心远程修改环境参数临界值;参数异常后立即报警。经测试;该系统具有测量准确、反应灵敏、安全可靠等特点;可稍加修改后适用于不同的场合。

title: Design of facility planting monitoring system based on cloud platform
abstract: In the background of "Internet plus agriculture"; in order to effectively monitor and manage plant growing environment in greenhouse; a management mode of "one center; one platform" is realized. Intelligent and standardized agricultural production service platform was built by combining information technology such as Internet of Things; Mobile Internet and Cloud Computing with traditional agricultural production. The system hardware microprocessor module uses MSP430; radio frequency module uses CC1101 to transmit and receive data; using multi-sensor adaptive fusion algorithm to process environmental data and uses ECS technology to deploy Middleware in the cloud as a signal transmission intermediary. The system can monitor the environmental information and greenhouse picture in real time; and can control the greenhouse mechanism remotely by issuing instructions from the cloud server to achieve an environment suitable for crop growth. The system is stable and reliable; and the error of data transmission is less than 8%; which ensures that the data is not lost.
keywords: ecs, internet of things, internet plus, multi-sensor adaptive fusion algorithm
affiliations: Nanjing Research Institute for Agricultural Mechanization, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, College of Engineering, Nanjing Agricultural University

abstract: In order to control brushless direct current（DC） motor accurately; the speed control system with the high performance digital signal processor TMS320 F28335 is designed. The hardware is designed in the system; the software is introduced and the corresponding flow chart is drawn. The structure of the system is simple; and the speed control of the brushless DC motor can be realized effectively.

title: New Energy Storage System Design of the Micro-grid
abstract: The energy storage system can ensure the stability of the bus voltage;which is the guarantee of safe and reliable operation of all kinds of micro-grid. The energy storage system used the new bidirectional convertor;which was based on control chip TMS320F2812 to output PWM signal;and controlled the on and off states of the power switching devices by the driving circuit. In the meanwhile;the voltage and current signals were detected by the circuit and sent to control chip to handle;the charge and discharge of batteries and the bidirectional energy-transform were realized. Finally;the convertor was simulated to verify its accuracy.

title: Research on Witness Nodes Precise Position Technology Underground Coal Mine
abstract: In view of the current personnel positioning system in coal mine;the positioning accuracy is not high;and the location blind area exists.The research uses the principle of the Internet assisted node localization to realize the precise positioning of the system.In the paper;the idea of precise positioning of witness nodes is analyzed;the flow of witness node positioning algorithm and the positioning system with pedestrian track estimation function are designed.The test of the long lane corridor simulating the roadway environment is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the method.

title: Design and Implementation of μC/OS-Ⅱ Transplantation on TMS320F2812
abstract: The μC/OS-Ⅱ system is a preemptive multitask real-time operation system kernel with good portability.Aiming at the complex problem of task management in software development process on the TMS320 F2812 platform;this paper transplants the μC/OS-Ⅱsystem to the target platform;and realizes the function of task creation;deletion and priority setting based on the μC/OS-Ⅱ system;which greatly reduces the difficulty of multitask development.It has been proved that this method has high application value;and it can provide a reference for multitask project development.

title: Research on speed sensorless vector control system for mine electric motor vehicle
abstract: Traditional speed sensor of mining electric vehicle has many drawbacks such as inconveniently installation;easy to be damaged;expensively maintaining;and poor anti-electromagnetic interference ability.Focusing on these problems;speed sensorless technique was introduced based on original variable-frequency drive;and model reference adaptive control was used as the control algorithm of the non-speed sensor.TMS320 F28335 DSP was used as the core and adopting vector control strategy and space vector pulse width modulation technique.The speed sensorless variable-frequency drive for the mining electric vehicle was developed.M language was used to simulate the whole system in MATLAB;and the results showed that the speed measurement effect of the proposed speed observer could be comparable to that of conventional optical-electricity encoders.The speed sensorless vector control system was tested by the three-phase asynchronous motor test in laboratory;and the results showed that asynchronous motor had good performance under no-load current;load current and variable speed conditions;which demonstrated that this driving device had stable speed control performance;and could greatly reduce the workload of the electric vehicle;so as to meet the demand of mine for traction.

abstract: In the aerospace telemetry system;in order to improve the noise signal transmission and storage stability and efficiency of the sensor;a noise signal acquisition compression and storage system based on FPGA is designed. title: Research and Design of Two-Stage Solar RV Power Supply
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the DC power provided by most solar RV(Recreational Vehicle)batteries cannot supply power to most on-board electrical appliances;a DSP(Digital Signal Processing)-based power supply system for RV is proposed. The power main circuit adopts two-stage transformation. The front stage is composed of a push-pull forward circuit;a high-frequency transformer boost;and a diode uncontrolled rectification to form a DC-DC boost circuit;which boosts the 48 V DC voltage output from the RV battery to a stable DC bus voltage of 320 V. The latter stage is based on the double closed-loop full-bridge inverter circuit controlled by TMS320 F28335;and realizes the output of stable 220 V/50 Hz AC voltage through the filter inductor and capacitor. The whole system is simulated and verified by MATLAB/Simulink;and the experimental platform is built to test the correctness of the design of the RV power supply.

title: 一种超长点数脉压的实现方法
abstract: As a wide spread technology in radar systems;pulse compression is used to improve the radar resolution.With the development of wide band radar systems;the points of pulse compression become larger and larger.A method of fast implementation of ultra-long points pulse compression in frequency domain based on 2-D FFT algorithm is proposed.TMS320 C6678 EVM board is used to test the new method.The experiment result shows that the efficiency of the proposed method is improved by more than 20% compared with the traditional methods.128 K points pulse compression can be finished in about 0.81 ms by only one 1 GHz TMS320 C6678 chip.

title: Design ofa hand-held smart curved ruler
abstract: A hand-held smart ruler based on TI CC2540 is introduced in this paper. By measuring the rolling distance of an idler wheel on the surface of the irregular objects; the long distance and uninterrupted measurement can be achieved. The design uses the self-made magnetoelectric coding component; uses the radial magnetized columnar magnet as the rotating shaft; combines the magnetoelectric encoder AS5145 B and the roller into one;uses the TP4056 charging module to realize the charging function;and uses the OLED screen for display. Combined with the software design;this smart ruler can achieve measurement;data storage and display.

title: Design and Implementation of signs smart ear tag for dairy cows in farms
abstract: The cow signs monitoring system is an important part of the farm farming system. It is an important indicator point for judging the signs; diseases; estrus and milk quality of dairy cows. The existing discriminating method is to manually measure the rectal temperature; which is time-consuming and not suitable for large-scale breeding. In this paper; a smart ear tag based on WIFI is designed to measure the body signs of cows with body temperature and food intake. CC3200 is used as WIFI transmitter and processor; combined with high-precision non-contact temperature sensor TMP102 to measure the temperature of the ear; and the film pressure sensor measures the food intake; and realizes the body temperature and ear temperature difference compensation algorithm in the software. The ear tag sends the collected body temperature and food intake as a topic message to the MQTT server; and the display terminal receives the information by subscribing to the related topic message. Powered by button battery; CC3200 low power management; the life of the ear tag can reach more than two years. While saving manpower; it has improved the efficiency of dairy cow monitoring.
keywords: cc3200, ear temperature, internet of things（iot）, low-power, mqtt, tmp102

title: A Head Pose Algorithm Based on the MARG Sensor
abstract: Since the single-sensor based head pose measuring system of the Helmet-Mounted Display（HMD） suffers from low accuracy and poor precision?a novel algorithm based on the information fusion of MARG sensor is proposed.First?the complementary filtering is combined with PI algorithm to estimate the gyroscope drift error?and then the pose data fusion is implemented by using the Extended Kalman Filter（EKF）.We made experiments to compare the performance of the conventional single EKF and the proposed algorithm in filtering by using the measuring system composed of a CC1310?a gyroscope?an accelerometer and a magnetometer.The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can restrain the drift of the gyroscope and the noise of the accelerometer?and consequently improve the stability and precision of the head pose algorithm.
keywords: attitude algorithm, complementary filtering, head pose detection, helmet-mounted display（hmd）, marg sensor, pi algorithm
affiliations: Tianjin Polytechnic University,School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Tianjin Polytechnic University,School of Mechanical Engineering

title: Train auxiliary inverter parallel technology based on SOGI single phase PLL
abstract: The traditional three-phase phase-locked loop system in the auxiliary power supply system of the railway train is complicated. Moreover;the phase-locked performance is degraded in the case of unbalanced bus voltage and disturbance. Aiming at this problem;this paper proposes an improved SOGI-based single-phase phase-locked loop design scheme;which can improve the response speed of phase-lock and reduce the steady-state error while improving the simplicity of the system. This paper proposes a SOGI-based parallel control method for train-assisted inverters based on SOGI mathematical modeling analysis. Experimental verification is carried out on a parallel experimental platform of 50 kV·A three-phase auxiliary inverter based on DSP TMS320F28335. Simulation and experimental results show that the phase-locked scheme can effectively improve the parallel control performance of the auxiliary inverter.
keywords: auxiliary power supply in parallel, pll, sogi
authors: Li Wei-jie;DIAO Li-jun;GU Cheng-bo;KANG Cheng-wei;WANG Wei

title: TMS320F28335平台串口升级应用程序的方案实现
abstract: 本文介绍在TMS320F28335DSP处理器平台下;通过串口实现在线升级应用软件的一种方法。串口通讯遵循Ymodem通讯协议;借助微软Window操作系统自带的超级终端;即可实现应用升级。避开了TMS320F28335自带BootLoader升级软件需占用GPIO口的弊端;本文论述的方法可避免编写上位机软件;是一种便宜的方法。

title: An Improved Control Strategy for Wide Input and Wide Output LLC Converter
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional LLC converter is difficult to adapt to work under wide input and wide output voltage;a control strategy is proposed to realize the output regulation of the converter by changing the main circuit topology. The control strategy can realize the conversion between full-bridge and half-bridge topologies according to the different input and output voltages;so it can be applied to wide input and wide output conditions. Taking the digital chip TMS320F28035 as the control core;an experimental prototype with input of 100-400 V and output of 24-48 V/800 W is built. The experimental results show that the proposed control strategy can achieve smooth switching of the topology structure and keep the output voltage stable while running efficiently.
keywords: control strategy, dc/dc converter, llc converter, topology conversion
affiliations: College of Information Engineering,Guangdong University of Technology

title: Design of a Data Acquisition System Based on LabVIEW
abstract: The system uses CC2530 to collect the temperature of the dispersed nodes through Pt100;and displays the temperature on the LabVIEW interface of the host computer in real time. It can realize the remote query; display and storage of the temperature by using LabVIEW; which can effectively meet the requirements of multi-measurement points; mobility and convenience in the process of industrial and agricultural testing; and has a very broad application prospect.
keywords: cc2530, labview, pt100, temperature

title: Design of VehicleTraffic Lights State Acquisition and Display System
abstract: This design is a state acquisition and display system for Traffic Light. The system consists of traffic light control module; Zigbee coordinator module and Zigbee terminal module. The traffic light module transmits the status information of Traffic Light to the coordinator through the serial port; and uses Zigbee wireless communication technology to send the status information of the signal lamp to the terminal and display it. Using CC2530 and peripheral interface to build hardware; Z-stack protocol stack to write the underlying software. The test results show that the system can collect and display traffic light status information timely and accurately.
keywords: the technology of zigbee, traffic lights, wireless communications
authors: PENG Wei-qing;ZHANG Mu-lei;XIAO Jian-li;WANG Fa-she;PI Bo;LIU Heng-yuan

title: Design of wireless sensor network terminal based on CC2530
abstract: With the development of wireless network transmission technology;wireless sensor network has been increasingly applied in many fields such as transportation;railway;environmental protection and agriculture. Among them;the wireless sensor network terminal is one of the important part of the system;this paper proposes a design of wireless sensor network terminal;CC2530 chip as the core processor;the chip integrates ZigBee communication protocols;and coupled with a variety of type sensor interface circuit; makes the system has simple structure; versatility; low cost and low energy consumption advantages;such as the feasibility of the scheme is verified by experiment.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着无线网路传输技术的发展;无线传感器网络在交通、铁路、环保、农业等多个领域得到越来越多的应用。其中;无线传感器网络终端是系统的重要组成部分之一;本文提出一种无线传感器网络终端设计方案;以CC2530芯片为核心处理器;芯片集成了ZigBee通信协议;同时配合多种类型传感器接口电路;使得系统具备结构简单、通用性强、低成本且低能耗等优势;通过实验验证了方案的可行性。
keywords: data collection, management, node, terminal, wireless sensor network

title: Research on Control Strategy of a Solid State Transformer Isolated Stage DAB Converter
abstract: Solid-state transformer is a new type of electrical equipment which applies power electronics technology to power transformer. The isolation stage of solid-state transformer adopts DAB converter;which is suitable for high power applications and easy to realize ZVS(Zero-Voltage Switching). Based on phase-shifting control;the flow direction of power and energy is adjusted by changing phase-shifting duty cycleby introducing compensation link in closed-loop control;static error of the system is eliminated and dynamic response speed is improvedthe simulation model is built to verify the working state of the DAB converter under phase-shifting control;the experimental platform based on TMS320 F28335 verifies that the DAB converter can realize DC voltage conversion function and the output voltage can be stabilized at a set value. Finally;the power frequency AC voltage is generated through the inverter stage;which verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy.
abstract_in_chinese: 固态变压器是一种将电力电子技术运用到电力变压器中的新型电气设备。固态变压器隔离级采用DAB变换器;适用于大功率场合;易于实现零电压关联ZVS(Zero-Voltage Switching)。基于移相控制;通过改变移相占空比来调节传输功率和能量的流动方向通过在闭环控制中引入补偿环节;消除了系统的静态误差;提高了动态响应速度搭建仿真模型;验证了移相控制下DAB变换器的工作状态;通过基于TMS320F28335的实验平台验证了DAB变换器能够实现直流变压功能;并且输出电压能够稳定在设定值;最终经逆变级产生了工频交流电压;验证了控制策略的有效性。
keywords: closed-loop control, compensation link, dab converter, duty cycle, phase shift control

title: Scale model design of nodes power control network based on ZigBee
abstract: The large scale model for displays usually need to be equipped with multiple power control points for the purpose of lighting and motors;but the traditional wired control method is not flexible enough to achieve complex control effects. In this paper;a wireless network node control system based on ZigBee protocol is designed;which can realize the node separate control and group control of the scale model power supply with the benefit of increase or decrease in the number of nodes dynamically;which also can effectively overcome the shortcomings of the traditional control method. The ZigBee node design is based on SoC chip of CC2530;and the ZigBee protocol stack depends on the ZStack of TI Company. The specific control protocol is designed in the system;and the host computer software is used for some complex control effect;which could obtain the working state of the node.
abstract_in_chinese: 大型展示用沙盘通常配置多个照明与电机电源控制点;传统的有线控制方式不够灵活;难以实现复杂的控制效果。本文设计了一种基于ZigBee协议的无线网络节点控制系统;可实现沙盘电源的节点单独控制与成组控制;节点可动态增减;有效地克服了传统控制方式的缺点。节点设计基于CC2530片上系统;ZigBee协议栈采用TI公司的ZStack。设计了控制协议;利用上位机软件可做出复杂的控制效果和获取节点的工作状态。
keywords: network design, node control, scale model, zigbee
affiliations: 淮安信息职业技术学院

title: Signal acquisition system for micro sensor based on FPGA
abstract: In order to realize real-time acquisition and display of analog signals output by micro sensor;a microsensor signal acquisition system based on field programmable gate array( FPGA) is proposed. The system is composed of a FPGA;a 24 bit high-precision analog-to-digital( A/D) converter ADS1256 and a host computer.FPGA is used acts as the the controller of the system. The general input/output( I/O) port of FPGA is programmed by Verilog language to simulate the signal timing of serial perpheral interface( SPI) bus;and complete the read-write operation control of the ADS1256. By using RS—232 serial communication;the sampled data is transported to the host computer developed in Visual C + + developing environment;and the functions of real-time acquisition;display and data storage of the analog signal of the micro sensors are finally realized. The precision of the acquisition system is tested by acquiring the standard direct current( DC) voltage signal;and the error is less than 0. 03 %.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现对微传感器输出的模拟信号进行实时采集和显示;提出了一种基于现场可编程门阵列(FPGA)的微传感器信号采集系统。系统由FPGA;24位高精度模/数转换芯片ADS1256和上位机构成。系统采用FPGA作为核心控制器;利用Verilog语言;对FPGA的普通I/O口进行编程;模拟串行外设接口(SPI)总线规范的信号时序;完成ADS1256的读写操作控制。通过RS—232串口通信将采集到的数据送入由Visual C++开发平台编写的上位机中;最终实现微传感器输出模拟信号的实时采集、显示和数据保存等功能。通过采集标准直流电压信号进行测试;测得采样误差小于0. 03%。
keywords: 24 bit analog-to-digital conversion(adc), field programmable gate array(fpga), micro sensors, voltage acquisition
affiliations: 中国计量大学机电工程学院

title: Design of Inverter Experiment System for Power Electronics Technology Course
abstract: The inverter experimental system with high-performance MCU-TMS320 F28335 as the digital control was designed; and the corresponding teaching experiment content was developed to meet the requirements of the teaching experiment of Power Electronics Technology course. After analyzing the structure of the instrument of the teaching experiment based on three-phase full-bridge converter; the frequency control strategy; square wave inverter control strategy; phase shift voltage regulation control strategy and SPWM inverter voltage regulation control strategy were applied in the teaching experiment instrument prototype the inverter verification experiments of a specific single-phase square wave and three-phase square wave; single-phase SPWM and three-phase SPWM fo cusing on the voltage regulation function and the frequency adjustment function are planned.
abstract_in_chinese: 研制了以高性能MCU-TMS320F28335为数字控制核心的逆变实验系统;配套设计相应教学实验内容;满足"电力电子技术"课程的教学实验要求。分析了基于三相全桥变换器的教学实验平台结构;设计了频率控制策略、方波逆变控制策略、移相调压控制策略和SPWM逆变的调压控制策略;还给出了教学实验平台样机。最后围绕电压调节功能和频率调节功能设计了具体的单相方波逆变验证实验、三相方波逆变验证实验、单相SPWM逆变验证实验和三相SPWM逆变验证实验。
keywords: digital control, experiment instrument, power electronic technology, spwm inversion, square wave inversion
affiliations: 丽水学院工学院
source: 丽水学院学报 ;Journal of Lishui University ; Editorial E-mail ;2019(05)

title: Design of Underground Hydraulic Prop Route Safety Detection System
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the pressure value of the underground single hydraulic prop group cannot be collected and processed centrally; a monitoring system of the routing system was designed. The system was divided into terminal nodes and routing nodes. The terminal node mainly uses SH79 TF166 single chip microcomputer as the main control circuit and uses ZigBee for wireless communication transmission. The routing node mainly uses CC2530 controller as the receiving control unit and uses MCP2515 chip for CAN bus transmission. Finally; the monitoring values were collected into the local gateway system. Through the field test; the designed routing system CAN meet the data acquisition work of multiple hydraulic props; selectively transmit the aggregated data to the gateway node through ZigBee wireless transmission or CAN bus; realize the pressure numerical monitoring of multiple underground hydraulic props; improve applicability and efficiency; and effectively ensure underground safety.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对井下单体液压支柱群的压力数值无法集中收集和处理的问题;设计了路由监测系统。该系统分为终端节点和路由节点。终端节点主要以SH79TF166单片机为主控电路;并利用ZigBee进行无线通信传输。路由节点主要以CC2530控制器作为接收控制单元;利用MCP2515芯片进行CAN总线传输。最后将监测值汇集到本地网关系统。通过现场测试;设计的路由系统能满足对多个液压支柱的数据采集工作;有选择地通过ZigBee无线传输或CAN总线的方式将汇总数据传输到网关节点;实现对多个井下液压支柱的压力数值监控;提高适用性和效率;有效保证井下安全。
keywords: can bus, routing node, single hydraulic prop, terminal node, zigbee wireless network
affiliations: 徐州工程学院信电工程学院, 安徽理工大学电气学院
source: 煤矿机械 ;Coal Mine Machinery ; Editorial E-mail ;2019(05)

The traffic light module transmits the status information of Traffic Light to the coordinator through the serial port; and uses Zigbee wireless communication technology to send the status information of the signal lamp to the terminal and display it. title: 基于1553B总线的兼容型智能控制器设计
abstract: According to the requirement of intelligence and universality of the electronic system in aerospace craft;a compatible intelligent controller based on 1553 B bus is designed in this paper.In the hardware design;the controller’s core circuit is consist of DSP chip TMS320 F2812 with high performance and 1553 B bus chip B61580.An acceleration recognition module is designed in the controller;which can sense the acceleration of aircraft.With the sensor;the controller could control the execution unit intelligently.In the software design;a compatible software is realized with C language.
abstract_in_chinese: 根据航天飞行器对电子系统智能性、通用性的要求;设计了一种基于1553B总线的兼容型智能控制器。该控制器在硬件上采用高性能DSP芯片TMS320F2812和1553B总线芯片B61580构成核心电路;控制器内置了加速度识别模块;能够感知飞行器的加速值;从而自主实现对执行单元的控制。软件上采用嵌入式C语言实现兼容性软件设计。经试验验证;该兼容型智能控制器运行可靠;性能良好;能够满足系统对智能控制器的要求。
keywords: 1553b, acceleration recognition, dsp, intelligent control
affiliations: 北京航天自动控制研究所, 北京航天长征飞行器研究所

title: 基于无线传感网络的在线室内环境监测研究
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a current popular technology in the field of indoor environment monitoring. In order to realize real-time online monitoring of indoor humidity; temperature; light and other factors; an indoor environment online monitoring system based on ZigBee bidirectional wireless communication technology is designed in this paper. The chip model of ZigBee communication module is CC2530. The communication mode of system gateway is GPRS mode. The data collected is processed online and real-time by data analysis model. After testing; the designed indoor environment real-time acquisition and monitoring system can run stably; acquire indoor environment data in real time; and update real-time on the server side of the system through the network management of the system; so as to realize the real-time monitoring and adjustment of indoor environment parameters.
abstract_in_chinese: 无线传感网络在室内环境监测领域中是当前热门技术;为了实现对室内湿度、温度、光照等因素的实时在线监测;设计了基于ZigBee双向无线通讯技术的室内环境在线监测系统;系统ZigBee的通信模块选用的芯片型号为CC2530;系统网关的通信模式选用GPRS模式;并利用数据分析模型对采集的数据进行了在线实时处理.经测试;设计的室内环境实时采集监测系统能够稳定运行;能够实时获取室内的环境数据并通过系统的网管在系统的服务器端实时更新;实现室内环境参数的实时监视与调节.
keywords: sensors, wireless sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: Anhui Open University, School of Information Engineering, 安徽广播电视大学信息工程学院

title: 基于嵌入式平台的智能窗帘开发
abstract: With the development of the Internet of things; people have more and more requirements for smart home; Smart curtains are of vital importance. It not only has the function of shading and beautifying; but also has the function of convenient and intelligent use. The system is based on the design of the intelligent cloud-object platform. The embedded microprocessor is selected to collect the light intensity value through the photosensitive wireless sensor; and the curtain is controlled by the stepper motor. At the same time; ZigBee is used to build wireless network communication technology. Data acquisition takes CC2530 as the underlying hardware platform to collect light intensity in real time. Intelligent curtain can automatically; manually; voice three ways to control the curtain lifting and opening; closing degree; to bring people a more convenient and comfortable living environment.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着物联网的发展;人们对智能家居有着越来越高的要求;智能窗帘在其中有着不可或缺的重要性。不仅要具有遮光作用和美化功能;更要具备方便智能的使用功能。系统基于智云物联平台设计;选取嵌入式微处理器;通过光敏无线传感器采集光强值、步进电机控制窗帘的升降;同时采用了ZigBee搭建无线网络通信技术。数据采集以CC2530作为底层硬件平台;实时采集光线强度。智能窗帘可通过自动、手动、语音三种方式控制窗帘的升降及打开、闭合程度;给人们带来更加便捷舒适的生活环境。
keywords: cc2530, embedded, intelligent curtains, internet of things, zigbee

title: ARM-based real-time data display system for automatic weather stations
abstract: In this study;an ARM-based real-time local data display system for automatic weather stations is proposed. This system uses an STM32 microprocessor as the main controller as well as an RS232 port and Zigbee wireless sensor network to automatically acquire real-time data collected by automatic weather stations. Finally;the data are displayed through a light emitting diode（LED）screen.This system was developed using the C programming language in the Keil u Vision4 and IAR Embedded Workbench development environments. Actual test results reveal that the proposed system can present local meteorological data such as temperature;relative humidity;and visibility through LED displays in real time and in an intuitive and steady manner. This system enables persons to understand local meteorological conditions quickly and can be used in various locations such as scenic locations;highspeed highways;and ships.
keywords: arm, cc2530, led, real-time data display systems, stm32, zigbee
affiliations: Hainan Provincial Meteorological Observation Center, Hainan Provincial Meteorological Information Center

title: Design of intelligent greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless sensor
abstract: In order to effectively monitor the greenhouse environment and reduce the labor cost investment; a set of intelligent greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless network was designed. The intelligent greenhouse monitoring system uses the CC2530 chip as the main controller to collect greenhouse environment data and upload it to the user through the wireless network; the user side uses LABVIEW software development to process and display the greenhouse data; the agricultural inspection vehicle is equipped with sensors to collect environmental data. The experiment verified that the system can control the relative humidity in the greenhouse at 45%～70% and the light intensity between 1 000～30 000 Lux.
keywords: agricultural inspection car, greenhouse monitoring, mobile acquisition, wireless network
authors: Zhang Xin;Liu Jie;Ye Run;Li Xiuquan;Huang Li
affiliations: Yangtze University, Electronics and Information Institute, The National Electrotechnics National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center

title: Design of Terminal Monitoring Node of Forest Environment Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: A terminal monitoring node of forest environment intelligent monitoring system is designed based on Internet of Things technology. The terminal selects STM32 as the main controller; combines the sensors to collect and judge the surrounding environment data of the nodes; and controls the operation of the peripheral devices and the entire terminal monitoring node system. CC2530 is selected as the data transmission main controller for receiving the alarm sent by the STM32 serial port. title: Micro-positioning Technology to Build Quanzhou Smart Tourism City
abstract: Tourism is one of the most promising industries; and the traditional development mode of tourism can no longer meet people’s needs. It is a very valuable research topic to introduce intelligent science and technology into tourism and realize tourism wisdom. In this paper; embedded chip（ARM STM32F0x; CC2530; CC2541;ATmega328）; micro-positioning technology（Beacon）; Raspberry Pi3 are used to connect to the cloud through BLE（Bluetooth Smart）; ZigBee; Wi-Fi; LoRa network. Tourists can enjoy all kinds of intimate and active services of smart city as long as they carry smart phones and Beacon accessories. This paper presents three smart city solutions: active intelligent voice guide; intelligent parking and active service smart building technology.
keywords: intelligent technology, micro positioning, smart city

title: 智能家居中ZigBee定位系统研究
abstract: ＜正＞由于室内环境较为复杂;北斗和GPS等室外定位技术很难达到室内定位的要求;传统的红外、超声波以及WiFi室内定位技术;存在着技术缺陷或开发成本高等问题;未能得到广泛推广应用。为此;设计了以CC2530微处理器为核心的室内定位系统;并根据不同通信节点的功能对其搭载相应的辅助通信模块。在12m×11.5m的实际环境中对所设计的定位系统进行了测试;结果表明传统的指纹库定位算法平均误差为2.03m。

title: Smart Home based on ZigBee Wireless Network Control System Design
abstract: This paper based on ZigBee wireless network technology has carried on the design of smart home control system;the system selected CC2530 for hardware development platform;software development using Z-Stack based programming;selected PC for home gateway;connected to the Internet and smart home system;finally realizes the remote control family internal sensors;improve the sense of convenience and comfort of People’s Daily life.

title: A Study on Detection to Elder People Falling Posture
abstract: The MPU6050 six-axis sensor detects the acceleration and inclination values of the elder people in three directions and transmits the data to the CC2530 microprocessor.After CC2530 adjusting the data;Zigbee wireless communication technology is used to transmit the data to the main controller of smart terminal STM32 in the nursing home.The main controller determines whether the elder people falls or not by combining with the multi-threshold algorithm for judging falls.After the fall;an alarm is issued and an alarm prompt is displayed on the host screen.This paper is mainly used to judge falling posture.By comparing the regional acceleration intensity SMA and SMV values of acceleration intensity as well as the difference of inclination angles under different static and motion states;it can distinguish falling from other daily behavior events.

title: 基于嵌入式的小区节能监控物联网系统设计
abstract: 本研究以S5PV210 ARM处理器和CC2530 ZigBee模块为核心设计小区节能嵌入式物联网监控系统。该系统硬件包含空调节能、照明节能和消防报警节能监控系统三个部分;能够实现对小区公共区域空调运行、路灯照明和消防报警系统的能耗采集和自动控制。软件部分以ZigBee模块为基础形成小区节能信号采集网络节点;其有物联网监测传输功能。本文详细阐述了上述系统的硬件和软件设计内容;幵对系统的应用价值迚行了展望;以期为嵌入式和物联网技术在小区节能监控系统中的应用提供借鉴。

title: Monitoring System for Dangerous Zone of Belt Conveyer Based on Thermal Imaging and ZigBee
abstract: The dangerous zone monitoring system based on thermal imaging and ZigBee is designed and realized. On the basis of the main processor CC2530; the thermal infrared signal monitoring circuit; relay control circuit and serial communication circuit are designed. Based on ZigBee network and internet; the monitoring terminal system software has been designed. After monitoring the human body’s thermal signals; the monitoring terminal generates warning signals. In addition; the monitoring terminal closes the belt machine system through relay circuit. The warning signals and human thermal images are transmited to remote monitoring terminal through gateway nodes.
keywords: belt conveyor, dangerous area, infrared thermal imaging, monitoring system, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Design of inverter repetitive control system based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In view of the difficult industrial application of repetitive controller to inverter; this paper studies the repetitive controller design and the software implementation of repetitive controller. The notch filter; the low pass filter and phase lead compensator are designed respectively to meet the requirement of the inverter stability and the steady error. In this paper; an inverter repetitive controller system is built based on TMS320F28335 chip. And the software implementation of all parts of repetitive controller is elaborated. A series of experiments about the inverter repetitive control system verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

title: Real-time acquisition system for ecological environment parameters based on Beidou and ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor real-time acquisition of ecological environment parameters; low level of intelligence and blind area of common remote communication technology; a real-time acquisition system of ecological environment parameters based on Beidou and ZigBee is designed and implemented. The system takes CC2530 chip as the core; which combines with ZigBee and Beidou short message technology; and selects the basic environmental parameters of temperature; humidity; pressure; light intensity; soil moisture content and negative oxygen ions. It establishes a ZigBee monitoring network; inserts Beidou short message module into the network node; and designs the remote data transmission coding which is easy to expand and suitable for short message. The coding of transmission is applied to Beidou mobile terminal to realize real-time display and storage of data. The experimental results show that the ZigBee monitoring network works well; and the Beidou short message module on the gateway node receives more than 95% packets. The system runs stably and reliably. At the same time; it also has expansibility and can integrate other sensors.

title: Application of ZigBee technology in distributed photovoltaic power generation system
abstract: Monitoring and maintenance of the PV modules are indispensable; especially for station locate on remote area.However; there exists amount of work about wiring and maintenance problem by transiting data in wired transmission tech like RS-485 transmission. Focus on solving these problems; a PV power generation monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless tech was investigated. The data transmission module was controlled by CC2530; compatible with RS-485 interface; and could operate under 4 different power modes. To verify the feasibility of this project; the hardware simulation platform was constructed. Different networking modes and detection modes were simulated; after operating for a long time; conclusion was made after comparing captured data and transmitted data.
abstract_in_chinese: 光伏电站的光伏组件和逆变器的监控与维护是必不可少的;特别是对于分布在人烟稀少的偏远地区的系统;采用RS-485总线等有线数据传输方式会对前期布线和后期维修等带来巨大工作量和成本投入。针对以上问题;设计了基于ZigBee技术的光伏发电监测系统。系统所采用的无线数据传输模块以CC2530为控制核心;兼容RS-485通讯接口;可工作于四种功耗模式。搭建硬件模拟平台;通过模拟不同的组网方式和不同的监测方式;并在长时间运行后;通过比对收发数据量;证明该监测方案的稳定性和可靠性。

title: Design of intelligent greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless sensor
abstract: In order to effectively monitor the greenhouse environment and reduce the labor cost investment; a set of intelligent greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless network was designed. The intelligent greenhouse monitoring system uses the CC2530 chip as the main controller to collect greenhouse environment data and upload it to the user through the wireless network the user side uses LABVIEW software development to process and display the greenhouse data the agricultural inspection vehicle is equipped with sensors to collect environmental data. The experiment verified that the system can control the relative humidity in the greenhouse at 45%～70% and the light intensity between 1 000～30 000 Lux.
abstract_in_chinese: 为有效监控温室环境;减小人力成本投入;设计一套基于无线网络的智能温室监控系统。智能温室监控系统使用CC2530芯片为主控制器;采集温室环境数据并通过无线网络上传到用户端用户端使用LABVIEW软件开发;负责处理温室数据并显示农业巡检小车搭载传感器移动式采集环境数据。试验验证表明:该系统可将温室中湿度控制在45%～70%;光照强度控制在1 000～30 000 Lux之间。

title: Development of Data Acquisition System with a Large Dynamic Range for Pulsed Radiation Field Diagnosis
abstract: A high-speed data acquisition system(DAS)with dynamic range of 100 dB is developed to meet the special needs of pulsed radiation diagnosis;which realizes the function of front-end waveform digitization of output signal of pulsed radiation field.By using both attenuation circuit and over-voltage protection circuit; the designed analog signal conditioning module can ensure the accurate measurements of large signal and small signal at same time;and avoid the error caused by overlapping measurement of oscilloscope channel range.The LMX2594 chip is used to produce 2-channel;1 GHz high quality homologous clock signals;while the time delay between them can be adjusted.The firmware programmed realizes the functions of receiving high-speed parallel sampling data;cyclic storage;sequential readout;and so on.The results of amplitude calibration and time calibration show that the linearity of the system is good and the triggered sloshing is less than 1 ns.The field test results show that the developed DAS can effectively acquire analog electrical signals with dynamic range of 100 dB from pulsed radiation field.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对脉冲辐射场诊断的特殊需求;研制了动态范围为100dB的高速数据采集系统;可实现脉冲辐射场输出信号波形前端数字化的功能。设计的模拟信号调理模块配合使用衰减电路和过压保护电路;可同时保证对大信号和小信号的准确测量;避免了示波器信道量程搭接的问题采用LMX2594芯片产生了2路、1GHz的高品质同源时钟信号;2路时钟信号之间的延时可调设计的固件程序可实现高速并行采样数据的接收、循环存储和顺序读出等功能。系统的电压幅值标定和时间标定结果表明;系统电压幅值线性良好;触发晃动小于1ns现场测试表明;系统可以有效获取脉冲辐射场输出的动态范围为100dB的模拟电信号。

abstract: In this paper;the automatic control system of intelligent pear grading machine based on industrial 4 is designed and researched based on the embedded technology and Internet of things technology under the background of industry 4. 0 and the AM5728 processor of Sitara series of TI company combined with image processing technology. The experimental results show that the correct classification number of the system is more than 930;that is;the accuracy rate is over 93%;and the system efficiency is high;and the stability is strong;so it has broad market space.

title: Design and Application of Intelligent Feed Management Control System for Household Pets
abstract: In order to broaden the intelligent feeding and management methods for pets; a pet feeder system model combining wireless object control and video monitoring was designed. The system consists of four components:an embedded micro-controller circuit; a drive control circuit; Wi-Fi remote control; intelligent embedded system camera image transmission. It uses STM32 F103 RCT6 embedded micro-controller processor to control the timing of automatic feeding or watering. It implements Pet Feeder remote control function using CC3200 chip. By Intel Edison embedded micro-computer camera information collection and upload it to the user’s browser; it realizes remote feeding and monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 为拓宽宠物智能喂养和管理方法;设计了以无线物联控制和视频监控相结合的宠物喂食器系统模型。系统主要由嵌入式微控器电路、驱动控制电路、Wi-Fi远程控制、智能嵌入式系统摄像头图像传输4部分组成。通过STM32F103RCT6嵌入式微控处理器来控制宠物喂食器进行定时定量喂食或自动喂水;利用支持HTTP服务器的CC3200对宠物喂食器进行远程功能控制;通过Intel Edison嵌入式微型计算机对摄像头信息进行采集并上传到用户浏览器;实现了远程喂食和监控功能。

title: Design of a Simple Frequency Meter based on DSP
abstract: In order to improve the precision of measuring the frequency;signal period;duty cycle and other electrical parameters;this paper proposes a simple frequency meter design base on signal digital processing(DSP);using TMS320F28335 DSP chip as the core;and external LCD12864 display screen;which can be used to measure the frequency;signal period and duty cycle of square wave.The proposed frequency meter uses the DSP TMS320F28335 internal timer TO to obtain the frequency of signal through the integration of the pulse number of interrupt timing frequency measurement and capturing frequency measurement method.In the proposed method;the signal period can be obtained according to the number of high frequency pulses;and then the signal frequency can be computed in accordance with the equation f=1/T.Finally;the value of frequency is showed by the LCD12864 real-time display.The test results show that the system is simple;convenient and versatile;and the relative error is less than or equal to 0.09%.The measurement range of the proposed frequency meter is 1 Hz-13 MHz;which can meet the actual needs.

abstract_in_chinese: 该终端选用STM32作为主控制器;结合各传感器对节点周围环境数据采集和判断;控制外围设备及整个终端监测节点系统的运行选用CC2530作为数据发送主控制器;用于接收STM32串口发送的报警数据;并通过ZigBee网络将采集到的各项环境数据和GPS定位信息无线发送至协调器服务器端;并实时报警;完成对森林环境数据的实时监测及处理.
keywords: sensor, stm32, terminal monitoring node, zigbee
authors: Cai Zhiwei;Gao Liang;Sun Lichao;Zhang Weiguang;Cong Wei

title: 基于CC3200的人流量统计监控系统设计
abstract: This paper introduces a real-time statistical monitoring system based on CC3200 controller for the flow of people in designated areas of public places. The system uses pyroelectric infrared sensor to detect human body. The main controller collects and uploads the sensor signal to the upper computer in real time. The upper computer uses KingView 6.55 software to develop the user interface and display the human flow statistics in real time.
abstract_in_chinese: 介绍一种基于CC3200为主控制器的对公共场所指定区域人流量进行实时统计监测的系统。系统采用热释电红外传感器检测人体;主控制器对传感器信号实时采集和上传到上位机;上位机采用KingView6.55组态王软件开发人机界面;实时显示人流量统计数据。
keywords: cc3200 chip, kingview 6.55, pir, statistics of flow

title: 基于无线传感的智能温室监控系统设计
abstract: In order to effectively monitor the greenhouse environment and reduce the labor cost investment; a set of intelligent greenhouse monitoring system based on wireless network was designed. The intelligent greenhouse monitoring system uses the CC2530 chip as the main controller to collect greenhouse environment data and upload it to the user through the wireless network the user side uses LABVIEW software development to process and display the greenhouse data the agricultural inspection vehicle is equipped with sensors to collect environmental data. The experiment verified that the system can control the relative humidity in the greenhouse at 45%～70% and the light intensity between 1 000～30 000 Lux.
abstract_in_chinese: 为有效监控温室环境;减小人力成本投入;设计一套基于无线网络的智能温室监控系统。智能温室监控系统使用CC2530芯片为主控制器;采集温室环境数据并通过无线网络上传到用户端用户端使用LABVIEW软件开发;负责处理温室数据并显示农业巡检小车搭载传感器移动式采集环境数据。试验验证表明:该系统可将温室中湿度控制在45%～70%;光照强度控制在1 000～30 000 Lux之间。
keywords: agricultural inspection car, greenhouse monitoring, mobile acquisition, wireless network
authors: Zhang Xin;Liu Jie;Ye Run;Li Xiuquan;Huang Li

title: 智能家居中ZigBee定位系统研究
abstract_in_chinese: 由于室内环境较为复杂;北斗和GPS等室外定位技术很难达到室内定位的要求传统的红外、超声波以及WiFi室内定位技术;存在着技术缺陷或开发成本高等问题;未能得到广泛推广应用。为此;设计了以CC2530微处理器为核心的室内定位系统;并根据不同通信节点的功能对其搭载相应的辅助通信模块。在12m×11.5m的实际环境中对所设计的定位系统进行了测试;结果表明传统的指纹库定位算法平均误差为2.03m。
affiliations: 安徽理工大学电气与信息工程学院

title: 采用滑模观测器的SGCMG框架伺服系统研究
abstract: Conventional mechanical angle measurement sensors are utilized in order to solve the problems caused by increasing system size; weight; cost and installing sensors that lead in errors and unreliability in frame servo systems. Based on TMS320 F28335 as main controller and A3 PE3000 as slave controller; we have designed the hardware circuit for electrical signal acquisition and operation. Meanwhile; a sliding mode observer is proposed for angle estimation to replace mechanical sensors. In this method; the relevant electrical signals in the motor windings are measured by hardware circuits. The rotor position and velocity estimation are implemented by establishing a sliding mode observer and a phase-locked loop algorithm. The simulation model is built in Simulink. The simulation results show that the values of position and velocity estimated by the sliding mode observer are convergent to real value after the system runs for 0.2 s.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对框架伺服系统中应用的传统机械式角度测量传感器存在增加系统尺寸、重量和成本以及安装传感器会引起系统误差和降低系统可靠性等问题;基于TMS320F28335主控制器和A3PE3000从控制器设计硬件电路进行电信号采集和运算;并提出滑模观测器进行角度估算以替代机械式传感器;角度估算依据硬件电路测得电机绕组中有关精确的电信号;采用建立滑模观测器和基于锁相环算法实现转子位置和速度估算。在Simulink中搭建仿真模型;仿真结果表明;通过滑模观测器估计得到的位置值和速度值在系统运行0.2 s后能够稳定的跟踪上实际值。
keywords: hardware design, mathematical modeling, permanent magnet synchronous motor, servo system, single gimbal control moment gyroscope, sliding mode observer
authors: Chen Maosheng;Ltd.;Dai Lu;Kong Lingbo;Wang Chaoqun;Hu Bing;Yu Yue

title: 基于ZigBee无线通信的靶标温度数据传输系统设计
abstract: In order to evaluate the detection performance of infrared optical systems under harsh environmental conditions;this paper develops a wireless target system that can be transmitted wirelessly by simulating the thermal radiation of various large objects. Firstly;based on the principle of ZigBee wireless communication;a wireless data transmission system composed of a three-level communication structure such as a total control computer;a data relay station and a target board system is designed. Then;a high-speed serial A/D analog-to-digital conversion hardware acquisition card is designed with ARM as the core processor;and the temperature data of each target unit can be wirelessly transmitted to the relay computerFurthermore;based on TI’s CC2530 chip;the coordination group hardware transmitted between the target communication module and the relay station is designed. Based on VC++;the upper computer software including the target terminal;router and coordinator is developed. Finally;communication with the host computer through the relay station is displayed by the master control unit to monitor the temperature control of each target unit. The target temperature data transmission system based on Zigbee wireless communication has the advantages of flexible network node combination;no spatial hypothesis order;and can greatly reduce the advantages of the data transmission line in the system;and the wireless transmission distance is effective within 100 m.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了评价恶劣环境条件下红外光学系统的探测性能;通过模拟各种大型物体的热辐射;研制了一种可无线传输的红外靶标系统数据传输系统。首先;基于ZigBee无线通信原理;设计了由总控计算机、数据中继站、靶板系统等三级通信结构组成的无线数据传输系统然后以ARM为核心处理器设计了高速串行A/D模数转换的硬件采集卡;可将各个靶标单元的温度数据通过无线传输至中继计算机进而;基于TI公司CC2530芯片设计了靶板通信模块与中继站之间传输的协调组硬件;又基于VC++开发了包含靶板终端、路由器、协调器三部分通信的上位机软件最后;通过中继站与上位机通信由总控上位机显示;监控每个靶元温控情况。该种基于Zigbee无线通信的靶标温度数据传输系统;具有网络节点组合灵活、空间假设次序无要求;且可大量减少系统中数据传输线路的优点;其无线传输距离在100m内有效。
keywords: cc2530, data transmission, heat radiation, zigbee wireless communication

title: 老人跌倒姿态检测研究
abstract: The MPU6050 six-axis sensor detects the acceleration and inclination values of the elder people in three directions and transmits the data to the CC2530 microprocessor.After CC2530 adjusting the data;Zigbee wireless communication technology is used to transmit the data to the main controller of smart terminal STM32 in the nursing home.The main controller determines whether the elder people falls or not by combining with the multi-threshold algorithm for judging falls.After the fall;an alarm is issued and an alarm prompt is displayed on the host screen.This paper is mainly used to judge falling posture.By comparing the regional acceleration intensity SMA and SMV values of acceleration intensity as well as the difference of inclination angles under different static and motion states;it can distinguish falling from other daily behavior events.
abstract_in_chinese: 通过MPU6050六轴传感器在3个方向上检测老年人的加速度和倾斜度值;并将数据传输到CC2530微处理器。经过CC2530调整数据后;使用Zigbee无线通信技术将数据传输到养老院中的智能终端STM32主控制器。主控制器结合多阈值判断跌倒算法确定老人是否摔倒;摔倒后发出警报;并在主机界面上显示警报提示。主要用于解决跌倒姿态的判断;通过对比人不同静止与运动状态下区域加速度强度SMA和加速度强度SMV的值以及倾斜角的不同;区分出人跌倒与日常其他行为事件。
keywords: fall posture judgment, mpu6050, multi-threshold algorithm for judging falls
affiliations: Changchun Institute of Technology, 长春工程学院

title: 用于脉冲辐射场诊断的大动态范围数据采集系统研制
abstract: A high-speed data acquisition system(DAS)with dynamic range of 100 dB is developed to meet the special needs of pulsed radiation diagnosis;which realizes the function of front-end waveform digitization of output signal of pulsed radiation field.By using both attenuation circuit and over-voltage protection circuit; the designed analog signal conditioning module can ensure the accurate measurements of large signal and small signal at same time;and avoid the error caused by overlapping measurement of oscilloscope channel range.The LMX2594 chip is used to produce 2-channel;1 GHz high quality homologous clock signals;while the time delay between them can be adjusted.The firmware programmed realizes the functions of receiving high-speed parallel sampling data;cyclic storage;sequential readout;and so on.The results of amplitude calibration and time calibration show that the linearity of the system is good and the triggered sloshing is less than 1 ns.The field test results show that the developed DAS can effectively acquire analog electrical signals with dynamic range of 100 dB from pulsed radiation field.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对脉冲辐射场诊断的特殊需求;研制了动态范围为100dB的高速数据采集系统;可实现脉冲辐射场输出信号波形前端数字化的功能。设计的模拟信号调理模块配合使用衰减电路和过压保护电路;可同时保证对大信号和小信号的准确测量;避免了示波器信道量程搭接的问题采用LMX2594芯片产生了2路、1GHz的高品质同源时钟信号;2路时钟信号之间的延时可调设计的固件程序可实现高速并行采样数据的接收、循环存储和顺序读出等功能。系统的电压幅值标定和时间标定结果表明;系统电压幅值线性良好;触发晃动小于1ns现场测试表明;系统可以有效获取脉冲辐射场输出的动态范围为100dB的模拟电信号。
keywords: clock de-jitter, cyclic storage, ip core, sampling data, source synchronization clock
authors: TIAN Geng;ZHANG Yan-xia;LI Bin-kang;RUAN Lin-bo;LI Hai-tao
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Intense Pulsed Radiation Simulation and Effect, 西北核技术研究院, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, 强脉冲辐射环境模拟与效应国家重点实验室

title: 基于CC3200的超声波测距
abstract_in_chinese: 针对物联网领域距离数据采集与远程监测的需求;设计实现基于TICC3200的超声波测距系统。该系统采用超声波传感器测距;通过TICC3200处理器对超声波传感器模块进行控制;并利用内置WiFi功能的网络处理器联网;实现无线方式的数据传输;工作在AP模式下的Web服务器可使用户通过网页远程开启并持续监控距离测量的结果。

title: 基于嵌入式的小区节能监控物联网系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 本研究以S5PV210 ARM处理器和CC2530 ZigBee模块为核心设计小区节能嵌入式物联网监控系统。该系统硬件包含空调节能、照明节能和消防报警节能监控系统三个部分;能够实现对小区公共区域空调运行、路灯照明和消防报警系统的能耗采集和自动控制。软件部分以ZigBee模块为基础形成小区节能信号采集网络节点;其有物联网监测传输功能。本文详细阐述了上述系统的硬件和软件设计内容;幵对系统的应用价值迚行了展望;以期为嵌入式和物联网技术在小区节能监控系统中的应用提供借鉴。
affiliations: 四川科技职业学院

title: 微型化计算机WIFI模块的设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 微型化计算系统是目前物联网、工业控制等领域研究的重点;本文为克服微型化计算机模块之间数据传输、控制存在传输距离短、部署困难等问题;提出了一种基于SPI接口的WIFI模块设计方案;该方案中通过将FH8812高性能SOC与CC3200无线网络MCU通过SPI接口连接;实现了微型化计算机模块之间的无线网络通信。

title: 智能式香梨分级机自动控制系统的设计——基于工业4.0
abstract: In this paper;the automatic control system of intelligent pear grading machine based on industrial 4 is designed and researched based on the embedded technology and Internet of things technology under the background of industry 4. 0 and the AM5728 processor of Sitara series of TI company combined with image processing technology. The experimental results show that the correct classification number of the system is more than 930;that is;the accuracy rate is over 93%;and the system efficiency is high;and the stability is strong;so it has broad market space.
abstract_in_chinese: 利用工业4.0背景下的嵌入式和物联网技术;采用TI公司Sitara系列的AM5728处理器;结合图像处理技术;设计了一套基于工业4.0的智能式香梨分级机自动控制系统。试验结果表明:系统正确分级数均超过9 3 0个;即正确率都在9 3%以上;且效率高;稳定性强;具有广阔的市场空间。
keywords: am5728, automatic control, embedded, image processing, industry 4.0, pear grader

title: Direct Torque Digital Control System Based on TMS320F2812
abstract: According to the theory of asynchronous motor direct torque control;a design method of direct torque control of asynchronous motor using TI′s DSP chip TMS320 F2812 was introduced. A low-pass filter with amplitude compensation was used to estimate the stator flux;which filled the defect of pure integration in the U—I model. The software′s interrupt program;speed measurement program;speed adjustment method were given;and the test under CCS debugging environment was given. As a result;the performance characteristics of the direct torque exhibited by the test results were analyzed in detail. The results show that the design method proposed obtains a good control effect in the dynamic and static performance of the system.
keywords: amplitude compensation, direct torque control, flux calculation, speed adjustment
affiliations: CRRC Qingdao Sifang Rolling Stock Research Institute Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of Improved FTSP Algorithm for Structural Health Monitoring
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low synchronization accuracy of bridge structure health monitoring in wireless sensor networks; an improved flooding time synchronization protocol（ FTSP） based on the hardware capture mechanism of start of frame delimiter（ SFD） was designed by using the iteratively reweighted least squares method estimated and compensated clock drift; and it was compared with the classical FTSP algorithm.According to the bridge structure; the linear chain network topology was selected. On the CC2530 hardware platform; the average synchronization error of the single-hop network was 3. 148 μs; and the average synchronization error of the 3-hop network was 9. 167 μs. The experimental results show that the improved FTSP algorithm can effectively solve the problems of transmission delay; access delay; reception delay and the effect of abnormal data on time synchronization accuracy and stability. It is a high-precision and high-stability time synchronization algorithm that satisfies the application of bridge structure health monitoring.
keywords: cc2530, flooding time synchronization protocol, iteratively reweighted least squares, start of frame delimiter, wireless sensor networks
affiliations: School of Information Engineering, Southwest University of Science and Technology

title: Design of Micro Steering Gear Control System Based on TMS320F28377D
abstract: By using the TMS320F28377 D dual-core CPU; this thesis puts flight control and rudder control together in a CPU; and gets information interaction through internal information sharing area（IPC） between CPU1 core and CPU2 core. It solves the communication problem of traditional flight control computer and rudder control computer which was depended on the external interface in tradition. First of all; the steering gear adopts AD sampling design in the chip; which greatly reduces the power supply module. Secondly; the steering gear feedback keeps high sampling accuracy even the AD on the chip is under low voltage. Finally; it is proved that the design of the steering gear has characters of high reliability; strong anti-interference; high engineering value and miniaturization through simulation and experiment.
keywords: ad on chip, control system, dual-core, ipc, micro steering gear
authors: Wang Hongsheng;Chen Ziwei;Liu Jia;Tang Ruimin;Yang Xi

title: Design of Remote Control Inverse Power Supply Base on TMS320F2812
abstract: According to the functional requirements of remote control inverter power supply in the new energy power generation system;a hardware design scheme of a two-stage power transformation structure is proposed.Using the digital signal processor TMS320 F2812 as the control core;the signal acquisition;communication and control circuits are designed and the flow chart of the control program is given.Adjusting the inverse parameters through the monitoring system;feasibility of the scheme and correctness of the control program are verified by the output waveforms.
keywords: digital signal processor, inverter power supply, monitoring system, remote control

title: 电动汽车用异步电机控制器硬件设计
abstract: ＜正＞以改制电动汽车为研究对象;完成7.5k W异步电机控制器设计。主控芯片使用TMS320F28335;对控制器的逆变电路、驱动电路、辅助电源、信号调理电路及通讯电路进行设计。引言:随着环境问题和能源危机日益突出;新能源汽车取代传统燃油汽车越来越成为现实;在各国政府的倡导和大力补贴下;电动汽车得到了快速推广。电动汽车的核心是电机控制器;它的性能直接影响车辆的可靠性和稳定性。本设计以DSP为控制核心;对异

title: Design of Wireless Window Control System Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: In this paper; a wireless intelligent window control system is designed based on ZigBee technology. It is composed of PC monitoring center; coordinator; ZigBee network module and each window control node. The hardware module is mainly the hardware circuit of the terminal node designed for wireless window control system based on the CC2530 chip. It is divided into power module and drive module. The power module is used for motor power supply; and the drive module is used for motor control. The software is mainly designed for the purposes of wireless window control. The design of the whole system is not only for intelligent control; but also for effective energy saving.
keywords: cc2530, energy saving, intelligent control, zigbee
authors: DONG Dezhi;ZHOU Songlin;WANG Qian;Tongling University;WANG Peng

title: Design of Rice Traceability System Based on WSN and RFID
abstract: A precise and real-time rice traceability system based on WSN and RFID is designed to trace rice planting;storage;processing;transportation and sales.Using CC2530 wireless module to transmit the collected rice growth environment data;and using RFID to trace the information of rice harvest;storage;transportation and processing;we constructs the traceability database and the docking of the electronic e-commerce platform of agricultural products.The design makes a complete data chain between agricultural producers;agricultural products and consumers;and has important application value in promoting the development and construction of agricultural information and agricultural products.
keywords: radio frequency identification, rice, traceability, wireless sensor networks
affiliations: Office of Academic Affairs,Qiqihar University, School of Electronical and Communication Engineering,Qiqihar University

title: Design of on-line Live Monitoring System for Temperature and Humidity of Curing Room Based on ZigBee Technology
abstract: According to the development demand of intelligent information management in cement concrete sample curing room;a wireless communication technology based on ZigBee is proposed. The core of this technology is CC2530/STM32 single chip computer. This paper introduces the basic structure;principle;hardware design;and software design of the multi-point temperature and humidity live monitoring system;which is based on the digital industrial protective temperature and humidity sensor SHT21;and the field LCD as its display interface. The system is characterized by low power consumption; high reliability; strong expansibility; modularization; easy operation and simple installation;etc.
keywords: curing rooms, sht21, temperature and humidity, zigbee
affiliations: Hunan Commumications Research Institute Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of Soil Condition Monitoring System Based on WSN
abstract: In view of the waste of resources and pollution of orchard environment caused by unreasonable fertilization;pesticide application and other agricultural activities in apple production;the influence of environmental and climatic conditions on apple industry in northern shaanxi mountains was considered.An orchard soil environment monitoring system based on wireless sensor network was proposed.The design uses CC2530 as the core chip;and uses TI′s Z-Stack protocol stack and development platform to build a wireless sensor network combining mesh topology and star topology.The system has been tested to operate stably under low power consumption;providing an effective way to implement orchard environmental monitoring in northern Shaanxi.
keywords: cc2530, orchard soil monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee
affiliations: School of Physics and Electronic Information,Yan′an University
source: Journal of Yanan University(Natural Science Edition).

title: Design of Warehouse Intelligent Environment Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: At present;the common storage environment monitoring system is mainly based on the LAN architecture;and it is difficult to realize real-time communication and early warning with the WAN intelligent terminal;and most of them are independently deployed. This paper designed a warehouse intelligent environment monitoring system based on ZigBee. The system used CC2530 single-chip microcomputer as the core to collect environmental parameters such as temperature;humidity;flame;smoke and illumination through sensors distributed in the warehouse;and transmitted it to the cloud platform in ZigBee mode. Then it followed the established management strategy to implement the corresponding procedures for ventilation;sprinkler fire and fire linkage. The system was configured by ZigBee wireless gateway;which overcome the shortcomings of traditional wired sensor deployment;also it’s fast and efficient;and could be applied to multiple warehouses simultaneously through the WAN.

title: Research of LQI Ranging Based on BP Neural Network
abstract: Received Signal Strength Indicator（RSSI） ranging is a commonly used method in wireless sensor network positioning technology;but when using RSSI ranging;reflection;scattering;and obstacles can have a significant impact. In this paper;the LQI is used for ranging;and experiments showed that there was attenuation and one-to-one correspondence between LQI and distance. In order to realize the LQI value ranging;the LQI value preprocessed by Gaussian filter was taken as input;and the distance was solved by BP neural network after training. Experiments on the ZigBee platform of CC2530 showed that LQI ranging based on BP neural network model has higher ranging accuracy and stability than traditional methods.
keywords: bp neural network, gaussian filter, lqi, ranging
affiliations: CETHIK Group Co., Ltd.

title: Research on an Intelligent Monitoring and Protecting System Based on High-speed DSP Processors
abstract: This paper aims at the monitoring and protecting system of reginal grid with dynamic complex loading; and discusses a parallel synchronous control method and a special topology structure based on DSPs. It proposes a new remote monitoring and protection system for power network load in which the main DSP controller commands the slave DSP controllers to finish the real time and synchronizes control process. The main DSP controls the synchronous sequence of each slave DSP; implements the priority control and the selection control of each bus. Each slave DSP is assisted by PLC; which plays the role of signal detection and AD transform processor; accomplishes the load signal detection of multi-channel power network; AD transform and PFE-FFT algorithm processing. It can analyze the transient dynamic signal of load voltage and current; work out the control instructions according to the grid rules and send it to the grid controller DSP3. This system highly improves the ability of real-time monitoring and protection of power network load; and improves the effectiveness of remote monitoring and protection operation of wide area power network.
keywords: analysis of high speed dynamic signal detection, pfe-fft, power grid monitoring and system protection, tms320f28335

title: Design of a System for Water Supply Pipeline Leakage Detection and Positioning with CC1310
abstract: Based on the chip CC1310;which is developed by TI;we design and implement a low-cost wireless system for detection and positioning the leakage of the water supply pipeline.The system consists of sensor nodes;concentrators and wireless gateways.The sensor and concentrator node are implemented with CC1310 chip and the gateway is implemented with ESP8266 module.Test data is transmitted to PC by the ESP8266 module.Finally;the upper machine can calculate the cross correlation between test data from the sensor node and the concentrator to sense and find the leak.Preliminary experimental results show that the system is able to detect the leakage of the water supply pipeline and its positioning function can fulfill practical needs.

title: Wireless Data Acquisition of Temperature and Humidity Based on CC2530
abstract: The working process of ZigBee protocol stack is briefly analyzed; and the point-to-point ZigBee wireless network built with CC2530 chip as the hardware core is described in this paper. The temperature and humidity wireless data acquisition based on ZigBee protocol stack is designed and realized respectively from the aspects of hardware and software. With the developing environment of IAR; the programming process of wireless network coordinator and terminal device are completed based on TI's Z-Stack protocol Stack. Through ZigBee wireless network communication between terminal device and coordinator; and through serial port communication between coordinator and PC; the coordinator can perform temperature and humidity detection and over-limit alarm for terminal device.

title: Indoor localization method based on RF signal strength
abstract: Based on the principle of radio frequency( RF) signal strength ranging;an indoor localization scheme is designed by using CC1101 chip. In the measuring region;a plurality of positioning module is set;a positioning module will be any three measurements and the K target module distance using three edge measuring method to calculate the K target module coordinates;all the K target module coordinates are average to obtain average coordinates;and screen three groups of data which has the minimum the average coordinate error;further average to obtain K target module coordinates. The method improves the positioning precision and alleviates the damage of individual target modules and the decrease of measurement precision caused by target beyond effective measurement distance. Experimental results show that the method is suitable for indoor large number of targets positioning.

title: Comparison Research of Phase-shift Control for Dual-active-bridge DC/DC Converter
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of high current stress and low efficiency in single-phase-shift control of dual active bridge(DAB) DC/DC converter; the current stress and efficiency of DAB DC/DC converter under single-phaseshift control and double-phase-shift control are compared and studied. First of all; the principle of both are analyzed;and then the theory of power regulation and current stress is deduced.The relationship between power and phase-shift un-der single-phase-shift control and double-phase-shift control is visually displayed by using Matlab tools;and the relationship between current stress and phase shift is found.The power regulation range and current stress of dualphase-shift control are much better than that of single-phase-shift control.Finally;the experimental platform of DAB DC/DC converter based on TMS320F28335 controller is compared; and the correctness of the theoretical derivation is verified by the experimental results.

title: 面向结构健康监测的改进FTSP算法设计
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low synchronization accuracy of bridge structure health monitoring in wireless sensor networks; an improved flooding time synchronization protocol( FTSP) based on the hardware capture mechanism of start of frame delimiter( SFD) was designed by using the iteratively reweighted least squares method estimated and compensated clock drift; and it was compared with the classical FTSP algorithm.According to the bridge structure; the linear chain network topology was selected. On the CC2530 hardware platform; the average synchronization error of the single-hop network was 3. 148 μs; and the average synchronization error of the 3-hop network was 9. 167 μs. The experimental results show that the improved FTSP algorithm can effectively solve the problems of transmission delay; access delay; reception delay and the effect of abnormal data on time synchronization accuracy and stability. It is a high-precision and high-stability time synchronization algorithm that satisfies the application of bridge structure health monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对无线传感器网络桥梁结构健康监测同步精度低的问题;采用迭代加权最小二乘法估计及补偿时钟漂移;设计了一种基于帧首定界符(SFD)硬件捕获机制的改进泛洪时间同步算法(FTSP);并与经典FTSP算法进行对比研究。根据桥梁结构;选用线性链状网络拓扑结构;在CC2530硬件平台上测得单跳网络平均同步误差为3. 148μs;3跳网络平均同步误差为9. 167μs。试验结果表明;改进FTSP算法有效地解决了发送延迟、访问延迟、接收延迟;以及异常数据对时间同步精度及稳定性影响的问题;是一种满足桥梁结构健康监测应用的高精度、高稳定性时间同步算法。
keywords: cc2530, flooding time synchronization protocol, iteratively reweighted least squares, start of frame delimiter, wireless sensor networks

title: 基于TMS320F28377D的微型舵机控制系统设计
abstract: By using the TMS320F28377 D dual-core CPU; this thesis puts flight control and rudder control together in a CPU; and gets information interaction through internal information sharing area(IPC) between CPU1 core and CPU2 core. It solves the communication problem of traditional flight control computer and rudder control computer which was depended on the external interface in tradition. First of all; the steering gear adopts AD sampling design in the chip; which greatly reduces the power supply module. Secondly; the steering gear feedback keeps high sampling accuracy even the AD on the chip is under low voltage. Finally; it is proved that the design of the steering gear has characters of high reliability; strong anti-interference; high engineering value and miniaturization through simulation and experiment.

title: Design and Fabrication of Embedded Wireless Monitoring System Based on Bluetooth Low Energy Transmission for Potentiometric Sensors
abstract: A small embedded wireless monitoring system for potentiometric sensors was designed and fabricated. The system employed a dual precision op amp of TLC4502 as the preamplifier and a bluetooth low energy （BLE） chip of CC2541 as the main controller;and the main controller integrated 14 bits analog to digital convertor （ADC）. The system used the BLE development application program （App） to establish a Bluetooth connection with the CC2541 for wireless real-time reading of sensing potentials. The monitoring system software was developed on the basis of a BLE-CC254X-1. 41 protocol stack by the embedded development software of IAR Embedded Workbench. To verify the reliability and accuracy of the system;a precision regulated power supply was used for analog potential acquisition test;and a p H composite electrode was used for monitoring the pH change. The test results showed that the system could be applied to real time measurement of potential signals for three times amplification with an accuracy of 0. 4 mV;and a consistent response to p H change was able to quickly output with a linear correlation coefficient of R~2= 0. 9994.Furthermore;the concentration change of L-cysteine （L-cys） was monitored in real time by the BLE system with a self-made L-cys sensor;and the dynamic response change was consistent with that of commercial multimeter;indicating that the rapid transmission and real time monitoring of potentiometric signals could be well realized through the BLE wireless sensing system.
keywords: bluetooth low energy, embedded system, monitoring, potentiometric sensor, wireless sensing

title: Design of an embedded system for sensor data acquisition based on DSP
abstract: An instrument was designed to measure the differential pressure of airship capsule;the atmospheric pressure;and the battery voltage of stratospheric airship. The data acquired;as important parameters;was stored and sent to fly control computer. The data stored could be used for data analysis and playback after flight. TMS320F2812 and discrete sensor and components were used in the embedded system;and the prototype was developed. Redundant design was used to improve the reliability of the data acquisition and communication. Experimental results showed that the differential pressure accuracy was ± 5 Pa;the atmospheric pressure was ± 80 Pa;and the battery voltage was ± 0. 03 V. The design improved the data accuracy and the integration of the device;and it will be the important parameters for fly control of stratospheric airship.

title: Design of a Simple Frequency Meter based on DSP
abstract: In order to improve the precision of measuring the frequency;signal period;duty cycle and other electrical parameters;this paper proposes a simple frequency meter design base on signal digital processing（DSP）;using TMS320F28335 DSP chip as the core;and external LCD12864 display screen;which can be used to measure the frequency;signal period and duty cycle of square wave.The proposed frequency meter uses the DSP TMS320F28335 internal timer TO to obtain the frequency of signal through the integration of the pulse number of interrupt timing frequency measurement and capturing frequency measurement method.In the proposed method;the signal period can be obtained according to the number of high frequency pulses;and then the signal frequency can be computed in accordance with the equation f=1/T.Finally;the value of frequency is showed by the LCD12864 real-time display.The test results show that the system is simple;convenient and versatile;and the relative error is less than or equal to 0.09%.The measurement range of the proposed frequency meter is 1 Hz-13 MHz;which can meet the actual needs.
