title: Design and implementation of high speed data transfer system between multi-core DSP and FPGA
abstract: To meet the demands of large data volume;high transmission speed and high real-time computing performance in em-bedded image processing system;this paper proposes a high-speed data transmission storage system with multi-core DSP TMS320C6678 as the core.Based on the DSP high-speed serial Rapid IO(SRIO) module for high-speed transmission of image data;usingthe SRIO module’s direct I/O transmission mode;using the 4x interface mode configuration;each interface transmission rate is 3.125 Gb/s;and theoretical transmission rate is 10 Gb/s.At the same time;DDR3 controller module is used to expand storagespace and achieve shared storage of optical and radar images.The test results show that the SRIO high-speed transmission systemdesigned has a transmission speed of more than 8 Gb/s;which reaches more than 80 % of the theoretical value;satisfies the high-speed transmission needs of large data;and effectively realizes data transmission and shared storage between multiple processors.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对嵌入式图像处理系统中大数据量、高传输速度及和高实时运算性能的需求;提出一种以多核DSPTMS320C6678为核心的高速数据传输存储系统;基于DSP高速串行Rapid IO (SRIO)模块进行图像数据高速传输;使用SRIO模块的Direct I/O传输模式;采用4x接口模式配置;每路接口传输速率为3.125 Gb/s;理论传输速率为10 Gb/s;同时使用DDR3控制器模块扩展存储空间;实现光学及雷达图像的共享存储。通过实验结果表明;设计的SRIO高速传输系统传输速度超过8 Gb/s;达到理论值的80%以上;满足大数据高速传输需求;有效实现了多处理器之间的数据传输和共享存储。
keywords: dsp, high-speed transmission, interface interconnection, srio

title: Optimized Model Predictive Control for Indirect Matrix Converter
abstract: Aiming at large amount of calculation in the conventional finite-control-set model-predictive control(FCS-MPC);an optimized model predictive control(OMPC)control method was proposed. The reference output current was converted to the desired output voltage with deadbeat;and then according to the position of the expected output voltage vector in the two-phase static coordinate system;a switching state selection method for the inverter stage was proposed;the rectifier stage with evaluation needs noly 3 switching states;there was no ergodic optimization for switching states in the inverter stage. Compared with traditional FCS-MPC;the number of optimization calculations was reduced from 24 to 3;the amount of calculation of the control system was reduced to a great extent. Finally;the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm was verified by the simulation model of indirect matrix converter and TMS320 F28335.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统有限状态控制集模型预测(FCS-MPC)控制方法计算量大的问题;提出了一种优化的模型预测(OMPC)控制方法。利用无差拍思想;将参考输出电流转化为期望输出电压;然后根据期望输出电压矢量在两相静止坐标系的位置;提出了一种逆变级开关状态的选择方法;整流级只需要3次寻优计算;逆变级不存在开关状态的遍历寻优。相对于传统FCS-MPC;优化模型预测将系统寻优次数由24次减少到3次;很大程度上降低了系统计算量。最后通过Matlab/Simulink仿真和TMS320F28335控制器验证了该方案的有效性。
keywords: deadbeat, indirect matrix converter(imc), model predictive
authors: Zhou Nianguang;Liu Haifeng;Fan Donghai;Zhu Weijiang;Zhu Weijun

title: Virtual Power Balance Control Scheme of Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converters with Output-parallel Structure
abstract: In view of the parallel output dual active bridge（DAB）DC-DC converter in the power electronic transformer（PET）;the influence of the front stage cascaded H-bridge（CHB）control strategy on the DAB is analyzed.A virtual power balance control（VPBC）method for DAB with equivalent input series output parallel（ISOP）and equivalent input independent output parallel（IIOP）is proposed;and the mechanism of the control strategy is also analyzed.Finally;the adopted VPBC scheme and input capacitor voltage balance control（VBC）scheme are verified and compared in a three cells experimental platform by using TMS320 F28335+FPGA6 SLX45.The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can significantly improve the dynamic response of DAB DC-DC converter for the load and input voltage mutation based on the transmission power balance of each module.Meanwhile;the transient fluctuation of the transmission power in the converter can be effectively suppressed.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对电力电子变压器（PET）中输出并联双有源全桥（DAB）DC-DC变换器;分析了前级级联多电平整流器（CHB）控制策略对于DAB变换器的影响;提出一种同时适用于等效输入串联输出并联（ISOP）和等效输入独立输出并联（IIOP）DAB变换器的虚拟功率均衡控制方法;并分析了该控制策略的作用机理。搭建了以TMS320F28335+FPGA6SLX45为控制器的三单元输出并联DAB变换器的实验平台;对所提出的虚拟功率均衡控制方法与输入电容电压平衡控制算法进行了对比验证。实验结果表明;所提方法在实现各个模块传输功率均分的基础上;可以显著提高变换器对于负载突变和输入电压突变时的响应速度。同时;也可有效地抑制变换器传输功率的暂态波动。
keywords: dual active bridge dc-dc converters, dynamic response, power balance control, power electronic transformer

title: 基于滑模变结构PR控制的PWM整流器研究
abstract_in_chinese: 针对PI控制器在负载突变和起动时对电流内环参考指令跟踪调节速度慢、存在静态误差等问题;提出基于电流内环的优化比例谐振(Proportional Resonant;PR)控制器;并结合具有开关特性的滑模控制器来降低电压外环PI控制器对电流内环控制精准性的影响将两者结合来提高三相PWM整流器的稳态性能及负载扰动时动态性能和鲁棒性能。最后;搭建基于TMS320F2812核心控制板的10 k W整流器实验平台进行验证;实验结果表明滑模PR控制策略的可行性和有效性;且具有较好的工程实际应用价值。

title: Multi-Module Optimized Power Balance Control Scheme of the Input-Series-Output-Parallel Operated Dual-Active-Bridge DC-DC Converters
abstract: Through the analysis of the operation characteristics and problems of dual-activebridge（DAB） DC-DC converters in the power electronic transformer（PET）;this paper proposed a multi-module optimized power balance control scheme with triple phase-shift（TPS） to improve the efficiency;enhance the dynamic response and balance the transmission for the input-series-outputparallel operated DAB converters.Compared to traditional input voltage balance control scheme;the proposed control scheme can further improve the efficiency and dynamic performance under the input voltage step-change condition without increasing additional sensors.Finally;the traditional input voltage balance control and proposed multi-module optimized power balance control schemes were compared in a scale-down three-cell experimental platform using TMS320F28335+FPGA6SLX45 as the core controller.The experimental results have verified the excellent performance of the proposed scheme and the theory analysis.
abstract_in_chinese: 通过分析电力电子变压器（PET）中的双有源全桥（DAB）DC-DC变换器的运行特征及所面临的问题;针对输入串联输出并联双有源全桥DC-DC变换器;基于三重相移（TPS）提出一种多模块优化功率平衡控制方法以同时提高变换器的效率及动态性能;并实现各个模块的传输功率均衡。相比于传统的输入电压均衡控制方法;该方法在不需要增加额外传感器的情况下;可以进一步提高变换器的效率;加强变换器对于输入电压突变时的响应能力并实现各个DAB模块的传输功率平衡。最后;搭建以TMS320F28335+FPGA6SLX45为核心控制器的三单元输入串联输出并联DAB变换器小功率实验样机;对所提多模块优化功率平衡控制方法与输入电压均衡控制方法进行对比实验研究;验证了所提算法的正确性与有效性。
keywords: dual-active-bridge(dab) dc-dc converter, dynamic performance, efficiency, power balance, power electronic transformer(pet)

title: Study on the Testing System of Bidirectional Impulse Electromagnet
abstract: In order to realize the performance test of the self developed bidirectional impulse electromagnet;a testing system was designed based on LabVIEW.The testing system used linear servo motor as the simulation load;and solved the test problem of the permanent magnet force and the electromagnetic force coexisting in the electromagnet.The testing device was controlled and the data was collected by Digital Signal Processor(DSP)TMS320F2812.The retaining force and starting force at different positions were tested emphatically.Experimental results suggest that the system was easy to operate and had good test accuracy.In addition;it also verified the superior performance of the bidirectional impulse electromagnet.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现对自行研制的双向作用脉冲电磁铁的性能测试;设计实现了基于LabVIEW的电磁铁测试系统。该测试系统以直线伺服电机为模拟负载;解决了电磁铁中永磁体作用力与电磁作用力共存的测试难题。系统通过数字信号处理器TMS320F2812进行控制和数据采集;可重点测试双向作用脉冲电磁铁在不同位置处的保持力和启动力。实验表明;该测试系统操作简便;有良好的测试精度;同时也验证了双向作用脉冲电磁铁的优越性能。

title: 基于DSP的小功率无刷直流风机双闭环控制系统研究
abstract_in_chinese: 采用TMS320LF2407A、SI9979芯片研究设计的小功率无刷直流风机控制系统;实现了对风机运行状态的稳定、有效控制;采用位置、速度双闭环控制结构以满足高精度、快速响应的性能要求;简述了系统研究中所涉及的软硬件方案和控制策略。测试结果表明;系统风阻特性、机械特性符合性能要求;控制效果良好。

title: 基于ZigBee物联网技术的智能家居系统设计

title: 基于CC2530和SIM900A的无线传感器网络设计
abstract: Wireless sensor network is designed based on CC2530 and SIM900 A. Temperature and humidity sensor;carbon dioxide sensor and light sensor is connected to wireless module CC2530 respectively to constitute sensor network terminal nodes;measuring the temperature and humidity;carbon dioxide and light;and transferring the measured data to the coordinator node of the wireless sensor network through the routing node. The coordinator node then storage;analysis and process the received data. SIM900 A is connected to the coordinator node to realize the long-distance transmission of the data;and send the warning message to the user’s mobile phone when the collected environment data exceeds the alarm threshold that set by the user. The experimental results show that the wireless sensor network is fully functional;easy to install;stable and reliable;and can measure the temperature and humidity;carbon dioxide concentration and light intensity accurately.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文设计基于CC2530和SIM900A的无线传感器网络。CC2530模块分别与温湿度传感器、二氧化碳传感器、光照传感器组合;构成无线传感器网路的终端节点;对一定环境内温湿度、二氧化碳和光照要素进行测量;将测量结果通过无线传感器网络的路由节点发送给协调器节点;协调器节点对接收到的数据进行存储、分析和处理协调器节点连接SIM900A实现数据的远程传输;当采集到的环境信息超过用户设定的报警阈值时;将报警信息及时发送至用户手机。实验证明:设计的无线传感器网络功能完整、安装简便、稳定可靠;可以准确地测量温湿度、二氧化碳浓度和光照强度数据。
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition, sim900a, wireless sensor network

title: TMS320C6678在雷达成像中的应用
abstract: The synthetic aperture radar signal processing platform;which based on the multicore digital signal processor(DSP)TMS320 C6678 and field programmable gate array(FPGA);is designed. And the imporoved radar real-time imaging algorithm is implemented on this platform. According to the characters of DSP and radar imaging;the algorithm will be optimized further on structure and parallel processing. Experimental results show that the system achieved continuous real-time imaging of radar echoes. But also through parallel or improved algorithm;the system can also be applied to interferometric synthetic aperture radar signal processing or radar guidance system.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文设计了FPGA(Field Programmable Gata Array)+TMS320C6678的合成孔径雷达信号处理平台;并在该平台上实现了改进的R-D(Range-Doppler)雷达成像算法的实时处理。并根据雷达成像处理和多核DSP的特点;对算法结构以及并行处理方面进行了优化。经过实验测试;该系统实现了对雷达回波数据的连续实时成像。通过算法改进或两路并联;该平台也可扩展到干涉合成孔径雷达数据处理中或雷达制导系统中。
keywords: multi-core parallel processing, range-doppler algorithm, real-time processing, tms320c6678
affiliations: China Xi’an Satellite Control Center, 西安卫星测控中心

title: 基于ZigBee的宿舍管理系统

title: 基于物联网技术的智能台灯设计
abstract_in_chinese: 随着计算机技术、通信技术与互联网技术的飞速发展;越来越多的智能化家居产品出现在人们的日常生活之中。为了实现台灯的自动控制;满足人们对高品质生活的需求;提出了一款基于物联网技术的智能台灯控制系统设计方案。通过热释电红外传感器和光照强度传感器实时采集环境数据;LCD液晶显示;用户按键;同时由CC2530芯片作为系统的微控制器传输并处理数据;控制LED照明模块;从而实现对台灯的自动控制。

title: 基于Zigbee的太阳能电池环境监测系统的研究与开发
abstract_in_chinese: 根据太阳能电池环境监测具有分散、灵活、偏远等特点以及传统有线网络布线繁琐、维护困难等问题;本设计提出一种基于CC2530-Zigbee的由太阳能电池进行供电的无线网络电池环境监测系统。本系统由数据采集终端节点和上位机实时监测平台组成;两个数据采集节点均采用太阳能电池和锂电池组合供电的方式;可以实时监测和记录温度、太阳能电池电压等参数信息;并可将采集到的数据经Zigbee网络无线传输到监测平台;实现数据的即时显示和存储功能。
affiliations: 广东海洋大学电子与信息工程学院

title: 基于ZigBee技术的空气质量检测系统研究开发实现
abstract_in_chinese: 随着无线通讯技术的飞速发展;和人们对空气质量检测要求的提高;本文介绍了一种基于ZigBee技术的便携式空气质量检测系统的设计与实现;改变了以往空气质量检测系统存在的实时性差、体积大、易错报、漏报以及控制系统复杂等问题。本系统以CC2530芯片为平台;在终端采集空气中的PM2.5（可入肺颗粒物）、PM10（可吸入颗粒物）、臭氧（化学式为"O3"）、一氧化碳（化学式为"CO2"）指标和空气的温湿度值;并通过ZigBee技术传送给集中器集中器再通过串口转USB传输给PC机;然后在PC机上进行数据的显示、处理和保存功能。本系统可用来检测室内外空气质量;具有能耗低、成本低、可靠性高和便携等优点。
affiliations: 东莞理工学院城市学院

title: 基于Zigbee及RSSI的养老院室内定位系统的开发
abstract_in_chinese: 我国人口老龄化状态日益严重;未来养老院养老势必成为主流。本文针对养老院场地较大;老人发生安全问题时;人员无法及时定位救助的问题;设计了一种基于Zigbee技术的室内无线定位系统。本设计采用TI公司的CC2530芯片作为系统核心;基于Z-STACK协议栈;使用IAR软件平台开发。经实际测试该定位系统易于操作、精度较高;是一种适应性较强的定位系统。
affiliations: 山西大同大学教育科学与技术学院

title: 基于ZigBee的无线组网技术研究
abstract_in_chinese: 在阐述Zig Bee技术特点的基础上;介绍Zig Bee网络的功能类型设备与节点类型;并提出Zig Bee协议下的网络拓扑结构;着重从组网流程方面对基于Zig Bee的无线组网技术进行相应研究。
affiliations: 中移铁通有限公司株洲分公司

title: 基于ZigBee技术的养老监护系统设计
abstract: The design of pension monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is realized for small and medium-sized pension in-stitutions. And wireless sensor network coverage of pension institutions includes the two subsystems of health monitory and safetypositioning is realized by utilizing the characteristics of ZigBee wireless network; which are low power; low cost and easy to build.Besides; based on the CC2530 and Z-stack protocol stack; the system realizes the development of the function of each node on the IAR platform; and realizes the design of the upper computer by using C#. Then; the data collected by the system can be monitoredand analyzed by the management center which can monitor the health status and safety range of the elderly in real time. After test-ing the stability and reliability of the system repeatedly to meet the requirements; the level of nursing care in small and mediumnursing homes can be improved to realize scientific and efficient management.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对中小型养老机构基于Zig Bee技术实现了养老监护系统的设计;系统具有低功耗、低成本、易搭建的特点;可实现养老机构无线传感器网络的全覆盖;包括健康监护和安全监护两个子系统。基于CC2530和Z-Stack协议栈;在IAR平台上实现传感器网络中各节点功能开发;采用C#实现上位机端软件设计。节点采集到的数据通过管理中心进行监测与分析;可对老人的健康情况和安全活动范围进行实时监护;经反复测试系统的稳定性和可靠性达到要求;可有效提高中小型养老院的监护水平;实现科学高效管理。
keywords: cc2530, pension system, z-stack protocol, zigbee technology
authors: LAN Li-hui;QI Hai-yang;ZHANG Yu;LI Zhuo;WANG Ji-run;WANG Si-yang
affiliations: College of Information Engineering, Shenyang University, 沈阳大学信息工程学院物联网工程系

title: 基于物联网的智能浇花系统的设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 基于物联网的智能浇花系统;提出了一款基于CC2530(Zigbee)网络的智能浇花系统设计方案。该系统通过CC2530节点挂上土壤温湿度传感器并实现采集数据;处理后上传CC2530网关;网关通过WiFi实时传到手机APP网关上挂OLED屏幕液晶;实时显示土壤温湿度值。CC2530对传感器的信号处理;通过按键或手机APP设置土壤温湿度阀值;控制水泵浇水;从而实现对植物的全天候监管。经过实验的数据证明;该系统使用简单;且反应精确灵敏等优势;成功地实现了设计要求;在实际生活工作中具有一定的应用价值。
affiliations: 贵州师范学院大数据科学与智能工程研究院, 贵州师范学院数学与计算机科学学院

title: 多路D/A转换信号发生装置设计
abstract: In system debugging and industrial testing; it is often necessary to generate multi-channel complex signals with special requirements; so a multi-channel signal generator is designed and implemented. The device takes the high performance DSP chip TMS320 F2812 of TI as the core; the DAC7724 of BB company as the digital to analog conversion chip; and the MAX3485 chip to realize the 485 communication between the upper computer and the signal generator. The user can output multiple different waveforms through the upper computer interface control signal generating device. The hardware interface circuit of each module; the software flow chart and the software design of the upper computer are described in detail. The experiments show that the signal generator can output multiple arbitrary shape waveforms according to the needs of users.
abstract_in_chinese: 在系统调试、工业测试中;常常需要产生多路复杂的、具有特殊要求的信号;故设计和实现了一种多路信号发生装置。该装置以TI公司的高性能DSP芯片TMS320F2812为核心;以BB公司的DAC7724作为数模转换芯片;并利用MAX3485芯片实现上位机与信号发生装置之间的485通信;用户可通过上位机界面控制信号发生装置输出多路不同波形。详细阐述了硬件各模块接口电路、软件流程及上位机软件设计;并通过试验表明;该信号发生装置能够按照用户需求输出多路任意形状波形。
keywords: dac7724, digital to analog conversion, max3485, signal generation, tms320f2812, upper computer
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第二十七研究所
source: 科技创新与应用 ;Technology Innovation and Application ; Editorial E-mail ;2018(28)

title: 基于蓝牙的温室物料运输小车控制系统设计
abstract: Based on the Android mobile phone;this paper constructed the Bluetooth wireless remote-control system of the greenhouse material transportation trolley.The related control circuit and software is composed of the CC2540 wireless transmission module and the STC89 C52 RC microcontroller as the control core.The system uses the mobile phone APP to carry on the real-time controlthe Bluetooth module transmits the signalthe monolithic computer controls the motor drive.Finally;the wireless remote-control controls car movement direction through the Bluetooth.Experimental tests have shown that the system is running well.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于安卓手机;构建了温室物料运输小车的蓝牙无线遥控系统;设计了以CC2540无线传输模块、STC89C52RC单片机为控制核心的相关控制电路与软件。该系统利用手机APP进行实时控制;蓝牙模块传输信号;单片机控制电机驱动;最终通过蓝牙无线遥控小车的运动方向。试验结果表明;系统运行良好。
keywords: android phone, bluetooth, greenhouse car, wireless control
affiliations: College of Mechanical and Electronic Engineering, 西北农林科技大学机械与电子工程学院, Northwest A&F University

title: 基于物联网的仓储环境采集系统研究
abstract: The system which combines the Internet of Things technology uses sensors to collect and store relevant environmental data. Through ZigBee wireless network communication; the system can process the data which realizes the functuion of intelligent monitoring and control to storage temperature; humidity and light intensity. It still solves the problems; such as the difficulty of traditional warehouse environment monitoring; inflexible networking; high cost of manual maintenance; etc. The system has higher practicability.
abstract_in_chinese: 系统结合物联网技术;利用传感器采集仓储相关环境数据;通过ZigBee无线网络进行通信并对数据进行处理;实现了对仓储温度、湿度及光照强度的智能监测及控制;解决了传统仓储环境监测难、组网不灵活、人工维护成本高等问题;系统具有较高的实用性。
keywords: cc2530, the internet of things, warehouse
affiliations: College of Electronics and Communication Engineering, 安徽新华学院电子通信工程学院, Anhui Xinhua University

title: 电能质量在线监测系统设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 电能质量对日常工作生活影响极为重要;电能质量是维持电力持续发展、创造国民经济效益的重要保证。随着国家经济水平不断发展;对电力需求不断提升;对电能质量的需求也日益提升。为了更合理有效地监测电能质量;本文基于DSP TMS320F2812设计电能在线监测系统;对系统网络设计以及系统硬件实现进行了研究和探讨。本文研究结果可为同类电能质量在线监测系统设计提供参考与借鉴。
affiliations: 中设设计集团股份有限公司

title: 物联网时代下单片机课程实验教学改革的初步探索
abstract_in_chinese: 本文对非物联网专业单片机实验教学内容和教学方法进行初步改革;在实验教学中加入无线通信和网络协议相关知识;将无线CC2530单片机作为硬件教学目标;初步搭建无线传感器网络平台采用进阶式实验项目教学方法;增强学生动手设计能力;适应物联网时代发展要求。
affiliations: 辽宁石油化工大学信息与控制工程学院

title: cc2530单片机多点温度采集实验设计
abstract: Because multipoint temperature acquisition is beneficial to analyze the temperature of equipment or system;raises technical indexes for controlled temperature;and improves the quality and quantity of products;it is used widely.On the other hand;because the single chip microcomputer based on cc2530 can overcome complex wiring problems;an design scheme of multipoint temperature acquisition experiments is proposed in the course of single chip microcomputer.Firstly;one cc2530 and three DS18 B20 temperature sensors were used as the core hardware;they were linked together by single bus. Secondly;software was designed by the idea of modularization. Finally;the software program was debugged and run in IAR EW8051 integrated development environment. The results show that the experiment realizes the function of temperature acquisition. The experiment scheme proposed in this paper not only cuts hardware cost;program runs stably;but also improves students’ ability to solve the application problems by using relevant theoretical knowledge.
abstract_in_chinese: 多点温度采集有利于分析整个设备或系统的温度;改善被控温度的技术指标;提高产品的质量和数量;因而;应用日益广泛;又由于应用cc2530单片机控制的采集系统可以克服复杂的布线问题;因此;在单片机授课过程中;提出了一种多点温度采集实验设计方案;首先以cc2530单片机和DS18B20温度传感器为核心进行软硬件设计;即3片DS18B20温度传感器通过单总线与1片cc2530相连;然后;采用模块化思想进行软件设计;最后采用IAR EW8051集成开发环境进行软件程序的调试、运行。结果显示;该实验实现了多点温度采集的功能。该实验方案不仅节约了硬件成本、程序运行稳定;而且提高了学生运用相关理论知识解决应用问题的能力。
keywords: cc2530 single chip microcomputer, multipoint temperature acquisition, single bus
affiliations: College of Computer and Control Engineering, 齐齐哈尔大学计算机与控制工程学院, Qiqihar University

title: ZigBee无线通信技术在电力仓储中的应用
abstract_in_chinese: 根据电力仓储管理中温湿度实时监控的需要;采用Zig Bee无线通信技术;以TI CC2530无线单片机及ZStack协议桟为核心;结合数字温湿度传感器;设计了一款多测点无线传感器网络测量系统。本文介绍系统的构成和工作原理、硬件选择和软件设计。测试结果表明;该系统监测效果良好;具有功耗低、体积小、操作方便、成本低等特点。
affiliations: 郑州电力高等专科学校

title: 基于物联网技术和Android系统的智能宿舍的设计与实现
abstract: On the basis of Internet of Things technology and Android system; establishes an intelligent system for real-time monitoring and householdappliances management of students’ dormitories. The system uses ZigBee short-range wireless transmission protocol to set up a dormitorycontrol and monitoring network; and uses CC2530 as the core control processor of the sub-nodes to realize intelligent control of dormitorylighting; air conditioning; curtains; security; air monitoring; etc. By adding servers and developing Android applications; mobile phones ornotebooks can be far away. The process monitors and controls the equipment in the house. Practice shows that the intelligent dormitory solu-tion proposed conforms to the development direction of the times and science and technology; improves the learning and living environmentof students at the same time; enhances the user experience; has a high market prospect and practical value.
abstract_in_chinese: 在物联网技术和Android系统的基础上;以学生宿舍为研究对象;建立一个对学生宿舍环境实时监测与家电管理的智能化系统。该系统以ZigBee近距离无线传输协议组建宿舍控制监测网络;采用CC2530作为子节点核心控制处理器;实现宿舍的灯光、空调、窗帘、安防、空气监测等智能化控制;并通过增设服务器以及开发Android应用程序;实现手机或笔记本远程对宿舍中的设备进行监测和控制。实践表明;所提出的智能宿舍解决方案;顺应时代与科技的发展方向;在改善学生学习和生活环境的同时;增强用户体验;具有较高的市场前景和实用价值。
keywords: android, cc2530, intelligent dormitory, internet of things, zigbee
affiliations: 淮安信息职业技术学院, Huaian Vocational College of Information Technology

title: 基于Android的空调远程控制系统
abstract: An air conditioning remote control system based on Android is designed to realize remote control of air conditioner. In the system;the control mode of air conditioner is extended by taking the CC2530 as the main controller;and combining with the infrared learning technology and WiFi wireless communication technology. The ZigBee terminal module is used in the system to realize acquisition and storage of infrared data. The control commands are sent by the Android client to drive the Zigbee terminal;so as to realize real-time remote control of air conditioner. An APP application program communicating with the cloud server is designed based on the Android platform and asynchronous socket technology. The test results show that the system can realize real-time remote control and temperature acquisition of air conditioner by using the APP application program.The scheme is economic;reasonable;easy to be implemented;and can be applied in other home appliances.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现对于空调的远程控制;设计一种基于Android的空调远程控制系统。系统利用CC2530作为主控制器;结合红外学习技术、WiFi无线通信技术;扩展了对空调的控制方式。采用ZigBee终端模块实现对红外数据的采集、存储;同时通过Android客户端发送控制命令驱动ZigBee终端实现对于空调的远程实时控制。基于Android平台和异步socket技术设计出一款与云服务器进行通信的APP应用程序。测试结果表明;该系统通过APP应用程序实现了对空调的远程实时控制和温度的采集。该方案经济合理;易于实现;可以应用在其他的家电领域。
keywords: android, cloud server, data acquisition, infrared data processing, remote control, socket technology
affiliations: School of Information Science and Engineering, 武汉科技大学信息科学与工程学院, Wuhan University of Science and Technology

title: ZigBee自组织网络在大棚环境监测中的应用
abstract: An environment monitoring system for greenhouse is designed to improve the efficiency of greenhouse planting;which is designed on the basis of the Zig Bee protocol;taking the Z-Stack protocol stack and CC2530 of TI as the core;and combining with the temperature-humidity sensor DHT11 and host computer program compiled by using the Lab VIEW software. The system is composed of a coordinator and multiple terminal nodes. The coordinator;as the core of the entire Zig Bee network;is responsible for the formation of the entire system network;can parse data packets for terminal nodes of the current Zig Bee network;and send them to the host computer by means of the RS 232 protocol. The terminal nodes collect the environment temperature-humidity information;and send it to the coordinator via the Zig Bee network. If any new node or old node joins or leaves the network;the coordinator can immediately present the status of the current network. The results of the experimental test show that the system is simple in design;runs stably;has reliable network security and a good application prospect.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了提高大棚种植效率;设计一种大棚环境监测系统。设计基于Zig Bee协议;以TI公司Z-Stack协议栈及CC2530为核心芯片;结合温湿度传感器DHT11;Lab VIEW软件编写的上位机程序。分别组成协调器和多个终端节点。协调器是整个Zig Bee网络核心;负责组建整个系统网络;能解析当前Zig Bee网络中终端节点数据包;通过RS 232协议发送给上位机。终端节点采集环境温湿度信息;通过Zig Bee网络发送给协调器;若有新的节点或者旧节点加入、离开网络;协调器能立刻反映当前网络状态。经实验测试验证;系统设计简洁、运行稳定、网络安全性可靠;有很好的应用前景。
keywords: cc2530, coordinator, environment monitoring, greenhouse planting, labview, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Nanchang Hangkong University, School of Information Engineering, 南昌航空大学信息工程学院

title: 一种DSP处理器接口驱动程序设计方法
abstract: In this paper; a DSP processor driver is designed on the uC/OS Ⅱ system. The program can drive the TMS320LF2407A processor to sample and calculate all kinds of digital signals. The experimental results of gasoline engine speed signal sampling and FFT calculation show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has good accuracy.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章在uC/OS Ⅱ系统上设计了一种DSP处理器驱动程序。该程序能够驱动TMS320LF2407A处理器进行数字信号的采样和各种数字计算。汽油机转速信号采样和FFT计算实验结果表明;该算法具有较好的准确率。
keywords: driver softare, dsp processor, uc/os Ⅱ
affiliations: 南京交通职业技术学院电子信息工程学院, Nanjing Vocational Institute of Transport Technology, Department of Electronic Engineering

title: 面向煤矿安全的智能监控及预警系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对矿井安全问题;文中设计了一个应用于煤矿井下的智能监控及预警系统;主要采用ZigBee网络及实时数据关联分析技术。井下系统由ZigBee无线传感器网络构成;选用C8051F124微处理器、CC2530芯片;以及多种采集矿井环境的传感器。井上网络使用高性能服务器将采集的数据进行分离写入数据库;并进行实时关联计算;将处理结果呈现在PC端及智能终端。
affiliations: 河北建筑工程学院信息工程学院

title: 基于RSSI测距的室内定位算法优化
abstract_in_chinese: 室内无线定位在生产、物流、监控等方面都有广泛用途。受无线通信距离和环境的影响;基于RSSI的室内定位存在误差较大的问题;本文设计了一种基于RSSI的定位优化方案来实现较高精度的室内无线定位。先对整个定位区域进行节点密度优化;通过区域划分;拟合区域的环境参数;再对节点信号进行滤波并选择;获得高可信度信号值;最后采用加权质心算法作定位计算;从而提高定位的精度。本方案利用CC2530 ZigBee模块进行定位实验;实验结果表明;本方法室内定位精度较高;具有一定的应用前景。
affiliations: 浙江师范大学工学院职业技术教育学院

title: TMS320F28335中断嵌套设计及应用
abstract_in_chinese: 简述了关键中断实时处理的一种方法。采用在中断服务程序ISR中修改中断优先级并使能高优先级中断实现中断嵌套;使关键中断不需等待;及时得到响应。
affiliations: 南京国电南自新能源科技有限公司

title: 基于CC2530的农业大棚智能环境监测系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high cost of wired transmission system in the cluster environment and network maintenance; a wireless real-time monitoring system for environmental monitoring in the greenhouse was designed. The wireless sensor network is established with the CC2530 chip as the core; and environmental information is collected and stored. Finally; build a host computer platform to achieve data storage and display functions. Experiments show that; the system is stable and reliable; and it can meet the needs of intelligent environmental monitoring of agricultural greenhouses.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对集群大棚环境有线传输系统成本高、网络维护量大等问题;设计了针对大棚内环境监测的无线实时监测系统。以CC2530芯片为核心建立无线传感器网络;对环境信息进行采集、存储。最后;搭建上位机平台;实现数据存储与显示等功能。实验表明;该系统运行稳定可靠;能满足对农业大棚环境智能监测的需求。
keywords: agricultural greenhouses, cc2530, intelligent monitoring, internet of thing
affiliations: Shanxi Agricultural University, College of Information Science and Engineering, 山西农业大学信息科学与工程学院

title: 基于遗传算法和转矩分配函数的开关磁阻电机转矩脉动抑制
abstract: Torque ripple of switched reluctance motor (SRM) was inevitable due to its special doubly salient motor structure. Although the conventional torque sharing function (TSF) control method of SRM could largely suppress the torque ripple;the torque ripple suppression was still limited by the physical conditions such as the switching frequency and the power supply voltage. A TSF control method was proposed based on genetic algorithm. The torque ripple was used as the optimization target to find the optimal switching angle using the optimization ability of the genetic algorithm. The experimental system based on genetic algorithm using TMS320F28335 was established. The experimental results on designed controller for a 8/6 prototype SRM validated the effectiveness of torque ripple minimization.
abstract_in_chinese: 开关磁阻电机(SRM)特殊的双凸极结构导致其运行时会产生很强的转矩脉动。传统的转矩分配函数(TSF)控制方法虽然可以在一定程度上起到抑制转矩脉动的作用;但是受到开关频率、功率电源电压值等物理条件的限制;仍会存在较大的转矩脉动。为此;提出了一种基于遗传算法的SRM TSF控制方案。利用遗传算法良好的寻优能力;在指数型TSF控制的基础上;将转矩脉动作为优化目标来寻取最优的开关角。将1台四相8/6极的SRM作为研究对象;搭建了以TMS320F28335为控制核心的试验平台。试验结果验证了基于遗传算法的TSF控制方法可以有效减小SRM的转矩脉动。
keywords: genetic algorithm, switched reluctance motor(srm), torque ripple, torque sharing function(tsf)

title: 基于ZigBee技术的温室大棚环境参数远程监测
abstract: 为了解决温室大棚中温度和湿度这两个环境参数的监测问题;设计了一种基于ZigBee技术的无线监测系统;解决了传统的温室大棚中有线通讯技术的高成本;高功耗;高复杂度网络覆盖范围小等问题。采用主控芯片CC2530组建无线传感网络;使用温湿度传感器DHT11作为传感器节点建立温室大棚温湿度监测系统。本系统表明;将ZigBee这样一种具有低成本;低功耗等优点的无线通信技术手段运用在温室大棚环境参数检测系统中;具有很强的应用前景。

title: 基于FMCW的近距离测距系统设计
abstract: FMCW（调频连续波）雷达由于其自身的良好特性;被广泛应用于各种领域;测距是其最基本的功能之一。本文基于雷达收发器IVS-162和TMS320F28335设计了一套近距离测距系统。首先;研究分析了FMCW雷达测距系统的工作原理;然后对雷达收发器IVS-162的工作原理与三角波调制信号理论进行分析研究;设计实现三角波发生电路、差频信号处理电路、数模转换和数字信号处理电路。最后给出被测目标距离的测试结果;结果表明系统可以对近距离目标进行有效测量。

title: 基于DSP的三相不对称有源电力滤波器设计
abstract: 针对传统谐波电流检测方法在三相不对称或发生畸变时电流检测精度不高以及误差较大问题;提出了一种基于瞬时无功功率理论的改进型谐波电流检测算法并详细介绍了双DSP控制系统的软件设计。以双TMS320F28335芯片为系统控制核心;构建基于电网电压前馈解耦的双闭环控制策略;利用Matlab/Simulink进行建模仿真并设计了一台50KVA的有源电力滤波器实验装置。实验结果表明设计能够很好地补偿谐波和无功电流;使电网进线电流正弦化;也证明了改进的谐波电流检测算法的正确性和可行性。
keywords: 三相不对称系统dsp, 有源电力滤波器
affiliations: 三峡大学电气与新能源学院

title: 基于CC2530的农村沼气监测系统设计
abstract: 为实现对农村沼气池状态的有效监控和管理;采用TI公司研发的Zig Bee无线传感芯片CC2530为核心设计沼气监测系统。整个系统由传感接入模块、中央处理模块、GPRS移动传输模块和应用管理模块四部分组成;能够实现对农村沼气池中沼气温度、浓度和液位等指标的监测及数据远程传输。文章详细介绍了各模块的组成、功能和设计思路;并分析了系统的测试环境;以期为系统实物开发奠定基础。
keywords: cc2530, gprs, 农村沼气监测系统
affiliations: 上饶职业技术学院

title: TMS320F2812的最小系统设计
abstract: The purpose of designing the DSP minimum system is to lay the foundatio n for designing a comprehensive experimental platform based on DSP. In the process of design; a reasonable design scheme is proposed for the hardware circuit(power supply and reset circuit; clock circuit; JTAG interface circuit and serial interface circuit) and DSP integrated development tool CCS is used for program editing and online simulation test. The simulation shows that this circuit has realized the basic function of DSP minimum system; and laid a good foundation for the whole experimental platform.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计DSP最小系统的目的是为设计基于DSP的综合实验平台打下基础。在设计过程中;对硬件电路(电源及复位电路、时钟电路、JTAG接口电路和串行接口电路)提出一种合理的设计方案并利用DSP集成开发工具CCS进行程序编辑和在线仿真测试。经仿真可知该电路已实现DSP最小系统的基本功能;为整个实验平台的搭建打下良好基础。
keywords: dsp, minimum system design

title: 基于无线传感网络的实验室监管系统设计
abstract: This paper focuses on the hardware and software design of the laboratory monitoring system. The design mainly includes three parts: sensor acquisition system; wireless sensor network system and equipment control system. The laboratory monitoring system uses sensors to collect laboratory data information; and wirelessly gathers the data to the upper computer control system for real-time display. The mobile terminal control system remotely accesses the upper computer through the mobile network for remote monitoring. Finally; based on the collected data information; human control and intelligent control; single control and multiple control combined with intelligent monitoring methods are realized.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章主要研究实验室监管系统的软硬件设计方案;设计主要包括传感器采集系统、无线传感网络系统、设备控制系统3个部分。实验室监管系统利用传感器采集实验室数据信息;通过无线方式将数据汇聚至上位机控制系统进行实时显示;移动终端控制系统通过移动网络远程访问上位机进行远程监控。最终根据采集的数据信息实现人为控制与智能化控制;单一控制与多元控制相结合的智能监管方式。
keywords: cc2530, host computer, mobile terminal, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Changchun Guanghua University, 长春光华学院

title: 基于手机Android客户端的智能家居系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 基于手机Android客户端的智能家居系统主要包括家庭内部ZigBee无线传感网络、ESP8266透传网关模块和手机Android客户端三部分。家庭内部ZigBee无线传感网络由ZigBee终端节点和ZigBee协调节点组成;其硬件模块采用CC2530作为主控芯片。另外;采用ESP8266透传网关与ZigBee无线传感网络进行通信;可实现对智能家电的的局域无线控制。

title: 电动汽车无线充电系统的研究
abstract: With the vigorous development of new energy sources;emission reduction and energy conservation have gradually become the main direction of new energy vehicle technology development.Electric vehicles have gradually become a trend of the development of the automotive industry;but the charging facility technology has restricted the development of electric vehicles.At present;the charging mode of electric vehicles is generally wired contact charging;which is inconvenient in practical operation.Based on wireless power transmission;this paper presents a design scheme of wireless charging based on magnetic coupling resonance.Aiming at the problem of charge-discharge transmission efficiency;an improved ZCT-PWM soft-switching chopper circuit is designed.The soft-switching conversion circuit is used to reduce the switching loss during charging.At the same time;the DSP charging control loop based on TMS320 F2812 is used to carry out the related experimental tests.The experimental results prove the rationality and correctness of the design.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着国家大力发展新能源;减排和节能逐步成为了新能源汽车技术发展的主要方向。电动汽车逐步成为了汽车行业发展的一种趋势;而充电设施技术却制约着电动汽车的发展。当前电动汽车的充电方式普遍为有线接触式充电;这种充电方式在实际操作中有诸多不便。本文以无线电能传输为基础;提出一种基于磁耦合谐振式的电动汽车无线充电的设计方案。针对充放电传输效率问题;设计一种改进型的ZCT-PWM软开关斩波电路;利用软开关变换电路;减小了充电过程中的开关损耗。同时;采用基于TMS320F2812的DSP充电控制回路;进行了相关的实验测试。其实验结果证明了设计方案的合理性和正确性。
keywords: dsp, electric vehicle, soft switch, wireless charging

title: A Cow Behavior Classification System Based on Semi-supervised Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
abstract: In order to determine the behavior of cows and improve the management level of fine feed;a Real-time identification system for cows’ movement behaviors based on the semi-supervised fuzzy clustering algorithm was developed and the wireless sensor node was designed on the principle of low power consumption;high sensitivity and high operational stability.At the same time;the transmission performance of wireless sensor nodes was tested to determine the optimal transmission distance and the optimal node fixed height;in which the transmission distance were set at 10;20 and 30 m;while the fixed height were 10;20 and 30 cm;respectively.And the accuracy;precision and sensitivity of K-means algorithm;BP neural networks algorithm and semi-supervised fuzzy clustering algorithm were compared.The results showed that the wireless sensor node consist with three-axis accelerometer ADXL345;processor MSP430-F149;and wireless transceiver CC1101 which could collect data automatically of cows’ movement behaviors;and meet the longterm reliable data transmission and other work requirements.The test results showed that the op-timal transmission distance was 10 mand the optimal fixed node height was 30 cm.The accuracy;precision and sensitivity of semi-supervised fuzzy clustering algorithm were 95.4%;53.0% and60.6%;respectively;that of K-means algorithm;BP neural network were 90.3%;39.9%;45.6%and 93.7%;45.5%;47.0%;respectively.In conclusion;the accuracy of semi-supervised fuzzy clustering algorithm was high;implementation was simple;learning complexity was low and running speed was fast;and it also had strong optimization ability.
abstract_in_chinese: 以实时判别奶牛行为;提升精细养殖技术水平为目标;本试验以系统功耗低、检测灵敏度高、运行稳定性强为原则设计无线传感节点;研发了一种基于半监督模糊聚类算法的奶牛行为实时判别系统。为获取最佳通信距离及最优节点固定高度;对无线传感节点分别进行固定高度—通讯距离与丢包率关系测试、固定高度—数据波动关系测试;通信距离分别取10、20、30m;固定高度分别取10、20、30cm并将半监督模糊聚类判别算法、K-means算法及BP神经网络算法在奶牛行为识别方面的准确度、精度及敏感度进行比较。结果显示;集成三轴加速度传感器ADXL345、处理器MSP430-F149、无线收发器CC1101等芯片设计的无线传感节点可精确采集奶牛运动加速度数据;满足长期可靠传输数据等工作要求。固定高度—通讯距离与丢包率、固定高度—数据波动关系测试结果显示;最优传输距离为10m;最佳节点固定高度为30cm。半监督模糊聚类算法性能最高;平均准确度达到95.4%;平均精度为53.0%;平均敏感度为60.6%。K-means算法的平均准确度达到90.3%;平均精度仅有39.9%;平均敏感度为45.6%。BP神经网络算法平均准确度达到93.7%;平均精度为45.5%;平均敏感度为47.0%。半监督模糊聚类算法具有准确性高、学习复杂度低、运行速度快的特点;具有良好的寻优能力;效率较高。
keywords: cow behavior, real-time discriminant, semi-supervisory fuzzy clustering algorithm, wireless sensor node

title: Design of high precision angle measuring system based on two speed resolver
abstract: The aim of this study was to implement high precision angel measurement of rotary device. Two speed resolver which electrical error is less than ± 10″ was utilized to as angle position angle. Powering and decoding circuits were designed for the two speed resolver. The angle information was then read by Digital Signal Processor(DSP)TMS320F28335. Compared with other decoding methods of two speed resolver;this study can reduce software consumption on data integration and error correction. The results we obtained demonstrate this system could output high quality angle position indication signal with features of high precision;high reliability and simply coding.
abstract_in_chinese: 为实现伺服电机驱动回旋机构应用中的角秒级的角度测量精度。选用电气误差小于±10″的无刷双通道旋转变压器作为角度位置传感器;设计了双通道旋转变压器的激励及解算电路;通过数字信号处理器(Digital Signal Processor;DSP)TMS320F28335读取解算电路输出的角度位置。与传统的无刷双通道旋转变压器角度解算电路相比较;可以有效减少软件算法中数据整合和纠错部分的工作量。实验结果表明该系统能稳定输出高质量的角度位置指示信号。适用于伺服电机定位控制等需要高精度角度位置反馈的场合;具有可靠性高、精度高、软件开销少的优点。
keywords: angle measurement, dual channel resolver-to-digital converter, tms320f28335, two speed resolver

title: Design of military training management system by ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a large amount of manpower supervision and control is needed when students military training;combined with ZigBee low-power communication technology;designed to use the host computer and ZigBee communications to achieve real-time monitoring of military training students a variety of physiological parameters(such as body temperature;heart rate;);Military training environment and other functions;so as to achieve an effective and scientific management of military training purposes.The system uses the CC2530 chip based on ZigBee technology.Each sensor module sends the collected data wirelessly to the host computer through the ZigBee module that comes with the CC2530 node device.The system has been tested and proved to be stable;real-time;costeffective and effective in preventing accidental accidents and meeting the real-time monitoring of military training for students in schools.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对学生军训时需要大量人力监管保障的问题;结合ZigBee低功耗通信技术;设计了利用上位机和ZigBee通信实现实时监控军训时学生身体多种生理参数(如体温、心率、血糖血氧浓度等)、军训环境等功能的系统;从而达到有效、科学的进行学生军训管理的目的。该系统采用基于ZigBee技术的CC2530芯片;各传感器模块经CC2530节点设备自带的ZigBee模块以无线的方式将采集到的数据发送到上位机。该系统经过测试表明;运行稳定、实时性好、性价比高;有效预防意外突发事件;满足了学校对学生军训管理的实时监控。
keywords: cc2530, military training management, real-time monitoring, zigbee

title: Design and Implementation of a LED Intelligent Lighting System Based on CC2530
abstract: The designing scheme for light-emitting diode(LED) intelligent lighting system is proposed and a wirelesscontrol network has been set up following ZigBee technology.The designing principles have been introduced about highpower dimmer power supply and wireless-control module based on CC2530 which as the network terminal node.Halfbridge LLC resonant structure is applied in LED driving power with pulse width modulation(PWM) dimming interface circuit.The prototype system is manufactured and provided the relevant test data and the experimental results demonstrate the possibility of the scheme.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出了一种发光二极管(LED)智能照明系统设计方案;组建了基于ZigBee技术的无线控制网络;介绍了作为终端节点的大功率调光电源和基于CC2530无线控制模块的设计原理;驱动电源应用了半桥LLC谐振结构;具有脉宽调制(PWM)调光接口电路。制作了样机并给出了相关测试数据;实验结果表明了该方案的可行性。

title: Design of Intelligent Door and Window Control System Based on ZigBee and 4G Technology
abstract: This paper introduces the design of software and hardware scheme of intelligent door and window control system which based on ZigBee and 4 G technology; changing the way of traditional monitoring. It uses the CC2530 as microprocessor. The wireless networks commun-ication of ZigBee and the 4 G wireless network technology are the means of communication; which makes door and window intelligent.
abstract_in_chinese: 介绍了基于ZigBee和4G技术相结合的门窗智能控制系统的软硬件设计方案;改变了传统的监控方式。系统以CC2530为微处理器;以ZigBee的无线自组网和4G无线网络技术为通信方式;实现了门窗控制的智能化。

title: 基于Zigbee的文物古建筑火灾报警系统设计与实现
abstract: 为解决文物古建筑火灾探测系统常采用有线网络存在的诸多弊端;本文设计并实现了一种基于CC2530芯片的低成本、低功耗的无线传感器网络节点。节点通过Zigbee协议实现自组网;传感器能够对环境中温湿度、烟雾等进行采集。通过对网络层Cluster-Tree算法进行改进;使节点能够长期、可靠地工作。经实验测试;该系统功能、稳定性和传输距离均能满足要求。
keywords: zigbee, 文物古建筑, 无线传感网络, 环境监测

title: 农产品冷链配送监测系统的设计与实现
abstract: In view of the problem that the environment of cold-chain distribution for agricultural products is difficult to be effectively guaranteed;the cold-chain distribution monitoring system for agricultural products is designed by using the technologies of narrow-band Internet of things( NB-IoT) based on mobile cellular communication and the wireless sensor network( WSN). By adopting sensor module and relay module;the acquisition and control of environmental information in cold-chain distribution compartment is realized. The WSN is built with MSP430 microcontroller and CC1101 wirelesschip as the core;and wireless data transmission of terminal node and coordinator node is realized. With the NB-IoT based on mobile cellular communications;the environment data collected by the local wireless sensor network can be transmitted to a remote terminal device. Based on browser/server( B/S) architecture;a cold-chain distribution monitoring system for agricultural products is designed. Through the system;real-time display and storage of environmental data in the process of cold-chain distribution of agricultural products;and remote control of the working state of related equipment are completed. The test results show that although the system is affected by the debris in compartment and the compartment itself;packet loss and time delay of data transmission are caused;the system can still better meet the application requirements of cold-chain distribution of agricultural products;to realize real-time monitoring of various environmental information in the cold-chain distribution compartment of agricultural products and remote control of equipment.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对农产品冷链配送环境难以得到有效保证这一问题;利用基于移动蜂窝通信的窄带物联网技术(NB-IoT)和无线传感器网络(WSN)技术;设计了农产品冷链配送监测系统。该系统利用传感器模块、继电器模块;实现了冷链配送车厢内环境信息的采集和设备的实时控制以MSP430单片机和CC1101无线芯片为核心;搭建了WSN;实现了环境数据在终端节点和协调器节点的无线传输利用基于移动蜂窝通信的NB-IoT;实现了本地环境数据的远程无线传输。基于浏览器/服务器(B/S)架构;设计了农产品冷链配送监测系统。通过该系统;完成了农产品冷链配送过程中环境数据的实时显示和存储;以及对相关设备工作状态的远程控制。测试结果表明;该系统虽然受到车厢内杂物和车厢本身对信号的影响;造成数据传输的丢包和时延;但仍能较好地满足农产品冷链配送的应用需求;实现了对农产品冷链配送车厢内各种环境信息的实时监测和设备的远程控制。
keywords: agricultural products, browser/server(b/s) architecture, cold-chain distribution, mobile cellular communication, narrow-band internet of things(nb-iot), wireless sensor network(wsn)
affiliations: College of Information Science and Technology, 甘肃农业大学信息科学技术学院, Gansu Agricultural University

title: 基于物联网的温室大棚监控系统的设计
abstract_in_chinese: 随着农业技术不断的进步;农业大棚越来越多;对大棚的管理和监控的要求也越来越高。本设计采用Zig Bee无线传输技术设计一种基于物联网的温室大棚监控系统;该系统分为数据采集模块、终端节点、协调器节点和上位机四部分;可实现对大棚内湿度、温度、光照强度、二氧化碳浓度等参数的远程实时监测;当环境参数异常时;系统能够自动报警。实验表明;该系统能有效监测温室大棚的环境参数;且实时性强;整体性能良好。
affiliations: 天津天狮学院信息与自动化学院, 天津博顿电子有限公司

title: 无线门禁系统的研究与设计
abstract: In this paper; a wireless access control system is designed by using TMS 320 f 28027 DSP as the main control chip;which is mainly used to control the threshold control. Access control system consists of two parts: master and slave. The host is theinitiator of each communication; responsible for the establishment and termination of the communication link; and occupies a dominant position in the communication process. The slave waits passively for a connection to complete the communication process withthe host. The design mainly includes access control equipment; radio frequency module; voice module; card module; electric control lock and other modules. The design is convenient and fast; and the collected information is accurate. it has good application value.
abstract_in_chinese: 该文通过研究;用TMS320F28027的DSP作为主控芯片;设计了一款无线门禁系统;主要用于;用于控制门限控制。门禁系统由主机和从机两部分组成。主机是每次通信的发起者;负责通信链路的建立与终止;在通信过程中占据主导地位。从机被动等待连接;配合主机完成通信过程。设计主要包括门禁主控设备、无线射频模块、语音模块、刷卡模块、电控锁等模块。该设计方便快捷、采集信息准确;具有良好的应用价值。
keywords: access control system, communication link, electric control lock, radio frequency
affiliations: 中车株洲电力机车有限公司, 湖南铁道职业技术学院, Hunan Railway Professional Technology College, CRRC Zhuzhou Electric Locomotive Co.

title: 基于物联网技术的智慧农业系统的设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 紧跟物联网发展的步伐;设计了一个智慧农业系统。该系统主要由TI公司提供的CC2530芯片组建无线传感器网络(Wireless Sensor Networks;WSN);远程采集数据、然后将收集的数据通过串口发送到上位机。上位机物联网平台实现了远程数据的展示并下达用户命令给协调器进行网络调整。此外;为了方便手持终端能够实时访问网络;使用ESP8266WIFIAP(Access Point)进行数据转发。系统具有可远程实时显示终端数据、低成本、功耗低等特点;有一定的应用价值。
affiliations: 河池学院计算机与信息工程学院

title: 基于DSP的三相交流异步电机变频调速系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the demand of the motor control system for high precision; low power consumption and low cost; designs the U/F speed control system of space vector pulse width modulation(SVPWM). TI’s high-speed digital signal processor(tms320 f28335) is selected as the core of the control in the design. Describes the overall design diagram of the system; and expounds the complete SVPWM control process in detail;presents the hardware design idea and the system control program design idea of each module of the system. The feasibility and rationality of the system design are verified by experiments.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对电机控制系统对高精度、小功耗和低成本的需求;设计空间电压矢量脉宽调制(SVPWM)的U/F调速控制系统。设计中选用TI的高速数字信号处理器TMS320F28335作为控制核心;描绘出系统总体设计框图;详细阐述完整的SVPWM实现过程;给出系统各个模块的硬件设计思路和系统控制程序设计思路。通过实验验证系统设计的可行性、合理性。
keywords: ac induction motor, dsp, svpwm, variable frequency speed regulation
affiliations: 西安石油大学电子工程学院, Xi’an Shiyou University, School of Electronic Engineering

title: 基于无线传感网络的鱼类培育环境监测系统设计
abstract: The main content of this paper is hardware and software design and implementation plan of environmental monitoring system for fish cultivation. The part of this design include three aspects; wireless sensor network; monitoring system of upper computer and mobile terminal monitoring. The system gets the environmental information through sensors; and sends them to server; people can get the information by mobile terminal which accesses the server at any time.
abstract_in_chinese: 文章主要研究鱼类培育环境监测系统的软硬件设计与实施方案;设计主要由无线传感网络、上位机监测系统、移动终端监测系统共同搭建完成。系统通过传感器采集环境信息;利用无线传感网络将数据传输汇聚并发送给上位机服务器;移动终端远程访问服务器进行实时监测。
keywords: cc2540, environmental monitoring, sensor, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Changchun Guanghua University, 长春光华学院

title: 基于ZigBee的智能环境污染信息采集系统
abstract_in_chinese: 为针对不同空气污染实现室内环境的智能调节;研究并设计了一种以ZigBee技术为基础的智能环境信息采集系统。此系统以CC2530芯片为核心进行内部节点的无线组网;通过各传感器节点监测室内外各处的温湿度、光照强度及CO、SO2等空气污染物浓度。各传感器采集到的数据通过终端节点发送到协调器;再通过串口与智能网关将数据发送到数据管理平台;可实现对室内环境的实时监测与调节。
affiliations: 中国电子科技集团公司第八研究所, 安徽理工大学电气与信息工程学院

title: 基于物联网智能家居安防系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 本文通过问卷调查以及对目前国内智能家居、智能安防系统的调查研究;以及根据市场的需求;结合物联网、现代通信技术以及嵌入式等技术实现WSN布局及数据传输;实现LBS系统定位以及智能门禁系统。WSN节点采用CC2530电路模块进行数据采集与控制;可以实现远程温度、湿度的数据采集、可燃气体检测与报警、人体感应;模拟了窗帘、门等设备的控制功能与状态检测。
affiliations: 浙江广厦建设职业技术学院

title: 面向光伏电池组件测量节点的ZigBee网络设计
abstract: In this paper;a ZigBee-based photovoltaic cell module monitoring node is designed with CC2530 as the main control chip;and its processor is described in detail. A large number of PV power plants exist abnormally;and the traditional wiring is complicated and the cost is high. Wireless communication module;power supply module and the acquisition module circuit schematic design and software workflow are detoriled. The analysis of the voltage;current and temperature and humidity data collected by the actual network shows that the node has the advantages of stability;reliability and high acquisition precision;which can meet the practical application requirements. Finally;based on LabVIEW;the host computermonitoring systemys constructed by the bottom monitoring node;ZigBee network and PV module monitoring system;which has a certain value of engineering applications.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前大量光伏电站存在的电池板工作异常、传统布线复杂以及成本较高的现状;论文以CC2530为主控芯片;设计了一种基于ZigBee的光伏电池组件监测节点;并详述了其处理器和无线通信模块、供电模块以及采集模块的电路原理图设计以及软件工作流程。分析实际组网采集到的电压、电流以及温湿度数据表明;该节点具有稳定、可靠以及采集精度高的优点;能够满足实际的应用需求;最后基于LabVIEW编写了上位机;构建了由底层监测节点、ZigBee网络以及监控系统上位机组成的光伏电池组件监控系统;具有一定的工程应用价值。
keywords: cc2530, node design, photovoltaic cell components, wireless communication technology, zigbee
affiliations: 国网怀化供电公司, State Grid Huaihua Power Supply Company

title: 智慧粮仓数据采集处理系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 以CC2530单片机技术为核心;运用物联网星型网络拓扑结构进行智慧粮仓数据采集处理系统设计;完成数据采集系统的硬件电路设计及软件编程。根据粮食存储要求;利用温湿度等传感器实现粮仓粮情信息数据的采集和传输处理;并通过Zigbee无线传感网络、Internet网络将粮仓内粮情参数传输存储到远程监控中心;从而实现粮食仓储智能化管理。

title: Mine-used Cascaded Quasi-Z-source DC-DC Boost Converter
abstract: This paper proposes a novel cascaded quasi-Z-source DC-DC boost converter which can be used in mine; and analyzes its circuit structure and operating principle; and deduces related voltage relation of the circuit. This circuit overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional Z-source converter such as low voltage gain; high voltage stress and discontinuous input current.The simulation results of the system based on MATLAB/Simulink are given. The experimental circuit based on TMS320 F28335 is built; the theoretical analysis and experimental results are in complete agreement with each other; and the feasibility and correctness of the novel DC-DC converter are verified.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出了一种新型的矿用级联准阻抗源DC-DC升压变换器;分析了其电路基本结构和工作原理;推导了电路的相关电压关系。该电路克服了传统Z源变换器电压增益小、器件应力大以及输入电流断续等问题。应用MATLAB/Simulink对电路进行了仿真;并在仿真结果的基础上以TMS320F28335为核心搭建出试验电路;理论分析与试验结果相符;验证了此DC-DC变换器的可行性和正确性。
keywords: boost ability, cascaded, dc-dc boost converter, quasi-z-source, voltage stress
affiliations: 山东科技大学电气与自动化工程学院

title: Design of High Reliability Power Management Circuit of DSP TMS320F28335
abstract: A highly reliable power management circuit of digital signal processor(DSP) TMS320 F28335 is designed. The power supply demands of the DSP were analyzed; and the required power was accounted. The 1.9 V and 3.3 V dual power supply management circuit meeting demands of power and power-on timing of the chip was designed. The circuit has the correct electrical sequence and reasonable time interval. The experimental platform verifies that the power supply circuit’ s output voltage is stable; the power-on timing is good; and the power supply ripple is within a reasonable range. In conclusion; both DC character and AC specialty of the circuit show excellent performance; which can guarantee the reliable operation of the DSP.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了适用于TMS320F-28335型数字信号处理器芯片的高可靠电源管理电路。分析和核算了电源需求;设计了满足该芯片工作所需功率的1.9 V和3. 3 V双电源驱动电路;双电源具有正确的上电顺序和合理的上电时间间隔。经实验平台测试;该电源电路输出电压稳定;上电时序良好;电源纹波在合理范围内;直流特性和交流特性均表现出优异性能;可保证DSP可靠工作。
keywords: high reliability, power management, power-on timing, tms320f28335
affiliations: 鄂尔多斯应用技术学院信息工程学院
source: 测控技术 ;Measurement & Control Technology ; Editorial E-mail ;2018(10)

title: 基于CC2530的短距离无线通信系统的实现
abstract_in_chinese: 基于CC2530构成的系统可以进行可靠的短距离无线数据传输。CC2530内部集成了符合IEEE 802.15.4协议的2.4 GHz无线数据收发器;通过设置无线数据收发器相关寄存器的参数;能够灵活实现IEEE 802.15.4协议物理层和MAC层的规定。实验表明;该系统能够准确、高效地进行无线数据传输。

title: 基于WSN的分布式直流充电桩监测系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前充电桩系统智能化管理的需求;提出了一种基于无线传感网络(WSN)的分布式直流充电桩监测系统。系统选择电能监测芯片CS5460A采集充电桩数据信息;利用CC2530芯片组建节点间的局域网络;通过GPRS将数据发送到上位机;在Lab View软件上开发上位机界面;实现充电桩运营时电流、电压、温度和充电电量四个参数的实时可视化显示以及报警指示。实验结果表明:无线传感网络的应用;降低了系统的布线成本;提高了充电桩运营的实时性与便捷性。

title: Residential Air Quality Monitoring System Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: In this paper;a residential air quality monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network was designed.The system collected all kinds of indoor air quality parameters（indoor PM2.5 concentration;carbon dioxide concentration;temperature and humidity;etc.）by ZigBee terminal arranged in each room.Monitoring data information was sent to the user’s mobile phone through GSM module to realize the real-time reminder function.PC terminal was used to realize the real-time display and storage of monitoring data.The field test results showed that the system had stable operation;convenient maintenance;reliable information transmission;strong usability in residential environment;and had a good application prospect.
keywords: air quality monitoring, cc2530, residential environment, wireless sensor network

title: Design and implementation of a simple stacker DSP control system
abstract: In view of the complicated control system of stacker system and high accuracy requirements;a simple stacker DSP control system is designed.Through the TMS320 F2812 DSP;the hardware circuit of each module of the system is designed.The system driver circuit is optimized with an integrated driver chip.The motor of xz-axis for the DC motor to L298 Nas a drive;y-axis motor for the stepper motor to ULN2003 Aas a driver.Input signal to the parallel keys through the TCRT5000 infrared sensor to locate the warehouse.The circuit principle and testing process are analyzed.Through the control of the xyz-axis motor;to achieve a total of 8×8 warehouse 64 arbitrary positioning control.The test results show that the system is reliable and has high stability.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对堆垛机系统控制复杂、精度要求较高等特点;提出了一种简易的堆垛机DSP控制系统;以TMS320F2812型DSP为主控制器;设计了系统的各模块硬件电路;利用集成化的驱动芯片对系统驱动电路进行了优化;其中x、z轴电机采用直流电机并以L298N作为驱动;y轴电机采用步进电机以ULN2003A作为驱动;输入信号以并联按键方式通过TCRT5000红外传感器实现了对货仓的定位。对电路原理与测试过程进行了分析;通过对x、y、z轴电机的控制;实现了对8×8共64个仓库的任意定位控制。测试结果表明;系统运行可靠且具有较高的稳定性。
keywords: dsp, l298n, stacker, tcrt5000, uln2 003a

title: Design and analysis of quantitative robot hand for acupuncture manipulation
abstract: In order to promote inheritance of acupuncture manipulation and advance the study of mechanism of acupuncture;make the robot hand realize quantification of acupuncture manipulation;a robot hand which can simulate lifting-thrusting and twirling manipulations in Chinese Acupuncture is designed. The digital signal processor( DSP) of TMS320 F28335 is used as the core controller to control the rotation of servo motor;so as to drive the robot hand to complete the acupuncture operation. The Lab VIEW upper PC is used to build the control interface. The main parameters of acupuncture operation are quantified and set by upper PC softwace. The robot hand can perform acupuncture operation accurately according to the action mode and parameters set by PC. The acupuncture manipulation of twirling reinforcing and reducing;and lifting-thrusting reinforcing and reducing are simulated and quantified.

title: A Design and Roalization of Marine Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: It is necessary to monitor the ecological environment dynamically for developing and utilizing Marine resources reasonably. A Marine monitoring system based on Internet of Thing was designed and realized. Hardware included the transmission module based on CC2530 and sensing module. The software realized remote sensor data collectionby Socket and local sensor data collection by node. js. The management and display platform are developed by Web technology to realize realtime display and queryof marine monitoring data through PC and mobile terminals.

title: The Design of Warehouse Environment Detecting System Based on Zigbee
abstract: Nowadays;the environmental detect ways of warehouses are inefficiencythey can’t achieve real-time data acquisition in all directions.These designs are lack of the overall importance and effectiveness.Based on CC2530 chip hardware platform;nodes in warehouse are connected to a network by Zigbee technology;a warehouse environment detecting system is developed by VC++6.0.In the system;the smoke sensors are used to detect gas concertation;temperature and humidity sensors are adopt to gather temperature and humidity;human infrared sensors are employed to detect whether illegal personnel entered.The gathered information is transmitted to host.When gathered data are not in the threshold range;the main control interface emits instruction;the alarm is triggered to alert and responding devices are controlled to deal abnormal.The system implements warehouse environment monitoring and danger deal.By the system;the hidden environment danger is reduced effectively;the management of the warehouse is more convenient;the interests of the business are protected;and certain labor costs are saved.

title: 基于STM32的无线病房呼叫管理系统的设计
abstract: A wireless ward call system is designed aimed at the shortcomings of the traditional wired call system;. The system is mainly controlled by STM32 F103 as the core. The system is divided into two parts: the receiving host and the calling extension. The Zigbee wireless transceiver module CC2530 is used for networking to realize communication between the host and the extension. The patient calls from the extension; transmits the call to the host computer via wireless network; and displays the number of the calling bed through the LCD screen; thus enabling the doctor to quickly rescue the patients in need.
abstract_in_chinese: 本设计是针对传统有线呼叫系统所存在的各种不足而设计的一个无线病房呼叫系统;其主要以单片机STM32F103为核心进行控制;系统分为接收主机和呼叫分机两大部分;使用Zigbee无线收发模块CC2530进行组网;实现主机和分机之间的通讯。病人通过从机进行呼叫;通过无线网传给主机;并通过液晶显示屏可以显示出呼叫的病床号;从而使医生可以快速地救助有需要的病人。

title: Wireless Data Acquisition and Control System Based on ZigBee and WiFi Technology
abstract: Being aimed at the data acquisition and remote control of equipment status in industry;combining with the advantages of ZigBee technology and WiFi technology;based on processor CC2530 chip and ESP8266 chip;a scheme of wireless data acquisition and control system based on ZigBee technology and WiFi technology is proposed. Firstly;this scheme improves the single traditional data acquisition method;and realizes the real-time multi-channel data acquisition secondly;it adopts WiFi communication mode;and the computer host or the mobile phone client can monitor the operation data of equipment finally the receiving terminal sets a control button;which can realize the remote control of the device state. The research results show that the data collecting by this system is correct;reliable;real-time and can achieve remote control accurately.

abstract: 针对智能健身装置功能的固定性和单一性;而设计出通过手机实现社交、提供健身方案、纠正健身动作的智能健身装置。该装置以STM32F103为主控芯片;利用zigbee模块和传感器搭建无线传感网;通过温湿度、酸碱度强度、动作传感器实时获取用户身体数据;将数据上传至移动终端设备上并且进行处理;用户根据处理结果进行运动;保证健身的高效性。智能健身装置的专家系统根据用户个体状态;为用户提供专业的健身方案;根据用户的健身情况;增加人机互动的趣味性。

title: 基于Zigbee的温湿度数据采集与组网设计
abstract: 温湿度测量在生产生活中应用广泛;随着工业生产技术的进步;对测量的要求也越来越高。但是;有线检测系统有很大的局限性;主要体现在布线困难、传输距离受限、成本高和实行性差等方面。本设计基于Zigbee无线通信技术设计温湿度数据采集系统;可以有效克服传统测量方式的弊端;各网络节点具有功耗低、布线简单、成本低的特点;可克服检测环境的限制;实现低成本无人连续在线监测。本系统是由DHT11温湿度传感器节点采集温湿度信息;然后通过Zigbee组网技术传输到协调器;上位机程序从串口读取数据显示并作出曲线图。

title: 基于LabVIEW体感输入设备光标控制算法研究
abstract: 技术的改革和创新使得传统的输入设备很难适应消费者的需求。针对传统有线输入设备功能单一、价格昂贵、场地局限等缺点;本文提出了在虚拟仪器LabVIEW操作系统上利用MEMS惯性传感器和CC2540蓝牙控制芯片实现无线光标定位的控制算法。算法采用倾角分级控制思想实现光标的位移和速度控制。经软硬件联合调试数据分析;算法能够平滑的模拟传统鼠标的定位控制功能。测试显示;系统在5m范围内仍保持125Hz报告率;无数据丢失。

title: Dark Field Image Real Time Processing System Based on TMS320C6748
abstract: Based on floating point DSP（TMS320 C6748）processor;we design a dark field image processing system in real time;with discussing the theory and the design method and providing the implementation of the system.On this basis;we make experiments of dark field images acquisition and analysis on gold nanospheres.Stepper motor controls the optical grating rotation of dark field;matching the successive acquisition of dark-field images;Simultaneously;CMOS camera acquires the images;which to be processed by DSP;and then we get the scattering spectra of sample.The experiments show that scattering spectra of gold nanospheres consists with the actual spectral properties of gold nanospheres and the functions and properties of the system reach the expectations.The image processing system accomplishes the real-time processing feature of dark field image;which has great application value on detection of early Tumor;heavy metals;chemical and biological and other fields.

title: Design of An Wireless Temperature Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to solve the problems of inflexibility and high cost of wired temperature monitoring systems in complex environment; a wireless temperature monitoring system based on ZigBee is designed; in which CC2530 of TI company is selected as the core chip of the wireless communication network; DS18B20 as the temperature acquisition module; and the collected temperature data is upload to the upper computer through serial communication. Network networking is realized through software design of coordinators and terminals in the system. The upper computer receives the temperature data in real time; processes the temperature data through the software program; displays the temperature in real time and then realizes the temperature monitoring. The experiments show that the system has the advantages of fast networking; strong real-time and easy to develop; and provides valuable reference for the application and expansion of temperature monitoring based on wireless sensor networks.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了解决在复杂环境下有线温度监测不灵活、成本高的缺点;设计了一套基于ZigBee的无线温度监测系统。系统选取TI公司的CC2530作为系统无线通信网络的核心芯片;温度采集模块采用传感器DS18B20测量温度数据;通过串口通信把采集的温度数据上传到上位机。通过系统中协调器和终端的软件设计实现网络组网。上位机实时接收温度数据;通过软件程序处理温度数据;将温度实时显示出来;实现温度监测。通过实验表明;该系统具有组网迅速、实时性强和易于开发等优点;为基于无线传感网络的温度监测应用和扩展提供了有价值的参考。

title: Application of ZigBee Wireless Network in Fishpond Water Quality Monitoring
abstract: Fishpond water quality is closely related to fish growth and reproduction;especially pH;dissolved oxygen and ammonia nitrogen concentration. In view of the shortcomings of the traditional fish pond water environment detection methods;such as high cost;poor real-time;and difficult information management;a real-time monitoring system for fishpond water quality based on ZigBee technology was designed. The system used the ZigBee protocol;GPRS wireless communication;and the Internet to establish a short-distance communication network. The CC2530 module is used as the core of wireless information processing. The pH value detection circuit and the dissolved oxygen detection circuit are designed. The system has realized the design of system parameters;wireless network;data acquisition and transmission;and remote host computer monitoring system. The test of packet loss rate and communication distance shows that the system can meet the real-time monitoring of fishpond water quality. Meanwhile;adaptive weighting algorithm is applied to test data;which enhances the reliability and accuracy of the test results.
abstract_in_chinese: 鱼塘水质与鱼类生长繁殖密切相关;尤其是pH值、溶氧量、氨氮浓度。针对目前传统鱼塘水环境检测方法普遍存在成本高、实时性差、不易信息化管理等不足;设计了基于ZigBee技术的鱼塘水质实时监测系统。该系统综合利用ZigBee协议、GPRS无线通信、Internet组建近距离通信网络;以CC2530模块作为无线信息处理核心;设计了pH值检测电路、溶氧检测电路等实现了系统参数设置、无线网组建;数据的采集和传输;远程上位机监控系统的设计。通过对系统丢包率和通信距离的测试表明;系统能满足鱼塘水质监测的实时性。同时对测试数据进行自适应加权融合算法处理;增强了测试结果的可靠性和准确性。

title: A design of portable fetal monitoring system based on wireless Bluetooth technique
abstract: Objective: To design and realize a portable fetal heart data acquisition system based on wireless Bluetooth technique so as to resolve the disadvantages of traditional monitoring equipment of fetal heart: bulky; difficult to carry; complex operation and so on. Methods: The data communication module of low-power dissipation Bluetooth 4(BLE4.0) chip CC2540 was embedded in the ultrasonic Doppler probe and the pressure sensor for uterine contractile. And then the detected fetal heart signals and the pressure signals of uterine contractions were transmitted through wireless Bluetooth network after they were processed by analog-digital conversion(ADC); autocorrelation algorithm and so on. Results: The real-time monitoring for fetal heart data could be realized after mobile monitoring devices were connected with wireless Bluetooth networks. Conclusion: The design of portable fetal monitoring system based on wireless Bluetooth technique has some characteristics included small size; low power dissipation; easy to carry; easy to operate and so on. And it has great significance in the development direction of mobile medical technique in the domain of perinatal medicine.

title: Design of Vehicle Power Supply Monitoring System Based on μC/OS-Ⅱ and LabVIEW
abstract: In order to remotely manage the power supply in the cab;realize the power supply output on-off and regulation control;as well as the monitoring of the power supply working state;a vehicle power supply monitoring system was designed based on distributed management.The monitoring system with the TMS320 LF2407 A as the carrier;using the multi-task real time of μC/OS-Ⅱ operating system;combined with the design of Lab VIEW monitoring platform;the distributed management of vehicle power supply was realized.

title: 数字信号处理大气中子单粒子效应(SEE)试验研究
abstract: In this paper;the testing method of Single Event Effects(SEE) experiment to 4 types of commonly uesd DSP was studied;including the radiation condition;experiment environment;equipment install and monitoring methods;etc. The database of the experiment was also data processed and analyzed. The experiment result is that TMS320 C6416 TBGLZA8 DSP SEU cross-section is 1.91 e-7 cm2/device;at 12000 m altitude;SEU rate is 1.15 e-03 n/device · hTMS320 C6418 ZTSA500 DSP SEU cross-section is 6.62 e-7 cm2/device;at 12000 m altitude;SEU rate is 3.97 e-03 n/(device · h)TMS320 F2812 DSP SEU cross-section is 8.82 e-9 cm2/device;at 12000 m altitude;SEU rate is 5.29 e-05 n/(device · h)SM32 C6415 EGLZ50 SEP DSP SEU cross-section is 1.62 e-7 cm2/device;at 12000 m altitude;SEU rate is 09.69 e-4 n/(device · h).
abstract_in_chinese: 本文针对4型航空常用的数字信号处理(DSP)进行了大气中子单粒子效应试验;对辐照条件、试验环境、试验件安装及监测方法进行研究;并对试验结果进行了数据处理及分析。试验结果表明;该4型DSP在14Me V中子辐射下均发生了单粒子翻转(SEU是单粒子效应中的一种模式);TMS320C6416TBGLZA8、TMS320C6418ZTSA500、TMS320F2812及SM32C6415EGLZ50SEP的单粒子翻转截面分别为1.91e-7cm2/device、6.62e-7cm2/device、8.82e-9cm2/device及1.62e-7cm2/device;在12000m处的飞行高度下;器件发生的单位翻转率分别为1.15e-03n/(device·h)、3.97e-03n/(device·h)、5.29e-05n/(device·h)、及9.69e-04n/(device·h)。
keywords: atmospheric neutron, cross section, dsp, seu, seu rate
affiliations: AVIC The First Aircraft Institute, 航空工业第一飞机设计研究院

title: ZigBee在货场货物拣择系统中的应用
abstract: As for railway freight;goods are mostly transported by containers;these containers need to be selected before they are loaded from a large number of containers in a large yard.If it rely on manual selection;it can spend more time;cause much errors and reduce efficiency.To improve efficiency;save manpower and save time;the paper designs a cargo picking system based on ZigBee.In this paper;the principle;network;protocol stack and hardware modules of ZigBee are studied.Terminal node and coordinator node based on CC2530 and CC2591 are designed.Terminal node is installed on container and coordinator node is connected to upper computer which realizes the communication between terminal node and PC.Via efficient network protocol;ZigBee network can be a wireless multihop network;which can increase the distance of wireless communication.Finally;the containers which are selected can send out sound and light signal.Several reliability experiments have been conducted and prove that the system is practicable.
abstract_in_chinese: 在铁路货运中货物多以集装箱方式运输;在装载需运输的目标集装箱之前;需要从货物众多、面积较大的货场中拣择出目标集装箱;若依赖于人工拣择;则效率低下、耗时较多、易出错;为提高作业效率、节省人力和时间;设计了一种基于ZigBee的货场货物拣择系统。通过研究ZigBee的原理、组网方式、协议栈、硬件模块设计等;设计了基于CC2530和CC2591的终端节点和协调器节点;终端节点安装在集装箱上;协调器节点和上位机连接;负责终端节点和PC机的通信;并通过上位机控制通信过程;利用ZigBee的多跳自组网特性;实现信息的多跳远距离传输;使目标集装箱上终端节点发出声光提示;工作人员依据声光提示便可迅速、准确地定位目标位置;拣择出目标集装箱;经多次可靠性试验;证明了系统的可行性。
keywords: cc2530, coordinator node, terminal node, upper computer software, zigbee
affiliations: 北京交通大学电气工程学院, School of Electrical Engineering, Beijing Jiaotong University

title: T型三电平并网逆变器的设计与实现
abstract: A T-type three-level grid-connected inverter is designed with DSP chip TMS320 F28335 as the control core. The article explains double closed loop control strategy based of PI voltage outer loop and PR current inner loop; and details the main circuit system and control system components selection and design options.According to the grid experiment results;the output current of the inverter is stable and its phase is symmetrical;the harmonic distortion is low; which meets the requirements of power quality required by inverter grid connection and proves the rationality of the inverter design parameters and the feasibility of the control scheme.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文以DSP芯片TMS320F28035为控制核心设计了一台T型三电平并网逆变器;对逆变器基于PI电压外环和PR电流内环的双闭环控制进行说明;并详细介绍了主电路系统和控制系统的元器件选型与设计方案。并网实验结果表明;该逆变器输出电流稳定且相位对称;谐波失真度低;满足逆变器并网所需达到的电能质量要求;证明了逆变器设计参数的合理性与控制方案的可行性。
keywords: dsp, grid-connected inverter, pr controller, t-type three-level
affiliations: School of Automation, 南京工程学院自动化学院, School of Electric Engineering, Nanjing Institute of Technology, 南京工程学院电力工程学院

title: 应用DSP技术实现焊接电弧弧长跟踪及控制
abstract: This system is based on the TMS320 f28335 chip. The welding voltage and current values are acquired in the whole welding process by the AD function;and are handled by some specific tracking algorithms. After then the PWM signal is output to control and track the motor action. At the same time;this system exchanges data with the PLC and teaching device by the SCI function. Finally;the arc length tracking and effective control are realized in the conditions of the high welding speed or high impulse frequency. The developed tracker can track and control the arc lengths of various welding without adding a specified extension module. The actual welding proves that the effects of the arc length tracking and control are good;and the expected welding target is achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 系统以TMS320F28335芯片为核心;通过其内部AD功能;检测焊接过程中的电压及电流值;经过特定跟踪算法处理后输出PWM信号控制跟踪电机动作;通过SCI功能与PLC和示教器实现数据交换;最终实现高速(指焊接速度)或高频(指脉冲频率)下的弧长跟踪及有效控制。研发的跟踪器针对不同焊接类型;无需添加指定扩展模块;即可实现多种焊接类型的弧长跟踪及控制。通过实际焊接证明;弧长跟踪及控制效果良好;达到预期的焊接效果。
keywords: arc length tracking, high impulse frequency, high welding speed, tms320f28335
affiliations: 唐山工业职业技术学院, Tangshan Sanyou Group Yuanda Chemical Fibre Co., 唐山三友远达纤维有限公司, Tangshan Polytechnic College

title: 基于无线蓝牙技术的便携式胎儿监护系统设计
abstract: Objective: To design and realize a portable fetal heart data acquisition system based on wireless Bluetooth technique so as to resolve the disadvantages of traditional monitoring equipment of fetal heart: bulky; difficult to carry; complex operation and so on. Methods: The data communication module of low-power dissipation Bluetooth 4(BLE4.0) chip CC2540 was embedded in the ultrasonic Doppler probe and the pressure sensor for uterine contractile. And then the detected fetal heart signals and the pressure signals of uterine contractions were transmitted through wireless Bluetooth network after they were processed by analog-digital conversion(ADC); autocorrelation algorithm and so on. Results: The real-time monitoring for fetal heart data could be realized after mobile monitoring devices were connected with wireless Bluetooth networks. Conclusion: The design of portable fetal monitoring system based on wireless Bluetooth technique has some characteristics included small size; low power dissipation; easy to carry; easy to operate and so on. And it has great significance in the development direction of mobile medical technique in the domain of perinatal medicine.

title: 基于TMS320C6748的暗场图像实时处理系统
abstract: Based on floating point DSP(TMS320 C6748)processor;we design a dark field image processing system in real time;with discussing the theory and the design method and providing the implementation of the system.On this basis;we make experiments of dark field images acquisition and analysis on gold nanospheres.Stepper motor controls the optical grating rotation of dark field;matching the successive acquisition of dark-field imagesSimultaneously;CMOS camera acquires the images;which to be processed by DSP;and then we get the scattering spectra of sample.The experiments show that scattering spectra of gold nanospheres consists with the actual spectral properties of gold nanospheres and the functions and properties of the system reach the expectations.The image processing system accomplishes the real-time processing feature of dark field image;which has great application value on detection of early Tumor;heavy metals;chemical and biological and other fields.
abstract_in_chinese: 以浮点型DSP(TMS320C6748)处理器为核心;设计了一种暗场图像实时处理系统;探讨了系统的原理和设计方法;给出了系统的实现方案;并进行了金纳米球暗场图像的采集与分析实验.系统通过步进电机控制暗场系统分光光栅转动;匹配暗场图像的连续采集同时;通过CMOS摄像头完成图像采集;并由DSP进行图像处理;得到待测样品散射光谱图.实验表明;金纳米球散射的实测与理论光谱特性基本吻合;检测精度达到了预期要求.该图像处理系统实现了对暗场图像的实时处理;在肿瘤早期诊疗、重金属检测、生化实时检测等领域具有重要的应用价值.
keywords: dark field image, dsp(tms320c6748), real time processing, scattering spectra

title: 基于IoT的多功能睡眠监测系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 为了帮助人们更好地了解自己的睡眠情况;文中设计了一款基于物联网的多功能睡眠监测系统来实时监测个人的睡眠质量。该系统以传感器网络为基础;通过无线模块进行数据传输;并通过终端显示。相比较传统的睡眠监测设备;该设备能够有效解决睡眠监测仪器的医用化及可穿戴监测设备的约束性等问题。实验结果表明;该系统具有操作方便、节能、体积小、响应速度快等特点;具有一定的推广应用价值。

title: 基于TMS320F28335的脊柱康复控制系统
abstract: This study developed a spine rehabilitation training control system based on crawling movements. The system includes a crawling mechanism; a motor control circuit; and control software. Through 6 motors; the training equipment is provided with the power needed for different training. The embedded systems adopts TMS320 F28335 as the control core; and the QT is used to design the software to realize the synchronization; alternating and corrective training of crawling training. The experimental results in this paper show that the motion control system has good reliability and meets the needs of repeated rehabilitation training for patients with spinal diseases.
abstract_in_chinese: 本研究开发了一种基于爬行运动的脊柱康复训练控制系统;该系统包括爬行机构;电机控制电路及控制软件等。通过6个电机为训练设备的不同训练需要提供动力;下位机采用TMS320F28335为控制核心;使用QT设计上位机用户端;实现了爬行训练的同步;交替和矫正训练。本文实验结果表明;该运动控制系统可靠性良好;满足脊柱疾病患者重复性康复训练的需求。
keywords: control system, qt, spinal rehabilitation, tms320f28335

title: Design on Home Environment Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: According to the characteristics of the family network and the requirements of the indoor environment monitoring; the home terminal monitoring system based on ZigBee2006 protocol stack is developed by using CC2530 chip; SHT11 temperature and humidity sensor; and MQ-2 gas sensor; etc. The ZigBee technology in wireless sensor network has such characteristics as low power consumption; low cost; low complexity; etc. The system uses terminal node to upload the collected data to the coordinator; and then the data is sent to the PC by the coordinator. The PC can display in real time the environmental data and users can observe them. The experimental results show that ZigBee technology can reduce the system complexity and cost; and control the regional terminal flexibly.
keywords: cc2530, monitoring system, sensor, wireless sensor network
authors: LIU Wenjuan;ZHU Liucun;XIA Jianqi;LI Ming;Yangzhou University;LI Hongbo

title: 基于物联网的温湿度采集系统
abstract: 本设计主要是通过对无线传感网络的介绍;搭建了一个基于物联网的温湿度采集系统;该系统主要用的模块有CC2530模块、OLED模块、DHT11温湿度传感器模块、MQ-2烟雾传感器模块等;在系统中实现两个终端节点（通过修改程序可增加节点数）将传感器测得的数据传给协调器;由协调器将接收到的数据通过OLED显示;还可通过串口在PC端上位机显示;当测得终端的温度超过一定的数值时;继电器吸合;可应用于控温系统。

title: 基于ARM的诱虫灯远程控制软件的设计与实现
abstract: 农作物在生长过程中;会遇到很多虫害的问题;诱虫灯装置是一种有效的病虫害绿色防控技术。本文以基于ARM平台;利用RaspberryPi设备设计和开发了一个诱虫灯远程控制软件;主要内容如下:（1）基于CC2530芯片的远程无线传输技术;（2）基于Python和SQLite程序设计技术。本文所设计的软件原型系统已经在苏州农业职业技术学院、太仓璜泾现代农业园区和吴江同里现代农业园区得到应用。

abstract: 本文介绍的新型电源控制器以STM32为控制芯片;CC3200的SimpleLink WiFi作为联网方案;使用ADC锰铜采样电阻分析电压、电流、有功功率等参数。通过手机APP、云端网页等方式智能控制;可实现远程控制和定时控制用电器通断。控制器自带USB充电插口、提供实时时钟、定时预约等功能。当出现过压、过载等危险情况时;系统自动识别控制断开电源。

title: 危险气体泄漏源搜寻多机器人系统的设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 危险气体泄漏源搜寻是仿生嗅觉技术的重要应用领域之一。为了提高气体泄露源定位的效率和准确性;设计并实现了一种基于无线传感器网络的气源目标搜寻多机器人系统。该系统由多个嗅觉机器人组成;每个机器人作为无线传感器网络节点实现信息交换;协同工作;实现危险气体泄漏源的定位。嗅觉机器人以DSP处理器(TMS320F28335)为控制核心;对MOS气体传感器和风速传感器的输出信号进行融合;设计了浓度梯度与风速信息相结合的单一气体泄漏源搜寻算法。当嗅觉机器人完成气源定位时将发出警报;其他机器人利用装配的麦克风阵列和声源定位算法实现对泄漏源的间接定位。最后;为了说明所设计的多机器人系统对气体泄露源定位的有效性和准确性;本文设计了针对单一泄露源的气源搜寻实验进行验证。

title: The Design of Vehicle Intelligent Power-Controller Based on Tms320f28335
abstract: In this paper a vehicle intelligent power controller was designed for power switching;exception protection and output controlling. Using TMS320 F28335(Texas Instruments) as main processor;the real-time collection of voltage;current and leakage current was accurately calculated and the power-controller realizes main-circuit exception protection.By designing of IP interface;it can communicate with PDU and control the power switch of each device.

title: Z-Stack协议栈的按键驱动机制分析
abstract: In the paper;the principle of common keys and Joystick key driver in Z-Stack protocol stack are introduced;including keys trigger events;ADC;keys callback-handler and the keys processing in application layer.The process is simple summarized up.Finally;the key interrupt in Z-Stack protocol stack should be paid attention to is proposed.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文介绍了Z-Stack协议栈中普通按键和Joystick按键驱动的原理;包括按键触发事件、ADC处理键值、按键回调处理以及应用层按键处理的总过程;并对该过程进行了简单梳理和总结;最后提出了Z-Stack协议栈中按键中断需要注意的地方。

title: 基于电子稳像的嵌入式行人检测系统
abstract: A new pedestrian detection algorithm based on digital signal processor( DSP) embedded platform based on electronic image stabilization processing is designed. The smoothing feature trajectory method is used to deal with the electronic image stabilization processing on input video. The Sobel edge operator is used to extract the image of the head and shoulder edge of the human body. According to the improved Hausdorff similarity measurement principle;a pedestrian target detection algorithm based on improved Hausdorff distance headshoulder edge template matching is proposed. The pedestrian target is tracked by Kalman filtering algorithm in realtime. The actual road test results show that pedestrian detection algorithm based on improved Hausdorff distance head-shoulder edge template matching designed and implemented on the TMS320 DM8168 embedded platform can achieve real-time detection and real-time tracking for pedestrians;detection rate of 95 %;the detection speed is 9 frames per second;and error detection rate of 4 % can be achieved;it can meet the demand for actual use.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计并实现了一种基于电子稳像处理的数字信号处理器(DSP)嵌入式平台的行人检测算法:采用平滑特征轨迹法对输入视频进行电子稳像处理采用sobel边缘算子提取人体的头肩边缘图像;根据改进Hausdorff相似性度量原理;提出了基于改进Hausdorff距离头、肩边缘模板匹配的行人目标检测算法通过卡尔曼滤波算法对行人目标进行实时跟踪。实际路口测试结果表明:在TMS320DM8168嵌入式平台上设计与实现的基于改进Hausdorff距离头肩边缘模板匹配的行人检测算法可以对行人实现实时检测和实时跟踪;结合电子稳像算法;可以达到95%的检测率、9帧/s的检测速度;而误检率为4%;能够满足实际使用需求。
keywords: electronic image stabilization, improved hausdorff distance, pedestrian detection, tms320dm8168

title: 基于图像处理的电路板表观快速检测系统的研究
abstract: The design scheme of circuit board wiring detection using digital image processing method is introduced;which uses TMS320 C6748 DSP as the main control CPU;realizes the control of the camera and step motor;completes the image processing algorithm;and realizes the human and machine interaction on the touch screen through the communication between DSP and ARM.At the same time;the scheme of further optimization is briefly proposed;and a circuit board detection scheme based on digital image processing in a more ideal environment is determined.

title: 基于ZigBee的家居环境监测系统设计
abstract: According to the characteristics of the family network and the requirements of the indoor environment monitoring; the home terminal monitoring system based on ZigBee2006 protocol stack is developed by using CC2530 chip; SHT11 temperature and humidity sensor; and MQ-2 gas sensor; etc. The ZigBee technology in wireless sensor network has such characteristics as low power consumption; low cost; low complexity; etc. The system uses terminal node to upload the collected data to the coordinator; and then the data is sent to the PC by the coordinator. The PC can display in real time the environmental data and users can observe them. The experimental results show that ZigBee technology can reduce the system complexity and cost; and control the regional terminal flexibly.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对家庭网络的特点以及室内环境监测的要求;系统利用无线传感网络中ZigBee技术的低功耗、低成本和低复杂度等特点;用CC2530芯片、SHT11温湿度传感器及MQ-2气体传感器等节点;在ZigBee2006协议栈的基础上开发出家居终端监测系统。系统利用终端节点将采集的数据上传至协调器;协调器将数据发送到上位机;上位机可实时显示环境数据供用户观察。实验表明;利用ZigBee技术可降低系统复杂度并节约成本;实现对终端的区域化灵活控制。

title: 基于TDOA测距的室内定位系统方案设计
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种基于TDOA测距的单体部署的定位系统设计方案。系统由定位伞和接收标签两部分构成;定位伞以Atmega128L为核心控制器;以CC2530为无线射频通讯。接收标签附着在目标体上;最终完成对目标的监控。此系统能广泛用在室内定位、导航中;为物联网、智能家居、移动机器人等领域服务。
