title: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Chicken House Environment Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: This paper constructed the ZigBee wireless sensor network with CC2530 chip as the core; and set up a real-time monitoring system based on Internet environment which realized the regional environmental parameters on-line monitoring; timely grasped the environmental conditions and poor control environment. This system consisted of the environmental regulation subsystem of application layer; the data analysis subsystem of control layer; and the environmental monitoring subsystem of sensing layer. The application layer couldvisually view the regional environment parameters and operate the environment control module through APP platform. The control layer could receive and send data with the gathering node; and also decide whether or not to carry out environmental adjustment operation according to the parameters threshold. The sensing layer realized data acquisition in real time through sensor devices; and controlled the environment automatically through the control device. The system had the advantages of simple construction; simple maintenance; operation and low cost; which was easier to promote.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, internet of things, zigbee
affiliations: College of Information Science and Engineering, Shanxi Agricultural University

title: Forest fire detection system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: To deal with high false alarm rate and difficult position problems of the traditional forest fire detection;an unmanned aerial vehicle was taken as the platform;cradle head tracking system carried with color and infrared camera to realize the automatic detection;identification and location of forest fire was put forward.The embedded platform was based on DM3730;the recognition of the flame was realized by getting the real-time infrared camera image processing;and cradle head dynamic tracing was driven.Combined with airborne GPS/IMU navigation information and track cradle head posture information;accurate fire positioning was completed.The color image obtained was returned to ground in real-time to realize monitoring fire on-line.In the field of flame recognition algorithm;BP neural network was used to train and identify.The effectiveness of BP neural network algorithm is verified by comparing with SVM recognition algorithm.In the field of positioning;the validity of the calculation method is verified by comparing the calculated latitude and longitude of the fire field with the actual latitude and longitude in the actual flight.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决传统森林火灾检测误报率较高和定位难的问题;提出一种以无人机作为平台;搭载带有彩色和红外摄像头的云台跟踪系统;实现森林火灾的自动探测、识别和定位。该嵌入式平台以DM3730为核心;通过对实时获取的红外图像进行处理实现对火焰的识别;驱动云台动态跟踪结合机载GPS/IMU导航信息及跟踪云台的姿态信息;完成精确的火场定位将获取的彩色图像实时回传地面;实现对火场的在线监测。在火焰识别算法方面;利用BP神经网络进行训练和识别。通过与SVM识别算法进行对比;验证了BP神经网络算法的有效性。定位方面;在实际的飞行中通过对比计算出的火场经纬度与实际经纬度;验证了计算方法的有效性。
keywords: bp neural network, embedded, fire positioning, flame recognition, svm algorithm

title: Design of Intelligent Voice Control Car
abstract: In order to improve the precision of the intelligent voice car control;non-specific human speech recognition ship LD3320 is used as voice recognition module;and STC11L08 is used as main control MCU. The SPI communication protocol is adopted for exchanging data between speech recognition chip and MCU control. The main control MCU is responsible for processing the results of identification form car control instruction. And CC1101 is used to send commands to the control panel on the car movement wireless receiving chip. After receiving the car control command from the control panel;the motor is controlled by the motor drive circuit according to the command;so as to achieve the purpose of controlling the car movement by voice. The actual test shows that the car responds quickly to the voice command recognition;and the recognition accuracy is high.
abstract_in_chinese: 采用LD3320非特定人声语音识别芯片以及STC11L08作为主控MCU设计智能声控小车。语音识别芯片和主控MCU之间采用SPI通信协议交换数据传递识别结果。主控MCU识别语音并形成小车控制指令;经由无线传输控制芯片发送至运动控制板上;通过控制电机达到控制小车运动的目的。测试表明;小车对语音指令识别的响应速度快、识别精度高。
keywords: intelligent car, speech recognition, voice control, wireless control

title: Implementation of manhole cover detection system based on multi feature fusion
abstract: Obstacle detection; as an important part of intelligent auxiliary driving; has received extensive attention. Among them;manhole cover detection plays an irreplaceable role in subsequent manhole cover location and defect detection. This paper starts from a macro perspective; and proposes a classification method of multi feature fusion. It sets trapezoidal region as the region of interest with prior knowledge; locks candidate region through the connectivity of edge; and extracts well cover position from the background through multi feature decision quickly and accurately. The method is implemented on the TMS320 DM6437 platform; and the feasibility of the scheme is verified.
abstract_in_chinese: 障碍物检测作为智能辅助驾驶的重要一环;得到了广泛关注和研究;其中;井盖的检测对后续的井盖定位和缺损检测有着不可替代的作用。从宏观特征入手;提出一种多特征融合的分类方法;首先利用先验知识划定梯形区域限制搜索区间;进而通过边缘的连通性锁定候选区域;并通过多特征判定;快速准确地从背景中提取出井盖位置。该方法在TMS320DM6437平台上进行了系统实现;验证了方案的可行性。
keywords: connectivity, macro perspective, multi feature fusion, tms320dm6437, trapezoidal region

title: Systematic design of real-time measuring and reliable transmission for body motion data
abstract: Real-time measuring of multiple motion data is the key issue for motion detection and health monitoring.This paper designs a motion capture system based on CC2530 SOC of TI;including a reliable wireless transmission protocol.It consists of multiple inertial sensors;a sink node;and PC.The sink node and sensor nodes form a star wireless networks;techniques of time-division multiple-access;loss packet detection and re-transmission are used to obtain the reliable transmission.The experimental results show our proposed system is portable;reliable and high-throughput.It can robustly acquire and transmit data from multi nodes in real-time.The system will contribute to the real-time monitoring of physiological parameters as well as motion recognition in human beings.
abstract_in_chinese: 实时测量多点运动数据是运动识别、健康监测等的核心问题;基于德州仪器(TI)公司CC2530片上系统设计了一套运动数据采集系统;并提出一种可靠的无线传输协议。系统由多个惯性传感器节点、汇聚节点及上位机组成。汇聚节点与惯性传感器节点组成星型无线网络;并基于时分多址复用(TDMA)技术通过漏包检测及重传实现可靠传输。实验结果表明;系统具有便携、高吞吐率、传输可靠性高的特点;能够稳定实现多个节点的实时数据采集传输;从而为人体的生理参数实时监测及运动识别提供保障。

title: Application of PIRC in harmonic suppression for electric vehicle charger
abstract: For the less effectiveness of conventional harmonic suppression methods in PWM rectifier charger networkside current;this paper proposes the proportional integral repetitive control(PIRC)scheme.At the basis of establishing the mathematical model and analyzing the harmonic characteristics;the problems of conventional PI control is discussed;then the PIRC controller is designed.And the simulation model of single-phase PWM rectifier charger is set up by MATLAB/Simulink;PIRC and PI control is simulated and analyzed respectively;then the two control schemes are verified experimentally on the experiment equipment with TMS320 F2812 controller.The results show that comparing with conventional PI control when the repetitive control gain is Krc=0.3;the THD for network-side current of the charger decreased from 7.43% to 2.79% by using the PIRC scheme.And the validity of PIRC control to suppress the odd-harmonics current in the charger network-side is verified.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对PWM整流充电机网侧电流谐波抑制方法控制效果不理想的问题;提出复合重复控制(PIRC)策略。在建立PWM整流充电机数学模型和分析谐波特性的基础上;分析了传统PI控制存在的问题;根据模型;设计了PIRC复合重复控制器;并在MATLAB/Simulink环境下搭建单相PWM整流充电机仿真模型;分别对PIRC控制和PI控制进行了仿真分析;然后采用TMS320F2812作为控制器;在样机上对该两种控制方案进行了实验验证。仿真和实验结果表明采用PIRC方案当重复控制增益Krc=0.3时;充电机网侧电流THD从传统PI控制的7.43%下降到2.79%;验证了PIRC控制策略抑制充电机网侧电流中奇次谐波的有效性。
keywords: electric vehicle charger, harmonic suppression, pi control, pirc controller

title: Design of Multi Time Scale Control System for Micro arc Oxidation Power Supply
abstract: First;micro arc oxidation(MAO)power supply topology was established. Then;the equivalent electrical model of MAO load was studied;and the load model parameters of different stages were obtained;which could provide effective parameter support for MAO power supply design. Based on the small-signal model of Buck circuit;smallsignal model was built and the relevant transfer function was derived for the current and voltage control combined with PI control;the phase-shift full-bridge the converter corresponding compensation was designed. Finally;software was designed with TMS320 F2812 as the core to produce MAO power trigger pulse;simulation and experimental results verify the correctness and validity of the equivalent electrical model of the MAO load studied.

title: Vector control method of single-phase grid-connected converter with reactive power compensation
abstract: A new vector control method for the delay problem in traditional fictitious method of single-phase grid-connected converter in the condition of voltage signal variation is proposed. Based on the mathematical model of singlephase converter;a fictitious three-phase signal is created according to phasor relationship between the phase voltage and line voltage. The real-time performance is significantly improved;which is faster than the instantaneous voltage dq conversion method with 3. 33 ms delay and the αβ detection method with 5. 0 ms delay;respectively. Moreover;a single-phase converter control strategy with reactive power compensation is designed. The MATLAB/Simulink simulation verifies the correctness of the proposed method. And an experiment platform is built with the IGBT module F4-100 R12 KS4 and 32-bit DSP processor TMS320 F2812. The experimental results indicate that the system has real-time reactive power compensation function and excellent performance of dynamic and static response.

keywords: fictitious method, reactive power compensation, single-phase converter, vector control

title: Design of a Seismograph Aquisition System With Multi-position Machine
abstract: In order to improve the integration of the signal acquisition system of seismographs; the level of intelligence and the accuracy of signal acquisition; a multi-position machine Seismograph acquisition system is designed with the high-performance multi-channel ADS1256 conversion device as the core and high-performance processor STM32 F1 as the main controller. The host computer based on Lab VIEW programming is used to realize the human-computer interaction; and the signal transmission between the upper and lower units is realized through the Ethernet. The lower unit can serve multiple upper computers. The system can automatically set the range and sampling rate through the upper computer to achieve real-time adjustment of the sampling system’s range and sampling rate.

title: Research on solar street lamp control system based on Internet of things
abstract: A solar street lamp control system based on the Internet of things is designed to solve the problem that the data collected by the solar street lamp control system can not be shared in real time and the street lamp and street light cannot communicate with each other. The system uses the STM32 F103 as the main control chip; and the CC2530 chip of the 2.4 GHz is the microprocessor of the ZigBee communication circuit; and it is also controlled with the main control system. The chip communicates; realizes the communication between street lamps and street lamps; self-organizing network; real-time collection and uploading of data; and intelligent management of street lamps.

title: Research on Information Collection System for Growing Environment of Chinese Medicinal Materials Based on Internet of Things
abstract: In order to understand the growth environment information of Chinese herbal medicines in real time;a design scheme of collecting information on growth environment of Chinese herbal medicines based on the Internet of things was proposed. With CC2530 chip as the core;a Zig Bee network is constructed. The Custer-Tree routing algorithm is used to improve the routing search and transmission data function. The Kalman filtering algorithm is used to fuse the collected data. The system can realize the main environmental information affecting the growth of Chinese herbal medicines. Real time acquisition. It mainly solves the dynamic collection and data management of the growth environment of Chinese herbal medicines;and provides reference data for the regulation of the growth environment of Chinese herbal medicines.

title: 中子发生器及相关三路电源设计
abstract: In the field of measurement; the neutron generator with good stability is controlled by threeway power supply; i.e. memory power supply; ion power supply and accelerator power supply; which are necessary for the design of the neutron tube. In order to achieve the system design target; it is necessary to improve the stability of three-way power supply. TMS320 F28335 is treated as the main control CPU system to detect the output parameters of the three-way power supply; the accelerator control circuit is designed in the pulse neutron generator system; and the special cable module is connected with the neutron tube to form a closed-loop control of neutron yield. The circuit system is jointed with neutron tube after debug; showing that the neutron yield stability of the neutron generator is less than 5%.
abstract_in_chinese: 在测量领域;稳定性能较好的中子发生器受控于三路电源;即设计中子管工作所必需的三路电源——存储器电源、离子源电源和加速极电源。为达到系统设计指标;需要提高三路电源的稳定性。以TMS320F28335为主控CPU系统检测三路电源的输出参数;将加速极控制电路设计在脉冲中子发生器系统内部;应用专用电缆组件与中子管连接;形成中子产额闭环控制。调试完成的电路系统与中子管联调;监测得到中子发生器的中子产额稳定性小于5%。
keywords: accelerator power supply, closed-loop control, ion source, neutron generator, neutron yield

title: 基于多特征融合的井盖检测系统实现
abstract: Obstacle detection; as an important part of intelligent auxiliary driving; has received extensive attention. Among them;manhole cover detection plays an irreplaceable role in subsequent manhole cover location and defect detection. This paper starts from a macro perspective; and proposes a classification method of multi feature fusion. It sets trapezoidal region as the region of interest with prior knowledge; locks candidate region through the connectivity of edge; and extracts well cover position from the background through multi feature decision quickly and accurately. The method is implemented on the TMS320 DM6437 platform; and the feasibility of the scheme is verified.

title: 人体运动数据的实时采集及可靠传输系统设计
abstract: Real-time measuring of multiple motion data is the key issue for motion detection and health monitoring.This paper designs a motion capture system based on CC2530 SOC of TI;including a reliable wireless transmission protocol.It consists of multiple inertial sensors;a sink node;and PC.The sink node and sensor nodes form a star wireless networks;techniques of time-division multiple-access;loss packet detection and re-transmission are used to obtain the reliable transmission.The experimental results show our proposed system is portable;reliable and high-throughput.It can robustly acquire and transmit data from multi nodes in real-time.The system will contribute to the real-time monitoring of physiological parameters as well as motion recognition in human beings.
abstract_in_chinese: 实时测量多点运动数据是运动识别、健康监测等的核心问题;基于德州仪器(TI)公司CC2530片上系统设计了一套运动数据采集系统;并提出一种可靠的无线传输协议。系统由多个惯性传感器节点、汇聚节点及上位机组成。汇聚节点与惯性传感器节点组成星型无线网络;并基于时分多址复用(TDMA)技术通过漏包检测及重传实现可靠传输。实验结果表明;系统具有便携、高吞吐率、传输可靠性高的特点;能够稳定实现多个节点的实时数据采集传输;从而为人体的生理参数实时监测及运动识别提供保障。
keywords: cc2530, loss recovery, motion monitoring, multiple inertial sensors, reliable transmission, tdma

title: 无线自组网节点极低基础功耗方案的设计
abstract: Wireless ad hoc networks are faced with many extreme challenges in the field of civil metrology;where battery-powered nodes must be able to sustain for more than 10 years.Through the analysis of the existing open source IOT operating systems; this paper presents a very low basic power scheme design;which creates a soft timer in the kernel to control operating systems’ clocks;in order to reduce power consumption.The scheme shows that the average current of CC1310 node is no more than 2.4 uA during inactivity on contiki operating system;and the proposed scheme can be ported on different hardware platforms.
abstract_in_chinese: 无线自组网用于民用计量领域面临着许多极其苛刻的挑战;其中电池供电的节点必须能够维持10年以上的寿命。通过对现有的开源IOT操作系统分析;本文提出了一种极低基础功耗方案的设计;即在内核中创建一个软时钟;用于控制操作系统的时钟运行;以此降低功耗。该方案表明;CC1310节点在contiki上非活跃期间的平均电流不超过2.5uA;且可在不同的硬件平台上移植。
keywords: contiki, extreme low power, soft-timer, wireless ad-hoc networks

title: 脉冲信号参数测量仪的DSP设计
abstract: A pulse signal parameter measuring instrument was designed using TMS320 F2812 as the control core. The measured pulse signal was passed by the peak-value detector after resistive subdivision; then the amplitude of the pulse signal was obtained with TMS320 F2812 sample and processing of it. The pulse signal was measured by the comparator of the different threshold level. The comparison results were counted by TMS320 F2812; and the frequency of the pulse signal; duty ratio; the increase time and the decrease time were obtained. The plan of pulse signal parameter measuring instrument has the characteristics of low cost; high convenience and high precision.

title: 智能声控小车的设计研究
abstract: In order to improve the precision of the intelligent voice car control;non-specific human speech recognition ship LD3320 is used as voice recognition module;and STC11L08 is used as main control MCU. The SPI communication protocol is adopted for exchanging data between speech recognition chip and MCU control. The main control MCU is responsible for processing the results of identification form car control instruction. And CC1101 is used to send commands to the control panel on the car movement wireless receiving chip. After receiving the car control command from the control panel;the motor is controlled by the motor drive circuit according to the command;so as to achieve the purpose of controlling the car movement by voice. The actual test shows that the car responds quickly to the voice command recognition;and the recognition accuracy is high.

title: Asynchronous motor variable frequency governor controlled by space vector optimization algorithm
abstract: In this paper;with TMS320F28035 chip as the control core;a variable frequency governor of asynchronous motor is designed. The threephase asynchronous motor driven by the intelligent power module IPM is controlled by the output of three phase PWM wave.The use of space vector SVPWM algorithm;and carries on the optimization;using the method of detecting the back EMF;innovative reduced photoelectric encoder;and pioneering research automatic conversion algorithm based on adaptive adjustment of the operating environment;can make the equipment work in the complex environment;the product has a good practical application.Good prospects.

title: Research on Ultrasonic Doppler Flowmeter Based on TMS320C6748 and XC6SLX16
abstract: This paper introduces a method to measure the fluid flow in open channel by using the principle of ultrasonic Doppler;based on TMS320 C6748 + XC6 SLX16 low power hardware platform. An ultrasonic loop signal is assembled by a transmitter and a receiving sensor. Hardware circuit to achieve the signal emission;as well as receive reflected ultrasonic signal;data transmission and data processing;etc. In hardware circuit architecture;XC6 SLX16 is used to control the transmitting;receiving and collecting of signals. TMS320 C6748 mainly realizes the signal processing;obtains the received frequency shift information;thus obtains the speed information. Finally;the height information of the current water level is obtained through the pressure sensor;so that the cross-sectional area information is obtained and the flow is calculated.
abstract_in_chinese: 介绍了基于TMS320C6748和XC6SLX16低功耗硬件平台;利用超声多普勒原理实现对明渠流体流量的测量的方法。采用一个发射和一个接收的传感器组合成超声波回路信号。硬件电路实现信号的发射以及反射回来的超声信号的接收、数据的传输、数据的处理等。硬件电路架构中XC6SLX16用于信号的发射、接收和采集等控制。TMS320C6748主要实现信号的处理;从中获得接收到的信号频移量;从而获得速度信息。最后通过压力传感器获得的当前水位的高度信息;从而获得横截面积信息;并算出流量值。
keywords: doppler, flowmeter, ultrasound
affiliations: 南京思孚泰科信息技术有限公司
source: 水利科技与经济 ;Water Conservancy Science and Technology and Economy ; Editorial E-mail ;2018(05)

title: 浅析德仪OSAL工作原理
abstract_in_chinese: 美国德州仪器(Texas Instruments;简称:TI)的CC254X BLE解决方案、CC2530 Zig Bee解决方案是现行市面上使用最多;入门最简单的SOC芯片方案;而德州仪器所建立的OSAL(Operation System Abstraction Layer;操作系统抽象层)抽象出一个小的操作系统;使用户能够更加简单的处理各种事件;处理系统逻辑;把本来抽象的BLE解决方案与Zig Bee解决方案很好的融入到该操作系统中;降低学习与使用难度。文章浅析OSAL的工作原理;结合使用过程中的一些心得;愿各位读者能更容易入门。
affiliations: 广州市番禺奥莱照明电器有限公司

title: 飞行显示器数据采集处理单元设计与实现
abstract_in_chinese: 飞行显示器是现代载人飞行器航电系统的重要设备;接收载机其他设备、系统的信息;或发出控制信号;使飞行员及时获得飞机内外部各种信息;据此进行正确的驾驶操作;完成飞行任务。文章主要介绍了面对多设备、多系统的数据传输接口;飞行员显示器中数据采集处理单元的设计与实现。
affiliations: 航空工业西安航空计算技术研究所

title: 基于ZigBee室内定位技术的智能垃圾桶
abstract: The key point of design is to design a low cost and practical wireless sensor positioning system based on ZigBee;and to realize the intellectualization of garbage disposal by wireless positioning control car.Through in-depth analysis of the existing indoor positioning technology and its characteristics;this paper introduces the wireless indoor positioning test platform of hardware and positioning algorithm.By using a three-side method and a great approximation of the algorithm;the location information of the target node is calculated precisely.The hardware platform integrated the CC2530 F256 chip with the core of 51;and it has a target location test for the mobile avoidance vehicle.The results show that the positioning system has good positioning accuracy and extensibility.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种基于ZigBee的低成本且实用的无线传感器定位系统;通过无线定位控制小车移动;来实现垃圾清理的智能化。通过深入分析现有室内定位技术及其特点;介绍了无线网络的室内定位试验平台的硬件组成和定位算法。通过三边定位法与极大似然估计算法的结合;精确计算出目标节点的位置信息。其中硬件平台集成了以51内核为核心的CC2530F256芯片;并以移动避障小车为载体进行了目标点定位试验。研究结果表明;该定位系统具有良好的定位精度与可扩展性。
keywords: indoor positioning, smart home, wireless positioning, zigbee
affiliations: 青岛科技大学自动化与电子工程学院, Qingdao University of Science and Technology, School of Automation and Electronic Engineering

title: 基于准PR控制的单相交流电子负载的研究与实现
abstract: For the electricenergy waste of traditional electricity load;energy feedback type single-phase AC electronic load was researched and designed which could effectively feed back energy;achieve the goal of reutilization of energy. The type control device was formed to "back to back" H-bridge as main circuit;the basic working principle of the whole system was analysed. The influence of the important parameters for the PR control algorithm on the control effect was verified and analyzed in the Matlab simulation platform;and the PI and quasi-PR control algorithm combined with complementary were applied to the design. A Matlab/Simulink model and the prototype system based on TMS320 F28335 were set up. The simulation and experimental results show that the control strategy is feasible.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统电子负载对电能的浪费;研究与设计的能馈式单相交流电子负载能有效地将电能回馈;达到能源二次利用的目的。以全控型器件形成的"背对背"H桥为主电路;分析了整个系统的基本工作原理。在Matlab仿真平台上对准PR控制算法中的重要参数对控制效果的影响进行了验证分析;并将PI及准PR控制算法进行结合互补应用于设计中。搭建了Matlab/Simulink模型和基于TMS320F28335样机系统;仿真和实验结果表明了所采用控制策略的可行性。
keywords: "back to back" h-bridge, pi control algorithm, quasi-pr algorithm, reutilization of energy, tm28335
authors: WU Fuzhuan;LIU Xinyang;ZHU Jing;JI Zhigang;CHEN Peng
affiliations: Zhongyuan University of Technology, School of electronic information, 中原工学院电子信息学院

title: 基于ZigBee的物联网智能家居设计
abstract: This paper puts forward a kind of Internet of things smart home control system; taking the system with embedded processor ARM Cortex-A9 as the core. The Linux platform for real-time operating system provides a good man-machine interface. Using CC2530 RF transceiver chip and Zig Bee wireless networking technology; combined with PC embedded integrated development environment IAR EWARM; the indoor environment data detection; security monitoring and home appliance intelligent control are designed through wireless communication technology. Thus; the overall intelligent management of home control has been realized; and the advantages of Internet of things smart homes in the Internet era have been fully demonstrated.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种物联网智能家居系统;该系统网关设计以嵌入式高性能四核处理器ARM Cortex-A9为核心;Linux实时平台操作系统提供良好的人机界面.采用CC2530射频收发芯片及ZigBee无线组网技术;结合上位机嵌入式集成开发环境IAR EW ARM;设计通过无线通信技术进行室内环境的数据检测、安防监测和家居家电智能控制;实现了家居控制的智能化统筹管理;充分展现了互联网时代物联网智能家居的优越性.
keywords: arm cortex-a9, cc2530, gateway, internet of things, smart home, zigbee
affiliations: 常熟理工学院计算机科学与工程学院, Changshu Institute of Technology, School of Computer Science and Engineering

title: 基于物联网的高校内网信息安全智能监控系统设计
abstract: As the traditional monitoring system is affected by signal interference and the application of specific scenes;the accuracy of system monitoring is low.In order to solve this problem;a design of intelligent monitoring system for information security in university intranet based on Internet of things is put forward.According to the whole frame of the system;the hardware structure and software function of the system are designed respectively.The CC2530 model chip is used and the wireless communication technology is used to deal with the nodes in a unified way.According to the processing results;we design terminal sensing;switch and client module to ensure that every information can be perceived by the system under the condition of signal interference.We design the monitoring node flow;active alert and specific scenario application of CC2530 chip.The method of threshold segmentation is used to deal with the data;and the information security and intelligent monitoring of the internal network is realized.The experimental results showed that the maximum precision of the system can reach 92%;which ensures the security of the information of the internal network of the university.
abstract_in_chinese: 传统监控系统由于受到信号干扰和具体场景应用的影响;导致系统监测精准度较低;为了解决该问题;提出了基于物联网的高校内网信息安全智能监控系统设计.根据系统整体框架;分别对系统硬件结构和软件功能进行设计.使用CC2530型号芯片;并采用无线通信技术对节点进行统一汇聚处理.根据处理结果设计终端感知、开关和客户端模块;保证每种信息都能在信号干扰条件下被系统感知.对CC2530型号芯片监控节点流程、主动预警和具体场景应用进行设计.并采用阈值分割法处理数据;实现内网信息安全智能监控.由实验结果可知;该系统监测精准度最高可达到92%;保证了高校内网信息的安全.
keywords: colleges and universities, intelligence monitoring, internet of things, intranet information, security
affiliations: Liming Vocational University, 黎明职业大学实验实训部, Department of Experimental Training

title: 基于无线传感网络的可移动式环境监测系统设计
abstract: In order to solve the problem of environmental monitoring in production activities;the traditional wired monitoring system is widely used at present. The wired transmission monitoring system requires a large number of lines;fixed locations;and high cost.Additionally;the wired sensor is set to be limited by the power supply.Therefore;a Zig Bee-based portable wireless sensor network node design scheme with built-in battery is proposed. With Zig Bee network ' s powerful networking capacity and wireless transmission capabilities;on-board SHT20 temperature and humidity sensors;R2868 flame sensor and MQ-2 smoke sensor;can collect data from each node through the terminal and send it to the coordinator. The coordinator can transmit data to the host computer in real time with 2 second delay through GPRS wireless remote monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 对于生产活动中的环境监测问题;当前广泛采用的是传统有线监测系统。针对有线传监测系统安装周期长、位置固定、成本较高、同时有线传感器的布置又受到电源限制的情况;在基于Zig Bee传感网络的基础上;提出了一种可内置电池的便携式无线传感网络节点的设计方案。凭借Zig Bee网络强大的组网容量和无线传输能力;在终端驱动SHT20温湿度传感器、R2868火焰传感器和MQ-2烟雾传感器;通过终端采集各个节点数据信息发送到协调器;协调器通过GPRS无线传输给上位机;经测试系统可实现数据2 s延时内在上位机实时刷新。
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, wireless sensor network, zigbee
authors: YANG Jianfeng;GUO Haopan;XIA Fan;RAN Shu;FANG Fang;DING Zhongtao;YANG Xue
affiliations: College of Information Science and Technology, 成都理工大学信息科学与技术学院, Chengdu University of Technology

title: 基于荧光测温的开关柜触头无线监测系统
abstract_in_chinese: 为避免人工巡检带来的不便;文中提出了基于荧光测温的开关柜触头无线监测系统方案。以STM32F407为核心搭建光纤温度测量系统;设计了激励光驱动电路、光电转换电路及宽带放大电路。利用荧光寿命测温原理;结合FFT算法完成对开关柜触头温度的测量。通过ZigBee无线芯片CC2530将测量的温度数据传输至监控室;使用LabVIEW设计上位机显示温度信息。本系统实现了无需人工巡检;实时监测开关柜运行状况的目标。
affiliations: 沈阳工业大学信息科学与工程学院

title: 基于人体红外和光强传感器的智能网络开关的研究与设计
abstract_in_chinese: 文中设计了一种基于人体红外和光强传感器的智能网络开关。该智能开关利用人体红外传感器和光强传感器实现对家中灯具的智能控制。只在室内有人和光线较暗时;开关才会控制灯亮;从而达到智能节能的目标;并且在无线组网的情况下实现对数据的实时传输。系统以CC2530无线射频芯片为核心;对ZigBee无线传感网络中的节点和传感器接口的软硬件进行设计。该系统使用性能好、精准度高;能够较好地满足家中灯具的智能化要求。
affiliations: 南京晓庄学院信息工程学院

title: 无线网络压力传感器设计
abstract: To facilitate installation and reduce wiring;wireless network pressure sensors are designed. Us-ing the low-power MSP430 G2553 controller and CC2530;the wireless network pressure sensor collects pressuredata via external interrupts. The wireless network pressure sensor converts the pressure of the strain gaugethrough AD to calculate the pressure data;and then sends it to the upper computer through the wireless chipCC2530. The upper computer acquires the wirelessly collected data and displays the acquired pressure conver-sion value through calculation. The experimental results show that the designed wireless pressure sensor canwork reliably and can be used in pressure detection sites where layout and wiring are difficultto save connectionand cost.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了便于安装和减少布线;设计了无线网络压力传感器.采用低功耗的MSP430G2553控制器和CC2530;无线压力传感器通过外部中断方式采集压力数据.无线压力传感器将应变片的压力通过A/D转换;计算出压力数据;然后再通过无线芯片CC2530发送到上位机.上位机获取无线的数据通过计算得到并显示采集的压力变换值.实验结果表明设计的无线压力传感器可以可靠工作;可以用在布局布线困难的压力检测场地;节省连线和成本.
keywords: cc2530, msp430, pressure sensor, wireless network
affiliations: Huainan Normal University, 淮南师范学院电子工程学院, School of Electronic Engineering

title: Design of Multi-Parameter Wireless Sensor Network Monitoring System
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of traditional physical wired sensor data acquisition and monitoring system;such as cumbersome wirings;large power consumption;unitary structure and poor dynamic performance;etc.;a wireless sensor acquisition system based on Zig Bee technology is designed which includes one data base station and multiple multi-parameter terminal acquisition nodes. The low power consumption CC2530 with good radio transmission performance is used as the main control chip of system node and data base station. Through the Z-stack protocol stack and OSAL operating system;the Zig Bee-based wireless sensor network communication and networking are implemented. Considering the different demands for different signals on-site;the design can simultaneously collect both digital signals and analog signals. Through the serial peripheral interface( SPI) of CC2530 master control chip;the output signals of digitized sensors are collected by extending the AD7656;6-channel parallel A/D conversion is realized;the analog signals output of multiple sensors are collected. The results of practical measurement verify the system’s network transmission performance and dynamic topological structure;and acquisition performance of each terminal acquisition node of digital signal and analog signal. It shows that the advantage of wireless sensor network technology based on Zig Bee will surely become the development direction of the sensor signal acquisition industry.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统物理布线式的传感器数据采集监测系统布线繁琐、功耗大、结构单一、动态性能差等特点;设计了一种基于ZigBee技术、包含一个数据基站和多个多参数终端采集节点的无线传感器采集系统。采用低功耗、无线收发性能良好的CC2530作为系统节点和数据基站的主控芯片。通过Z-Stack协议栈和OSAL操作系统;实现了基于ZigBee的无线传感器网络的通信和组网。考虑到采集现场对不同信号的需求;该系统可同时采集数字信号和模拟信号。节点通过CC2530主控芯片的串行外设接口(SPI);采集数字化传感器输出信号通过扩展AD7656实现6通道并行A/D转换;从而采集多个传感器输出的模拟信号。实测结果验证了系统的网络传输性能和动态拓扑结构;以及各终端采集节点对数字信号和模拟信号的采集性能。基于ZigBee的无线传感器网络技术优势突出;必将成为传感器信号采集行业的发展方向。
keywords: serial peripheral interface(spi), single chip, wireless communication, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Dynamic System Design and Application of Intelligent Integrated Grouting Equipment
abstract: This paper designs a kind of equipment for the preparation;transmission;and grouting of slurry preparation.The embedded weighing system is used to weigh the material.The circuit design and software design of the weighing system are introduced.In order to improve the accuracy of the sampling signal;ADS1256 is selected with 24-bit AD sampling chip.The wavelet transform is used to filter the sampled signal.The noise signal is effectively suppressed;and the weighing accuracy is improved.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种集浆液制备、传送及注浆一体式的设备;采用了嵌入式的动态称重系统对物料进行称重;介绍了称重系统的电路设计以及软件设计;为了提升采样信号的精度;选用了具有24位的AD采样芯片ADS1256。并运用小波变换对采样信号进行滤波;噪声信号得到有效抑制;提高了称重精度。

title: Development of underground garage lighting control system based on ZigBee
abstract: To solve the problems of complex wiring;configuration;installation difficulties in underground garage lighting system;an underground garage lighting solution based on ZigBee was proposed;in which CC2530 was used as its core chip;and node hardware;software and management software were designed and developed.The administrator could configure the relationship between detection node and control node on host computer to achieve the goal that lights on when cars come otherwise off for energy saving.The examples were given to explain that the system is easy to install;rebuild;expand;and it can be remotely debugged;verifying that it can save costs;shorten development time and improve system performance.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决地下车库照明系统线路繁杂、安装调试困难、配置不够灵活等问题;提出基于ZigBee的地下车库照明解决方案;采用CC2530作为核心芯片;设计开发节点硬件、软件和管理软件。安装调试人员能够通过管理软件实现检测节点和控制节点的地址灵活配置;实现车来灯亮、车走灯灭的目标;达到节能的效果。实例验证了该系统易于安装、改建和扩充;可实现远程调试;能够节省成本;缩短开发时间;提高系统性能。
keywords: cc2530, energy conservation, underground garage lighting systems, wireless networks, zigbee
affiliations: 首都机场动力能源有限公司, 北京建筑大学电气与信息工程学院

title: Design and implementation of infusion monitoring system based on improved capacitance detection method
abstract: Objective To design a high-performance; reliable and practical wireless infusion monitoring system to realize automated infusion monitoring. Methods The system was composed of an infusion monitor; an intelligent gateway and a host computer; which used AD7746 chip to monitor the electric capacity; I2 C serial bus for capacity-related data readback;CC2530 SCM for difference calculation and infusion state determination; and Zig Bee technology to execute wireless data transmission at real time. Results The system carried out multi-node monitoring on volume and velocity at real time; and the acquired data were accurate and reliable. Conclusion The system gains advantages over the traditional ways in practicability and reliability when used for infusion monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的 :设计一种高性能、可靠、实用的无线输液监测系统;以满足目前输液监护对自动化的迫切需求。方法 :该系统由输液监测仪、智能网关、上位机3个部分组成。采用AD7746芯片监测电容;利用I2C串行总线实现电容数据的回读;采用CC2530单片机对电容数据进行差分计算并判别当前输液状态;利用Zig Bee技术实现数据的无线实时传输。结果:该系统可对多个输液节点的输液量及输液速度进行实时监测;且采集的数据准确可靠。结论:该设计有效克服了原有监测方法的弊端;大大提高了监测的实用性和可靠性;为输液监测提供了一种更加行之有效的方法。
keywords: ad7746 chip, capacitance method, cc2530 scm, infusion monitoring, zigbee technology

title: 基于DSP的语音滤波系统研究
abstract: Based on FIR filter; a speech filter system using DSP chip TMS320 F2812 and audio decoder chip TLV320 AIC23 as its hardware is designed in this paper; FIR filter is realized by DSP integrated system development environment; the speech filter system has good real-time perfor-mance and the high frequency noise is restrained effectively; The simulation and the experimental results of the actual hardware system show the effectiveness of the system.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于FIR滤波算法;利用DSP处理芯片TMS320F2812;音频处理芯片TLV320AIC23设计了一种语音滤波系统;并在DSP集成开发环境中实现了窗函数法设计的FIR滤波器;该语音滤波系统实时性好;并有效抑制了高频噪声;仿真和实际硬件系统实验结果表明该系统的有效性。
keywords: fir filter, speech filter system, tms320f2812, window function method
affiliations: School of Mechanical Engineering, 漳州职业技术学院机械工程学院, Zhangzhou Institute of Technology

title: 永磁无刷直流电机及其微机测控伺服系统研究
abstract: On the basis of Microcomputer Measurement and Control Technology;brushless DC motor(BLDC)and its control system are designed and realized in this paper. Taking excessive torque ripple of B LD C into consideration;a proper motor structure is firstly designed according to actual measurement and control requirements on the spot;then the motor scheme is optimized by improved multi-niche genetic algorithm. The overall design scheme and hardware circuit of servo system is subsequently determined;where TM S320 F28335 is taken as the control core. The mixed sectional-type commutation strategy is proposed in order to restrain commutation torque ripple of BLDC. A master-slave distributed communication system of variable frequency speed regulation control platform based on full-digital Brushless DC motor is finally designed;on the basis of which;the optimal control effect--decentralized control and centralized processing is achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计并实现了基于微机测控技术的无刷直流电机及其控制系统。针对无刷直流电机转矩波动过大的缺陷;首先根据现场的实际测控要求设计了合适的电机结构;并在此基础上利用改进多生境遗传算法对电机方案进行优化。之后确定了以TMS320F28335为控制核心的伺服系统的总体设计方案;并对伺服系统硬件进行了设计。为进一步抑制电机的换相转矩波动;提出混合分段式换相策略。在此基础上;设计了一套针对全数字无刷直流电机变频调速控制平台的主从分布式通信系统;使得主控计算机实现分散控制、集中处理的最优控制效果。通过有限元联合仿真及实验对无刷直流电机及伺服系统进行验证。所设计的基于微机测控技术的无刷直流电机控制系统在精密控制领域有着广泛的应用前景。
keywords: brushless dc motor, improved multi-niche genetic algorithm, masterslave distributed communication system, microcomputer measurement and control technology, torque ripple
affiliations: 常州工学院计算机信息工程学院, Changzhou Institute of Technology, School of Computer and Information Engineering, Changzhou Liu Guojun Institute of Jiangsu Joint Vocational and Technical College, 江苏联合职业技术学院常州刘国钧分院

title: 一种低成本电路设计在伺服控制系统中的应用
abstract: This paper presented a servo control design based on DSP and the discrete drive circuit. By optimizing thecircuit design; this low-cost scheme can satisfy the specification performance for accuracy and response time; whichalso limits the circuit size. The corresponding system; in which the DSP of TMS320 F2812 is used as the main controlunit; is equipped with the simplest periphery circuits. Using the PID control with feed forward compensation as its al-gorithm; the controller accomplishes the brush motor control with pulse-width modulation.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文介绍了一种基于DSP和分立驱动电路的伺服控制电路设计方案;通过优化电路设计;实现低成本设计;既能满足控制精度、响应速度等性能要求;又控制了体积。系统采用TMS320F2812型DSP为主控单元;以最简单的方式配置外围电路算法上采用带有前馈补偿的PID的控制方式;通过脉宽调制实现对有刷电机的控制。
keywords: brush motor, discrete drive, dsp, pulse-width modulation, servo control
affiliations: China Airborne Missile Academy, 中国空空导弹研究院

title: 一种数字无刷电动舵机控制系统的设计
abstract: A digital brushless electric actuator system is designed. The control system adopts a floating-point digital signal processor TMS320 F28335 as control core of control circuit;uses the magnetoelectric encoder as the angle measuring device;uses the brushless DC motor as the actuator;uses the ball screw and gear pair as the retarding mechanism to realize high real-time and wide-band output of system.The experimental results show that the phase delay is 16. 8° at 1°;10 Hz sinusoidal signal;the system angular velocity comes up to 580( °)/s;and the system bandwidth achieves to about 34 Hz.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文实现了一种数字无刷电动舵机控制系统;该系统以浮点信号处理器TMS320F28335作为控制核心;以磁电编码器作为舵偏角反馈装置;以直流无刷电机作为伺服电机;以齿轮副和滚珠丝杠副作为减速机构;实现了系统的高实时性、宽带宽输出。试验结果表明;该系统对于1°;10Hz输入信号的相位延迟为16.8°;角速度可到达580(°)/s;系统频带可达到34 Hz。
keywords: brushless dc motor, digital brushless electric actuator, digital signal processor
affiliations: Naval Military Representative Office in Luoyang, 海军驻洛阳地区航空军事代表室

title: 无线数据采集系统在噪音环境下的应用
abstract_in_chinese: Zig Bee协议是以IEEE 802.15.4协议作为基础的无线通信技术;该技术具有着诸多特点都很适合在嘈杂环境下使用。文章提出了一种基于Zigbee的无线数据采集系来统应用在多网络复杂环境;该系统利用RSSI值作为标准;动态切换通信信道;避让拥挤信道。系统采用TI公司的CC2530做主控芯片;程序上基于Z-Stack协议栈标准进行编写;在多网络环境下进行实验检测。实验结果表明:终端节点采集的数据可靠;网络信噪比占优;在噪音环境下具有良好的表现。
affiliations: 湖南科技大学物理与电子科学学院

title: 基于ZigBee无线通信的小型步进电机驱动系统设计
abstract: In this paper;the design principle of the wireless driver system and the design process of the driver are described in detail.The experimental results show that the design fully meets the actual requirements and ensures the operation precision of the optical fiber unit within 10 um.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对LAMOST工程的新一代光纤定位单元设计了一种小型步进电机驱动系统。驱动芯片采用A3988;该芯片具备双步进电机驱动能力MCU采用TI的CC2530;它是一款8位控制器;同时内置无线收发芯片;遵守2.4GHz频段内的ZigBee无线通信协议;用于无线控制。详细说明了该无线驱动系统的设计原理;以及驱动程序的设计流程。实验结果表明;该设计完全满足实际要求;保证了光纤单元的运转精度在10μm以内。
keywords: a3988, drive system, lamost, stepper motor, zigbee
affiliations: 中国科学技术大学工程科学学院
risk.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学), University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学)
risk.level: Very High (EL), Very High (1286)

title: 基于ZigBee传感网的农产品仓库环境监测系统
abstract_in_chinese: 为了加强农产品仓库的环境监测;基于ZigBee无线传感网的架构;采用MSP430g2231的MPU;采用DS18B20温度传感器;HS1101湿度传感器;CC2530的ZigBee芯片采用MSP430为核心MCU;DS18B20为温度传感器;HS1101为湿度传感器;LTH301-302的红外线对射型光电传感器为害虫计数传感器;设计了一种农产品仓库环境监测系统。具有成本低、能耗低、灵活布局的优点;能有效地减少农产品货损;具有良好的推广前景。
affiliations: 福建农林大学交通与土木工程学院, 福建农林大学作物科学学院

title: 一种新型Z源逆变器
abstract: To improve the ability of Z-source inverter booster at the same time and reduce the capacitance stress;a power embedded Z source inverter circuit topology theory is proposed;the switch embedded inductor and dc power supply branch circuit topology structure is adopted. Analysing the topology of store process;its basic structure and working principle;and using simulation software MATLAB/Simulink;the circuit topology theary is verified. Based on the DSP-TMS320 F2812 control platform to build prototype experimental verification;the experimental results prove that the simulation results show that the topology is feasible and accurate. Ability to effectively improve the inverter’s booster at the same time reduces the stress of the capacitor voltage.
abstract_in_chinese: 为提高Z源逆变器升压能力同时减小电容应力;提出了一种电源嵌入式Z源逆变器的电路拓扑理论采用了开关电感和直流电源嵌入分支电路的拓扑结构;通过分析该拓扑的储放能过程;及其基本结构和工作原理并利用MATLAB/Simulink仿真软件进行了验证。最后基于DSP-TMS320F2812控制平台搭建样机进行实验验证;仿真及实验结果表明;该拓扑结构是可行的准确的在有效提高逆变器的升压能力的同时降低了电容电压的应力。
keywords: dsp, matlab/simulink, power supply embedding, switching inductance, z-source inverter
affiliations: Shandong University of Science and Technology, 山东科技大学

risk.level: Very High (Defense & Security Affiliated Research Universities)

title: 电磁波泥水位监测系统设计及应用
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一个基于电磁波原理的泥水位监测系统;系统以PIC32MX和ADS1256芯片为核心;选用基于电磁波原理的雷达物位传感器完成泥石流泥水位感知;能够远程设定数据采集频度、根据设定阈值自动增加数据采集频率。系统具有GPRS和北斗两种传输模式;能够在GPRS信号微弱情况下自动切换到北斗数据传输模式;有效保证了数据传输的可靠性。阐述了系统的工作原理和软硬件设计思路;并在张家口市崇礼区三道营村庙儿沟进行了野外应用。
affiliations: 国土资源部地质环境监测技术重点实验室, 中国地质调查局水文地质环境地质调查中心

title: 基于物联网的智能农业控制系统的设计
abstract: In order to solve the problems existing in the modern agricultural;an Intelligent agriculture control system was designed.The hardware and software design of the system was completed; including the upper computer; Zig Bee wireless sensor control network. The system realized the automatic collection of environmental data and the automatic control of the environment. System was based on Zig Bee network technology; with CC2530 as main control module.Through the data by sensor; executive component was Intelligent controlled and the planting environment can be improved. Test results show this system is effective.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对当前农业种植环境存在的问题;设计了一种基于物联网的智能农业控制系统。该系统完成了硬件及软件的设计;包括上位机、Zig Bee协调器、数据采集节点、自动控制执行节点。实现了农业种植主要环境数据的采集;以及极端环境情况下的自动调节控制。系统网络基于Zig Bee网络实现;主控模块采用CC2530;通过传感器采集的数据;控制执行节点启动;从而改善种植环境。通过模拟试验;测试了系统的可行性。
keywords: cc2530, intelligent agriculture, internet of thing, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: Tan Kah Kee College, 厦门大学嘉庚学院信息科学与技术学院, Xiamen University, Information Science Technology College

risk.level: Very High (Defense & Security Affiliated Research Universities)

title: 基于ZigBee的RSSI改进定位算法在列车盲区定位中的实现
abstract: In order to real-time positioning of train tunnel driving to make up for the inadequacy of existing positioning satellite navigation and positioning system blind area;the RSSI improved centroid localization algorithm is proposed based on Zig Beetechnology and improving the weighted centroid localization algorithm;and the Zig Bee system chip CC2530 is used to form the wireless sensor network( WSN). The design and implementation of hardware and software are completed;and the feasibility of the algorithm is verified by experiment.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了能够对隧道内行驶的列车进行全程实时定位、弥补卫星导航定位系统存在定位盲区的不足;提出了基于Zig Bee技术的RSSI改进质心定位算法和改进加权质心定位算法;并利用Zig Bee系统芯片CC2530组建了无线传感器网络;完成了软硬件设计与实现;最后通过实验验证了该算法的可行性.
keywords: blind location, rssi ranging, zigbee technology
affiliations: 大连交通大学电气信息学院, School of Electrical and Information Engineering, Dalian jiaotong university

title: 基于传感器网的烟尘多环芳烃自动吸附系统研究
abstract: In order to efficiently absorb polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons(PAHs)in soot;an automatic adsorption smoke PAHs system is designed using wireless sensor networks.The system consists of transmission part;wireless sensor network nodes and adsorption particles.The CC2530 module starts the transmission system to complete the work of replacing the adsorption particles.The experimental results show that the content of PAHs detected by the adsorption particles in the recovery bin is greater than that of the adsorbed particles in the lower screen mesh.It shows that the automatic adsorption of soot PAHs system based on sensor networks can play a role in absorbing PAHs.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了高效吸附烟尘中的多环芳烃;设计了基于传感器网的烟尘多环芳烃自动吸附系统.该系统由传输部分、传感网节点、吸附颗粒等组成;利用CC2530模块启动传输系统;完成更换吸附颗粒的工作.结果表明:自动吸附系统回收箱内吸附颗粒检出的多环芳烃含量大于下筛网上吸附颗粒中的多环芳烃;可以起到吸收多环芳烃的作用.
keywords: automatic adsorption, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, soot, wireless sensor network
affiliations: 东北师范大学物理学院, School of Physics, Northeast Normal University

title: 基于CC2530单片机的心电监测分析仪设计
abstract: Objective A remote wireless electrocardiogram(ECG) monitoring system is designed by using the CC2530 microcontroller as the device core. Methods Acquisition; conversion and data processing for ECG signals are realized on CC2530 micro-controllers. And the ECG data is transmitted to the coordinator by using Zig Bee. It realizes the real-time monitoring of ECG signals and heart rate variability(HRV) data. Results The test results show that the maximum error of the designed ECG monitoring analyzer is 3 beats per minute and the average error is 1.6 beats per minute; which can meet the requirement of pharmaceutical industry standards of the People’s Republic of China. Conclusion The ECG monitoring analyzer has good portability; high measurement precision and good practical application values.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的以CC2530单片机为核心;设计出一个远程无线心电监测系统。方法在CC2530单片机上实现心电信号的采集转换和数据处理;然后通过Zig Bee将数据传输到协调器;实现了心电信号和心率变异性数据的实时监测的功能。结果经测试;该系统的最大误差为3 beat/min;平均误差为1.6 beat/min。符合中华人民共和国医药行业标准。结论该设备有便携测量精度高的特点;具备一定参考价值和实用性。
keywords: cc2530, ecg monitoring, hrv, zig bee
authors: PAN Tianwen;WEI Pengbo;TIAN Qing;GU Xiaofeng;YU Zhiguo
affiliations: Jiangnan University, Engineering Research Center of IoT Technology Applications, Ministry of Education, 物联网技术应用教育部工程研究中心江南大学电子工程系, Department of Electronic Engineering

title: 基于DSP的高速数据采集与存储系统设计
abstract: Designs a high-speed data acquisition and memory system based on DSP. This system adopts TMS320F28335 as the core controller chip;the date was acquired by ADC of DSP; and the converted date is transmitted to external SRAM by high-speed DMA. This system uses DMA to transmit date; which can reduce CPU resource consumption and improve the transmission efficiency of data. Experiments show that this system is stable and reliable to accomplish data acquisition and memory; and can be applied to data processing later.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种基于DSP的高速数据采集与存储系统的设计方法。以TMS320F28335为核心控制器;通过内部ADC完成模拟信号的采集转换;使用DMA模块将转换后的数据高速传送到DSP外扩的SRAM中。以DMA方式传送数据;可降低CPU资源消耗;提高传送效率。经测试该方法能够有效可靠地进行数据采集与存储;为后续的数据处理工作奠定基础。
keywords: data acquisition and memory, dma, sram, tms320f28335
affiliations: 西安石油大学电子工程学院, Xi’an Shiyou University, School of Electronic Engineering

title: 光伏水泵最大功率跟踪控制系统的设计与实现
abstract: Given the fact that the water resources in the northwestern part of China are relatively poor while the sunshine is relatively adequate; the groundwater resources can be rationally utilized with the help of the solar energy through the photovoltaic pump system. In order to improve the utilization of solar energy; a set of photovoltaic pump power tracking control system is designed. Hardware is constructed by TMS320 F28335 chip as the master; DC/DC converter;intelligent inverter power module;DC conversion power; optical isolation;bus voltage and current sampling and other circuits. Software is constructed through the CCS3.3 development platform; to design the master program;voltage space vector control; maximum power tracking control and other subroutines; etc.; to complete the design of the system. Finally; the experimental results show that the photovoltaic pump system designed in this paper can improve DC voltage utilization and maximum power tracking control.
abstract_in_chinese: 根据我国西北部地区水资源比较贫乏和光照条件相对比较充足这一特点;光伏水泵系统能够通过太阳能将地下水资源进行合理地利用;同时为了提高太阳能的利用率;设计一套光伏水泵最大功率跟踪控制系统。该系统由TMS320F28335芯片、DC/DC变换器、智能逆变功率模块、直流变换功率、光电隔离、母线电压电流采样检测等电路构成。利用CCS3.3开发平台;设计主控程序、电压空间矢量控制、最大功率跟踪控制和其他子程序等。实验结果表明;设计的光伏水泵系统能够实现最大功率跟踪控制功能;提高直流电压利用率。
keywords: maximum power tracking, photovoltaic pump, vector control
affiliations: School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Suzhou Vocational University, 苏州市职业大学电子信息工程学院

title: 基于CC3200的智能家居语音识别控制系统
abstract: Based on various theories and technologies such as speech recognition;wireless communication;intelligent control;cloud computing and wireless sensor;this paper designs an smart home speech recognition control system with CC3200. The system uses a voice recognition module made by iFLYTEK to collect the speech and uses the UART communication protocol and CC3200 serial module to achieve the communication between the Upper and Lower Computer. In the end;the CC3200 uploads the preprocessed date to the cloud server to complete the analyses and transmits the commands received from cloud to the control terminals;by which to realize the function of intelligently controlling home furnishings by using voice. In addition;the system has the advantages of convenient operation and low cost.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文综合运用语音识别、无线通信、智能控制、云计算、无线传感器等多种理论和技术;设计了一套基于CC3200的智能家居自然语言识别控制系统。该系统采用科大讯飞的语音识别模块采集语音;然后利用UART通信协议和CC3200进行上下位机通信;最后CC3200将预处理后的数据上传至云端服务器解析并接收云端命令传送至控制终端;以实现语音控制家居智能化工作的功能。该系统具有操作方便快捷;成本低等优点。
keywords: cc3200, cloud server, smart home, voice recognition, wireless communication
affiliations: Henan University of Science and Technology, 河南科技大学信息工程学院, School of Information Engineering

title: Research on Control Strategy of Axially-laminated Anisotropic Rotor Reluctance Synchronous Machine
abstract: In order to obtain a wide speed range of axial laminated rotor reluctance synchronous motor;the relationship among the maximum electromagnetic torque;the maximum power factor;the maximum speed and the current synthetic vector leading d axis angle was obtained based on the phasor diagram through the vector control strategy and experiments of ALA rotor reluctance synchronous motor.A vector control platform with TMS320 F2812 DSP processing chip as the core was designed;and the 2.8 times speed regulation range was obtained in the experiment.The experimental results showed that the vector control strategy had realized the effect of electrical motor’s fast response;energy-efficient and wide speed regulation range.
abstract_in_chinese: 为达到轴向叠片转子磁阻同步电机调速范围宽的目的;从相量图出发;通过对ALA转子磁阻同步电机的失量控制策略进行分析和实验验证;获得了最大电磁转矩、最高功率因数、最高转速同电流综合矢量超前d轴角度的关系;设计了以TMS320F2812 DSP处理芯片为核心的矢量控制平台;实验得到了2.8倍的调速范围。结果表明;矢量控制策略实现了电机快速响应、高效节能且调速范围宽的效果。
keywords: axially-laminated anisotropic rotor, reluctance synchronous motor, vector control
affiliations: 湖北理工学院电气与电子信息工程学院

title: Small Stepping Motor Drive System Based on ZigBee Wireless Communication
abstract: In this paper;the design principle of the wireless driver system and the design process of the driver are described in detail.The experimental results show that the design fully meets the actual requirements and ensures the operation precision of the optical fiber unit within 10 um.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对LAMOST工程的新一代光纤定位单元设计了一种小型步进电机驱动系统。驱动芯片采用A3988;该芯片具备双步进电机驱动能力MCU采用TI的CC2530;它是一款8位控制器;同时内置无线收发芯片;遵守2.4GHz频段内的ZigBee无线通信协议;用于无线控制。详细说明了该无线驱动系统的设计原理;以及驱动程序的设计流程。实验结果表明;该设计完全满足实际要求;保证了光纤单元的运转精度在10μm以内。
keywords: a3988, drive system, lamost, stepper motor, zigbee

title: Grain depot monitoring system based on WSN
abstract: In order to achieve granary digital management;we use wireless sensor network technology to achieve granary temperature and humidity monitoring system.The topology of the cluster is used to deploy all the sensor nodes and build the whole network.The high performance CC1101 radio frequency chip and low power consumption micro-controller are selected to design and implement nodes.Based on the study of MAC protocol;time synchronization method to synchronize and schedule the dormancy and work of each sensor node to achieve reliable data transmissionWe improve the TDMA-based MAC protocol;and design the entire network communication protocol.Finally the system communication performance and power consumption were tested;verified the reliability of the system put forward.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了实现粮仓数字化管理;采用嵌入式技术和无线射频技术设计节点;构建无线传感器网络;实现粮仓温湿度自动监测。采用分簇的拓扑结构部署全部传感器节点并构建整个网络;选用高性能的CC1101射频芯片和低功耗的微控制器;设计并实现传感器节点和汇聚节点在研究MAC协议基础上;提出一种时间同步方法;有效地调度各传感器节点的休眠与工作;可靠地实现数据的传输改进基于TDMA的MAC协议;设计了整个网络的通讯协议最后对系统通信性能进行了测试;实验表明数据包到达率在99.8%以上;保证了系统的可靠性。
keywords: cc1101, communication protocol, low power consumption, wsn

abstract_in_chinese: 介绍了利用双控制芯片DSP、FPGA采集处理永磁同步电机电机解码的电路方案。详细介绍了AD2S1200的工作原理以及采集系统的设计思路和参数。对外围电路、驱动电路、AD2S1200芯片与XC3S500E的接口电路、XC3S500E与TMS320F28335的接口电路做了详细的介绍。利用FPGA采集数据;通过数据总线传输给DSP;减轻了DSP数据处理的负担;不仅使系统的控制精度得到了保证;而且可靠性高、稳定性好;达到了设计要求。

title: 基于DSP28335+IR2110芯片的移相全桥驱动电路设计
abstract: In order to solve the problem of phase-shifted full-bridge circuit driving and phase angle control;a digitally controlled phaseshifted full-bridge driving circuit was designed. TPL521 optocoupler isolation;IR2110 gate driver chip. PWM signals are generated by the DSP and sent to the IR2110 for phase angle control after optocoupler isolation and logic circuits. This text carries on the analysis to the principle of IR2110 drive circuit and parameter design;set up and give out some code to TMS320F28335. The experimental results show that the PWM waveforms with different phase angles generated by TMS320F28335 can meet the requirements of phase-shifted full-bridge control for different phase angles.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决移相全桥电路驱动及相角控制问题;设计了一种数字控制的移相全桥驱动电路.以TPL521为光耦隔离、IR2110为栅极驱动芯片.由DSP产生PWM信号;经过光耦隔离和逻辑电路后送至IR2110进行相角控制.文章对IR2110驱动电路原理进行分析及参数进行设计;对TMS320F28335进行设置并给出部分代码.实验结果表明:通过TMS320F28335可产生的不同相角的PWM波形;满足了移相全桥对不同相角控制的要求.
keywords: ir2110, phase angle control, phase-shifted full-bridge, tms320f28335

title: 基于DSP的飞机防滑控制器设计与可靠性分析
abstract: A new kind of aircraft antiskid braking controller based on the digital signal processor( TMS320 F28335) is designed in this paper. The circuits including power;signal process and valve control are presented with single power supply. Optimization on structure and skills in PCB lay-out can improve its reliability. FMECA is imposed for reliability analysis and raising improvement. The simulation results obtained from the hardware-in-the-loop demonstrate that the controller can meet the requirement of aircraft braking.
abstract_in_chinese: 文中设计了一种以TMS320F28335为控制核心的飞机防滑刹车控制器。在单电源供电的基础上;设计了电源电路、轮速调理电路和伺服阀驱动电路等功能模块;并通过优化电路结构和PCB布图增强控制器的可靠性。同时;利用故障模式、影响及危害性分析(FMECA)方法对控制盒进行可靠性定量分析;提出进一步提高控制器可靠性的方案。与半物理仿真台的联调结果表明;控制器工作稳定可靠;能够满足飞机防滑刹车的要求。
keywords: antiskid braking controller, circuit reliability, dsp, failure mode hazard, fmeca

title: 基于DSP的全数字化无刷直流电机控制系统设计
abstract: In order to improve the control effect of brushless dc motor;a kind of brushless dc motor based on DSP chip TMS320 F2812 control system has been designed.The system adopts the double closed-loop control structure.Among them;the current adopts current hysteresis structure;peed loop adopts incremental pid control structure.At the same time the hall position signal detection circuit;stator current detection circuit;drive/inverter circuit is introduced;and the corresponding hardware circuit is given.The design scheme of circuit is simple;strong reliability;and its application value is high.At the same time;the experimental results verify the effectiveness of the method.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了提高无刷直流电机的控制效果;设计一种基于DSP芯片TMS320F2812的无刷直流电机控制系统。该系统采用双闭环结构控制。其中;电流采用电流滞环结构速度环采用增量式PID控制结构。同时介绍了霍尔位置信号检测电路、定子电流检测电路、驱动/逆变电路;给出相应的硬件电路。方案电路简单;可靠性强;具有较高的应用价值;实验结果验证了该方法的有效性。
keywords: bldcm, fully digital, the double closed loop structure, the incremental pid, tms320f2812
affiliations: 西安石油大学

title: 基于嵌入式ARM与ZigBee技术的智能家居系统
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems of smart home;a smart home system based on ARM;Zig Bee and Wi-Fi is designed in this paper.The system takes ARM920 T embedded processor S3 C2440 as the core;ARM Linux as real-time operating system;and uses the communication technology of Zig Bee and Wi-Fi.In the realization of low-power smart home;low-cost;self-network;security at the same time meet the needs of home appliances personalized control.

title: 电动汽车动力电池测试系统的变流及控制
abstract: The dynamic performance of power batteries directly affects the indicators of electric vehicles(EVs);such as starting; acceleration; mileage and fast charging. In this paper; the test requirements and method for power batteries are analyzed; and the variable power test which is closely combined with actual pavement conditions is selected with the dynamic stress test(DST) standard power curve as a reference curve. In addition; the requirements of battery testing equipment are simulated; and an interleaved bidirectional DC/DC converter is selected as the system’s topologymoreover; the operation principle of the converter is elaborated; together with the design parameters and control method.TMS320 F28335 was adopted as the control center; and a hardware test platform was built. Experiment results indicated that the proposed control method can realize rapid responses from the interleaved parallel bidirectional DC/DC converter;achieving a bidirectional flow of energy and satisfying the application requirements of EV power battery test.
abstract_in_chinese: 动力电池的动态性能直接影响电动汽车的起动、加速、续航、快速充电等指标。分析动力电池的测试要求和方法;选择结合实际路况的变功率测试;使用动态应力测试DST(dynamic stress test)标准功率曲线作参考曲线。模拟工况下电池测试设备要求;选用交错并联双向DC/DC变换器为拓扑结构;详尽阐述了变换器的工作原理;给出了参数设计和控制方法。采用TMS320F28335为控制核心;搭建了硬件实验平台进行测试。实验结果表明;所采用的控制方法能实现交错并联双向DC/DC变换器的快速响应;实现能量的双向流动;满足电动汽车动力电池测试的应用要求。
keywords: bidirectional dc/dc converter, dynamic stress test(dst), dynamic-state test, power battery

title: 无线楼宇安全监测系统的设计
abstract: The current monitoring system of building safety has some defects;such as limited applications andtoo many devices which result in high cost and inflexible network. To solve this problem;a wireless networktransmission system and its corresponding protocol for Z-Stack were designed. The system is mainly consisted byfour parts:a sensor module;a routing node module;a coordinating module and an upper computer module. ACC2530 chip was used as the core-controlling element of wireless sensor communication to effectively controlthree modules. Because the communication ability of CC2530 component was limited;then the other CC2591 chip was added to this module to expand the application of the system. The designed system realized thefunctions of receiving and sending data. The real-time dynamic situation of each sensor and routing could beobserved and controlled through the person-machine interface of upper computer. When the nodefailure occurred;the upper computer would alarm in time to alert the people who were around the fault node.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对楼宇安全监测系统使用范围不够大和使用器件过多;导致成本过高和组网不灵活等缺陷;研究并设计了一套无线网络传输系统以及对应的Z-Stack协议栈。系统主要由传感器模块、路由节点模块与协调器模块以及上位机组成;使用了CC2530芯片作为各个模块传感通讯的核心元件;并且用来有效的控制这三个模块。由于CC2530自带通信元件的使用范围有限;所以在此模块扩充一个CC2591芯片增加了系统的使用范围。设计的系统实现了节点接收和发送信息;并且在上位机PC机界面可以观察到每个传感器和路由的实时动态情况并且能远程控制;当节点故障时上位机及时的显示报警;并且在故障节点处发出警报提示周围的人员。
keywords: building monitoring, cc2530, remote control, wireless sensor node

title: 基于TMS320F28335的三相感应电机矢量控制系统的研究
abstract: In order to improve the traditional induction motor speed control method is difficult to meet the increasing requirements of the level of automation shortcomings and improve the speed control system of the motor control performance. Based on the TMS320 F28335; a vector control method is used in this paper. In the environment of photoelectric encoder as speed sensor; the flux linkage is observed through the current model and the magnetic field is oriented. Different types of parameter data are used to verify the experiment. The experimental results show that the flux-based observation based on the current model method can accurately orient the magnetic field. It is concluded that the vector control system based on DSP can greatly reduce the influence of parameter changes during the motor running; reduce the motor pulsation and improve the reliability and precision of the motor control effectively. The control performance can be completely matched with the direct current Motor comparable.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了改善三项感应电机传统调速方法难以满足日益进步的自动化水平要求的缺点;提高调速系统对电机的控制性能。本文基于TMS320F28335运用矢量控制方法;在以光电编码器为测速传感器的环境下;通过电流模型观测其磁链并进行磁场定向;分别使用不同类型的参数数据进行实验验证。实验结果表明基于电流模型法的磁链观测能够准确的进行磁场定向。得出结论:基于DSP的矢量控制系统能够极大的减小电机运行过程中参数变化的影响;同时减小电机脉动;有效的提高了电机控制的可靠性与精度;其控制性能完全可以与直流电动机相媲美。
keywords: current model, flux linkage, magnetic field orientation, speed control system, vector control
affiliations: 河南理工大学电气工程与自动化学院, Henan Polytechnic University, School of Electrical Engineering and Automation

title: Design of the Motor Driving System for Miro Sot Soccer Robot
abstract: In order to meet the functional requirements of Miro Sot soccer robot;such as small size;good maneuverability and strong anti-interference capability;a motor driving system for autonomous mobile robot which is swerved by two differential speed driving wheels is designed. Taking DSP-TMS320 LF2407 A as the core device;the speed control of the two DC motors for the two group wheels( right and left) is carried out through adopting PWM mode for speed regulation and driving the DC motor by the dual H bridge driver L298. As the dedicated DSP chip TMS320 LF2407 A for controlling the motor;its rich peripheral functions simplify the design of motor control circuit;and makes the circuit structure more compact and reasonable. In addition;due to the digital signal processor( DSP) chip;the speed sampling cycle of the soccer robot is shortened and the sampling accuracy is higher.The experiments show that this system can improve the hardware integration;stability;and control precision;as well as the motion performance of robot it also provides reference for DC motor drive applications in mobile robots and other occasions.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了满足Miro Sot足球机器人体积小、机动性好、抗干扰性强等要求;设计了一套两轮差速驱动转向移动机器人电机驱动系统。以DSP-TMS320LF2407A为核心器件;采用脉宽调制(PWM)方式进行调速。采用双H桥驱动器L298驱动直流电机;实现对左右两组车轮的两个直流电机的驱动调速控制。作为专用于电动机控制的数字信号处理器(DSP)芯片TMS320LF2407A;其丰富的外设功能简化了电机控制电路;使电路结构更趋紧凑合理。DSP芯片使得足球机器人的电机速度采样周期缩短、采样精度更大。试验表明;该系统提高了机器人的硬件集成度、稳定性能以及控制精度;改善了机器人的运动性能;也为直流电机在移动机器人及其他场合的驱动应用提供参考。
keywords: dc motor, driving system, dsp, l298, mirosot, pid algorithm, pwm, soccer robot

title: Electric Parameter Effective Value Measurement Algorithm for Servo Speed-Control System
abstract: A calculation method of effective value for the servo control system of non sinusoidal AC signal is presented.The method provides the frequency of the waveform;then determines the sampling number;executes the sampling in one cycle of the waveform and obtains the effective value of waveform.The algorithm is verified by the experimental platform built by TMS320 F2812;and the feasibility of the algorithm is proved.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种针对伺服调速系统非正弦交流变频信号的有效值计算方法。该方法首先确定波形的频率;然后确定采样次数;在一个周期内对波形进行实时采样;最终得出波形的有效值。借助TMS320F2812搭建的实验平台对算法进行验证;证明了算法的可行性。

title: Research and Design of a LED Intelligent Lighting System Based on Wireless Network
abstract: An intelligent LED lighting system based on wireless network is designed. The system is mainly composed of wireless module; gateway module; management system and data center. The system uses CC2530 as the control chip and ZigBee as the wireless communication protocol. At the same time; the gateway module is designed using Arduino; and the LED intelligent lighting system based on the wireless network is constructed to realize the basic LED dimming function.

title: Wireless remote monitoring system of power lithium battery pack based on ZigBee
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages of the traditional wired monitoring system in power lithium battery;such as poor mobility; power consumption; and difficult installation and maintenance; a wireless remote monitoring system in power lithium pack was set up by CC2530 chip based on ZigBee communication technology; and on this basis; the ZigBee network software was designed which was successfully implemented the power lithium battery voltage; current and temperature acquisition and display. The test results show that the wireless remote monitoring system has stable data transmission; high reliability; and low power consumption; which can be widely used in the wireless remote monitoring system of power lithium battery pack.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统动力锂电池组有线监控系统存在移动性差、功耗大、安装维护困难等缺点;采用了CC2530芯片组建了基于ZigBee通信技术的动力锂电池组实时无线远程监控系统;并在此基础上进行了ZigBee网络软件设计;实现了对动力锂电池组电压、电流及温度的采集与显示。实验结果表明该无线远程监控系统数据传输稳定、可靠性高、功耗低;可广泛应用于动力锂电池组无线监控领域。

title: Offline parameter estimation algorithm for induction motor in consideration of leakage inductance variation with frequency
abstract: In order to analyze the problem that the leakage inductance varies with current frequency because of the deep bar effect in squirrel-caged rotor that leads to the measured deviation of magnetizing inductance and rotor resistance;an offline parameter estimation algorithm for induction motors was proposed. Stator resistance was measured through DC test with the least square method while magnetizing inductance and rotor resistance were measured through low-frequency AC test. The proposed method eliminates the influence result from leakage inductance variation by identifying the magnetizing inductance and rotor resistance without the requirement of leakage inductance. Furthermore;the proposed algorithm identifies the nonlinear voltage drop on inverter and compensates for the voltage drop on inverter automatically to ensure the estimation precision. The magnetizing curve of induction motor is also obtained by estimating the magnetizing inductance under different levels of magnetizing. The effectiveness of the proposed estimation algorithm is validated on the platform of TMS320 F28035.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对电机转子的鼠笼结构会导致总漏感随电流频率的不同而发生变化给激磁电感和转子电阻的测量带来偏差的问题;提出了一种离线辨识电机参数的算法。采用直流实验结合最小二乘法辨识定子电阻;采用低频交流实验辨识激磁电感和转子电阻;且激磁电感和转子电阻的辨识无需电机总漏感参数;从而消除了转子漏感参数变化给辨识带来的影响。另外;辨识算法辨识逆变器的非线性压降模型并对逆变器压降进行补偿以提高算法精度;激磁电感的辨识在不同激磁水平下进行以得到电机的激磁曲线。在TMS320F28035实验平台上实现辨识算法;验证了算法的辨识精度。

title: Design of Wireless Networking System for Street Lamp Controllers Based on Mobile Terminal
abstract: Because the operating parameters of street lamp system can not be centrally controlled and the faults can not be detected and repaired in time;a solar street lamp controller monitoring system is designed based on the CC2530 wireless networking module and the HMI man-machine interface as the mobile control terminal. Based on CC2530 F256 as the main control chip; the system is briefly introduced from the overall design scheme to the hardware design and software design of the mobile control terminal node and street lamp system node; and the test of system loss rate. The experimental results show that the system has characteristics of low loss rate of data; stable performance and strong real-time performance. It also has a strong portability and can be widely used in smart home; online water quality and soil monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对现有路灯系统运行参数无法集中控制、故障无法及时发现检修等问题;本文介绍了一个以CC2530无线自组网模块为核心;以HMI人机界面为移动控制终端的太阳能路灯控制器监测系统。该系统以CC2530F256为主控芯片从系统的整体设计方案、移动控制终端节点和路灯系统节点的硬件设计、软件设计和系统的丢包率测试等几个方面对系统进行了介绍经实验获得的实测数据表明;设计的系统具有丢包率低、性能稳定、实时性强的特点;而且可移植性强;在智能家居;在线水质和土壤监测等领域也可有广泛的应用。

title: Design of FMCW Radar Level Meter Gauge
abstract: A kind of radar level meter was designed based on TMS320 F28335 as the core chip of DSP using frequency modulation continuous wave(FMCW)radar IVS-179. Hardware circuit of water level gauge was designed;and the realization of waveform generator and programmable filter amplifier circuit in the signal processing module was mainly introduced;realizing temperature module correcting distance and serial port communication transferring data. The specific software running workflow was described; heterodyne frequency signal frequency was measured according to WIN_FFT_CZT algorithm;and temperature correction parameter was corrected according to the linear fitting. Measurement done on the water level gauge prototype in the lab shows that single measuring time is about 68.5 ms;measurement accuracy is about 4 mm;which satisfies the requirement of real-time and accuracy of water level measurement.
abstract_in_chinese: 选用调频连续波(FMCW)雷达传感器IVS-179;设计了一种以TMS320F28335作为DSP核心芯片的雷达水位计。设计了水位计硬件电路并重点介绍了波形发生器及信号处理模块中可编程滤波放大电路的实现;采用温度传感器矫正测量距离、串口通讯传递数据。叙述了水位计软件运行的具体工作流程;采用WIN_FFT_CZT算法测量差频信号频率;并根据线性拟合法确定了温度矫正参数。制作了水位计样机;在实验室中测量显示单次测量时间约为68.5ms;测量精度约为4mm;满足对水位的实时测量及精度要求。
keywords: czt, fmcw, level meter gauge, linear fitting, temperature correction, tms320f28335

title: 基于ZigBee无线传感网络的交通信息采集系统设计
abstract: In order to reduce the incidence of traffic accidents;this paper designs a traffic information collection system based on ZigBee;the system mainly uses CC2530 RF chip combined with CC2592;it can achieve longer distance traffic and winter temperature and humidity detection. It constructs a wider range of tree wireless sensor networks and can provide reliable real-time traffic information. In terms of traffic information collection;with good usability and market value.
abstract_in_chinese: 为降低交通事故的发生率;设计了一种基于ZigBee交通信息采集系统;系统主要使用CC2530射频模块与CC2592远程扩展模块相结合;能够实现更远距离车流量以及冬季温湿度的实时检测。构建了一个较大范围的树形无线传感网络;能够实时提供可靠的路况信息;在交通信息采集方面;具有很好的实用性和市场价值。

title: 基于ZigBee技术的环境监测系统设计
abstract: Traditional environment monitoring system has some disadvantages;such as complex wiring;small monitoring range and large labor consumption.For the above disadvantages;a new monitoring system based on wireless sensor network was designed.In the new system;CC2530 MCU was chosen as the main control chip of every node;and the ZigBee routing protocol with GPRS network communication technology were applied to coordinate remote wireless transmission between the coordinator node and the host computer.The system has been verified to have the characteristics of low power consumption;large monitoring range;real-time monitoring and so on.It can be applied to environmental monitoring.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统环境监测系统布线复杂、监测范围小、人工成本高等问题;设计了基于无线传感网络的监测系统.选用CC2530型单片机作为网络中各个节点的主控芯片;以ZigBee路由协议组网;配合GPRS通信技术进行协调器节点与上位机之间的远距离无线传输.经仿真验证:系统节点功耗低、监测范围大、能够进行实时监测;可实际应用于环境监测中.
keywords: cc2530, environmental monitoring, ns2 simulation, wireless sensor networks, zigbee routing protocol

title: DSP大气中子单粒子效应试验研究
abstract: The research of the sensitive property of Digital Signal Processor(DSP)single event effect under the atmospheric neutron radiation environment was carried out based on the 14 Mev neutron radiation source in this paper. An experiment scheme on ground was designed including detection; experimental setup; testing procedure and criterion of the single event effect caused by atmospheric neutron. Different types of DSP; such as SMJ320F2812;SMJ320C6415;TMS320C6416;TMS320C6418; were used in the test. The results of the Single Event Upset(SEU)were acquired and then the cross section was calculated. The results show that the main sensitive phenomenon is single event upset; Single Event Function Interrupt(SEFI)occurred in some devices. The devices with the same feature size have the same order of the cross section magnitude; validating the feasibility of the experimental method. The results provide the basic data to evaluate the reliability and security of the avionic electronic equipments.
abstract_in_chinese: 利用14Me V快中子辐照源;开展了数字信号处理器(DSP)大气中子单粒子效应地面模拟试验研究。设计了地面模拟的试验方法;包括单粒子效应监测方法、试验系统布局、试验程序及其判据等。获得了SMJ320F2812、SMJ320C6415、TMS320C6416、TMS320C6418等多款型号DSP器件的中子单粒子效应的翻转错误数试验数据;分析计算得到14Me V中子辐照源下的敏感截面。结果显示;DSP器件的主要敏感现象为单粒子翻转(SEU);部分器件还发生了单粒子功能中断效应(SEFI)。相同工艺的被测DSP器件的中子单粒子效应敏感截面具有相同的数量级;验证了本文使用的地面模拟试验方法的可行性;为航空电子设备的可靠性与安全性评估提供了大气中子单粒子效应的器件级基础数据。
keywords: atmospheric neutron, dsp, sefi, sensitive cross section, seu
authors: Sun Xupeng;Yang Hui;Chen Dongmei;Zhong Zhengyu;Di Tong;Bai Hua;Feng Guoqiang;Co.Ltd.

abstract_in_chinese: 某导航控制计算机系统中;为了实现对AD信号的高精度的采集;采用了以TMS320C6748为核心;与ADS1258的组合的高精度、A/D数据采集系统。重点阐述了TMS320C6748外围电路的设计、ADS1258电路设计、硬件接口电路设计;以及SPI接口驱动的开发实现。通过系统联试等多种方法验证;设计方案采集精度高、系统运行稳定可靠;可满足某捷联惯性测量组合的要求。

title: 一种高精度多路信号采集系统的设计
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the measurement system and the integration;miniaturization and intelligent level of the measurement device;a high precision multi-channel signal acquisition system is designed.The system consists of power supply module;the front signal processing module;A/D conversion module;MCU module and the host computer and other components.In the system hardware design;high-performance multi-channel analog device ADS1256 as the core;high-performance processor STM32 F4 GZT6 as the main controller designed a high-precision multi-channel signal acquisition module;the module can set the range and sampling rateLabWindows/CVI programming of the host computer to achieve human-computer interaction.The accuracy of the module measurement is detected using an ultrahigh precision voltage source.The system can set the range and sampling rate through the host computer to realize the real-time adjustment of the sampling system and the sampling rate;and can be used for high-precision acquisition of multi-channel signal.
abstract_in_chinese: 为提高测量系统的精度和测量装置的集成化、小型化、智能化水平;设计了一种高精度多路信号采集系统。该系统由电源模块、前级信号处理模块、A/D转换模块、微控制单元(MCU)模块以及上位机等部分组成。在系统硬件设计中;以高性能多路模数转换器件ADS1256为核心、高性能处理器STM32F4GZT6为主控制器设计了高精度多路信号采集模块;该模块可以自主设置量程和采样速率;采用基于LabWindows/CVI编程的上位机实现人机交互。利用超高精度电压源检测了模块测量的精度。该系统可以通过上位机自主设置量程和采样速率;实现了采样系统量程和采样速率的实时调整;可用于多路信号的高精度采集。
keywords: adjustable range, ads1256, high-precision signal acquisition, host computer, stm32f4gzt6

title: 基于ZigBee的远程无线多点温度监测系统设计
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统温度监测系统布线不易改变、操作不便的缺点;提出一个采用Zig Bee和Android技术的远程多点温度监测系统的硬件和软件设计方案。系统在S5PV210芯片上构建嵌入式Linux网关服务器;使用CC2530芯片和SHT11传感器作为温度监测节点;开发了Android客户端软件;实现了远程多点温度监测和报警功能。实验结果表明;系统具有精度高、可靠性好和易于扩充的优点。

title: 基于TMS320C6678的粒子群算法并行设计
abstract: In view of the real-time requirement of PSO in practical applications; the parallelism of the algorithm is analyzed. Ac-cording to the architecture characteristics of TMS320C6678 multi-core processor; this paper designs a local parallel and global serial model; and maps the application program to multi-core processor efficiently. The experimental data shows that the design gives full play to the performance advantage of C6678 and improves the real-time processing capability of the system effectively. The design promotes the application of PSO algorithm in practice effectively and is of important significance to other kinds of swarm intelligent algorithm.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对粒子群算法在实际应用中的实时性需求;对算法的并行性进行分析;并根据TMS320C6678多核处理器的架构特点;设计出局部并行全局串行的并行模型;高效地将应用程序映射到多核处理器中。实验数据表明;该设计充分发挥了TMS320C6678的性能优势;有效提高了系统的实时处理能力。该设计有效地推进了PSO算法在实际中的应用;对其他各种群智能算法有重要的借鉴意义。
keywords: parallel processing, particle swarm optimization, speedup rate, tms320c6678

title: 表贴式永磁同步电机控制器的设计
abstract: For the single-phase AC input; SPMSM controller based on vector control is designed optimally with TMS320 F28335 DSP. The inverter frequency is enhanced by optimized design on software and hardware; and at last a prototype of 400 W permanent magnet synchronous motor controller is manufactured. Experimental results show that the motor controller based on vector control can effectively generate circular flux and obtain good steady state and dynamic performance.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对单相交流输入场合;采用DSP控制芯片TMS320F28335优化设计了基于矢量控制的表贴式永磁同步电机控制器。从软件和硬件上优化设计;提升逆变器工作频率;最终完成了一台400W永磁同步电机控制器原理样机。实验结果表明本文研制的永磁同步电机控制器能有效生成圆形磁链;具有良好的稳态和动态性能。

title: 基于嵌入式平台的网络视频监控系统应用
abstract: In view of monitoring requirements of many scenes such as important industrial sites around;home security and so on;which is automatic detection of intrusion target;intelligent PTZ control to tracking the movement of moving objects;remote terminal access;an economical;reliable and intelligent network video surveillance system is designed in this paper. The system chooses the embedded platform based on TMS320DM8168 digital media processor of the Da Vinci series as the core;receives video data of network camera through RTP network transmission protocol and then sends data to the network;optimizes the detection and tracking algorithm according to the system application scenarios;and according to the algorithm processing result controls the camera PTZ through the network;to ensure accurate tracking of the moving trajectory of the monitored target. The system solves the problem of automatic intelligent detection and tracking in network monitoring;and has the functions of scalability and product compatibility. The feasibility of the system is verified by the experimental results.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对重要工业场所周边、家居安防等场景下的自动检测入侵目标、智能控制云台跟踪目标运动轨迹、远程终端访问的监控需求;设计了一套经济、可靠、智能的网络视频监控系统。该系统选择以达芬奇系列的TMS320DM8168数字媒体处理器为核心的嵌入式平台;通过RTP网络传输协议接收网络摄像头的视频数据;进行处理后再发送到网络;根据系统应用场景优化检测跟踪算法;同时根据算法处理结果驱动网络控制摄像机云台转动;确保精确跟踪监控目标的运动轨迹。该系统解决了在网络监控方面的自动智能检测跟踪问题;并且具有功能扩展性和产品兼容性。研究实验的结果验证了这套系统的可行性。

abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前路灯能耗大、控制简陋等诸多问题;文中设计了一种基于ZigBee无线调光的LED路灯控制系统;采用LED路灯代替传统路灯。该路灯系统以CC2530芯片为核心控制部件;采用2.4 GHz-IEEE 802.15.4-ZigBee技术实现了控制中心和GPRS终端之间、GPRS终端与路灯之间及路灯与路灯之间的无线通信;通过改变PWM波的占空比来调节LED灯的亮度;显著减少了能耗。

title: 基于ZIGBEE通信的环境监测系统
abstract_in_chinese: 随着经济和科学的发展;蔬菜智能温室环境参数的自动化检测已成为发展趋势。传统环境监测系统需要大量布线;不易维护。本系统CC2530芯片为主控和信息传输节点;DHT11温湿度传感器定时进行温湿度采集;建立环境自动化检测系统;利用ZIGBEE组网技术进行节点布置和通信;经试验该系统布点灵活、能耗低、通信信号稳定。

title: 一种针对伺服调速系统输出电参量的有效值测量方法
abstract_in_chinese: 提出一种针对伺服调速系统非正弦交流变频信号的有效值计算方法。该方法首先确定波形的频率;然后确定采样次数;在一个周期内对波形进行实时采样;最终得出波形的有效值。借助TMS320F2812搭建的实验平台对算法进行验证;证明了算法的可行性。

title: 基于矢量控制的电动汽车用永磁同步电机系统研究
abstract: Considering the higher harmonic distortion and higher torque ripple caused by traditional PWM strategy when applied to electric vehicles;a permanent magnet synchronous motor system based on space vector pulse width modulation strategy for electric vehicle application was designed. The principle of space vector pulse-width modulation is described in detail;and the vector control system for PMSM was set up in MATLAB/Simulink. The id= 0 control strategy was used;and the system dynamic response was simulated. Digital signal processor( DSP) TMS320 F28335 of TI company was used as the main control chip to set up the experimental platform. The system status and efficiency below the base speed was studied in experiments. The simulation results and the experimental results show a good consistency. It provides practical value to PMSM system design and analysis.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对传统PWM调制技术运用到电动汽车时;存在的谐波含量较大;转矩脉动较高等缺点;设计了基于矢量控制的电动汽车用永磁同步电机系统。基于矢量控制的原理;在MATLAB/Simulink环境下搭建了永磁同步电机矢量控制系统模型;采用i_d=0控制策略;仿真研究了系统动态响应。以TI公司的数字信号处理器(DSP)TMS320F28335作为控制芯片;搭建了永磁同步电机控制系统实验平台;实验研究了电机系统在基速以下运行的状态和效率。仿真和实验结果具有很好的一致性;该研究可为电动汽车用永磁同步电机系统的设计和分析提供参考。
keywords: control strategy, dsp tms320f28335, matlab/simulink, pmsm(permanent magnet synchronous motor), vector control
