title: 输送带纵向撕裂监测系统图像采集处理器研究
abstract: 提出了一种多视点输送带纵向撕裂故障在线监测系统的设计方案;实现了输送带纵向撕裂的检测;提高了输送带的检测宽度;降低了线阵CCD相机与线阵LED光源方位调整的难度;提出了一种图像采集处理器的设计方案;实现了对多路线阵相机图像的采集、处理及传输。以TMS320C6678为核心设计了图像采集处理器的硬件电路。在集成开发环境CCS上;基于SYS/BIOS系统设计了图像采集处理器的软件;实现了对多路线阵相机的控制、多核调度及与上位机的通信。实验表明;该图像采集处理器实现了多路输送带图像的采集、处理和高速传输;最多可连接4路线阵相机;每路相机采集速率可达25 Mb/s;可用于多视点输送带纵向撕裂故障在线监测系统。
keywords: 多核调度, 多视点, 纵向撕裂, 线阵ccd相机, 输送带
authors: 刘意;苗长云;孟德军;万全婷

title: 基于TVP5158和DM3730的视频采集与编码系统研究
abstract: 针对新型综合船桥系统中的视频监控的应用需求;文章提出一种方法;即以DM3730为核心处理器;TVP5158作为视频AD转换和视频交织;把采集的交织数据通过DM3730的驱动进行解交织;并进行编码后;通过HDMI接口送入到显示单元;实现船只关键场所的监控。同时该系统可以通过网络TCP/IP传输给远程客户端;从而方便实现远程监控。

title: 基于LabVIEW的电能质量扰动信号发生器设计
abstract: 电力系统中电能质量问题对其敏感设备造成的危害日益严重;用户对电能质量要求越来越高。现阶段模拟电能质量扰动信号源的主要方法是基于单片机或FPGA的方法;这种方法存在设计复杂、人机交互不够友好等问题。根据电能质量的特性参数;给出一种基于虚拟仪器的电能质量扰动信号源的总体结构、硬件设计与软件设计。选用NI ELVIS II和DSP TMS320F2812开发板产生扰动信号;且通过LabVIEW设计的上位机界面进行信号显示与输出。系统测试表明;利用虚拟仪器技术设计的两套扰动信号源具有人机界面友好、易于操作及扩展性强等特点;具有一定的工程应用价值。

title: 基于ROS系统的三维风速流场移动测量系统设计
abstract: 针对空间流场风速的测量要求;提出基于ROS系统的三维风速流场测量系统设计。采用Cortex-A8AM3359微处理器作为主控制器;系统平台采用基于ARM平台的ROS系统;使用热球风速传感器测量空间中的风速并通过RM417采集模块传输数据。基于ROS平台设计了多个应用程序节点;用于实现传感器数据通信和电机驱动通信;通过利用ROS节点间消息传递机制实现三维移动传感器平台的控制和对传感器数据的采集;同时设计了上位机程序对移动平台进行模式的选择控制和数据的存盘;并利用MATLAB程序进行插值拟合产生三维风速流场分布图。经实验测试运行;此系统运行稳定;能准确测量和得到测量空间的风速和流场分布。

title: 基于DSP的光学望远镜二维扫描控制系统设计
abstract: 针对光学望远镜二维扫描系统对扫描角度和扫描速度等参数的高精度要求;采用双力矩电机伺服控制技术实现扫描系统设计要求;简述了双力矩电机作为二维扫描系统的核心控制部分的工作原理;重点介绍了双力矩电机的伺服系统设计。二维扫描系统主控芯片采用具有定点核与浮点核的TMS320F28335芯片。实际设计实验表明;二维扫描控制系统设计合理;运行满足设计要求;具有高精度、超低功耗的特点。

title: ZigBee在货场货物拣择系统中的应用
abstract: 在铁路货运中货物多以集装箱方式运输;在装载需运输的目标集装箱之前;需要从货物众多、面积较大的货场中拣择出目标集装箱;若依赖于人工拣择;则效率低下、耗时较多、易出错;为提高作业效率、节省人力和时间;设计了一种基于ZigBee的货场货物拣择系统。通过研究ZigBee的原理、组网方式、协议栈、硬件模块设计等;设计了基于CC2530和CC2591的终端节点和协调器节点;终端节点安装在集装箱上;协调器节点和上位机连接;负责终端节点和PC机的通信;并通过上位机控制通信过程;利用ZigBee的多跳自组网特性;实现信息的多跳远距离传输;使目标集装箱上终端节点发出声光提示;工作人员依据声光提示便可迅速、准确地定位目标位置;拣择出目标集装箱;经多次可靠性试验;证明了系统的可行性。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 上位机软件, 协调器节点, 终端节点
affiliations: 北京交通大学电气工程学院

title: 复合重复控制在电动汽车充电机谐波抑制中的应用
abstract: 针对PWM整流充电机网侧电流谐波抑制方法控制效果不理想的问题;提出复合重复控制（PIRC）策略。在建立PWM整流充电机数学模型和分析谐波特性的基础上;分析了传统PI控制存在的问题;根据模型;设计了PIRC复合重复控制器;并在MATLAB/Simulink环境下搭建单相PWM整流充电机仿真模型;分别对PIRC控制和PI控制进行了仿真分析;然后采用TMS320F2812作为控制器;在样机上对该两种控制方案进行了实验验证。仿真和实验结果表明采用PIRC方案当重复控制增益Krc=0.3时;充电机网侧电流THD从传统PI控制的7.43%下降到2.79%;验证了PIRC控制策略抑制充电机网侧电流中奇次谐波的有效性。
keywords: pirc控制器, pi控制, 电动汽车充电机, 谐波抑制

title: 电动汽车动力电池测试系统的变流及控制
abstract: 动力电池的动态性能直接影响电动汽车的起动、加速、续航、快速充电等指标。分析动力电池的测试要求和方法;选择结合实际路况的变功率测试;使用动态应力测试DST（dynamic stress test）标准功率曲线作参考曲线。模拟工况下电池测试设备要求;选用交错并联双向DC/DC变换器为拓扑结构;详尽阐述了变换器的工作原理;给出了参数设计和控制方法。采用TMS320F28335为控制核心;搭建了硬件实验平台进行测试。实验结果表明;所采用的控制方法能实现交错并联双向DC/DC变换器的快速响应;实现能量的双向流动;满足电动汽车动力电池测试的应用要求。
keywords: 动力电池, 动态工况测试, 动态应力测试（dst）, 双向dc/dc变换器

title: 基于物联网的智能电网监控系统研究
abstract: 随着电力系统的不断升级发展;电力系统服务的地区和人群也越来越广和越来越多;因此要求电力系统具备极高的容错性。加强对智能电网的稳定性、可靠性和安全性的有效监控对提升电力系统的服务质量具有非常重要的意义。采用物联网技术构建三层体系结构的智能监控系统;以CC2530-F256作为ZigBee射频芯片构建底层数据传感层;采用GPRS和4G技术构建通信网络层;以关系型数据作为上层的数据存储层;从而实现整个智能监控系统的高效运行。
keywords: 智能电网, 物联网, 电力系统, 监控系统

title: 输入串联输出并联双有源全桥DC-DC变换器多模块优化功率平衡控制方法
abstract: 通过分析电力电子变压器（PET）中的双有源全桥（DAB）DC-DC变换器的运行特征及所面临的问题;针对输入串联输出并联双有源全桥DC-DC变换器;基于三重相移（TPS）提出一种多模块优化功率平衡控制方法以同时提高变换器的效率及动态性能;并实现各个模块的传输功率均衡。相比于传统的输入电压均衡控制方法;该方法在不需要增加额外传感器的情况下;可以进一步提高变换器的效率;加强变换器对于输入电压突变时的响应能力并实现各个DAB模块的传输功率平衡。最后;搭建以TMS320F28335+FPGA
keywords: 动态性能, 双有源全桥dc-dc变换器, 多模块功率平衡, 效率, 电力电子变压器
affiliations: 西南交通大学电气工程学院
source: 北大核心;电工技术学报

title: 具有无功补偿功能的单相并网变流器矢量控制方法
abstract: 针对单相并网变流器在电压信号突变情况下传统虚构方法存在延时问题;提出一种新型矢量控制方法。在建立单相变流器数学模型基础上;利用相线电压的相量关系;构造出虚拟的三相电压信号。与目前延时3.33ms的瞬时电压dq分解法和延时5.0 ms的αβ检测法相比;实时性明显提高。设计了具有无功补偿功能的单相变流器控制策略。MATLAB/Simulink仿真验证了所提方法的正确性。基于IGBT模块F4-100R12KS4和32位DSP处理器TMS320F2812搭建了实验平台。实验结果表明;系统具有实时无功补偿功能和良好的动静态响应能力。
keywords: 单相变流器, 无功补偿, 矢量控制, 虚构方法

title: 基于快速排序算法的模块化多电平换流器电容电压均衡策略
abstract: 模块化多电平换流器（Modular Multilevel Converter;MMC）在模块数较多时;传统算法实现电压均衡将占据大量计算资源;影响系统的运行速度甚至动态响应特性。为此;提出一种基于快速排序算法的电容电压均衡策略。采用分治技术;基于比较、划分的思想实现模块电容电压排序;根据电容能量变化选择触发模块实现电容电压均衡。推导快速排序算法的时间复杂度和排序效率;分析算法对系统特性的影响;研究不同情况下基于快速排序算法的均衡策略的适应性。采用DSP控制器TMS320F28335测量算法的执行时间并在PSCAD/EMTDC中搭建MMC仿真模型;验证了基于快速排序算法的电容电压均衡策略的有效性和正确性;表明快速排序算法可以有效降低排序计算量;减少仿真时间;并且随着模块数的增加优势愈加明显。
keywords: 快速排序算法, 时间复杂度, 模块化多电平换流器, 电压均衡策略, 运行速度

title: 基于无线传感网的环境监测系统
abstract: 针对传统的环境监测系统有线传输布线和维护不便、施工周期长且不便扩展等缺陷;设计一种基于Zig Bee无线传感网的环境安全监测系统.数据采集节点以CC2530芯片为核心;对温湿度、烟雾浓度、空气粉尘浓度、甲醛浓度等环境参数进行采集并发送;以嵌入式微处理器为主控的协调器模块接收环境参数数据并处理后;通过WiFi上传至上位机和云服务器.实验结果表明;系统工作稳定、安装维护方便、可扩展性强;实现环境参数数据可靠传输;具有较高实用价值.
keywords: wifi, zigbee无线传感网, 传感器, 环境监测
affiliations: 福建师范大学协和学院信息技术系

title: 基于ZigBee传感网的农产品仓库环境监测系统
abstract: 为了加强农产品仓库的环境监测;基于ZigBee无线传感网的架构;采用MSP430g2231的MPU;采用DS18B20温度传感器;HS1101湿度传感器;CC2530的ZigBee芯片采用MSP430为核心MCU;DS18B20为温度传感器;HS1101为湿度传感器;LTH301-302的红外线对射型光电传感器为害虫计数传感器;设计了一种农产品仓库环境监测系统。具有成本低、能耗低、灵活布局的优点;能有效地减少农产品货损;具有良好的推广前景。
keywords: zigbee, 仓库, 农产品
affiliations: 福建农林大学交通与土木工程学院,  福建农林大学作物科学学院

title: 多路D/A转换信号发生装置设计
abstract: 在系统调试、工业测试中;常常需要产生多路复杂的、具有特殊要求的信号;故设计和实现了一种多路信号发生装置。该装置以TI公司的高性能DSP芯片TMS320F2812为核心;以BB公司的DAC7724作为数模转换芯片;并利用MAX3485芯片实现上位机与信号发生装置之间的485通信;用户可通过上位机界面控制信号发生装置输出多路不同波形。详细阐述了硬件各模块接口电路、软件流程及上位机软件设计;并通过试验表明;该信号发生装置能够按照用户需求输出多路任意形状波形。
keywords: dac7724, max3485, tms320f2812, 上位机, 信号发生, 数模转换

title: 基于CC3200的大棚温湿度无线控制系统设计（英文）
abstract: 针对传统大棚测量温湿度运用温度计和湿度计导致测量过程复杂、测量结果不精确以及控制系统操作繁琐的问题;设计了基于CC3200的温室大棚温湿度（temperature and humidity;TH）无线控制系统。该系统以FPGA作为主控制器;通过控制DHT22将温湿度信号发送至CC3200无线模块;进而实现了数据的远距离传输以及对系统的自动控制。

title: 基于ZigBee和Qt的高精度无线温控系统
abstract: 为了实现高精度温度测量的需求;设计了基于ZigBee和Qt的高精度无线温度监控系统。该系统协调器以CC2530为核心处理器建立ZigBee无线局域网;多个无线传感器终端节点进行连接;将数据通过USB串口上传到Qt上位机;上位机运用最小二乘法对数据进行标定;将处理后的数据在软件中实时显示曲线和数据。经过测试;系统运行稳定可靠;测量误差降低;分辨率达到0. 01～0. 1℃;满足高精度温度测量及远程监控的要求。
keywords: qt上位机, zigbee, 分布式温度测量, 无线通信

title: 工业高帧视频编码系统的设计与实现
abstract: 针对专用视频处理器TMS320DM8148不能直接采集Cammera Link接口的视频数据的问题;提出一种基于TI方案的编码系统;采用DSP+FPGA构架;FPGA以其优良的逻辑性;负责采集Cammera Link接口的视频数据;FPGA采集视频数据后缓存;然后通过GPMC传送给DM8148;DM8148通过内部各模块相互协作;实现编码。后期测试表明该方案视频显示流畅无误码;证明了该方案的可行性。

title: 基于CC2530与ZigBee技术智能家居硬件系统的设计
abstract: 结合ZigBee技术;充分运用CC2530强大的组网功能;利用CC2530芯片实现控制服务器与设备间的数据传输和控制;提出智能家居中的环境监测方案;设计各元器件的电源转换模块;完成温湿度检测模块、空气质量检测模块、可燃气体检测模块的硬件设计。经检测;环境监测系统能灵敏地获取温度、湿度、有害气体检测数值;完成对家居环境的伺服检测。
keywords: cc2530, mcu, zigbee, 有害气体检测

title: 基于物联网技术和Android系统的智能宿舍的设计与实现
abstract: 在物联网技术和Android系统的基础上;以学生宿舍为研究对象;建立一个对学生宿舍环境实时监测与家电管理的智能化系统。该系统以ZigBee近距离无线传输协议组建宿舍控制监测网络;采用CC2530作为子节点核心控制处理器;实现宿舍的灯光、空调、窗帘、安防、空气监测等智能化控制;并通过增设服务器以及开发Android应用程序;实现手机或笔记本远程对宿舍中的设备进行监测和控制。实践表明;所提出的智能宿舍解决方案;顺应时代与科技的发展方向;在改善学生学习和生活环境的同时;增强用户体验;具有较高的市场前景和实用价值。
keywords: android, cc2530, zigbee, 智能宿舍, 物联网
authors: 章万静;周文技;刘长荣;徐义晗

title: 基于ZigBee和云平台的葡萄霜霉病防控系统的设计与应用
abstract: 以防控葡萄霜霉病为背景;针对传统喷施农药的方法无法避免果实残毒和食品安全等问题;设计并实现基于ZigBee和云平台的葡萄霜霉病防控系统。该系统采用CC2530构建ZigBee环境监控网络;根据实时采集的空气相对湿度、光照强度参数进行数据整合;整合数据与预设病变阈值参数对比;确定控制节点的开启与关闭以实现智能防控;提高系统防控的有效性;另外;系统基于TCP/IP协议的GPRS通信实现数据交互;用户通过远程监控中心可对葡萄生长环境进行实时监测和病变阈值在线决策。通过实地运行测试;试验表明该系统功能可靠、运行稳定、操作方便;具有一定的应用前景。
keywords: gprs, zigbee, 云平台, 数据整合, 病变阈值, 葡萄霜霉病
authors: 刘斌;来智勇;杨宁;苏鹏飞

title: 基于物联网的地铁隧道断面监测系统的设计
abstract: 为了满足地铁隧道安全信息监测的需要;设计一种远程地铁隧道断面监测与预警系统。系统主要由分布在隧道断面上的监测点和云服务器监控中心两部分组成。监测点以CC2530芯片为核心;使用智能倾角传感器采集断面倾角变化数据;并结合Zig Bee无线传感技术和GPRS通信技术将数据上传至云服务器监控中心。通过定制通信协议实现倾角数据的收发存储和查询功能。实践证明;系统结构稳定可靠;具有一定的先进性和推广性;为准确预测地铁隧道的安全情况提供参考。
keywords: cc2530, gprs, zigbee, 云服务器, 地铁隧道, 断面监测

title: 飞行设备中的新型实时数据传输系统设计
abstract: 针对飞行设备内部各种传感器的数据传输方式为有线传输现状;无形中加大了布线安排、体积增大、成本增加以及无法实时获取数据和数据质量低等问题;设计一种基于CC3200的WiFi数据传输模块。该模块以FPGA作为主控核心单元;并辅以滤波电路、模/数转换电路;最终通过CC3200将处理好的数字信号数据发送给控制中心。经过试验;测试结果符合具体预定要求并且性能稳定、可靠;没有出现数据丢失的情况;现已成功应用于某航天测试系统中。

title: 基于Android和ZigBee的嵌入式Web服务器设计
abstract: 针对基于传统C/S结构的Web服务器软硬件成本高、移动不便等问题;提出一种基于Android和ZigBee的温室监测系统的嵌入式Web服务器设计方案。该服务器的硬件部分由Zig Bee协调器以及嵌入式Android设备组成;Android设备的MCU采用Exynos 4412处理器;Zig Bee协调器采用CC2530作为核心模块;它们之间通过串口相互通信。服务器软件部分采用Android自带的SQLite数据库存储数据;并使用PHP脚本和Ajax技术来实现温室传感数据的实时监测。实验结果表明;该设计方案解决了C/S模式下服务器成本高、部署不便的问题;并且实现了对温室的远程实时监测。
keywords: android, c/s结构, sqlite数据库, web服务器, zigbee, 嵌入式设备
affiliations: 西南大学工程技术学院
source: 北大核心;现代电子技术

title: 光伏水泵最大功率跟踪控制系统的设计与实现
abstract: 根据我国西北部地区水资源比较贫乏和光照条件相对比较充足这一特点;光伏水泵系统能够通过太阳能将地下水资源进行合理地利用;同时为了提高太阳能的利用率;设计一套光伏水泵最大功率跟踪控制系统。该系统由TMS320F28335芯片、DC/DC变换器、智能逆变功率模块、直流变换功率、光电隔离、母线电压电流采样检测等电路构成。利用CCS3.3开发平台;设计主控程序、电压空间矢量控制、最大功率跟踪控制和其他子程序等。实验结果表明;设计的光伏水泵系统能够实现最大功率跟踪控制功能;提高直流电压利用率。
keywords: 光伏水泵, 最大功率跟踪, 矢量控制
affiliations: 苏州市职业大学电子信息工程学院

title: 基于Android平台的智能蓝牙防丢器的设计
abstract: 本设计利用现在已普及的智能手机为载体;设计了一款基于Android平台和低功耗蓝牙技术的智能防丢器。防丢器由两部分组成;一部分是与物件绑定在一起的从机;一部分是用户所持有的主机。当从机和主机建立蓝牙连接以后;防丢系统便正式开始运行。从机部分采用支持蓝牙4.0BLE的CC2540芯片;主机部分是常见的Android手机。在安卓系统上完成对检测软件的编程。该软件能够通过手机与蓝牙芯片之间的信号强度值来进行报警。文章阐述了Android蓝牙连接的一些细节并对判断逻辑的实现做出解释。
keywords: android系统, 低功耗蓝牙, 防丢器
affiliations: 北京林业大学理学院,  北京工业大学计算机学院

title: 基于多核DSP的信号分选软件设计与实现
abstract: 介绍了一种基于TMS320C6678的信号处理分选软件架构设计及实现方法;该技术可实现雷达侦察设备信号分选模块的小型化;进一步优化软件模块后可实现信号分选的多核并行处理;提高对复杂信号环境的适应能力。
keywords: tms320c6678, 多核软件开发套件, 并行处理

title: 基于ZigBee技术的环境监测系统设计
abstract: 针对传统环境监测系统布线复杂、监测范围小、人工成本高等问题;设计了基于无线传感网络的监测系统.选用CC2530型单片机作为网络中各个节点的主控芯片;以ZigBee路由协议组网;配合GPRS通信技术进行协调器节点与上位机之间的远距离无线传输.经仿真验证:系统节点功耗低、监测范围大、能够进行实时监测;可实际应用于环境监测中.
keywords: cc2530, ns2仿真, zigbee路由协议, 无线传感器网络, 环境监测
source: 河南科技学院学报(自然科学版)

title: 中性束注入器多通道远程真空测量系统设计
abstract: 为满足中性束注入器多点、远程真空监测的需要;设计了基于STM32的多通道远程真空测量系统。该系统采用规管传感器测量得到真空室的真空度电压信号;采样芯片ADS1256测量经信号调理电路调理后的规管电压信号;以STM32F103ZET6作为主控芯片;结合模数转换电路、基准电压产生电路及其他电路;将处理后的数据由以太网传输到上位机;利用上位机软件实现对中性束注入器真空状态的实时监测、预警和分析。测试结果表明:该系统稳定有效运行;适用于中性束注入器真空度测量。
keywords: stm32, 中性束注入器, 多通道, 测量, 真空, 远程

title: 一种凸极式永磁同步电机闭环MTPA控制策略研究
abstract: 针对基速以下时采用最大转矩电流比控制的闭环矢量控制系统中;当给定转矩或负载转矩突变时;因电流调节器饱和而导致电机动态跟踪过程中实际工作状态脱离MTPA的问题;对凸极式永磁同步电机的MTPA控制、控制器饱和限幅等方面进行了研究。提出了一种d轴电流环优先响应的控制器限幅策略;以优化系统动态跟踪过程中的电流跟踪轨迹提升稳定性;在此基础上;提出了一种采用q轴反馈电流在线修正d轴给定电流的闭环MTPA控制策略;利用Matlab/Simulink搭建了系统仿真模型;并利用基于TMS320F28335的电机控制系统对闭环MTPA控制策略进行了实验研究。研究结果表明:该控制策略在转矩突变时;d轴给定电流可以实时修正;并迅速跟踪;维持电机在动态跟踪过程中实际电流矢量在MTPA附近。
keywords: 凸极式永磁同步电机, 最大转矩电流比控制, 矢量控制, 限幅

title: 基于ZigBee物联网技术的智能家居系统设计
abstract: 设计了一种实用的基于Zig Bee技术的智能家居系统;同时设计了上位机和移动APP程序用于数据采集和控制。通过对CC2530片上系统的设计;以及Z-Stack协议栈修剪;可以快速的提高硬件系统的扩展性以及系统软件开发的便捷性;因此缩短了开发应用时间成本和生产成本。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 上位机, 手机应用, 智能家居
authors: 宋小东;李智博;申高展;罗璇
affiliations: 承德石油高等专科学校热工系,  中国船舶重工集团公司第七0二研究所

title: 基于TMS320C6678的复数求模算法研究
abstract: 得益于强大并行处理能力;TMS320C6678在信号处理中应用十分广泛;特别是雷达信号处理领域。信号处理中经常需要对复数求模;而传统的求模方法在TMS320C6678上效率极低;严重影响了其处理效率。本文针对TMS320C6678进行了复数求模算法的优化研究;并给出了四种复数求模算法的效率和精度的对比。
keywords: 复数向量求模, 复数求模, 求模优化
affiliations: 西安电子工程研究所

title: 基于物联网的中药材生长环境信息采集系统研究
abstract: 为了实时了解中药材生长环境信息;提出了一种基于物联网的中药材生长环境信息采集系统设计方案。以CC2530芯片为核心构建了一个Zig Bee网络;运用Cluster-Tree路由算法提高路由查找和传送数据功能;利用卡尔曼滤波算法对采集数据进行融合处理;系统可实现对影响中药材生长的主要环境信息实时采集;主要解决中药材生长环境信息动态采集和数据管理;为中药材生长环境调控提供参考数据。
keywords: cluster-tree算法, 中药材, 信息采集, 卡尔曼滤波算法, 物联网
affiliations: 亳州职业技术学院信息工程系,  亳州职业技术学院智能工程系
source: 佳木斯大学学报(自然科学版)

title: 智慧粮仓数据采集处理系统设计
abstract: 以CC2530单片机技术为核心;运用物联网星型网络拓扑结构进行智慧粮仓数据采集处理系统设计;完成数据采集系统的硬件电路设计及软件编程。根据粮食存储要求;利用温湿度等传感器实现粮仓粮情信息数据的采集和传输处理;并通过Zigbee无线传感网络、Internet网络将粮仓内粮情参数传输存储到远程监控中心;从而实现粮食仓储智能化管理。
keywords: zigbee技术, 数据采集, 智慧粮仓

title: 基于太阳能光伏电池组件的微芯片电源电路设计
abstract: 采用无线通信技术实现太阳能光伏组件的电流、电压、温度等重要数据采集、传输、汇聚;一般必须安装数据采集和通信控制电路板在太阳能光伏组件板上.电路板上主控微芯片工作电压在3.3 V左右;若用太阳能光伏电池组件发电为微芯片提供电能;则有必要研究设计一种特殊的供电电路;该电路必须具备适于比较宽的输入电压范围;确保输出的低电压不变;工作效率高;考虑充分利用微芯片资源;简化设计;降低成本.针对CC2530微芯片设计研究一种自适应宽动态电源电路;该电路巧妙利用CC2530芯片中的MCU产生PWM波实现电源控制;获得稳定的3.3 V输出电压值;解决太阳能光伏的组件数据采集电路板安全稳定的供电问题.其创新之处在于实现了一片CC2530芯片采集数据、无线通讯和电源管理的目的;简化了电路;省去了传统采用的独立DC-DC电源模块.实验证明;基于CC2530芯片设计的自适应宽动态电源电路工作效率高;输出电压稳定.
keywords: 光伏电池组件, 太阳能, 微芯片, 电源, 电路设计
authors: 徐鹏飞;钟万熊;朱黎;尧志伟;黄定懿
affiliations: 湖北民族学院信息工程学院,  国网利川市供电公司团堡供电所
source: 湖北民族学院学报(自然科学版)

title: 面向套色系统的CAN-Ethernet网关设计
abstract: 工业以太网技术的快速发展使套色控制系统的远程技术支持成为了可能。面向套色控制系统;提出一种基于CAN-Ethernet网关的设计方案;以实现更为精准的套色、更快的印刷速度。该网关设计方案以TI公司的高性能TMS320F28335芯片为核心、外扩网卡芯片DM9000A和CAN收发控制器为基础;通过移植Lwip协议栈与CANOpen协议栈到DSP作为数据传输平台;以工业领域应用广泛的Modbus协议作为应用层协议;实现人机界面终端与套色单元盒之间有效的传输。测试实验结果表明;该网关可以满足套色控制系统的实时显示要求。
keywords: can-ethernet网关, modbus, 套色控制系统, 工业以太网

title: 基于ZigBee无线网络技术的LED无极调光及控制系统
abstract: 针对目前LED照明系统功耗大、控制系统复杂和亮度调节非智能化等诸多问题;本文设计了一种基于Zig Bee的LED无极调光及控制系统。该系统采用CC2530实现网络远端数据传输;建立网络;与集成PWM芯片SY5802A组成PWM模拟调光方式实现无级调光。其也设置了上位机;能实时显示监控电压、电流及功率等指标信息;并且可以远端控制LED亮度。
keywords: cc2530, led照明, sy5802a, zigbee, 无极调光

title: 基于zigbee的压力传感器数据采集系统设计
abstract: <正>本文设计了一种基于zigbee的压力传感器数据采集系统;该系统采用CC2530微处理器;结合zigbee协议栈Z-Stack;实现压力数据通过zigbee网络自动采集。压力传感器的输出信号通过16位的高精度∑-?型AD7705进行模数转换;协调器节点收到的数据能够通过AT24C04进行存储;达到掉电保存。整个系统稳定可靠;更换不同的传感器;可轻松实现不同应用需求。

title: 基于LMX2594的K波段频率源的设计与实现
abstract: 介绍了一种K波段频率源的设计方法。本文采用LMX2594数字锁相环芯片;并用C8051F330单片机对锁相环芯片进行操作;然后再倍频的方法实现了实现了该K波段频率源的设计。该频率源具有频率稳定度高;相位噪声低;杂散低等优点。测试结果表明该频率源的相位噪声为-90dBc@1kHz;-98dBc@10kHz;输出功率大于10dBm;可以满足系统的各项要求。
keywords: k波段, 杂散, 相位噪声, 锁相环, 频率源
affiliations: 成都信息工程大学

title: 基于FMCW的近距离测距系统设计
abstract: FMCW（调频连续波）雷达由于其自身的良好特性;被广泛应用于各种领域;测距是其最基本的功能之一。本文基于雷达收发器IVS-162和TMS320F28335设计了一套近距离测距系统。首先;研究分析了FMCW雷达测距系统的工作原理;然后对雷达收发器IVS-162的工作原理与三角波调制信号理论进行分析研究;设计实现三角波发生电路、差频信号处理电路、数模转换和数字信号处理电路。最后给出被测目标距离的测试结果;结果表明系统可以对近距离目标进行有效测量。
keywords: 信号处理电路, 模数转换, 测距, 雷达收发器

title: 基于STM32单片机的便携式空气净化器设计
abstract: 设计了一种基于STM32单片机为核心的空气净化系统。利用温湿度传感器、PM2.5传感器检测室内外空气质量;将采集到的数据传输给STM32单片机;利用过滤网及负离子发生器净化空气;并将收集的数据通过单片机与cc2530芯片通信;可将PM2.5含量、温湿度数据通过zigbee协议发送给装有cc2530接收芯片的服务器;构成物联网络实时监控区域空气质量。经实验测试;该系统具有高精度、低功耗、抗扰能力强、过滤性能好等优点;实际应用价值高;市场前景广阔。
keywords: pm2.5传感器, stm32单片机, 空气净化器

title: 基于ZigBee的水产养殖水质控制管理系统设计
abstract: 传统大型水产养殖场凭养殖户的经验;通过观察水体颜色、鱼类异常行为以及闻水味的方式监测水质;导致监测随意性大、出错几率高、费时费力;因此设计了基于Zig Bee无线网络的水质管理系统;该系统以德州仪器CC2530芯片为核心构建了一个无线传感网络;该网络可实时采集监测点温度、溶解氧含量、p H、亚硝酸盐浓度、浊度等数据;并传送到PC上位机。PC上位机同时依据水质情况;通过SMT32F101控制器控制供氧泵;水阀、投饵机等设备;及时对水质异常等状况进行及时处理。试验表明;水质数据的传输速率可达到140 kb;有效传输距离在150 m以上;系统具有可扩展性强、功耗低、稳定性高等特点;能够满足水质监控、增氧、定时投饵、病害防治方面的功能要求。
keywords: zigbee, 实时监控, 水产养殖, 自动控制
authors: 高磊;高伟;周勇;牛文学;赵永来;刘文枝;王利鹤

source: 北大核心;中国农业科技导报

title: 基于物联网的农业生产监控系统设计
abstract: 针对农业大棚种植作物对环境参数的要求;提出了一种基于物联网技术的农业生产监控系统。基于CC2530核心芯片完成无线传感器网络的组建;并构建系统网关;准确获取环境参数信息;通过与服务器对接实现数据交换。在服务器搭建的网页平台界面;能够实现大棚变化的实时监控。试验表明:该农业自动化生产监控系统可操作性强;传输数据快捷稳定;控制准确;实用价值较高。
keywords: 农业生产, 无线传感器网络, 物联网, 监控

title: 基于MEMS传感器的煤矿井下人员定位系统设计
abstract: 针对现有井下人员定位系统存在定位精度低及成本高等问题;设计了基于MEMS传感器的煤矿井下人员定位系统。该系统采用MPU9150惯性传感器获取测量数据;以CC2530为主控芯片实现数据的采集、处理;通过井下已有的WiFi基站;并结合行人航迹推算算法实现井下人员的精确定位:利用融合了行走频率和加速度方差的表达式来确定步长;采用四元数法估计行人方向角;并根据扩展卡尔曼滤波对方向角的原始数据进行修正;从而获得井下人员的具体位置。实验结果表明;在100m距离内;该系统的定位误差小于2.2m;能够实现煤矿井下人员的高精度定位。
keywords: mems传感器, 人员定位, 扩展卡尔曼滤波, 步态估计, 煤矿井下, 行人航迹推算
affiliations: 重庆工程职业技术学院机械工程学院,  成都理工大学工程技术学院

title: 基于TMS320F28035的移相式感应加热电源研究
abstract: 近年来;感应加热技术日趋成熟;应用日益广泛。异相式感应加热电源是根据硬件电路参数在Simulink中建立电源系统的仿真模型;并获得仿真结果;然后以DSP作为主控芯片;建立样机并进行调试。结果表明:在感应加热过程中进行异相调功是可行的。
keywords: dsp, 异相式调功, 感应加热, 电源
affiliations: 内蒙古科技大学信息工程学院

title: 基于物联网的太阳能路灯控制系统的研究
abstract: 针对太阳能路灯控制系统采集的数据不能实时共享;路灯与路灯之间不能相互通信等问题;设计了一种基于物联网的太阳能路灯控制系统;该系统采用STM32F103为主控芯片;2.4 GHz的CC2530芯片为Zig Bee通信电路的微处理器;并与主控芯片进行通信;实现了路灯与路灯之间相互通讯、自组织网络;数据的实时采集上传;路灯的智能化管理。
keywords: 太阳能, 物联网, 路灯
source: 齐齐哈尔大学学报(自然科学版)

title: 一种便携式无线有毒气体检测仪的设计
abstract: 为提高动火现场的环境监察程度;提出了以STM32L151RBT6低功耗微控制器为核心的便携式有毒气体检测仪;采用电化学式气体传感器对有毒气体进行检测;运用cc1101这种高性能射频收发器实现无线数据传输功能;采用USB接口方式实现数据上传和充电功能;提出了检测仪中的硬件和软件设计;实验调试表明;有毒气体检测精度均符合国标要求;在石油化工等领域具有极高的应用价值。
keywords: stm32l151rbt6, 无线通信, 有毒气体, 电化学

title: Smart Home Speech Recognition and Control System Based on CC3200
abstract: Based on various theories and technologies such as speech recognition;wireless communication;intelligent control;cloud computing and wireless sensor;this paper designs an smart home speech recognition control system with CC3200. The system uses a voice recognition module made by iFLYTEK to collect the speech and uses the UART communication protocol and CC3200 serial module to achieve the communication between the Upper and Lower Computer. In the end;the CC3200 uploads the preprocessed date to the cloud server to complete the analyses and transmits the commands received from cloud to the control terminals;by which to realize the function of intelligently controlling home furnishings by using voice. In addition;the system has the advantages of convenient operation and low cost.
keywords: cc3200, cloud server, smart home, voice recognition, wireless communication

title: Design of extreme low fundamental power scheme for wireless Ad Hoc Networks
abstract: Wireless ad hoc networks are faced with many extreme challenges in the field of civil metrology;where battery-powered nodes must be able to sustain for more than 10 years.Through the analysis of the existing open source IOT operating systems; this paper presents a very low basic power scheme design;which creates a soft timer in the kernel to control operating systems’ clocks;in order to reduce power consumption.The scheme shows that the average current of CC1310 node is no more than 2.4 uA during inactivity on contiki operating system;and the proposed scheme can be ported on different hardware platforms.
keywords: contiki, extreme low power, soft-timer, wireless ad-hoc networks

title: Forest fire detection system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: To deal with high false alarm rate and difficult position problems of the traditional forest fire detection;an unmanned aerial vehicle was taken as the platform;cradle head tracking system carried with color and infrared camera to realize the automatic detection;identification and location of forest fire was put forward.The embedded platform was based on DM3730;the recognition of the flame was realized by getting the real-time infrared camera image processing;and cradle head dynamic tracing was driven.Combined with airborne GPS/IMU navigation information and track cradle head posture information;accurate fire positioning was completed.The color image obtained was returned to ground in real-time to realize monitoring fire on-line.In the field of flame recognition algorithm;BP neural network was used to train and identify.The effectiveness of BP neural network algorithm is verified by comparing with SVM recognition algorithm.In the field of positioning;the validity of the calculation method is verified by comparing the calculated latitude and longitude of the fire field with the actual latitude and longitude in the actual flight.
keywords: bp neural network, embedded, fire positioning, flame recognition, svm algorithm

title: Design of Wireless ad Hoc Network Welding Parameters Monitoring System Based on ZigBee and Virtual Instrument
abstract: In view of difficult process management; complicated wiring and high cost in welding field; a wireless ad hoc network monitoring system for welding parameters was designed based on Zig Bee and virtual instrument. The wireless communication technology of Zig Bee was used in the wireless interaction of each node in the system; the RF SOC chip CC2530 was used as the core; the Holzer current and voltage sensors were selected; and the hardware and program of sensor terminal node and coordinator node were designed. The serial port conversion technology was used to communicate with the host computer; and the virtual instrument technology was used to realize the data processing and display of the monitoring system application program. Finally; the centralized management and automatic monitoring of distributed welding equipment in welding field were realized.
keywords: virtual instrument, welding parameters monitoring system, zigbee
affiliations: Chongqing Industry Polytechnic College, Department of Automobile Engineering

title: Design of monitoring system in henhouse environment based on ZigBee
abstract: Aiming at the problems that some henhouse environments are bad so that hens are easily infected by some bacteria and viruses; environmental monitoring system in henhouse is developed based on ZigBee 2007/PRO and android application. Three main parameters; such as temperature and humidity; illumination intensity and ammonia concentration are collected; and then ventilators and lights are controlled. The system employs CC2530 of TI Company as coordinators and terminals. Sensors and control devices are connected with terminals; which are properly distributed in henhouse; and then ZigBee2007/PRO is used to build ZigBee star network. Environmental parameters are collected from terminals and transferred to a coordinator and mobile phone; and then the coordinator handles the environment parameter data and sends the instruction to the control terminal node to form the whole monitoring system.
keywords: cc2530, control, environmental parameters detection, henhouse, zigbee
affiliations: College of Engineering and Technology, Tianjin Agricultural University

title: Sound Source Orientation System based on DSP
abstract: A sound source orientation system based on TMS320F2812 processor; developed and designed on the Code Composer Studio 5.5 integrated environment is described. The sound source orientation software system involves three main modules including sound signal acquisition; the sound signal preprocessing and the sound source orientation. The sound source orientation adopts a generalized cross-correlation delay and direction-finding cross-directional algorithm based on a planar quad cross array. The azimuth estimation of the target sound source is achieved by the direction information of the sound source target relative to the sensor nodes and the coordinate information of each sensor in the system. This system is designed with the generalized cross-correlation delay and direction-finding cross-directional algorithm; so as to obtain the information of the direction angle and the azimuth angle; and then the information is sent to the microcontroller for orientation respectively. Finally; the experimental results indicate that the overall design of the system is feasible and stable; and the precision is high in the condition of high SNR.
keywords: azimuth estimation, generalized cross-correlation, sound source orientation, tms320f2812
affiliations: Nanyang Institute of Technology

title: Residential Air Quality Monitoring System Based on ZigBee Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: In this paper;a residential air quality monitoring system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network was designed.The system collected all kinds of indoor air quality parameters（indoor PM2.5 concentration;carbon dioxide concentration;temperature and humidity;etc.）by ZigBee terminal arranged in each room.Monitoring data information was sent to the user’s mobile phone through GSM module to realize the real-time reminder function.PC terminal was used to realize the real-time display and storage of monitoring data.The field test results showed that the system had stable operation;convenient maintenance;reliable information transmission;strong usability in residential environment;and had a good application prospect.
keywords: air quality monitoring, cc2530, residential environment, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Repton High School,Derby,UK

title: Design of ZigBee-WiFi Gateway for Vacuum Oven
abstract: In the process of power battery production;it is necessary to put battery into vacuum oven for drying;the temperature;the vacuum degree and other factors directly influence the quality of the power battery. In order to remotely control the temperature and vacuum degree of vacuum oven in the process of power battery manufacturing;the wireless communication system based on the Zig Bee-Wi Fi gateway for the power battery production is presented. The system uses wireless module CC2530 as the core chip;to complete the machine networking in workshop;and use of Wi Fi wireless module ESP8266 to complete data interconnection Zig Bee and Wi Fi network;implement the data information exchange and sharing between the vacuum oven and the Internet.This wireless communication system has the characteristics with easy networking;low power consumption and low cost. So;this communication system can meet the requirement of data transmission and sharing in power battery manufacturing and other production activities.
keywords: battery drying, monitoring system, vacuum oven, wireless communication, zigbee
affiliations: School of Information Engineering,Guangdong University of Technology, Guangdong Zhengye Technology Co.,Ltd
source: 国际设备工程与管理(英文版).

title: Study on Algorithm of Complex Number Modulus Based on TMS320C6678
abstract: TMS320 C6678 is widely used in digital signal processing algorithms due to its powerful parallel processing capability;especially in radar digital signal processing field. The complex number modulus is often needed to be calculated in digital signal processing;however very low efficiency of the traditional algorithm for complex modulus calculation on TMS320 C6678 affects its processing efficiency seriously. Based on TMS320 C6678;optimization of complex modulus algorithm is studied; comparison results of four algorithms in efficiency and accuracy are provided.
keywords: complex number modulus, complex number vector modulus, optimization of complex number modulus algorithm
affiliations: Xi’an Electronic Engineering Research Institute

title: Experimental Investigation of DSP Single Event Effect Caused by Atmospheric Neutron
abstract: The research of the sensitive property of Digital Signal Processor（DSP）single event effect under the atmospheric neutron radiation environment was carried out based on the 14 Mev neutron radiation source in this paper. An experiment scheme on ground was designed including detection; experimental setup; testing procedure and criterion of the single event effect caused by atmospheric neutron. Different types of DSP; such as SMJ320F2812;SMJ320C6415;TMS320C6416;TMS320C6418; were used in the test. The results of the Single Event Upset（SEU）were acquired and then the cross section was calculated. The results show that the main sensitive phenomenon is single event upset; Single Event Function Interrupt（SEFI）occurred in some devices. The devices with the same feature size have the same order of the cross section magnitude; validating the feasibility of the experimental method. The results provide the basic data to evaluate the reliability and security of the avionic electronic equipments.
keywords: atmospheric neutron, dsp, sefi, sensitive cross section, seu
authors: Sun Xupeng;Yang Hui;Chen Dongmei;Di Tong;Zhong Zhengyu;Bai Hua;Feng Guoqiang
affiliations: Beijing San-talking Testing Engineering Academy, Co.Ltd.

title: Design and Realization of Signal Sorting Software Based on Multicore DSP
abstract: This paper introduces the architecture design and realization method of signal sorting software based on TMS320C6678.The technology can realize the miniaturization of signal sorting module in the radar reconnaissance devices;and can also realize the multicore parallel processing of signal sorting and increase the adaptability for the complex signal environment after the further optimisation for signal sorting software module.
keywords: multi-core sofeware development kit, parallel processing, tms320c6678
affiliations: The 723 Institute of CSIC

title: Design of Phase-Shifted Full Bridge Drive Circuit Based on DSP28335+IR2110
abstract: In order to solve the problem of phase-shifted full-bridge circuit driving and phase angle control;a digitally controlled phaseshifted full-bridge driving circuit was designed. TPL521 optocoupler isolation;IR2110 gate driver chip. PWM signals are generated by the DSP and sent to the IR2110 for phase angle control after optocoupler isolation and logic circuits. This text carries on the analysis to the principle of IR2110 drive circuit and parameter design;set up and give out some code to TMS320F28335. The experimental results show that the PWM waveforms with different phase angles generated by TMS320F28335 can meet the requirements of phase-shifted full-bridge control for different phase angles.
keywords: ir2110, phase angle control, phase-shifted full-bridge, tms320f28335

title: Design of activity monitoring system for layers based on WSN
abstract: 【Objective】A real-time activity monitoring system based on wireless sensor network（WSN）was designed;which could provide technical support for determining the health status of layer by studying the activity changes.【Method】On the terminal node;the ADXL345 accelerometer was used to collect the activity data;and the data was processed and transmitted by CC2530 as the core. A backpack type wearing was designed for the layer’s body. Low-powerconsumption Zig Bee protocol for wireless communications was adopted;Visual Studio 2012 and SQL ServerⅡ2008 were used in upper computer to design monitoring and management terminal.【Result】The monitoring system designed in this study could meet the communication requirements in a 50.0 m×6.0 m×3.5 m henhouse;and the average packet loss rate during testing was only 0.19%. A certain degree of stress response was observed within 6 h after the five layers were wearing terminal nodes. After 24 h monitoring;the monitoring system only lost 3 and 11 data packets on the No.1 layer and No.4 layer respectively. By comparing the monitoring images;the monitoring system was applied to the layers. Acceleration of activity;egg production and during sleep could all be accurately captured and displayed.【Suggestion】The following suggestions were proposed:further optimizing the size of the terminal node and wearing material to improve wearing comfort;strengthening the stability of network communication to obtain more accurate data of activity;increasing the classification algorithm to identify the diseases of layer;and alarm the epidemic prevention.
keywords: activity, layers, monitoring device, wireless sensor network（wsn）
authors: HOU Ruo-yi;HUANG Yong-kai;LIU Xiu-lin;LU Hui-shan;LIU Ye-hong

title: Design and implementation of a vocoder based on TMS320F28335
abstract: In order to meet the demand of the low-rate speech communication;a multi-rate vocoder is designed using TMS320 f28335 DSP. The vocoder can implement three kinds of speech compression algorithms in real time at the rate of 2.4 kb/s;1.2 kb/s and 0.6 kb/s. The composed voice of low bit rate vocoders usually have occasionally hoarseness; out-of-tone speech. Hence voiced-unvoiced classification is improved using Support Vector Machine combined with several characteristic parameters.On-chip memory shortage is another significant issue in DSPs of most vocoders;therefore;external FLASH is always needed. However;TMS320 f28335 DSP meets the storage requirements of multi-rate voice codec algorithm without additional memory design. Moreover;this vocoder has certain advantages in power consumption;size and cost. In addition;due to the unique hardware interface control;it is easy to achieve rate conversion;which greatly improves the vocoder flexibility and scope of application. The test results show that the speech synthesized by the multi-rate vocoder is clear and natural;and the vocoder shows better capability applied to actual communication system.
keywords: multi-rate vocoder, selp, svm, tms320f28335
affiliations: China Electronic Technology Group Corporation No.58 Research Institute

title: Wireless sensor network design based on CC2530 and SIM900A
abstract: Wireless sensor network is designed based on CC2530 and SIM900 A. Temperature and humidity sensor;carbon dioxide sensor and light sensor is connected to wireless module CC2530 respectively to constitute sensor network terminal nodes;measuring the temperature and humidity;carbon dioxide and light;and transferring the measured data to the coordinator node of the wireless sensor network through the routing node. The coordinator node then storage;analysis and process the received data. SIM900 A is connected to the coordinator node to realize the long-distance transmission of the data;and send the warning message to the user’s mobile phone when the collected environment data exceeds the alarm threshold that set by the user. The experimental results show that the wireless sensor network is fully functional;easy to install;stable and reliable;and can measure the temperature and humidity;carbon dioxide concentration and light intensity accurately.
keywords: cc2530, data acquisition, sim900a, wireless sensor network
affiliations: Tianjin Meteorological Observation Centre

title: Application of TMS320C6678 in radar imaging
abstract: The synthetic aperture radar signal processing platform;which based on the multicore digital signal processor（DSP）TMS320 C6678 and field programmable gate array（FPGA）;is designed. And the imporoved radar real-time imaging algorithm is implemented on this platform. According to the characters of DSP and radar imaging;the algorithm will be optimized further on structure and parallel processing. Experimental results show that the system achieved continuous real-time imaging of radar echoes. But also through parallel or improved algorithm;the system can also be applied to interferometric synthetic aperture radar signal processing or radar guidance system.
keywords: multi-core parallel processing, range-doppler algorithm, real-time processing, tms320c6678
affiliations: China Xi’an Satellite Control Center

title: 基于蓝牙和红外传感器的报警装置设计
abstract: 蓝牙无线通信技术因其功耗低、开放性和安全性的特点;在信息通信技术中得到了广泛的应用。文章以CC2540低功耗蓝牙模块为核心;结合PIR人体红外传感器设计了一个危险位置报警装置。

affiliations: 南京机电职业技术学院

title: Microchip Power Supply Circuit Based on Solar Photovoltaic Battery Module
abstract: The use of wireless communication technology to achieve solar photovoltaic components of the current;voltage;temperature and other important data collection;transmission;aggregation;the general must be installed data acquisition and communication control circuit board in the solar PV module board.The main working voltage of the microchip on the circuit board is about 3.3 volts.If the solar photovoltaic cell module is used to generate electric power for the microchip;it is necessary to study and design a special power supply circuit.The circuit must have a suitable input voltage range;to ensure that the output of the low voltage unchanged;high efficiency;consider the full use of micro-chip resources;simplify the design and reduce costs.In this paper;an adaptive wide dynamic power supply circuit is designed for CC2530 microchip design.The circuit utilizes the MCU in CC2530 chip to generate PWM control to realize power supply control and obtain stable 3.3 V output voltage value to solve the solar PV module data acquisition circuit board safe and stable power supply problem.Its innovation lies in the realization of a CC2530 chip to collect data;wireless communications and power management purposes;simplifying the circuit;eliminating the need for the traditional use of independent DC-DC power supply module.Experiments show that the adaptive wide dynamic power supply circuit based on CC2530 chip design has high working efficiency and stable output voltage.
keywords: circuit design, microchip, photovoltaic cell module, power supply, solar energy
authors: HUANG Dingyi;ZHONG Wanxiong;XU Pengfei;YAO Zhiwei;ZHU Li

title: 一种基于TI-CC2530+GPRS技术的挡土墙变形监测系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞本文设计了一款基于TI-CC2530+GPRS技术的挡土墙变形监测系统;系统主要由实时监测模块;网络通讯模块;云服务器平台及太阳能供电模块组成。实时监测设备主要包括四个激光测距模块以及角度传感器等。网络通讯模块系统设计多个监测点间的测量数据利用ZigBee进行无线传输;利用ZigBee协议栈将所有测量设备联网;所有的监测数据都发送到ZigBee协调器进行数据处理。利用协调器+GPRS的模式与云服务器之间进行数据交互;用户可以实时监

title: 基于zigbee的压力传感器数据采集系统设计
abstract: ＜正＞本文设计了一种基于zigbee的压力传感器数据采集系统;该系统采用CC2530微处理器;结合zigbee协议栈Z-Stack;实现压力数据通过zigbee网络自动采集。压力传感器的输出信号通过16位的高精度∑-?型AD7705进行模数转换;协调器节点收到的数据能够通过AT24C04进行存储;达到掉电保存。整个系统稳定可靠;更换不同的传感器;可轻松实现不同应用需求。

title: 基于ZigBee的宿舍管理系统
abstract: ZigBee宿舍管理系统是基于ZigBee协议;以CC2530为主控制器;将每个宿舍视为一个终端节点;由协调器组成网络;通过接收每个节点传来的传感器数据并与上位机进行串口通信;使得管理人员可以实时监测和控制所有的终端节点;从而实现宿舍管理智能化。

title: Design of K Band Frequency Source based on LMX2594
abstract: A design method of the K-band frequency source is introduced in this paper.The chip of LMX2594 Digital PLL is used in this paper;C8051F330MCU is used to do operation in the PLL chip;and then multipliers it to achieve the K-band frequency source;which has lots of characteristics;such as high frequency stability;low phase noise and low spurs.The test results show that:the phase noise of the frequency source is-90dBc@1kHz;-98dBc@10kHz;the power level of the output greater than 10 dBm;which can meet the requirements of the system.
keywords: frequency synthesizer, k-band, phase noise, pll, spurs
affiliations: Chengdu University of Information Technology

title: 基于Zstack协议栈的无线网络终端设计
abstract: 如同大众所知道的;人类的文明、工业和科技经历了几个革命性的阶段。1776年;詹姆斯·瓦特制造了第一台具有实用价值的蒸汽机;这是第一次工业革命的重要标志;也为今后的工业发展奠下了基础。1946年;世界上第一台电子数字式计算机在宾夕法尼亚大学投入运行;它不仅预示着人类已经步入电子时代;也代表了智慧的延伸;计算机的出现全面加快了工业与科技的发展。在无线通信领域;Zibgee技术也取得了很大的成功。本设计是基于Zigbee技术的无线网络终端节点软件设计与开发;设计中移植了Zstack协议栈并组建了树形网络;成功完成温湿度节点、可燃气体浓度检测节点以及继电器节点的程序设计和测试。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, zstack

title: Temperature and Humidity Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
abstract: Based on the ZigBee wireless transmission technology;the system chooses the intelligent solution of TI company;taking CC2530 as the control core. It realizes the data acquisition of temperature and humidity through DTH11 sensor. The MySQL database is used to store the temperature and humidity information; and the functions of server side data display; query and dynamic analysis are realized. In addition; users can send control commands remotely on servers and mobile application terminals by preset thresholds; change the level signals of the corresponding I/O ports; and automatically call control modules to adjust the state of devices such as relays; infrared transmitters; etc. In order to change the heating; cooling; drying and humidifying state of the controlled appliances; the remote operation of the temperature and humidity monitoring system is completed.
keywords: control module, dth11, level signal, server side, threshold value, zigbee

title: Design of Large Capacity Memory Based on DSP and NAND Flash
abstract: For the problem that a large number of key data need to be stored safely and quickly in engineering application;a large-capacity memory based on DSP is designed in this paper.Samsung K9 FAG08 U0 M NAND Flash is selected as the storage medium and TMS320 F28335 DSP as the controller.After analyzing the structure and pins of NAND Flash;the DSP and NAND Flash connection program is designed.Implementing the function to erase;read and write with C language.The circuit board is designed and implemented;and the data acquisition and storage experiments are carried out.
keywords: flash, large capacity storing, read-write operation, tms320f28335
affiliations: 西安石油大学电子工程学院

title: Research on the Time Synchronization Method of GIS Partial Discharge Wireless Monitoring System Based on Physical Layer Time Capturing
abstract: In GIS partial discharge wireless monitoring system;time synchronization is an important segment. How-ever;current synchronization methods cannot satisfy the requirement of wireless system in several ways. In this arti-cle;the uncertain delays in wireless system are eliminated and a new synchronization method is proposed based onphysical layer time capturing. Then an experiment platform is built based on CC2530 and TCXO and electromagneticinterference is analyzed. Finally;capturing delay is confirmed to 4 microseconds. After the synchronization is cor-rected;the result is obtained: the single-synchronization error is sub-nanosecond and the accumulated drift in pathwith time is about 1×10-6. With theoretical analysis and experiment;the method in this article satisfies the time accu-racy requirement and can be applied in wireless monitoring system flexibly.
keywords: cc2530, gis partial discharge, physical layer time capturing, tcxo, time synchronization, wireless monitoring
authors: WANG Xin;WU Xinan;ZHENG Yihui;ZHAO Jianming;CHEN Hongtao;LI Lixue
affiliations: Center of Electrical ＆ Electronic Technology,Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Songyuan Power Supply Company,Jilin Electric Power Co.,Ltd.

title: Design of a portable wireless toxic gas detector
abstract: To improve the environmental monitoring of hot work; put forward to STM32 L151 C8 T6 low-power microcontroller as the core of the portable toxic gas detector.Use electric chemical gas sensor to test the toxic gas; using the cc1101 the high-performance transceiver to realize wireless data transmission function.Using USB interface for data upload and charging function.Put forward the detector in the design of hardware and software.After the experimental debugging; suggesting that the toxic gas detection precision is in line with the national standard requirements; has a very high application value in petrochemical and other fields.
keywords: electrochemistry, stm32l151rbt6, toxic gases, wireless communication
affiliations: College of Computer and Control Engineering, Qiqihar University, Harbin East Alarm Equipment Development Co.,LTD
source: Journal of Qiqihar University(Natural Science Edition).

title: Investigation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor System Used in Electric Vehicles Based on Space Vector Modulation
abstract: Considering the higher harmonic distortion and higher torque ripple caused by traditional PWM strategy when applied to electric vehicles;a permanent magnet synchronous motor system based on space vector pulse width modulation strategy for electric vehicle application was designed. The principle of space vector pulse-width modulation is described in detail;and the vector control system for PMSM was set up in MATLAB/Simulink. The id= 0 control strategy was used;and the system dynamic response was simulated. Digital signal processor（ DSP） TMS320 F28335 of TI company was used as the main control chip to set up the experimental platform. The system status and efficiency below the base speed was studied in experiments. The simulation results and the experimental results show a good consistency. It provides practical value to PMSM system design and analysis.
keywords: control strategy, dsp tms320f28335, matlab/simulink, pmsm（permanent magnet synchronous motor）, vector control
affiliations: College of Electrical Engineering,Zhejiang University

title: Integrated application technology of power Internet of things chip
abstract: According to the information needs of the current power equipment acquisition operation;combined with networking technology at present;puts forward a chip based networking power of integrated system;through the integrated module;to complete the operation data of power equipment acquisition.In this regard;the operation of electric power equipment to equipment in common temperature data acquisition as the research object;using MSP430 as the main control chip core processing temperature data;using CC2530 as the RF output module;SHT10 temperature sensor;the temperature of the electric power network integrated acquisition system was constructed;and mainly from the Perspective of hardware and software on the construction of.Finally;through the above design;the simple test of the integrated system is carried out to verify the feasibility of the integrated system in power data acquisition.
keywords: msp430, power internet of things, radio frequency, system construction, temperature acquisition
affiliations: Guangdong power grid co.,LTD foshan buddhist city power supply bureau

title: The smart home system based on Zigbee mesh network
abstract: For the traditional smart home system;the problems caused by the failure of the terminal are caused by the failure of the gateway and the lack of signal strength;a smart home system based on ZigBee wireless mesh networking is studied;the system is mainly composed of terminal nodes;coordinators and upper planes;CC2530 is used as the main control chip of the coordinator and terminal node. The coordinator connects with the upper machine through the RS485 interface;the Zigbee wireless network is established to receive the data collected by each terminal sensor and send the feedback information to the upper or forward coordinators to the terminal nodes;the terminal node is assigned a short address to determine which terminal is sending the data.In the simulation experiment;you can use a bit machine to monitor the lighting and air conditioning use of each room and determine whether the temperature is too high;controling the corresponding relay to achieve fire warning function and control of lighting and air conditioning.
keywords: mesh networking, smart home, the terminal node, zigbee coordinator
affiliations: Hubei Video Image and HD Projection Engineering Technology Research Center, Wuhan Institute of Technology

title: Design of Kindergarten Children Supervision System Based on Internet of Things Technology
abstract: For the frequent safety hazards in kindergarten;many children are caused by slow rescue or failure to contact rescuers in a timely manner. We research on an efficient monitoring system for kindergarten children based on internet of things technology;it includes the hardware design of STM32 host system;sensor layer circuit;and communication network layer circuit. Using the internet of things technology to build an monitoring system with two layers of architecture. Chip CC2530 with sensor interconnection make up the sensor layer and it as RF chip to build short range network communication layer;GPRS and 4 G technologies build the remote network communication layer. Using the data processing module circuit collection pulse pressure and temperature;the sensing layer physiological signal preprocessing and extract the feature parameters to the host system and make a preliminary judgment;the judgment results by the gateway to the PC and early warning. Through the experiment;teachers and parents can grasp the children’s location information and physical and mental status in real-time;realizing the effective monitoring and early warning of the entire monitoring system.
keywords: efficient monitoring, physiological data, security risks, telecommunication

title: Design of Intelligent Access Control Teaching Demonstration System Based on the CC2530
abstract: The entrance guard system controlled in two ways was designed to meet the teaching needs at the perception layer of the Internet of things with CC2530 as main control chip;using RFID card and infrared induction of the human body.The experimental model of the system indicates that it can run stably;and work with low cost;low energy consumption and high sensitivity.The application of the system to the professional teaching of the Internet of things can lay agood foundation for subsequent data collection and network learning because it is highly visual and expansible.
keywords: cc2530, infrared detection of human body, intelligent access control, light intensity, radio frequency identification, teaching demonstration system
affiliations: Chuzhou Vocational and Technical College

title: 实时聚合酶链式反应仪中温度传感系统的研制
abstract: 为实时聚合酶链式反应（PCR）仪设计了一个基于数字信号处理器（DSP）芯片TMS320F2812的温度传感系统。在此系统里;用PT100温度传感器设计了一个四线制温度传感模块来测量温度并将其转化为电压信号;利用模数转换器（ADC）模块将电压信号转换为数字信号。最后;这些数据点通过串口传到个人计算机（PC）。实验结果表明该套系统的线性度为0.99;标准差为0.0419。
keywords: 四线制, 实时聚合酶链式反应仪, 恒流源, 温度传感
affiliations: 南昌大学第一附属医院

title: Design of information security intelligent monitoring system for colleges and universities intranet based on Internet of things
abstract: As the traditional monitoring system is affected by signal interference and the application of specific scenes;the accuracy of system monitoring is low.In order to solve this problem;a design of intelligent monitoring system for information security in university intranet based on Internet of things is put forward.According to the whole frame of the system;the hardware structure and software function of the system are designed respectively.The CC2530 model chip is used and the wireless communication technology is used to deal with the nodes in a unified way.According to the processing results;we design terminal sensing;switch and client module to ensure that every information can be perceived by the system under the condition of signal interference.We design the monitoring node flow;active alert and specific scenario application of CC2530 chip.The method of threshold segmentation is used to deal with the data;and the information security and intelligent monitoring of the internal network is realized.The experimental results showed that the maximum precision of the system can reach 92%;which ensures the security of the information of the internal network of the university.
keywords: colleges and universities, intelligence monitoring, internet of things, intranet information, security
affiliations: Department of Experimental Training,Liming Vocational University

title: Dark Field Image Real Time Processing System Based on TMS320C6748
abstract: Based on floating point DSP（TMS320 C6748）processor;we design a dark field image processing system in real time;with discussing the theory and the design method and providing the implementation of the system.On this basis;we make experiments of dark field images acquisition and analysis on gold nanospheres.Stepper motor controls the optical grating rotation of dark field;matching the successive acquisition of dark-field images;Simultaneously;CMOS camera acquires the images;which to be processed by DSP;and then we get the scattering spectra of sample.The experiments show that scattering spectra of gold nanospheres consists with the actual spectral properties of gold nanospheres and the functions and properties of the system reach the expectations.The image processing system accomplishes the real-time processing feature of dark field image;which has great application value on detection of early Tumor;heavy metals;chemical and biological and other fields.
keywords: dark field image, dsp（tms320c6748）, real time processing, scattering spectra
affiliations: Tianjin Key Laboratory of Optoelectronic Sensor and Sensing Network Technology,Nankai University, College of Electronic Information Technology and Optical Engineering,Nankai University

title: Application of network video monitoring system based on embedded platform
abstract: In view of monitoring requirements of many scenes such as important industrial sites around;home security and so on;which is automatic detection of intrusion target;intelligent PTZ control to tracking the movement of moving objects;remote terminal access;an economical;reliable and intelligent network video surveillance system is designed in this paper. The system chooses the embedded platform based on TMS320DM8168 digital media processor of the Da Vinci series as the core;receives video data of network camera through RTP network transmission protocol and then sends data to the network;optimizes the detection and tracking algorithm according to the system application scenarios;and according to the algorithm processing result controls the camera PTZ through the network;to ensure accurate tracking of the moving trajectory of the monitored target. The system solves the problem of automatic intelligent detection and tracking in network monitoring;and has the functions of scalability and product compatibility. The feasibility of the system is verified by the experimental results.
keywords: detection, embedded, network intelligent monitoring, ptz, tracking
affiliations: School of Electronic Information,Sichuan University

title: 基于多特征融合的井盖检测系统实现
abstract: 障碍物检测作为智能辅助驾驶的重要一环得到了广泛关注和研究其中井盖的检测对后续的井盖定位和缺损检测有着不可替代的作用。从宏观特征入手提出一种多特征融合的分类方法首先利用先验知识划定梯形区域限制搜索区间进而通过边缘的连通性锁定候选区域并通过多特征判定快速准确地从背景中提取出井盖位置。该方法在TMS320DM6437平台上进行了系统实现验证了方案的可行性。
keywords: tms320dm6437, 多特征融合, 宏观特征, 梯形区域, 边缘连通
authors: 乔瑞萍;王方;孙贺;董员臣

title: 基于物联网的智慧农业系统
abstract: 该文设计并实现了一个基于物联网的智慧农业生长环境的温度湿度信息集成系统。首先进行了系统构架设计然后进行了设备选型、网络构建及软件设计。通过Zigbee无线传感器节点实现数据的实时感知、传递等功能并利用CC2530无线单片机实现温度和湿度等的处理。实验表明该系统可实现农业种植环境温湿度等数据的采集。系统具有成本低廉控制更简单功耗低组网方便等特点。
keywords: cc2530, zigbee, 传感器, 智慧农业, 物联网
authors: 李道全;朱庆伟;于海洋;张敬增

title: 基于Zigbee技术的家庭成员健康监测系统设计
abstract: This paper designed a set of real-time monitoring family environment health data real-time monitoring system;using Zigbee wireless communication technology to transmit real-time data. And build family health file on the server. People can see their health data at any time;and in the terminal setting health small guards when set index is beyond normal;healthy index will be issued a warning to remind;in order to timely control yourself or your family’s health.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文设计了一套家庭环境人体健康数据实时监测系统;采用Zigbee无线通信技术传送实时数据;并在服务器建立家庭成员健康档案;人们可以随时看到自己的健康数据;并在终端设置健康小卫士;当指标超出设置的正常健康指标值时会发出警告提醒;以便及时掌握自己或者家人的健康情况.
keywords: cc2530, health testing for family members, zigbee
affiliations: Jilin Jianzhu University, School of Electrical and Computer, 吉林建筑大学电气与计算机学院

title: 基于ZigBee技术的物联网时钟系统研究
abstract: A design of the IOT clock system was presented in the paper from 3 perspectives of network formulation;hardware and software. In the system;the IOT network structural model was applied to the clock controller;wherein the short-distance ZigBee wireless transmission technology was used for effective connection between the terminal clock nodes and the gateway equipment to establish the network topology for clock management in a large area in which the clock data will be synchronized strictly. In the meantime;clocks can simply be calibrated by changing the master time and then transmitted to other nodes in the network. The remote clock control system is easy for construction and maintenance due to its easy access;low power consumption and costs as well as the high interference immunity of its terminal nodes.
abstract_in_chinese: 从网络组建、硬件、软件三方面进行物联网时钟系统的设计。该系统在时钟控制器中应用了物联网的网络架构模型;用短距离ZigBee无线传输技术将系统中的终端时钟节点和网关设备有效连接;构建网络拓扑;实现大区域时钟管理;使区域内时钟信息严格同步;同时时钟校正也只需调整主机时间;再通过网络传播给其他节点;远程时钟控制系统中的各个终端节点抗干扰性好;功耗低;成本低;而且操作简单;用户使用方便;易于建设及维护。
keywords: alarm timing, cc2530, clock, hardware, software, zigbee
affiliations: School of Engineering Technology at Fuyang Vocational Technical College, 阜阳职业技术学院工程科技学院

title: 基于DSP串行通信接口开发的研究
abstract: Digital signal processor( DSP) often communicates through serial port in practical application.Therefore;the corresponding modules are often integrated in DSP. Based on the TMS320 F2812 of TI company as a platform;this paper has introduced the SCI module interface;and gives three modes which are query;interruption and FIFO for the serial communication of SCI module in the development. Finally;a specific development case based on FIFO interrupt mode is given;which provides reference and guidance for the actual development.
abstract_in_chinese: 数字信号处理器(DSP)在实际应用中经常通过串口进行通信;因而在DSP中往往会集成相应的模块。以TI公司的TMS320F2812为平台;介绍了其上的SCI模块接口;并给出了基于查询、中断和FIFO这3种方式下SCI模块串口通信的具体开发流程。最后给出了基于FIFO中断模式的具体开发案例;为实际开发提供了借鉴和帮助。
keywords: dsp, interrupt, serial communication interface
affiliations: Xi’an Aeronautics Computing Technique Research Institute, 航空工业西安航空计算技术研究所

title: Design of ZigBee-WiFi Gateway for Vacuum Oven
abstract_in_chinese: In the process of power battery production;it is necessary to put battery into vacuum oven for drying;the temperature;the vacuum degree and other factors directly influence the quality of the power battery. In order to remotely control the temperature and vacuum degree of vacuum oven in the process of power battery manufacturing;the wireless communication system based on the Zig Bee-Wi Fi gateway for the power battery production is presented. The system uses wireless module CC2530 as the core chip;to complete the machine networking in workshop;and use of Wi Fi wireless module ESP8266 to complete data interconnection Zig Bee and Wi Fi network;implement the data information exchange and sharing between the vacuum oven and the Internet.This wireless communication system has the characteristics with easy networking;low power consumption and low cost. So;this communication system can meet the requirement of data transmission and sharing in power battery manufacturing and other production activities.
keywords: battery drying, monitoring system, vacuum oven, wireless communication, zigbee
affiliations: Guangdong University of Technology, School of Information Engineering, School of Information Engineering,Guangdong University of Technology, Guangdong Zhengye Technology Co.,Ltd, Guangdong Zhengye Technology Co.

title: 基于DSP的温度控制系统研究
abstract_in_chinese: 本文利用TI公司的TMS320F28335芯片设计了一种温度控制系统。该系统除了实现温度采集和人机交互等功能外;还采用了具有积分分离的增量式PID调节器;充分发挥DSP芯片浮点运算方便、处理速度快等特点;提高了温度控制的精度;适用于工业生产中需要精确温度控制的仪器或设备。
affiliations: 大屯煤电公司

title: 船用交流中频静止变频电源设计
abstract_in_chinese: 船舶设备对所用电源品质要求较高;不仅要求其精度高、噪声低、效率高;还要具备控制灵活、系统紧凑、稳定性好等优点;400 Hz中频电源就符合了这些要求。文中采用双闭环反馈控制与重复控制相结合的方式;主电路逆变部分采用组合式三相逆变器;设计了基于DSP TMS320F28335的硬件和软件系统。现场调试和实际运行结果表明;所设计的船用交流中频静止变频电源符合设计要求;能够稳定运行;且控制效果良好。

title: 硅微陀螺阵列的滚动时域估计滤波算法研究
abstract: Silicon micro gyroscopes have been widely used in medium-low precision inertial stability platform. The output precision of silicon micro gyroscopes array can be improved by data fusion. Based on Kalman filtering for gyroscopes output;a Moving Horizon Estimation（ MHE） algorithm was studied which made use of several former measurements. The optimal output estimation can be acquired by MHE. Based on the TMS320 F28335 embedded platform;a gyroscope array with 2×2 ADIS16080 was built up. Experiments show that after Kalman filtering;the average variation for single gyroscope output noise is 4.1794 s-2. The variation can be reduced to 4.071 7 s-2 by gyroscope array data fusion. Furthermore;the noise variation after MHE with prediction horizon is 3 can be reduced to 2.127 3 s-2.
abstract_in_chinese: 硅微陀螺在中低精度的惯性稳定平台中具有广泛应用。通过多个硅微陀螺组成阵列;采用数据融合技术可提高硅微陀螺的输出精度。在卡尔曼滤波算法基础上;研究了一种考虑前若干个时刻量测输出值的滚动时域估计（MHE）算法;获得陀螺阵列输出的最优估计。采用2×2的ADIS16080组成陀螺阵列;基于TMS320F28335嵌入式计算平台开展试验研究。试验结果表明;单陀螺输出经卡尔曼滤波后;输出噪声方差的均值为4.179 4 s-2。采用陀螺阵列信息融合后;方差降至4.071 7 s-2。进一步采用预测长度为3的MHE算法可将输出噪声方差减少至2.127 3 s-2。
keywords: drift, gyroscope array, kalman filtering, moving horizon estimation

title: 基于磁感应技术无线地下收发器信号处理算法仿真与实现
abstract: To solve problems such as complicated wireless underground transmission channel and unsatisfactory hardware filtering effect;the paper designs the FIR filtering algorithm that is suitable for wireless underground signal;and presents an improved OOK demodulation algorithm;which replaces the traditional semi-wave or full-wave rectifier with Hilbert transforming algorithm to extract signal envelope. The algorithm is verified feasible through MATLAB emulation;and realized on TMS320 C6748.

title: ZigBee技术在农业物联网中的应用
abstract: This article sets the greenhouse group environment monitoring as an example;elaborating the application of ZigBee technology in agricultural IOT.ZigBee technology not only realizes the network connections between each node;but also improves the automation level of monitoring and control.It is proved by practice that the system has the advantages of stable operation;low energy consumption;convenient control and so on.It can feedback accurately of greenhouse temperature and humidity;illumination and soil conditions;which benefits the use of IOT to take operations on the centralized control;light control and irrigation.This wireless network system is based on the CC2530 Instruments chip of Texas company;realizing the modular monitoring of greenhouse environmental factors;highlighting exhaustively the advantages of ZigBee technology in the agricultural IOT.
abstract_in_chinese: 以温室群环境监测为例;对ZigBee技术在农业物联网中的应用进行阐述。ZigBee技术不仅实现了各节点的组网连接;还提高了监测与控制的自动化性水平。通过实践表明;该系统具有运行稳定、低耗节能、控制方便等优点;能准确反馈温室中温度、湿度、光照、土壤等情况;有利于利用物联网技术进行集中控温、控光、灌溉。该无线网络系统基于Texas Instruments公司的CC2530芯片;实现对温室环境因子的模块式监测;充分凸显ZigBee技术在农业物联网中的优势。
keywords: adhoc network, greenhouse, iot, low power, wireless sensor network, zig bee

title: Wireless geomagnetic parking guidance system based on 2.4GHz
abstract: Purpose—To design a kind of 2.4 GHz wireless geomagnetic parking guidance system to solve the problems that cars are difficult to park.Methods-In order to release parking spaces on the screen in real time;the geomagnetic sensor is utilized in the designed system to detect the status of parking spaces and ZigBee technology to achieve transmission.Besides;MAG3110 is used as the magnetic detector to detect whether the parking spaces are free and CC2530 as the main chip to achieve information transmission.Results and Conclusions-The proposed scheme is proved to be reasonable and effective by experiments.The parking system can help car owners know about faster and more accurately the information where there are free parking spaces;thus reducing the time to look for parking spaces and effectively improving the utilization rate of the parking spaces.
abstract_in_chinese: 目的针对停车难的问题;设计一种2.4GHz的无线地磁停车引导系统。方法该系统利用地磁传感器来检测车位的状态使用ZigBee技术实现传输实时在屏幕上发布停车场车位情况。系统中使用MAG3110作为地磁探测器来检测车位是否空闲;CC2530为主控制芯片实现信息传输。结果与结论通过实验验证了该方案的合理性和有效性;可更快更准确地获知车位空闲信息;减少车主寻找车位时间;有效提高停车场的利用率。
keywords: geomagnetism, sensor, zigbee
affiliations: 宝鸡文理学院计算机学院

title: Research on Underground Pipeline Monitoring System Based on ZigBee and GPRS
abstract: In order to make the underground pipeline facilities were detected before destruction;and timely notify the emergency maintenance personnel;design a kind of underground pipeline based on Zig Bee wireless sensor network security monitoring system.Monitoring system controlled by the PC machine;on the basis of CC2530 center node and sensor node;sensor module;GPRS communication module.On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of underground pipeline safety monitoring system;determine the long linear topological structure;set up a central control node and 5 wireless sensor nodes of wireless sensor network;designed the sound sensor and vibration sensor node hardware circuit.Effect of the running situation of the designed system test;the test results show that the monitoring system is running in good condition;can carry on the real-time vibration monitoring of pipeline;accurately reflect the vibration of the pipeline surrounding and promptly report to the police.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了使地下管线设施在遭受破坏之前就被监测到;并能及时通知应急维护人员;设计了一种基于ZigBee无线传感网络的地下管线安全监测系统。监测系统由上位PC机、基于CC2530的中心控制节点和传感器节点、传感器模块、GPRS通信模块组成。在分析地下管线安全监测系统特点的基础上;确定采用长直线型拓扑结构;搭建了具有1个中心控制节点和5个无线传感器节点的无线传感器网络;设计了声音传感器和震动传感器节点的硬件电路。对所设计系统的运行情况进行了效果测试;测试结果表明该监测系统运行状况良好;能够对管线进行实时振动监测;准确反映出管线周边的振动并及时报警。
keywords: cc2530, gprs, underground pipeline, wireless sensor network, zigbee

title: Design and Implementation of the Wireless ECG Monitor Based on AD8232 and CC2530
abstract: Based on the heart rate monitor front end AD8232 chips and Zigbee system solutions CC2530 single chip; the wireless ECG monitor has been realized in order to implement the acquisition; processing and wireless transmission of electrocardiogram signal. Meanwhile; the real-time heart rate has been calculated and wirelessly transmitted. The wireless ECG monitor is characterized by low power consumption; small size and simple operation. It can be seen from the experimental results that the wireless ECG monitor designed in this paper can successfully obtain favorable ECG data and real-time heart rate data and display it.【 Abstract 】
abstract_in_chinese: 基于心电模拟前端AD8232芯片和Zigbee片上系统解决方案CC2530单片机;该文实现了无线心电监护仪;以实现对心电模拟信号的采集、处理和无线发送;并实现了实时心率的计算和无线传输。该无线心电监护仪具有低功耗;小体积;操作简单等特点。实验结果显示它能够获取较好心电波形数据并实时显示心率数据。

title: Design of Energy Saving Household PM2.5 Monitor
abstract: In view of the increasingly serious air pollution;people pay more and more attention to the health of the human body.In this paper;we designed a household-friendly energy-saving PM2. 5 monitor to meet the needs of ordinary residents to understand the air quality. The design is based on the IAR development environment by utilizing the CC430 F5137 low power mode;CC1101 low power RF;timing wakeup algorithm;sensor detection;low power consumption segment LCD display and other key technologies to achieve the timing of PM2. 5 data acquistion;the wireless transmission;and timely update and display. The practice shows that the overall design achieves the effect of energy saving and realizes the purpose of home use. Meanwhile;the energy-saving design can provide some reference to the similar products in the design of low-power.
abstract_in_chinese: 由于大气污染情况愈发严重;人们越来越重视人体的健康状况;该文设计了一款适合家用的节能型PM2.5监测仪;以满足普通居民对空气质量了解的需求。该设计基于IAR开发环境;应用CC430F5137低功耗工作模式、CC1101低功耗RF、定时唤醒算法、传感器检测和低功耗段式液晶显示等关键技术;实现了对PM2.5数据的定时采集、无线传输和定时更新显示。实践表明;整体设计达到了节能的效果;实现了家用的目的;同时;该节能型设计也能为同类产品在低功耗设计上提供一定的参考。
keywords: low power consumption, monitor, pm2.5, timed wake-up, wireless transmission
authors: Zhou Zhipeng;Xu Zhen;Song Qiuyun;Wang Zhichao;Ding Yi;Deng Kailian

title: The design and implementation of video surveillance system based on Davinci technology
abstract: Based on Davinci dual core embedded development platform;a set of intelligent monitoring system is designed. The system uses TI’s TMS320 DM6467 as the core processor;embedded Linux operating system;and uses the multi thread programming way to realize video capture;detection and tracking;video display;performance testing and other functions;the software structure is clear;easy to maintain and easy to expand. The results show that the system runs stably;the surveillance video is smooth;the modules are running normally;the accurate acquisition of moving targets is achieved;and the design requirements are achieved.
abstract_in_chinese: 基于Davinci双核嵌入式开发平台设计了一套智能监控系统。系统采用TI公司的TMS320DM6467作为核心处理器;嵌入式Linux操作系统;并采用多线程程序设计方式实现了视频采集、检测与跟踪、视频显示、性能测试等功能;软件框架结构清晰;便于维护且易于扩展。实测结果表明系统运行稳定;监控视频流畅;各模块运行正常;实现对运动目标的准确捕获;达到设计要求。

title: The system of gateway for collecting wireless data based on CC2530
abstract: A system of gateway for collecting wireless data based on CC2530 was introduced in this article;which was composed of the gateway of ethernet transfers to ZigBee and the gateway of ZigBee transfers to BS-485.This system can realize information pathways from the underlying of RS-485 bus devices to ZigBee to ethernet.Adopted CC2530 module and ADM2483 to compose the circuits of terminal collection in order to transfer the gateway of RS485 to ZigBee.The circuit of terminal collection is specific to connect industrial electronic equipment;such as Smart meters.While the gateway of ethernet transfers to ZigBee adopting CC2530 and serial-ethernet-Wi-Fi module;meanwhile upload the data to ethernet by wireless network directly.This system of gateway can install in industrial environment;which is needed to be upgraded urgently;which has great application prospects in the future.
abstract_in_chinese: 本文介绍了一套基于CC2530的无线数据采集网关系统。该系统由以太网转ZigBee网关和ZigBee转RS-485网关组成;实现了从底层RS-485总线设备到ZigBee再到以太网的信息通路。RS485转ZigBee网关方面采用CC2530模块与ADM2483组成终端采集电路;专用于连接工业电子设备;如智能电表。而以太网转ZigBee网关方面;采用CC2530与串口-以太网-wifi模块;通过有线网络直接将数据上传至以太网。该套网关可以直接加装于亟待升级改造的工业环境中;实现工业物联网;极具应用前景。
keywords: cc2530, wireless data acquisition, zigbee

title: Development and Test of Mine Water Quality Online Monitoring System Based on Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: At present;some problems of the identification process of mine water source type;such as artificial sampling;high labor intensity;long period of data analysis;still exist.It is necessary to design a new mine water quality monitoring systems based on wireless sensor networks.The proposed system consists of sensor nodes;sink node and the ground monitoring station.The sensor nodes obtain data of mine water temperature;pH value and conductivity;which uses Atmega128 as the processing core.The communication modules uses CC2530 chip and its periphery circuits to receive and send data to the sink node.The ground monitoring station gets the data from the sink node from RS232 serial port.The system software consists of two parts;the node software and monitoring software.The node software;which is compiled using C Language in IAR Embedded Workbench;can complete data acquisition and processing.The monitoring software;which is compiled using C#;can provide administrators with a visual image of realtime data monitoring platform.The tests show that the system operates stability and high reliability.
abstract_in_chinese: 为解决目前矿井水源类型识别人工采样、劳动强度大;数据分析周期长等问题;构建了基于无线传感网络的矿井水质在线监测系统;该系统由传感器节点、协调器节点和地面监控主机构成。传感器节点采用Atmega128处理器实时采集矿井水温度、pH值和电导率信息;通过无线通信模块CC2530直接发送给协调器节点;协调器节点通过串口将数据上传给地面监控主机。节点软件以IAR为开发环境;采用单片机C语言开发实现数据处理和传输。监测软件以C#程序开发直观的实时数据监控平台。通过现场测试表明;系统运行稳定;可靠性高。
keywords: conductivity, mine water quality monitoring, ph value, wireless networks

title: Design of an On-line High Frequency Digital Control Uninterruptible Power System
abstract: Based on the digital signal processer of TMS320 F28335 and the complex programmable logic device that EPM7256 AETC100; a novel digital control scheme for an on-line high frequency uninterruptible power system(UPS); which consists of an active power factor correction unit; a battery charging and discharging unit; an inverter; a control unit; an auxiliary power supply and a human-machine interface; is designed in this paper. Firstly; the structure and work principle of this UPS are described. Then; the key digital control technologies such as the dual half-wave power factor correction(PFC); the double-loop control strategy using proportional-resonant(PR) regulator for the inverter; the decoupled double synchronous reference frame phase-locked loop(DDSRF-PLL) are discussed detailedly. Finally; a series of experiments are conducted; and the results verify that the proposed scheme has high feasibility and reliability.
abstract_in_chinese: 设计了一种基于DSP芯片TMS320F28335和CPLD控制器EPM7256AETC100的高频数字化在线式交流不间断电源(Uninterruptible Power Supply;UPS)系统;系统集有源功率因数校正、电池充放电、逆变、控制、辅助电源及人机界面等单元于一体。本文详细讨论了系统总体方案设计;介绍了基于双半波BOOST变换器的功率因数校正、基于PR控制器的逆变器双环控制、基于解耦双同步坐标系的单相锁相环等关键技术;并完成了2k VA样机设计和性能指标测试;实验和仿真结果验证了该设计方案的可行性和样机系统的可靠性。
keywords: double-loop control, high frequency and digital control, on-line ups, phase-locked loop, power factor correction

title: Research on smart grid monitoring system based on Internet of Things
abstract: With the continuous upgrading and development of power system; the area and population of power system service are becoming wider and wider. Therefore; the power system is required to have high fault tolerance.Strengthening the effective monitoring of the stability; reliability and security of smart grid is of great significance to improve the service quality of power system. The intelligent monitoring system with three layer system structure was constructed based on IOT technology. CC2530-F256 was used as RF chip ZigB ee to build the underlying data sensing layer and GPRS and 4 G technology were used to construct communication network layer with relational data as the data storage layer to achieve the efficient operation of the whole intelligent monitoring system.
abstract_in_chinese: 随着电力系统的不断升级发展;电力系统服务的地区和人群也越来越广和越来越多;因此要求电力系统具备极高的容错性。加强对智能电网的稳定性、可靠性和安全性的有效监控对提升电力系统的服务质量具有非常重要的意义。采用物联网技术构建三层体系结构的智能监控系统;以CC2530-F256作为ZigBee射频芯片构建底层数据传感层;采用GPRS和4G技术构建通信网络层;以关系型数据作为上层的数据存储层;从而实现整个智能监控系统的高效运行。
keywords: internet of things, monitoring system, power system, smart grid

title: Research on Human Motion Recognition Based on GRNN and PNN
abstract: In this paper; GRNN and PNN were presented to realize motion detection using development board;which includes MPU6050 sensing triaxial accelerometer data;CC2541 collecting triaxial accelerometer data.The data were transferred to MATLAB via serial communication.The noise were filtered with the help of wavelet analysis and got the main valid data.The features of the motion signal were extracted in frequency domain and time domain; and we got 6 major motion’s features.Different combination of characteristics also have been used in order to comfirm which one was best.According to sinmulation results;GRNN’s recognition rates achieves 90.1% and PNN is 91.6% and the run time was all less than 1 second.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出了一种利用由MPU6050和CC2541组合的开发板;运用GRNN和PNN实现运动姿态的识别。MPU6050测出三轴加速度的原始数据;CC2541用来采集三轴加速度数据;并通过串口传输到上位机MATLAB端;对原始数据主要的处理方法是通过MATLAB进行小波变换;滤除噪声;得到三轴加速度数据主体部分;并在上位机端编写了提取特征点;特征点在时域和频域各取三个;共有六个特征点;进行运动姿态的识别判断。在特征点的选用上利用算法比较了不同的特征点的组合;得到一个最优结果。在上位机端编写GRNN和PNN的程序;可以运行出准确度;运行时间;得到GRNN的准确度为90.1%;PNN的准确度为91.6%;运行时间均在1秒以下。
keywords: cc2541, grnn, motion detection, mpu6050, pnn

title: Design of Shock Wave Test System Based on Android and WiFi
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings that the preparatory work was tedious and the mobility was poor in the current shock wave testing methods such as lead electrical measurement method and storage test method; in this paper; a shock wave testing system scheme was proposed based on Android and WiFi. The system uses Android smart phone as the display; processing tool and recorder control terminal of shock wave data waveforms; and the CC3200 chip(TI) is embedded into the memory recorder as WiFi hot spot. The smart phone connects the hot spot; then remotely controls the recorder and reads the data in the recorder through the UDP protocol of Socket mechanism; finally the phone is used to calculate; process and analyze the shock wave data. Multiple tests show that the Android smart phone can accurately control the recorder and read data at high speed in the range of up to 110 m; and the system runs steadily. The system greatly reduces the preparatory work of the test; and it is convenient; fast and strongly practical.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前引线电测法和存储测试法等冲击波测试方法中准备工作繁琐、可移动性差等缺点;文中提出一种基于Android和WiFi冲击波测试系统方案。系统用Android智能手机作为冲击波数据波形的显示、处理工具和记录仪控制终端将CC3200芯片(TI)嵌入到存储记录仪作为WiFi热点。智能手机连接热点;通过Socket机制的UDP协议远程控制记录仪和读取记录仪中的数据;最终利用手机计算、处理和分析冲击波数据。通过多次试验表明;Android智能手机等可以在高达110 m范围内准确控制记录仪且能高速读取数据;系统运行稳定。该系统大大减少了测试前期准备工作;方便快捷、实用性较强。
keywords: android operating system, cc3200 chip, remote control, shock wave recorder, socket, wifi wireless communication

title: Embedded Monitoring and Control System Design for Hydraulic Support in Fully Mechanized Coal Face
abstract: Fully mechanized face hydraulic support embedded pressure monitoring system has been developed.The system has used ZigBee star topology;and built pressure sensing network with STR912 and CC2530.Embedded system STR912 has implanted μC/OS-Ⅱ real-time operating system to achieve multi-task control about pressure data storage;alarm and communication.Tests show;embedded system can reduce the impact of cutting coal dust from hardware level;the pressure test accuracy can be effectively controlled within ±10 kN;Zig Bee wireless transmission packet loss rate less than 0.5%.
abstract_in_chinese: 研制适于综采面液压支架压力监测的嵌入式控制系统。系统采用Zig Bee星型拓扑结构;利用STR912和CC2530搭建支架压力传感网络;在STR912上植入μC/OS-II实时操作系统以实现对压力数据存储、报警和通信等多任务控制。测试表明;嵌入式系统能降低截煤产尘对硬件的影响;其压力测试精度能有效控制在±10 kN内;ZigBee无线传输丢包率低于0.5%。
keywords: embedded monitoring system, fully mechanized face hydraulic support, pressure, zigbee

title: 利用GRNN和PNN对运动姿态的识别研究
abstract: In this paper; GRNN and PNN were presented to realize motion detection using development board;which includes MPU6050 sensing triaxial accelerometer data;CC2541 collecting triaxial accelerometer data.The data were transferred to MATLAB via serial communication.The noise were filtered with the help of wavelet analysis and got the main valid data.The features of the motion signal were extracted in frequency domain and time domain; and we got 6 major motion’s features.Different combination of characteristics also have been used in order to comfirm which one was best.According to sinmulation results;GRNN’s recognition rates achieves 90.1% and PNN is 91.6% and the run time was all less than 1 second.
abstract_in_chinese: 提出了一种利用由MPU6050和CC2541组合的开发板;运用GRNN和PNN实现运动姿态的识别。MPU6050测出三轴加速度的原始数据;CC2541用来采集三轴加速度数据;并通过串口传输到上位机MATLAB端;对原始数据主要的处理方法是通过MATLAB进行小波变换;滤除噪声;得到三轴加速度数据主体部分;并在上位机端编写了提取特征点;特征点在时域和频域各取三个;共有六个特征点;进行运动姿态的识别判断。在特征点的选用上利用算法比较了不同的特征点的组合;得到一个最优结果。在上位机端编写GRNN和PNN的程序;可以运行出准确度;运行时间;得到GRNN的准确度为90.1%;PNN的准确度为91.6%;运行时间均在1秒以下。
keywords: cc2541, grnn, motion detection, mpu6050, pnn

title: 基于Android和WiFi的冲击波测试系统设计
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings that the preparatory work was tedious and the mobility was poor in the current shock wave testing methods such as lead electrical measurement method and storage test method; in this paper; a shock wave testing system scheme was proposed based on Android and WiFi. The system uses Android smart phone as the display; processing tool and recorder control terminal of shock wave data waveforms; and the CC3200 chip(TI) is embedded into the memory recorder as WiFi hot spot. The smart phone connects the hot spot; then remotely controls the recorder and reads the data in the recorder through the UDP protocol of Socket mechanism; finally the phone is used to calculate; process and analyze the shock wave data. Multiple tests show that the Android smart phone can accurately control the recorder and read data at high speed in the range of up to 110 m; and the system runs steadily. The system greatly reduces the preparatory work of the test; and it is convenient; fast and strongly practical.
abstract_in_chinese: 针对目前引线电测法和存储测试法等冲击波测试方法中准备工作繁琐、可移动性差等缺点;文中提出一种基于Android和WiFi冲击波测试系统方案。系统用Android智能手机作为冲击波数据波形的显示、处理工具和记录仪控制终端将CC3200芯片(TI)嵌入到存储记录仪作为WiFi热点。智能手机连接热点;通过Socket机制的UDP协议远程控制记录仪和读取记录仪中的数据;最终利用手机计算、处理和分析冲击波数据。通过多次试验表明;Android智能手机等可以在高达110 m范围内准确控制记录仪且能高速读取数据;系统运行稳定。该系统大大减少了测试前期准备工作;方便快捷、实用性较强。

title: 基于ZigBee和GPRS的地下管线监测系统研究
abstract: In order to make the underground pipeline facilities were detected before destruction;and timely notify the emergency maintenance personnel;design a kind of underground pipeline based on Zig Bee wireless sensor network security monitoring system.Monitoring system controlled by the PC machine;on the basis of CC2530 center node and sensor node;sensor module;GPRS communication module.On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of underground pipeline safety monitoring system;determine the long linear topological structure;set up a central control node and 5 wireless sensor nodes of wireless sensor network;designed the sound sensor and vibration sensor node hardware circuit.Effect of the running situation of the designed system test;the test results show that the monitoring system is running in good condition;can carry on the real-time vibration monitoring of pipeline;accurately reflect the vibration of the pipeline surrounding and promptly report to the police.
abstract_in_chinese: 为了使地下管线设施在遭受破坏之前就被监测到;并能及时通知应急维护人员;设计了一种基于ZigBee无线传感网络的地下管线安全监测系统。监测系统由上位PC机、基于CC2530的中心控制节点和传感器节点、传感器模块、GPRS通信模块组成。在分析地下管线安全监测系统特点的基础上;确定采用长直线型拓扑结构;搭建了具有1个中心控制节点和5个无线传感器节点的无线传感器网络;设计了声音传感器和震动传感器节点的硬件电路。对所设计系统的运行情况进行了效果测试;测试结果表明该监测系统运行状况良好;能够对管线进行实时振动监测;准确反映出管线周边的振动并及时报警。

title: Design of arc welding power source based on DSP control
abstract: Current research status of arc welding power supply;digital and intelligent welding power supply is the development trend of modern market economy competition.DSP control unit;which is characterized by digital control;is introduced;to further enhance the performance of welding power source. In this paper;a digital arc welding power source based on TMS320 F2812 chip DSP control is proposed;which is based on the safety and reliability of the digital arc welding power source.Experiment shows that by the PWM generation circuit;the dynamic characteristics of the circuit and the sampling circuit of the main control circuit;so that the whole arc welding power supply can be stable and reliable work.
abstract_in_chinese: 综合目前弧焊电源的研究现状;数字化和智能化的焊接电源是现代市场经济竞争的发展趋势。其中以数字控制为特点的DSP控制单元的引入;进一步提升了焊接电源的性能。文中提出了一种基于DSP芯片TMS320F2812控制的数字弧焊电源依据安全、可靠的目的进行分析设计。实验表明;由PWM产生电路、动态特性电路及采样电路组成的主控制电路;使得整个弧焊电源能够稳定、可靠的工作。
